attrs.description: headScanPhotoSet: required list of up to 5 photo items { stagedRef, or scanRef with photoIndex, viewHint? } (REQ-002-038). A scanRef item is copied, never moved or replaced. The V1 request carries no other media; visual evidence is validated and stored by FR-003.

nodes.title: Required fields complete

attrs.description: Key attribute 'required fields completeness': whether every field the FR-025 template requires is answered.

nodes.title: Responses

attrs.description: Questionnaire responses, an object keyed by questionId per FR-025. Absent on a media-only call (REQ-002-047).

nodes.title: Template set

attrs.description: templateSetId (string): the FR-025 questionnaire set the patient answered (REQ-002-037, REQ-002-041). Absent on a media-only call.

nodes.title: Template version

attrs.description: templateVersion (string): the questionnaire template version the patient answered. Any version that is, or at some time was, designated Active for Inquiry is accepted and recorded; every other version is rejected (REQ-002-037). Absent on a media-only call.

nodes.title: Intake processing result

attrs.description: What the intake engine returns for one request: normalized payload, alerts, media reference and audit identifiers. Links to the stored media artifact and the audit entry. Carries the template and ruleset versions used.

nodes.title: Normalized payload

attrs.description: normalizedPayload: the normalized questionnaire responses (responsesNormalized in the response contract). Absent on a media-only call.

nodes.title: Processed at

attrs.description: processedAt: when the run happened; copy of the audit entry value.

nodes.title: Processing ID

attrs.description: processingId: identifies one processing run; issued to every submit attempt, also a rejected one (REQ-002-052); copy of the audit entry value.

nodes.title: Refund ladder and fee settings

attrs.description: One global record (Screen 7): refund ladder bands, late payment fee, rescheduling fee, balance due days, unpaid balance cancellation point, Hairline share of a patient cancellation fee, patient confirmation window, and the settlement period with its cutoff day and payout day for manually paid clinics. Read by FR-006, FR-007, FR-007B, FR-015 and FR-017.

nodes.title: Clinic cancellation deduction

attrs.description: Fixed amount above 0 deducted from a clinic's next payout when the clinic cancels, stated in the Fee Currency and stored together with its currency code. No starting value; may be Not set, in which case no deduction is made. Re-entered in the new currency after a Default Currency change. FR-017 reads it. Applies on the day of the cancellation.

nodes.title: Balance due days

attrs.description: Days before the procedure date that the balance of the deposit-now, balance-later option is due. Default 7. Whole number, 1 to 30. Locked at booking confirmation as a balance due date stored on the booking.

nodes.title: Fee currency

attrs.description: Currency in which the fixed late payment fee, the fixed rescheduling fee and the clinic cancellation deduction are stated. It is set to the system default currency when the first fixed amount is saved, and every stored fixed amount keeps its own currency code from then on. After a Default Currency change it moves to the new default only in a save in which every fixed amount that is set has been re-entered in the new currency; until then Screen 7 cannot be saved. A currency in use as the Fee Currency cannot be disabled.

nodes.title: Hairline share of patient cancellation fee

attrs.description: Percentage 0-100 of a patient cancellation fee kept by Hairline; the rest goes to the clinic. No starting value; may be Not set, in which case Hairline keeps the whole fee and holders of the Screen 7 permission see a banner on the admin dashboard asking them to set it, which clears when the share is saved. Applies on the day of the cancellation.

nodes.title: Late payment fee type

attrs.description: How the late payment fee is calculated: fixed amount or percentage. Not set until a value is set; required once a value is set.

nodes.title: Late payment fee value

attrs.description: Value of the late payment fee. Starts as Not set; no fee is charged while it is not set. Fixed amount above 0 in the Fee Currency, stored and locked together with its currency code, precision per its minor units, converted via USD with the rate set locked at quote acceptance; or a percentage above 0 and up to 100 of the late installment. Locked at booking confirmation.

nodes.title: Patient confirmation window

attrs.description: Days after a clinic marks a procedure complete during which the patient may raise a problem before the clinic share is released. Default 7; whole number from 1 to 30. Applies on the day of the event.

nodes.title: Refund ladder

attrs.description: Bands of days before the procedure date and the refund percentage for each (0-100). Launch default: more than 30 days 90, 15 to 30 days 50, under 15 days 0. Every number of days falls in exactly one band. Locked at booking confirmation.

nodes.title: Rescheduling fee type

attrs.description: How the rescheduling fee is calculated: fixed amount or percentage. Not set until a value is set; required once a value is set.

nodes.title: Rescheduling fee value

attrs.description: Value of the rescheduling fee. Starts as Not set; no fee is charged while it is not set. Fixed amount above 0 in the Fee Currency, stored and locked together with its currency code, precision per its minor units, converted via USD with the rate set locked at quote acceptance; or a percentage above 0 and up to 100. Locked at booking confirmation. Never applies to a change an admin makes in V1.

nodes.title: Settlement cutoff day

attrs.description: Day of the week the settlement period closes. Default Sunday. Must differ from the payout day.

nodes.title: Settlement payout day

attrs.description: Day of the week the settlement statement is paid out. Default Wednesday. Must differ from the cutoff day.

nodes.title: Settlement period

attrs.description: The one settlement period for all manually paid clinics. Weekly only in V1; no per-clinic value exists.

nodes.title: Unpaid balance cancellation point

attrs.description: Days after the oldest unpaid due date (the oldest installment or balance that is unpaid right now) at which a booking that still has an unpaid balance is cancelled. Whole number from 1 to 30, smaller than the balance due days and the installment cutoff. No default; may be Not set, in which case nothing is cancelled for non-payment. If enabled: Assigned Countries must be empty, Account Status must be Active and Account Mode must be Live on a production deployment and Test elsewhere. The flag must be moved to another account before this account can be set Inactive or Archived.

nodes.title: Admin invitation sent

attrs.description: Email to the invitee when a Super Admin sends an admin team invitation (or re-sends it): invitation link, role, personal message. Raised at the provisional admin stage.

nodes.title: Admin password reset sent

attrs.description: Password reset email sent when a Super Admin triggers a reset from the user detail page. Raised at the provisional admin stage.

nodes.title: Repeated access denial alert

attrs.description: Alert to Super Admin when multiple failed access attempts are detected. Raised at the provisional admin stage.

nodes.title: Admin role changed

attrs.description: Email to the affected admin user when their role changes: effective date/time, old role, new role, permission change summary. Raised at the provisional admin stage.

nodes.title: Admin role permissions changed

attrs.description: Email to affected admin users when the permissions of their role change. Raised at the provisional admin stage.

nodes.title: Affiliate activation email sent

attrs.description: Activation email with the one-time set-password link sent to a new or resending affiliate (Main Flow step 9, Screen 10.2).

nodes.title: Booking completed for commission

attrs.description: Booking completion event that triggers asynchronous affiliate commission calculation (REQ-018-023); see unclear item on overlap with EVT-final-payment-confirmed.

nodes.title: Affiliate code created or updated

attrs.description: Notification to the affiliate that a discount code was created (Alternative Flows A1 and A4).

nodes.title: Affiliate commission structure changed

attrs.description: Affiliate emailed old rate, new rate and effective date (Alternative Flow A2 step 8).

nodes.title: Affiliate incentive triggered

attrs.description: FR-019 triggers the incentive event that FR-018 consumes when an affiliate-bound code is redeemed at the first successful payment (PRD lines 445, 775).

nodes.title: Affiliate offboarded

attrs.description: Affiliate emailed the offboarding notice with the final-settlement outcome (Alternative Flow B5 step 9).

nodes.title: Affiliate payout confirmed

attrs.description: Payout confirmation email sent when the FR-017 payout status becomes Paid (REQ-018-009, Screen 7).

nodes.title: Affiliate payout cycle generated

attrs.description: Monthly job on the 7th generates the payout list for the previous month (REQ-018-007).

nodes.title: Affiliate suspended

attrs.description: Affiliate emailed the suspension and its reason (Alternative Flow B3 step 7).

nodes.title: Aftercare activated

attrs.description: aftercare.activated: notification catalog event (FR-030 catalog, PRD line 167). Stub created during FR-030 migration; the producer FR supplies the detail.

nodes.title: Aftercare request awaiting provider availability

attrs.description: aftercare.awaiting_availability: the admin marks the request Awaiting provider availability and the patient is told of the delay (Workflow 2 B3). FR-011 is the producer; FR-030 owns delivery and catalogue registration.

nodes.title: Aftercare plan completed

attrs.description: aftercare.completed: aftercare ends and the event carries an outcome value: completed (the end of the last milestone or the subscription term, REQ-011-096), paperwork only, cancelled by the patient (subscription cancellation once the paid period ends) or cancelled by an admin (REQ-011-101). FR-006 reads this event to move the booking on (REQ-006-060); reading the outcome is queued for FR-006. FR-011 is the producer; FR-030 owns registration.

nodes.title: Aftercare escalation or red flag triggered

attrs.description: aftercare.escalation_triggered: notification catalog event (FR-030 catalog, PRD line 171). Stub created during FR-030 migration; the producer FR supplies the detail.

nodes.title: Aftercare milestone due

attrs.description: aftercare.milestone_due: notification catalog event (FR-030 catalog, PRD line 168). Stub created during FR-030 migration; the producer FR supplies the detail.

nodes.title: Aftercare payment due

attrs.description: aftercare.payment_due: the provider completes the standalone plan, the request becomes Payment due and the patient is told payment is due; the 48 hours start at this notice (Workflow 2 step 3). FR-011 is the producer; FR-030 owns delivery and catalogue registration.

nodes.title: Aftercare provider reassigned

attrs.description: aftercare.provider_reassigned: mandatory notice to the patient and the new aftercare provider (or assigned Hairline aftercare team member) when an admin saves a reassignment on Screen 19; no admin alert and the previous provider is not a recipient. FR-011 is the producer; FR-030 owns notification delivery.

nodes.title: Aftercare provider withdrawn

attrs.description: aftercare.provider_withdrawn: the provider tells the admin that they cannot continue the aftercare (Workflow 4 D1) and the admin is notified. FR-011 is the producer; FR-030 owns delivery and catalogue registration.

nodes.title: Aftercare questionnaire due

attrs.description: aftercare.questionnaire_due: notification catalog event (FR-030 catalog, PRD line 170). Stub created during FR-030 migration; the producer FR supplies the detail.

nodes.title: Aftercare questionnaire missed

attrs.description: aftercare.questionnaire_missed: notification catalog event (FR-030 catalog, PRD line 170). Stub created during FR-030 migration; the producer FR supplies the detail.

nodes.title: Aftercare request assigned to a provider

attrs.description: aftercare.request_assigned: the admin assigns a provider to a standalone request on Screen 15 and the provider is notified (Workflow 2 step 2). FR-011 is the producer; FR-030 owns notification delivery and catalogue registration.

nodes.title: Aftercare request expired

attrs.description: aftercare.request_expired: the request becomes Expired after 48 hours without successful payment (Workflow 2 B1, Workflow 2b B1b). For a request converted from FR-038 monitoring the notice says the patient may start a new standalone request (REQ-011-094). FR-011 is the producer; FR-030 owns delivery and catalogue registration.

nodes.title: Aftercare request rejected

attrs.description: aftercare.request_rejected: the request becomes Rejected, by the admin with a reason, by the 7-day unassigned expiry (standalone only) or by the patient cancelling a changed price (Workflow 2 B2, B3 and B4). For a request converted from FR-038 monitoring the notice says the patient may start a new standalone request (REQ-011-094). FR-011 is the producer; FR-030 owns delivery and catalogue registration.

nodes.title: Aftercare scan due

attrs.description: aftercare.scan_due: notification catalog event (FR-030 catalog, PRD line 169). Stub created during FR-030 migration; the producer FR supplies the detail.

nodes.title: Aftercare scan missed

attrs.description: aftercare.scan_missed: notification catalog event (FR-030 catalog, PRD line 169). Stub created during FR-030 migration; the producer FR supplies the detail.

nodes.title: Standalone aftercare payment confirmed

attrs.description: aftercare.standalone_payment_confirmed: notification catalog event (FR-030 catalog, PRD line 172). Stub created during FR-030 migration; the producer FR supplies the detail.

nodes.title: Aftercare assigned to the Hairline team

attrs.description: aftercare.team_assigned: the aftercare is assigned to the Hairline aftercare team, by the provider handover or by the admin, and the admin and team are notified (Workflow 1 A2, Workflow 2b B1a). FR-011 is the producer; FR-030 owns delivery and catalogue registration.

nodes.title: Aftercare team message

attrs.description: aftercare.team_message: notice to the patient, by push and email, when the aftercare team sends a message or replies to the patient's Contact Support message. FR-011 is the producer; FR-030 owns notification delivery.

nodes.title: Analytics export ready

attrs.description: Email notifications for scheduled report delivery (provider-configured); delivered through S-03 as the FR-030 analytics.export_ready notification with PDF attachment and a secure link that expires after 48 hours (PRD lines 59, 698).

nodes.title: Affiliate payout processed

attrs.description: To the affiliate (admin optional) after the monthly affiliate payout, by email and push (prd.md line 96).

nodes.title: Disputed booking added to next payout

attrs.description: Provider notice sent automatically when a dispute is resolved with Add to Next Payout, optional for other actions (prd.md line 967).

nodes.title: Manual payment reminder sent

attrs.description: Admin-triggered reminder from Screen 4 or 4a; FR-020 picks the template from the reminder type (prd.md lines 576, 581-584).

nodes.title: Outstanding invoice alert

attrs.description: Internal admin alert for overdue patient invoices past a configurable threshold, by email and push (prd.md line 98). The PRD names no owner for the threshold.

nodes.title: Overdue payout alert

attrs.description: Admin alert on payout day when a statement was not approved during the buffer window and was skipped by auto-processing (prd.md line 99).

nodes.title: Payment due reminder

attrs.description: Installment or balance reminder to the patient 3 days before the due date, by email and push (prd.md line 94).

nodes.title: Payment failed

attrs.description: To the patient (admin optional) on a failed charge or webhook, by email and push (prd.md line 93).

nodes.title: Payment received

attrs.description: Receipt to the patient (provider and admin optional) on a successful Stripe payment, by email and push (prd.md line 92).

nodes.title: Payout failed

attrs.description: To admin (provider and affiliate optional) on a failed Stripe transfer, by email and push (prd.md lines 97, 167).

nodes.title: Payout statements ready for review

attrs.description: Admin push and email: X statements ready for review, with the payout date (prd.md line 149).

nodes.title: Appointment reminder due

attrs.description: booking.appointment_reminder: notification catalog event (FR-030 catalog, PRD line 144). Two reminders by default, 7 days and 1 day before the appointment; the anchor is the appointment date.

nodes.title: Booking cancelled

attrs.description: booking.cancelled: patient and provider, sent for an admin cancellation (with the reason), a provider drop-out at the FR-006 Screen 10 submit, and a system cancellation for an unpaid balance (including an installment plan default); the wording follows FR-006 REQ-006-011.

nodes.title: Booking confirmed

attrs.description: booking.confirmed: notification catalog event (FR-030 catalog, PRD line 141). Stub created during FR-030 migration; the producer FR supplies the detail.

nodes.title: Booking handoff

attrs.description: Accepted subquote handoff payload sent to FR-006 Booking & Payment at acceptance; the accepted subquote is the atomic commercial input and its inherited context is resolved from its parent quote. No funds are collected in FR-005.
attrs.payload: AcceptanceEvent, accepted parent quote ID/version, accepted subquote ID/version, immutable acceptance snapshot, and the pre-scheduled slot (slot-hold reference)

nodes.title: Booking hold expiring soon

attrs.description: booking.hold_expiring_soon: patient reminder, and admin exception alert.

nodes.title: Booking payment window expired

attrs.description: booking.payment_window_expired: mandatory, patient and provider, and admin exception alert.

nodes.title: Booking provider-fault replacement

attrs.description: booking.provider_fault_replacement: mandatory, patient and admin exception alert.

nodes.title: Booking rescheduled

attrs.description: booking.rescheduled: mandatory, patient and provider, sent on an admin appointment change with the old and new appointment.

nodes.title: Booking revived

attrs.description: booking.revived: mandatory, patient and provider.

nodes.title: Booking scheduled

attrs.description: booking.scheduled (displayed as "Booking Accepted — Slot Held (Pending Payment)"): mandatory, patient only, sent on patient acceptance (Acceptance stage) and on an admin-authored replacement acceptance (booking stage); the provider is told by quote.accepted.

nodes.title: Call initiated

attrs.description: An audio or video call is started from a conversation through Twilio.

nodes.title: DSR blocked by an obligation

attrs.description: dsr.blocked_by_obligation: approval was blocked by an active obligation; the patient is told the expected timeline (REQ-023-038).

nodes.title: DSR deadline approaching

attrs.description: dsr.deadline_approaching: the SLA deadline of an open request is near; Admins are notified (Communication Structure).

nodes.title: DSR denied

attrs.description: dsr.denied: an Admin denied the deletion request with a reason; the patient is notified with the reason (REQ-023-043).

nodes.title: DSR fulfilled

attrs.description: dsr.fulfilled: the deletion request is completed; the patient is notified of the outcome, the actions taken and the legal basis of any retained records (Main Flow step 5).

nodes.title: DSR in progress

attrs.description: dsr.in_progress: an Admin approved the request and the obligation check passed, so processing has started; the patient is notified of the status change (REQ-023-046).

nodes.title: dsr.obligation_block_ended

attrs.description: dsr.obligation_block_ended: the obligation that blocked a deletion request has ended; the patient is told the request resumes (REQ-023-029, REQ-020-163).

nodes.title: DSR verification required

attrs.description: dsr.verification_required: an Admin found the identity proof of a deletion request insufficient; the request is set to Verification Required and the patient is notified (Alternative Flow A1).

nodes.title: Email change code sent

attrs.description: email change code: when a patient changes the email address on the profile, a 6-digit code is sent to the new address to confirm it (FR-001 prd.md line 675). Owner answer 2026-11-22: its own Event, owned by FR-030.

nodes.title: Final payment confirmed

attrs.description: Payment confirmation (final) to the patient.

nodes.title: Initial payment confirmed

attrs.description: Payment confirmation (deposit) to the patient, and confirmation to the provider, on the first successful initial charge.

nodes.title: Inquiry cancelled

attrs.description: inquiry.cancelled: sent to the patient when the patient cancels the inquiry (Inquiry or Quoted stage) and when an admin closes the inquiry; a cancellation caused by an approved account deletion sends the patient no notice. Providers are not recipients: a provider holding a draft, sent or expired quote receives quote.cancelled_inquiry. The patient's cancellation reason is never shown to a provider.

nodes.title: Inquiry questionnaire unconfigured

attrs.description: System flags the Inquiry flow as unconfigured and notifies admin that no active Inquiry questionnaire is set; patient inquiry submissions are blocked until a new set is designated.

nodes.title: Inquiry submitted

attrs.description: inquiry.submitted: notification catalog event (FR-030 catalog, PRD line 126). Stub created during FR-030 migration; the producer FR supplies the detail.

nodes.title: Inquiry TTFQ SLA breached

attrs.description: inquiry.ttfq_sla_breached (FR-020/FR-030 catalog): fired once per distributed inquiry/provider pair when the provider has not submitted a parent quote within the FR-026 SLA target from distribution (PRD line 60).

nodes.title: Installment charged

attrs.description: Confirmation to the patient after a successful installment charge, by email and push (REQ-007B-016).

nodes.title: Installment charge failed

attrs.description: Immediate notice to the patient that an installment charge failed, with a clear error message (REQ-007B-017).

nodes.title: Installment overdue notice

attrs.description: One notice to the patient and one to the billing admins on the day after an installment due date passes with the installment unpaid, after that day's retry; the patient notice replaces that day's failure notice and states the date on which the booking will be cancelled when the cancellation point is set (REQ-007B-101, REQ-007B-111).

nodes.title: Installment plan completed

attrs.description: Booking status change notification sent to the patient when the final installment completes (communication scope, final installment).

nodes.title: Installment plan defaulted

attrs.description: Admin alert that a plan is Defaulted after three failed retries and the booking is overdue (REQ-007B-020).

nodes.title: Installment reminder due

attrs.description: Reminder to the patient before each installment due date at the times set in the FR-007 payment reminder setting, by email and push (REQ-007B-014).

nodes.title: Keyword flag raised

attrs.description: A conversation is automatically flagged because a moderation keyword matched; admins are alerted and deep-linked to the conversation. Patient and provider are not notified.

nodes.title: Legal acceptance reminder sent

attrs.description: Reminder sent by the daily job (REQ-027-063) to a patient or provider team member with pending required acceptance, at most every 7 days and up to the reminder limit. Recorded at the Admin configuration stage, where the job runs.

nodes.title: Legal acceptance coverage below threshold

attrs.description: The Acceptance Rate of a Current version is below the Admin-set threshold: the Admins holding A-09 Edit Settings are notified once per version, evaluated daily from 14 days after the version became Current (REQ-027-063, REQ-027-023).
attrs.payload: document type, version, acceptance rate, threshold

nodes.title: Legal version published

attrs.description: Publication succeeded: the publishing Admin is notified (REQ-027-022); user acceptance prompts start when the version is Current (REQ-027-004, REQ-027-030).
attrs.payload: document type, locale, version, effective date, material change flag

nodes.title: Medical alert generated

attrs.description: System generates a Red, Yellow / Amber or Green medical alert from a submitted Inquiry questionnaire and delivers it to the Provider Platform.

nodes.title: Message sent

attrs.description: A patient, provider or admin message is sent in a conversation; recipients get a real-time alert and unread badges update (REQ-012-007, REQ-012-026).

nodes.title: Missing translation logged

attrs.description: A client requested a key with no value in the selected locale: the system shows fallback text and logs the missing key with locale, surface and fallback used, for coverage reporting (PRD Alternative Flow B1, prd.md line 183). Raised at the patient stage; the same event also occurs on the provider and admin surfaces.

nodes.title: monitoring.advice_posted

attrs.description: monitoring.advice_posted: the provider submits advice and the patient is notified; an edit by the provider, or a text change by an Admin, sends the same notice marked "updated" (REQ-037-078).

nodes.title: monitoring.assignment_ended

attrs.description: monitoring.assignment_ended: a monitoring assignment ends other than by the provider's own withdrawal; the patient and Admin are notified, and the provider only when an Admin ends the assignment (REQ-037-078).

nodes.title: monitoring.assignment_pending

attrs.description: monitoring.assignment_pending: An advice-mode case becomes Pending Assignment; Admin is notified (Business Workflows ActivateAdvice step; REQ-037-036).

nodes.title: monitoring.completed

attrs.description: monitoring.completed: The patient completes the case (REQ-037-053, REQ-037-079).

nodes.title: monitoring.converted_to_inquiry

attrs.description: monitoring.converted_to_inquiry: The FR-003 inquiry is submitted and the case converts (REQ-037-030, REQ-037-079).

nodes.title: monitoring.export_ready

attrs.description: monitoring.export_ready: a PDF has finished generating (the summary PDF, the conversion PDF or a regenerated report); the patient is notified when it is ready. For a converted case the notice opens FR-038 Screen 6 while the draft is open, otherwise Screen 7.

nodes.title: monitoring.progress_reminder

attrs.description: monitoring.progress_reminder: default patient reminder on a transplant-progress case (FR-038) only; hair-loss monitoring cases (FR-037) have no reminders. Schedule set on Screen 1; stopped when the case is completed or converted.

nodes.title: monitoring.provider_assigned

attrs.description: monitoring.provider_assigned: Admin saves an initial assignment; the patient is notified and the provider is notified of the assignment (REQ-037-078). A reassignment uses monitoring.provider_reassigned.

nodes.title: monitoring.provider_reassigned

attrs.description: monitoring.provider_reassigned: Admin saves a reassignment; the patient and the replacement provider are notified (REQ-037-078).

nodes.title: monitoring.provider_withdrawn

attrs.description: monitoring.provider_withdrawn: The assigned provider withdraws; the patient and Admin are notified and the case returns to Admin as Pending Reassignment (Screen 11).

nodes.title: Password reset OTP sent

attrs.description: reset code: system sends a 6-digit password reset OTP to the registered email (prd.md Workflow 3, Screens 10 and 11). Same message for unregistered emails is privacy-preserving and sends nothing.

nodes.title: Patient account locked

attrs.description: account locked: emitted when failed login attempts reach the configured maximum; a security event is logged (prd.md Workflow 2, alternative B2).

nodes.title: Patient password changed

attrs.description: password changed: emitted when a patient changes or resets their password; prior refresh tokens are revoked and a security audit entry is recorded (prd.md Screens 12, 17, 17a).

nodes.title: Patient payment overdue notice

attrs.description: One notice to the patient on the day after the final payment due date when the balance is still unpaid.

nodes.title: Patient profile changed by admin

attrs.description: admin edit: patient is notified by email of every admin edit and the notice lists the changed fields; there is no review screen and the admin edit is final (REQ-001-034, REQ-001-035; prd.md Admin Editability Rules, Workflow 4 alternative D1).

nodes.title: Payment configuration changed

attrs.description: Email to admins when payment configuration is published (Stripe account activation, currency conversion, split payment), and email to affected providers on a provider-specific deposit rate change.

nodes.title: Daily rate digest

attrs.description: Daily email digest to admins summarising rate source outages with affected pairs and all rate changes across pairs.

nodes.title: Payment overdue

attrs.description: payment.overdue_notice: a scheduled job raises this once when a balance is still unpaid the day after its due date: Final Payment Status becomes Overdue, the booking is flagged, billing admins are notified and the patient gets one overdue notice. It stops when the booking is Cancelled or Completed.

nodes.title: Payment reminder

attrs.description: Payment reminder for the upcoming final payment, sent by the system or by an admin on request.

nodes.title: Payment attempted from unsupported country

attrs.description: Alert to admins that a payment was attempted or blocked for a country with no Stripe account and no Global Fallback (a country held only by an Inactive or Archived account counts as having no account).

nodes.title: Payout executed

attrs.description: Payout notification to the provider after execution. Payout execution is described in FR-017; the producer stage is recorded as the treatment stage and raised as an ownership question.

nodes.title: Promotion discount approval requested

attrs.description: promotion.discount_approval_requested: FR-030 notification catalogue event. Targeted providers are notified that a Both Fees program awaits their approval. Fires when an admin publishes an Admin-via-Provider program and on Re-invite, not when the program enters Pending Approval (REQ-019-010); the one approval-requested event.

nodes.title: Promotion reconciliation requested

attrs.description: FR-017 receives a reconciliation event when an admin records a Refund on a Completed redemption (Screen 6, Refund action).

nodes.title: Provider activation email

attrs.description: provider.activation: mandatory account activation email with a one-time password setup link (creation, resend, Owner email change). Stub owned by FR-020.

nodes.title: Provider bank details updated

attrs.description: Email confirmation sent to the Owner after bank account details are updated (Billing Main Flow step 14).

nodes.title: Provider closure rejected

attrs.description: FR-020 `provider.closure_rejected`: mandatory email to the provider with the review notes when an admin rejects the closure request (Closure Main Flow step 16).

nodes.title: Provider closure requested

attrs.description: FR-020 `provider.closure_requested`: mandatory notification to admins when a provider submits an account closure request (Closure Main Flow step 10).

nodes.title: Provider deactivated

attrs.description: FR-020 `provider.deactivated` deactivation email sent by FR-015 when a deactivation takes effect; always sent for closure deactivations. Stub created during FR-032 migration.

nodes.title: Provider document expiration warning

attrs.description: provider.document_expiration_warning: notification catalog event (FR-030 catalog, PRD line 189). Stub created during FR-030 migration; the producer FR supplies the detail.

nodes.title: Provider login email changed

attrs.description: provider.login_email_changed: mandatory security notice to the old and new login addresses. Stub owned by FR-020.

nodes.title: Provider onboarding requested

attrs.description: provider.onboarding_requested: notification catalog event (FR-030 catalog, PRD line 188). Stub created during FR-030 migration; the producer FR supplies the detail.

nodes.title: Provider password changed

attrs.description: Security alert email to the provider after a password change: "Your password was changed on [date] at [time]" (Account Settings Main Flow step 22; REQ-032-021).

nodes.title: Provider reactivated

attrs.description: provider.reactivated: notice to the provider Owner when Notify Provider is checked. Stub owned by FR-020.

nodes.title: Provider response escalated

attrs.description: A provider still silent after 72 hours is escalated to the admin follow-up queue and gets further reminders.

nodes.title: Provider response published

attrs.description: A provider response was published; the patient is notified (workflow B1 outcome, Screen 6).

nodes.title: Provider response reminder

attrs.description: A provider who has not replied within 48 hours is reminded automatically.

nodes.title: Provider scheduled change cancelled

attrs.description: provider.scheduled_change_cancelled: notice to the Owner if they were told of the scheduled change. Stub owned by FR-020.

nodes.title: Provider status cancellation alert to admin support

attrs.description: provider.status_cancellation_admin_support: admin alert, one per affected inquiry or case, to admins with Respond to Support. Stub owned by FR-020.

nodes.title: Provider status cancellation notice to patient

attrs.description: provider.status_cancellation_patient: patient notice before acceptance that the offer is no longer available, with Contact Admin/Support. Stub owned by FR-020.

nodes.title: Provider status redistribution reminder

attrs.description: provider.status_redistribution_reminder: sent once to the patient 48 hours after the confirm variant of provider.status_cancellation_patient is left unanswered (FR-020 REQ-020-159); dropped when the patient has answered, the inquiry was cancelled, an admin reassigned or reran distribution, or the support marker was cleared. Mandatory.

nodes.title: Provider suspended

attrs.description: provider.suspended: notice to the provider Owner when Notify Provider is checked. Stub owned by FR-020.

nodes.title: Questionnaire version published

attrs.description: A questionnaire set is published as a new version: version incremented, set marked Active, previous Active version archived; version-controlled updates reach all platforms.

nodes.title: Quote accepted

attrs.description: quote.accepted: emitted at acceptance. Outcome notices go to providers only, never to the patient: one notice per sent parent quote (selected or not selected); an unsent draft cancelled because another quote was accepted produces no notice; non-selected notices never reveal the selected provider or accepted price. Also sent to the replacement provider at an admin-authored replacement acceptance. Delivered through FR-020.

nodes.title: Quote cancelled (inquiry cancelled)

attrs.description: quote.cancelled_inquiry: sent to each provider holding a draft, sent or expired quote when the patient cancels the inquiry and when an approved account deletion cancels it; not sent for an admin Close inquiry; never sent to the provider of a replacement draft quote.

nodes.title: Quote expired

attrs.description: Emitted once per expiry window of a parent quote when expiry processing moves a sent quote to expired (FR-030); a restore opens a fresh window; never for the admin-authored replacement quote, which has no expiry.

nodes.title: Quote expiring soon

attrs.description: Emitted once per expiry window of a sent parent quote when it reaches the FR-026 quote-expiring-soon lead time (FR-030); never for drafts, accepted or terminal quotes, or the admin-authored replacement quote, which has no expiry.

nodes.title: Quote restored

attrs.description: quote.restored: fired by FR-004 when an admin restores an expired quote. The quote returns to sent with a fresh full expiry window; the patient and the provider are told (REQ-030-218, REQ-004-106).

nodes.title: Quote submitted

attrs.description: Emitted on the first send of a parent quote, for FR-020 notification. Not emitted for an admin-authored replacement quote.

nodes.title: Quote updated

attrs.description: "Quote revised (new version)": emitted when a new version of an already-sent quote is re-sent, including after an admin edit. FR-004 is the only producer. Saving a draft emits nothing.

nodes.title: Quote withdrawn

attrs.description: Mandatory notice; FR-004 is the only producer, at the quote stage for a withdrawal before acceptance and at the booking stage for a withdrawal after acceptance. Goes to the patient for every withdrawal and to the admin only when the withdrawn quote was already accepted; FR-006 then starts the provider-fault transfer without re-emitting it.

nodes.title: Rate protection alert

attrs.description: Urgent alert to admins when an auto-fetch pair's rate changes more than the global Rate Protection Threshold within 24 hours.

nodes.title: Rate sync failed

attrs.description: Alert to admins when a scheduled sync fails for an auto-fetch pair; the pair keeps its last cached rate.

nodes.title: Re-verification OTP sent

attrs.description: re-verification code: when the patient picks Email OTP on Identity Re-verification, a 6-digit code is sent to the registered email (prd.md Screen 18).

nodes.title: Refund approval overdue

attrs.description: refund.approval_escalated: escalation notice to a super-admin when an exception or manual refund has had no decision for 2 business days; the refund stays awaiting approval.

nodes.title: Refund processed

attrs.description: Refund confirmation to the patient and the provider.

nodes.title: Regional configuration saved

attrs.description: A regional grouping change (including its status), a starting price change, a destination default currency change or a system-wide default starting price change was saved; the save confirmation is the on-screen message only and no separate notification is sent.
attrs.payload: admin user, entity type, change reason, change details

nodes.title: Review edited by patient

attrs.description: A patient edited a published review; the provider is notified so they can re-evaluate any response (Main Flow step 4d).

nodes.title: Review published

attrs.description: A new review is published; the provider is notified of a new published review (Provider Platform scope, REQ-013-017).

nodes.title: Review removed by admin

attrs.description: Admin removal notice (REQ-013-017); sent to the reviewing patient only. FR-030 catalogue key review.removed_by_admin.

nodes.title: Review requested

attrs.description: review.requested: review invitation anchored on the review eligibility date (FR-013); the invitation is sent on that date and any reminder is counted from it. FR-030 owns the event and its timing and cadence (Screen 10 link-outs).

nodes.title: Review response removed by admin

attrs.description: review.response_removed: fired by FR-013 when an admin removes the provider's public response to a review; sent to the provider with the removal reason. Informational.

nodes.title: Stripe account connection or authentication failure

attrs.description: Admin dashboard notification and urgent alert for a Stripe connection failure, API error or failed authentication.

nodes.title: Support case admin reply

attrs.description: support.case_admin_reply: emitted when an admin sends a message in the case thread. Notifies the patient or provider.

nodes.title: Support case assigned

attrs.description: support.case_assigned: emitted when a case is assigned or reassigned. Notifies the new assignee.

nodes.title: Support case closed

attrs.description: `support.case_closed`: FR-034 triggers it and FR-020/S-03 notifies the patient by push and email (Resolved to Closed, including closure when the auto-closure period expires (FR-035 lines 70, 412)). Stub created during FR-035 migration.

nodes.title: Support case created

attrs.description: support.case_created: emitted when a case is created, whether submitted from the patient app, the provider Help Centre or entered by an admin. Triggers the optional confirmation to the submitter and the notice to the assigned admin.

nodes.title: Support case escalated

attrs.description: support.case_escalated: emitted when a case is escalated to a Super Admin; a manual escalation notifies the chosen new assignee and a system escalation of an overdue case notifies all Super Admins.

nodes.title: Support case reopened

attrs.description: `support.case_reopened`: sent to the patient, the provider and the admin when a Closed case is reopened, with the reopening reason (FR-032 Screen 5.9 for a provider reopen).

nodes.title: Support case resolved

attrs.description: `support.case_resolved`: FR-034 triggers it and FR-020/S-03 notifies the patient by push and email (In Progress to Resolved; the email carries the resolution summary (FR-035 line 395)). Stub created during FR-035 migration.

nodes.title: Support case status changed

attrs.description: `support.case_status_changed`: FR-034 triggers it and FR-020/S-03 notifies the patient by push and email (Open to In Progress status change). Stub created during FR-035 migration.

nodes.title: Support case user reply

attrs.description: `support.case_user_reply`: email to the assigned admin (or all support staff if unassigned) when the patient or the provider replies to a case (FR-032 Screen 5.8 for a provider reply).

nodes.title: System alert

attrs.description: system.alert: system health or monitoring alert surfaced to admins (REQ-030-104). The PRD names no producer; it is placed at the platform-wide Stage.

nodes.title: System escalation

attrs.description: system.escalation: operational escalation requiring admin action (REQ-030-103). The PRD names no producer; it is placed at the platform-wide Stage.

nodes.title: Takedown decided

attrs.description: Admin approved or rejected a takedown request; the patient is notified of the decision and reason (workflow A4 step 4).

nodes.title: Takedown requested

attrs.description: A patient created a takedown request; the admin takedown queue is notified (workflow A3 step 4).

nodes.title: Team compliance flag raised

attrs.description: A compliance flag on a team member notifies the admin compliance team.

nodes.title: Team invitation accepted

attrs.description: An invitee accepted and a team member record was created.

nodes.title: Team invitation delivery failed

attrs.description: An invitation email failed for 24 hours; the admin team is alerted (B4).

nodes.title: Team invitation sent

attrs.description: An invitation email was generated for an invitee.

nodes.title: Team member removed

attrs.description: A team member was removed and access revoked.

nodes.title: Team member role changed

attrs.description: A team member's role was updated.

nodes.title: Team member suspended

attrs.description: A team member was suspended (provider or admin action).

attrs.description: Candidate FR-020 event monitoring.aftercare_conversion_started: the patient started conversion to FR-011 standalone aftercare.

nodes.title: Transplant-progress case converted to aftercare

attrs.description: Candidate FR-020 event monitoring.converted_to_aftercare: the FR-011 standalone request was created and the case converted.

nodes.title: Travel-date review required

attrs.description: travel.date_review_required: a replacement TravelContext starts in travel-date-review-required after a provider-fault transfer; the patient, the replacement provider and admin are notified.

nodes.title: Travel record corrected by admin

attrs.description: travel.record_corrected: admin applies a correction to any travel record; both the patient and the provider are notified and the itinerary section refreshes.

nodes.title: Travel record entered by provider

attrs.description: travel.record_entered: the provider enters flight or hotel details on the patient's behalf in Path A; the patient is notified that travel details are confirmed and available.

nodes.title: Travel record submitted

attrs.description: travel.record_submitted: the patient submits passport, flight or hotel details; the provider is notified and the provider status badge updates.

nodes.title: Travel request sent

attrs.description: travel.request_sent: the automated in-app and email request to the patient, sent once when the booking becomes Confirmed (passport request in Path A, flight and hotel request in Path B). Admin re-notify sends a manual reminder for a patient-owned pending item.

nodes.title: Treatment added

attrs.description: treatment.added: sent to all active providers the first time a treatment becomes Active, by any route ("New treatment available in catalog").

nodes.title: Treatment cancelled

attrs.description: treatment.cancelled: notification catalog event (FR-030 catalog, PRD line 147). Stub created during FR-030 migration; the producer FR supplies the detail.

nodes.title: Treatment completed

attrs.description: treatment.completed: sent to the patient when treatment completes, with post-op and medication instructions; the admin is also notified of completion for billing (Integration 3, REQ-010-007, REQ-010-008).

nodes.title: Treatment completion signalled to aftercare

attrs.description: Signal from FR-010 to FR-011 when the provider saves End of Treatment: patient ID, treatment record ID, conclusion notes, prescription, advice, medication instructions, actual graft count, completion date (Integration 4, REQ-010-006, REQ-010-009, REQ-010-023).

nodes.title: Treatment day updated

attrs.description: treatment_day_updated: day status or day progress synced to the patient app and admin dashboard within 30 seconds (Integration 1 and 3, REQ-010-032). Day statuses only; no clinical notes.

nodes.title: Treatment deactivated

attrs.description: treatment.deactivated: sent to the providers who offer the treatment when an admin deactivates it.

nodes.title: Treatment documentation completed

attrs.description: treatment.documentation_completed: notification catalog event (FR-030 catalog, PRD line 149). Stub created during FR-030 migration; the producer FR supplies the detail.

nodes.title: Treatment plan changed

attrs.description: treatment.plan_changed: emitted for every treatment-detail change (plan days, clinicians or graft estimate); carries what changed and the new values, never money fields; registered in the FR-030 catalogue. Also fires from Confirmed, before the treatment stage; one producer stage recorded.

nodes.title: Treatment started

attrs.description: treatment.started: sent to the patient when Check In moves the booking to In Progress (Integration 3, REQ-010-007).

nodes.title: Treatment task in progress reminder due

attrs.description: treatment.task_in_progress_reminder: notification catalog event (FR-030 catalog, PRD line 150). Stub created during FR-030 migration; the producer FR supplies the detail.

nodes.title: Treatment updated

attrs.description: treatment.updated: sent to providers who currently offer the treatment when an admin updates it, only when the treatment is Active after the save; also used with "treatment available again" wording when an Inactive treatment that has been Active before returns to Active, sent only to providers with a pricing configuration.

nodes.title: Verification OTP sent

attrs.description: verification code: system sends a 6-digit OTP to the patient's email to confirm the address at registration (prd.md Workflow 1, Screen 5). The email-change code is its own Event, EVT-email-change-otp-sent.

nodes.title: Patient Authentication & Profile Management

attrs.summary: The Patient Authentication & Profile Management module enables patients to securely register, authenticate, and manage their personal profiles within the Hairline platform.

nodes.title: Medical History & 3D Scanning

attrs.summary: FR-002 defines shared backend engines for processing medical intake data and head media, consumed by FR-003 (Inquiry) and others.

nodes.title: Inquiry Submission & Distribution

attrs.summary: The Inquiry Submission & Distribution module enables patients to submit comprehensive treatment requests through the mobile app, which are then automatically distributed to relevant providers based on location and availability.

nodes.title: Quote Submission & Management

attrs.summary: The Quote Submission & Management module enables providers to create, edit, submit, and manage detailed quote responses for distributed patient inquiries.

nodes.title: Quote Comparison & Acceptance

attrs.summary: The Quote Comparison & Acceptance module enables patients to review quotes from multiple providers, including multiple parent quotes from the same provider.

nodes.title: Booking & Scheduling

attrs.summary: Enable patients to convert one accepted subquote into a confirmed procedure booking by paying a deposit or first installment.

nodes.title: Payment Processing

attrs.summary: Enable patients to pay securely for procedures (deposit at booking and final payment before or on procedure day) in supported currencies and methods, while ensuring compliant handling of payments, automated receipt/invoice generation, platform commission calculation, and timely provider payouts after treatment completion.

nodes.title: Split Payment / Installment Plans

attrs.summary: Enable patients to pay for hair transplant procedures through interest-free installment plans spanning 2-9 months, providing financial flexibility while ensuring full payment completion 30 days before the scheduled procedure date.

nodes.title: Travel & Logistics Coordination

attrs.summary: Enable coordinated travel logistics for patients and providers across the full appointment lifecycle.

nodes.title: Provider Team & Role Management

attrs.summary: The Provider Team & Role Management feature enables multi-user collaboration within provider organizations by allowing clinic owners to invite team members, assign role-based permissions, and manage access to the Hairline platform.

nodes.title: Treatment Execution & Documentation

attrs.summary: The Treatment Execution & Documentation module enables providers to document the entire hair transplant procedure lifecycle from patient arrival through treatment completion.

nodes.title: Aftercare & Recovery Management

attrs.summary: The Aftercare & Recovery Management module provides comprehensive post-procedure support for hair transplant patients through milestone-based tracking, scan monitoring, questionnaire assessments, and multi-tenant communication.

nodes.title: Messaging & Communication

attrs.summary: Enable secure, auditable, real-time messaging and audio/video communication between patients and providers across the Hairline platform to support quote clarification, procedure coordination, and patient care.

nodes.title: Reviews & Ratings

attrs.summary: Enable patients with completed treatment cases to submit post-procedure reviews with structured ratings and optional photos, published immediately upon submission (no pre-publication moderation gate).

nodes.title: Provider Analytics & Reporting

attrs.summary: The Provider Analytics & Reporting module delivers a 13-screen suite (12 analytical + 1 export config) split across two tenants: provider and admin.

nodes.title: Provider Management (Admin-Initiated)

attrs.summary: The Provider Management module enables administrators to onboard and manage hair transplant providers who will serve patients through the Hairline platform.

nodes.title: Admin Patient Management

attrs.summary: The Admin Patient Management module provides Hairline internal administrators with comprehensive oversight and management capabilities for all patient accounts and activities across the platform.

nodes.title: Admin Billing & Financial Management

attrs.summary: The Admin Billing & Financial Management module provides Hairline administrators with comprehensive tools to manage the platform's financial operations across all stakeholders (patients, providers, and affiliates).

nodes.title: Affiliate Management

attrs.summary: The Affiliate Management module enables Hairline to partner with external entities (influencers, clinics, organizations) who promote the platform in exchange for commission-based compensation.

nodes.title: Promotions & Discount Management

attrs.summary: Define, approve, and apply discounts across the Hairline platform with clear governance and auditability.

nodes.title: Notifications & Alerts

attrs.summary: Provide reliable, configurable notifications (email, push, optional SMS in future phases) for key lifecycle events across patients and providers.

nodes.title: Multi-Language & Localization

attrs.summary: FR-021 defines Hairline's multi-language and localization capability across the Patient App, Provider Dashboard, Admin Platform, and system-delivered communications.

nodes.title: Search & Filtering

attrs.summary: Search and filtering capabilities are critical for enabling users to efficiently navigate large datasets across the Hairline platform.

nodes.title: Data Retention & Compliance

attrs.summary: Establish organization-wide data retention, auditability, and privacy controls to meet healthcare and financial record-keeping obligations while honoring user privacy rights.

nodes.title: Treatment & Package Management

attrs.summary: The Treatment & Package Management module establishes a two-tier content management system for medical procedures and service packages within the Hairline platform.

nodes.title: Medical Questionnaire Management

attrs.summary: The Medical Questionnaire Management module enables administrators to manage a central catalog of questionnaire sets, where each set is a named, versioned package of questions (e.g., "Medical Safety Screening", "Pain Assessment", "Sleep Quality Check").

nodes.title: App Settings & Security Policies

attrs.summary: The App Settings & Security Policies module provides a centralized, audited, and versioned configuration surface for application-wide settings, security policies, app data lists, and notification templates that affect multiple modules and tenants (Patient, Provider, Admin).

nodes.title: Legal Content Management

attrs.summary: Provide centralized management of legal content (Terms & Conditions, Privacy Policy, Consent forms, Cancellation Policy) with versioning, preview, publishing, acceptance tracking, and audit trail.

nodes.title: Regional Configuration & Pricing

attrs.summary: The Regional Configuration & Pricing module enables Hairline administrators to control how treatment locations (countries/cities) are presented to patients and set starting price estimates for different regions and currencies.

nodes.title: Payment System Configuration

attrs.summary: The Payment System Configuration module empowers platform administrators to manage the complete payment infrastructure for the Hairline multi-tenant platform.

nodes.title: Notification Rules & Configuration

attrs.summary: The Notification Rules & Configuration module provides comprehensive administrative control over the Hairline platform's notification system.

nodes.title: Admin Access Control & Permissions

attrs.summary: The Admin Access Control & Permissions module is a Super Admin-only configuration tool that serves as the single source of truth for all role definitions and permission matrices across the entire Hairline platform.

nodes.title: Provider Dashboard Settings & Profile Management

attrs.summary: Provider Dashboard Settings & Profile Management enables clinic administrators and staff to configure their organization's profile, account settings, notification preferences, billing information, and team member permissions.

nodes.title: Help Centre Content Management

attrs.summary: The Help Centre Content Management module provides a centralized knowledge base and support system for both provider and patient platforms.

nodes.title: Support Center & Ticketing System

attrs.summary: The Support Center & Ticketing System provides a unified formal support system for managing both patient and provider inquiries, technical issues, feedback submissions, and general support requests.

nodes.title: Patient Help Center & Support Submission

attrs.summary: The Patient Help Center & Support Submission module provides the patient-facing interface for accessing self-service help content and submitting support requests directly from the patient mobile app.

nodes.title: Monitor Your Hair Loss

attrs.summary: Monitor Your Hair Loss gives a patient a structured, longitudinal record of their hair-loss condition before they decide whether to request treatment.

nodes.title: Monitor Your Transplant Progress

attrs.summary: Monitor Your Transplant Progress is a self-service utility for patients whose hair transplant may have been performed outside Hairline and who want to record recovery progress without buying an aftercare package.

nodes.title: System PRD

attrs.summary: The system PRD: platform-wide rules and the shared platform context that every Functional Requirement builds on.

nodes.title: Patients register by mobile app only with email and password

attrs.statement: System MUST allow patients to register accounts via mobile app only with email and password
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary, prd.md line 1272. Also stated in the PRD at line 26: "Register and create accounts via mobile app only"; line 82: "Patient-Initiated: Primary flow through mobile app registration and login (patients can ONLY be registered via the mobile app)".

nodes.title: Email verified by 6-digit OTP before activation

attrs.statement: System MUST require email verification via 6-digit OTP before account activation
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary, prd.md line 1273. Also stated in the PRD at line 415: "Email verification required for account activation"; line 113: "System validates the OTP and confirms email verification (codes expire after 15 minutes; resend available with rate limiting)".

nodes.title: Patients authenticate with email and password

attrs.statement: System MUST authenticate patients with email and password credentials
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary, prd.md line 1274. Also stated in the PRD at line 27: "Login and authenticate with email/password"; line 179: "System validates email and password combination".

nodes.title: Password reset by email OTP

attrs.statement: System MUST support password reset via email OTP verification
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary, prd.md line 1275. Also stated in the PRD at line 30: "Reset password via email OTP"; line 528: "Reset code sent to registered email"; line 219: "System sends a 6-digit password reset OTP to the patient's email".

nodes.title: Patients view and edit their profile

attrs.statement: System MUST allow patients to view and edit their profile information
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary, prd.md line 1276. Also stated in the PRD at line 28: "Manage profile information (name, email, phone, date of birth, gender, country)"; line 29: "Update profile image and preferences"; line 34: "Access profile overview, settings, and account management features"; line 278: "System validates changes and updates profile"; line 273: "System displays current profile information".

nodes.title: Account locked after configurable failed login attempts

attrs.statement: System MUST track and lock accounts after configurable max failed login attempts (default: 5; per Admin Settings A-09 / FR-026). The account stores the failed-attempt count and the time the lock started; the count resets after a successful login and when the lock ends, and attempts made during the lock do not extend it.
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary, prd.md line 1278. Also stated in the PRD at line 933: "Maximum failed login attempts before account lockout (configurable in Admin Settings A-09)"; line 963: "Account lockout prevents brute force attacks"; line 193: "System tracks failed attempts (configurable max attempts before lockout, default: 5; per Admin Settings A-09 / FR-026)".

nodes.title: All authentication events logged for audit

attrs.statement: System MUST log all authentication events for audit trail
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary, prd.md line 1279. Also stated in the PRD at line 960: "All authentication attempts logged"; line 936: "Successful logins logged for security monitoring"; line 179: "System logs successful login for audit trail"; line 58: "Audit logging for all authentication and profile changes".

nodes.title: Email addresses unique across all patient accounts

attrs.statement: System MUST maintain unique email addresses across all patient accounts. The check also runs when a patient saves a pending email, when an admin saves an email, and again at code confirmation. A patient gets the same neutral message as on Screen 4 and the existing owner is emailed; an admin gets a plain "address already in use" error. If the address was taken between save and confirmation, the confirmation fails with the neutral message and the pending address is cleared.
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary, prd.md line 1283. Also stated in the PRD at line 927: "Email addresses must be unique across the platform"; line 1015: "Unique email address enforcement".

attrs.statement: System MUST store patient profile data (name, email, phone, DOB, gender, country)
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary, prd.md line 1284. Also stated in the PRD at line 438: "Gender options: Male, Female, Other, Prefer not to say"; line 28: "Manage profile information (name, email, phone, date of birth, gender, country)".

attrs.statement: System MUST maintain session management for authenticated users
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary, prd.md line 1285. Also stated in the PRD at line 57: "Session management and authentication tokens"; line 179: "System creates authenticated session".

attrs.statement: Patient data retention follows the system PRD, Platform-Wide Rules: One 10-year retention period
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary. Retention is the one platform-wide period carried by REQ-SYS-002.

attrs.statement: On the date picker, Done confirms the selected date and updates the Date of Birth field on the profile creation screen.
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 478, 485 (Calendar Picker Overlay: Done Button, Business Rules).

nodes.title: Re-verification offers password or email code

attrs.statement: On the Identity Re-verification screen the patient verifies with either their password or an email one-time code, and can switch between the two methods.
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 924, 925, 926 (Identity Re-verification: Verification Method Selector, Password Field, Email OTP Field).

nodes.title: Re-verification failure message

attrs.statement: When re-verification fails, the Identity Re-verification screen shows the message “Invalid password/code. Please try again.”
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 928 (Identity Re-verification: Error Message row).

nodes.title: Password changed message holds no limits or sensitive details

attrs.statement: The confirmation message on the Password Changed screen must not include attempt limits or sensitive details.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 903 (Password Changed Confirmation: Message Text row).

nodes.title: Wrong codes share the failed-login limit; the code then stops working

attrs.statement: A wrong 6-digit code (registration, password reset, re-verification, email change) counts toward the same limit as failed logins (the FR-026 max login attempts setting, default 5). After the limit the code stops working and the patient must request a new one; the resend cooldown applies. There is no separate setting. One failed-attempt counter per account serves both sign-in and code entry; it resets after a successful sign-in or code entry and when a lockout ends, and a lowered limit applies from the next failed attempt (REQ-026-145).
attrs.rationale: FR-001 PRD Screens 5, 11 and 18; owner default 255 (other option: a separate new setting).

nodes.title: Duplicate email at registration gets the neutral result; only a registration that never had a verified email may register again

attrs.statement: A registration with an email that belongs to an existing account gets the same neutral "check your email" result as a new email and reveals nothing on screen; the system emails the existing owner that an account already exists. An existing account is every record except a registration that never had a verified email, including an account whose email is unverified after an admin change. A registration that never had a verified email (never finished) may register again with the same email: only that unfinished record is replaced and a new code is sent.
attrs.rationale: FR-001 PRD Screen 4 and Edge Cases; consistent with the neutral reset message (Workflow 3, C3).

nodes.title: Password reset, admin reset, suspension and a fulfilled deletion end every existing session

attrs.statement: A password reset by the patient, a password reset by an admin and a suspension each end all existing sessions of the patient on every device, as Change Password does (REQ-001-119). After a patient reset a new session starts only where the account status allows it (REQ-001-076). When FR-023 sets a deletion request to Fulfilled, every session of the patient ends too, login with the old credentials gets the standard "Invalid email or password" result, and the email address is free for a new registration, which creates a new account with no link to the old data.
attrs.rationale: FR-001 PRD Screen 12 and Login Rules; owner default 256 (other option: sessions end only on Change Password) and default 273 for a fulfilled deletion (other option: the address stays blocked). FR-016 has no session-ending rule for suspension or admin reset.

nodes.title: Email change: the code goes to the new address and the old email stays the login email until confirmed

attrs.statement: When the patient changes the email on the profile, the 6-digit code is sent to the NEW address. The login email stays the old address, and the new one is held as pending (ENT-patient.pending_email), until the code is confirmed. Screen 14 shows the pending address (read only), the code input, Resend and Cancel change (clears the pending address). The code lives 15 minutes (REQ-001-098) and follows the same resend limit and wrong-code limit as the other codes; when it expires the pending address stays until the patient resends or cancels. After confirmation the new address becomes the login email, the pending value is cleared and a notice goes to the old address.
attrs.rationale: FR-001 PRD Screen 14 and Screen 18.

nodes.title: Admin email change: notice to the old address, the patient confirms the new address at the next login

attrs.statement: An admin may change a patient's email. The new address is saved as unverified, a notice goes to the old address, and at the patient's next login a code is sent to the new address and the patient confirms it before the session starts, on Screen 5 with the same expiry, resend and wrong-code rules. An address already in use gets a plain "address already in use" error (REQ-001-009).
attrs.rationale: FR-001 PRD Admin Editability Rules; owner default 257 (other option: only the patient can change the email). FR-016 only says admins may update the email with justification and audit (REQ-016-013); the FR-016 side is queued.

nodes.title: Settings Main has a Consent row and a Language row

attrs.statement: Settings Main (Screen 15) has a Consent row that opens the general Consent view (FR-027, REQ-027-016) and a Language row that opens the app language choice (FR-021, REQ-021-002, REQ-001-165). FR-001 owns Settings Main and the Notification, Privacy and Terms sub-screens; the two opened views are owned by FR-027 and FR-021.
attrs.rationale: FR-001 PRD Screen 15.

nodes.title: Delete Account screen shows the free-text reason, the extra-verification input and the request status

attrs.statement: Screen 16 shows three conditional blocks: the optional free-text reason (max 500 characters) when the chosen reason requires an explanation (REQ-026-092); the additional-verification input while the request is in Verification Required (REQ-023-034); and a read-only request status line while a request is open (REQ-023-046). The Request Deletion button is hidden while a request is open (REQ-023-037). No new screen.
attrs.rationale: FR-001 PRD Screen 16.

nodes.title: First sign-in consent gate

attrs.statement: After a successful login, a patient who has not given the general consent is shown the FR-027 consent prompt before the main app (REQ-027-062). A patient who does not accept stays in the limited state of REQ-027-033.
attrs.rationale: FR-001 PRD Workflow 2 and Screen 9.

nodes.title: Deactivated is a reserved account status value

attrs.statement: The account status list keeps the value Deactivated as a reserved value: nothing sets it, nothing shows it and it has no behaviour. An admin changes account status only through the FR-016 flows. The system also locks an account after failed logins (REQ-001-007), unlocks it when the lock period ends, and returns a Locked account to Active after a password reset (REQ-001-076).
attrs.rationale: FR-001 PRD Screen 19; owner default 254 (other option: remove the value from the list).

nodes.title: After a correct code or login, the next screen depends on the registration state

attrs.statement: After a correct verification code on Screen 5, and after a login with correct credentials, the next screen depends on the registration state: a patient whose profile or discovery step is unfinished goes to Screen 6 (then Screen 8); a patient whose registration is finished goes to the login success step and the session starts. A patient who verified the email but never finished the profile is sent back to finish it at the next login, on any device, before entering the app.
attrs.rationale: FR-001 PRD Screen 5, Screen 9 and Alternative Flow B3; owner default 270 (other option: let the patient in and rely on the block at inquiry submission).

nodes.title: Validate responses against questionnaire template

attrs.statement: Engine MUST validate responses against the FR-025 template requirements of the version named in the request; a missing required answer is rejected with ANSWER_REQUIRED_MISSING naming the question.
attrs.rationale: Core Requirements. Validation uses the version in the request, not the latest published one (REQ-002-037, REQ-002-041).

nodes.title: Derive risk tags deterministically; the engine is the only producer

attrs.statement: Engine MUST derive risk/alert tags deterministically from the severity flags FR-025 sets on the answers of the version named in the request. It is the only producer of risk tags: one tag per Yes answer on a Critical or Standard question (code is the questionId, label is the question text of that version); a Yes on a No Alert question produces no tag. The highest severity among the tags is returned as alertTier (Critical is Red, Standard is Amber; FR-025 REQ-025-064). When no tag is raised it returns one tag with code NONE and severity none (Green), so alerts is never empty.
attrs.rationale: Core Requirements. FR-003 and FR-025 point here instead of deriving tags themselves. A consumer takes alertTier as returned and does not aggregate severities itself. The admin input is the severity flags in FR-025; there is no separate risk-tag rule configuration.

nodes.title: Validate and persist media artifacts

attrs.statement: Engine MUST validate and persist media artifacts
attrs.rationale: Core Requirements (line 293). Workflow 1 step 4: engine persists head scan media under anonymized patient identifier and stores to storage. Shared Services (line 47): S-01 validates head scan media.

nodes.title: Return normalized payload, alerts, per-photo media results, scanRef and audit fields

attrs.statement: Engine MUST return processingId, normalized payload, alerts and alertTier, per-photo media results, scanRef and audit fields
attrs.rationale: Core Requirements. Response contract in Screen Specifications: processingId, normalized, alerts, alertTier, scanRef, one media item per photo, audit.

nodes.title: Stamp responses with one version: templateVersionUsed and the set identifier

attrs.statement: Responses MUST be stamped with templateVersionUsed and the set identifier (templateSetId); there is no separate ruleset stamp. Validation and alert derivation use the version named in the request, and FR-003 questionnaireVersion is a copy of templateVersionUsed.
attrs.rationale: Data Requirements. The earlier second stamp (rulesetVersion) named the same FR-025 set version, so it is removed.

nodes.title: Media artifacts store validation status and quality score

attrs.statement: Media artifacts MUST store validationStatus and qualityScore (0 to 100).
attrs.rationale: Data Requirements. The score is the value the FR-026 quality threshold check used (REQ-002-034).

nodes.title: Audit records capture processing id and time

attrs.statement: Audit records MUST capture processingId and processedAt
attrs.rationale: Data Requirements (line 300). Key Entities IntakeProcessingResult (lines 340-342).

nodes.title: No PII in engine responses

attrs.statement: No PII in the structured fields of engine responses; anonymized identifiers only. Free-text answers and a visible face in the head scan photos are the documented exception in REQ-002-048.
attrs.rationale: Security and Privacy Requirements. Narrowed to structured fields because the free-text answers cannot be filtered (owner default 75).

nodes.title: Store media under anonymized patient id

attrs.statement: Media MUST be stored under anonymizedPatientId
attrs.rationale: Security and Privacy Requirements (line 305). Repeated in integration contract rules (line 196) and Security Considerations (line 394).

nodes.title: All operations auditable and retention-compliant

attrs.statement: Every submit attempt (accepted or rejected) and every media-only call MUST be fully auditable and retention-compliant; the derive-only and read calls write no audit entry.
attrs.rationale: Security and Privacy Requirements. The derive-only call persists nothing and the read call changes nothing, so neither writes an audit entry (REQ-002-044, REQ-002-043).

nodes.title: Consume questionnaire templates and rules read-only

attrs.statement: Engine MUST consume questionnaire templates/rules from FR-025 (read-only)
attrs.rationale: Integration Requirements (line 310). Entry point 2 (line 75): engine automatically consumes updated templates/rules when FR-025 publishes new versions.

nodes.title: Expose the submit, derive-only, read and media-only calls

attrs.statement: Engine MUST expose the submit, derive-only and read calls consumed by FR-003, and the media-only call consumed by FR-011 and FR-037.
attrs.rationale: Integration Requirements. Entry point 1. Detail in REQ-002-043, REQ-002-044 and REQ-002-047.

nodes.title: Return structured error codes on validation failure

attrs.statement: Engine MUST return structured error codes for validation failures (the full list is in REQ-002-036).
attrs.rationale: Integration Requirements (line 312). The same outcome, with guidance and no persisted artifacts, is stated as REQ-002-036.

nodes.title: Entry points to FR-002

attrs.statement: Entry points: (1) FR-003 Submission: FR-003 (Inquiry Submission) calls engine API with questionnaire responses and head scan media. (2) Template Updates: Engine automatically consumes updated templates/rules when FR-025 publishes new versions. (3) Admin Configuration: Admin publishes template versions via FR-025 (A-09 settings); engine applies to new inquiries.
attrs.rationale: Entry Points (prd.md lines 72-76). Communication Structure In Scope (lines 57-61) lists the same five flows: FR-003 to Engine submission, Engine to FR-003 return, Engine to providers read-only via FR-003/PR-02, Admin to Engine via FR-025, Engine to System consumption of published versions.

nodes.title: Patients reach the engine only through FR-003

attrs.statement: Patients do not directly interact with FR-002 engine; all interaction through FR-003
attrs.rationale: Patient Platform breakdown (prd.md line 30; lines 28-29 give the capture and submit flow). Patient-facing capture UI is handled by FR-003; the patient app submits questionnaire responses and the head scan photo set (V1) to the engine via FR-003.

nodes.title: Providers consume processed artifacts read-only (normalized questionnaire, alerts, provider copy of the media)

attrs.statement: Providers consume read-only processed artifacts: the normalized questionnaire, the alerts and the provider copy of the media (REQ-002-048).
attrs.rationale: Provider Platform breakdown. Workflow 2: FR-003 reads the stored result by processingId, distributes it, and providers consume it read-only.

nodes.title: Engine passive after initial processing

attrs.statement: Provider review UI is handled by FR-003/PR-02; engine remains passive after processing, except scheduled staging clean-up (REQ-002-051)
attrs.rationale: Provider Platform breakdown. Workflow 2 step 5: provider actions (review, revision request) are handled by FR-003/FR-004; the engine only removes staged photos on a schedule.

nodes.title: Admin manages templates, fields and risk-tag rules

attrs.statement: Admin manages questionnaire templates, sections, fields, guidance copy and the severity flags on answers via FR-025
attrs.rationale: Admin Platform breakdown. Admin Editability 1. Template creation and editing are owned by FR-025. Alert severity comes from the severity flags (REQ-002-020); FR-025 has no separate risk-tag rule configuration.

nodes.title: Admin configures the quality thresholds and video duration limits; photo count, size, formats and views are fixed

attrs.statement: Admin configures the head scan quality thresholds and the video duration limits in FR-026. The head scan photo count, per-file size, formats and views are fixed by the product (REQ-002-032, REQ-002-033) and are not admin settings. Alert severity is driven by the severity flags admins set on questionnaire answers in FR-025; there is no separate alert threshold setting.
attrs.rationale: Owner default 74: the product fixes the photo count, size, formats and views. The other option was to keep them editable in FR-026.

nodes.title: Admin cannot change fixed security constraints

attrs.statement: Admin cannot modify fixed security constraints (encryption, retention policies)
attrs.rationale: Admin Platform breakdown (line 42). Admin Editability 2 (line 227) states it as 'Admin cannot alter fixed security constraints (e.g., password policy, OTP length)'; the two examples differ, so both are kept here.

nodes.title: Template versioning and publishing owned by FR-025; engine consumes the set designated Active for Inquiry
