attrs.statement: Template versioning and publishing are managed through FR-025. The engine consumes the version of the set currently designated Active for Inquiry (FR-025 REQ-025-049, REQ-025-050).
attrs.rationale: Admin Platform breakdown. FR-025 owns the designation; the engine does not pick a set itself.

nodes.title: Media service validates head scan media and transforms it

attrs.statement: S-01: 3D Media Processing Service: Validates head scan media (V1 photo set) and handles media transformations (the original file stays unmodified; see Media Rules)
attrs.rationale: Shared Services. What a transformation may do to the original is stated as REQ-002-042.

nodes.title: Media storage with secure access controls

attrs.statement: S-05: Media Storage Service: Stores processed media artifacts with secure access controls
attrs.rationale: Shared Services (line 48). Security Considerations (line 394): artifacts access-controlled. Assumption (line 362): cloud storage is available for persisted media artifacts with secure access.

nodes.title: FR-002 excludes UI, chat, scheduling, pricing

attrs.statement: Out of scope: patient-facing capture UI (handled by FR-003), provider review UI (handled by FR-003/PR-02), real-time chat between patients and providers, appointment scheduling functionality, pricing setup and quote management (covered by FR-004), direct patient-provider communication
attrs.rationale: Communication Structure Out of Scope (prd.md lines 65-70, list items joined). Executive Summary (line 12): FR-002 covers backend engines only. Assumption (line 366): FR-003 manages drafts/resubmissions and user communications.

nodes.title: Engine operations auditable with who, when and the rejection reason on rejected attempts

attrs.statement: Every submit attempt (accepted or rejected) and every media-only call is fully auditable (timestamps, actor/service, processingId, template set and version, the rejection reason on rejected attempts); the derive-only and read calls write no audit entry.
attrs.rationale: General Rules 1. The audit reason field is written when an attempt is rejected (REQ-002-036); no override exists in this FR.

nodes.title: Engine keeps no session state; the processing result and media are persisted; draft UX in FR-003

attrs.statement: Draft/submit/edit UX is defined in FR-003; the engine keeps no session state between calls, and the processing result and media are persisted (REQ-002-043).
attrs.rationale: General Rules 2. The earlier wording said persisted artifacts only, which left the result without a home.

nodes.title: Deletion requests archive or anonymize, never hard delete

attrs.statement: Retention follows the system PRD rule One 10-year retention period (REQ-SYS-002); deletion requests result in archival/anonymization (no hard deletes).
attrs.rationale: Data & Privacy Rules 2. The retention period itself is carried by REQ-SYS-002; this Rule keeps the archival/anonymization and no-hard-delete clause. Applies at the patient deleted stage because deletion requests are named.

nodes.title: Role-based access; admin sensitive views logged

attrs.statement: All access is role-based; admin access is logged with justification for sensitive views.
attrs.rationale: Data & Privacy Rules 3 (line 212).

nodes.title: Intake payloads and media encrypted

attrs.statement: Intake payloads and media artifacts processed under this FR are encrypted in transit (TLS 1.3) and at rest (AES-256), in alignment with the Constitution and FR-026.
attrs.rationale: Data & Privacy Rules 4 (line 213).

nodes.title: V1 head media is a standardized photo set

attrs.statement: For V1, head media is a standardized photo set captured in the patient app and uploaded to the system (not a true 3D model).
attrs.rationale: Media Rules 1 (line 217). Executive Summary (lines 11 and 13): V1 'scan' is a standardized head scan photo set (multiple 2D views); true 3D capture is deferred to V2.

nodes.title: Head scan needs at least one photo; no view is compulsory

attrs.statement: The head scan offers five views (front, top, left, right, back). At least one photo is required; no single view is compulsory. The product fixes these views; they are not an admin setting.
attrs.rationale: Media Rules 2. Error code MEDIA_NO_PHOTO when no head scan photo is supplied. Owner default 74.

nodes.title: Allowed formats and fixed photo limits enforced

attrs.statement: Allowed formats: JPG/PNG. A head scan holds up to 5 photos of at most 2 MB each, with no total-size limit, counted on its own (separate from the FR-003 visual evidence limit, which has its own count). The product fixes the count, size and formats; they are not admin settings.
attrs.rationale: Media Rules 3. Error codes MEDIA_FORMAT_NOT_ALLOWED, MEDIA_COUNT_EXCEEDED and MEDIA_SIZE_EXCEEDED (REQ-002-036). Owner default 74.

nodes.title: Basic quality checks with actionable guidance

attrs.statement: Basic quality checks MUST be enforced against the two FR-026 minimums, a brightness minimum and a blur minimum (each 0 to 100, default 40), and actionable guidance returned on failure. The engine scores each photo 0 to 100 for brightness and for blur; a photo passes only when each score reaches its own minimum. The qualityScore returned per photo is the lower of the two scores, for display; validationStatus carries the result.
attrs.rationale: Media Rules 4. Error code MEDIA_QUALITY_INSUFFICIENT with retake instructions. The device check uses the same thresholds (REQ-002-050).

nodes.title: Video is a future form and is not in the V1 contract; duration limits apply if it is added

attrs.statement: headVideo is a future form and is not part of the V1 contract; if it is added, the FR-026 duration limits (min/max) apply.
attrs.rationale: Media Rules 5. Kept as a future note; the V1 request carries the photo set only (REQ-002-038).

nodes.title: Failed validation returns error codes with per-photo detail, stores nothing and writes an audit entry

attrs.statement: On validation failure, engine returns the error items (REQ-002-052) with per-photo detail and guidance to the caller (FR-003); no artifacts are persisted, and an audit entry records the rejection reason. Error codes cover every enforced rule: MEDIA_FORMAT_NOT_ALLOWED, MEDIA_COUNT_EXCEEDED, MEDIA_SIZE_EXCEEDED, MEDIA_QUALITY_INSUFFICIENT, MEDIA_NO_PHOTO, MEDIA_REF_NOT_OWNED, TEMPLATE_VERSION_UNKNOWN, NO_ACTIVE_TEMPLATE_SET, ANSWER_REQUIRED_MISSING.
attrs.rationale: Media Rules 6 and Alternative Flows A1 and A3. MEDIA_NO_PHOTO replaces the earlier view-set code, which named a rule that does not exist. The audit reason field holds the rejection reason.

nodes.title: Prior template version or prior Active set accepted and recorded; unknown version rejected

attrs.statement: Engine accepts a submission made on any version that is, or at some time was, designated Active for Inquiry (the history comes from FR-025), and records the template set id and the version used (templateVersionUsed) in the audit entry; validation and alert derivation use that version. Every other version, including one published but never designated Active, is rejected with TEMPLATE_VERSION_UNKNOWN, and a state with no set designated Active for Inquiry (FR-025 REQ-025-052) is rejected with NO_ACTIVE_TEMPLATE_SET. The derive-only call applies the same rule.
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flows A2 and A3. The request names the set and the version, so the engine can tell a version that was once Active from one that never was; a published set is not Active until an admin designates it (FR-025 REQ-025-049).

nodes.title: Request carries the head scan photo set only

attrs.statement: The V1 request carries headScanPhotoSet (required, a list of up to 5 photo items, each a stagedRef or an existing scanRef with photoIndex) as its only media. A scanRef item names a stored scan, which is copied into this inquiry's set and never moved or replaced; the same validation runs again. A scanRef item is accepted only when the referenced scan is stored under the same anonymizedPatientId as the request; otherwise the attempt is rejected with MEDIA_REF_NOT_OWNED and an audit entry records it. Visual evidence is validated and stored by FR-003 and does not pass through FR-002. headVideo is future and is not part of the V1 contract (REQ-002-035). The response returns one item per photo (storedUri, providerCopyUri, validationStatus, qualityScore) and the scanRef FR-003 reads.
attrs.rationale: Integration contract. The earlier list of four media forms did not match what FR-003 sends or what FR-002 stores.

nodes.title: Distribution of processed payload through FR-003

attrs.statement: FR-003 reads the stored processing result by processingId for distribution (REQ-002-043).
attrs.rationale: Workflow 2 trigger and steps 1-2: FR-003 reads the stored result and distributes to providers.

nodes.title: Admin edits versioned; prior versions stay available

attrs.statement: Admin edits are versioned; prior versions remain accessible for existing inquiries.
attrs.rationale: Admin Editability 3 (line 228).

nodes.title: New inquiries use the version of the set currently designated Active for Inquiry

attrs.statement: System keeps prior versions for existing inquiries; new inquiries use the version of the set currently designated Active for Inquiry (FR-025 REQ-025-049, REQ-025-050).
attrs.rationale: Workflow 3 outcome and Alternative Flow C1 (owned by FR-025). The earlier wording said the latest published version, which FR-025 does not use.

nodes.title: Original media file kept unmodified; a transformation creates a separate copy

attrs.statement: The original media file is kept unmodified; any transformation creates a separate copy.
attrs.rationale: Media Rules 7. Answers the open question under REQ-002-023 about what transformations may do to the original.

nodes.title: Processing result persisted by processingId and read back by it

attrs.statement: Engine MUST persist the processing result (normalized payload, alerts, alertTier, per-photo media results, scanRef and audit fields) keyed by processingId and return it on a read by processingId. A provider open returns the media as signed links (REQ-002-049). The read writes no audit entry. Retention follows REQ-SYS-002.
attrs.rationale: FR-003 reads the result by processingId when it distributes the inquiry, so FR-002 keeps it. The earlier wording kept only the media; the engine is stateless between calls only in that it holds no session state. FR-003 stores processingId on the inquiry.

nodes.title: Derive-only call returns the risk tags and persists nothing

attrs.statement: Engine MUST offer a derive-only call: FR-003 sends templateSetId, templateVersion and the completed answers, the engine validates them, returns the risk tags and the alertTier, persists nothing and writes no audit entry (a missing required answer is returned as ANSWER_REQUIRED_MISSING). Submit runs the same derivation.
attrs.rationale: FR-002 is the only producer of risk tags; FR-003 calls this when the patient completes the questionnaire so the tags it shows are the ones submit will derive.

nodes.title: Idempotency key is the draft id; an identical retry returns the first result, a changed retry supersedes

attrs.statement: A submit request MUST carry an idempotencyKey, which is the FR-003 draft id (for a media-only call, the caller's scan id). A retry with an identical payload MUST return the first result. A retry with a changed payload MUST supersede the earlier set: that set is archived, never hard-deleted (REQ-002-028, REQ-SYS-002), and the earlier processingId is marked superseded.
attrs.rationale: A dropped response must not leave two stored photo sets for one inquiry, and a replaced set is still a retained record, so it is archived. Keying on the draft id stops a key reused for another inquiry from overwriting the first inquiry's photos.

nodes.title: Photos staged at capture and promoted at submit

attrs.statement: Photos MUST be held in staging from capture until submit, when the engine promotes them under anonymizedPatientId. Staging identity, access and removal are in REQ-002-051.
attrs.rationale: The patient captures before the engine stores anything, so the files need a holding place.

nodes.title: Media-only call for FR-011 and FR-037 with no responses or templateVersion

attrs.statement: Engine MUST offer a media-only validation and storage call for FR-011 and FR-037: it takes anonymizedPatientId, an idempotencyKey (the caller's scan id) and headScanPhotoSet with no responses or templateVersion, applies the limits of REQ-002-032 to REQ-002-036, and returns processingId, scanRef and the per-photo results. The questionnaire fields are absent on this call, and the call is audited (REQ-002-010).
attrs.rationale: Aftercare and the scan-only flow store a head scan without a questionnaire. Whether the scan is optional or needs at least one photo is set by FR-011 and FR-037.

nodes.title: Provider copy of the media has metadata stripped; face and free text are a documented exception to REQ-SYS-001

attrs.statement: Providers MUST receive a transformed copy of the head scan photos with device and location metadata stripped, made by S-01 at promotion and returned as providerCopyUri; the original stays unmodified for the patient and Admin, and storedUri is never sent to providers. A visible face in the photos and the free-text answers are a documented exception to REQ-SYS-001: providers may see them before payment.
attrs.rationale: Owner default 75: the face and free text are clinically needed to quote, so they are shown unblurred and unfiltered. Other options were blurring or cropping the face, or holding the front view until booking. Confirmation by the owner is requested.

nodes.title: Provider media access by a 15-minute signed link scoped to the distribution

attrs.statement: Provider access to the media MUST use a signed link to the provider copy that lives 15 minutes; the read call issues a new link on each authorised open, only for a provider the inquiry was distributed to. FR-003 asks for no further link when access ends: for providers who declined or were not selected, once a quote is accepted; for every provider, at inquiry cancellation. The booked provider keeps access while the booking is active.
attrs.rationale: A stored URI must not be a permanent public address. A short link that is reissued on each authorised open needs no revocation call: access ends when FR-003 stops asking. Owner default 76; other options were one fixed window for all distributed providers, or access ending for everybody at cancellation.

nodes.title: Engine media check is authoritative; device check is advisory

attrs.statement: The engine check MUST be authoritative. The device check at capture is advisory and uses the same two FR-026 minimums (brightness and blur); when the engine rejects the media, FR-003 returns the patient to the capture screen.
attrs.rationale: A modified or older app cannot be trusted to enforce the limits.

nodes.title: Staged photos: keyed by draft, restricted, removed on a schedule

attrs.statement: Staged photos MUST be keyed by the FR-003 draft id (for a media-only call, the scan id), readable only by the uploading patient and the engine, encrypted as REQ-002-030 requires, and removed by S-05 on a schedule: 7 days after the draft's last activity, or for a media-only call 7 days after staging. They are outside the REQ-SYS-002 retention rule; only promoted artifacts are retained.
attrs.rationale: Staged face photos need an owner, an access rule and a removal trigger. Removal is a scheduled job inside S-05, so no cross-FR event is needed; the last-activity time comes from the FR-003 draft inactivity rule (REQ-003-004). FR-011 and FR-037 have no draft, so their staged photos expire 7 days after staging.

nodes.title: Every submit attempt gets a processingId; version is checked first; rejections have one body shape

attrs.statement: Every submit attempt, accepted or rejected, MUST get a processingId. The engine MUST check the version first (REQ-002-037), then validate the answers and the photos, also on a prior version. A rejection MUST return error items { code, questionId or the photo's stagedRef or scanRef, message, guidance }; when answers and photos both fail, both lists come back in one response. The audit entry MUST carry the processingId, the template set id and the version.
attrs.rationale: The audit entry needs a processingId even when the attempt is rejected, and a caller needs to know which question or photo each error names. A fixed order stops a prior-version submission from skipping validation.

nodes.title: The error code tells the caller where to land the patient

attrs.statement: The error code MUST tell the caller where to land the patient: ANSWER_REQUIRED_MISSING to the questionnaire (first, when photos also fail); TEMPLATE_VERSION_UNKNOWN makes FR-003 reload the Active set and keep the draft; NO_ACTIVE_TEMPLATE_SET keeps the draft and shows a submission-unavailable message; the media codes return the patient to capture (REQ-002-050).
attrs.rationale: Only a missing answer can be fixed in the questionnaire. An unknown version is fixed by loading the current set, and with no Active set there is nothing for the patient to correct, so a retry loop would return the same code.

nodes.title: Patient creates and submits inquiry with full content

attrs.statement: System MUST allow patients to create and submit inquiries with destinations, media, date ranges, head scan media (V1 photo set; V2 true 3D), and medical questionnaire.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Workflow 1 outcome (complete inquiry created with destinations, media, head scan reference, date ranges and medical questionnaire; inquiry ID generated) and the Inquiry Payload composition list.

nodes.title: Inquiry distributed to matching and selected providers

attrs.statement: System MUST distribute completed inquiries to matching providers in selected countries and those explicitly chosen by the patient.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Distribution Rules 1 (providers in selected countries OR explicitly selected by patient) and Screen 9 (only inquiries for the provider's countries OR explicitly selected by the patient).

nodes.title: Providers see anonymized patient data and tiered alerts

attrs.statement: Providers MUST see anonymized patient data and tiered medical alerts until payment confirmation per system PRD.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Workflow 2 last step (provider views enforce anonymization until payment and show medical alerts prominently) and Data Access Rules 1.

nodes.title: Draft autosave and resume with 7-day inactivity expiry

attrs.statement: System MUST support draft autosave and resume for incomplete inquiries. A draft expires after 7 days of inactivity; the 7 days is fixed at launch and is not an admin setting. A patient who opens an expired draft is told it has expired and starts a new inquiry.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Alternative Flow A1 (draft saved automatically; patient can resume within 7 days; draft expires after 7 days of inactivity) and User Story 2.

nodes.title: Admin views, edits, reassigns, soft deletes and overrides with audit

attrs.statement: Admin MUST be able to view, edit (with warnings), reassign, soft delete (archive), and override distribution with a full audit trail. Inquiries do not expire automatically at launch, so there is no expiry override.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Workflow 4 and Admin Editability Rules.

nodes.title: Inquiry linked to patient, providers, locations, scan and questionnaire

attrs.statement: System MUST link inquiries to patients, providers, locations, head scan media, and questionnaire responses.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 1231 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Encryption and immutable audit logs

attrs.statement: System MUST encrypt all inquiry-related data at rest and in transit, and maintain immutable audit logs.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Data and Privacy 1 and 3 (all inquiry data encrypted at rest and in transit) and Security Considerations.

nodes.title: Shared Services used for notifications and media

attrs.statement: System MUST integrate with Shared Services for notifications and media/scan handling.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 1240 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Internal APIs let FR-004 read inquiry without mutation

attrs.statement: System MUST expose internal APIs required by FR-004 (quote) to consume inquiry data without mutation.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 1241 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Patient cancels in Inquiry or Quoted; admin only afterwards

attrs.statement: System MUST allow patients to cancel their own inquiry in Inquiry or Quoted stages with a required cancellation reason; cancellation is immediate and irreversible. From the Accepted stage onward, System MUST NOT offer patient cancellation; it MUST show "Contact support", and cancellation is performed only by an admin through FR-006. System MUST record who cancelled in `cancelled_by` (patient, system or admin).
attrs.rationale: Restated by Cancellation Rules 4 (cancellation is immediate and irreversible; no grace period, no admin approval required; reason required with predefined options), Workflow 5 and Alternative Flow E2.

nodes.title: Inquiry cancellation cascade to draft, sent and expired quotes

attrs.statement: System MUST auto-cancel only the draft, sent, and expired quotes when an inquiry is cancelled by the patient or by an approved account deletion, with distinct cancellation status "Cancelled (Inquiry Cancelled)"; quotes in any other status MUST keep their status and cause, and `quote.cancelled_inquiry` (FR-020) MUST go only to providers whose quotes were cancelled by this cascade.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Alternative Flow A4, Workflow 5 outcome, Alternative Flow E3 and Cancellation Rules 4 (all associated draft, sent and expired quotes auto-cancelled with status Cancelled (Inquiry Cancelled)).

nodes.title: Admin booking cancellation or Close inquiry cancels the inquiry as admin and releases hold

attrs.statement: When an admin cancels a booking through FR-006, or closes the inquiry through Close inquiry on FR-006 Screen 6, System MUST set the inquiry to `Cancelled` with `cancelled_by = admin`, leave `cancellation_reason` empty (the admin's reason is the booking's cancellation reason in FR-006, shown to the patient and the provider as FR-006 defines), release any active appointment slot hold (FR-006 hold of the FR-026 configured duration) immediately, and leave the accepted quote with the status `accepted`. Any open replacement quote (draft or sent) follows REQ-003-127.

nodes.title: Provider capacity management handled by a separate FR

attrs.statement: Provider capacity management is referenced but handled by a separate FR (TBD); integration expectations remain.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 1257 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Treatment-area catalog exposed for inquiry creation

attrs.statement: System MUST expose an active, ordered treatment-area catalog for inquiry creation, including a stable option identifier, label, and image/icon URL; Admin manages the catalog under FR-026.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Screen 1 Treatment Area notes (catalog retrieved from the Inquiry Configuration API; each option has a stable identifier, patient-facing label and image/icon URL; Hair, Beard and Both remain the default seeded options and are not a fixed client-side enum) and Inquiry Configuration Rules 5.

nodes.title: Minimum lead time enforced in date picker and at submission

attrs.statement: System MUST enforce the Admin-configured minimum inquiry lead time consistently in the patient date picker and at submission. The default blocked window is 3 days and does not change the existing two-year, non-overlap, or availability rules.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Screen 5 notes and rules (minimum lead time from inquiry date is the active Admin-configured blocked window, default 3 days; calendar eligibility and submission validation use the same value).

nodes.title: Provider status revalidated at allocation, routing and reassignment

attrs.statement: System MUST revalidate provider status at allocation, exclusive routing, and reassignment, and MUST NOT allocate inquiries to a `Suspended` or `Deactivated` provider from the effective time, including through in-flight jobs or retries, or to an `Active` provider whose FR-015 `password_set` is false. On inquiry submission, an explicitly selected provider that has become ineligible MUST be rejected with a validation error that names the provider, so the patient can choose another; it MUST NOT be removed from the selection silently (Screen 7a).
attrs.rationale: Restated by Distribution Rules 2, Rule 6 (Active provider with password_set false is not eligible), Workflow 2 matching and exclusive routing, Workflow 4 reassignment, Screen 7a and the edge case for a distribution job or retry that targets a provider that became Suspended or Deactivated after matching (allocation is revalidated and skipped; no ProviderInquiry or notification is created).

nodes.title: Provider suspension or deactivation keeps accepted inquiry open

attrs.statement: When a provider becomes `Suspended` or `Deactivated`, System MUST NOT cancel an inquiry whose accepted treatment belongs to that provider; it MUST keep the inquiry open with `supportRequired = true` while FR-006 Alternative Flow B4 records cause `ProviderSuspended` or `ProviderDeactivated` on the booking; before treatment starts, B4 closes the booking and an admin rehomes the patient through FR-006 Alternative Flow B5, an `In progress` booking stays `In progress` for the admin decision in FR-006 Alternative Flow B7, and an `Aftercare` booking follows FR-006 Alternative Flow B6; for inquiries still comparing providers, System MUST cancel only that provider's ProviderInquiry participation and quotes, keep the inquiry stage, flag it `supportRequired = true`, and preserve other providers' offers. Before acceptance, patients MUST receive the offer-unavailability message with Contact Admin/Support; after acceptance and before treatment starts, they MUST receive the `booking.provider_fault_replacement` notice that an admin will arrange a replacement provider within the same inquiry. Patients MUST NOT receive the patient-cancellation message in either case (FR-015 A5/Screen 4).

nodes.title: Automatic redistribution after cascade removes the last live offer

attrs.statement: Before acceptance, when the provider-status cascade cancels the last live offer on the inquiry (a sent quote that has not expired, with no other live offer remaining), System MUST redistribute the inquiry, at most once per provider-status event, to eligible providers that have not yet received it under the normal Workflow 2 distribution rules, keep `supportRequired = true`, and tell the patient "[Clinic] is no longer available. We are finding new offers for you." If the patient had not explicitly selected the affected provider, the redistribution is automatic. Only if the patient had explicitly selected the affected provider, System MUST first ask the patient to confirm and MUST redistribute only after confirmation; confirm, decline and no-answer follow REQ-003-128. System MUST NOT redistribute while another live offer remains (Workflow 2 Alternative Flow B4).
attrs.rationale: Restated by Workflow 2 Alternative Flow B4 step 3 (redistribution removes the exclusive restriction for an FR-037 exclusive inquiry; while the patient has not confirmed the inquiry is not redistributed and the patient keeps the Contact Admin/Support action; runs at most once per provider-status event and inquiry) and the matching edge case.

nodes.title: Entry points to inquiry creation

attrs.statement: Entry points: Patient-Initiated (primary flow through mobile app inquiry creation); Admin-Managed (direct inquiry creation and management by admin team); Provider-Viewed (provider access to distributed inquiries).
attrs.rationale: PRD Entry Points (69-71).

nodes.title: No direct patient-provider chat in this module

attrs.statement: Out of scope: direct patient-provider chat (handled by FR-012).
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 65 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Providers cannot modify patient data before a quote

attrs.statement: Given pre-quote stage, when a provider attempts to modify patient data, the system blocks and logs read-only access. Provider can review inquiry details.
attrs.rationale: User Story 3 scenario 3 (1396); Screen 10 business rules (924); Provider Platform scope (35-37).

nodes.title: Primary service is Get a Hair Transplant; other services use other workflows

attrs.statement: Service options: "Get a Hair Transplant" (primary option); "Monitor Hair Loss", "Aftercare: Monitor Transplant Progress" and "Aftercare for Transplant" (secondary - different workflow). Primary focus on "Get a Hair Transplant" option; other services are secondary features.
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen 1 notes and business rules (463-484).

nodes.title: Patient eligibility validated at service selection

attrs.statement: System validates patient eligibility; if eligibility is not valid, show an eligibility error and block progression.
attrs.rationale: PRD Workflow 1 flow diagram, service step (79-87).

nodes.title: One active treatment-area option chosen; inactive options stay readable

attrs.statement: When the service is Get a Hair Transplant, patient must select one active treatment-area option; the other services do not ask for one. The selected option must be active when the inquiry is created; inactive options remain readable on historical inquiries through their saved snapshot.
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen 1 business rules (478-481); Inquiry Configuration Rules 5.

nodes.title: Used treatment-area option cannot be deleted

attrs.statement: A treatment-area option used by an existing inquiry cannot be deleted. It may be deactivated for future inquiries while historical inquiry display retains the saved label and asset reference.
attrs.rationale: PRD Business Rules, Inquiry Configuration Rules 5 (1041-1042).

nodes.title: Lead time is an Admin-set whole number of blocked days

attrs.statement: Admin configures the minimum inquiry lead time as a whole number of blocked days. The default is 3; the permitted value is 0 through 730, consistent with the existing two-year date horizon.
attrs.rationale: PRD Inquiry Configuration Rules 5 (1043).

nodes.title: Patient platform reads catalog and lead time from the backend

attrs.statement: The patient platform retrieves the current catalog and lead-time setting from the backend. A client release is not required for ordinary option or lead-time changes only after implementation verifies compatibility with this dynamic response.
attrs.rationale: PRD Inquiry Configuration Rules 5 (1044).

nodes.title: At most 10 destination countries

attrs.statement: Maximum 10 countries selectable. Country selection limited to 10 countries maximum.
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen 2 rules (510), Validation and Constraints 1 (1161), Workflow 1 destination step (89).

nodes.title: Starting price shown per destination country with fallback currency

attrs.statement: Starting prices displayed for transparency. Starting price per country; currency based on patient location; fallback pricing for unsupported currencies.
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen 2 notes and rules (503-513).

nodes.title: Detailed hair-concern fields: four required, two optional

attrs.statement: All required fields must be completed: nature of concern (text), duration (a choice from the Admin-managed problem-duration list), previous treatments (text) and symptom severity (integer 1-10 slider). Lifestyle factors and additional notes are optional. Text fields have character limits.
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen 3 data fields and rules (519-545); Workflow 1 details step.

nodes.title: Visual evidence limited to 5 files with size and format rules

attrs.statement: Visual evidence limited to 5 files total, photos and videos together; the head scan photo set is counted separately. Photos: JPG/PNG <= 2MB each. Videos: MP4 <= 30s, <= 20MB each. File size and format validation enforced; invalid media is blocked with actionable guidance.
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen 3 rules, Validation and Constraints 1, Workflow 1 upload step, Edge Cases. The 5-file total covers the inquiry's photos and videos together; the head scan photo set (Screen 4) is counted on its own.

nodes.title: Head scan photo set required and must meet FR-002 thresholds

attrs.statement: Head scan photo set must meet minimum completeness/quality thresholds required by FR-002. Head scan media quality validation applies. The photo set holds up to 5 photos, JPG or PNG, 2 MB each, counted on its own and separate from the 5-file visual-evidence limit on Screen 3.
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen 4 data fields and rules (554-572); Validation and Constraints 2.

nodes.title: Patient can retake a poor-quality head scan capture

attrs.statement: Patient can retake capture if quality poor; the system prompts retake with guidance when the scan quality is not valid.
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen 4 rules (571); Workflow 1 scan step.

nodes.title: Head scan media encrypted, access-controlled, shown through engine outputs

attrs.statement: Captured media encrypted and stored securely. Head scan media stored securely with access controls. Media accessible to providers for assessment via engine outputs.
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen 4 rules (572-574); Data Security 3.

nodes.title: V1 head scan is a photo set; true 3D is V2

attrs.statement: In V1, "3D head scan" capture is implemented as a standardized head scan photo set (multiple 2D views). True 3D capture is deferred to V2. Head scan requires viewer (photo set gallery in V1; interactive 3D in V2).
attrs.rationale: PRD Executive Summary (16-17), Screen 4 purpose and notes (547-570), Screen 10 head scan notes and rules (920).

nodes.title: At most 10 treatment date ranges

attrs.statement: Maximum 10 date ranges selectable.
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen 5 rules (591), Workflow 1 dates step.

nodes.title: Date ranges cannot overlap

attrs.statement: Date ranges cannot overlap. Overlapping date ranges are rejected server-side with correction prompts.
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen 5 rules, Validation and Constraints 2 (1169), Edge Cases (1420).

nodes.title: Date ranges at most 2 years in the future

attrs.statement: Dates limited to 2 years in future.
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen 5 rules, Validation and Constraints 1.

nodes.title: Date and provider availability validated

attrs.statement: System validates date availability and provider availability.
attrs.rationale: PRD Workflow 1 dates step (97); Screen 5 notes and rules (593-602).

nodes.title: Every medical question needs Yes/No; Yes needs details

attrs.statement: All questions require Yes/No answers. Detailed explanations required for "Yes" answers. The patient must complete the medical questionnaire before submission; missing details for "Yes" answers block submission until completed.
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen 6 rules (643-644), Medical Data Rules 2, Submission Rules 1 (1023), Edge Cases (1421).

nodes.title: Questionnaire managed by admin through FR-025 and versioned

attrs.statement: Medical questionnaire managed by admin (not hard-coded) via FR-025 (Medical Questionnaire Management). Questionnaire content versioned and auditable.
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen 6 rules (646), Medical Data Rules 2 (1086-1090).

nodes.title: MVP questionnaires are Yes/No only; typed answers need V2 work

attrs.statement: MVP: Inquiry questionnaires support Yes/No questions only (enforced in FR-025 publishing/activation rules). Future (V2+): if Inquiry questionnaires allow non-Yes/No question types, the inquiry response schema and UI must be extended to support typed answers (e.g., numeric scale, multi-select, free text).
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen 6 rules (647-648); Key Entities MedicalQuestionnaireResponse note.

nodes.title: Medical alerts prominently shown as colour-coded chips

attrs.statement: Alerts prominently displayed to providers. Critical alerts: red color-coded chips. Standard alerts: yellow/amber color-coded chips. No alerts: green color-coded chips.
attrs.rationale: PRD Medical Data Rules 1, Screen 9 rules (846), Screen 10 rules (917), UI/UX Display Rules 4.

nodes.title: Critical alerts inform providers; they never reject the patient

attrs.statement: Inquiry flagged with critical alerts for provider awareness (not patient rejection). "Critical" means the FR-025 Red tier. Admin can review and provide guidance to providers. A critical alert shows as a badge on the inquiry's row in the admin inquiry queue (Screen 11); no separate admin notification is sent at launch. Medical alerts are for provider awareness, not patient rejection.
attrs.rationale: PRD Alternative Flow A3 (140-156); Business Process Assumptions (1330).

nodes.title: Patient selects at least 1 and at most 5 providers

attrs.statement: Maximum 5 providers selectable. Patient must select at least 1 provider to proceed.
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen 7a data fields and rules (689-713); Distribution Rules 2.

nodes.title: Provider suggestions ranked by reviews and admin curation, in selected countries

attrs.statement: Provider suggestions based on positive reviews and admin curation (system PRD). Only providers in patient's selected destination countries are shown. Patient can search/filter providers by country, rating, and specialty.
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen 7a notes and rules (693-709); Workflow 1 provider step; Distribution Rules 2.

nodes.title: Selected providers included; others may also receive the inquiry

attrs.statement: Selected providers are included in the inquiry for distribution; system may also distribute to additional matching providers per distribution rules.
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen 7a rules (710).

nodes.title: Patient reviews all sections and accepts terms before submit

attrs.statement: Patient must review all sections. Patient can edit any section before submission. The Current Terms & Conditions must be accepted before submission: the checkbox appears only when the patient has not yet accepted them, and submission stays blocked until they are accepted (FR-027 REQ-027-033, REQ-027-035).
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen 7 rules (672-675); Workflow 1 review step.

nodes.title: Submission generates a unique inquiry ID in HPID format

attrs.statement: Submission generates unique inquiry ID (HPID format: HPID + YY + MM + 4-digit sequence). Inquiry uniqueness validation applies.
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen 7 rules (676), Workflow 1 review step and Workflow 2 identify step, UI/UX Display Rules 3 (1151-1153), Validation and Constraints 2.

nodes.title: A patient has only one active inquiry at a time

attrs.statement: Patient can only have one active inquiry at a time. Cancelled inquiries are not counted as "active".
attrs.rationale: PRD Submission Rules 1, Screen 8 rules (775, 782).

nodes.title: Inquiry editable by the patient only in Inquiry stage

attrs.statement: Patient can modify inquiry if still in "Inquiry" stage; otherwise a blocked message (stage changed) is shown.
attrs.rationale: PRD Submission Rules 1, Alternative Flow A2, Screen 8 rules.

nodes.title: Returning patient offered to continue an incomplete inquiry

attrs.statement: System shows "continue with your request" option; patient can resume from last completed step; system displays inquiry status as "incomplete" or "pending". On return within 7 days the system restores the last step and data and previously validated sections remain intact.
attrs.rationale: PRD Alternative Flows A1, A2; User Story 2.

nodes.title: Failed submission shows an error and allows retry

attrs.statement: Show submission error and allow retry when submission does not succeed.
attrs.rationale: PRD Workflow 1 flow diagram, submission step.

nodes.title: Only complete and valid inquiries are distributed

attrs.statement: System detects a submitted inquiry meeting completeness requirements; an incomplete or invalid inquiry is not distributed and errors are returned or the inquiry is flagged for fix. Every inquiry record MUST include destinations, treatment date ranges, problem details and questionnaireSummary (including derived medical alerts), media attachments (photos/videos and head scan photo set / scanRef from FR-002), a linked patient identifier (HPID-based patientId) and distribution metadata via related ProviderInquiry records, fully populated before an inquiry is eligible for distribution to providers.
attrs.rationale: PRD Workflow 2 trigger and flow diagram (186-215); Key Entities Inquiry Payload composition (1270-1279).

nodes.title: At most 10 providers per inquiry; explicit selections always included

attrs.statement: When matched providers exceed 10, select up to 10 providers (ensure explicitly selected providers included; remaining per matching rules).
attrs.rationale: PRD Workflow 2 flow diagram (199-202).

nodes.title: Provider-specific anonymized views created and timestamps recorded

attrs.statement: Create provider-specific inquiry views (anonymized); distribute inquiry to providers and record timestamps.
attrs.rationale: PRD Workflow 2 flow diagram (204-213).

nodes.title: Provider notifications: first send attempt within 5 minutes, with retry and SLA alert

attrs.statement: Send provider notifications (target: first send attempt within 5 minutes). If notification dispatch fails: queue/retry, alert on SLA risk and log attempts.
attrs.rationale: PRD Workflow 2 flow diagram (213-217); Alternative Flow B3 outcome.

nodes.title: No matched provider: admin assigns manually and patient may be told of delay

attrs.statement: If no providers are found in the patient's selected countries, the system notifies admin of the unmatched inquiry for manual assignment; patient is optionally notified of potential delay. Admin can manually assign inquiries.
attrs.rationale: PRD Workflow 2 flow diagram (206-208), Alternative Flow B1, Distribution Rules 2; B4 step 3 (if redistribution finds no eligible provider, B1 applies).

nodes.title: Provider capacity checks are advisory and do not block distribution

attrs.statement: Provider capacity limits affect distribution where capacity data is available; until the dedicated Provider Capacity Management FR is delivered, capacity checks are advisory and MUST NOT block inquiry distribution.
attrs.rationale: PRD Alternative Flow B2, Distribution Rules 2.

nodes.title: Providers must respond within 72 hours (configurable)

attrs.statement: Providers must respond within 72 hours (configurable).
attrs.rationale: PRD Distribution Rules 2 (1031); the change log records alignment with the system PRD.

nodes.title: No inquiry expires automatically at launch

attrs.statement: System MUST NOT expire an unquoted inquiry automatically at launch. An inquiry stays open until the patient or an admin cancels it, or it is quoted and the patient decides. Draft expiry (REQ-003-004) and quote expiry (FR-004, FR-026) are separate and unchanged.
attrs.rationale: PRD Submission Rules 1 (1024), Screen 9 rules (848).

nodes.title: Decline action only for the exclusive provider, with confirmation and reason

attrs.statement: Decline Exclusive Inquiry declines an FR-037 monitoring-conversion inquiry before quote creation; exclusive assigned provider only; confirmation and reason required.
attrs.rationale: PRD Workflow 3 flow diagram (297-303), Screen 10 data fields (868).

nodes.title: Duplicate decline requests release the inquiry only once

attrs.statement: Repeated decline requests MUST NOT distribute the inquiry more than once. Duplicate decline requests return the committed result without creating duplicate provider views or notifications.
attrs.rationale: PRD Alternative Flow C2 (329), Edge Cases (1427).

nodes.title: Decline fallback is triggered only by an explicit decline, not by expiry

attrs.statement: The automatic fallback is triggered by an explicit provider decline only. Quote expiry (FR-004) does not trigger it, and inquiries do not expire at launch (REQ-003-067).
attrs.rationale: PRD Alternative Flow C2 expiry boundary (330), Distribution Rules 2, Edge Cases (1428).

nodes.title: Redistribution after provider status removes the exclusive restriction

attrs.statement: For an FR-037 exclusive inquiry, redistribution removes the exclusive restriction in the same way as the explicit-decline fallback (REQ-037-029). The supportRequired marker stays on the inquiry.
attrs.rationale: PRD Workflow 2 Alternative Flow B4 step 3 (279).

nodes.title: Provider asks admin for clarification; inquiry stays in Inquiry stage

attrs.statement: Provider requests clarification via admin; admin facilitates communication; inquiry remains in "Inquiry" stage until resolved.
attrs.rationale: PRD Workflow 3 flow diagram, Alternative Flow C1.

nodes.title: A provider sees an inquiry only through a ProviderInquiry row that is not cancelled

attrs.statement: A provider sees an inquiry only if a ProviderInquiry row exists for that provider on it and the row is not `cancelled`. A provider in a matching country that was not matched into the capped list and was not selected by the patient does not see the inquiry.
attrs.rationale: PRD Data Access Rules 3, Screen 9 rules (844), Data and Privacy 2.

nodes.title: Masked patient name format and visible fields

attrs.statement: Patient name masking format: first name + last initial + asterisks (e.g., "John D*****"). Full name revealed only after payment confirmation. Patient ID (HPID-based) visible; name, phone number, and email remain masked/hidden until payment confirmation. Age, gender and country are shown.
attrs.rationale: PRD UI/UX Display Rules 5, Screen 10 notes (891-893).

nodes.title: Patient ID display format

attrs.statement: Patient ID format: HPID + YY + MM + 4-digit sequence. Example: HPID2501001 (HPID + 25 + 01 + 0001).
attrs.rationale: PRD UI/UX Display Rules 3, Screens 9, 10 and 11 Patient ID columns.

nodes.title: Primary date range shown with tooltip for the others

attrs.statement: Primary date range displayed prominently. Additional ranges shown as "[+ X other ranges]" with tooltip expansion. Tooltip shows all date ranges with full details.
attrs.rationale: PRD UI/UX Display Rules 1, Screen 9 rules.

nodes.title: Relative, yesterday and dated time display

attrs.statement: Recent inquiries: relative format ("X minutes ago", "X hours ago"). Previous day: specific format ("Yesterday at 3:45 PM"). Older inquiries: date format ("Sep 22, 2025").
attrs.rationale: PRD UI/UX Display Rules 2, Screen 9 rules.

nodes.title: Inquiry detail timeline lists creation, distribution, views and status changes

attrs.statement: Timeline: creation, distribution to providers, provider views, status changes; sorted descending by time with relative and absolute timestamps.
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen 10 notes (908-909).

nodes.title: Admin can edit every category of inquiry data

attrs.statement: Admin can edit ALL inquiry data in the system: inquiry data (all patient-submitted information), patient data (patient information, contact details), provider data (provider assignments and settings), system data (expiration rules, capacity limits) and medical data (questionnaire responses and alerts). Admin can override any system-calculated settings.
attrs.rationale: PRD Admin Editability Rules 1 and 2, Screen 10 rules (919), Screen 12 rules (1006).

nodes.title: Every admin change needs a reason

attrs.statement: Change reason required for all modifications. Block save and require a reason when none is provided.
attrs.rationale: PRD Workflow 4 flow diagram, Admin Editability Rules 3, Screen 12 rules.

nodes.title: Admin edits logged with who, when, what, reason

attrs.statement: All admin edits logged with timestamp and admin identification. Edit history maintained for audit trail. Audit trail records who, when, what changed (old -> new), reason, IP (if available); filterable by field, user, date range; exportable (CSV/JSON) for compliance; immutable and timestamped. Complete audit trail maintained.
attrs.rationale: PRD Admin Editability Rules 3, Screen 12 notes (1004-1011) and rules.

nodes.title: Patient and provider notified of significant admin changes

attrs.statement: Patient and provider notified of significant changes. Trigger re-notifications when impactful fields change; admin may re-notify parties if impactful.
attrs.rationale: PRD Admin Editability Rules 3, Workflow 4 flow diagram, Screen 12 notes (1000).

nodes.title: Visual warnings shown for data modification

attrs.statement: Visual warnings displayed for data modification. Edit inquiry details with caution banners and field-level audit.
attrs.rationale: PRD Admin Editability Rules 3, Screen 12 notes and rules.

nodes.title: Admin reassignment offers only eligible providers

attrs.statement: Select provider(s) from eligible providers only (Active, Owner password set). Ineligible providers (status not Active, or Owner password not set) are hidden from the admin provider picker. If a selected provider becomes ineligible before the admin saves, the save is blocked with "[Provider] can't receive inquiries right now (not active or activation not completed)." The same check applies to providers included through the distribution override.
attrs.rationale: PRD Workflow 4 flow diagram (349-352), Screen 12 notes (1005).

nodes.title: Admin reassignment avoids duplicates and may send a note

attrs.statement: Reassign providers (single/multi) with eligibility checks: search providers by country/specialty; multi-select. Validation: avoid duplicates; respect provider capacity policies (if enabled). Optional note sent to provider(s) upon assignment.
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen 12 notes (1002-1006).

nodes.title: Admin distribution overrides need confirmation and reason

attrs.statement: Override distribution with required reason: re-run matching; include/exclude specific providers. All overrides require confirmation and reason entry. There is no expiry override at launch because inquiries do not expire (REQ-003-067).
attrs.rationale: PRD Workflow 4 flow diagram (355-358), Screen 12 notes (1001-1004).

nodes.title: Admin soft delete only, with reason, Archived badge and a Completed or Cancelled guard

attrs.statement: Soft delete only (no hard deletes). Archive requires reason and confirmation; retains data for audit; prevents further edits; read-only view after deletion; display badge "Archived" wherever an archived inquiry is shown in admin views. An admin may archive an inquiry only when its stage is Completed or Cancelled; any other stage is refused with a message and nothing changes. Archive hides the inquiry in admin list views, sends no patient or provider notice and changes no status.
attrs.rationale: PRD Workflow 4 flow diagram (360-363), Screen 12 notes (1007-1009) and rules (1013), Data Security 3 (soft deletes only, no hard deletes allowed).

nodes.title: Admin can escalate an urgent case

attrs.statement: Escalate urgent case: mark urgent and assign owner; escalation is logged.
attrs.rationale: PRD Workflow 4 flow diagram (365-367).

nodes.title: Admin contacts patient or provider and the intervention is logged

attrs.statement: Admin contacts patient or provider, resolves the issue and updates the inquiry if needed; the system logs the intervention in the audit trail. Admin notes are time-stamped and visible to admins only.
attrs.rationale: PRD Workflow 4 flow diagram (369-372), Screen 12 notes (999).

nodes.title: Admin overview shows all inquiries with filters and bulk actions

attrs.statement: Shows all inquiries in all lifecycle stages. Admin has full visibility of all data. Advanced filtering by patient and provider locations, stage, payment status and date ranges, using valid enum values and ranges. Bulk actions available. Real-time status updates.
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 960, 964-968 (Screen 11 Advanced Filters row and business rules).

nodes.title: All inquiry data access is logged and monitored

attrs.statement: All data access logged for audit trail. Admin access logged for audit trail. Access attempts logged and monitored.
attrs.rationale: PRD Data Access Rules 3, Data and Privacy 2 and 3.

nodes.title: Cross-tenant data access only through authenticated APIs

attrs.statement: Cross-tenant data access through authenticated APIs only.
attrs.rationale: PRD Data and Privacy Rules, Data Access (1102).

nodes.title: Cancelled inquiries follow the same retention

attrs.statement: Cancelled inquiries are subject to the same retention policy as completed inquiries; cancellation does not accelerate data deletion timelines.
attrs.rationale: PRD Data and Privacy Rules, Data Retention (1096).

nodes.title: Admin sees patient cancellations but cannot block or reverse them

attrs.statement: Admin has oversight visibility of patient-initiated cancellations but cannot block or reverse them.
attrs.rationale: PRD Cancellation Rules 4 (1066).

nodes.title: Cancellation preflight changes no state and a failure does not cancel

attrs.statement: Preflight (no state change): confirm inquiry still active; load quotes and notification targets. If preflight fails, show a temporary error with Retry/Back and do NOT cancel yet.
attrs.rationale: PRD Workflow 5 flow diagram (390-395).

nodes.title: Cancellation commits atomically with an audit event

attrs.statement: Atomic commit: set inquiry = Cancelled with timestamp and reason; cancel draft, sent, and expired quotes (if any); write immutable audit event. With no quotes, only the inquiry status is updated and no quote cascade is needed.
attrs.rationale: PRD Workflow 5 flow diagram (397-399), Alternative Flow E1 (421-432).

nodes.title: Cancellation audit event content

attrs.statement: Cancellation event is logged in immutable audit trail with: patient ID, inquiry ID, timestamp, reason, optional feedback.
attrs.rationale: PRD Cancellation Rules 4 (1068).

nodes.title: Providers whose quotes were cancelled are notified without the reason, first send attempt within 5 minutes

attrs.statement: Only providers whose quotes were cancelled receive notification of the cancellation; cancellation reason is NOT shared with providers (patient-private analytics data). Send/enqueue notifications (target: first send attempt within 5 minutes, not a guarantee; a failed first attempt is retried under the FR-030 retry rule; owned by this FR; FR-020 delivers the notice, REQ-020-020); if enqueue/send fails, queue/retry notifications and log attempts (do not roll back cancellation). When no quote was cancelled, no provider is notified.
attrs.rationale: PRD Workflow 5 flow diagram (401-405), Alternative Flow E1, Alternative Flow E3 notes, Cancellation Rules 4, Screen 8a rules.

nodes.title: Cancellation reason is patient-private

attrs.statement: Cancellation reason is patient-private data (not shared with providers; stored for analytics and audit).
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen 8a rules (774).

nodes.title: Cancellation reason chosen from admin-configurable options

attrs.statement: Cancellation reason is required before the Confirm button becomes active. Default options: "Changed my mind", "Found a better option elsewhere", "Medical concerns", "Financial reasons", "Travel restrictions", "Timeline doesn't work", "Other" (admin-configurable via FR-026 Screen 5a). The stored `cancellation_reason` is the label of the selected option, checked against the options active at the time; who cancelled is recorded separately in `cancelled_by`. Additional notes are required if "Other" is selected (max 500 characters). Optional feedback: max 1000 characters.
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen 8a data fields and rules (755-777).

nodes.title: Account-deletion request cancels the inquiry with a system reason

attrs.statement: When an admin approves a patient's account-deletion request (FR-023), System MUST cancel the patient's open inquiry in stage Inquiry or Quoted. The cancellation happens at approval, not when the request is submitted, and a refused request cancels nothing. A deletion request is blocked while the patient has an inquiry at the Accepted stage or later (FR-001). System MUST set the system-generated cancellation reason "Account Deleted (System)" and `cancelled_by = system` and MUST NOT prompt the patient for a cancellation reason. Draft, sent, and expired quotes are auto-cancelled as in Workflow 5, other quotes keep their status and cause; only providers whose quotes were cancelled are notified and MUST NOT see the cancellation reason; inquiry becomes read-only.
attrs.rationale: PRD Alternative Flow E3 (437-450), Cancellation Rules 4 (1064).

nodes.title: Cancelled inquiry stays visible and read-only

attrs.statement: Cancelled inquiry remains visible in patient dashboard with "Cancelled" badge (read-only); no actions available except viewing details. The same read-only state applies to the quote comparison screen (FR-005 Screen 1, REQ-005-041).
attrs.rationale: PRD Cancellation Rules 4 (1065), Screen 8 notes (742).

nodes.title: No cooldown after cancellation

attrs.statement: No cooldown period after cancellation: patient can immediately create a new inquiry (one-active-inquiry rule: cancelled inquiry is no longer "active").
attrs.rationale: PRD Cancellation Rules 4 (1067), Screen 8b rules (813-814), Alternative Flow A4 (172-176).

nodes.title: Cancel Inquiry and Contact support shown by stage

attrs.statement: "Cancel Inquiry" is visible only in Inquiry or Quoted stages and hidden when stage is Accepted, Confirmed, In progress, Aftercare, Completed, or Cancelled. "Contact support" is shown in place of "Cancel Inquiry" from the Accepted stage onward (Accepted, Confirmed, In progress or Aftercare) and opens Help & Support so an admin can act on the request.
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen 8 data fields and notes (731-740), Workflow 5 trigger (382).

nodes.title: Inquiry status is the source of truth when cancel and quote submit collide

attrs.statement: If a quote is submitted concurrently with cancellation, the system processes cancellation first (inquiry status is source of truth); the incoming quote submission is rejected with an "Inquiry no longer active" error. FR-004 must implement the corresponding rejection handling.
attrs.rationale: PRD Workflow 5 flow diagram (399-400), Edge Cases (1425).

nodes.title: Provider draft locked with Inquiry Cancelled banner

attrs.statement: If the patient cancels while a provider is drafting a quote, the provider's draft is locked with an "Inquiry Cancelled" banner upon next save/refresh.
attrs.rationale: PRD Edge Cases (1424).

nodes.title: Cancellation success screen reflects server time and real cascade

attrs.statement: Cancellation Timestamp reflects server-side time (not client clock) for audit consistency. The Impact Summary shows the committed `cascade_quote_count` set by the cascade (STP-003-046), which can differ from the modal preview when a quote was sent or expired between the modal and the commit. The success screen is shown only after Workflow 5 completes successfully.
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen 8b rules (809-815).

nodes.title: Admin cancels from acceptance onward with reason and audit

attrs.statement: From acceptance onward, only an admin can cancel, through the FR-006 booking cancellation, from any booking state, with a mandatory reason and an audit entry. The booking and the inquiry become Cancelled, any active appointment hold is released, and the accepted quote keeps the status accepted. Refunds and fees follow the refund rules in FR-006 (Payment & Billing Rules: the refund ladder set in FR-029, or the provider-fault terms where the provider is at fault).
attrs.rationale: PRD Cancellation Rules 4 (1062), Alternative Flow E2 (434-449), User Story 4 scenario 3.

nodes.title: supportRequired is an independent marker cleared only by audited admin resolution

attrs.statement: supportRequired is an independent marker, not a lifecycle stage. Clearing it requires an audited admin resolution. Later reactivation does not clear supportRequired; only an audited admin resolution clears it.
attrs.rationale: PRD Business Rules 6 (1060), Workflow 2 Alternative Flow B4 step 5 (284), Key Entities Inquiry.

nodes.title: Provider-caused causes are distinct and never overwritten

attrs.statement: Provider-caused causes are distinct from patient cancellation, account-deletion cancellation, and Payment Window Expired, and are never overwritten by later provider status changes. The causes ProviderSuspended and ProviderDeactivated are stored on the affected ProviderInquiry and on the FR-006 booking.
attrs.rationale: PRD Business Rules 6 (1061), Workflow 2 Alternative Flow B4 Boundary (286), Key Entities (1258).

nodes.title: Completed and cancelled inquiries are not reclassified; reactivation restores nothing

attrs.statement: Completed and already-cancelled inquiries are not reclassified. Later reactivation does not restore cancelled participation or quotes. A cancelled ProviderInquiry record is retained and never reopened by reactivation.
attrs.rationale: PRD Workflow 2 Alternative Flow B4 step 5 (284), Key Entities ProviderInquiry status (1262).

nodes.title: Provider becomes eligible once its password is set; earlier inquiries not re-sent

attrs.statement: An Active provider that has not yet set its password (FR-015 password_set = false) becomes eligible once the password is set; inquiries distributed before then are not re-sent to it.
attrs.rationale: PRD Business Rules 6 (1057).

nodes.title: Cascade processing deduplicated per provider-status event and inquiry

attrs.statement: Cascade processing is deduplicated per provider-status event and inquiry. A replayed provider-status cascade produces no duplicate cancellations, support flags, or patient messages.
attrs.rationale: PRD Workflow 2 Alternative Flow B4 Boundary (286), Edge Cases (1431).

nodes.title: Patient told other offers stay open, or asked to confirm redistribution

attrs.statement: Before acceptance, the patient receives the offer-unavailability message (provider.status_cancellation_patient) with a Contact Admin/Support action (FR-020). When other offers remain open, the message says "[Clinic] is no longer available. Your other offers are still open." When the patient must confirm first, the message asks the patient to confirm the redistribution. In neither case does the patient see the Workflow 5 patient-cancellation confirmation, and no patient cancellation reason is requested.
attrs.rationale: PRD Workflow 2 Alternative Flow B4 step 4 (281).

nodes.title: Dashboard shows provider-unavailable banner and keeps other offers actionable

attrs.statement: A provider-caused status change (ProviderSuspended or ProviderDeactivated) never shows patient-cancellation copy. For a still-comparing inquiry (Inquiry or Quoted stage), the dashboard shows a provider-unavailable banner with a Contact Admin/Support action, the affected provider's offers show as unavailable while other offers remain actionable, and when no live offer remains and the patient had explicitly selected the affected provider the dashboard first asks the patient to confirm the redistribution with Confirm and Decline actions (REQ-003-128). After acceptance, the dashboard keeps the current stage and tells the patient that an admin will arrange a replacement provider within the same inquiry.
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen 8 notes (743).

nodes.title: Distribution timestamp set once per provider and feeds response metrics

attrs.statement: distributed_at (timestamp, UTC) is set once per provider when the inquiry is distributed to that provider, including when an inquiry is released to normal distribution after an exclusive provider declines (REQ-037-029). Distribution retries or re-sends to the same provider never overwrite it. It is the start point for FR-014 time to first quote (TTFQ) and response rate, and for the FR-020/FR-030 inquiry.ttfq_sla_breached alert.
attrs.rationale: PRD Key Entities ProviderInquiry (1260).

nodes.title: Provider inquiry detail shows full inquiry content and scan metadata

attrs.statement: Provider inquiry detail shows: countries (primary country highlighted; remaining in order selected), problem details, media (photos with thumbnails and modal preview, videos with poster frame and player), head scan (V1 photo set gallery viewer with zoom/compare, quality score and capture metadata if available, retake indicator if replaced after initial capture), all selected date ranges (primary first), the full Q&A list with derived alerts and a link to the audit trail of the questionnaire version used.
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen 10 notes (884-916).

nodes.title: Treatment-area options are an Admin-managed list seeded with Hair, Beard and Both

attrs.statement: Treatment-area options come from the Admin-managed catalog; Hair, Beard, and Both remain the default seeded options and are not a fixed client-side enum.
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen 1 Treatment Area Selection notes.

nodes.title: Patient receives notifications for status changes

attrs.statement: Patient receives notifications for status changes.
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen 8 Business Rules; kept general.

nodes.title: Problem-duration choices come from an Admin-managed list owned by FR-026

attrs.statement: Problem-duration choices come from an Admin-managed problem-duration list retrieved from the backend, not a fixed client-side enum; the list is managed with the other inquiry configuration owned by FR-026. Starting values, editable by Admin: Less than 6 months; 6 to 12 months; 1 to 2 years; 2 to 5 years; More than 5 years. The patient must select one active option. The inquiry stores the chosen option's label as text, so a later edit or deactivation of the option changes no saved inquiry; an inquiry created by an FR-037 conversion takes the label the monitoring case saved.
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen 3 Duration row and Duration Options notes.

nodes.title: Provider search on Screen 7a is debounced and case-insensitive

attrs.statement: The provider search on Screen 7a searches by provider name or keyword, is debounced, and is case-insensitive.
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 697 (Screen 7a Search row: Debounced; case-insensitive).

nodes.title: Provider inquiry list search by patient ID and filters

attrs.statement: The provider inquiry list (Screen 9) can be searched by patient ID, the search is debounced and case-insensitive, and the list can be filtered by age range, concern, date range (requested treatment dates), medical alerts, location (patient country), stage and inquiry date using valid ranges and enum values. The list can open with stage, location (country) and an inquiry date period already applied, as when a provider follows an FR-014 analytics drill-down; the provider can change or clear them.
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 836, 845-846 (Screen 9 Patient ID searchable; Search and Filters rows).

nodes.title: Cancel modal shows the quote impact and the provider note only when quotes exist

attrs.statement: On the cancel confirmation modal (Screen 8a) the Impact Summary reads "X quotes will be cancelled" when the inquiry has quotes to cancel (draft, sent or expired) and "No quotes to cancel" when it has none, taken from `preview_quote_count`, counted when the modal opens. The note "Providers of the quotes being cancelled will be notified of this cancellation, normally within 5 minutes" is shown only when there are quotes to cancel. Go Back closes the modal with no change of state.
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 770, 774, 785 (Screen 8a Impact Summary, Provider Notification Note, Go Back rules).

nodes.title: Cancellation success screen text follows the number of quotes cancelled

attrs.statement: On the cancellation success screen (Screen 8b) the Impact Summary reads "Your inquiry was cancelled." when no quote was cancelled and "Your inquiry and X quote(s) were cancelled." otherwise, where X is the committed `cascade_quote_count`. The line "The providers of the cancelled quotes have been notified of this cancellation." is shown only when at least one quote was cancelled.
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 807-808 (Screen 8b Impact Summary and Provider Notification Status rows).

nodes.title: Admin cancellation or Close inquiry also cancels a replacement draft, with no provider notice

attrs.statement: When an admin cancels the booking through FR-006 Screen 9 or closes the inquiry through Close inquiry on FR-006 Screen 6, System MUST move any open replacement quote (draft or sent) of that inquiry to `Cancelled (Inquiry Cancelled)`, MUST NOT send `quote.cancelled_inquiry` to any provider (an admin cancellation or close sends no provider notice, REQ-020-020), and no `quote.expired` follows. The quote-side behaviour is owned by FR-004 (REQ-004-111). The patient cancellation path has no replacement quote, because a replacement exists only after acceptance.
attrs.rationale: The rule that owns the cascade trigger (REQ-003-013) covers the patient and account-deletion paths only, so the admin paths needed their own trigger in this FR.

nodes.title: Patient confirmation of a redistribution: confirm, decline, or no answer after 48 hours

attrs.statement: When System asks the patient to confirm a redistribution (REQ-003-021), it MUST set `redistribution_state` to `awaiting_patient_confirmation`. On confirm, it MUST set `confirmed` and run normal Workflow 2 matching (Alternative Flow B1 applies when no eligible provider is found). On decline, it MUST set `declined`, leave the inquiry as it is with `supportRequired = true` and the Contact Admin/Support action, and not redistribute. If the patient has not answered after a fixed 48 hours, System MUST send one reminder (`provider.status_redistribution_reminder`, FR-020 REQ-020-159), set `admin_follow_up`, and show the inquiry in the admin inquiry queue (Screen 11); it MUST NOT send a second reminder. The patient can still confirm or decline after the reminder. The state returns to `none`, and any pending reminder is dropped, when the inquiry is cancelled, when an admin reassigns providers or reruns distribution on Screen 12, or when an admin clears `supportRequired` (REQ-003-111). The reminder is sent only while the state is `awaiting_patient_confirmation`.
attrs.rationale: Owner default: ask first, remind once, then hand the case to an admin, so an inquiry never waits with no live offer and no owner.

nodes.title: Quotes count, responses count and the ProviderInquiry viewed and quoted status come from current data

attrs.statement: `quotes_count` is the number of the inquiry's quotes in sent, accepted or expired status (FR-004) and is shown on the admin overview. `responses_count` is the number of the inquiry's ProviderInquiry rows with status `quoted` or `declined` and is shown on the patient dashboard. Both are recomputed from current data each time they are shown. A ProviderInquiry row becomes `viewed` when the provider first opens the inquiry detail (Screen 10). It becomes `quoted` when the provider first sends a quote for the inquiry (FR-004) and stays `quoted` afterwards, even if that quote later expires or is withdrawn; a quote that is only a draft does not count.
attrs.rationale: Two counters on two screens had no source and could be mistaken for one number.

nodes.title: Conversion inquiry arrives pre-filled, records its source case and shows summary pending until the PDF is attached

attrs.statement: An inquiry created by an FR-037 conversion MUST arrive with the compatible fields pre-filled, which the patient has reviewed and edited in FR-037; the patient completes the inquiry-only information (destinations, dates, provider selection and the terms check) on the FR-003 screens. The source monitoring case is recorded by the conversion record (REQ-037-062) and the monitoring-summary PDF is attached to the inquiry. Until the PDF is attached, the inquiry shows "summary pending" to the patient on Screen 8 and to providers on Screen 10; a later attachment appears with no change of inquiry stage (REQ-037-059).
attrs.rationale: FR-037 conversion hands the inquiry to FR-003; this is the intake side (REQ-037-059, REQ-037-062).

nodes.title: Shared treatment version and one to five package options

attrs.statement: Providers MUST create, edit, and submit parent quotes with one shared immutable Treatment-version relationship and one to five package-based Quote Options. Technique details MUST be loaded read-only through that relationship and MUST NOT be duplicated as provider-entered Quote data.

nodes.title: Admin-controlled expiry window captured at first send

attrs.statement: System MUST enforce the admin-controlled FR-026 expiry window (default 48h), captured at first send, and compute the deadline per sent quote. The only renewal is the admin restore of an expired quote (REQ-004-105). The admin-authored replacement quote follows the same window from its first send on Screen 8 (REQ-004-082).

nodes.title: Competing quotes cancelled on subquote acceptance

attrs.statement: System MUST cancel every other parent quote for the same inquiry as `cancelled_other_accepted` upon one subquote acceptance by the patient. Each sent parent quote MUST produce one not-selected notice per parent quote; unsent drafts MUST be cancelled silently without notice. The not-selected notice is the FR-030 `quote.accepted` event with `outcome` = `competing_parent_cancelled_other_subquote_accepted` (REQ-030-038). The admin-authored replacement acceptance of a provider-fault transfer MUST NOT run this cascade (REQ-004-082).

nodes.title: Provider withdrawal after acceptance hands over to FR-006

attrs.statement: System MUST support provider withdrawal after acceptance, only while the booking is `Accepted` or `Confirmed`, before check-in, and without a provider-fault marker, by moving the parent quote to `withdrawn`, keeping the AcceptanceEvent and snapshot unchanged, and handing the case to the FR-006 provider-fault transfer, with full audit and the mandatory `quote.withdrawn` notice.

nodes.title: Admin inline edit of quotes, after acceptance except price, currency and promotion

attrs.statement: Admin MUST be able to inline edit policy-bound fields of `draft` and `sent` quotes with required reason and re-notifications. After a subquote is accepted, an admin MUST still be able to change any quote field except price, currency, and promotion (the date range and treatment details can be changed), with a mandatory reason and full before and after history; the change MUST be stored as a new version beside the acceptance snapshot, which stays unchanged, and payment records MUST NOT change. While the booking carries a provider-fault marker, this admin edit right is suspended, except for admin notes (REQ-004-109). A replacement draft is edited only on Screen 8 and is not opened on Screen 7 (REQ-004-048).

nodes.title: Quote references inquiry and patient and appends only

attrs.statement: Quotes MUST reference original inquiry and patient; quote data appends, never overwrites inquiry data.
attrs.rationale: Business Rules restate it: quotes MUST reference the distributed inquiry ID and be linked to the original patient object; no reduction or overwriting of inquiry-supplied fields; downstream stages inherit upstream data.

nodes.title: Edits and transitions versioned and auditable

attrs.statement: All quote edits and state transitions MUST be versioned and auditable.
attrs.rationale: Business Rules and Workflow 3 restate it: all state transitions (draft to sent to expired, etc.) MUST be fully auditable, are logged, and result in notifications as appropriate.

nodes.title: Encryption and soft deletes only

attrs.statement: All quote data MUST be encrypted at rest and in transit; soft deletes only.
attrs.rationale: Business Rules: quotes CANNOT be hard deleted (only archived/soft deleted).

nodes.title: Integration with FR-003 and FR-020

attrs.statement: Module MUST integrate with FR-003 for inquiry context and FR-020 for notifications.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 716 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Admin settings applied from FR-026 quote configuration

attrs.statement: Admin settings (quote expiry window, quote-expiring-soon lead time, and quote currency) MUST be applied from the FR-026 quote configuration.

nodes.title: Money on withdrawal follows FR-006 placeholder

attrs.statement: Money handling for provider withdrawal after acceptance follows the FR-006 provider-fault terms (REQ-006-053); exact refund and payment-allocation mechanics are owned by FR-007, FR-007B, and FR-017.

nodes.title: Multiple parent quotes per provider per inquiry

attrs.statement: System MUST allow the same provider to create multiple parent quotes for one active inquiry; every quote retains an independent lifecycle, expiry, version history, and audit history.
attrs.rationale: Business Rules: each inquiry may have multiple parent quotes from multiple providers or from the same provider; package alternatives within a parent quote are Quote Options, not independent quote responses.

nodes.title: One to five ordered Quote Options

attrs.statement: Each quote MUST contain between one and five ordered Quote Options, and submission MUST be blocked outside that range.

nodes.title: Option keeps source package and quote-owned snapshot

attrs.statement: Each Quote Option MUST retain the selected provider package ID/version and a stable, versioned quote-owned snapshot of its inclusions and standard values. The parent quote MUST retain the Treatment ID/version that every option belongs to.
attrs.rationale: Business Rules: selecting a package MUST create a quote-owned snapshot.

nodes.title: Inline customization never touches the package library

attrs.statement: Providers MUST be able to customize every selected package inline for the current quote without updating or creating reusable package-library records, and without creating a new package version.
attrs.rationale: Business Rules: inline option customization MUST NOT update or create reusable package-library records.

nodes.title: Applicable date ranges and complete option/date pricing

attrs.statement: Each Quote Option MUST define at least one applicable patient-requested date range and a price, appointment date/time, timezone, and optional structured promotion for every applicable option/date combination. Pairings the provider cannot offer MAY be left out.
attrs.rationale: Business Rules: providers must select option applicability from patient-requested date ranges; a parent quote yields up to (options x date ranges) subquotes; unavailable combinations are omitted rather than priced; each priced pairing becomes one subquote for FR-005.

nodes.title: Separate relative day plan per option

attrs.statement: Each Quote Option MUST own a separate ordered day-to-day treatment plan using consecutive relative day numbers.

nodes.title: Shared clinical facts stay on the parent quote

attrs.statement: Estimated grafts, graft description, visual treatment plan, clinicians, common notes, and common requirements MUST remain shared parent-quote fields.
attrs.rationale: Business Rules: these MUST NOT be duplicated as option-specific facts.

nodes.title: Atomic aggregate version and audit

attrs.statement: Quote version and audit records MUST capture the complete parent-and-options aggregate atomically, including option additions/removals, package snapshots, inclusion changes, date-price changes, and option plan changes.
