nodes.title: Stable identifiers and aggregate subquote version

attrs.statement: FR-004 MUST expose stable identifiers for the parent quote, Quote Option, and option/date price so FR-005 can record exactly one accepted option/date combination. FR-004 versions the complete parent quote aggregate atomically; therefore, the FR-005 `subquoteVersion` MUST equal the owning parent quote's current `QuoteVersion`. Quote Options and option/date-price records do not have independent revision counters.

nodes.title: Seven-tab quote creation flow

attrs.statement: Provider Quote Creation/Edit MUST use the ordered seven-tab flow defined in Screen 1, including Sub-screen 2A for quote-local package editing and one combined Dates & Pricing tab driven by the selected package options.

nodes.title: Quote Data Ownership Matrix

attrs.statement: Every Quote, Quote Option, option item, option/date price, and option plan-day field MUST follow the Screen 1 Quote Data Ownership Matrix, with exactly one provider-editing surface or an explicit read-only/system-derived owner.

nodes.title: Quote currency from configuration, captured at first send

attrs.statement: Quote currency MUST come from the active FR-026 quote configuration (the FR-029 Default Currency), MUST NOT be provider input, and MUST be captured on the quote at first send so historical prices retain their original currency. The admin-authored replacement quote captures it at its first Screen 8 save (REQ-004-082).
attrs.rationale: Business Rules: drafts carry no captured currency; packages carry no currency of their own; currency is displayed read-only.

nodes.title: Quote-level attachments

attrs.statement: Providers MUST be able to attach quote-level supporting files that apply to every option; file security, access, audit, and retention rules MUST be enforced.

nodes.title: Shared eligible clinicians

attrs.statement: A quote MUST support one or more eligible clinician assignments shared across every option. When a team member is removed or suspended, has a role change that takes away the rights needed to work their open items, or is force-suspended or force-removed by an admin, the system rewrites the clinician list of every draft, sent and accepted quote of that provider that names the member to the replacement clinician chosen at that moment, as a system change recorded in the quote's audit history; reactivating the member does not give the quotes back (REQ-009-191).

nodes.title: Graft description generated from template

attrs.statement: Graft description MUST be generated from the fixed template text written in this PRD (Business Rules, "Graft Description template") and the estimated graft count, displayed read-only, and versioned with the quote. There is no admin setting for the template.
attrs.rationale: Business Rules: providers MAY enter and revise Estimated Grafts; the system regenerates Graft Description whenever Estimated Grafts changes; providers MUST NOT directly edit it.

nodes.title: System-owned values visible only where authorized

attrs.statement: System-owned identifiers, lifecycle status, price summaries, commission, timestamps, customization state, and version/audit metadata MUST be visible only where authorized and MUST NOT be provider-editable.

nodes.title: Analytics count parent responses, amounts from accepted price

attrs.statement: Quote-amount analytics MUST be computed from the accepted option/date price only. Unaccepted quotes MUST be excluded from amount metrics and counted once as a parent response in volume and conversion metrics; Quote Options MUST NOT be counted as responses. The counting boundary is the parent quote: each submitted parent quote MUST be counted once, on its first successful submission; several parent quotes from one provider are separate responses; and drafts, edits, re-sends, aggregate versions, Quote Options, and option/date-price records MUST NOT add responses. Response, option, subquote, acceptance, and confirmed-booking counts are different grains and MUST NOT be interchanged. FR-014 reads this Rule and keeps its references to it.
attrs.rationale: Business Rules: analytics MUST distinguish parent quote responses from Quote Options so option counts do not inflate quote-response or conversion metrics.

nodes.title: Provider status revalidated at creation and submission

attrs.statement: System MUST revalidate provider status at quote creation and submission and MUST reject quote submission by a `Suspended` or `Deactivated` provider from the effective time, including in-flight requests.
attrs.rationale: Edge Cases: a submission at or after the effective time is rejected; no sent quote, patient notification, or version is created.

nodes.title: Provider-status cancellation of unaccepted quotes

attrs.statement: When a provider becomes `Suspended` or `Deactivated`, System MUST cancel that provider's unaccepted parent quotes with status `cancelled_provider_status` and `cancellationProvenance` `ProviderSuspended` or `ProviderDeactivated`, once per parent quote rather than per option or option/date alternative, without rewriting the AcceptanceEvent, accepted IDs/versions, or quote-local package snapshots, and without reclassifying terminal or completed history. An accepted parent quote MUST NOT receive `cancelled_provider_status`; it keeps `accepted` and is handled by the FR-006 provider-fault transfer. Processing MUST be deduplicated per provider-status event and quote.

nodes.title: One package seeds one option with prefills

attrs.statement: A quote MUST be built from one treatment plus one to five Active packages. Each selected Active package MUST seed exactly one alternative Quote Option (maximum five per parent quote), never summed with another package. The package standard price MUST prefill each applicable option/date-price row, and the package's relative day plan MUST prefill the option plan.

nodes.title: Two package edit paths and option provenance

attrs.statement: Editing a package in the FR-024 package management screen MUST change only the library (as a new package version), and editing inside quote creation MUST change only a quote-local copy that is never written back. Each Quote Option MUST record its source package ID, source package version, and an inline-customised flag.
attrs.rationale: Business Rules, Package library edits and quote inline edits: the quote-local edit path covers Sub-screen 2A, Tab 5 and Tab 4 prices and never creates a package version; the first inline change sets the option's inline-customised flag.

nodes.title: Promotion terms copied at send; one automatic promotion

attrs.statement: System MUST store the offered price as entered and any promotion discount separately, MUST copy the terms of every attached promotion into the sent quote version at send, and MUST attach at most one automatic FR-019 promotion per quote to each eligible option/date-price row at send, chosen by the FR-019 priority order when several qualify. Later FR-019 promotion edits MUST NOT change a sent quote.

nodes.title: Expiry and currency captured at first send

attrs.statement: System MUST capture the quote expiry and quote currency read-only at first send from the FR-026 quote configuration. Drafts MUST carry neither, and there MUST be no per-quote expiry extension other than the admin restore of an expired quote (REQ-004-105). The admin-authored replacement quote captures its expiry at its first send, which is Save and Continue on Screen 8, and its currency at its first Screen 8 save (REQ-004-082).

nodes.title: No provider quote edits or new quotes after acceptance

attrs.statement: After a subquote is accepted, System MUST block every FR-004 quote edit by providers; their treatment-detail changes (plan, clinicians, grafts) MUST go through FR-010. Admin edits after acceptance follow REQ-004-005 and are blocked, except admin notes, while the booking carries a provider-fault marker (REQ-004-109). Price, currency, and promotion MUST never change after acceptance. An accepted parent quote MUST never be reopened, expired, or restored to an acceptable state, including after `Payment Window Expired`, and no new parent quote MAY be created or sent for an inquiry with an active acceptance (REQ-004-110), except the admin-authored replacement quote of REQ-004-048.

nodes.title: Appointment fields are the FR-006 slot-hold key

attrs.statement: The Quote Option appointment date/time and time zone, together with the provider, MUST be the key FR-006 uses for the slot hold placed at acceptance; FR-004 MUST NOT create an appointment record.

nodes.title: Quote expiring soon emitted once

attrs.statement: System MUST emit `quote.expiring_soon` once per expiry window of a sent parent quote when it reaches the FR-026 quote-expiring-soon lead time, and MUST NOT emit it for draft, accepted, or terminal quotes, including the replacement quote, which the patient does not compare. A lead time raised after the send applies only to reminders not yet sent; a reminder whose time has already passed is skipped, not sent late (REQ-026-031).

nodes.title: Option/date price greater than zero

attrs.statement: Every option/date price MUST be greater than 0 before send, and a zero price MUST block send. A date range the clinic cannot serve MUST be left out of that option rather than priced.
attrs.rationale: A zero price is blocked with an inline error on that row.

nodes.title: Automatic promotion usage reservation

attrs.statement: A sent quote carrying an automatic FR-019 promotion MUST hold exactly one reserved use of that promotion's usage limit. A re-send of a new version MUST keep the existing reservation, create one only if the new version newly qualifies, and release it if the new version no longer carries the promotion. The reservation MUST be released when the quote expires, is withdrawn, is archived, or ends not selected or cancelled, MUST be released with reason `not_applied` when the accepted row does not carry the promotion, and MUST be consumed at acceptance when the accepted row carries it, so the usage limit is never exceeded. When an admin restores an expired quote, System MUST re-check the promotion's validity and usage limit and take a new reservation only when the quote holds none; if the limit is used up or the promotion has ended, the restore MUST be blocked with a message and the provider MAY send a new quote (REQ-004-105). If the booking later ends in `Payment Window Expired` or is cancelled before the first payment, FR-005 and FR-019 own the return of the consumed use to the limit.

nodes.title: First-send timestamp set once

attrs.statement: System MUST set the parent quote's `firstSentAt` on its first send, and a re-send or new version MUST NOT change it.

nodes.title: Treatment Base Price is a reference-only prefill

attrs.statement: The FR-024 treatment Base Price MAY prefill a new option/date-price row only where no other standard value exists; it MUST be treated as a non-binding reference and MUST NOT be read after the quote is sent.

nodes.title: FR-004 produces quote.updated on re-send

attrs.statement: FR-004 MUST be the producer of `quote.updated` and MUST emit it when a new version of an already-sent quote is re-sent, described as "quote revised (new version)".

nodes.title: quote.submitted on first send and quote.expired on expiry

attrs.statement: System MUST emit `quote.submitted` on the first send of a parent quote and `quote.expired` when expiry processing moves a sent parent quote to `expired`. Recipients, content, and whether the notice can be switched off are set in the FR-030 notification Rules (REQ-030-033 and REQ-030-036).

nodes.title: FR-004 is the only producer of quote.withdrawn

attrs.statement: FR-004 MUST be the only producer of `quote.withdrawn`. The notice MUST go to the patient for every withdrawal and to the admin only when the withdrawn quote was already accepted.
attrs.rationale: A withdrawal before acceptance is a normal provider action; FR-006 reacts to a post-acceptance withdrawal without emitting the event again.

nodes.title: Admin-authored replacement quote

attrs.statement: During an FR-006 provider-fault transfer before treatment starts, System MUST let an admin author a replacement quote for the replacement provider inside the same inquiry through Screen 8, with a mandatory reason and full audit. The quote MUST be marked admin-authored for a replacement and linked to the AcceptanceEvent it replaces, MUST NOT be offered for patient comparison, MUST stay hidden from the replacement provider and the patient until it is accepted (a `draft` until Save and Continue sends it, then `sent`), MUST be editable only on Screen 8 and be excluded from Screen 2 and Screen 7, MUST NOT emit `quote.submitted`, and MUST be the target of the FR-005 admin-authored replacement acceptance.
attrs.rationale: Business Rules: it is the only exception to the block on new quotes after acceptance.

nodes.title: Admin edit of a sent quote creates a version

attrs.statement: An admin edit of a sent quote through Screen 7 MUST create a new quote version and MUST emit `quote.updated` when that version is re-sent.

nodes.title: Replacement quote pricing, expiry and ending the case

attrs.statement: System MUST NOT attach an automatic FR-019 promotion to an admin-authored replacement quote or take a promotion usage reservation for it; the admin sets the replacement price directly, so the replacement quote carries no promotion, and the use held by the original acceptance's promotion, which FR-019 marks Superseded, returns to the usage limit. A replacement quote MUST NOT emit `quote.expiring_soon`; Save and Continue sends it, it expires under the normal quote expiry if the admin does not record the replacement acceptance first (REQ-004-082), and a replacement draft that was never sent follows the 7-day draft rule. It MUST leave the inquiry flagged `supportRequired` without cancelling it automatically, and the admin MAY author another replacement quote, close the inquiry with Close inquiry on FR-006 Screen 6 when the booking is already `Cancelled` with the marker, or cancel through FR-006 Alternative Flow B2 (Screen 9) when the fault is still pending.

nodes.title: Inquiry must be active to create or submit

attrs.statement: System MUST verify parent inquiry is not in Cancelled status before accepting quote creation or submission. If inquiry is cancelled mid-draft (race condition), system rejects submission with error "Inquiry no longer active" and locks the draft with "Inquiry Cancelled" banner. Opening quote creation for a cancelled inquiry is blocked with "Inquiry no longer active — this inquiry was cancelled by the patient." and no draft is created; a drafting provider sees the banner "This inquiry was cancelled by the patient. Your draft can no longer be submitted." on next save or refresh, and the draft is retained for reference but cannot be submitted.
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 682.

nodes.title: Restricted recipient mode for FR-037 conversions

attrs.statement: If the inquiry was created via an FR-037 monitoring-case conversion with an active exclusive provider assignment (REQ-037-029, Business Rule 7; see FR-003 Workflow 2 Alternative Flow B3), only that assigned provider may create quotes for the inquiry, including any additional parent quote. Any other provider attempting to open the inquiry for quote creation is blocked with error "This inquiry is restricted to its assigned provider." The restriction does not change the other workflows (editing, expiry, withdrawal, admin oversight) on quotes that already exist. FR-038 is self-service and does not create an FR-004 inquiry or provider assignment.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 683 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Only assigned clinic staff submit or edit

attrs.statement: Only assigned clinic staff may submit/edit quotes for assigned inquiries.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 641 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Treatment from the admin-curated catalog

attrs.statement: Treatment type selection MUST use admin-curated treatment catalog; no free text. A treatment the provider has set to Not Offered blocks new quotes only: existing drafts and sent quotes are unchanged and a draft can still be sent (REQ-024-006).
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 642 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Grafts, prices and slots present and valid

attrs.statement: Graft/quantity, option/date prices, and scheduled slots MUST be present and valid.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 643 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Package active when selected; later changes warn only

attrs.statement: Every Quote Option MUST originate from a package that is active in the authenticated provider's package library when it is selected. If the source package is later edited or deactivated, existing draft and sent options keep their snapshot; a draft may still be submitted, and Tab 7 shows a warning that the source package has changed or is inactive.

nodes.title: What a package seeds and what is entered per quote

attrs.statement: A selected package seeds services and their pricing, included travel services (transport, hotel, flight, and other travel services), the standard price, and the relative day-by-day plan; date ranges, additional notes, and documents are never packaged and are entered per quote.

nodes.title: Treatment first; every option uses it

attrs.statement: Package selection occurs after the shared treatment is selected; every option in the quote MUST use that parent treatment. Tab 2 is unavailable until an active treatment is selected.

nodes.title: Changing treatment after options exist

attrs.statement: Changing the treatment after options exist requires confirmation. Packages are not tied to a treatment (REQ-024-101), so the package choices stay; the system must identify the option pricing and plan data that depend on the old treatment and must not silently retain or discard them.

nodes.title: Library changes never alter existing options

attrs.statement: Package-library changes after snapshot creation MUST NOT alter existing draft or sent options unless the provider explicitly replaces the source package and confirms a new snapshot; replacing the package requires a new snapshot and audit entry. Patients see only the option's own copy of the package content, never the live library package.

nodes.title: Each option/date pairing once per option

attrs.statement: Each option/date-range pairing MAY appear only once per option; (quoteOptionId, sourceInquiryDateRangeId) is unique.

nodes.title: Appointment within range, future, with timezone

attrs.statement: The appointment slot must fall within its selected inquiry date range and be in the future when sent; a timezone is required.

nodes.title: Option-owned content

attrs.statement: Included services, custom services, date applicability/pricing, promotions, and the day-to-day plan belong to the Quote Option or its option/date price record.

nodes.title: Removing an option

attrs.statement: A provider may remove an option before submission while at least one valid option remains; removing an option also removes its draft date-price rows and draft treatment plan after explicit confirmation.

nodes.title: Plan day numbers stay relative

attrs.statement: Relative day numbers are never resolved to stored calendar dates. Downstream consumers (FR-005 comparison, FR-010 In Progress) present the plan by day number against the accepted appointment.

nodes.title: First send reads the FR-026 quote configuration

attrs.statement: On first send, System records the first-send timestamp, captures the quote expiry and the quote currency read-only from the active FR-026 quote configuration, and records that configuration's version on the quote; drafts carry neither. If the FR-026 configuration cannot be read, first send is blocked and the draft is kept unchanged.

nodes.title: Expiry never reset or extended

attrs.statement: Later edits and re-sends do not reset the quote expiry, later setting changes never affect a sent quote, and there is no per-quote extension. Providers cannot modify the window and only see the computed expiry timestamp.

nodes.title: Only sent quotes expire

attrs.statement: Expiry applies only to `sent` parent quotes. Upon expiry, system updates the parent quote to `expired` and every child subquote becomes ineligible for acceptance. `accepted` quotes and every cancelled, withdrawn, or archived quote are never moved to `expired`. The `quote.expired` notice is set by REQ-004-046.
attrs.rationale: A quote accepted shortly before its expiry stays `accepted` during the payment hold.

nodes.title: Draft edits emit nothing

attrs.statement: Saving draft edits without re-sending emits nothing.

nodes.title: Provider withdraws a sent quote before acceptance

attrs.statement: A provider MAY withdraw a `sent` quote before acceptance from Screen 3, with an optional reason; the quote moves to `withdrawn`, its promotion reservation is released, and the patient receives `quote.withdrawn`. A provider soft-deletes drafts only (REQ-004-076).
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 145 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Accepted quote stays accepted

attrs.statement: An accepted parent quote stays `accepted` and is never reopened for acceptance or moved to `expired`, including after FR-006 moves the booking to `Payment Window Expired`; its status changes only through provider withdrawal (Workflow 6), which is allowed only while the booking is `Accepted` or `Confirmed`, before check-in, and without a provider-fault marker (REQ-004-079). An admin booking cancellation in FR-006 moves the booking and inquiry to `Cancelled` but leaves the accepted parent quote `accepted`. Competing parent quotes stay cancelled.

nodes.title: Inquiry cancellation reason is patient-private

attrs.statement: The patient's inquiry cancellation reason is patient-private and NOT shared with providers.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 223 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Draft cancelled by provider status is silent to the patient

attrs.statement: Cancelling an unsent draft because of provider suspension or deactivation is silent to the patient: the patient never saw it, so it triggers no `provider.status_cancellation_patient` notice on its own (admin support alerts still follow FR-020).
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 150 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Reactivation does not restore cancelled quotes

attrs.statement: Later reactivation of the provider does not restore quotes cancelled with `cancelled_provider_status`; other providers' quotes are unaffected by the cascade; quotes already expired, withdrawn, archived, or otherwise terminal are not reclassified.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 150 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Patient sees provider-status cancellation as unavailable

attrs.statement: Patients see a quote cancelled by provider status as unavailable ("Offer Unavailable") with a Contact Admin/Support action rather than the patient-cancellation message.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 224 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Provider soft-deletes drafts only

attrs.statement: A provider MAY soft-delete a draft quote only (removes it from the provider listing, not from the audit/archive); the system sets status = Archived with rationale. A sent quote cannot be soft-deleted by the provider: it leaves the offered state only by withdrawal before acceptance (REQ-004-070), by expiry, or through the patient's choice. Quotes in any status other than draft (sent, accepted, expired, withdrawn, cancelled_other_accepted, cancelled_inquiry_cancelled, cancelled_provider_status) cannot be soft-deleted by the provider.
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 70, 153 (Workflow 4: Quote Deletion).

nodes.title: Admin soft delete and restore

attrs.statement: Soft-deletes are fully auditable and revertible only by admin. Admin can perform soft delete or restore and view the immutable audit trail and full quote history; soft delete and restore are unavailable for a quote in `accepted` status, which is never deleted or restored. Only admin can restore expired or archived quotes if justified (GDPR-compliant log). Restore is offered only for an expired quote and for a quote archived from `draft` or `sent`, read from its archive audit entry; a quote archived from any other status shows no Restore action. A restore MUST be blocked, with a message that names the failed guard, when the inquiry is not open, the provider is not `Active`, the inquiry has an active acceptance (REQ-004-110), or the booking carries a provider-fault marker (REQ-004-109). An archived draft is restored to `draft` with the 7-day count restarted. An archived sent quote (admin archive only) is restored to `sent` when its original expiry has not passed, with no renewal, and to `expired` otherwise; an expired quote is then restored under REQ-004-105.
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 57, 906.

nodes.title: Admin authors a quote only as a replacement

attrs.statement: Admin authors a quote only as the replacement quote of an FR-006 provider-fault transfer (Workflow 7, Screen 8).

nodes.title: Withdrawal after acceptance needs a confirmation, a reason, an Accepted or Confirmed booking and edits nothing

attrs.statement: A provider submits a withdrawal after acceptance with a mandatory reason, and only while the booking is `Accepted` or `Confirmed`, before check-in, and carries no provider-fault marker. The Withdraw action opens a confirmation that states the consequence: the booking goes to the admin for a transfer or refund. In every other booking state the action is hidden and Screen 3 shows a short note that the quote can no longer be withdrawn. The parent quote moves from `accepted` to `withdrawn`. This is the only status change FR-004 makes after acceptance; no quote field, option, or option/date-price record is edited.

nodes.title: Replacement quote only before treatment starts

attrs.statement: The provider-fault transfer with a replacement quote and a new acceptance applies only before treatment starts (booking `Accepted`, `Confirmed`, or `Cancelled` with the provider-fault marker); provider drop-out after acceptance, including an FR-010 reassignment, is not a quote withdrawal. If the fault happens in Aftercare, no replacement quote, new acceptance, or new payment is created. Screen 8 is unavailable for a booking in `In Progress` or later stages and once a replacement acceptance has been recorded for this transfer.

nodes.title: Replacement quote preconditions

attrs.statement: Before the admin authors a replacement quote, the system checks that the booking carries a provider-fault marker (pending, or closed with `ProviderFault`, `ProviderSuspended`, or `ProviderDeactivated`) and is `Accepted`, `Confirmed`, or `Cancelled` with that marker, that no replacement acceptance has been recorded for this transfer, that treatment had not started, and that the replacement provider is `Active` and is not the provider at fault. When a check fails, Screen 8 is blocked with a message that names the failed check.

nodes.title: Replacement quote expires like any other quote, fixes its currency at first save and is accepted by the admin

attrs.statement: A replacement quote MUST expire like any other quote. Its currency MUST be captured from the active FR-026 quote configuration at the first Screen 8 save, shown on Screen 8, and fixed after that. Save Draft keeps it a `draft` with no expiry; Save and Continue is its first send, which moves it to `sent`, records the first-send time, copies the FR-026 quote expiry setting (default 48 hours) onto it, and computes the expiry from that moment. If the admin does not record the replacement acceptance before the expiry, the quote moves to `expired` and `quote.expired` is emitted once, and the admin authors a new replacement quote. When the admin records the replacement acceptance, the quote moves from `sent` to `accepted`. This acceptance MUST NOT run the cancel-other-quotes cascade: the original quote keeps its status, and every other open replacement quote of the inquiry, draft or sent, is cancelled as `cancelled_other_accepted` silently, with no notice to its provider.

nodes.title: Authoring a replacement quote sends no notice

attrs.statement: Authoring a replacement quote sends no notice.

nodes.title: Accepted terms never change

attrs.statement: After acceptance, price, currency, and promotion never change; the booking's appointment changes only through the FR-006 admin appointment change or an admin edit of the accepted quote's date range or appointment (REQ-005-023), each of which emits `booking.rescheduled`, while the acceptance snapshot keeps the accepted appointment as the baseline.

nodes.title: Edits only while draft or sent, admin exception after acceptance

attrs.statement: Providers may edit a quote only while it is `draft` or `sent`; admins may edit `draft` and `sent` quotes, and after acceptance any field except price, currency, and promotion (REQ-004-005). A replacement draft is edited only on Screen 8 (REQ-004-048). Edits on expired, withdrawn, archived, or cancelled quotes are prohibited for providers and admins, and a late edit or deletion is disallowed with a user message.

nodes.title: Acceptance values are read-only copies of the FR-005 snapshot

attrs.statement: `acceptedTotal`, `termsAcknowledgedAt`, and `lockedExchangeRateSnapshot` are read-only copies written at FR-005 acceptance from the acceptance snapshot; the FR-005 snapshot is authoritative, and downstream FRs read money fields from it. Acceptance state is not stored on the option/date-price record; it is derived from FR-005.

nodes.title: confirmed is not a quote status

attrs.statement: `confirmed` is a booking status owned by FR-006, never a quote status; an accepted quote stays `accepted`.

nodes.title: Automatic promotion with no uses left is not attached

attrs.statement: An automatic promotion with no uses left is not eligible and is not attached; when its last use is reserved by another quote before this quote is sent, it is not attached at send, because the usage limit can never be exceeded.

nodes.title: Discount review threshold

attrs.statement: Discounts are provider-managed with no admin review. A percentage discount above the maximum discount value (the FR-019 setting, starts at 50 percent) is refused as a hard cap; a fixed-amount discount has no cap (REQ-019-114).
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 671 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Notifications follow platform rules

attrs.statement: All notifications MUST comply with platform notification/audit/logging rules.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 674 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Quote objects archived for the platform retention period

attrs.statement: GDPR/data compliance: all quote objects are archived; retention follows the system PRD, Platform-Wide Rules: One 10-year retention period.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 675 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Price range derived from option/date prices

attrs.statement: The quote price range is derived from all option/date prices, from the lowest to the highest option/date price, and is never entered separately.

nodes.title: Abandoned drafts auto-archived 7 days after the last edit

attrs.statement: System retains an abandoned draft for 7 days after its last edit, then auto-archives it. The 7 days are a fixed platform rule with no admin setting, and the rule applies to a replacement draft too.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 215 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Patient accepts one subquote; no parent-level action

attrs.statement: The patient accepts exactly one subquote through FR-005; there is no parent-level Accept or Decline action. If the patient accepts no subquote, all open sent quotes expire automatically.

nodes.title: Draft locked when another quote is accepted

attrs.statement: While a provider is drafting a quote, if another quote is accepted, the unsent draft is cancelled silently as "cancelled (other accepted)" with no notice; on next open the draft is read-only with the "Another Quote Accepted" badge and cannot be submitted.

nodes.title: Drafts and archived quotes hidden from patients

attrs.statement: Drafts and archived quotes are never shown to patients.

nodes.title: Cancelled quotes are read-only with badge and banner

attrs.statement: Quotes with status "Cancelled (Inquiry Cancelled)" are displayed with greyed-out row styling and an "Inquiry Cancelled" badge, show a prominent "Inquiry Cancelled" banner on the detail view, have all edit and delete actions disabled, and remain read-only for reference; an edit attempt is blocked with the message "This quote was cancelled because the patient cancelled their inquiry". Quotes with status "cancelled (other accepted)" are similarly greyed out with an "Another Quote Accepted" badge. When an admin closed or cancelled the inquiry, the banner and the blocked-edit message are neutral: "This inquiry was closed. Your quote can no longer be changed."
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 500.

nodes.title: Admin promotion change on a draft or sent quote

attrs.statement: Admin may add, replace, or remove the structured promotion on an option/date price of a draft or sent quote; inline create is permitted with `scope = AD_HOC_QUOTE_BOUND` per FR-019 Screen 9 Mode 2. The promotion must resolve to a valid PromotionProgram id or null, a reason is required, and the change creates a new quote version into which the current promotion terms are copied.

nodes.title: Structured promotions only

attrs.statement: A promotion on an option/date price must resolve to a valid structured `PromotionProgram`; no free-text promotion.

nodes.title: Admin grafts change regenerates description; prior text stays in quote history

attrs.statement: When an admin saves a new Estimated Grafts value through Screen 7, Graft Description is regenerated from the approved template; the prior text stays in quote history.
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 364, 594 (rule text brought in line with the PRD).

nodes.title: Validation Summary checklist on Review & Submit

attrs.statement: Tab 7 (Review & Submit) MUST show a read-only Validation Summary checklist of every tab's completion, linking each unresolved issue to its owning tab; Submit Quote MUST stay blocked while any blocking issue is unresolved.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 772 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Patient Quote Review shows new, updated and expired indicators

attrs.statement: The patient Quote Review screen MUST show read-only indicators that a quote is new, updated, or expired.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 773 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Admin Quote List flags an inquiry with more than one quote

attrs.statement: The admin Quote List MUST show a badge or icon, with a count or indicator, on an inquiry that holds more than one quote.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 774 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Admin restores an expired quote with a fresh window

attrs.statement: Only an admin, with a mandatory reason, MAY restore an expired quote. The restore MUST be blocked, with a message that names the failed guard, when the inquiry is not open, the provider is not `Active`, the inquiry has an active acceptance (REQ-004-110), or the booking carries a provider-fault marker (REQ-004-109); the same guards apply to every restore of an archived quote (REQ-004-077). Before restoring, System MUST re-check the validity and usage limit of the promotion on the quote's rows and take a new reservation only when the quote holds none; if the limit is used up or the promotion has ended, the restore MUST be blocked with a message and the provider MAY send a new quote. The same re-check applies when an archived sent quote is restored to `sent`. The restored quote MUST return to `sent` with a fresh full window: its new expiry is the restore time plus the FR-026 quote expiry window in force at that time. This is the only case in which a quote's expiry is renewed.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 775 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: quote.restored notice to patient and provider

attrs.statement: When an admin restores an expired quote, System MUST notify both the patient and the provider through `quote.restored`; FR-004 is the only producer. Drafted default channels are Email and Push; recipients, content, and whether the notice can be switched off are set in the FR-030 catalogue (REQ-030-218).
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 776 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: A sent quote opens or updates the FR-012 conversation

attrs.statement: When a provider sends a quote, the patient and that provider MUST be able to message each other: the first quote from a provider to a patient opens their FR-012 conversation, and a later quote from the same provider is added to it. FR-012 owns the conversation itself.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 777 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Admin Quote List is grouped by inquiry by default with a toggle

attrs.statement: The admin Quote List MUST group quotes by inquiry by default, and the admin MUST be able to toggle the grouping on and off.
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 552 (Screen 5 Inquiry Grouping control: Default grouped by inquiry, Toggle grouping).

nodes.title: Provider-fault marker freezes the accepted quote; the replacement quote is the only quote write

attrs.statement: While the booking carries the provider-fault marker, whether the fault is pending or the booking is already `Cancelled` with the marker, System MUST block provider edits and admin Screen 7 edits of every field of the accepted quote except admin notes, MUST block an admin restore of any quote of the inquiry, and MUST hide a second Withdraw action. The replacement quote on Screen 8 is the only quote write allowed. The marker stops payment, reminders, and revive in FR-006 (REQ-006-081).
attrs.rationale: Keeps the accepted quote from changing underneath a pending replacement; mirrors the FR-006 pending-fault block.

nodes.title: Active acceptance is the latest AcceptanceEvent without a supersession record

attrs.statement: An active acceptance is the latest AcceptanceEvent on the inquiry that has no supersession record, whatever the status of its parent quote or subquote. The original acceptance stays active, even after its quote is withdrawn, until the replacement acceptance is recorded; once it is superseded, superseded takes precedence over withdrawn for the original subquote. The original parent quote keeps its own status, and only the replacement parent quote counts as the inquiry's accepted quote. A restore stays blocked between a withdrawal and the replacement acceptance.
attrs.rationale: One definition so every rule that says an acceptance is active reads the same fact.

nodes.title: An open replacement quote is cancelled without notice when an admin closes or cancels the inquiry

attrs.statement: When an admin closes the inquiry (Close inquiry on FR-006 Screen 6) or cancels it (FR-006 Screen 9), System MUST move any open replacement quote (draft or sent) of that inquiry to `cancelled_inquiry_cancelled`, MUST NOT send `quote.cancelled_inquiry` to any provider (an admin close or cancellation sends no provider notice, REQ-020-020, REQ-003-127), and no `quote.expired` follows. The cascade trigger is owned by FR-003 (REQ-003-013) and FR-006.
attrs.rationale: The replacement quote is admin-authored and never offered to the patient, so the provider is not told and the cancellation, not expiry, ends it.

nodes.title: A provider who has not accepted the current legal documents cannot submit a quote

attrs.statement: A provider who has not accepted the current legal documents MUST NOT be able to submit a quote (first send or re-send). The acceptance prompt of FR-027 is shown and the draft is kept unchanged; creating and editing a draft is not blocked (REQ-027-033).
attrs.rationale: prd.md Workflow 1 legal acceptance check; creating and editing a draft stays open

nodes.title: Every parent quote shown; each subquote a complete selectable choice

attrs.statement: System MUST show every parent quote received for an inquiry, including multiple parent quotes from the same provider, and MUST expose each child subquote as a complete patient-selectable commercial choice.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Main Flow steps 1-2 and the Patient Platform scope: the patient views parent quotes grouped by provider and quote response within the Inquiry Dashboard, and each subquote presents its package, date range, appointment details, pricing, and inherited parent information as one complete choice.

nodes.title: Exactly one subquote acceptance per inquiry; no parent acceptance

attrs.statement: System MUST allow the patient to accept exactly one valid subquote per inquiry and MUST NOT allow direct acceptance of a parent quote or any upper-level inherited record.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Business Rule 1 (a parent quote cannot be accepted directly; subsequent attempts are blocked with guidance, including after Payment Window Expired), Alternative Flow A2 (a second acceptance is prevented with guidance referencing the accepted subquote), the Screen 1 business rules (parent quotes are grouping and inheritance boundaries, not patient-selectable acceptance items; a subquote is the lowest-level complete commercial choice and the only selectable acceptance item; exactly one subquote acceptance is permitted per inquiry), the Communication Structure (Patient to System: accept action on one eligible subquote), the fixed-in-codebase subquote acceptance uniqueness constraint, Screen 4 (exactly one Accepted across the inquiry), the edge case on simultaneous accept attempts across devices (first valid acceptance wins; others see an informative message), and the implementation note that concurrency control prevents races across subquotes of the same inquiry.

nodes.title: Siblings Not Selected and competing parent quotes auto-cancelled

attrs.statement: On acceptance, System MUST mark sibling subquotes in the accepted parent quote Not Selected and MUST auto-cancel all competing parent quotes for the same inquiry with reasons and notifications.
attrs.rationale: Restated by the Provider Platform scope (competing parent quotes auto-cancelled with reason "Other subquote accepted"; sibling subquotes in the accepted parent quote become "Not Selected"), Business Rule 2 (a valid acceptance atomically acquires the slot hold, locks the subquote and its inherited parent context, marks siblings Not Selected and auto-cancels competing parent quotes with clear reasons and notifications; if the slot is already held or blocked, the attempt fails before any of those state changes), and Main Flow step 8.

nodes.title: Ineligible subquotes blocked from acceptance

attrs.statement: System MUST block subquote acceptance when the subquote or its parent quote is expired, withdrawn, cancelled, archived, superseded, or stale, or when the owning provider is `Suspended` or `Deactivated` (FR-015), with clear messaging.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Business Rule 5 (a subquote is ineligible if it or its parent quote is expired, withdrawn, cancelled, archived, superseded, or no longer the version presented to the patient, or if its owning provider is Suspended or Deactivated under FR-015), the Entry Points (acceptance is available only while the target subquote and its parent quote are eligible), Screen 1 (expired or withdrawn parent quotes make all child subquotes ineligible; terminal child subquotes are visually disabled), Screen 2 (Accept is disabled if the subquote or parent quote is expired, withdrawn, cancelled, superseded, or stale, or another subquote is already accepted), and Alternative Flow A3 with its edge case (a parent quote withdrawn just before confirmation blocks acceptance with explanation, and the patient returns to the inquiry dashboard to select another eligible subquote).

nodes.title: Booking/payment handoff prepared without collecting funds

attrs.statement: System MUST prepare the booking/payment handoff from the accepted subquote without collecting funds in this module.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Payment & Billing (acceptance prepares the booking/payment handoff; no funds are collected in this module), Main Flow step 10, the Patient Platform scope (after acceptance, proceed to the booking/payment entry point), and the Out of Scope list (payment collection and invoice issuance are handled in Booking & Payment).

nodes.title: Immutable acceptance snapshot with binding fields

attrs.statement: System MUST preserve an immutable acceptance snapshot containing the accepted subquote identifier/version, the underlying Quote Option ID and Option/date-price ID, the source package ID/version, the parent quote identifier/version and expiry, provider and inquiry references, treatment ID/version, package and service snapshot, date range, appointment date/time/timezone, offered price, any patient-applied promotion code and the resulting discounted price, promotion, currency, exchange rate and its timestamp, treatment plan, estimated grafts, graft description, visual plan, clinician IDs, notes, requirements, attachment IDs with versions, actor, and timestamp; `acceptedSubquoteVersion` MUST equal `acceptedParentQuoteVersion` because both identify the same FR-004 aggregate revision; all resulting state changes MUST be audited. Price, currency, date range, appointment, and promotion are the binding fields that downstream modules MUST read from the snapshot; the snapshot appointment is the accepted baseline, and booking notices MUST read the booking's current appointment, which can change only through an FR-006 admin appointment change or an admin edit of the accepted quote's date range or appointment (REQ-005-023). The treatment details are the original record at acceptance; later changes to plan, clinicians, or grafts are made only through FR-010 or an admin edit of the accepted quote (REQ-005-023), with audit and patient notice, and never edit the snapshot.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Payment & Billing binding snapshot fields (price, currency, date range, appointment, and promotion are read from the snapshot by every downstream module and the snapshot never changes after acceptance; an admin may later change the booking's appointment through FR-006 or through an admin edit of the accepted quote's date range or appointment (REQ-005-023), each of which emits booking.rescheduled, and every booking notice reads the booking's current appointment; after acceptance only the clinic or an admin may change the plan, clinicians, or grafts, through FR-010 or, for an admin, the admin edit of the accepted quote (REQ-005-023), with audit and patient notice, and the snapshot itself is never edited), Payment & Billing pricing (the resulting price and promotion are frozen into the snapshot; only the provider-fault transfer creates a new linked record), and Key Entities (acceptedSubquoteVersion MUST equal acceptedParentQuoteVersion; acceptanceSnapshot preserves the complete subquote plus inherited parent context, including the exchange rate and its timestamp and any patient-applied promotion code).

nodes.title: Acceptance record retention follows the platform retention Rule

attrs.statement: Retention of acceptance and related parent quote/subquote records follows the system PRD, Platform-Wide Rules: One 10-year retention period.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Data & Privacy Rule 4 (acceptance and related quote/subquote records follow the system PRD, Platform-Wide Rules: One 10-year retention period, REQ-SYS-002).

nodes.title: Integration with FR-004 and FR-020

attrs.statement: System MUST integrate with FR-004 for parent quote, Quote Option, option/date-price, lifecycle, aggregate `QuoteVersion`, and audit contracts and with FR-020 for notifications.
attrs.rationale: Restated by the integration-points note: FR-005 consumes parent quote and subquote data from FR-004, updates inquiry, parent quote, and subquote states, and triggers the notification service.

nodes.title: Booking handoff built from the accepted subquote

attrs.statement: System MUST emit a booking handoff whose atomic commercial input is the accepted subquote and whose inherited context is resolved from its parent quote.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Payment & Billing (the accepted subquote is the complete handoff unit; it carries the selected package, date range, appointment date/time/timezone, offered price, promotion when applicable, and references to the inherited parent quote, provider, and treatment context), Main Flow step 10, and the Entry Points (upon acceptance the system locks the selection, resolves sibling and competing outcomes, and triggers booking handoff).

nodes.title: Filter and sort subquotes on subquote and inherited criteria

attrs.statement: System MUST allow patients to filter and sort subquotes using both subquote-owned and inherited comparison criteria.
attrs.rationale: Restated by the Screen 1 business rules (patient can sort/filter subquotes). The sort and filter options, the default sort and the price-order currency handling are owned by FR-022 (REQ-022-057, REQ-022-068, REQ-022-058, REQ-022-069).

nodes.title: Side-by-side comparison of up to three subquotes

attrs.statement: System MUST support side-by-side comparison of up to three subquotes, regardless of whether they belong to the same or different parent quotes/providers.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Main Flow step 3, the Screen 1 business rules (compare up to three side-by-side, including siblings under one parent quote or subquotes from different parent quotes/providers), and the Compare Selection field (maximum three eligible subquotes, regardless of parent quote or provider grouping).

nodes.title: Subquote comparison differentiators

attrs.statement: System MUST display these subquote comparison differentiators: package, included/custom services, date range, appointment details, total price, currency, promotion, price per graft, treatment plan, inherited graft count, provider review rating/count, and provider credentials summary (certifications and awards only; never the medical license number). Estimated travel costs remain deferred pending an approved FR-008 source.
attrs.rationale: Restated by the Screen 1 Comparison Differentiators field, which lists the same rows.

nodes.title: Quote screen may link to the existing provider conversation

attrs.statement: A quote screen MAY link to the existing provider conversation. In-app messaging itself is defined in REQ-012-006 (FR-012 Messages/Inbox).
attrs.rationale: Restated by the Screen 1 Message Provider button. In-app messaging itself is defined in REQ-012-006 (FR-012 Messages/Inbox).

nodes.title: Provider notified of quote questions within 5 minutes

attrs.statement: System MUST deliver a patient's quote question to the provider as an FR-012 message, and the provider's notification of it MUST arrive within 5 minutes at the latest, unless the provider has switched that notice off or held it in their notification preferences (REQ-012-007).
attrs.rationale: Restated by the Communication Structure (System to Provider: notify the provider of patient quote questions within 5 minutes).

nodes.title: Subquote resolves one Quote Option and one Option/date-price

attrs.statement: A subquote MUST resolve exactly one FR-004 Quote Option and one applicable Option/date-price record into one complete package, date range, appointment, and offered-price selection. It MUST inherit shared provider, treatment, graft, visual-plan, clinician, note, requirement, attachment, currency, expiry, and audit context from exactly one parent quote. FR-005 owns the subquote identifier and state: the identifier is derived deterministically from the Quote Option ID and Option/date-price ID, so it stays the same across parent re-versions while both records exist. A parent quote offers up to (number of Quote Options × number of date ranges) subquotes, because a provider may leave out pairings it cannot offer.
attrs.rationale: Restated by the Executive Summary (the subquote is the atomic patient comparison and acceptance unit; one Quote Option package snapshot together with exactly one Option/date-price record; neither is accepted independently), Screen 1 (a parent quote offers up to Quote Options x date ranges subquotes and every Quote Option has at least one date range; a selectable subquote has exactly one date range, and its appointment must fall within that range), and Key Entities (FR-005 owns id and state; id is derived deterministically from quoteOptionId and optionDatePriceId).

nodes.title: Confirmation validates the current parent QuoteVersion

attrs.statement: Acceptance confirmation MUST validate the current parent aggregate `QuoteVersion`, MUST require the derived `subquoteVersion` to equal it, and MUST reject stale selections before creating an AcceptanceEvent.
attrs.rationale: Restated by the Executive Summary and Key Entities (subquoteVersion is the owning parent quote's QuoteVersion, not a separate revision counter), Main Flow step 6, Screen 2 (confirmation rejects a stale version; the accepted subquote and inherited context lock on acceptance), Screen 3 (the summary must reflect the latest subquote and parent versions), the implementation note on version validation before locking the snapshot, and the edge case where the provider edits the parent quote or selected subquote after the patient opens confirmation (the stale confirmation is rejected and the current version must be reviewed).

nodes.title: Parent quote and subquote analytics remain distinct

attrs.statement: Parent quote and subquote analytics MUST remain distinct: one provider response counts once at parent level (metric: Parent Quote Responses), while comparison and selection behavior is recorded at subquote level (metrics: Subquote Comparisons and Subquote Selections). Drafts, versions, edits, and resends MUST NOT add to the parent count. A parent quote counts once, on its first successful submission; several parent quotes count separately, one each. The parent count and the subquote counts are distinct grains: parents versus subquotes are never summed. Quote Option and subquote counts, when reported, MUST be labelled as such and never substituted into parent metrics.

nodes.title: Acceptance atomically acquires an exclusive slot hold

attrs.statement: Acceptance MUST atomically acquire an exclusive hold on the selected appointment slot and MUST reject a second acceptance for a slot already held or blocked by another pending or confirmed booking, including a concurrent acceptance that finds an active hold already exists, before creating an AcceptanceEvent, changing quote/inquiry states, or emitting a booking handoff. The rejected patient MUST be told the slot was just taken.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Business Rule 2, Main Flow step 6 (one fixed, exclusive slot hold keyed by provider, appointment date/time, and time zone; if another pending or confirmed booking holds or blocks the slot, acceptance is rejected before an AcceptanceEvent or booking handoff is created), Alternative Flow A5 and Screen 3 (error state "This appointment slot was just taken. Please choose another subquote."; no acceptance is recorded; the patient returns to the inquiry dashboard; the existing reservation is unchanged), and Payment & Billing post-acceptance hold (acceptance and exclusive slot reservation are one atomic operation; a second acceptance targeting the held or blocked slot is rejected).

nodes.title: Provider status revalidated at acceptance

attrs.statement: System MUST revalidate the owning provider's status at acceptance and MUST block acceptance of any subquote whose provider is `Suspended` or `Deactivated` from the effective time, including in-flight confirmations. For a still-comparing inquiry, System MUST keep other providers' subquotes acceptable. When the status takes effect after acceptance, System MUST release any active hold, retain the AcceptanceEvent and acceptance snapshot without rewriting, record cause `ProviderSuspended` or `ProviderDeactivated` with `supportRequired` on the FR-006 booking and the FR-003 ProviderInquiry (the supersession record is written only when the replacement acceptance is recorded), route the case to the FR-006 provider-fault transfer within the same inquiry, and tell the patient that an admin will arrange a replacement provider instead of showing the patient-cancellation message.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Business Rule 8 (cause ProviderSuspended or ProviderDeactivated with an independent supportRequired marker; distinct from patient inquiry cancellation and Payment Window Expired; does not reclassify Completed or already-terminal history), Alternative Flow A6 (from the effective time Accept is blocked and an in-flight confirmation is rejected before an AcceptanceEvent or hold is created; FR-004 cancels that provider's parent quotes once each, while other providers' subquotes stay acceptable and the inquiry keeps its stage with supportRequired = true), Payment & Billing provider status change during hold (the hold is released even if time remains; the acceptance snapshot and locked price/exchange rate are retained unchanged), and the edge case of a status change while the patient is on the confirmation modal.

nodes.title: AcceptanceEvent and snapshot immutable; admin may edit the accepted quote except price, currency and promotion

attrs.statement: System MUST NOT allow an AcceptanceEvent or its acceptance snapshot to be deleted, restored, or edited, and MUST NOT allow an accepted subquote or its parent quote to be deleted or restored. After acceptance an admin MAY edit the accepted quote in any field except its price, currency, and promotion (the date range and the treatment details may be changed), with a mandatory reason and a full before/after history. An edit of the date range or appointment MUST run the same slot-availability check as the FR-006 admin appointment change, update the booking's current appointment, and emit `booking.rescheduled`; an edit of the treatment details MUST notify the patient through `treatment.plan_changed`. The edit MUST be stored as a new version beside the acceptance snapshot, and the snapshot keeps the terms as accepted. Admins MAY also add audited notes or corrections as annotations next to an AcceptanceEvent; an annotation MUST NOT change the event, its snapshot, or any quote, subquote, or inquiry state.
attrs.rationale: Restated by the Admin Platform scope and Admin Editability (after acceptance an admin may edit the accepted quote in any field except price, currency and promotion, with a mandatory reason and full before/after history, stored as a new version beside the unchanged acceptance snapshot, a change of the date range or appointment running the FR-006 slot-availability check and emitting booking.rescheduled, and a change of treatment details emitting treatment.plan_changed; an annotation never alters the AcceptanceEvent, its snapshot, the accepted IDs/versions, or any quote, subquote, or inquiry state), Business Rule 6 (AcceptanceEvents, accepted subquotes, and their parent quotes are never deleted or restored), Screen 5 (annotations are append-only, each showing author, time, and reason; no delete or restore action exists), and Key Entities (AcceptanceAnnotation is an audited, append-only admin note).

nodes.title: Only additional acceptance is the provider-fault replacement

attrs.statement: System MUST allow exactly one patient acceptance per inquiry. The only additional acceptance record is the admin-authored record created by an FR-006 provider-fault transfer before treatment starts; it MUST point to an admin-authored FR-004 replacement quote, Quote Option, and option/date-price row, and the original MUST be marked superseded by one supersession record inserted at the replacement acceptance rather than by editing it. The admin-authored record carries no patient terms acknowledgment, so its terms acknowledgment time stays empty; it records the admin as actor, and the supersession record written in the same operation carries the actor and the reason.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Business Rule 1 (applies only before treatment starts; the closure is recorded on the booking as its cause; one supersession record with cause ProviderFault, ProviderSuspended, or ProviderDeactivated links the closed acceptance to the new one; the patient keeps the same inquiry and re-enters nothing; money already paid is refunded to the patient in full, with no cancellation fee, and the replacement booking takes a new payment, the mechanics being defined by FR-007, FR-007b, and FR-017), Alternative Flows A3, A6, and A9 (FR-006 owns the provider-fault case; the admin authors the replacement quote on FR-004 Screen 8 and records a new AcceptanceEvent with actorType = admin; the AcceptanceSupersession record is inserted once and never updated; the original AcceptanceEvent and snapshot stay unchanged as history), Admin Editability, and Key Entities (AcceptanceSupersession).

nodes.title: Patient promotion code on one named subquote before acceptance

attrs.statement: System MUST let the patient apply a promotion code to one named subquote before acceptance, validated through FR-019, and MUST freeze the discounted price and promotion into the acceptance snapshot. The code MUST NOT be written to the provider's quote or promotion records, and the price and promotion MUST NOT change after acceptance except through an FR-006 provider-fault transfer. If the code is no longer valid, or its usage limit is exhausted, when the patient confirms, the acceptance MUST NOT happen and nothing is recorded as accepted; the patient MUST return to the subquote detail with the reason shown and the price is back to what the row carried when the quote was sent, including any promotion attached at send, and may accept without the code or enter another. The offered price is the price the provider entered for the row before any promotion (REQ-004-035).
attrs.rationale: Restated by Alternative Flow A8 (the discounted price is shown next to the offered price and carried into the confirmation summary; an invalid code shows the reason and leaves the offered price unchanged; the code does not carry over to another subquote; after acceptance the promotion and price cannot be removed, replaced, re-entered at checkout, or changed by revalidation, including an admin void), the Screen 2 Promotion Code field and business rule (not available after acceptance), and Payment & Billing pricing.

nodes.title: Auto-applied promotion use consumed or released at acceptance

attrs.statement: On acceptance, System MUST consume the auto-applied promotion use reserved at send for the accepted parent quote and MUST release the reservations of every parent quote that ends Not Selected or auto-cancelled, as defined by FR-019. When the accepted subquote does not carry the automatic promotion reserved for its parent quote, System MUST release that reservation with reason `not_applied`.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Main Flow step 8 and Payment & Billing auto-applied promotion use (a sent parent quote holds at most one reserved use; re-sending keeps it, creates one only if the new version newly carries the promotion, and releases it if not; Payment Window Expired or cancellation before the first payment returns the consumed use to the limit; provider-selected promotions and patient-entered codes reserve at acceptance and consume at first payment; usage limits count reservations plus consumed uses). The reservation lifecycle itself is defined by FR-019.

nodes.title: Acceptance outcome notices; recipients and content set by REQ-020-019

attrs.statement: At acceptance, System MUST notify the patient and the providers of the outcome, and the patient notice MUST also fire on an admin-authored replacement acceptance. Recipients, content, and whether a notice can be switched off are set by the notification Rule REQ-020-019 (FR-020).
attrs.rationale: Restated by Main Flow step 9 and Alternative Flow A9 (the patient notice also fires at the replacement acceptance). Recipients, content, and whether a notice can be switched off are set by the notification Rule REQ-020-019 (FR-020).

nodes.title: Entry points to quote comparison

attrs.statement: Patient accesses quote comparison from the Inquiry Dashboard (FR-003 Screen 8), where quotes are displayed within the inquiry context, or via push/email notification.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 77 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Providers see acceptance outcomes read-only

attrs.statement: Providers have read-only visibility of the accepted or non-selected outcome for their parent quotes and subquotes; the provider platform is read-only in this module.
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 41.

nodes.title: Flagged acceptance races investigated; first valid acceptance stands

attrs.statement: Flagged acceptance races or errors are investigated by an admin: the first valid acceptance stands, and the admin records findings as an annotation.
attrs.rationale: Stated in the Admin Platform scope, Admin Editability, and the Screen 5 Conflicts field.

nodes.title: Acceptance-related transitions immutably audited

attrs.statement: All acceptance-related state transitions are immutably audited (who, when, what, reason). Audit logs must record the accepted subquote, inherited parent snapshot, actor, presented versions, and every affected parent quote and sibling subquote.
attrs.rationale: Stated by Business Rule 4 and Data & Privacy Rule 3; restated by Main Flow step 11, the Shared Services scope, and the implementation note (append-only audit trail covering acceptance, sibling Not Selected outcomes, and competing parent quote cancellations).

nodes.title: Terms acknowledgment required before acceptance

attrs.statement: The terms acknowledgment checkbox must be checked before the Accept button is enabled; the patient confirms the exact subquote with terms acknowledgment and a complete selection summary, and the confirmation modal requires the acknowledgment if it is not already checked.
attrs.rationale: Stated in Main Flow step 5, the Screen 2 Terms Acknowledgment field and business rule, and the Screen 3 Terms Acknowledgment field.

nodes.title: Inquiry status checked at confirmation

attrs.statement: System checks inquiry status at confirmation; if the inquiry has been cancelled, acceptance is blocked with the message "This inquiry has been cancelled."
attrs.rationale: Main Flow step 6 revalidates the inquiry atomically at confirmation; the edge case covers an inquiry cancellation being processed while the patient accepts.

nodes.title: Acceptance sets parent quote and inquiry to Accepted and writes the accepted total

attrs.statement: After the exclusive hold succeeds, System records the selected subquote as Accepted, locks its inherited parent context and commercial details, sets the parent quote and inquiry to Accepted, records the acceptance snapshot (including the exchange rate and its timestamp) and the slot-hold reference, and writes the accepted subquote's price after any promotion as the parent quote's accepted total (FR-004 acceptedTotal), read from the snapshot. No appointment record is created at acceptance; FR-006 creates it only on successful first payment.
attrs.rationale: Main Flow step 7 and the Main Flow outcome (inquiry transitions to Accepted; one subquote and its inherited parent context are locked as the accepted selection).

nodes.title: One outcome notice per sent parent quote; no quote.declined

attrs.statement: Each provider receives one notice per sent parent quote (selected or not selected); an unsent draft quote cancelled by FR-004 because another quote was accepted produces no notice. No quote.declined event is emitted for these outcomes.
attrs.rationale: Main Flow step 9; delivery is through FR-020.

nodes.title: Non-selected notices reveal no winner or price

attrs.statement: Notifications sent to non-selected providers (due to auto-cancellation) MUST NOT reveal the identity of the selected provider or the accepted price. The non-selected reason reads "Other subquote accepted" or "Inquiry cancelled by patient", and a provider whose parent quote is cancelled because the provider's account was suspended or deactivated sees "Provider account suspended or deactivated".
attrs.rationale: Business Rule 7, Main Flow step 9, and the Screen 4 Reason field (must not identify another provider or disclose the accepted price).

nodes.title: Parent quote expiry during review

attrs.statement: When the parent quote countdown reaches zero while the patient is viewing details, System disables the Accept button and shows an "Expired" badge with guidance to choose another quote; every subquote under that parent quote becomes ineligible. The expiry timer applies to every child subquote and shows a static "Expired on [date]" when expired. If no eligible subquote remains, the patient may cancel the inquiry and submit a new one, or contact support.
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow A1, the Screen 1 Expiry Timer field, and the Patient Platform scope (the patient sees the parent quote expiry countdown).

nodes.title: Cancelled inquiry makes the dashboard read-only

attrs.statement: If the inquiry stage is "Cancelled", all Accept buttons and Compare checkboxes are disabled and the dashboard is read-only with a "Cancelled" badge; quote data remains visible for reference. If the patient cancels the inquiry while on the acceptance confirmation modal, the modal is dismissed and the inquiry dashboard refreshes to show the "Cancelled" badge with all actions disabled.
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 business rules, Alternative Flow A4 (the cancellation itself and the quote cascade belong to FR-003 Workflow 5 and FR-004; the patient can create a new inquiry immediately), and the confirmation-modal edge case.

nodes.title: Admin booking cancellation keeps the acceptance; no supersession record

attrs.statement: If an admin cancels the booking after acceptance, the AcceptanceEvent is retained unchanged and no AcceptanceSupersession record is written; the accepted subquote and parent Quote stay accepted.
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow A4, Payment & Billing cancellation during hold, and the Screen 5 Supersession Indicator (no supersession record exists for a cancellation). The edge case on a patient who wants to cancel immediately after accepting says the same: an admin cancellation through FR-006 keeps the accepted subquote and parent quote accepted and writes no supersession record.

nodes.title: Provider-unavailable inline errors

attrs.statement: Before acceptance, when Accept is blocked because the provider became Suspended or Deactivated, the patient sees the inline error "This provider is no longer available. Please contact support." with a Contact Admin/Support action, not the patient-cancellation messaging. After acceptance, when the deposit or booking-confirming payment is blocked for the same reason, the patient sees the inline error "This clinic can no longer perform your treatment. An admin will arrange a replacement clinic within the same inquiry." and is not asked to start a new inquiry or re-enter anything. Both are on-screen errors shown in the app, not FR-020 notifications, and are localized through FR-021 like other UI text.
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow A6 outcome and the confirmation-modal edge case. The FR-020 patient notices for the same events are separate and owned elsewhere.

nodes.title: Replayed cascades and late requests never revive or duplicate

attrs.statement: A replayed provider-status cascade or a stale acceptance request arriving afterward creates no duplicate cancellation, notification, AcceptanceEvent, or hold. Late acceptance requests or payment callbacks cannot revive the original selection, and later reactivation does not restore it.
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow A6 outcome and the provider-status edge case.

nodes.title: Unaccepted replacement quote

attrs.statement: If no replacement acceptance is recorded, the replacement quote expires under the normal FR-004 quote expiry and no AcceptanceEvent or AcceptanceSupersession record is written. The inquiry stays flagged supportRequired and is not cancelled automatically.
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow A9. The admin's follow-up actions (another replacement quote on FR-004 Screen 8, or cancelling the inquiry and booking on the FR-006 admin screen) belong to FR-004 and FR-006.

nodes.title: No replacement acceptance once treatment has started

attrs.statement: If the provider fault happens while the booking is In Progress, or in Aftercare after treatment is done, no replacement acceptance is created.
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow A9 boundary and Business Rule 1 (the provider-fault transfer applies only before treatment starts). The admin's In Progress and Aftercare actions (move to Aftercare with reassignment, cancel, or reassign the aftercare provider or team) belong to FR-006.

nodes.title: Comparison panel needs at least two selected subquotes

attrs.statement: The comparison panel renders only when at least two subquotes are selected.
attrs.rationale: Stated in the Screen 1 list and comparison panel heading and the Comparison View field.

nodes.title: Comparison panel follows the current parent version

attrs.statement: The comparison panel always shows the current parent quote version. If the provider re-versions a parent quote, the panel refreshes to the current version; if a compared subquote no longer exists or becomes ineligible, it drops out of the panel and the patient is told why.

nodes.title: Accept available from the dashboard and the detail

attrs.statement: Patient can view subquote details and accept an eligible subquote directly from the dashboard; Accept is enabled only for a current eligible subquote.
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 business rules and the per-subquote Actions field (View Details and Accept).

nodes.title: Subquote price display

attrs.statement: Each subquote shows the offered price as entered by the provider, before any promotion (FR-004), with the price after promotion shown next to it when a promotion applies; a structured promotion attached to the subquote shows its discount separately from the offered price, with its terms when present. Prices use the parent quote currency snapshot and cannot be edited by the patient.
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 per-subquote Price and Promotion fields.

nodes.title: Price per graft

attrs.statement: Price per graft is the subquote's offered price, before any promotion, divided by the inherited graft count; it is calculated and non-editable.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 214 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Subquote state derived from lifecycle

attrs.statement: Subquote state is Available, Accepted, Not Selected, Expired, Withdrawn, Cancelled, or Superseded, derived from the parent and subquote lifecycle; exactly one subquote across the inquiry is Accepted and not superseded. After an admin-authored replacement acceptance (REQ-005-024) the original accepted subquote is Superseded: read-only, never acceptable again, with its AcceptanceEvent and acceptance snapshot unchanged and closed by the supersession record.
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 per-subquote State field and Screen 4 Subquote Outcome field.

nodes.title: Subquote detail read-only and current

attrs.statement: All relevant parent quote and subquote details from FR-004 Screen 4 are displayed read-only on the subquote detail, which reflects the latest provider edits.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 business rules and the Inherited Parent Context field.

nodes.title: Accept opens the confirmation modal

attrs.statement: Tapping Accept on a subquote detail screen opens the confirmation modal with the complete subquote summary, inherited context, and next steps.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 and Screen 3 business rules; Main Flow step 4.

nodes.title: Idempotent confirmation

attrs.statement: Confirmation is idempotent: duplicate confirmations do nothing, and repeat requests keyed to the inquiry and accepted subquote do not create multiple accepted states; after a network loss during acceptance the system retries safely with no duplicate accept states.
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 business rules, the network-loss edge case, and the implementation note on idempotent acceptance.

nodes.title: Confirmation modal exits

attrs.statement: After confirmation the modal closes and the patient is directed to the booking/payment entry; the patient can cancel to return to the quote detail screen.
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 business rules and the Confirm and Cancel actions (Cancel is always available).

nodes.title: Selected provider sees the accepted terms from the snapshot

attrs.statement: The selected provider sees the package, date range, appointment details, price, currency, and promotion accepted from it, read from the acceptance snapshot; this is shown only to the selected provider and is read-only.
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 Selected Subquote field.

nodes.title: Oversight status derived from booking cancellation and supersession

attrs.statement: Admin oversight status is active, booking cancelled (derived from the FR-006 booking cancellation, with no supersession record), or superseded (provider fault, including provider suspension or deactivation, derived from linked supersession records). "Superseded — Provider Fault" links to the replacement admin-authored acceptance record; "Booking Cancelled" is read from the FR-006 booking cancellation and links to its audit trail.
attrs.rationale: Screen 5 Global Acceptance Table and Supersession Indicator fields.

nodes.title: Confirmation copy content-managed; legal text central

attrs.statement: Acceptance confirmation copy and UX notes are content-managed; legal text and terms acknowledgment text are controlled centrally (A-09 system settings).
attrs.rationale: Admin Editability (configurable with restrictions), the A-09 dependency, and the business process assumption.

nodes.title: Acceptance binds the exact appointment and price

attrs.statement: Patient acceptance of the subquote constitutes acceptance of its exact appointment and price. FR-006 must not ask the patient to select another package, date range, appointment, or quote price.

nodes.title: No patient decline action

attrs.statement: Patients do not have an explicit "decline" action; sibling subquotes become Not Selected and competing parent quotes auto-cancel on acceptance or expire by policy.
attrs.rationale: Promoted from the user behavior assumptions because it is a business rule.

nodes.title: Mistaken cancellation has no restore

attrs.statement: When an admin finds a quote or subquote was cancelled by mistake, no restore action exists: the admin records the finding as an audited annotation, prior acceptance is not overridden, and the patient uses the recovery routes in Alternative Flows A1 and A7.

nodes.title: Conflicts flag set automatically by the system
