attrs.statement: System MUST set the Conflicts flag on an acceptance automatically when a second acceptance is rejected; an admin does not set it. The flagged acceptance is then investigated by an admin (Screen 5).
attrs.rationale: Stated in the Admin Platform scope and the Screen 5 Conflicts field.

nodes.title: Acceptance waits for the patient's legal document acceptance

attrs.statement: System MUST block the patient's confirmation of an acceptance until the patient has accepted the current legal documents, showing the FR-027 acceptance prompt; viewing and comparing quotes stay available (REQ-027-033).
attrs.rationale: prd.md General Module Rules and Screen 2 Accept Button; viewing and comparing stay available

nodes.title: Acceptance is blocked and retryable when terms text or the Settings API is missing

attrs.statement: System MUST block acceptance with a message, and let the patient retry, when the acceptance terms text (FR-026 A-09) has not been set, or when the Settings API is unavailable as the slot hold is placed; no stale or guessed hold duration is used and no AcceptanceEvent is created (REQ-026-118, REQ-026-144).
attrs.rationale: prd.md General Module Rules; no stale or guessed hold duration and no AcceptanceEvent

nodes.title: Proceed to payment from the accepted subquote without reselection

attrs.statement: Patients MUST be able to proceed to payment after accepting one subquote; FR-006 MUST consume its package, date range, appointment, price, promotion, and inherited parent context without reselection.

nodes.title: Booking confirmed only after successful first payment

attrs.statement: System MUST confirm booking only after successful deposit/initial installment and unmask patient identity to provider.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Main Flow steps 5 and 6, General Module Rules (first rule) and the Confirmation entry point.

nodes.title: Exclusive appointment hold owned before payment

attrs.statement: System MUST require an exclusive appointment hold, keyed by provider, appointment date/time, and time zone, created atomically with FR-005 acceptance; reject any handoff that does not own the valid hold before payment initiation; and create the appointment record and convert the hold into a provider calendar block only after successful payment confirmation.
attrs.rationale: Restated by General Module Rules (Overlapping Appointment Prevention), Business Rules (Post-Acceptance Hold), Screen 3 business rules and Key Entities (Calendar Slot relationships).

nodes.title: Admin-only cancellation with scheduled refunds

attrs.statement: System MUST enforce the cancellation policy, with refunds following the refund ladder set in FR-029 (rescheduling deferred to V2). Apart from the unpaid-balance case in REQ-006-016, only an admin MAY cancel a booking, from `Accepted`, `Payment Window Expired`, or `Confirmed` (and from `In Progress` only through the Cancel route of Screen 11), never from `Aftercare`, with a mandatory reason, confirmation, and audit entry; the booking and inquiry MUST become `Cancelled`, the accepted quote MUST stay `accepted`, and `booking.cancelled` MUST be sent. The refund MUST follow REQ-006-053. The patient MUST NOT have an in-app cancel action from acceptance onward and MUST be offered "Contact support" instead.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Alternative Flows B2 and B3, Admin Status and Date Intervention Rules (Cancel booking) and Screen 9 business rules.

nodes.title: One fixed slot hold; Payment Window Expired on hold expiry

attrs.statement: System MUST hold the accepted subquote's appointment slot with one fixed hold that starts at subquote acceptance and lasts the FR-026 slot-hold duration (default 48 hours); payment failure MUST NOT extend or restart it. If the hold expires before the first payment succeeds, System MUST set the booking to `Payment Window Expired`, release the hold, create no appointment record, block payment against that accepted selection, and preserve the immutable AcceptanceEvent/snapshot without reopening the prior parent quote or accepted subquote. The hold is keyed by provider, appointment date/time, and time zone. Recovery is by the audited admin revive, or by admin cancellation on a support request followed by a new inquiry; the patient is offered the "Contact support" route and has no in-app retry.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Business Rules (Post-Acceptance Hold, Payment Window Expired, Payment Window Expired Recovery, Payment Failure Handling), Alternative Flow B1 and Key Entities (Calendar Slot).

nodes.title: Booking links to one acceptance with matching versions

attrs.statement: System MUST link each booking to exactly one FR-005 AcceptanceEvent, accepted parent quote identifier/version, accepted subquote identifier/version, immutable acceptance snapshot, and provider calendar slot. `acceptedSubquoteVersion` MUST equal `acceptedParentQuoteVersion`.

nodes.title: Patient identity masked until payment; PII encrypted

attrs.statement: System MUST keep patient identity masked to the provider until the booking has reached `Confirmed` (payment confirmation), MUST keep it visible once unmasked, including after a later cancellation, and MUST encrypt PII at rest and in transit.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Data & Privacy Rules, Fixed in Codebase (identity unmasking tied to payment confirmation), Screen 3 and Screen 4 business rules.

nodes.title: All booking state changes and accesses logged

attrs.statement: System MUST log all booking state changes and accesses with user, timestamp, and reason.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Data & Privacy Rules (immutable audit logs) and Fixed in Codebase (audit logging enablement).

nodes.title: Payment Service integration with the locked exchange rate

attrs.statement: System MUST integrate with Payment Service for deposits, installments, and refunds, and MUST use the exchange rate locked in the acceptance snapshot without relocking it.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 1143 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Booking notification events

attrs.statement: System MUST integrate with Notification Service for confirmations, reminders, and policy notices, and MUST trigger these FR-030 events: `booking.scheduled` (sent on patient acceptance and on an admin-authored replacement acceptance), `booking.rescheduled` (sent on an admin appointment change and on an emergency edit of the appointment time), `booking.cancelled` (sent on any booking cancellation with the reason or cause, and with the cancellation fee and the refund amount filled in by the system: an admin cancellation, a provider drop-out at the Screen 10 submit, and a system cancellation for an unpaid balance (cause `UnpaidBalance`, which an FR-007B installment plan that defaults and stays unpaid reaches at the cancellation point of Alternative Flow B8); not for a provider withdrawal, which FR-004 announces through `quote.withdrawn`), `booking.hold_expiring_soon`, `booking.payment_window_expired`, `booking.revived`, `booking.provider_fault_replacement` (sent to the patient and the admin at the admin submit of the provider-fault transfer; a withdrawal is announced before it by `quote.withdrawn`, a drop-out by `booking.cancelled` at the same submit, and a provider suspension or deactivation by this event only, REQ-030-044), `booking.confirmed` (sent when the first payment confirms the booking), and `booking.appointment_reminder` (sent twice by default, 7 days and 1 day before the appointment date, as FR-030 sets in REQ-030-048). The patient notice sent at Close inquiry is the admin-close variant of `inquiry.cancelled`, whose event and template are owned by FR-020 and FR-030 (REQ-020-076). Recipients, message content, and whether each notice is mandatory are owned by the notification Rules in FR-020 (for example REQ-020-021) and FR-030 and are not restated here. FR-004 is the only producer of `quote.withdrawn`; FR-006 does not emit it and reacts to it by starting the provider-fault transfer in Alternative Flow B5.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 1144 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Slot-hold duration and reminder lead time read from FR-026

attrs.statement: System MUST read the slot-hold duration (default: 48 hours) and the "hold expiring soon" reminder lead time from FR-026 and MUST NOT keep a separate FR-006 hold setting. When the Settings API is unavailable as a hold is placed (subquote acceptance or admin revive), System MUST block the action so it can be retried and MUST NOT use a stale or guessed duration (REQ-026-144).
attrs.rationale: Restated by Admin Editability Rules (slot-hold duration and reminder lead time).

nodes.title: Cancelled inquiry blocks entry to booking and payment

attrs.statement: System MUST verify the parent inquiry is not in "Cancelled" status before allowing entry to the booking/payment flow. If cancelled, system MUST block entry and display a read-only blocked state (Screen 1 blocked state) with clear messaging.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 1150 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Provider suspension or deactivation cancels pre-treatment bookings

attrs.statement: When a provider's suspension or deactivation becomes effective, System MUST cancel that provider's `Accepted` and `Confirmed` bookings with cause `ProviderSuspended` or `ProviderDeactivated` and an independent `supportRequired` marker, release holds/reservations/slots, block further payment, revalidate provider eligibility at booking-confirming payment, treat any racing capture as paid money refunded in full under the B4 payment terms (see Provider-Status Cancellation), retain the accepted snapshot and booking/payment history, write the supersession record only at the replacement acceptance, and let an admin rehome the patient to a replacement provider in the same inquiry through Alternative Flow B5, without restoration on reactivation (Alternative Flow B4; FR-015 A5/Screen 4). `In Progress` and `Aftercare` bookings MUST keep their status and receive the cause and `supportRequired` (Alternative Flows B7 and B6).
attrs.rationale: Restated by Alternative Flows B4 to B7 and Payment & Billing Rules (Provider-Status Cancellation).

nodes.title: Payment Window Expired applies only to the first payment step

attrs.statement: `Payment Window Expired` MUST apply only to the first payment step (acceptance to deposit or first installment). A missed later installment or final payment MUST NOT cause `Payment Window Expired`, booking cancellation, or inquiry cancellation. The one exception is the unpaid balance of a booking paid with the Installments option on Screen 1 (the "deposit plan" of FR-029): when that balance is still unpaid at the cancellation point set in FR-029, counted in days after the due date of the first missed installment, System MUST cancel the `Confirmed` booking with closure cause `UnpaidBalance`, cancel the inquiry as in Alternative Flow B2, release the calendar block, void the remaining installments, send `booking.cancelled`, and apply the refund ladder. The rule is inactive until an admin sets that point, which has no default, and it applies only to bookings confirmed after the value is set.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Payment & Billing Rules (First-Payment Boundary) and the Alternative Flow B1 boundary.

nodes.title: Admin revive and appointment change; no other manual status change

attrs.statement: Admin MAY revive a `Payment Window Expired` booking to `Accepted` only through Screen 7 with a mandatory reason, a slot availability re-check, a check that the appointment is later than the new payment deadline, a new hold of the FR-026 duration, one promotion use taken again where the accepted promotion has a usage limit (re-reserved for a provider-selected promotion or patient code, taken again for an automatic promotion; the revive is rejected if the limit has no room), an audit entry, an unchanged AcceptanceEvent, and a mandatory "booking revived" notice to patient and provider. A revived booking MUST count again in the FR-014 pending-payment figures, aged from the start of its new hold (REQ-014-139). A revive MUST be blocked while the booking carries the marker of a pending provider fault. A revive MUST NOT extend the expired hold; it starts a new one, and the initial payment then MUST pass the Initial Payment Guard (REQ-007-017) against that new hold. Appointment date changes MUST be made through Screen 8 or the admin edit of the accepted quote's date range or appointment (REQ-005-023), both running the same checks (provider `Active`, slot availability, a feasible FR-007B plan recalculation, and for an `Accepted` booking an appointment later than the payment deadline), MUST NOT apply the FR-029 rescheduling fee, MUST update the booking's current appointment while the acceptance snapshot keeps the accepted baseline, MUST send `booking.rescheduled`, and MUST trigger an FR-008 travel review for any travel records already linked to the booking. No other manual status change is allowed.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Admin Status and Date Intervention Rules (Revive, Change appointment date/time, No other status jumps) and Screens 7 and 8 business rules.

nodes.title: Provider withdrawal after acceptance cancels with ProviderFault; admin transfer

attrs.statement: When the provider withdraws or drops out after acceptance and before treatment starts, System MUST set the `supportRequired` marker with the cause `ProviderFault` at the trigger, MUST, at the admin submit on Screen 10, re-check the booking status and cancel the booking with cause `ProviderFault`, release the hold or calendar block, keep the AcceptanceEvent unchanged, and let an admin transfer the patient to a replacement provider in the same inquiry through an admin-authored replacement quote and a new admin-authored acceptance that points to that quote, option, and date-price row (Alternative Flow B5, Screen 10; FR-004 Workflow 7 and Screen 8). A replacement quote that is not accepted MUST expire under the normal quote expiry, the inquiry MUST stay `supportRequired` without automatic cancellation, and the admin MAY author another replacement quote or, for a `Cancelled` booking that still carries the marker, close the inquiry (REQ-006-082). System MUST write the single supersession record linking the original AcceptanceEvent to the new one at the replacement acceptance, as one append-only insert; the B4 or B5 closure is recorded on the booking as its cause. A provider fault during `Aftercare` MUST NOT create a new quote, acceptance, or payment; the booking stays `Aftercare` and an admin reassigns the aftercare provider or team through FR-011 (Alternative Flow B6); the replacement booking MUST receive the carried-over passport and copied flight and hotel records flagged "travel-date review required" per FR-008, with the originals kept read-only on the closed booking.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Alternative Flow B5, Admin Status and Date Intervention Rules (Provider-fault transfer) and Screen 10 business rules.

nodes.title: Provider fault while In Progress keeps the booking In Progress

attrs.statement: When a provider fault occurs while the booking is `In Progress`, System MUST keep the booking `In Progress`, MUST NOT cancel it automatically or create a replacement quote or acceptance, and MUST flag it `supportRequired` with the cause. Only an admin MAY resolve it on Screen 11 (Alternative Flow B7), with a mandatory reason, confirmation, and audit entry, by either moving the booking to `Aftercare` and reassigning the aftercare provider or team through FR-011 Screen 19, or cancelling the booking through Screen 9. The admin MUST also set the patient refund amount, from zero up to the full amount paid, under the same mandatory reason and audit entry, and System MUST hold the provider's payout for that booking from the fault until the chosen route completes, MUST take the refund from that held payout, and MUST deduct any shortfall from the provider's next payout when the payout was already released. The decision records the choice only: System MUST resolve the `supportRequired` marker and end the payout hold once the chosen route completes, by the Screen 9 submit or the FR-011 Screen 19 submit.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Alternative Flow B7, Admin Status and Date Intervention Rules (In-Progress provider fault) and Screen 11 business rules.

nodes.title: Admin actions blocked for a suspended or deactivated provider

attrs.statement: System MUST block an admin revive (Screen 7), an admin appointment change (Screen 8), and an admin-authored replacement acceptance (Screen 10) when the provider concerned is `Suspended` or `Deactivated` at submit, MUST change nothing, and MUST show the action-specific message that directs the admin to cancel the booking, to the provider-fault transfer, or to another replacement provider (Admin Status and Date Intervention Rules; FR-015 Rule 9). The messages are: revive, "This provider is suspended or deactivated, so this booking cannot be revived. Cancel the booking instead."; appointment change, "This provider is suspended or deactivated, so this appointment cannot be changed. Use the provider-fault transfer instead."; replacement acceptance, "This provider is suspended or deactivated, so this replacement quote cannot be accepted. Choose another replacement provider."
attrs.rationale: Restated by Admin Status and Date Intervention Rules (Provider must be Active for admin booking actions) and Screens 7, 8 and 10 business rules.

No reminder is sent while a provider fault is pending on the booking. A lead time raised after the hold was placed applies only to reminders not yet sent; a reminder whose time has already passed is skipped, not sent late (REQ-026-031).

The Contact Support button opens a plain support request with the booking reference and no request type (REQ-034-182).

nodes.title: Cancelled and Completed bookings are terminal

The action is not offered in `In Progress` or `Aftercare`; those stages use Screen 11 and Alternative Flow B6. `Cancelled` and `Completed` are terminal and cannot be cancelled again.

nodes.title: A full refund for provider withdrawal, drop-out, suspension or deactivation before treatment starts; an in-treatment fault takes an admin-set refund; other cancellations follow the FR-029 refund ladder

attrs.statement: A full refund applies when the provider withdraws, drops out, or is suspended or deactivated before treatment starts; an in-treatment provider fault takes an admin-set refund; every other cancellation follows the refund ladder set in FR-029. When the provider withdraws or drops out after acceptance and before treatment starts (Alternative Flow B5), or the booking is cancelled by a provider suspension or deactivation (Alternative Flow B4), the patient is refunded everything paid, pays no cancellation fee, and a replacement booking takes a new payment; the same terms apply to an admin cancellation of a booking with a pending provider fault. While `In Progress` the case follows Alternative Flow B7: the admin sets the patient refund amount from zero up to the full amount paid, with a mandatory reason and an audit entry, and the provider's payout for the booking is held from the fault until the chosen route completes; the refund comes out of the held payout, and if the payout was already released, the shortfall is deducted from the provider's next payout.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Alternative Flow B2 step 6, Screen 9 business rules and Screen 6 business rules.

nodes.title: Provider-status cancellation money follows the B5 withdrawal terms

attrs.statement: Bookings cancelled by an effective provider suspension/deactivation (Alternative Flow B4) are rehomed by admin to a replacement provider in the same inquiry through the Alternative Flow B5 transfer. The payment terms are the same as for a provider withdrawal or drop-out (Alternative Flow B5): the patient is refunded everything paid, pays no cancellation fee, and the replacement booking takes a new payment; exact mechanics are defined in FR-007, FR-007B, and FR-017. Provider eligibility is revalidated at booking-confirming payment (FR-015 Rule 9). A payment captured while suspension/deactivation becomes effective is recorded and treated as paid money, refunded in full under these B4 terms; it never confirms or revives the booking.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Alternative Flows B4 step 4, B5 Payment terms and B7 Payment terms.

nodes.title: No patient cancel or retry message for provider-status cascades

nodes.title: Aftercare provider fault keeps the booking in Aftercare

attrs.statement: The booking stays `Aftercare` and the treatment record stays unchanged. No new quote, no new acceptance, and no new payment are created, and the AcceptanceEvent is not superseded. When entered from B4, the booking carries the provider-status cause and the `supportRequired` marker; the original provider loses aftercare actions on the case.
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 187.

nodes.title: Travel records carry over to the replacement booking

attrs.statement: Travel carries over through FR-008 only when the replacement booking's travel path (A or B) matches the original's: when the replacement booking's travel context is created, the patient's passport record carries over to it, and the flight and hotel records are copied to it and flagged "travel-date review required" for admin review. When the paths differ, nothing is carried over or copied and the replacement's own initial travel requests go out. The original travel records stay read-only on the closed booking, and the patient re-enters nothing that was carried over.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 177 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Transfer cancels the original booking with ProviderFault first

attrs.statement: If the original booking is not already `Cancelled`, the submit first cancels it with cause `ProviderFault` and releases its hold or calendar block; until this submit the original booking keeps its status and its hold, with payment, payment reminders and revive blocked (Alternative Flow B5 steps 1 and 2).

nodes.title: Appointment change keeps the original hold expiry

attrs.statement: An `Accepted` booking keeps its original hold expiry.

nodes.title: Booking status lifecycle

attrs.statement: `Accepted` (subquote accepted, awaiting payment) → `Confirmed` (deposit paid) → `In Progress` (procedure started, via FR-010) → `Aftercare` (treatment complete, or closed early by an admin decision on Screen 11; aftercare active via FR-011) → `Completed` (FR-011 emits the aftercare completion event, whatever its outcome value: completed, paperwork only, cancelled by the patient, or cancelled by an admin; REQ-011-096, REQ-011-101). An `In Progress` booking with a provider fault moves to `Aftercare` only through the admin decision on Screen 11 (Alternative Flow B7), and the decision date is then the aftercare start date handed to FR-011. From `Accepted`, hold expiry transitions to `Payment Window Expired`. From `Payment Window Expired`, only the audited admin revive returns the booking to `Accepted` with a new hold. `Confirmed` is a booking status only, never a quote status. `supportRequired` is a marker, not a status.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 1163 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Cancelled booking entries

attrs.statement: **Cancelled entries** (source state, actor, cause): (1) `Accepted`, `Payment Window Expired`, or `Confirmed` → `Cancelled` by admin cancellation (Screen 9), including support-routed patient requests, with the admin's reason, and `In Progress` → `Cancelled` through the Cancel route of Screen 11; the inquiry also becomes `Cancelled` and the accepted quote stays `accepted` (Alternative Flows B2, B3, and B7). Cancel Booking is not offered in `In Progress` or `Aftercare` on Screen 6. A cancellation of a booking with a pending provider fault takes the cause `ProviderFault` (REQ-006-081). (2) `Accepted` or `Confirmed` → `Cancelled` at the admin submit of the provider-fault transfer, cause `ProviderFault` (Alternative Flow B5). (3) `Accepted` or `Confirmed` → `Cancelled` by the system on an effective provider suspension or deactivation, cause `ProviderSuspended` or `ProviderDeactivated` with `supportRequired = true` (Alternative Flow B4), followed by the B5 transfer. The inquiry of a booking closed through (2) or (3) stays open until the replacement acceptance, or until an admin closes it with Close inquiry (REQ-006-082). (4) `Confirmed` → `Cancelled` by the system, cause `UnpaidBalance`, when the unpaid balance of a booking paid with the Installments option is still unpaid at the cancellation point set in FR-029, counted in days after the due date of the first missed installment; the inquiry also becomes `Cancelled`, the remaining installments are voided, the refund ladder applies, and the rule is inactive until that point is set and applies only to bookings confirmed after it is set (Alternative Flow B8). A provider fault or provider-status event during `Aftercare` does not cancel the booking; it stays `Aftercare` and follows the aftercare reassignment (Alternative Flow B6). `Completed` and `Cancelled` are terminal.

While only one admin holds the Issue Refunds permission, a refund that needs approval stays awaiting approval until a second holder exists (REQ-031-069). When 2 business days pass with no decision, System sends an escalation notice to a super-admin (notification catalogue event `refund.approval_escalated`, FR-030), who decides in the same view, never as the requester; System never approves or denies on its own. A closure-case refund (REQ-006-053) runs with no second approval. The sum of all refunds on a booking never exceeds the amount paid (REQ-007-066). The requester, approver, decision and reason are logged and notifications sent.

attrs.rationale: Payment amounts derive from the accepted subquote's offered price after the accepted promotion, as frozen in the acceptance snapshot, and are never recomputed. Do not price from a parent range, sum alternative packages/date rows, reload library prices, or add informational price components to an already complete offered total. The accepted promotion and discounted price are frozen at acceptance (FR-019). Checkout and payment offer no code entry, removal, replacement, or price-changing revalidation; do not mutate the AcceptanceEvent or reapply current promotion settings to payments.

nodes.title: Initial payment guard before processor submission

attrs.statement: Before initial processor submission, system MUST validate FR-006 selection eligibility, accepted versions, and exclusive unexpired hold ownership; invalid handoffs are blocked and hold expiry follows `Payment Window Expired`, without hold extension or quote reopening. Payment failure MUST NOT extend or restart the hold; only the FR-006 audited admin revive creates a new hold. Later confirmed-booking payments do not acquire a new acceptance hold. A patient who has not accepted the Current Terms and Privacy Policy cannot start a payment (REQ-027-033); a scheduled installment charge is not blocked by it.
attrs.rationale: **Initial Payment Guard**: Before calling the payment processor, validate the FR-006 handoff (FR-006 owns these checks): the booking is `Accepted`; the parent inquiry is not `Cancelled`; the parent quote and accepted subquote are still `Accepted`; the provider is still Active (FR-015); parent/subquote versions match the AcceptanceEvent (`acceptedSubquoteVersion = acceptedParentQuoteVersion`); and that event owns the unexpired exclusive appointment hold. Payment cannot select a different package, option/date-price record, appointment, or quote price. This hold guard applies to the first confirming charge, not to later installments/final payments on an already confirmed booking.

nodes.title: Payment Window Expired applies only to the first payment step

A missed later installment or final payment MUST NOT cause `Payment Window Expired`, booking cancellation, or inquiry cancellation, except the FR-006 unpaid balance cancellation (Alternative Flow B8) at the FR-029 Unpaid Balance Cancellation Point, which applies only when an admin has set that point and only to bookings confirmed after it is set.
attrs.rationale: A missed later installment or final payment never causes `Payment Window Expired`, booking cancellation, or inquiry cancellation; it is flagged and notified.

nodes.title: Provider fault after acceptance blocks payment and refunds paid money in full; an interrupted treatment gets an admin-set refund

attrs.statement: When a provider fault after acceptance closes a booking (FR-006 Alternative Flow B5), System MUST block further payment against it. When the provider withdraws, drops out, or is suspended or deactivated (FR-006 Alternative Flow B4), the patient is refunded in full everything paid, with no patient fee and no second approval, and the replacement booking takes a new payment. For a treatment already started and interrupted by the provider's fault, an admin MUST review the case and set the patient refund amount, from zero up to the full amount paid, with a mandatory reason and an audit entry, and the provider's payout for that booking MUST be held until the admin decides (see Fund Release & Money Routing Rules). Detailed refund and fund-release mechanics are defined in FR-007B and FR-017. A provider fault during Aftercare reassigns only the aftercare provider or team (FR-011) and has no payment effect here.

nodes.title: Up to three automatic retries with backoff for transient failures

attrs.statement: **Retry Policy (Constitution-aligned)**: For transient processor/network failures, Payment Service MUST perform up to 3 automatic retries using exponential backoff with jitter (and idempotency) before marking a payment attempt failed; hard declines require explicit patient action to retry.
attrs.rationale: System classifies failure type (hard decline vs transient error). surface progress and final failure to patient if retries exhaust

nodes.title: Hard decline shows a clear error; patient retries or picks another method against the same snapshot

attrs.statement: For hard declines, System displays clear error and suggested next steps (retry, use different method). Patient retries or selects another method against the same accepted snapshot while the original FR-006 hold remains valid.
attrs.rationale: Display clear error messaging and retry options on failure Booking remains unconfirmed until successful initial payment; failure/retry does not change the accepted selection.

nodes.title: Failed or abandoned authentication leaves payment incomplete; retry only while the original hold is active

attrs.statement: Payment remains incomplete until successful authentication; booking not confirmed. Retrying is allowed only while the original FR-006 hold remains active; an authentication challenge does not restart the payment window.
attrs.rationale: System informs patient of the authentication requirement and guides action If challenge fails or times out, System presents retry and alternative method options Hold expires during an authentication challenge; retry cannot extend/recreate the hold or bypass FR-006 eligibility; only an FR-006 audited admin revive starts a new hold

nodes.title: Expired selection stays blocked; AcceptanceEvent retained; recovery by new inquiry or admin revive

attrs.statement: On hold expiry, FR-006 releases the hold, creates no appointment record, and records `Payment Window Expired`; payment against that accepted selection remains blocked. Retain the AcceptanceEvent and snapshot unchanged. Do not reopen the parent quote or make the accepted subquote selectable again; recovery is by the patient cancelling the inquiry and starting a new inquiry, or by the FR-006 audited admin revive.
attrs.rationale: `Payment Window Expired` blocks further payment against that selection without reopening its parent/subquote; only the FR-006 audited admin revive creates a new hold.

nodes.title: Hairline is seller and holds the payment; clinic share moves before treatment

For the deposit-and-balance option, the part of the amount paid that is above Hairline's commission moves at the 60-day mark and each later payment tops it up. Hairline's balance pays refunds, chargebacks, and Stripe fees first and recovers the clinic's part afterwards.

nodes.title: A payment captured when the booking is not payable, or a partial deposit left when the hold expires, is refunded in full automatically

A partial deposit still held when the hold expires is treated the same way. System MUST refund it in full automatically, write an audit entry and notify the patient, with no admin approval.

nodes.title: Screen 6 is the single refund control: the system starts closure-case refunds, an admin submits only exception or manual refunds, admin-set up to the amount still refundable

attrs.statement: Every refund is executed on Screen 6. A closure-case refund follows the booking's recorded closure cause (REQ-006-053) and is started by the system, never by an admin. An admin submits only an exception to the policy or a manual refund, the only cases offered when no closure cause is recorded or the cause is not listed. An exception or manual refund is admin-set: any amount from zero up to the amount still refundable, with a mandatory reason, and the ladder amount is shown beside it. FR-006 Process Refund and the FR-017 refund action open this screen instead of running their own refund. FR-017 opens it from its refund launcher (Screen 4b) and from its completion problem outcomes (Screen 7) with the invoice and booking prefilled and, where an admin has already set the amount there, that amount shown; the amount stays within the amount still refundable.

nodes.title: The patient has three payment options chosen on FR-006 and changeable only before the first successful payment; FR-007 shows the amount due now

attrs.statement: The patient chooses one of three payment options on FR-006 Screen 1: pay in full now, a deposit now with the balance later, or installments (2 to 9, FR-007B). FR-007 Screen 1 shows the chosen option read-only, with the amount due now. The option can change only before the first successful payment, by returning to FR-006. The first successful charge of the chosen option confirms the booking.

nodes.title: Payment status values are defined: Refunded means all paid money returned, Partial deposit means part of the deposit received

attrs.statement: Unpaid: nothing is paid. Deposit only: the deposit is paid and the balance is not. Installments active: an installment plan has started and is not fully paid. Full paid: the whole payable total is paid. Refunded: all money paid has been returned; a part refund leaves the previous status and shows in the refund history. Deposit status Partial: only part of the deposit amount has been received and the rest is still due; the booking is not confirmed until the full deposit is paid, Payment Status stays Unpaid (there is no Pending value), and the partial deposit is refunded in full automatically when the hold expires (REQ-007-096). At Risk is not a status. The moment the booking becomes Full paid, whichever option settled it (pay in full, the final balance or the last installment), is the fully-paid event other modules read; FR-018 reads it for affiliate accrual (REQ-018-309).

nodes.title: A standalone aftercare payment is refunded by an admin decision and released after the confirmation window counted from the payment

attrs.statement: For a standalone aftercare payment (REQ-007-088) no refund ladder applies: an admin decides any refund beyond FR-011's own refund cases with a reason on Screen 6, opened from the aftercare payment record, as a manual refund (REQ-007-015). FR-011's own cases are the automatic refund in REQ-011-037 and the pro-rata refund of the unused full months when a plan paid in full is cancelled (REQ-011-097); the system starts them, and the commission and the provider's payout (FR-017) fall in the same proportion. The provider's money is released after the same patient confirmation window as a booking, counted from the date of the payment instead of procedure completion.

nodes.title: A booking confirmed on short notice pays in full at confirmation

attrs.statement: A booking confirmed with fewer days left before the procedure than the FR-029 balance due days MUST take the full amount at confirmation. The deposit-and-balance and installment options are not offered, so no balance can fall due in the past.

nodes.title: A standalone aftercare payment is recorded on an aftercare payment record with retry and a 48-hour expiry

attrs.statement: A standalone aftercare payment (REQ-007-088) has no booking, so System MUST record it on an aftercare payment record with its own id, the patient, the provider, the amount, the currency and the payout snapshot; Screens 5B and 6 open from that record. A failed payment can be retried with another method and the request expires after 48 hours without a successful payment (FR-011 Alternative Flow B1). FR-011's automatic refund (REQ-011-037) stays for its own failure cases; any other refund is an admin refund (REQ-007-100).

nodes.title: Interest-free installment plans of 2 to 9 monthly payments

attrs.statement: System MUST offer interest-free installment payment plans with 2-9 monthly payments
attrs.rationale: PRD id REQ-007b-001 (prd.md line 816). Restated by General Module Rules (interest-free, 0% APR for all patients; options 2 to 9 monthly payments, enabled in FR-029), Fixed in Codebase (interest rate always 0%) and Screen 1 notes (highlight that installments are interest-free).

nodes.title: Feasible options from time to procedure, monthly frequency and cutoff

attrs.statement: System MUST determine feasible installment options based on time until procedure, monthly frequency, and the cutoff days configured in FR-029 (minimum 30 days; the plan keeps the cutoff days it was created with); the maximum number of installments is (days until procedure - cutoff days) ÷ 30, rounded down, plus 1, so 60 days with a 30-day cutoff allows 2 installments; offered options are limited to enabled installment counts configured in FR-029 (2-9)
attrs.rationale: PRD id REQ-007b-002 (prd.md line 817). Restated by General Module Rules (only feasible counts are offered given booking date, procedure date, monthly frequency and cutoff window), Main Flow steps 2 and 3 (e.g. 2 to 5 installments for a procedure in 6 months) and Screen 1 (Maximum Installments 2 to 9, based on (days until procedure - 30) / 30).

nodes.title: Final installment completes by the configured cutoff

attrs.rationale: PRD id REQ-007b-003 (prd.md line 818). Restated by General Module Rules (final payment completes by the configured cutoff days, minimum 30), the Main Flow outcome, Alternative Flow A1 (same cutoff window kept) and Screens 4 and 6 (Final Payment Deadline must meet the configured cutoff rule).

nodes.title: Installment amount is booking total divided by installment count

attrs.statement: System MUST calculate installment amounts as equal shares of the booking total (accepted price after promotion) ÷ number of installments, rounded down to the currency's smallest unit; the last installment is the total minus the sum of the others, so the amounts always sum to the total
attrs.rationale: PRD id REQ-007b-004 (prd.md line 819). Restated by General Module Rules (rounded to 2 decimal places), Main Flow step 5, Alternative Flow A1 step 2 (fewer installments give a higher amount for the same total) and the Screen 4 sub-table (amounts must sum to Total Amount).

nodes.title: Retryable failures retried after waits of 1, 3 and 7 days; no automatic retry after a hard decline

attrs.statement: System MUST execute 3 automatic retry attempts for an installment whose charge failed for a retryable reason (any failure except a hard decline, so a technical fault or insufficient funds), with waits of 1 day, 3 days and 7 days (retries fall on day 1, day 4 and day 11 after the failure). A hard decline is a refusal because the card is expired, lost, stolen, invalid or flagged for fraud. After a hard decline, or when a retry returns one, System MUST NOT retry automatically and MUST cancel the retries still pending; it MUST notify the patient, who must use Pay now or update the card, and the installment becomes Defaulted on day 11 after the due date if still unpaid. Admin retries do not count toward the 3 automatic retries
attrs.rationale: PRD id REQ-007b-018 (prd.md line 845). Restated by Alternative Flow B1 steps 3 to 5, Payment & Billing Rules, Fixed in Codebase (3 attempts; schedule 1, 3 and 7 days) and the S-02 scope.

attrs.rationale: PRD id REQ-007b-019 (prd.md line 846). Restated by Alternative Flow B1 step 6, Payment & Billing Rules, the Screen 5 flag for plans overdue after 3 failed retries and the plan status values on Screens 3, 4 and 6.

nodes.title: Admin notified of a defaulted plan

nodes.title: Patient can update the card and pay a failed or overdue installment at once

attrs.statement: System MUST allow the patient to update the card of an active installment plan at any time before the next installment is charged; the new card applies to the remaining installments and to a Failed or Overdue one, which the update re-offers to charge, and the patient can charge it at once with Pay now. Neither happens while the support-required marker is on
attrs.rationale: PRD id REQ-007b-021 (prd.md line 851). nodes.title: Refund base is the paid amount excluding late fees; FR-006 and FR-007 compute the refund

attrs.statement: System MUST show the admin the amount paid so far excluding late fees as the refund base. FR-006 and FR-007 compute the refund as a percentage of that amount per the cancellation refund ladder owned by FR-029 (or the provider-fault terms), and FR-007B only voids the unpaid installments and records the outcome
attrs.rationale: PRD id REQ-007b-022 (prd.md line 852). Restated by Alternative Flow B2 step 2, the Admin scope (process refunds for cancelled bookings with partial installments) and Screen 6 (Cancel Plan calculates refunds per cancellation policy).

nodes.title: Remaining installments voided with the booking, before the refund is computed

attrs.statement: System MUST cancel remaining installments when booking is cancelled. The void is one step shared by the admin cancellation, the provider-fault cancellation and the unpaid-balance cancellation: it runs before the refund is computed, waits for any charge in flight, sets the plan Cancelled, and adds a charge that still succeeds to the refund base. Stopping the installments and the refund happen inside the FR-006 Cancel Booking action, and installment plans have no separate cancel action
attrs.rationale: PRD id REQ-007b-023 (prd.md line 853). Restated by Alternative Flow B2 step 5, Screen 6 (Cancel Plan stops future installments) and User Stories 5 and 6.

nodes.title: Date change keeps the due dates and recalculates the final payment deadline, or is blocked when no plan fits

nodes.title: Plan total, currency and exchange rate copied read-only from the accepted snapshot

attrs.rationale: PRD id REQ-007b-025 (prd.md line 858). Restated by General Module Rules, Main Flow upstream context and step 1, Screens 1, 2, 4 and 6 (Currency read-only, from the accepted snapshot), Data Dependencies, the FR-019 dependency (promotion already in the total), User Story 1 scenarios 4 and 5, and Edge Cases (a quote, package or promotion edited after acceptance has no effect).

nodes.title: First-installment retries only within the FR-006 payment hold

attrs.statement: System MUST allow a failed first installment to be retried, or another payment method used, only within the original FR-006 payment hold; when the hold expires the booking moves to `Payment Window Expired` and installment checkout is blocked. `Payment Window Expired` applies only to that first payment step, and missed later installments MUST NOT cause `Payment Window Expired` or inquiry cancellation; they cancel the booking only at the FR-029 Unpaid Balance Cancellation Point, when one is set
attrs.rationale: PRD id REQ-007b-026 (prd.md line 859). Restated by General Module Rules (Payment Window Expired applies only to the first payment step), Screen 1 (retry or another payment method only while the hold is active per FR-007 REQ-007-017; when the hold expires installment checkout is blocked), Alternative Flow B1 boundary, Edge Cases and User Stories 1 (scenario 6) and 3 (scenario 4).

nodes.title: Provider fault after acceptance cancels remaining installments and refunds paid ones in full

attrs.statement: When the provider fails after acceptance (FR-006 Alternative Flows B4 and B5 only), System MUST cancel remaining installments with no patient cancellation fee. On a provider withdrawal, drop-out, suspension or deactivation, System MUST refund in full every installment already paid and any late fee already collected, and the replacement booking takes a new payment per FR-006 Alternative Flows B4 and B5. The FR-006 unpaid-balance cancellation does not take this path: it takes the refund ladder
attrs.rationale: PRD id REQ-007b-027 (prd.md line 860). Restated by Alternative Flow B4 steps 1 and 2 and its outcome (the patient is refunded in full and continues with the replacement provider in the same inquiry), and the FR-006 dependency note. Owner ruling 2026-11-22: a suspension or deactivation follows the same terms as a withdrawal or drop-out.
