attrs.statement: Before treatment starts (booking Accepted or Confirmed), when the provider withdraws the accepted quote, drops out, or is suspended or deactivated, and an admin transfers the patient to a replacement provider through FR-006 Alternative Flow B5 by authoring a replacement quote in the same inquiry, the installment plan follows the B4 outcome.
attrs.rationale: PRD prose rule, no id. prd.md line 185 (Alternative Flows).

nodes.title: Money movement is owned by FR-007 and FR-017

attrs.statement: Money movement (Hairline as the seller on the card payment, refunds, chargebacks and Stripe fees paid from Hairline's balance first, the clinic's share moving to its locked Stripe balance, the pull-back on cancellation or rescheduling, and the payout at release) is owned by FR-007 (REQ-007-090) and FR-017. The day count for an installment plan once fully paid is that FR-007 rule, separate from the plan's cutoff days. FR-007B adds only that the share moves when the plan is fully paid and a Defaulted plan blocks the movement.
attrs.rationale: PRD prose rule, no id. Payment & Billing Rules (money movement).

nodes.title: Late fee charged when the late payment grace period passes without payment

attrs.statement: A late fee is added once to an installment when the late payment grace period saved on the plan, counted from the due date, passes with the installment unpaid and no automatic retry is pending (the fee waits until the retries end). It is collected with the next successful charge, never as a separate charge, and the refund base excludes it. The fee amount is set by the admin in FR-029 and saved on the plan at confirmation; its currency, base and treatment are in REQ-007B-110.
attrs.rationale: PRD prose rule, no id. Payment & Billing Rules and Alternative Flow B1 Outcome.

nodes.title: Overdue is a calculated flag, not a stored plan status

attrs.statement: Overdue is not a status: it is a calculated flag on the installment, true from the day after its due date while it is unpaid, not Cancelled and not paused on a Defaulted plan, and it is not stored. The plan flag is true while any installment is Overdue.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 867 (Key Entities, Entity 1 Installment Plan: Overdue is a calculated flag, not stored).

nodes.title: Overdue starts the day after the due date with one patient notice and one billing-admin notice

attrs.statement: An installment is Overdue from the day after its due date while it is unpaid, not Cancelled and not paused on a Defaulted plan. On that day the day's retry runs first; if the installment is still unpaid System sends the patient one overdue notice, which replaces that day's failure notice and states the date on which the booking will be cancelled when the cancellation point is set, and notifies the billing admins once. The provider sees the Overdue banner on the plan detail screen and is notified only when the plan is Defaulted.

nodes.title: The cancellation point cancels the booking for an unpaid balance whatever the retry state

attrs.statement: When the Unpaid Balance Cancellation Point saved on the plan is set (the booking was confirmed after FR-029 set it), System hands the Confirmed booking to FR-006 Alternative Flow B8 (cause UnpaidBalance) that many days after the due date of the first missed installment, whatever the retry, grace period or Defaulted state; pending retries and the grace period end with the plan. While the support-required marker is on the count pauses, is not reset, and nothing is handed over (REQ-007B-103). While the point is unset nothing cancels automatically. It covers any unpaid balance.

nodes.title: A pending provider fault pauses every charge, retry, reminder, flag, late fee and cancellation-point hand-off

attrs.statement: While the booking carries the support-required marker (FR-006 REQ-006-081), System MUST NOT charge, retry, remind, flag Overdue or Defaulted, add a late fee for an installment, or hand the booking to FR-006 Alternative Flow B8, and the retry, grace and cancellation-point clocks are paused, not reset. A card update is still accepted but re-offers no charge. If a replacement is accepted, the replacement plan recalculates all dates (B4); otherwise charges resume at the Screen 10 submit.

nodes.title: After treatment starts a Defaulted plan is resolved by payment only

attrs.statement: The FR-006 Cancel Booking route is open only while the booking is Accepted, Payment Window Expired or Confirmed, and in In Progress only through the FR-006 provider-fault route. Once treatment has started, a Defaulted plan is resolved by payment only (Retry Charge or Mark as Resolved), with no cancel route.

nodes.title: Later installments on a Defaulted plan are paused, with no flag or fee, until the plan returns to Active

attrs.statement: While a plan is Defaulted, System MUST NOT charge its later installments on their due dates. They keep their dates and amounts, are not Overdue, and get no overdue notice, reminder or late fee. When the plan returns to Active (REQ-007B-108), each paused installment whose due date has passed is charged once at the next daily run, before any Overdue flag or notice that day, with the normal failure handling.

nodes.title: The installment option is offered only when installments are enabled, the amount qualifies and enough days remain

attrs.statement: System MUST offer the installment option only when installments are enabled in FR-029, the booking total is at or above the FR-029 minimum booking amount (converted at the locked rate) and the days until the procedure are at least the cutoff days plus 30. The options offered are the enabled counts up to the maximum; when none fits the installment option is not shown and only pay in full is offered. When fewer days remain than the FR-029 balance due days only pay in full is offered.

nodes.title: Retries and the grace period continue past the cutoff; the share moves after the plan is Completed, as FR-007 sets

attrs.statement: Retries and the grace period continue past the cutoff date. The plan is Completed whenever the final installment is paid, after which the clinic's share moves as FR-007 REQ-007-090 sets, whatever the date.

nodes.title: A Defaulted plan returns to Active when nothing is Failed or Overdue, whoever paid

attrs.statement: A Defaulted plan returns to Active when no installment is Failed or Overdue, whoever paid (the patient with Pay now or a new card, an admin Retry Charge, or Mark as Resolved), and becomes Completed when every installment is Paid.

nodes.title: An installment is settled outside the card only as a recorded bank transfer that a second billing admin approves

attrs.statement: Mark as Resolved is used only for a bank transfer into Hairline's account. The admin enters the amount, date, receiving account and reference, and a second admin who holds the Resolve Installments permission (FR-031) approves it, never the same admin; only then is the installment Paid with payment source manual. FR-007 owns the manual payment record, the refund of a manual payment and the clinic-share movement for it.

nodes.title: A fixed late fee converts at the accepted rate, a percentage applies to the late installment, and the fee stays outside the clinic share

attrs.statement: A fixed late fee is converted at the plan's accepted exchange rate and a percentage fee applies to the late installment amount. The fee stays outside the clinic's share and commission (owned by FR-029 and FR-007). A fee still uncollected when the plan ends lapses. A provider-fault full refund (REQ-007B-027) returns a collected fee.

nodes.title: The patient sees the late fee, grace period and cancellation point at checkout, and the plan keeps them as confirmed

attrs.statement: Screen 1 shows the late fee, the grace period and, when set, the cancellation point before the patient confirms. The plan keeps the values in force at confirmation, as it keeps the cutoff days; a later FR-029 change applies only to plans confirmed afterwards. The overdue notice states the date on which the booking will be cancelled when the point is set.

nodes.title: On an Active plan Pay now can also pay the next scheduled installment or all remaining ones early

attrs.statement: On an Active plan, Pay now also lets the patient pay the next scheduled installment, or all remaining installments at once, in due-date order; the due dates of unpaid installments do not change, and the plan is Completed when every installment is Paid.

nodes.title: A failed scheduled installment job is queued for retry and the admin is alerted when the scheduling system is unavailable

attrs.statement: System MUST queue a failed scheduled installment job for retry and MUST alert the admin when the scheduling system is unavailable (the schedule of the job is owned by FR-017, REQ-017-183).
attrs.rationale: Carried clause Failure handling of the original PRD, restored in prd.md Business Rules in version 1.14 and now stated as a rule.

nodes.title: Passport submission only after booking Confirmed

attrs.statement: The system MUST allow patients to submit a passport photo and structured form data only after the linked FR-006 booking is Confirmed.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 1028 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Passport data encrypted and number masked for the patient

attrs.statement: The system MUST store passport data encrypted and mask `passport_number` in patient display views; full passport details are visible only to the assigned provider and admin for the confirmed booking.
attrs.rationale: Passport number is shown masked (for example A1234****) in the patient display and confirmation view; the assigned provider and admin see it in full (Screen 1 rules, Screen 7, Passport Rules).

nodes.title: Passport access restricted to patient, assigned provider and admin

attrs.statement: The system MUST restrict passport data access to the submitting patient, their assigned provider, and admin.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 1030 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Provider notified of passport submission or correction

attrs.statement: The system MUST notify the provider when a patient submits passport details or admin corrects the record.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 1031 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Automatic passport request at Confirmed (Path A)

attrs.statement: The system MUST automatically request passport details from the patient once when the linked FR-006 booking becomes **Confirmed** and the accepted option snapshot yields Path A, except for items already carried over to a replacement booking under REQ-008-032. No provider or admin trigger is required.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Main Flow 1 trigger and step A2, Patient Platform scope, Shared Services scope and Business Rules 'Automated Trigger on Confirmed Booking'.

nodes.title: Flight as two independent leg records

attrs.statement: The system MUST allow flight information to be submitted as two independent records (outbound and return), each with a `leg_type` indicator.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 1038 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Flight submitter follows the travel path

attrs.statement: The system MUST allow the patient to submit flight records in Path B or the provider to submit them in Path A only when flight is included in the accepted option. It MUST reject mixed submitters for the same booking.
attrs.rationale: No submitter mixing: Path A flight and hotel entries come from the provider only, Path B entries from the patient only; admin corrects in both paths (Travel Path Determination).

nodes.title: Travel dates validated against the current appointment

attrs.statement: The system MUST validate that `arrival_date` is ≥ `departure_date`, that the outbound flight arrives on or before the current booking appointment date, that the return flight departs after it, and that hotel check-in is on or before that date with check-out after check-in. The current booking appointment equals the accepted snapshot appointment unless an admin-approved change exists. Because treatment plan days are relative, a return flight or hotel check-out before the last treatment plan day is not rejected; it raises the soft warning in REQ-008-031.
attrs.rationale: Field-level date validation also appears on Screens 3, 4, 8 and 9. Treatment plan days are relative, so an early departure is a warning (REQ-008-031), not a rejection.

nodes.title: No total price on the flight record

attrs.statement: The system MUST NOT include a `total_price` field in the flight record (payment is handled against the accepted option/date-price selection).
attrs.rationale: Flight cost is part of the accepted option/date-price selection (FR-004, FR-005, FR-007); Screens 3 and 8 and the Assumptions repeat the exclusion.

nodes.title: Flight baggage field name normalised

attrs.statement: The system MUST normalise the flight API field to `baggage_allowance` (singular) for consistency.
attrs.rationale: The PRD marks the baggages_allowance spelling as an API naming discrepancy to resolve with the backend team.

nodes.title: Hotel submitter follows the travel path

attrs.statement: The system MUST allow the patient to submit hotel information in Path B or the provider to submit it in Path A only when hotel is included in the accepted option. It MUST reject mixed submitters for the same booking.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 1046 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Hotel check-out after check-in

attrs.statement: The system MUST validate that `check_out_date` is after `check_in_date`.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 1047 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Hotel transportation field is canonical for pickup notes

attrs.statement: The `transportation` field in the hotel record MUST be the canonical field for airport pickup and transfer coordination in MVP. When the hotel is marked Not needed, no transportation details are collected (accepted for MVP).
attrs.rationale: No separate transport form exists in MVP (Screens 4 and 9 notes, Hotel Records, Assumptions).

nodes.title: Itinerary is a read view per confirmed booking

attrs.statement: The system MUST assemble one active travel itinerary per confirmed booking/appointment as a read view from its TravelContext, the current passport, flight, and hotel records, and the Booking; the itinerary MUST NOT be stored as a separate record.
attrs.rationale: Itinerary Rules and Screen 5 purpose restate this; admin corrections refresh the relevant section automatically.

nodes.title: Itinerary visible to patient, provider and admin

attrs.statement: The system MUST display the itinerary to the patient, provider (for coordination), and admin.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 1053 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Travel record changes audit-logged

attrs.statement: The system MUST log all changes to travel records (who, when, what) for audit.
attrs.rationale: Itinerary Rules: all record submissions and admin corrections are logged (who, when, what).

nodes.title: Travel records locked on submission; admin corrections versioned

attrs.statement: Travel records (passport, flight, hotel) MUST be locked immediately after submission. The system MUST prevent any edit by the patient or provider post-submission. Admin corrections MUST write a new locked version, mark the previous as superseded, and log the correction with a mandatory reason.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Screen 1, 3, 4, 8 and 9 rules, Passport Rules, Flight Records and Alternative Flow A2. Admin correction on any tab writes a new locked version and marks the previous one superseded (Screen 12 tabs).

nodes.title: Travel path derived from the accepted option snapshot

attrs.statement: The binary travel path MUST be derived from `included_services` in the accepted FR-004 Quote Option snapshot carried by the FR-005 AcceptanceEvent, not selected by the provider in FR-008. `flight` or `hotel` (the FR-004 `accommodation` item type) yields `provider_included` (Path A); neither yields `patient_self_booked` (Path B), including transport-only options. FR-008 MUST persist the derived path and accepted inclusions in TravelContext at booking confirmation. Path A allows provider entry only for included flight/hotel services and never patient entry; Path B allows patient entry only and never provider entry. An omitted Path A flight/hotel service is "Not included" and is not collected in MVP. The reusable package preset and parent quote are not the authority for this choice. The FR-004 included_services checklist alone decides the path; option item names are display detail only.
attrs.rationale: Travel Path Determination: travel_path is not user-selectable; the provider edits option-level included_services in FR-004 and those changes stay within that quote. Transport-only inclusion remains Path B.

nodes.title: Provider travel status tracker follows included services

attrs.statement: For a Path A booking, the system MUST surface a travel status tracker on the provider's confirmed booking view covering passport, outbound flight, return flight, and hotel; entry actions MUST follow the accepted option's included services.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 1060 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Automatic travel request on Confirmed

attrs.statement: The system MUST automatically send the applicable travel request notification to the patient (in-app + email) once when the booking transitions to Confirmed after successful initial payment — no manual trigger required.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 1064 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Patient notified of provider entry and admin correction

attrs.statement: The system MUST notify the patient when the provider enters travel details on their behalf (Path A), and when admin applies a correction to any of their travel records.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 1065 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Provider notified of patient submission and admin correction

attrs.statement: The system MUST notify the provider when the patient submits passport or travel details, and when admin applies a correction to any travel record for their patient.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 1066 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Admin edits any travel record with audit entry

attrs.statement: Admin MUST be able to edit any travel record with a mandatory audit log entry.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 1071 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: One TravelContext per confirmed booking

attrs.statement: FR-008 MUST create or reuse exactly one TravelContext per confirmed FR-006 Booking, keyed by `booking_id`; passport, flight, and hotel records MUST link to that TravelContext rather than using a flat `quote_id` as their sole operational key.

nodes.title: TravelContext retains the accepted snapshot provenance

attrs.statement: TravelContext MUST retain the immutable AcceptanceEvent ID, accepted parent quote and subquote IDs/aggregate version, Quote Option ID, Option/Date-Price ID, accepted appointment date/time/timezone, accepted date range start and end, and included-service snapshot, all read from the FR-005 accepted snapshot. The accepted parent and subquote versions MUST match the same FR-004 aggregate `QuoteVersion`. FR-008 MUST NOT reselect or reconstruct a different package, date range, appointment, or price.
attrs.rationale: acceptedSubquoteVersion equals acceptedParentQuoteVersion because both refer to the same FR-004 parent aggregate revision (Travel Context and Booking Lifecycle).

nodes.title: No travel coordination before successful initial payment

attrs.statement: FR-008 MUST NOT create TravelContext or send initial travel requests on subquote acceptance, payment attempts, `Payment Window Expired`, or cancellation before successful initial payment. Repeated delivery of the confirmed-booking signal MUST NOT duplicate TravelContext or the initial request.
attrs.rationale: Business Rules 'Automated Trigger on Confirmed Booking' and acceptance scenarios 1 and 2: replayed confirmation events or retries never create a second TravelContext or a duplicate initial request.

nodes.title: Cancelled booking closes the TravelContext; date change flags review

attrs.statement: When a confirmed booking is cancelled, FR-008 MUST set the TravelContext to `closed` and close pending travel requests while retaining submitted travel records and audit history. When FR-006 confirms an admin-approved appointment change and sends its `booking.rescheduled` event (REQ-006-011), FR-008 MUST flag existing travel dates for audited revalidation; external travel is not automatically rebooked.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 1078 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Travel APIs resolve the booking server-side and reject overrides

attrs.statement: Travel record APIs MUST accept a confirmed `booking_id`, resolve TravelContext and acceptance provenance server-side, enforce the Path A / Path B submitter and inclusion rules, and reject client-supplied changes to accepted quote, subquote, option, date-price, path, or inclusion values. Travel record APIs and patient re-notification MUST also reject any write against a closed TravelContext.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 1079 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Only admin clears travel-date review

attrs.statement: Only an admin MAY clear `travel-date-review-required`, by confirming that the existing flight and hotel dates still fit the current booking appointment or by correcting the affected records. Either action MUST return the TravelContext to `active` and record the admin, time, reason and outcome in the audit log.

nodes.title: Early departure raises an acknowledged soft warning

attrs.statement: When a return flight departs, or the hotel check-out date falls, before the last treatment plan day (current booking appointment date plus the plan day count minus one), the system MUST show the submitter a soft warning that must be acknowledged before saving, MUST still allow the record to be saved, MUST record who acknowledged it and when, and MUST show the provider an early-departure flag on the booking. If a reschedule then leaves the return flight or the hotel check-out before the new last treatment plan day, the earlier acknowledgment is cleared and asked again.
attrs.rationale: Applies on Screens 3, 8 and 12 (return flight) and Screens 4, 9 and 12 (hotel check-out); the provider's status badge shows 'Leaves before last treatment day' with the time the submitter acknowledged the warning (Screen 6).

nodes.title: Provider-fault transfer carries travel records to the replacement booking

attrs.statement: When FR-006 Alternative Flow B5 transfers a patient to a replacement booking, the system MUST keep the original TravelContext closed with its records read-only; only when the replacement booking's travel path (A or B) matches the original's, MUST carry the passport record over to the replacement TravelContext as a new locked booking-linked record, MUST copy the current flight and hotel records to it with a copy-source reference and the flag "travel-date review required", MUST NOT request carried-over items from the patient again, and MUST set the replacement TravelContext to `travel-date-review-required` until an admin clears the review under REQ-008-030. When the paths differ, nothing is carried over or copied, the replacement TravelContext starts `active`, and the initial requests for its own path are sent. Each copied record (passport, flight, hotel) keeps its original submitter plus the copy-source reference; any correction to a copy goes through the admin. The carry-over also keeps any Not-needed marks, the no-travel declaration and an Incomplete passport mark as they were, and the admin travel record shows "carried over from the original booking" so an admin can review them.
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow B2: copied flight and hotel records show 'Travel-date review required' on the provider Travel section until admin clears it; admin confirms or corrects copied dates on Screens 11 and 12.

nodes.title: Itinerary has no stored record

attrs.statement: The itinerary MUST be a read view assembled from the TravelContext, the current passport, flight, and hotel records, and the Booking; no itinerary table or stored itinerary record MAY exist.

nodes.title: Automatic flight and hotel request at Confirmed (Path B)

attrs.statement: The system MUST automatically request flight and hotel details (no passport) from the patient once when the linked FR-006 booking becomes **Confirmed** and the accepted option snapshot yields Path B, except for items already carried over to a replacement booking under REQ-008-032. No provider or admin trigger is required.
attrs.rationale: Passport is not requested in Path B (Passport Rules).

nodes.title: Future phase: in-app flight search and booking

attrs.statement: The system SHOULD integrate a flight search API (e.g. Amadeus) to enable in-app flight booking in a future phase.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 1087 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Future phase: in-app hotel search and booking

attrs.statement: The system SHOULD integrate a hotel search API (e.g. Booking.com) to enable in-app hotel booking in a future phase.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 1088 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Future phase: commission tracking on platform bookings

attrs.statement: The system SHOULD support commission tracking on platform-facilitated bookings once API booking is live.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 1089 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Future phase: dedicated transport record

attrs.statement: The system SHOULD support a dedicated transport record entity when Hairline operates its own driver network.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 1090 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Future phase: real-time flight price estimates

attrs.statement: The system SHOULD display real-time flight price estimates during inquiry date selection once a flight API is integrated.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 1091 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: MVP is information capture and coordination only

attrs.statement: In MVP the platform MUST NOT support in-app flight or hotel booking, platform-managed transport, commission tracking, airport transport booking, travel price preview during inquiry date selection, or OCR/auto-extraction of travel data from patient screenshots. It facilitates information capture and coordination only: all flight and hotel bookings are completed outside the platform by the patient or the provider, and all travel details are entered manually.
attrs.rationale: PRD Executive Summary, Out of Scope (MVP) list and Assumptions. Airport transport is informational only through the hotel Transportation Details field.

nodes.title: Travel lives inside the confirmed booking detail screens

attrs.statement: Travel status, records and actions MUST be surfaced as a Travel section inside the confirmed booking detail screen of the provider (visible only once the booking is Confirmed) and of the admin (visible for every confirmed booking regardless of travel path). There MUST be no standalone travel dashboard or travel oversight screen; admin reaches a booking through the existing inquiry and booking management.
attrs.rationale: Entry points: the automated in-app prompt and email on Confirmed for the patient, and the Travel section of the booking detail screen for provider and admin (Multi-Tenant Architecture; Screens 6 and 11 placement). Conflicts with REQ-008-023 and SC-007 wording; recorded as a question.

nodes.title: Passport photo is a reference document only

attrs.statement: The passport photo MUST be stored in compliant secure storage as a reference document only. It MUST NOT be parsed or processed automatically, is viewable but not downloadable by the assigned provider and admin, and is not shown in any list, itinerary view or the patient's confirmation view. All passport fields are entered manually by the patient.
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 301, 303, 310, 486, 679 (checked against the PRD text).

nodes.title: Travel path fixed at booking confirmation

attrs.statement: The travel path MUST be fixed at booking confirmation: the derived path and the included-service snapshot are stored in the booking's TravelContext, and later package-library or quote changes MUST NOT reroute an existing booking. Neither the parent quote as a whole nor the reusable package preset determines the accepted travel choice.

nodes.title: Included travel items listed on the patient itinerary

attrs.statement: Included travel items of the accepted option (for example hotel, airport transfer, or another travel service such as a city tour) MUST be listed as Package Travel Items on the patient itinerary whenever they exist, in Path A or Path B, named from the accepted option's included-services list as saved with the TravelContext at confirmation. Services not included are shown as Not included and are not collected in MVP. The FR-004 included_services checklist supplies these labels; option item names are display detail only.
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 419, 794, 796 (checked against the PRD text).

nodes.title: Transport is provider-arranged and has no separate record

attrs.statement: Transport (airport pickup) MUST always be provider-arranged when included in the accepted option and MUST NOT be tracked as a separate record or form in MVP; it is captured through the Transportation Details notes of the hotel record. Providers may use those notes to plan clinic-side logistics such as verifying arrival times for pickup.
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 401, 406, 615, 801, 832 (checked against the PRD text).

nodes.title: Passport required for Path A only

attrs.statement: Passport submission MUST be required for every Path A appointment and MUST NOT be required or requested for Path B, where the patient manages their own passport for independent bookings. The passport submission screen is never shown for Path B.
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 299, 330, 815-816 (checked against the PRD text).

nodes.title: Invalid passport submission rejected, nothing stored

attrs.statement: A passport submission that fails validation (missing required fields, invalid dates, or failed photo quality check) MUST be rejected with field-level errors; no passport record is created or updated and the passport status remains Awaiting until a successful submission.
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 184-185, 193 (checked against the PRD text).

nodes.title: Passport photo quality gate before submission

attrs.statement: Before a passport photo can be submitted, the app MUST run an on-device quality check (lighting, focus, blur) and block submission with an actionable error (for example 'Too blurry - retake in better light') when it fails. The check is a quality gate only: no OCR or data extraction.
attrs.rationale: The PRD names Google ML Kit as the Flutter implementation; that is a technical choice and is not carried into the graph.

nodes.title: Passport data is PII, encrypted at rest and in transit

attrs.statement: Passport data (especially passport_number and passport_image) MUST be treated as PII under GDPR and data protection rules and MUST be encrypted at rest and in transit.
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 854, 1009 (checked against the PRD text).

nodes.title: Provider passport access logged and limited to assigned clinic

attrs.statement: Provider access to passport data MUST be logged (timestamp, provider user ID), and a provider MUST NOT be able to view passport data of patients not assigned to its clinic. The provider sees the passport number in full and the passport view is read-only; incorrect data is corrected by contacting admin. Once the TravelContext is closed (booking cancelled after confirmation, or closed by a provider-fault transfer) or the booking reaches Completed, the provider MUST lose access to the passport record; flight and hotel details stay read-only for that provider, and admins keep access.
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 490-493 (checked against the PRD text).

nodes.title: Earlier passport details reused through a new locked record

attrs.statement: If passport details were previously submitted for an earlier appointment, the passport request is still sent as usual. The patient either confirms the earlier details ("Use these details") or enters new ones ("Enter new details"), and the result is a new booking-linked locked record; the earlier record is not edited.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 305 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Edit of a submitted record is blocked and redirected to admin

attrs.statement: Once a passport, flight or hotel record is submitted, an attempt by the patient or provider to edit, delete or re-submit it MUST be blocked and the submitter MUST be shown a message that corrections are requested through admin. The provider has no edit or flag capability on a patient-submitted record and contacts admin when it looks incorrect. The exceptions are an admin soft-delete of a passport record, after which the patient may submit one new passport (REQ-008-076); an admin Incomplete mark on a submitted passport, after which the patient may submit one new passport that supersedes the earlier record (REQ-008-065); and an admin soft-delete of a flight or hotel record, after which its owner may enter one replacement (REQ-008-067).
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow A2; Screens 1, 3, 4, 6, 8, 9 and 10 rules.

nodes.title: At most two current flight records per booking

attrs.statement: A confirmed booking MUST have at most two current flight records (outbound and return); superseded admin-correction versions remain in history. Both legs use the same form and the leg type is set at creation.
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 822-823 (checked against the PRD text).

nodes.title: Round-trip legs are independent and presented sequentially

attrs.statement: A round trip MUST be two FlightRecord entries (outbound, return) linked to the same appointment. Each leg MUST be independent, so either may be missing (one-way, or return not yet confirmed). After the outbound leg is submitted the system prompts for the return leg, the form header labels the leg ('Outbound Flight' or 'Return Flight'), and the UI presents the legs as two sequential steps or two tabs.
attrs.rationale: Round-Trip rules, Screens 3 and 8, and the Assumption that round trip is the standard expectation.

nodes.title: At most one current hotel record per booking

attrs.statement: A confirmed booking MUST have at most one current hotel record in MVP (no multi-hotel or multi-city case); superseded admin-correction versions remain in history. Provider hotel entry is enabled only while no hotel record has been submitted for the appointment.
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 558, 830 (checked against the PRD text).

nodes.title: Itinerary sections show submitter, timestamp and pending state

attrs.statement: Each itinerary section MUST show the submission timestamp and the submitter (patient or provider). A pending item shows an 'Awaiting submission' state, and a submission link appears only when the patient owns that item (Path B, or the Path A passport). The passport section (full name, masked passport number, date of expiry) appears only for Path A, and in Path A the return flight section only if a return record exists. In Path B the outbound flight, return flight and hotel rows are always shown, as the record, Awaiting or Not needed.
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 420, 422, 429-430 (checked against the PRD text).

nodes.title: Record visibility limited to owner, assigned clinic and admin

attrs.statement: A patient MUST see only their own travel records; a provider MUST see only bookings assigned to its clinic and only the booking currently open (no cross-patient or cross-clinic access); admin sees all travel records without restriction.
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 427, 458, 617, 646 (checked against the PRD text).

nodes.title: No-travel declaration by a Path B patient

attrs.statement: On the travel requirement check (Path B only), the patient MUST state whether travel is needed. Yes leads to flight and then hotel submission. No MUST set the TravelContext travel_required flag to false (no_travel_required), stop further travel submission requests and the admin Re-notify action for the booking, skip the flight and hotel steps, and show the itinerary as 'No travel required'. The check is not shown for Path A.
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 330-332 (checked against the PRD text).

nodes.title: No-travel declaration reversed by admin only

attrs.statement: A patient MUST NOT be able to reverse a no-travel declaration and contacts admin instead. Admin MAY override no_travel_required from the Travel section and re-send the travel submission request. The declaration and any admin override MUST be recorded on the TravelContext with timestamp and actor ID. The provider MUST see "Patient declared no travel needed" on the Travel Details view and MUST be notified when the declaration is made or overridden.
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 333-335 (checked against the PRD text).

nodes.title: Admin re-notify limited to patient-owned pending items

attrs.statement: Admin 'Re-notify patient' MUST send a manual notification only for a patient-owned pending item: the passport in Path A (not yet submitted, or marked Incomplete), or flight or hotel in Path B unless the booking is marked no_travel_required or the item is marked Not needed. Provider-owned Path A flight and hotel items MUST NOT create patient submission notifications. There are no automatic reminders at MVP; after the initial request this admin action is the only follow-up.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 647 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Closed TravelContext is read-only; refunds are out of scope

attrs.statement: A closed TravelContext MUST reject new passport, flight and hotel records, patient re-notification and admin corrections; its records stay read-only with their audit history, and Enter Flight, Enter Hotel, Re-notify patient, Override no-travel declaration, Confirm Travel Dates and Apply Correction are not available. The patient itinerary is then read-only and shows no submission links. The original provider loses access to the passport record, while flight and hotel details stay read-only for them; admins keep access (REQ-008-050). Any external flight or hotel cancellation is coordinated outside the platform under the governing booking policy; FR-008 MUST NOT calculate refunds or cancellation fees.
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 431, 464, 650, 807 (checked against the PRD text).

nodes.title: Appointment change keeps the accepted baseline visible

attrs.statement: When an approved admin intervention changes the appointment date after confirmation and FR-006 sends its booking.rescheduled event (REQ-006-011), the system MUST preserve the immutable accepted appointment baseline, show the current booking appointment alongside it, and revalidate the existing flight and hotel dates before the itinerary is treated as current. Patients and providers see 'Travel dates under admin review' on the affected sections but cannot clear it. FR-008 MUST NOT automatically rebook external travel. A reschedule on a booking with no flight or hotel records starts no review. Submissions and edits stay allowed during a review, and the admin still confirms the dates.
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 431, 464, 808-809 (checked against the PRD text).

nodes.title: Treatment plan days stay relative

attrs.statement: Treatment plan days in the accepted option are relative days. FR-008 MUST NOT store them as calendar dates; it derives the last treatment plan day only to show the early-departure warning, and later FR-010 changes to the treatment plan, clinicians or grafts MUST NOT change the TravelContext or the accepted snapshot.

nodes.title: Provider status badges and entry actions follow path and inclusion

attrs.statement: The provider Travel section MUST show status badges for the passport (Path A only; Awaiting, Submitted or Incomplete), the outbound flight, the return flight and the hotel (Not included, Awaiting, Submitted or, in Path B, Not needed), updated in real time on submission and on admin correction, and MUST show the Awaiting states immediately when the booking becomes Confirmed. In Path A, View Passport appears, and Enter Flight and Enter Hotel appear only for included services that have not yet been submitted; services not included show 'Not included' with no entry action. In Path B only View Travel Details (read-only) is shown and the provider cannot enter or modify records. An item marked Not needed shows Not needed, not Awaiting.
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 449-452, 457, 459-460, 786 (checked against the PRD text).

nodes.title: Incomplete passport status is admin-managed

attrs.statement: 'Incomplete' MUST be a passport status set by an admin from the admin travel record screen, with a mandatory reason, when a submitted passport record is deemed unusable or incorrect. The patient MUST be notified, and the mark clears when the patient submits one new passport (which supersedes the earlier record) or when an admin correction is saved. Otherwise a locked record cannot be re-submitted, except after an admin soft-delete returns the passport to Awaiting (REQ-008-076).
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 462 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Admin corrections need a mandatory reason note

After a flight or hotel soft-delete the status returns to Awaiting and the item's owner (provider in Path A, patient in Path B) MAY enter one replacement, following the passport pattern (REQ-008-076); until then the item counts as not submitted. The owner of a soft-deleted flight or hotel record MUST receive a notice asking them to enter it again.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 767 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Overall Status of the travel record is worked out from the submitted items

attrs.statement: The system MUST work out the booking's Overall Status shown on the admin travel record screen as follows. Pending: nothing has been submitted. Partially submitted: some required items are in, or the passport is marked Incomplete by an admin. Complete: all required items are in and the passport is not marked Incomplete. Required items: in Path A, the passport plus each of the flight and the hotel that the accepted option includes; in Path B, the outbound flight, the return flight and the hotel, except any item marked Not needed. A booking marked no_travel_required is Complete. A soft-deleted flight or hotel record counts as not submitted until re-entered. When every required Path B item is marked Not needed, the Overall Status is Complete; this is separate from the no-travel declaration, which stays its own flag.
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 669, 768 (Screen 12 Overall Status badge and its derivation).

nodes.title: Admin sees whether the first automatic travel request was sent and when

The all-or-nothing no-travel declaration (REQ-008-058) stays.

attrs.statement: System MUST restrict admin impersonation of a provider team member to Super Admins and apply the FR-015 "Login as Provider" rules: reason (min 20 chars) and password re-authentication before start, persistent banner with End Session, write actions allowed except changing the user's password, login email, or payout/bank/financial settings, session start/end and every write action logged and attributed to the admin, and automatic end after 30 minutes of inactivity. attrs.rationale: Impersonation is blocked when the provider is Deactivated ("Login as Provider is not available for a deactivated provider."). attrs.statement: System MUST let only a Hairline admin hand the Owner role of a provider organization to another person (Rule 11). The new Owner MUST already be an active team member of that organization; the previous Owner becomes a Manager; the action requires a reason; and the new and the previous Owner are both notified by email. attrs.rationale: Rule 11 (Owner Handover): Only a Hairline admin can hand the Owner role of a provider organization to another person; no provider-side user can do it (Rule 2). The handover is one admin action, so the provider organization has exactly one Owner before and after it (Rule 1). The action requires a reason, is recorded in the FR-009 audit trail (Rule 4) and FR-015 Tab 8: Activity Log with the admin as actor, and the new and the previous Owner are notified by email.

nodes.title: Accepted snapshot is the only source of money and appointment data

attrs.statement: System MUST read price, currency, date range, appointment, and promotion only from the accepted snapshot reached through the booking's AcceptanceEvent, and MUST seed the case's treatment plan days, clinician set, and estimated graft count from the same snapshot; FR-010 MUST NOT read accepted data from live FR-004 records or edit the snapshot (Rule 14)
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary id kept verbatim. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 951.

nodes.title: FR-010 is the only path for post-acceptance treatment-detail changes

attrs.statement: System MUST make FR-010 the only path for post-acceptance changes to treatment plan days, clinician set, and estimated graft count (apart from the admin edit of the accepted quote, REQ-005-023, and the replacement-clinician rewrite when a team member leaves the case, REQ-010-123), blocked while the booking is `Accepted` and limited to the clinic (Owner, Manager, or Clinical Staff, from `Confirmed` until Check In) and admins (from `Confirmed` until the treatment ends); each change MUST require a reason, be audited with before/after values, notify the patient through the FR-030 `treatment.plan_changed` event, leave the accepted snapshot unchanged, and never change money fields (Rule 13; Alternative Flow A2)
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary id kept verbatim. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 952.

nodes.title: Plan days stored and displayed as relative day numbers only

attrs.statement: System MUST display and store treatment plan days as relative day numbers only, never as calendar dates (Rule 15)
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary id kept verbatim. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 953.

nodes.title: Treating provider never reassigned in FR-010

attrs.statement: System MUST NOT reassign the treating provider in FR-010; provider withdrawal, drop-out, or replacement after acceptance MUST be handed to the FR-006 Alternative Flow B5 provider-fault transfer before Check In, and to the FR-006 Alternative Flow B7 admin decision while In Progress (Rule 16; Alternative Flow B6)
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary id kept verbatim. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 954.

nodes.title: Admin Change Treatment Details screen from Confirmed until the treatment ends

attrs.statement: System MUST give admins the Change Treatment Details screen (Screen 9) for any booking from `Confirmed` until the treatment ends, with mandatory reason, a before and after confirmation step, a Treatment Detail Change record, an audit entry, and the `treatment.plan_changed` event; the clinic form follows the same rules but closes at Check In
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary id kept verbatim. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 955.

nodes.title: No manual setting of booking or case status in FR-010

attrs.statement: System MUST NOT let any user set a booking or case status by hand in FR-010; provider Cancel / Close Case requests and admin case closures resolve only through the FR-006 governed actions (change appointment, cancel booking before Check In, provider-fault transfer, the Screen 11 In Progress decision)
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary id kept verbatim. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 956.

nodes.title: Day-based progress synced to patient app and admin within 30 seconds

attrs.statement: System MUST sync day-based treatment progress (accepted Quote Option ID, current treatment day number, day description from the case's current treatment plan, seeded from that option's `QuoteOptionPlanDay` records in the accepted snapshot, and day status) to patient app and admin dashboard in real-time (within 30 seconds of provider update) for transparency into day-to-day treatment progress *(day statuses only — clinical notes are provider-only)*
attrs.rationale: Renumbered from the PRD id REQ-010-007A (ids are digits only). Renumbered from the PRD id REQ-010-007A (ids are digits only). Day statuses only; clinical notes stay provider-only. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 946.

nodes.title: Booking status moves Confirmed, In Progress, Aftercare, Completed with no skipping

attrs.statement: Booking status MUST transition through sequence: Confirmed → In Progress → Aftercare → Completed (no skipping stages). Exceptions: an admin may move an In Progress booking to Aftercare through the FR-006 Screen 11 decision (early close, Rule 17, or after a provider fault, Rule 12), an admin may cancel an In Progress booking through the same Screen 11 decision after a provider fault (Rule 12, Rule 16), and an admin may cancel the booking through the FR-006 Cancel Booking action before Check In.
attrs.rationale: Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 552.

nodes.title: Documentation starts only at Check In; record created at confirmation as Awaiting Check In

attrs.statement: Treatment documentation MUST be initiated by the "Check In" action from the Confirmed list (cannot pre-document treatments). The treatment record itself is created at booking confirmation (first successful payment) in status "Awaiting Check In", seeded from the accepted snapshot, so audited treatment-detail changes before Check In have a record to change
attrs.rationale: The record is created at booking confirmation, which the PRD places in the booking flow, so the rule also applies at the booking stage. The Check In gate itself is held by FR-006 REQ-006-043. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 553.

nodes.title: Timestamps recorded in UTC and shown in the provider's local timezone

attrs.statement: All timestamps (check-in, end of treatment) MUST be recorded in UTC and displayed in provider's local timezone
attrs.rationale: Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 556.

nodes.title: At most one treatment In Progress per patient

attrs.statement: System MUST allow at most one treatment In Progress per patient; the limit is enforced in the Check In rule, and a case with the `supportRequired` marker or Closed Early does not count as In Progress (Rule 3, Rule 7)
attrs.rationale: Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 558.

nodes.title: Plan days, clinician set and estimated graft count locked for providers after Check In and for everyone once the treatment ends

attrs.statement: Plan day descriptions, the assigned clinician set, and the estimated graft count are locked for providers once Check In is performed; locked for everyone while the booking is `Accepted`; changeable by the clinic from `Confirmed` until Check In and by an admin from `Confirmed` until the treatment ends (End Treatment saved or Closed Early), only through the treatment-detail change (Rule 13); from the end of the treatment they are locked for everyone and the actual graft count is the correction path (Rule 8)
attrs.rationale: Source link names the stakeholder item the product owner decision log (reports/2026-10-16/mtg002-quote-model-decisions-2026-10-16.md, items M2 and Q2) refines. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 559.

nodes.title: Each treatment day is a discrete record

attrs.statement: Each treatment day is a discrete record — day records are NEVER consolidated into a single multi-day record
attrs.rationale: Repeated by the Screen 4 business rule on day independence. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 560.

nodes.title: Only five day statuses are valid

attrs.statement: Valid day statuses are: Not started | In progress | Finished | Need caution/attention | Cancelled/Deferred. No other statuses are permitted.
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 and Screen 5 add that Pause is not a valid status and must not appear in the Status dropdown. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 561.

nodes.title: Provider Cancel or Close Case does not change status or trigger money actions

attrs.statement: The provider's Cancel / Close Case action does NOT auto-transition status or trigger financial actions. The admin resolves it only through FR-006 Screen 11 (early close without a fault, or provider-fault decision); no one sets a booking status by hand
attrs.rationale: Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 562.

nodes.title: Suspension or deactivation leaves In Progress cases In Progress with a support marker

attrs.statement: When a provider's suspension or deactivation becomes effective, System MUST leave that provider's In Progress cases In Progress with cause `ProviderSuspended` or `ProviderDeactivated` and an independent `supportRequired` marker, block further provider documentation, preserve clinical notes, photos, and head scan photo sets, and let an admin decide case by case through FR-006 Alternative Flow B7 (move the booking to Aftercare with an FR-011 aftercare reassignment, or cancel the booking), without restoring the provider's actions on reactivation (Alternative Flow B5; Rule 12; FR-015 A5/Screen 4). Provider-requested Cancel/Close Case (B4) remains a non-transitioning admin flag.
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary carries the stay-In-Progress reading; the former REQ-010-025 (cancel reading) is merged into this Rule. Also stated in Alternative Flow B5, Rule 12 and the suspended-mid-treatment edge case; the edge case adds that a later deactivation does not overwrite an earlier ProviderSuspended cause.

nodes.title: Post-acceptance treatment-detail changes only through FR-010, with reason and audit

attrs.statement: After subquote acceptance, FR-010 is the only path for changing the treatment plan days, the assigned clinician set, and the estimated graft count, apart from the admin edit of the accepted quote (REQ-005-023) and the replacement-clinician rewrite when a team member leaves the case (REQ-010-123); the rest of this rule governs the FR-010 path. No change is allowed while the booking is `Accepted` (unpaid); changes are allowed only from `Confirmed`. Only the clinic (Owner, Manager, or Clinical Staff, from `Confirmed` until Check In) or an admin (from `Confirmed` until the treatment ends) may make the change. Each change MUST record actor, role, reason, timestamp, and before/after values; MUST notify the patient through the FR-030 `treatment.plan_changed` event; MUST leave the accepted snapshot unchanged as the original record; and MUST NOT change price, currency, date range, appointment, or promotion (Alternative Flow A2). Admin changes use FR-010 Screen 9.
attrs.rationale: Restates REQ-010-027 with more detail (who may change, what is recorded); possible duplicate within this FR. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 564.

nodes.title: Money and appointment baseline read only from the accepted snapshot

attrs.statement: Price, currency, date range, accepted appointment baseline, and promotion are read only from the accepted snapshot, reached through the FR-006 booking's AcceptanceEvent. The operative procedure date (Check In gate and displays) is the current FR-006 booking appointment, which equals the snapshot appointment unless an approved FR-006 admin date change or an admin edit of the accepted quote's date range or appointment (REQ-005-023) applies. FR-010 never edits the snapshot or reads these values from live FR-004 records. The case's current treatment details are seeded from the same snapshot and then change only under Rule 13. An admin emergency edit changes only the appointment time on the same date and the booking notes, so it never moves the Check In date; date changes go through the FR-006 Change Appointment action (FR-006 Screen 8).
attrs.rationale: Restates REQ-010-026 and adds the operative procedure date; possible duplicate within this FR. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 565.

nodes.title: FR-010 never reassigns the treating provider; hand-off to FR-006 flows

attrs.statement: FR-010 never reassigns the treating provider. Provider withdrawal, drop-out, or replacement after acceptance and before Check In is handed to the FR-006 Alternative Flow B5 provider-fault transfer (Alternative Flow B6); after Check In it is handed to the FR-006 Alternative Flow B7 admin decision (move to Aftercare with an aftercare reassignment, or cancel), with no replacement acceptance. The B5 payment terms apply to the transfer: the patient is refunded in full everything paid, pays no cancellation fee, and the replacement booking takes a new payment.
attrs.rationale: Restates REQ-010-029 and adds the refund rules in FR-006 (Payment & Billing Rules: the refund ladder set in FR-029, or the provider-fault terms where the provider is at fault); possible duplicate within this FR. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 567.

nodes.title: Treatment documentation retention follows the system 10-year Rule

attrs.statement: Treatment documentation retention follows the system PRD, Platform-Wide Rules: One 10-year retention period
attrs.rationale: Pointer to REQ-SYS-002; the retention period is held once in the system PRD.

nodes.title: Documentation changes logged; no hard deletes

attrs.statement: All changes to treatment documentation MUST be logged with timestamp, user ID, and action type (create, update, status change, archive/soft-delete, restore). Hard deletes are forbidden for treatment documentation and associated media assets.
attrs.rationale: Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 575.

nodes.title: Treatment photos and notes are PHI and must follow data protection regulations

attrs.statement: Treatment photos and medical notes constitute Protected Health Information (PHI) and MUST comply with data protection regulations
attrs.rationale: Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 576.

nodes.title: Audit log retained 10 years minimum, immutable

attrs.statement: Audit log retention (10 years minimum, immutable)
attrs.rationale: Listed under Fixed in Codebase (Not Editable). Overlaps REQ-010-014 (immutable audit log). Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 592.

nodes.title: Admin can configure the documentation deadline and reminder timing

attrs.statement: Admin can configure the documentation completion deadline (default 24 hours, range 12-48 hours, counted from the moment the End Treatment gate is first met) and the first reminder timing (default 6 hours; range 1 hour up to the deadline minus 1 hour, so it is always earlier than the deadline; a value outside the range is rejected); reminders stop when the case is Closed Early or blocked
attrs.rationale: Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 597, 598.

nodes.title: Admin cannot disable required fields or bypass validation

attrs.statement: Fixed in codebase / configurable with restrictions: Admin cannot disable required fields or bypass validation rules (ensures data quality) Required fields for treatment completion (conclusion notes, prescription, advice, medication, actual graft count, final head scan photo set (V1))
attrs.rationale: Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 593, 599.

nodes.title: Photo upload limits are admin-configurable

attrs.statement: Photo upload limits (max number of photos, max file size) System enforces a reasonable per-case upload limit (configurable by admin). Upload interface shows current count and disables additional uploads when limit reached with a clear message. Treatment Photos (Before): Regular photos of patient's condition before procedure (JPG/PNG) (Max 10MB per file; JPG/PNG only; multiple uploads allowed)
attrs.rationale: Edge case on too many head scan photo sets: the upload interface shows the current count and disables further uploads at the limit. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 359, 586, 909.

nodes.title: Free-text clinical fields limited to 2000 characters

attrs.statement: Screen validation: Conclusion Notes: Max 2000 characters Prescription: Max 2000 characters Advice: Max 2000 characters Beginning Note: Max 2000 characters; auto-saved every 2 minutes Note: Max 2000 characters
attrs.rationale: Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 357, 404, 427, 428, 429.

nodes.title: Graft counts are whole numbers from 0 to 10000

attrs.statement: Screen validation: Actual Graft Count: Min 0, max 10000; compared against estimated count for reference Actual Graft Count: Min 0, max 10000; edit logged Estimated Graft Count: Whole number from 0 to 10000
attrs.rationale: Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 431, 497, 533.

nodes.title: FR-010 never initiates payment capture

attrs.statement: FR-010 MUST NOT initiate payment capture. Final payment collection is handled in FR-007 / P-03: Booking & Payment.
attrs.rationale: Restates REQ-010-021's second half; possible duplicate within this FR. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 603.

nodes.title: Completion timestamp used for billing reconciliation; shown on the admin dashboard

attrs.statement: Treatment completion timestamp is used for billing reconciliation and reporting; the completed treatment shows on the admin dashboard
attrs.rationale: Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 605.

nodes.title: Price, currency and promotion never change in FR-010

attrs.statement: Price, currency, and promotion are read from the accepted snapshot and never change in FR-010; neither treatment-detail changes nor treatment completion modify amounts (Rule 14).
attrs.rationale: Overlaps REQ-010-026 and Rule 14; possible duplicate within this FR. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 606.

nodes.title: No-Show: the booking stays Confirmed and any refund follows the FR-006 refund rules

attrs.statement: If a case is flagged as No-Show, the booking stays Confirmed and any refund follows the FR-006 refund rules.
attrs.rationale: The refund rules are owned by FR-006; this rule only states that the No-Show label changes no status.

nodes.title: Patient sees day statuses only; clinical notes are provider-only

attrs.statement: Patient sees day status badges only — provider clinical notes are NOT visible to the patient.
attrs.rationale: Repeated on Screen 2 (clinical notes for the day not visible) and Screen 5 (notes entered here are provider-only). Applies on screens SCR-010-01, SCR-010-02 and SCR-010-05. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 281.

nodes.title: Beginning note shown to the patient only if the provider entered it

attrs.statement: Beginning note is visible to the patient only if the provider has entered it; otherwise the section is hidden. Hidden if provider has not entered it; no placeholder shown
attrs.rationale: Applies on screen SCR-010-01. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 274, 282.

nodes.title: Patient sees the summary note and before/after photos after completion

attrs.statement: Views provider-authored treatment summary note after completion (high-level outcome, final graft count, treatment type) Accesses before/after photos uploaded by provider (after completion)
attrs.rationale: Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 36, 37.

nodes.title: Estimated graft count is shown for reference; actual count appears after End of Treatment

attrs.statement: Estimated graft count is shown for patient reference; actual graft count appears after End of Treatment.
attrs.rationale: Applies on screen SCR-010-01. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 283.

nodes.title: Patient screens are read-only; patient has no part in clinical documentation

attrs.statement: All fields are read-only; the patient cannot take any action on this screen. NOT involved in clinical documentation (no access to detailed medical notes, complications, or real-time clinical data during procedure)
attrs.rationale: Applies on screens SCR-010-01 and SCR-010-02. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 38, 284.

nodes.title: Admin sees all active treatments and their day progress in real time

attrs.statement: Admin real-time visibility into treatment progress across all active procedures (which day + day status + day description — for oversight) View all active treatments across all providers (real-time "In Progress" list with current day and status)
attrs.rationale: Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 51, 70.

nodes.title: Admin can view payment status for operational follow-up

attrs.statement: View payment status (outstanding balance / split pay) for operational follow-up (view only; no new screen part)
attrs.rationale: Module Scope, Admin Platform. View only; no screen field shows payment status.

nodes.title: Chat, video and live streaming of treatment are out of scope

attrs.statement: Real-time chat between patient and provider during treatment (patients are physically present) Video documentation of procedure (future enhancement) Live streaming of detailed treatment progress to third parties (e.g., patient's family) (future enhancement)
attrs.rationale: Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 74, 75, 76.

nodes.title: No SMS treatment alerts in the MVP

attrs.statement: SMS notifications to patient's emergency contact (handled by S-03: Notification Service configuration; no SMS treatment alerts are sent in MVP and this capability is reserved for a future phase once S-03 SMS support is enabled)
attrs.rationale: Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 77.

nodes.title: Entry points to treatment execution

attrs.statement: Entry points: Provider navigates to "Confirmed" section in Patient Management (Provider Platform dashboard) System opens the case detail page in tabbed view (tabs: Treatment Plan | Note | Book hotel & Book flight | In Progress) Provider can resume documentation for "In Progress" treatments from the "In Progress" section in Patient Management Provider can view completed and Closed Early treatments from the "Completed" section (read-only mode)
attrs.rationale: Screens SCR-010-03 and SCR-010-04 are the provider entry screens. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 83, 85, 91, 92.

nodes.title: Check In unavailable shows a generic reason; the admin sees the payment detail and can assist

attrs.statement: Check In is disabled with a generic reason that never shows payment detail when the procedure date is in the future in the appointment timezone (tooltip: "Cannot check in future appointments. Wait until procedure date."), when the booking has an outstanding balance or a Defaulted installment, when it carries the `supportRequired` marker, or when the patient has another treatment In Progress; the admin sees the payment detail and can assist per billing ops. Patient must complete payment through the booking/payment flow (FR-007) before treatment documentation can start. After the appointment date Check In stays available with the late Check In prompt (Alternative Flow A3).
attrs.rationale: The blocking condition itself is held by FR-006 REQ-006-043 (see cross-FR duplicates). Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 604, 911, 921.

nodes.title: Early arrival: provider confirms early Check In; original appointment time kept

attrs.statement: Provider clicks Check In; system detects early arrival and displays confirmation prompt Outcome: Treatment proceeds earlier than scheduled; original appointment time preserved in booking record
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow A1. The confirmation prompt text is in the flow step; the Outcome line is the second part. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 138, 143.

nodes.title: Treatment-detail change form validation

attrs.statement: Screen 9 validation: Current Treatment Plan Days: Days stay relative; no calendar dates; at least one day remains; days that already have a day status other than Not started cannot be removed Assigned Clinicians: At least one clinician remains; only clinicians on the treating provider's staff list Change Reason: Mandatory; 10 to 1000 characters Confirm Change: Enabled only when at least one value changed and the reason is valid
attrs.rationale: Estimated graft count range is held by the graft-count rule. The clinic form on Screen 4 follows the same rules. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 531, 532, 534, 537.

nodes.title: Admin treatment-detail change available from Confirmed until the treatment ends, never while Accepted, Expired or Cancelled

attrs.statement: The admin may use this screen from `Confirmed` until the treatment ends (End Treatment saved or the case Closed Early), including after Check In; it is never available while the booking is `Accepted`, `Payment Window Expired`, or `Cancelled`, nor once the treatment has ended; the actual graft count stays the correction path afterwards.
attrs.rationale: Applies on screen SCR-010-09. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 542.

nodes.title: Change saved only after the admin confirms the before and after summary

attrs.statement: The change is saved only after the admin confirms the before and after summary.
attrs.rationale: Applies on screen SCR-010-09. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 543.

nodes.title: Each saved change creates one Treatment Detail Change record and an audit entry

attrs.statement: Each saved change creates one Treatment Detail Change record (Entity 5) with actor, actor type, role, reason, timestamp, and before and after values, and adds an audit trail entry.
attrs.rationale: Applies on screen SCR-010-09. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 544.

nodes.title: Patient no-show: Report Issue Before Check In flags the case for the admin; booking stays Confirmed

attrs.statement: A provider reports a patient no-show with Report Issue Before Check In after trying to reach the patient (no fixed waiting time); the system flags the case for the admin on the dashboard, the booking stays Confirmed, and the admin decides case by case whether to rebook or cancel; any refund follows the FR-006 refund rules; No-Show stays an admin case label (Alternative Flow B1)
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow B1. The outcome states no financial penalty; the admin decides rebook or cancel.

nodes.title: Medical postponement: Report Issue Before Check In flags the case for the admin; booking stays Confirmed

attrs.statement: Provider does not click Check In; instead clicks Report Issue Before Check In, selects reason: Medical postponement; documents the condition and clearance requirements System notifies admin; the booking stays Confirmed. The admin reschedules through the FR-006 Change Appointment action (FR-006 Screen 8) with no financial penalty, or cancels through the FR-006 Cancel Booking action (FR-006 Screen 9). Note: 'Postponed' is an admin-managed case label, not a system-defined booking pipeline status
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow B2. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 189, 190.

nodes.title: Interrupted treatment: reason in day note; case stays In Progress until admin acts

attrs.statement: Provider documents the interruption reason in the affected day's note field. If treatment can resume, the day stays In progress and the provider sets Finished when complete (Need caution/attention is a final status that counts as finished, not a pause). If it cannot, the provider sets the day to Cancelled/Deferred, clicks Cancel/Close Case, and documents the reason; the system flags the case for the admin on the dashboard and the case stays In Progress until the admin acts. The admin lets the case resume later, changes treatment details through Screen 9, or closes the case early on FR-006 Screen 11 with no provider fault (Alternative Flow B4); the refund is set by the admin on that screen
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow B3. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 201, 204, 205.

nodes.title: Provider closes an In Progress case with a reason; the admin sees a dashboard flag and closes it early on FR-006 Screen 11

attrs.statement: A provider close request on an In Progress case flags the case for the admin on the dashboard with reason and note; the case stays In Progress until the admin closes it early on FR-006 Screen 11 without a fault, or resolves a provider fault through the Screen 11 decision (Rule 17, Alternative Flow B4)
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow B4. Closure is resolved through the FR-006 Screen 11 early close or the In-Progress provider-fault decision. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 216, 217.

nodes.title: Provider documentation blocked and records read-only after a provider status cascade

attrs.statement: Provider documentation actions (day edits, End Treatment) are blocked; day records, clinical notes, photos, and head scan photo sets are retained read-only. Patient/admin notifications per FR-015 Screen 4 and FR-030; the patient is told an admin will contact them about the next step
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow B5; overlaps Rule 12, possible duplicate within this FR. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 231, 232.

nodes.title: Provider fault before Check In: documentation blocked, records retained read-only

attrs.statement: FR-006 cancels the booking with cause ProviderFault; provider documentation on this case is blocked; day records, notes, photos, and head scan photo sets are retained read-only
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow B6. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 246.

nodes.title: Replacement booking reads money and seeds treatment details from the replacement acceptance

attrs.statement: Patient and admin are notified through FR-006 Alternative Flow B5 (booking.provider_fault_replacement); the replacement provider learns through quote.accepted and the patient receives booking.scheduled; the replacement booking follows the FR-006 main flow; its FR-010 case reads its money fields and seeds its treatment details from the replacement acceptance snapshot
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow B6. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 248.

nodes.title: Saved End of Treatment is final for the provider; adjustments go through admin and FR-011

attrs.statement: Once saved, the provider cannot return to edit In Progress documentation — an audit snapshot is captured. Provider cannot edit completed treatment record; aftercare template selection and plan activation are handled entirely by FR-011. If adjustments are needed, provider contacts admin; admin can modify the aftercare plan through FR-011's admin interface; audit trail logs admin intervention.
attrs.rationale: Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 442, 932.

nodes.title: Actual graft count is the definitive record; estimates preserved

attrs.statement: Actual graft count is the definitive record; the current estimated graft count, and the original estimate in the accepted snapshot, are preserved for reference and audit.
attrs.rationale: Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 443.

nodes.title: Completion blocked until the final head scan is stored; photos queue when storage is down

attrs.statement: Media files (head scan photo sets and treatment photos) queued locally on provider device with status "Pending Upload"; background process retries upload every 5 minutes; provider sees upload progress indicator; treatment completion blocked until all required uploads (final head scan photo set) are successfully stored — optional treatment photos may remain queued without blocking completion. Error handling: If upload fails, photos queued locally; retry with exponential backoff; provider notified of pending uploads
attrs.rationale: Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 757, 917.

nodes.title: If the FR-011 signal fails, the treatment stays complete, the booking stays in Aftercare, and the admin retries the signal

attrs.statement: If the signal to FR-011 fails, the treatment is still marked complete in FR-010 and FR-006 still moves the booking to Aftercare; the admin dashboard shows a failed-signal flag and the admin action is a retry of the signal (Rule 18, Integration 4)
attrs.rationale: Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 767.

nodes.title: Admin may edit treatment documentation except snapshot, money fields and provider

attrs.statement: Admin has full edit access to treatment documentation fields as confirmed in client requirements, except the accepted snapshot, the money fields read from it (price, currency, date range, appointment, promotion), and the treating provider, which are read-only in FR-010.
attrs.rationale: Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 507.

nodes.title: Admin edits logged with admin identity and a reason

attrs.statement: All edits by admin are logged in the audit trail with timestamp and admin identity; admin MUST provide a reason for each edit (stored alongside before/after values).
attrs.rationale: Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 510.

nodes.title: Admin can trigger End Treatment on behalf of the provider

attrs.statement: Admin can trigger End Treatment on behalf of a provider only when the End Treatment gate is met (REQ-010-104) and the booking carries no `supportRequired` marker (Rule 12); the End of Treatment modal collects the same required fields as Screen 6.
attrs.rationale: Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 513.

nodes.title: Admin may correct provider clinical notes for legal or compliance reasons, always logged

attrs.statement: Editing provider clinical notes by admin is permitted for legal or compliance corrections and is always logged.
attrs.rationale: Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 515.

nodes.title: Admin remove means archive or soft-delete only, restorable

attrs.statement: Admin “remove” actions are archive/soft-delete only (no hard delete) for treatment documentation or media assets; archived items remain retained per policy and are restorable.
attrs.rationale: Overlaps the hard-delete ban in the Audit Rule; possible duplicate within this FR. Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 516.

nodes.title: Cancellation and early close run through FR-006 actions; no automatic financial resolution

attrs.statement: Case cancellation before Check In is performed by an admin through the FR-006 Cancel Booking action; an In Progress case is closed early through FR-006 Screen 11 (Rule 17). Financial reconciliation follows the refund rules in FR-006 (Payment & Billing Rules: the refund ladder set in FR-029, or the provider-fault terms where the provider is at fault) and the platform does not perform automatic financial resolution.
attrs.rationale: Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 514.

nodes.title: Auto-saved state restored when the provider reopens the record

attrs.statement: Auto-save mechanism persists all field changes every 2 minutes to server; when provider re-opens treatment record, last auto-saved state restored; provider can continue from where they left off.
attrs.rationale: Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 913.

nodes.title: Optimistic locking: second saver is warned before overwriting

attrs.statement: System implements optimistic locking: first provider to save changes succeeds; second provider receives warning "Another user has modified this treatment record. Reload to see latest version?" with option to review changes before overwriting.
attrs.rationale: Archived FR-010 PRD baseline, lines 915.

nodes.title: Reminders at the reminder-timing setting and the completion deadline; admin dashboard flags Overdue Documentation
