attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 824. Security Considerations, Audit trail (business rule promoted from the technical section).

nodes.title: Simultaneous sends keep message order; idempotent

attrs.statement: Maintain message ordering and idempotency safeguards; admin emergency messages sorted chronologically with patient/provider messages.
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 923. Edge Cases, Simultaneous sends.

nodes.title: Admin can edit keyword flags and the post-intervention flag switch

attrs.statement: Configure moderation rules and automatic keyword flags; maintain compliance audit trail; Keyword/phrase flags that trigger moderation or escalation cues, and the post-intervention flag switch (default on), in the Moderation settings group on Screen 5; the keyword list starts empty and the admin team fills it before go-live.
attrs.rationale: prd.md Admin scope; Admin Editability, Editable by Admin. Notification preferences and quiet hours moved to FR-030. The emergency reason options are a fixed list of three (REQ-012-106).

nodes.title: Fixed in the codebase, not admin-editable

attrs.statement: Cryptographic standards and security controls; Read receipt semantics and audit logging requirements; Minimum retention periods mandated by compliance; Attachment type and size limits: Images (JPG/PNG max 5MB), Video (MP4 max 10MB), PDF (max 10MB); Maximum number of attachments per message (5); Emergency intervention reasons: the fixed list Policy Violation / Urgent Dispute / Patient Safety.
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 632, 633, 634, 635, 636. Admin Editability, Fixed in Codebase. The 2000-character limit of that list sits in its own rule.

nodes.title: Configurable only within restrictions: escalation routing, intervention permissions, export controls (future phase)

attrs.statement: Escalation routing rules (allowed destinations/roles only); Future phase: Conversation export controls (admin conversation export is deferred); Emergency intervention permissions (restricted to authorized admin roles only).
attrs.rationale: prd.md Admin Editability, Configurable with Restrictions.

nodes.title: Chat screens offer a machine-translation switch

attrs.statement: Patient and provider chat screens MUST offer an on/off switch for machine translation of messages for the reader. The switch is shown and works only while the platform-wide translation switch (FR-021) is on. The translation behavior itself is owned by FR-021; this module owns only the switch in the conversation thread.
attrs.rationale: prd.md Screens 2 and 4, Translation switch. Added 2026-11-20.

nodes.title: Conversation status is calculated from its flags

attrs.statement: Conversation status MUST be calculated from the conversation's flags, with no manual control: Escalated while a flag is escalated_to_intervention (the admin has enabled emergency intervention on Screen 6B and has not yet sent or cancelled); Resolved only when the conversation has at least one flag and all its flags are closed (resolved or intervention_completed); otherwise Active, which covers a conversation with no flag and one with any open flag that is not under intervention. Enabling emergency intervention is the step that sets the flags to escalated_to_intervention; cancelling Screen 6B puts the flags back as they were. While an emergency intervention session is open the conversation shows Escalated whether or not it has a flag; with no flag, the audit entries are the record of the session.
attrs.rationale: prd.md Functional Requirements Summary and Key Entities, Conversation. Added 2026-11-20.

nodes.title: Eligible patients submit reviews with ratings, feedback and photos

attrs.statement: System MUST allow eligible patients, those with a treatment case marked Completed in FR-010 (not Closed Early or Cancelled), to submit reviews (overall + categories, feedback, optional photos).
attrs.rationale: Restated by the Executive Summary, Main Flow steps 1 and 2 and Screen 1. General Module Rules: "Eligibility check required: only patients with a completed procedure may review."

nodes.title: Review needs 3 months since the case was marked Completed; at most two reviews per case

attrs.statement: System MUST enforce time gating (≥ 3 months counted from the day the case was marked Completed) and one published review per treatment case. After a removal (approved takedown or admin policy removal) the patient MAY submit one further review for the case; a case has at most two reviews in total, so once the further review is removed the case cannot be reviewed again. Removed reviews are kept in the archive and are never restored.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Module Scope, Entry Points, Main Flow prerequisites and General Module Rules ("Time gating: review invitation and entry allowed ≥ 3 months post-procedure."). Change Log 1.13 records the 3-month gate as a product-owner additional requirement that needs no client-transcription evidence.

nodes.title: Reviews publish immediately; no pre-publication moderation

attrs.statement: System MUST publish reviews immediately upon patient submission (no pre-publication moderation gate).
attrs.rationale: Restated by the Executive Summary, the Main Flow outcome, Screen 1 rules ("The save action persists the current review payload and immediately publishes valid patient submissions.") and Screen 2 rules (Submitted is not a review status in V1). Change Log 1.2 records the removal of the moderation gate.

nodes.title: Patient submitted-review list and review detail across cases

attrs.statement: System MUST provide patient submitted-review list and review-detail views across treatment cases.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 rule: "Includes all submitted reviews for the logged-in patient across all completed treatment cases." Screens 2 and 3.

nodes.title: Patient takedown request flow; no direct patient deletion

attrs.statement: System MUST provide patient takedown request flow (submit -> pending -> admin decision -> notification), and MUST NOT allow direct patient deletion of submitted reviews.
attrs.rationale: Restated by the Executive Summary, Module Scope, Screen 3 ("Patient cannot directly delete a submitted review."), General Module Rules ("Patient cannot directly delete submitted reviews; takedown requires admin decision workflow.") and workflows A3 and A4.

nodes.title: Published reviews shown on patient-facing provider surfaces

attrs.statement: System MUST display published reviews on patient-facing provider/clinic profile and offer-evaluation surfaces with ratings summary, review list, provider responses, public-safe media, and `Verified Off-platform` markers when applicable.
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 rules: the embedded section uses the same review data model as patient-submitted reviews, provider responses and admin management; admin-seeded reviews display the Verified Off-platform marker; the provider response displays with the review when available.

nodes.title: Admin inserts, edits, removes reviews and decides takedowns with audit

attrs.statement: System MUST provide admin capabilities to insert authenticated reviews, edit existing reviews, remove reviews, and process takedown requests with full audit trail.
attrs.rationale: Restated by the Admin Platform scope, workflows A1, A2 and A4, and Screens 8 and 9.

nodes.title: Provider average rating, count and distribution calculated

attrs.statement: System MUST calculate and display provider average rating, count, and distribution over Published or Flagged reviews, including admin-seeded `Verified Off-platform` reviews.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Screen 5 (Ratings summary: average rating, count, distribution), Screen 4 (rating summary teaser, cached summary allowed) and Main Flow step 3. Scalability Considerations: caching of ratings summary and distribution per provider (technical, not migrated).

nodes.title: Provider list, filter and detail screens across treatment cases

attrs.statement: System MUST provide provider-side list/filter/detail screens across treatment cases, including search by reviewer alias and filtering by treatment, rating, date, response status, and source type.
attrs.rationale: Restated by the Provider Platform scope and Screens 5 and 6. The filter criteria themselves are owned by FR-022 (REQ-022-092, REQ-022-042).

nodes.title: Reviews linked to patient, provider and completed procedure

attrs.statement: System MUST link reviews to patient, provider, and completed procedure records.
attrs.rationale: Key Entities Review links (patient, procedure, provider, treatment_id) and Data Dependencies (completed procedure records with completion date and provider association).

nodes.title: Review photos stored and retrieved securely with metadata

attrs.statement: System MUST securely store and retrieve review photos with metadata.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Shared Services (S-05 handles secure photo storage and retrieval) and Screen 1 Photos. Media handling in Implementation Notes (thumbnails, access protection) is technical and not migrated.

nodes.title: Takedown request records persisted with decision data

attrs.statement: System MUST persist takedown request records including reason, status, decision note, requester, decider, and timestamps.
attrs.rationale: Key Entities TakedownRequest; workflows A3 and A4.

nodes.title: One canonical review schema across Patient, Provider and Admin

attrs.statement: System MUST preserve a single canonical review schema across Patient, Provider, and Admin platforms (`overall_rating`, `facility_rating`, `staff_rating`, `results_rating`, `value_rating`, `feedback_text`, `photos[]`, plus read-only clinic/treatment context fields).
attrs.rationale: Screen 9 note: "Admin tooling must read/write the same canonical review schema as patient/provider surfaces to prevent cross-tenant drift." Screen 4 context note says the embedded section connects to the same review data model.

nodes.title: Reviewer identity always aliased; no PII in public views

attrs.statement: System MUST always alias reviewer identity and prevent exposure of PII in public views.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Data & Privacy Rules ("Patient display name is always the alias; see canonical reviewer alias algorithm below."), Screen 4 ("Always the alias; no PII exposure") and the reviewer alias rows of Screens 5 and 6 (no PII exposure). Algorithm: see the reviewer alias rule.

nodes.title: Review data and photos encrypted; auditable logs

attrs.statement: System MUST encrypt review data and photos in transit and at rest and maintain auditable logs.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Security Considerations (encrypt data in transit and at rest; signed URLs for media; full audit trail for all state changes). The mechanics are technical and not migrated.

nodes.title: Unpublish and archive for compliance removals and takedowns

attrs.statement: System MUST support unpublish + archival for compliance removals and approved takedown requests; an admin removal of a review also closes any Pending takedown request on it as Approved, decided by the removing admin at the removal time with the removal reason as its decision note (audited as the `remove` action with the takedown request id; the patient gets the removal notice only). A removal or approved takedown clears any flag reason, and a Removed review is read-only for admins. There is no Restore action.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Screen 8 ("Removed reviews are unpublished + archived (not hard deleted)."), Screen 9 ("Approve decision: review unpublished + archived."), Security Considerations (soft-delete (unpublish) for takedowns) and the approved-takedown edge case.

nodes.title: Review events raise notifications; delivery follows FR-020 and FR-030

attrs.statement: The review module raises a notification on each of these events: new published review, provider reply, admin removal of a review (to the reviewing patient), admin removal of a provider response (event `review.response_removed`, raised by this module, to the provider with the reason), takedown decision, review edited by the patient (to the provider, informational only), review edited by an admin (to the reviewing patient), takedown requested (to admins), and takedown overdue (to admins). Notices that would go to the placeholder patient of an admin-seeded review are not sent. The invitation fires on the eligibility date (3 months after the treatment case was marked Completed in FR-010) and reminder timing counts from that date; reminder cadence is owned by FR-030. Delivery, recipients, content and opt-out follow the notification-service Rule in FR-020 and the FR-030 notification catalogue.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Main Flow step 4(d), workflows A3 step 4, A4 step 4 and B1 outcome, the Provider Platform scope (receive notification on new published reviews) and Shared Services. Invite and reminder timing is owned by FR-030; delivery, recipients, content and opt-out are owned by FR-020 and the FR-030 catalogue.

nodes.title: Ratings summary endpoints for provider profiles with caching

attrs.statement: System MUST provide ratings summary endpoints for provider profiles with caching.
attrs.rationale: Screen 4: rating summary teaser is read-only and a cached summary is allowed. Scalability Considerations: caching of ratings summary and distribution per provider.

nodes.title: Patient review detail shows response, removal reason, edit flow

attrs.statement: Patient Review Detail MUST display provider response (when available), admin removal reason (when removed), and support pre-filled edit flow for published reviews.
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 rules: "`Edit Review` opens pre-filled form fields; saved edits are published immediately (no moderation gate)."

nodes.title: Takedown modal with required reason and 10-year retention notice

attrs.statement: Takedown request submission MUST use a confirmation modal/bottom-sheet with required patient reason and explicit 10-year retention-policy notice before submission.
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 rules: the takedown request is submitted from a bottom sheet/modal with required reason and mandatory retention-policy notice. The notice text is display-only policy text: "Review content will be removed from public view but archived for 10 years. Audit records of this takedown are kept for the same 10 years." Change Log 1.14 makes the reason required.

nodes.title: Provider inline response composer with validation and cancel

attrs.statement: Provider Review Detail MUST include a documented inline response-composer model/state (not separate screen navigation) with validation, cancel/confirm behavior, and immutable post-publish response rendering.
attrs.rationale: Screen 6 rules: the composer is an inline state of the screen, not a separate navigation screen; Cancel response asks for confirmation if unsaved content exists; Submit response is enabled only when validation passes.

nodes.title: Admin review settings and restricted export; cadence owned by FR-030

attrs.statement: Admin Review Settings MUST support review category labels, photo guidelines, removal reason catalog, restricted flagging/SLA settings, and RBAC-restricted export actions with audit logging. Reviewer identity is always shown as the alias, so there is no display-policy setting. Review reminder cadence is owned by FR-030 (Notification Rules & Configuration); Screen 10 provides link-outs only.
attrs.rationale: Screen 10 and its rules. Change Logs 1.12 and 1.14 move invitation and reminder cadence to FR-030 and leave Screen 10 with read-only link-outs.

nodes.title: Per-treatment sub-scores endpoint for FR-014 (PRD id REQ-013-018a)

attrs.statement: System MUST additionally expose a per-treatment aggregated sub-scores endpoint that returns, for a given provider, `{treatment_id → {avg_overall, avg_facility, avg_staff, avg_results, avg_value, review_count, distribution}}` over Published or Flagged reviews only. This endpoint is the data contract consumed by FR-014 "review sub-scores per treatment" analytics; cache invalidation MUST be triggered on every change of a review's visibility or rating (publish, edit republish, admin add, admin edit of a rating, removal, unpublish from flag resolution, and approved takedown).
attrs.rationale: Renumbered from REQ-013-018a because Rule ids carry digits only. Change Log 1.13 item 4; Dependencies FR-014.

nodes.title: Entry points to reviews, takedown requests and review settings

attrs.statement: The review invitation fires on the eligibility date (3 months after the treatment case was marked Completed in FR-010) and triggers the review flow; reminders count from that date. Patient navigates to “Write a Review” from provider history. Patient views published reviews from provider profile/offer evaluation surfaces. Patient navigates to “Submitted Reviews” to view review history and request takedown from detail page. Providers access “Reviews” in dashboard to list/filter/detail reviews and respond. Admins access “Review Management”, “Takedown Requests”, and “Review Settings” from Admin platform navigation.
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 56, 57.

nodes.title: Submission validated; ineligible attempts blocked with clear messaging

attrs.statement: System validates inputs (rating ranges, feedback length, file type/size) and verifies eligibility. Ineligible attempts (too early, case not marked Completed, or both reviews of the case already used) are blocked with clear messaging; the submission screen says no more reviews can be submitted for the case.
attrs.rationale: Main Flow step 2 and the Edge Cases list. Rating ranges and lengths are in the rating and feedback rule; file limits in the photo rule.

nodes.title: Overall and four category ratings required; feedback 100-2000 characters

attrs.statement: Overall rating and the four category ratings (facility, staff, results, value) are required integers 1-5. Feedback is required and must be 100-2000 characters.
attrs.rationale: Composed from the Screen 1 data field table (Overall, Facility, Staff, Results, Value Rating, Feedback). Screen 1 notes: the 100-character minimum ensures reviews contain enough substance to be useful to other patients; the 2000-character ceiling deters off-topic walls of text and reduces spam/abuse surface area without truncating genuine narrative experience. Rating rows use a row-select interaction pattern (tap row to set/update score) and display selected values in X/5 star format.

nodes.title: Eligibility logic, text lengths and rating scale fixed in code

attrs.statement: Fixed in Codebase (Not Editable): Eligibility logic requires a case marked Completed and the time threshold. Minimum and maximum lengths for text fields and rating scale bounds.
attrs.rationale: Admin Editability Rules, Fixed in Codebase list. Statement is the two list items verbatim under the list heading.

nodes.title: Review photos optional, up to 5 files; over-limit uploads prevented

attrs.statement: Photos are optional: up to 5 files, jpg/png, max 10MB each. Photos exceed limits: user informed, upload prevented until compliant.
attrs.rationale: Composed from the Screen 1 Photos row (Up to 5 files; jpg/png; max 10MB each) and the Edge Cases line (Photos exceed limits: user informed, upload prevented until compliant.).

nodes.title: Photo guidelines shown; display policies and removal right disclosed

attrs.statement: Clear photo guidelines; sensitive/identifying content discouraged. Disclose display policies and admin's right to remove for violations.
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 business rule and notes. The guideline text is the admin setting photo guidelines text.

nodes.title: Patient may edit a published review at any time; edits publish immediately

attrs.statement: Patient can edit their published review at any time except while a takedown request on it is `Pending`. `Edit Review` opens pre-filled form fields; saved edits are published immediately (no moderation gate).
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 rule ("One review per completed procedure; patient can edit their published review at any time.") and Screen 3 rule (`Edit Review` opens pre-filled form fields; saved edits are published immediately (no moderation gate).). Edit availability by status is in the Screen 3 actions rule.

nodes.title: Publish and edit republish recalculate provider rating metrics

attrs.statement: System publishes (or republishes, on edit) the review immediately and recalculates provider rating metrics (average, count, distribution) with associated cache invalidation. Recalculation applies whether the action is an initial submission or an edit to an already-published review, and, under the same rule, to every other change of a review's visibility or rating (REQ-013-031): admin add, admin edit of a rating, admin removal, unpublish from flag resolution, and approved takedown. Published and Flagged reviews count in the aggregates, so setting or clearing a flag needs no recalculation. Admin-seeded reviews count in the average and distribution and are labelled Verified Off-platform.
attrs.rationale: Main Flow step 3. The takedown decision rule repeats the recalculation on approval.

nodes.title: Patient edit re-runs flagging, tracks edits, audits and notifies provider

attrs.statement: On edit (republish), system also: (a) re-runs B2 automated flagging (keyword/duplicate/rate-limit checks) against the new payload, including a comparison with the last admin redaction so an edit cannot restore redacted content, (b) sets `last_edited_at` and increments `edit_count`, (c) writes a full audit record (before/after values, actor=patient), and (d) notifies the provider, for information only, that a review they may have responded to was edited; the provider has no action on the notice because responses are immutable (REQ-013-055).
attrs.rationale: Main Flow step 4 (Change Log 1.13 item 5). last_edited_at and edit_count are calculated by this rule.

nodes.title: Edited reviews show an Edited relative-time marker on public surfaces

attrs.statement: Edited reviews (patient or admin edit) surface an "Edited {relative_time}" marker on all public surfaces (Patient list, Patient detail, Provider list/detail, Provider Profile Reviews Section) so readers can distinguish current content from the original publish. An admin edit sets the marker but does not change the edit count, which counts patient edits.
attrs.rationale: Main Flow step 5, second sentence.

nodes.title: Patient sees confirmation; review live and listed

attrs.statement: Patient sees confirmation; review is live on provider profile and appears in Patient “Submitted Reviews” list. If the submission or edit matches a flagging rule, the review is also queued as B2.
attrs.rationale: Main Flow step 5, first sentence.

nodes.title: Admin-seeded reviews flagged Verified Off-platform and published directly by admin

attrs.statement: Admin-imported authenticated reviews must be flagged as "Verified Off‑platform" with verification source and date. These are published directly by admin (no patient submission flow). Each is linked to a placeholder patient and a placeholder procedure. They count in the provider average and distribution.
attrs.rationale: Admin-Seeded Review Policy. Restated by workflow A1 (step 2: System validates fields and stores source provenance; step 3: System publishes review flagged as "Verified Off-platform"; outcome: seeded review with explicit provenance marker and full audit record), Screen 8 rules (Admin-seeded reviews must be flagged as "Verified Off-platform" with verification provenance) and Screen 4 rules (Admin-seeded reviews must display the Verified Off-platform marker).

nodes.title: Admin-seeded review needs complete source verification metadata

attrs.statement: Admin-seeded reviews require structured `source_metadata`; all required sub-fields must be provided. Source platform is one of Google, Trustpilot, Doctolify, Provider Website, Email Testimonial, Other, and "Other" requires a free-text platform name. Source URL must be a valid URL and is required unless `source_platform` = Email Testimonial. Evidence files: 1-5 files, jpg/png/pdf, max 10MB each, stored via S-05. Capture date is an ISO date and not in the future.
attrs.rationale: Composed from the Screen 8 Source verification group rows (Source platform, Source URL, Evidence file(s), Capture date). Change Log 1.13 item 2 introduces the structured source_metadata payload, persisted to Review.source_metadata.

nodes.title: Seeded review needs a permission record and admin attestation

attrs.statement: Admin-seeded reviews require a permission record: either a file upload or a text reference, plus a mandatory admin attestation checkbox confirming consent was obtained. The reviewer display name is admin-entered, PII-safe, with no full last name and no contact info.
attrs.rationale: Composed from the Screen 8 rows Permission record and Reviewer display name. The alias and display-name policy is in the reviewer alias rule.

nodes.title: Admin add, edit and remove record identity, time, reason and before/after

attrs.statement: Every admin add/edit/remove action records admin identity, timestamp, reason, and before/after changes. Audit records of patient edits and provider responses use the same entity, with an actor type and actor id.
attrs.rationale: Screen 8 rule. Restated by workflow A2 step 2 (System records before/after values, reason, and admin identity.).

nodes.title: Admin edit and remove need a reason; removal reason at least 10 characters

attrs.statement: Insert authenticated reviews and edit/remove existing reviews with mandatory reasons. These actions stay available for a provider of any status, including a Deactivated provider, because reviews are retained. Removal reason must be at least 10 characters.
attrs.rationale: Admin Editability Rules, Editable by Admin list, plus the Screen 8 rows Edit fields (Reason required for edit), Remove review (Removal reason min 10 chars) and Removal/edit reason (Reason catalog plus optional details; required for edit/remove). The insert case is covered by the source verification rules, which the PRD calls the provenance inputs.

nodes.title: Review status labels Published and Removed; takedown state shown separately

attrs.statement: Review status badge uses app-facing labels: `Published`, `Removed`. A review with status `Flagged` stays publicly visible and shows as `Published` to the patient. `Submitted` is not a review status in V1; successful review submission immediately creates a `Published` review. Takedown request state is displayed separately from review status when applicable (`Pending`, `Approved`, `Rejected`), for the latest request only; earlier requests stay in the admin history. `Removed` means no longer publicly visible due to admin action or approved takedown.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 business rules. Key Entities give the review a third status, Flagged, which admins see and patients and the public see as Published (REQ-013-079). Change Log 1.10.

nodes.title: My Reviews list newest first, paginated, with empty-state message

attrs.statement: Default list sort is latest submission date descending. The list is paginated and shows the empty state "No reviews yet - complete a treatment to leave a review" when the patient has no submitted reviews.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 rule plus the Review list row (sorted by newest first; paginated), the Sort option row (Default: Most recent first) and the Empty state row ("No reviews yet - complete a treatment to leave a review", shown when the patient has no submitted reviews).

nodes.title: Edit and takedown actions only while a review is Published

attrs.statement: For `Published` status (a `Flagged` review counts as `Published`, REQ-013-079), `Edit Review` is available unless a takedown request is `Pending`, and `Request Takedown` is available unless a request is `Pending` or the one further request after a rejection has been used. For `Removed` status, detail is read-only and shows admin removal reason; edit/takedown actions are hidden.
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 business rules and the Edit review and Request takedown rows (visible only when status = Published).

nodes.title: Review stays published while a takedown request is pending

attrs.statement: A review has at most one `Pending` takedown request. While a request is `Pending`, review remains `Published` unless manually removed by admin (which closes the request as `Approved`), and the patient cannot edit it. After a rejection the patient may file one further request with a new reason.
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 rule. Restated by workflow A3 outcome (review remains visible until decision) and the Screen 9 note on the reject decision.

nodes.title: Takedown request recorded as Pending, linked to review and case; admin queue notified

attrs.statement: System records patient reason, creates takedown request with `Pending` status, and links it to review/case. System notifies admin takedown queue.
attrs.rationale: Workflow A3 steps 3 and 4.

nodes.title: Takedown reason required, 10-1000 characters

attrs.statement: The patient takedown reason is required and must be 10-1000 characters.
attrs.rationale: Composed from the Screen 3 Takedown reason row. Change Log 1.14 replaced the optional message with this required reason.

nodes.title: Admin approves or rejects takedown with note; approval unpublishes, recalculates, notifies

attrs.statement: Admin reviews request reason, review content, and compliance context. Admin approves or rejects request with decision note. System applies decision: approved -> review unpublished/archived (any flag on it is cleared) and provider rating metrics recalculated; rejected -> review remains published. System notifies patient of decision and reason; the decision note is also shown on Review Detail (Screen 3).
attrs.rationale: Workflow A4. Edge Cases add that on a rejected request the review stays published and the decision reason is visible to the patient on Review Detail (Screen 3).

nodes.title: Takedown decision note required; admin removal reason stored on removed review

attrs.statement: The takedown decision note is required, 10-1000 characters. Approved takedown must persist `Admin removal reason` on the removed review so Patient Review Detail (Screen 3) can display the same reason consistently. Admin removal reason is required when approving takedown.
attrs.rationale: Composed from the Screen 9 rows Decision note and Admin removal reason and the Screen 9 note (Approved takedown must persist `Admin removal reason` on the removed review so Patient Review Detail (Screen 3) can display the same reason consistently.).

nodes.title: Review content retained for the 10-year period; takedowns archive, never hard-delete

attrs.statement: Review content (review record + photos + provider responses + takedown requests) retained per the system PRD, Platform-Wide Rules: One 10-year retention period; approved takedown requests are processed by unpublish + archival with restricted access — never hard-deleted.
attrs.rationale: Data & Privacy Rules. Screen 3 retention notice repeats it to the patient.

nodes.title: Audit records immutable and retained for the 10-year period

attrs.statement: `AdminAction` and all audit-log records (patient self-edits, admin edits/removals/seeded reviews, takedown decisions, settings changes, provider responses) are immutable (Constitution §VI, Audit Trail); retention follows the system PRD, Platform-Wide Rules: One 10-year retention period.
attrs.rationale: Data & Privacy Rules; Change Log 1.13 item 1. Retention follows the one 10-year period of the system PRD.

nodes.title: All review mutations fully auditable with actor type and prior values

attrs.statement: All review mutations are fully auditable (who, when, what, before/after, reason where applicable), including patient self-edits to published reviews, admin actions (edits, removals, seeded reviews, takedown decisions, settings changes), and provider response creation. Audit records preserve actor type (patient / provider / admin) and prior field values to satisfy constitution Auditability requirements.
attrs.rationale: Data & Privacy Rules. Restated by Screen 8 (audit trail preview, full audit retained) and Screen 7 (review visibility/filter results must preserve complete audit traceability).

nodes.title: Photos and text must not expose sensitive personal information

attrs.statement: Photos and text must not expose sensitive personal information; admin may redact or remove post-publication.
attrs.rationale: Data & Privacy Rules.

nodes.title: Reviewer alias algorithm; seeded display name; always alias

attrs.statement: Reviewer alias algorithm (canonical, applied uniformly across Patient, Provider, and Admin public surfaces): `{first_name} {last_initial}.` (e.g., "Sarah M."); collisions within the same provider's review list are deduplicated with a numeric suffix (`Sarah M. 2`, `Sarah M. 3`, …). Admin-seeded reviews use an admin-entered `reviewer_display_name` field (free text, subject to the same PII-safety policy — no full last name, no contact info) instead of the algorithmic alias; the `Verified Off-platform` badge accompanies the display name. Public surfaces always show the alias; there is no setting or option to change that. Admin views may unmask the patient identity per RBAC for review handling; this is not a public display option.
attrs.rationale: Data & Privacy Rules, canonical alias, whole bullet verbatim (Change Log 1.13 item 6). Includes the admin-seeded reviewer_display_name rule and the always-alias rule.

nodes.title: Ratings use a 1-5 scale; averages may display half stars

attrs.statement: Ratings use 1–5 scale with half‑stars display allowed for averages.
attrs.rationale: General Module Rules.

nodes.title: Provider response required, 50-1000 characters

attrs.statement: The provider response text is required and must be 50-1000 characters. The character counter updates live and submit is blocked outside the limits.
attrs.rationale: Composed from the Screen 6 rows Response text, Character counter and Submit response. Screen 6 notes: the 50-character minimum prevents single-word or non-substantive replies that erode trust; the 1000-character ceiling keeps public responses scannable on review surfaces and discourages defensive long-form rebuttals.

nodes.title: Provider responses public and immutable while published

attrs.statement: Provider responses are public and immutable while published; admins may remove a response for policy violation. After an admin removal, the provider may submit exactly one replacement response (see one-active-response rule below) — outside of that single replacement, posted responses cannot be edited or re-posted by the provider.
attrs.rationale: Screen 6 rule; Change Log 1.13 item 8 re-worded it from immutable once posted.

nodes.title: One active provider response per review; one replacement after admin removal

attrs.statement: Provider may have at most one active public response per review in V1. If admin removes a prior response for policy violation, provider may submit one replacement response; both the removed and replacement responses are retained in the audit trail (`AdminAction` for the removal, `ProviderResponse` history for the lifecycle). If the replacement is removed too, the provider may not respond again: a review has at most one original and one replacement response.
attrs.rationale: Screen 6 rule; Change Log 1.12 item 2.

nodes.title: Respond action only on published reviews without an active response or earlier replacement; submission recorded and patient notified

attrs.statement: Respond as Provider is visible only when the review is published (a Flagged review counts as published), the provider account is active, and the review has no active response and no replacement response was ever published (a removed original response does not count; once a replacement is published, Respond stays hidden even if the replacement is later removed). Submission records provider identity and timestamp and triggers patient notification (not sent when the review is an admin-seeded review linked to a placeholder patient, REQ-013-077). A suspended provider sees the review view-only, with no Respond control.
attrs.rationale: Composed from the Screen 6 row Respond as Provider (Visible only when review is published and no response exists) and the Screen 6 rule (Submission records provider identity and timestamp and triggers patient notification.).

nodes.title: Provider detail and list show the treatment name and date; no patient or case filter

attrs.statement: Detail and list show the treatment name and date, so multi-case histories are told apart by treatment and date, not by case identifier. The list has no patient or case filter.
attrs.rationale: Screens 5 and 6 business rules.

nodes.title: Only Published reviews shown on patient profile and provider list surfaces

attrs.statement: Only `Published` reviews (a `Flagged` review counts as `Published`, REQ-013-079) are visible on patient-facing provider/clinic profile surfaces. Only published reviews (including a `Flagged` review) appear in provider list surfaces.
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 and Screen 5 business rules.

nodes.title: Embedded review section inherits provider identity from the host profile

attrs.statement: The embedded preview must not redefine or duplicate the full provider profile layout; it inherits provider identity and navigation from the host provider profile screen.
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 business rule and context note (it is not a standalone provider profile screen; non-review profile content belongs to the provider profile and quote-review specifications).

nodes.title: View all opens the full review list of the same provider

attrs.statement: `View all` opens the complete review list for the same provider without changing review ownership or source rules.
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 business rule.

nodes.title: Profile review preview limited; full list paginated, newest first, sort and rating filter

attrs.statement: The provider profile review preview shows a limited count of Published reviews before View all. The full reviews list is paginated, newest first by default, with sort by recency or rating and filter by rating.
attrs.rationale: Composed from the Screen 4 rows Review preview list, Full reviews list state and Sort/filter controls.

nodes.title: Provider review list paginated, newest first by default; sort by recency or rating

attrs.statement: The provider review list is paginated, newest first by default, and can be sorted by recency or rating (default: recency).
attrs.rationale: Composed from the Screen 5 rows Review list and Sort. Filter criteria are owned by FR-022 (REQ-022-092).

nodes.title: Public review photos follow the media privacy and removal rules

attrs.statement: Review photos shown publicly must follow the same media privacy and removal rules as submitted review photos.
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 business rule.

nodes.title: Admin list covers patient-submitted and admin-seeded reviews with audit traceability

attrs.statement: Admin list includes patient-submitted and admin-seeded reviews. Review visibility/filter results must preserve complete audit traceability.
attrs.rationale: Screen 7 business rules.

nodes.title: Settings changes are admin-only and audit logged

attrs.statement: Settings changes are admin-only and audit logged.
attrs.rationale: Screen 10 business rule.

nodes.title: Settings must not weaken fixed eligibility, rating, length, retention or privacy rules

attrs.statement: Settings must not weaken fixed eligibility, rating scale, text length, retention, or privacy rules.
attrs.rationale: Screen 10 business rule.

nodes.title: Export preserves RBAC, PII handling and audit traceability

attrs.statement: Export actions must preserve RBAC, PII handling, and audit traceability.
attrs.rationale: Screen 10 business rule. REQ-013-022 states the export is RBAC-restricted and audit logged.

nodes.title: Flagging thresholds and takedown SLA configurable within policy bounds

attrs.statement: Configurable with Restrictions: Flagging thresholds and auto-flag rules for admin review (within safe bounds approved by policy). Takedown decision SLA/queue prioritization parameters; the takedown decision deadline runs from 12 hours to 7 days and defaults to 48 hours.
attrs.rationale: Admin Editability Rules. Screen 10 rows Flagging thresholds (restricted safe ranges only) and Takedown SLA settings (restricted policy range).

nodes.title: Admin edits review labels, photo guidelines and removal reasons

attrs.statement: Editable by Admin: review category labels (canonical keys remain fixed); photo guidelines text; removal reasons catalogue.
attrs.rationale: Composed from the Admin Editability Rules (Editable by Admin) and the Screen 10 row Review categories/labels (Admin-editable labels; canonical keys remain fixed). Invitation timing and reminders are configured in FR-030, not here (REQ-013-022, Screen 10 and Change Logs 1.12 and 1.14).

nodes.title: Photo guidelines text required; edits audit-logged through AdminAction

attrs.statement: Photo guidelines text is required. All edits are captured via AdminAction with before/after values; there is no formal version model.
attrs.rationale: Composed from the Screen 10 row Photo guidelines text; Change Log 1.12 item 4.

nodes.title: Removal reason catalog holds at least one active reason

attrs.statement: The removal reason catalog must hold at least one active reason.
attrs.rationale: Composed from the Screen 10 row Removal reason catalog.

nodes.title: System-automated flagging queues content for admin review post-publication

attrs.statement: Trigger: Content flagged by system-automated detection (keyword matching, duplicate submission patterns, rate-limit triggers). User-initiated flagging is a future enhancement. Steps: System sets the review status to Flagged and queues the content for admin review; Admin resolves the flag on Screen 8 with a reason: uphold (the review returns to Published and the flag reason is cleared), redact (an admin edit; the review returns to Published and the flag reason is cleared) or unpublish (an admin removal). Outcome: Policy-compliant content remains; violations are removed with audit record. A flagged review stays publicly visible (shown as Published) until an admin removes it.
attrs.rationale: Workflow B2. Edge Cases: "Duplicate or spam reviews: auto‑flag for admin review post-publication." Implementation Notes (technical, not migrated) add that anti-abuse covers duplicate detection, keyword flags and rate limits for submissions. User-initiated flagging is a future enhancement (Change Log 1.11).

nodes.title: RBAC enforced for submit, moderate and respond actions

attrs.statement: Enforce RBAC for submit/moderate/respond actions.
attrs.rationale: Security Considerations, promoted as a business rule.

nodes.title: Takedown retention notice text

attrs.statement: Review content will be removed from public view but archived for 10 years. Audit records of this takedown are kept for the same 10 years.
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 Retention notice. REQ-013-020 requires the notice; this Rule carries its text, which reflects the one 10-year retention period.

nodes.title: Takedown request queue filter

attrs.statement: The takedown request queue is filterable by status and date.
attrs.rationale: Paraphrase of Screen 9 Request queue Validation cell 'Filterable by status/date' (PRD line 437).

nodes.title: Admin-seeded reviews use a placeholder patient and procedure

attrs.statement: Each admin-seeded (off-platform) review MUST be linked to a placeholder patient and a placeholder procedure, so REQ-013-010 holds for every review. The admin add form takes the provider, treatment, ratings, text and review date, and a reason. The placeholder patient is not a person, so notices addressed to it are suppressed.
attrs.rationale: Admin-Seeded Review Policy and Data Requirements. Closes the gap that seeded reviews have no real patient or procedure while REQ-013-010 requires both links.

nodes.title: Takedown decision deadline setting defaults to 48 hours

attrs.statement: Admin Review Settings MUST include a takedown decision deadline setting, from 12 hours to 7 days, that defaults to 48 hours. When the deadline passes on a Pending request, the queue shows it as Overdue and admins are notified; no request is approved or rejected automatically.
attrs.rationale: Integration Requirements, Screen 10 Takedown SLA settings row and Configurable with Restrictions.

nodes.title: Flagged review stays publicly visible, shows as Published

attrs.statement: A review with status Flagged MUST stay publicly visible until an admin removes it; patients and the public see it as Published. Every rule keyed on Published (visibility, patient Edit and Request Takedown, provider Respond, the rating aggregates and the sub-score endpoint) also covers Flagged, so setting or clearing a flag needs no recalculation. An admin resolves a flag as uphold or redact (back to Published, flag reason cleared) or unpublish.
attrs.rationale: Security and Privacy Requirements, workflow B2 outcome and Edge Cases (duplicate or spam). Admins see the Flagged status; the public view does not change until a removal.

nodes.title: Screen 1 layout locked; current definitions and shared rules apply

attrs.statement: Screen 1 layout, sections, widget count, chart types, filters, and responsive behavior remain locked. Its TTFQ, four-stage Confirmed-booking funnel, and active accepted-but-unpaid aging MUST use the current Screen 1 definitions and shared analytics rules under the approved CR-FR014-20261007-01 metric-only exception; the v2.0 formulas are superseded where explicitly revised.
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-001. States the Screen 1 lock; the Screen 1 Rules REQ-014-002 to REQ-014-032 follow it individually. Restated by the Screen 1 lock notice (PO formula/metric-label-only exceptions, Qualified stage removed, TTFQ from distribution, only the New row badge kept).

nodes.title: Screen 1 time range filter

attrs.statement: System MUST offer a time range filter in the Screen 1 header with options Today, This week, Last 4 weeks, Last 12 weeks and Custom, defaulting to Last 4 weeks
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-002 (Screen 1).

nodes.title: Screen 1 country filter

attrs.statement: System MUST offer a multi-select Country filter in the Screen 1 header, defaulting to all countries
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-003 (Screen 1).

nodes.title: Screen 1 click cross-filters all sections

attrs.statement: System MUST apply a single click on any Screen 1 widget element as a cross-filter on all sections
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-004 (Screen 1).

nodes.title: Screen 1 operational list opens only from View list

attrs.statement: System MUST open the operational list behind a Screen 1 element in a new context only from an explicit "View list" action in the element's tooltip or keyboard focus menu
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-005 (Screen 1).

nodes.title: Screen 1 tooltip definition and localisation

attrs.statement: System MUST show in each Screen 1 tooltip the metric definition, numerator and denominator, and time basis, and MUST localize dates, currencies and timezone
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-006 (Screen 1).

nodes.title: Screen 1 loading, low-sample and error states

attrs.statement: System MUST show skeletons while Screen 1 loads, helper copy with counts still rendered below 30 inquiries, non-blocking error banners with retry, and masked patient names throughout
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-007 (Screen 1).

nodes.title: Screen 1 Tile 1 New Inquiries

attrs.statement: System MUST display Tile 1 (New Inquiries) as Today and This week counts, opening the FR-003 provider inquiry list with the period pre-applied
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-008 (Screen 1).

nodes.title: Screen 1 Tile 2 TTFQ

attrs.statement: System MUST display Tile 2 (TTFQ) as p50 and p90 against the SLA in a compact dual bullet, coloured Green, Amber or Red by the Tile 2 thresholds, opening the FR-003 provider inquiry list filtered to the inquiries in the period (response time is per provider, not per team member)
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-009 (Screen 1).

nodes.title: Screen 1 TTFQ measurement

attrs.statement: System MUST measure TTFQ per the Tile 2 formula, from the inquiry's distribution to the provider to the first send of the provider's earliest parent quote, excluding auto-acknowledgements
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-010 (Screen 1).

nodes.title: Screen 1 Inquiry Queue columns

attrs.statement: System MUST display the Inquiry Queue with columns Received (relative time and SLA countdown), Patient (ID-masked), Age, Problem, Country and Actions (View link)
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-011 (Screen 1).

nodes.title: Screen 1 Inquiry Queue New badge, sort and paging

attrs.statement: System MUST mark Inquiry Queue rows with the `New` badge until the provider submits a parent quote, sort `New` rows first then by received time ascending, and show 10 rows per page
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-012 (Screen 1).

nodes.title: Screen 1 B1 funnel

attrs.statement: System MUST display B1 as a funnel (Inquiries, Quoted, Accepted, Confirmed booking) with count and step percentage per stage and overall booking conversion as footer
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-013 (Screen 1).

nodes.title: Screen 1 B1 counting grain

attrs.statement: System MUST count B1 as distinct inquiry/provider pairs in one inquiry cohort, cumulative through each reached stage, with Confirmed booking meaning the first successful initial charge of the chosen option (full payment, deposit, or first installment) confirms the FR-006 Booking; clicking a stage opens the FR-003 provider inquiry list with that stage, the period and the country filter (when set) pre-applied
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-014 (Screen 1).

nodes.title: Screen 1 B2 TTFQ bullet chart

attrs.statement: System MUST display B2 as a bullet chart of p50 and p90 with the SLA as target marker, coloured by the Tile 2 thresholds, opening the FR-003 provider inquiry list filtered to the inquiries in the period
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-015 (Screen 1).

nodes.title: Screen 1 B3 booking intensity heatmap

attrs.statement: System MUST display B3 as a 6-row by 7-column Monday-to-Sunday calendar heatmap for the next 6 weeks, coloured by the Intensity Index (bookings on the day divided by that month's daily average, times 100)
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-016 (Screen 1).

nodes.title: Screen 1 B3 booking count basis

attrs.statement: System MUST count B3 as "Scheduled bookings" only per REQ-014-116 (Confirmed, In Progress, Aftercare or Completed by appointment date)
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-017 (Screen 1).

nodes.title: Screen 1 B3 colour bands and drill-down

attrs.statement: System MUST colour B3 cells Cool (50% or less), Below avg (50 to 90%), Neutral (90 to 110%), Above avg (110 to 150%) or Hot (over 150%), show the Scheduled bookings, monthly average and index in the cell tooltip, and open the Schedule day view on click
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-018 (Screen 1).

nodes.title: Screen 1 B3 baseline order and clamp

attrs.statement: System MUST choose the B3 baseline in the order 12-month same-month average, current month to date, rolling 90 days, and clamp the colour index to 0 to 300% while showing the actual value in the tooltip
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-019 (Screen 1).

nodes.title: Screen 1 B4 country donut

attrs.statement: System MUST display B4 as a donut of the top 8 countries by inquiry share plus Other, with total inquiries in the centre and `CC (ISO-2) • %` slice labels
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-020 (Screen 1).

nodes.title: Screen 1 B4 slice border by Confirmed booking rate

attrs.statement: System MUST style B4 slice borders by confirmed booking rate (thin/neutral under 20%, medium/amber 20 to 40%, thick/green over 40%) and show country, inquiries, Confirmed bookings and Confirmed booking rate in the tooltip
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-021 (Screen 1).

nodes.title: Screen 1 B4 cohort basis and drill-down

attrs.statement: System MUST compute B4 Confirmed bookings and rate from the inquiry cohort and Confirmed booking stage in Analytics Counting & Time Basis, and open the FR-003 provider inquiry list with that country and the period pre-applied on slice click
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-022 (Screen 1).

nodes.title: Screen 1 C1 weekly income chart

attrs.statement: System MUST display C1 as a weekly area line chart of income only in the provider currency, opening the Earnings report for the clicked week
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-023 (Screen 1).

nodes.title: Screen 1 C2 income by treatment Pareto

attrs.statement: System MUST display C2 as a Pareto bar chart of income by treatment (top N plus Other, with cumulative percentage line), attributing treatment as Screen 4 Widget 2 does, opening the Cases list filtered by treatment
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-024 (Screen 1).

nodes.title: Screen 1 C3 accepted-but-unpaid aging buckets

attrs.statement: System MUST display C3 as a stacked horizontal bar of accepted selections awaiting initial payment in the buckets 0-24h, 1-3d, 4-7d, 8-14d and over 14d, with an optional legend by treatment (top 3) or country
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-025 (Screen 1).

nodes.title: Screen 1 C3 age and eligibility basis

attrs.statement: System MUST compute C3 age from the immutable acceptance time and count only pending bookings with a valid exclusive payment-window hold, excluding cancelled selections, superseded acceptance events, expired holds and Payment Window Expired bookings
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-026 (Screen 1).

nodes.title: Screen 1 C3 drill-down to Accepted Quotes

attrs.statement: System MUST open from a C3 bucket the Accepted Quotes list resolved to the exact accepted subquote and pending booking, using the actual configured hold deadline
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-027 (Screen 1).

nodes.title: Screen 1 C4 payout chart and inline table

attrs.statement: System MUST display C4 as a monthly column chart (last 6 to 12 months) with an inline table of 2 to 3 rows and columns Type, Period, Amount, Scheduled Date and Cadence
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-028 (Screen 1).

nodes.title: Screen 1 C4 payout Type mapping

attrs.statement: System MUST set the C4 Type to the provider display status from the Screen 4 Widget 8 FR-017 mapping (Upcoming, Processing, Paid, Failed; Voided never shown), listing the next Upcoming payout, any Processing or Failed payout, then the most recent Paid payout, up to 3 rows
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-029 (Screen 1).

nodes.title: Screen 1 C4 scheduled date and drill-down

attrs.statement: System MUST show in C4 the FR-017 scheduled payout date (the paid date for Paid rows) and open the Payout statements list (CSV/PDF export) on bar click
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-030 (Screen 1).

nodes.title: Screen 1 single scrollable page order

attrs.statement: System MUST present Screen 1 as one scrollable page without tabs, ordered header filters, Section A (Inbox), Section B (Performance), Section C (Financials)
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-031 (Screen 1).

nodes.title: Screen 1 single column at 1024px and below

attrs.statement: System MUST collapse Screen 1 to a single column at 1024px width and below
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-032 (Screen 1).

nodes.title: Funnel conversion trend chart (Screen 2)

attrs.statement: System MUST display cumulative distinct-inquiry funnel conversion trend ending in Confirmed booking as a multi-line chart with weekly/monthly toggle
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1701 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-033).

nodes.title: Conversion by treatment type (Screen 2)

attrs.statement: System MUST display conversion breakdown by treatment type as a grouped bar chart
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1702 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-034).

nodes.title: Conversion by patient country (Screen 2)

attrs.statement: System MUST display conversion breakdown by patient country as a ranked horizontal bar
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1703 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-035).

nodes.title: Parent-quote acceptance rate trend (Screen 2)

attrs.statement: System MUST display parent-quote acceptance rate trend using accepted parents and submitted parents from the same first-submission cohort
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1704 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-036).

nodes.title: TTFQ p50/p90 trend from distribution to first send (Screen 2)

attrs.statement: System MUST display TTFQ p50 and p90 trend, measured from the inquiry's distribution to the provider to the `first_sent_at` of the provider's earliest parent quote for the inquiry per inquiry/provider pair (never changed by a re-send or new version), with SLA reference line
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1705 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-037).

nodes.title: Cancellation and no-show KPI tiles (Screen 2)

attrs.statement: System MUST display cancellation and no-show rate KPI tiles with sparklines
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1706 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-038).

nodes.title: Anonymised platform benchmark table (Screen 2)

attrs.statement: System MUST display an anonymised platform benchmark comparison table (TTFQ, booking conversion, parent-quote acceptance rate, avg rating) with percentile bands and the same per-metric counting definitions for provider and peer values
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1707 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-039).

nodes.title: Benchmark pool of at least 5 providers

attrs.statement: Benchmark pool MUST require minimum 5 providers; display explanatory message if pool is insufficient
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1708 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-040). Restated by Data Quality Rule 9 (line 1457) and Implementation Notes (line 1628: benchmark outputs only above the minimum peer count).

nodes.title: Full patient location table and donut (Screen 3)

attrs.statement: System MUST display full patient location table (all countries, sortable) and linked donut chart
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1712 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-041).

nodes.title: New vs returning patient rate (Screen 3)

attrs.statement: System MUST display new vs. returning patient rate as donut and monthly trend line
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1713 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-042).

nodes.title: Patient journey time p50/p90 (Screen 3)

attrs.statement: System MUST display patient journey time (p50 and p90 days inquiry → first successful booking-confirming payment) with distribution histogram, without failed-attempt or later-installment duplication
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1714 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-043).

nodes.title: Review sub-scores per treatment (Screen 3)

attrs.statement: System MUST display review sub-scores (overall, results, staff, facility, value) per treatment type
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1715 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-044).

nodes.title: Treatment preference distribution (Screen 3)

attrs.statement: System MUST display treatment preference distribution (quoted inquiry count vs. Confirmed booking count per treatment, by the parent quote's treatment)
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1716 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-045).

nodes.title: Aftercare activation rate KPI (Screen 3)

attrs.statement: System MUST display aftercare activation rate KPI with trend sparkline
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1674 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-046).

nodes.title: No patient age distribution widget

attrs.statement: Removed in v3.11. No patient age distribution widget is included in this version; the ID is kept so later numbering stays stable
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1718 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-047). Restated by Screen 3 Business Rules (line 457: no patient age distribution widget is included in this version).

nodes.title: Revenue trend with weekly/monthly/quarterly toggle (Screen 4)

attrs.statement: System MUST display revenue trend with weekly/monthly/quarterly toggle
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1679 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-048).

nodes.title: Revenue by treatment full list (Screen 4)

attrs.statement: System MUST display revenue by treatment type — full list (not capped at 8)
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1680 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-049).

nodes.title: Revenue by patient country (Screen 4)

attrs.statement: System MUST display revenue by patient country
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1681 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-050).

nodes.title: Commission deducted and income after commission from confirmation-time snapshot (Screen 4)

attrs.statement: System MUST display commission deducted and "Income after commission (before refunds)" (gross income minus commission deducted) per period using each booking's confirmation-time commission snapshot: percentage per completed payment in range; flat rate once per procedure completed in range (FR-015 REQ-015-022)
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1725 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-051).

nodes.title: Refund volume and refund rate trend (Screen 4)

attrs.statement: System MUST display refund volume and refund rate trend
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1683 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-052).

nodes.title: Payment option split and installment adoption rate (Screen 4)

attrs.statement: System MUST display the payment option chosen per booking (Full payment, Deposit plus balance, Installment plan) and a monthly installment adoption rate (bookings first confirmed in the month with an FR-007B installment plan divided by all bookings first confirmed in the month)
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1727 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-053).

nodes.title: Cash-at-risk summary of accepted selections under valid holds (Screen 4)

attrs.statement: System MUST display cash-at-risk summary of distinct accepted selections awaiting initial payment under valid holds, linking to Screen 1 Section C3; expired/cancelled/superseded selections MUST be excluded
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1728 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-054).

nodes.title: Full payout history (Screen 4)

attrs.statement: System MUST display full payout history (column bar + paginated table covering all history)
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1729 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-055).

nodes.title: Average accepted subquote price by treatment (Screen 5)

attrs.statement: System MUST display average accepted subquote price by treatment type with acceptance-time trend overlay
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1690 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-056).

nodes.title: Accepted-price distribution histogram (Screen 5)

attrs.statement: System MUST display accepted-price distribution histogram with provider and platform accepted-price median reference lines
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1734 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-057).

nodes.title: Accepted price vs parent-quote acceptance rate scatter (Screen 5)

attrs.statement: System MUST display a descriptive accepted-price vs. parent-quote acceptance-rate scatter using the same first-submission cohort for both axes (one point per treatment), without offered-price conversion or causal claims; replace with text insight if fewer than 3 treatment types have both coordinates
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1735 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-058).

nodes.title: Platform benchmark comparison with accepted-price-only amounts (Screen 5)

attrs.statement: System MUST display platform benchmark comparison table with percentile bands, consistent units/cohorts/FX basis, and accepted-price-only amount observations; require minimum 5 eligible providers for each benchmark metric
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1736 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-059).

nodes.title: Provider selects screens to include in an export

attrs.statement: System MUST allow providers to select which of Screens 2 to 5 to include in the export, and MUST block selecting a screen on which the user can see no widget
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1740 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-060).

nodes.title: PDF and CSV exports use the screens' metric definitions

attrs.statement: System MUST support PDF and CSV exports using the same approved metric definitions, samples, eligibility, and cutoff as the included screens, with authorized accepted-selection provenance in detailed rows
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1741 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-061).

nodes.title: Scheduled recurring exports for the previous full period

attrs.statement: System MUST support scheduled recurring exports (weekly/monthly/quarterly) covering the previous full period in the provider's timezone, with recipient limits, retry, and edit/pause/resume/delete as defined on Screen 6
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1742 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-062).

nodes.title: Generated reports stored 7 days for re-download

attrs.statement: System MUST store generated reports for 7 days for re-download
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1743 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-063). Restated by Screen 6 Business Rules (line 697: generated reports stored 7 days for re-download from Report History section) and S-05 dependency (line 1578).

nodes.title: Three-section platform overview (Screen 7)

attrs.statement: System MUST display three-section overview (Operations, Performance, Finance) with platform-wide aggregations
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1747 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-064).

nodes.title: Provider TTFQ health distribution donut (Screen 7)

attrs.statement: System MUST display provider TTFQ health distribution donut (Green/Amber/Red counts) with a separate grey "No data" tier for providers with no TTFQ observation, kept out of the percentages
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1705 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-065).

nodes.title: Engagement rate, Dormant and Non-responding provider counts (Screen 7)

attrs.statement: System MUST display provider engagement rate, activity-based Dormant provider count, and separately labelled Non-responding provider count (0 first-submitted parent quotes within the Dormant threshold window)
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1749 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-066).

nodes.title: Platform funnel and TTFQ from underlying observations (Screen 7)

attrs.statement: System MUST display a cumulative distinct-platform-inquiry Confirmed-booking funnel and TTFQ bullet chart computed from underlying inquiry/provider first-response observations, not summed provider funnels or averaged provider percentiles
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1750 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-067).

nodes.title: Platform financial summary tiles (Screen 7)

attrs.statement: System MUST display platform GMV, commission earned, upcoming payout obligations, and cash-at-risk as financial summary tiles
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1751 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-068).

nodes.title: Provider league table (Screen 8)

attrs.statement: System MUST display provider league table (sortable by TTFQ, booking conversion, parent-quote acceptance rate, rating, distinct-inquiry response rate) with platform variance column
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1755 (Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-069).

nodes.title: Provider performance scatter (Screen 8)

attrs.statement: System MUST display provider performance scatter plot (TTFQ vs. conversion rate, one point per provider)

nodes.title: Counting definitions apply to all widgets, drill-downs, aggregates, benchmarks and exports

attrs.statement: These definitions apply to all provider/admin widgets, drill-downs, aggregates, benchmarks, and exports. A chart's "Quoted" inquiry stage is not the same unit as a submitted-parent volume metric.
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1436. Analytics Counting & Time Basis preamble.

nodes.title: Admin-authored replacement quotes are not provider responses

attrs.statement: A quote that an admin authors for a replacement provider during an FR-006 provider-fault transfer (FR-004 Workflow 7, `authorType = admin`) is not a provider response. It is excluded from every provider quote count (parent response volume, inquiry response rate, parent-quote acceptance rate), from booking conversion and the inquiry funnel for the replacement provider, and from TTFQ, together with its replacement acceptance and booking. Admin views report these quotes only as a separate count of provider-fault replacements.
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1439.

nodes.title: Acceptance grain is the immutable AcceptanceEvent

attrs.statement: FR-005's immutable AcceptanceEvent identifies the selected Subquote, its Quote Option and Option/Date-Price Record, inherited parent context, and accepted aggregate revision. Deduplicate redelivery of the same acceptance and count each accepted parent once. `acceptedSubquoteVersion = acceptedParentQuoteVersion`; neither a changed package preset nor an unselected alternative may replace the accepted snapshot. Historical acceptance measures patient selection and is retained after cancellation or payment-window expiry; it is not proof of a confirmed booking or captured revenue.
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1440.

nodes.title: Parent-quote acceptance rate cohort and formula

attrs.statement: Numerator = distinct parents in the selected first-submission cohort with an AcceptanceEvent by the reporting cutoff. Denominator = all distinct submitted parents in that same cohort, including unaccepted, expired, withdrawn, or later-cancelled parents. Use the parent's `first_sent_at` (set by FR-004 on first send; never changed by a re-send) to assign each parent to its cohort; do not divide acceptance events occurring in one period by unrelated submissions in another. This is a parent-level rate, not accepted subquotes divided by available subquotes.
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1441.

nodes.title: Inquiry response rate cohort and formula

attrs.statement: Denominator = distinct `(providerId, inquiryId)` distribution records first assigned to that provider within the selected distribution period. Numerator = those same pairs with at least one submitted parent response by the cutoff. Retries of distribution and multiple parent responses do not multiply either side. Missing authoritative distribution data yields an unavailable metric, not a proxy based on platform inquiries or quote volume.
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1442.

nodes.title: Inquiry funnel and booking conversion cohort

attrs.statement: Use inquiry `created_at` to select the inquiry cohort. Provider views count distinct `(providerId, inquiryId)` pairs assigned to that provider; platform views count distinct Inquiry IDs across providers, not the sum of provider totals. Quoted means at least one parent was submitted; Accepted means an AcceptanceEvent exists for that inquiry and, in provider views, that provider; Confirmed booking means the first successful initial charge of the option the patient chose (full payment, deposit, or first installment) confirmed the FR-006 Booking. Each inquiry contributes at most once to each reached stage and cumulatively to preceding stages. Inquiries have no treatment (the provider chooses it in the parent quote), so treatment segments start at Quoted and use the parent/accepted booking's treatment; unquoted inquiries count only in all-treatments views. Deduplicate within each segment. Later cancellation does not erase a reached milestone; cancellation and no-show metrics remain separate. `In Progress` is a procedure-start milestone, never a synonym for payment confirmation.
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1443.

nodes.title: Reporting cutoff and empty denominators

attrs.statement: Historical funnel/acceptance/response cohorts are evaluated through the earlier of the selected period end and the pipeline's data-as-of time. Current cohorts show that cutoff and indicate that outcomes may still be pending. A zero denominator is N/A, not 0% or 100%. Tooltips/exports state the unit, cohort timestamp, numerator/denominator, cutoff, and relevant sample sizes; rates based on these distinct-record sets cannot exceed 100%.
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1444.

nodes.title: First response and journey cohorts

attrs.statement: TTFQ uses the same inquiry-created cohort and reporting cutoff as the funnel, which differs on purpose from the distribution-period cohort of the inquiry response rate; screens that show both (such as Screen 8) and exports MUST state each metric's cohort basis in the tooltip and export definition. TTFQ contributes one observation per inquiry/provider pair whose first parent response occurred by that cutoff, from the inquiry's distribution to that provider (`inquiry_providers.distributed_at`) to the `first_sent_at` of the provider's earliest parent quote for the inquiry; a re-send or new version never changes it. Pairs without an authoritative distribution timestamp have no TTFQ observation. Unanswered inquiries remain in funnel/response denominators but have no completed TTFQ observation. Provider distributions pool those observations; platform p50/p90 pool the underlying observations, not provider percentile averages. Journey time instead uses the successful initial payment that first confirms a booking, selects the confirmation-time cohort, and counts the inquiry once. Later installments or failed payment attempts do not create new journey observations.
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1445.

nodes.title: Accepted-price grain

attrs.statement: Count one immutable accepted total price per accepted parent, including the accepted package/date-price and promotion. Standalone price metrics use `AcceptanceEvent.acceptedAt` to select their cohort; Screen 5's scatter uses its expressly stated parent first-submission cohort. Unaccepted parents have a price range, not one amount, and remain excluded from all amount observations while included in parent volume/rate metrics. Cancellation, hold expiry, package-library edits, quote revisions, or later financial adjustments do not rewrite the historical acceptance-price observation. Show accepted selection counts and distinguish these statistics from captured revenue.
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1446.

nodes.title: Active cash risk eligibility

attrs.statement: At the displayed snapshot time, include only Accepted FR-006 pending bookings with a non-superseded AcceptanceEvent, valid exclusive slot hold, and no successful initial payment. It is a current snapshot and ignores the time range filter (REQ-014-317). Calculate age from immutable `acceptedAt`, and validate the actual configured hold deadline. Remove cancelled, expired-hold, and `Payment Window Expired` selections even before stale quote status caches update; do not restart age on payment retries. When an admin revives an expired booking it re-enters these figures and its age counts from the start of its current hold. Sum each eligible accepted total price once as potential accepted booking value, not deposit receivables, captured revenue, or outstanding installment balances.
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1447.

nodes.title: Financial record grain

attrs.statement: Payments, refunds, commission deductions, installments, and payouts retain their existing owning-record accounting rules. Aggregate those records before attaching read-only AcceptanceEvent/Booking/quote provenance; joining several packages or date options MUST NOT multiply financial totals. This change does not redefine fund release, fees, payout routing, or travel responsibility.
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1448. Restated by Screen 4 Business Rules (line 599) and Screen 12 Business Rules (line 1319).

nodes.title: Refund source of truth

attrs.statement: Refunds are counted only from refund rows (`payments.payment_type = 'refund'` with `payment_status = 'completed'`); refund amount, refund count, and Net GMV use these rows alone. An original payment whose `payment_status` later becomes `refunded` stays in gross income/GMV and captured payment counts (`payment_type ≠ 'refund'` and `payment_status IN ('completed', 'refunded')`) and is never counted as a second refund. This prevents a refund from being removed from gross figures and subtracted again.
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1449. Restated by Screen 4 Business Rules (line 595: Income excludes refund rows; refunds reported in Widget 5).

nodes.title: Shared benchmark rule

attrs.statement: All provider benchmark comparisons (Screen 2 Widget 7 and Screen 5 Widget 4) use one peer pool: active providers with ≥30 inquiries in the same rolling 12-month window, minimum 5 eligible providers per metric (price metrics additionally require accepted-price observations). Provider identities stay anonymised (Rule 13). Colour is direction-aware: for higher-is-better metrics (conversion, parent-quote acceptance, ratings) Green = at or better than median, Amber = up to 10% worse, Red = more than 10% worse; for TTFQ p50 lower is better, so worse means above median. Average accepted price is neutral: variance and percentile are shown without colour. Benchmarks refresh at the FR-026 benchmark refresh frequency.
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1450. Restated by Screen 5 Business Rules (line 666: provider identity fully anonymised in benchmark calculations).
