nodes.title: Filter applicability by source dimension

attrs.statement: A filter applies only to widgets whose source records carry that dimension. Inquiries carry no treatment (the provider chooses it in the FR-004 Parent Quote), so the Treatment filter applies from Quoted onward: quoted inquiries, parent quotes, acceptances, bookings, accepted prices, payments and refunds attributed through the accepted parent (Screen 4 Widget 2 attribution), reviews, and aftercare. Funnel and conversion widgets with a treatment selected follow the Screen 2 rule: the Inquiries stage shows "— (inquiries have no treatment)" and conversion is measured from Quoted. Widgets built on inquiries, patient registrations, provider counts, or payout statements are not filtered by a dimension their records lack; they keep rendering unfiltered data with a visible note such as "Not filtered by treatment". This covers: Screen 4: Widget 8 payout history is filtered by neither treatment nor patient country, because payout statements are per provider period (likewise Screen 1 C4 for the country filter); Screen 9: Widgets 1 (inquiry volume), 3 (new vs. returning), and 5 (seasonality) are not treatment-filtered; Widget 2 measures from Quoted; Widgets 4 (journey time) and 6 (affiliate bookings) filter by the accepted parent's treatment; Screen 10: Widgets 1 (demand map), 2 (provider coverage), 3 (demand vs. supply gap), and 5 (emerging origins) are not treatment-filtered; Widget 4 measures conversion from Quoted
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 1459, 1460, 1461, 1462. Rule 5A with its per-screen sub-bullets.

nodes.title: Daily FX rates, locked at transaction date, 48-hour fallback cap

attrs.statement: All currency amounts converted using the daily FX rates (the Currency Exchange Rate record owned by FR-029: one fetched rate per pair per day) cached from the currency conversion API; rates locked at the transaction date for historical data. On API failure, fall back to the previous day's cached rate up to a maximum of 48 hours; beyond 48 hours, affected widgets show "FX data unavailable" instead of rendering with stale rates; Accepted-price observations preserve the FR-005 acceptance snapshot's original currency, total price, locked exchange rate, and acceptance time. If a different reporting currency needs an additional conversion, use a historical acceptance-date reporting rate and retain its provenance; do not replace the commercial locked rate with today's rate. Payment/payout records retain their own existing historical financial FX basis. Missing historical provenance yields an unavailable affected amount metric, not an inferred currency, current package price, or current FX value.
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 1458, 1459. Rule 10 with its accepted-price sub-bullet. Restated by Assumption 9 (line 1616) and External dependency Currency Conversion API (line 1585).

nodes.title: Patient identity masked in provider-facing analytics

attrs.statement: Patient identity is masked in all provider-facing analytics: where a patient row is shown, display the patient ID plus a partially masked name in the FR-003 format (for example HP102589-0001 · "Aylin K****"); full names and contact details are never shown
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1475. Rule 11. Restated by Screen 1 States (line 254: patient names masked throughout).

nodes.title: Patient identities never exposed to affiliates

nodes.title: Provider identities anonymised in benchmarks and platform-wide charts

nodes.title: All analytics access logged to the audit log

nodes.title: FR-014 uses the existing role and permission model

attrs.statement: FR-014 consumes the existing role and permission model; it does not define new roles or expand access beyond the owning platform's permission system.
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1483. Rule 15A.

nodes.title: Widgets without data-domain permission are not rendered or requested

attrs.statement: If a user lacks permission to view a widget's underlying data domain, the UI MUST not render that widget for that user, and the corresponding widget data MUST not be requested. Remaining widgets reflow within the existing responsive layout.
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1484. Rule 15B.

nodes.title: Default provider-role access matrix

attrs.statement: Default provider-role access to the provider analytics screens, using the FR-009 roles. The matrix states the default data-domain grants only; actual visibility is always resolved through Rules 15A and 15B, so a role whose permissions are changed sees whatever its granted data domains allow. Where the matrix says "Only with financial permission", the FR-031 permissions of REQ-031-118 decide: View Financial Dashboard gates the income and revenue widgets (every Screen 1 Section C and Screen 4 widget other than the payout widgets), View Payouts gates the payout widgets and payout history (Screen 1 C4 and Screen 4 Widget 8), and View Financial Reports gates financial exports (Screen 6). Screens or sections a role cannot see are hidden from navigation, not shown as locked. The Analytics nav item opens the first of Screens 2, 3, 4 and 5 the role can see and is hidden when it can see none; Screen 1 renders only the sections the role may see, and a role with no visible section sees "No analytics available for your role". Screen 1 Main Dashboard — Sections A and B (inbox and performance): Owner: Full; Manager: Full; Billing Staff: Hidden; Clinical Staff: Hidden; Screen 1 Main Dashboard — Section C (financials): Owner: Full; Manager: Only with financial permission; Billing Staff: Full; Clinical Staff: Hidden; Screen 2 Performance & Conversion: Owner: Full; Manager: Full; Billing Staff: Hidden; Clinical Staff: Hidden; Screen 3 Patient Analytics: Owner: Full; Manager: Full; Billing Staff: Hidden; Clinical Staff: Satisfaction and aftercare widgets only; Screen 4 Finance & Payouts: Owner: Full; Manager: Only with financial permission; Billing Staff: Full; Clinical Staff: Hidden; Screen 5 Pricing & Benchmarks: Owner: Full; Manager: Full; Billing Staff: Full; Clinical Staff: Hidden; Screen 6 Export Report Configuration: Owner: Full; Manager: Exports limited to the screens and widgets the user can see; Billing Staff: Exports limited to the screens and widgets the user can see; Clinical Staff: Exports limited to the screens and widgets the user can see (Screen 3 exports contain only the satisfaction and aftercare widgets)
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 1473, 1475-1483. Rule 15F with its matrix (lines 1475-1483). FR-009 roles per dependency line 1566.

nodes.title: Colour is never the only signal

attrs.statement: Colour is never the only signal. Every Green/Amber/Red tier, benchmark variance, health badge, aging bucket, heatmap cell, and gap/outlier flag MUST also carry a text label or icon (for example ✓ On target, ▲ Watch, ✕ Off target, or the tier name), and chart series MUST be distinguishable by label, pattern, or marker shape as well as colour.
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1502. Rule 15C.

nodes.title: WCAG 2.1 AA contrast

attrs.statement: Text, data labels, and status badges MUST meet WCAG 2.1 AA contrast (4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text and for chart marks and UI components against their background) in the platform default palette.
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1503. Rule 15D.

nodes.title: Every chart has a text alternative

attrs.statement: Every chart MUST have a text alternative: an accessible name and summary, plus keyboard-reachable tooltips/drill-downs, or a data-table view of the same values. Heatmaps and maps fall back to their ranked-table equivalents for screen readers.
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1504. Rule 15E.

nodes.title: Admin-editable analytics values and recalculation rule

attrs.statement: Values are owned by the FR-026 Analytics Configuration Manager (Screen 5e); FR-014 reads the active version at calculation time. Recalculation rule: live dashboards and benchmarks always use the configuration version active when they are calculated, including for past periods shown on screen. After a change, the next calculation recolours and re-buckets every period in view (for example, last month's TTFQ tiers after an SLA change); past periods are not frozen at older values. Each aggregate records the configuration version used. PDF/CSV exports and scheduled-export files already generated are never rewritten; they keep the values and version from their generation time. Editable by Admin: SLA target (minutes, default 120) — platform-wide value used across all TTFQ color coding and benchmark charts; per-provider SLA overrides are out of scope for this version; Benchmark refresh frequency (default Weekly); Provider engagement status thresholds (Active/At Risk/Dormant day boundaries; defaults At Risk 7 days, Dormant 30 days); Outlier detection threshold for Screen 13 (default 30%); Target monthly commission reference line on Screen 12 Widget 2 (optional; unset by default, and the line is hidden until set)
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 1498, 1500, 1501, 1502, 1503, 1504. Admin Editability Rules. Assumption 4 (line 1611) restates the single platform-wide SLA in minutes; FR-026 dependency (line 1574).

nodes.title: Values fixed in codebase

attrs.statement: Fixed in Codebase: Dashboard section order (Screen 1: A → B → C); TTFQ formula and funnel stage definitions; Booking Intensity Index formula; Commission calculation logic: `IF provider_commissions.type = 'percentage' THEN payment.amount × (effective_rate / 100) ELSE effective_flat_amount once per completed procedure` — percentage applies per completed payment, flat rate applies once per FR-010 completed procedure (FR-015); the conditional is fixed; the type and rate/amount values come from each booking's confirmation-time commission snapshot (`snapshot_commission_percentage` / `snapshot_commission_amount`, FR-015 REQ-015-022, FR-029), never from the provider's current commission configuration
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 1523, 1524, 1525, 1526. Admin Editability Rules, Fixed in Codebase.

Reconcile any legacy fallback against the accepted snapshot before presenting historical amount metrics.

nodes.title: Last active from provider_activity_logs; last_login_at field must not be used

attrs.statement: Engagement views rely on `provider_activity_logs.action_at` as the canonical activity timestamp source (documented in system-data-schema.md). Last active = `MAX(action_at)` per provider. The previously referenced `provider_users.last_login_at` field does not exist in the schema and must not be used.

nodes.title: Analytics data contract canonical boundaries

attrs.statement: Parent Quote first-submission `first_sent_at`: Where used: Response volume, TTFQ, acceptance-rate cohorts, provider ramp; Canonical boundary / legacy constraint: One immutable first send per stable parent identity, set by FR-004 on first send and never changed by a re-send or new version; legacy `quotes.sent_at` is never used as a fallback for these metrics; AcceptanceEvent acceptedAt + accepted snapshot: Where used: Acceptance milestones, accepted prices, aging origin; Canonical boundary / legacy constraint: FR-005 event is authoritative; legacy `quotes.accepted_at` alone cannot identify the chosen package/date price or establish an active hold; Parent/subquote IDs and accepted aggregate versions; Quote Option/Option-Date-Price IDs: Where used: Drill-downs, accepted-price observations, detailed exports; Canonical boundary / legacy constraint: Resolve the exact accepted version and inherited context; require equal parent/subquote aggregate versions; Booking linkage, confirmation event, hold deadline, and lifecycle: Where used: Confirmed funnels, patient journey, pending-payment aging; Canonical boundary / legacy constraint: FR-006 distinguishes Accepted, Confirmed, In Progress, Payment Window Expired, and Cancelled; flat quote status is insufficient; Original accepted total price/currency and locked FX provenance: Where used: Accepted-price aggregates, comparisons, exports; Canonical boundary / legacy constraint: Preserve immutable acceptance value; any additional historical reporting conversion follows Rule 10; Owning payment/refund/commission/payout records: Where used: Financial aggregates; Canonical boundary / legacy constraint: Deduplicate before quote-hierarchy joins; selected price is not a substitute for captured transaction amounts
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 1593-1600. Analytics Data Contract and Legacy Compatibility table.

nodes.title: Do not backfill accepted amounts; show unavailable instead

attrs.statement: Do not backfill an accepted amount by choosing a current alternative or consulting today's package library. System-wide schema/spec updates and implementation migration are outside this FR-014 documentation change.
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1614. Analytics Data Contract closing paragraph.

nodes.title: Admin analytics responsive across desktop, tablet and mobile

attrs.rationale: PRD line 1622. Assumption 3 (a layout rule). Restated by Screen 1 Layout (line 130).

nodes.title: Payout cadence sourced from provider commission configuration

attrs.rationale: PRD line 1624. Assumption 5 (a data-source rule). FR-015 dependency (line 1570) names provider_commissions.payment_cycle.

nodes.title: Caches never hold data across provider tenants

attrs.statement: Aggregate reads are cached per provider and filter combination and invalidated when the next aggregation cycle completes or the FR-026 configuration version changes. attrs.rationale: PRD line 1639. Implementation Notes, Caching; the tenant-isolation sentence is a business rule.

nodes.title: Every analytics request scoped server-side to tenant and permitted domains

attrs.statement: Every analytics request is scoped server-side to the caller's provider tenant and permitted data domains (Rules 15A, 15B and 15F); the client never filters restricted data. Access is logged per Rule 15. Export artifacts are stored in S-05 with secure links that expire after 48 hours, and benchmark outputs only expose anonymised peer statistics above the minimum peer count.
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1640. Implementation Notes, Security and audit logging; restates Rules 15, 15A, 15B, 15F, the 48-hour secure link and the benchmark minimum.

nodes.title: Screen 1 header filters and cross-filtering

This clarifies click behaviour only; sections, widgets, chart types, filters, and layout are unchanged. Tooltips state metric definition + numerator/denominator + time basis. Localize dates/currencies/timezone. Skeletons on load.

nodes.title: Screen 1 Tile 2 TTFQ colour tiers

attrs.statement: Value: p50 and p90 vs SLA (compact dual-bullet); Color: Green (p50 ≤ SLA and p90 ≤ 2×SLA) · Amber (p50 ≤ SLA and p90 > 2×SLA) · Red (p50 > SLA); Tap → the FR-003 provider inquiry list filtered to the inquiries in the period; response time is per provider, not per team member; admin-authored replacement quotes (FR-004 Workflow 7) are not counted
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 154-156.

nodes.title: TTFQ formula: first send minus distribution per provider/inquiry

attrs.statement: TTFQ formula: `Parent Quote.first_sent_at` of the provider's earliest parent quote for the inquiry `− inquiry_providers.distributed_at` per `(providerId, inquiryId)` (elapsed wall time from the inquiry's distribution to that provider; display in provider timezone). This is the same clock as the FR-020/FR-030 `inquiry.ttfq_sla_breached` alert, so a provider who receives an inquiry later (for example after an FR-003 exclusive-provider decline releases it to normal distribution) is not penalised for time before distribution. Missing `distributed_at` yields no TTFQ observation for that pair, not a fallback to `inquiry.created_at`. `first_sent_at` is set by FR-004 on the parent quote's first send; a re-send or new version never changes it. Draft creation, option/date-price creation, later parent quotes, edits, and resends do not reset the first-response timestamp. Exclude auto-acks; calls/messages do not stop the clock.
attrs.rationale: PRD line 158. Fixed in codebase (line 1509). Shares its clock with the SLA-breach alert.

nodes.title: Screen 1 Inquiry Queue columns, New badge, sort and paging

attrs.statement: Received: Relative time + SLA countdown timer; Patient: ID-masked (HP102589-0001 · "Aylin K****"); Age: Patient age; Problem: Treatment area; Country: Patient country; Actions: View link; Row badge: `New` = inquiry distributed to this provider (FR-003 `inquiry_providers`) with no parent quote submitted by the provider yet (FR-004). Default sort: `New` rows first, then received time ascending. 10 per page.
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 164-171.

nodes.title: Screen 1 B1 four-stage booking funnel

attrs.statement: Chart: Funnel chart; Stages: Inquiries → Quoted → Accepted → Confirmed booking; Each stage: Count + Step % (stage ÷ previous stage); Footer: Overall booking conversion = Confirmed bookings ÷ Inquiries; Confirmed booking = the first successful initial charge of the option the patient chose (full payment, deposit, or first installment) confirms the FR-006 Booking. `In Progress` means procedure started via FR-010 and is not the payment-confirmation label. Count distinct inquiry/provider pairs in a single inquiry cohort cumulatively through each reached stage, per Analytics Counting & Time Basis; multiple parent quotes and subquotes do not multiply the funnel. Drill-down: click stage → the FR-003 provider inquiry list with that stage, the period and the country filter (when set) pre-applied
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 179-185.

nodes.title: Screen 1 B2 TTFQ vs SLA bullet chart

attrs.statement: Chart: Bullet chart (p50 + p90, SLA as target marker); Axis: 0 → max(3×SLA, 1.2×p90), units = minutes (render h:m); Color: Green/Amber/Red per TTFQ formula above; Drill-down: click → the FR-003 provider inquiry list filtered to the inquiries in the period
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 189-192.

nodes.title: Screen 1 B3 Booking Intensity Index

attrs.statement: Chart: Calendar heatmap (6 rows × 7 cols, Mon→Sun); Colored metric: Intensity Index = `(Bookings_on_day ÷ MonthlyDailyAvg_for_that_day's_month) × 100`; `Bookings_on_day` counts FR-006 Bookings whose appointment falls on that day and whose status is `Confirmed`, `In Progress`, `Aftercare` or `Completed` (the "Scheduled bookings" figure; "Confirmed bookings" elsewhere keeps the payment-milestone meaning). Held bookings (`Accepted`), `Payment Window Expired` and `Cancelled` bookings never count, and no separate held figure is shown. The monthly average uses the same status filter. Color scale: ≤50% Cool · 50–90% Below avg · 90–110% Neutral · 110–150% Above avg · >150% Hot; Cell tooltip: `Scheduled bookings: N • Monthly avg: m/day • Index: X%`; Drill-down: click cell → Schedule day view; Baseline priority: 12-month same-month avg → current MTD → rolling 90-day; Index clamped 0–300% for coloring; actual value in tooltip
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 196-203. Intensity formula fixed in codebase (line 1510); status filter restated by REQ-014-116 and Key Entity 2 (line 1789).

nodes.title: Screen 1 B4 Patient Location donut

attrs.statement: Chart: Donut (top 8 countries by inquiry share + Other); Center: total Inquiries in range; Slice labels: `CC (ISO-2) • %`; Slice border: thin/neutral <20% confirmed booking rate · medium/amber 20–40% · thick/green >40%; Tooltip: `Country • Inquiries: N • Confirmed bookings: B • Confirmed booking rate: R%`; Confirmed bookings and the confirmed booking rate use the inquiry cohort and Confirmed booking stage defined in Analytics Counting & Time Basis (rate = Confirmed bookings ÷ Inquiries). Drill-down: click slice → the FR-003 provider inquiry list with that country and the period pre-applied
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 207-213.

nodes.title: Screen 1 C1 Earnings Trend

attrs.statement: Chart: Area line chart (weekly, X = ISO week start, Y = income in provider currency); Single series: Income only; Drill-down: click week → Earnings report filtered to that week
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 221-223.

nodes.title: Screen 1 C2 Revenue by Treatment Pareto

attrs.statement: Chart: Pareto bar chart (ranked bars + cumulative % line); X = treatment (dynamic), Y₁ = income, Y₂ = cumulative %; Top N + Other; drill-down: click bar → Cases list filtered by treatment; Treatment attribution follows Screen 4 Widget 2 (definition only; chart and layout unchanged)
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 227-230.

nodes.title: Screen 1 C3 accepted-but-unpaid aging

attrs.statement: Chart: Stacked horizontal bar; Buckets: 0–24h · 1–3d · 4–7d · 8–14d · >14d; X = count of accepted selections awaiting successful initial payment; optional legend by treatment (top 3) or country; Age = snapshot time − `AcceptanceEvent.acceptedAt`, or the start of the current hold when an admin has revived an expired booking; count one pending Booking/AcceptanceEvent with a valid exclusive payment-window hold. Exclude cancelled selections, superseded acceptance events, expired holds, and `Payment Window Expired` bookings, even if a flat quote status still says Accepted. Snapshot: this chart shows the current state and ignores the time range filter (REQ-014-317); Drill-down: click bucket → Accepted Quotes list resolved to the exact accepted subquote and pending booking; retain the same chart and buckets. Older buckets may legitimately be empty with the default 48-hour hold; use the actual configured deadline, not an assumed fixed limit.
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 234-238.

nodes.title: Screen 1 C4 Payouts history and upcoming

attrs.statement: Chart: Column bar (monthly, last 6–12 months) + inline table (2–3 rows); Inline table columns: Type, Period, Amount, Scheduled Date, Cadence; Type = the provider display status from the Screen 4 Widget 8 FR-017 mapping (Upcoming / Processing / Paid / Failed; Voided is never shown). Rows: the next Upcoming payout, any Processing or Failed payout, then the most recent Paid payout, up to 3 rows. Scheduled Date = FR-017 scheduled payout date; for Paid rows it shows the paid date. Cadence = how the payout is released (see Assumption 5), not a per-clinic frequency. Definition only; columns and layout unchanged; Fixed window: this tile ignores the time range filter; Drill-down: click bar → Payout statements list (CSV/PDF export)
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 242-245.

nodes.title: Error state: non-blocking banners, retry and telemetry

nodes.title: Screen 2 Widget 1 Funnel Conversion Trend

attrs.statement: Chart type: Multi-line chart (one line per funnel stage); X axis: Week or month (toggle); Y axis: Conversion % to that stage from Inquiries; Lines: Quoted % · Accepted % · Confirmed booking %; Drill-down: Click a point → the FR-003 provider inquiry list with that stage and the period pre-applied; Calculation: Each stage % = distinct inquiry/provider pairs in the selected inquiry cohort that have reached that stage by the reporting cutoff ÷ all inquiry/provider pairs in that cohort. Counts are cumulative, not mutually exclusive highest-stage buckets. Use the shared cohort and cutoff definitions in Analytics Counting & Time Basis.
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 270-276.

nodes.title: Screen 2 Widget 2 Conversion by Treatment Type

attrs.statement: Chart type: Grouped bar chart; X axis: Treatment type (from catalog); Y axis: Quote-to-booking conversion % (Quoted → Confirmed booking); Groups per bar: Quoted count, Accepted count, Confirmed booking count; Drill-down: Click bar → filtered list of quoted inquiries for that treatment; Data source: Patients do not choose a treatment in the FR-003 inquiry; the provider chooses it in the FR-004 Parent Quote. A treatment segment therefore starts at Quoted: the base is inquiries quoted with that treatment (Parent Quote treatment context), and Accepted and Confirmed booking stages follow the FR-005/FR-006 handoff for that treatment. Inquiries that were never quoted have no treatment and appear only in the all-treatments funnel (Widget 1). Deduplicate `(providerId, inquiryId, treatmentId)` within each treatment segment before counting stages; child options, date-price records, and quote revisions MUST NOT multiply counts. An inquiry may appear in more than one treatment segment, so segment counts are not additive.
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 284-290.

nodes.title: Screen 2 Widget 3 Conversion by Patient Country

attrs.statement: Chart type: Horizontal ranked bar chart; Y axis: Patient country (top 10 by inquiry volume); X axis: Booking conversion % (Inquiries → Confirmed booking); Secondary bar: Inquiry count (context for the rate); Drill-down: Click bar → the FR-003 provider inquiry list with that country and the period pre-applied; Data source: `inquiries.patient_id → patients.location_id → countries.name`, with temporary fallback to legacy `patients.location` only for unmigrated rows.
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 298-304.

nodes.title: Screen 2 Widget 4 Quote Acceptance Rate Trend

attrs.statement: Chart type: Line chart; X axis: Week or month (toggle); Y axis: Parent-quote acceptance rate = distinct accepted parent quotes ÷ distinct submitted parent quotes in the same first-submission cohort; Drill-down: Click point → parent Quotes list for that first-submission cohort, with accepted subquote provenance where present
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 312-315.

nodes.title: Screen 2 Widget 5 TTFQ Trend

attrs.statement: Chart type: Dual-line chart (p50 line + p90 line); X axis: Week or month (toggle); Y axis: Minutes (render as h:m); Reference line: SLA target; Color band: Green/Amber/Red zones based on SLA thresholds; Drill-down: Click point → the FR-003 provider inquiry list with the period pre-applied, sorted by TTFQ
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 323-328.

nodes.title: Screen 2 Widget 6 Cancellation and No-Show Rate

attrs.statement: Chart type: Two KPI tiles + trend sparklines; Tile 1: Cancellation rate = cancelled (post-confirmed) ÷ confirmed bookings; Tile 2: No-show rate = no-show ÷ confirmed bookings; Sparkline: Rate trend over selected period; Drill-down: Click Cancellation tile → Bookings list filtered to post-confirmation cancellations (FR-006); click No-show tile → Cases list filtered to FR-010 closure reason `No-show`; Data source: Cancellations come from post-confirmation cancellations in the FR-006 Booking lifecycle. No-shows come from FR-010 case closures with closure reason `No-show`; No-show is an admin-managed case closure label, not a booking pipeline status. Each confirmed booking counts at most once, and a booking closed as No-show counts as a no-show, not a cancellation. Draft/quote expiry and `Payment Window Expired` before confirmation are not post-confirmation cancellations or no-shows. Historical acceptance remains recorded separately. Both rates use the confirmation cohort, like Screen 11 Widget 1: the denominator is the bookings first confirmed in the period, and the numerators are the cancellations and no-shows among those same bookings, whenever they occur.
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 336-342.

nodes.title: Screen 2 Widget 7 Platform Benchmarks

nodes.title: Screen 3 Widget 1 Full Patient Location Breakdown

attrs.statement: Chart type: Ranked table + donut chart (linked); Table columns: Country · Inquiries · Confirmed bookings · Confirmed booking rate · Avg rating (Confirmed bookings and rate follow the inquiry cohort and Confirmed booking stage in Analytics Counting & Time Basis); Table: All countries (not capped at 8); sortable by any column; Donut: Top 10 countries by inquiry volume + Other; Drill-down: Click row/slice → Inquiries list filtered to that country; Avg rating: average `overall_rating` of this provider's Published or Flagged FR-013 reviews (FR-013 REQ-013-079) published within the selected range, grouped by the reviewing patient's country (review → patient → `patients.location_id → countries.name`, with the same legacy `patients.location` fallback). Shows "—" when the country has no reviews in range; the review count appears in the tooltip.
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 379-385.

nodes.title: Screen 3 Widget 2 New vs Returning Patients (provider-scoped)

attrs.statement: Chart type: Donut (current period split) + trend line over time; Definition: Provider-scoped: New = patient's first inquiry distributed to this provider · Returning = patient with an earlier inquiry distributed to this provider; Trend: New vs. Returning count per month over selected range; Drill-down: Click segment → Patient list filtered by type; Data source: `inquiries.patient_id` joined to this provider's `inquiry_providers` records — count distinct patient_ids whose earliest inquiry distributed to this provider falls in the range = New; patients in the range with an earlier inquiry distributed to this provider = Returning. Inquiries the patient sent only to other providers do not make them Returning.
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 393-398. Restated by Screen 3 Business Rules (line 458: returning is based on the same provider's patient base).

nodes.title: Screen 3 Widget 3 Patient Journey Time

attrs.statement: Chart type: Two KPI tiles + distribution histogram; Tile 1: Median days from inquiry → payment (p50); Tile 2: p90 days from inquiry → payment; Histogram: Distribution of journey durations in days (binned: 0–7d · 8–14d · 15–30d · 31–60d · >60d); Drill-down: Click histogram bin → Inquiries list filtered to that journey-duration range; Calculation: first successful initial-payment capture time that confirms the FR-006 Booking − `inquiry.created_at`, for bookings first confirmed within the selected range. Resolve the booking through its AcceptanceEvent and selected subquote; count the inquiry once. Payment-attempt creation, failed attempts, later installments, and retries of the same successful event MUST NOT add journey observations.
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 406-412.

nodes.title: Screen 3 Widget 4 Review Sub-Scores by Treatment

attrs.statement: Chart type: Grouped bar chart; X axis: Treatment type; Y axis: Score (1–5); Groups per bar: Overall · Results · Staff · Facility · Value; Data source: FR-013 per-treatment sub-scores endpoint (REQ-013-023), keyed by `treatment_id`, Published or Flagged reviews only (REQ-013-023); not joined through quote status; Drill-down: Click bar → Reviews list filtered to that treatment
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 420-425.

nodes.title: Screen 3 Widget 5 Treatment Preference Distribution

attrs.statement: Chart type: Horizontal ranked bar chart; Y axis: Treatment type; X axis: Quoted inquiry count + Booking count (dual bars); Purpose: What treatments the provider quotes most vs. what actually gets booked; Drill-down: Click bar → filtered Inquiries or Bookings list; Data source: Quoted bars count distinct inquiries the provider quoted, by the treatment of the submitted Parent Quote (FR-004); inquiries have no treatment until quoted. Booking bars count Confirmed bookings (FR-006), by the treatment of the accepted parent quote (FR-005 AcceptanceEvent). Both follow Analytics Counting & Time Basis; quote statuses are not used.
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 433-439.

nodes.title: Screen 3 Widget 6 Aftercare Activation Rate

attrs.statement: Chart type: KPI tile + trend sparkline; Value: Aftercare plans activated ÷ completed treatments; Drill-down: Click → Aftercare records list; Data source: FR-011 aftercare records created for procedures completed in the period ÷ procedures completed in the period (FR-010 completion), by the accepted parent's treatment. Each completed procedure counts once.
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 447-451.

nodes.title: Screen 3 shows no patient names or identifiers

attrs.statement: PII: no patient names or identifiers shown; all aggregated.
attrs.rationale: PRD line 459. Screen 3 Business Rules.

nodes.title: Screen 4 Widget 1 Revenue Trend

attrs.statement: Chart type: Area line chart; X axis: Week / Month / Quarter (toggle); Y axis: Income amount (provider currency); Single series: Income (captured payments only); Drill-down: Click period → Payments list filtered to that period; Calculation: Gross captured income per the Refund Source of Truth rule — `SUM(payments.amount)` where `payment_type ≠ 'refund'` and `payment_status IN ('completed', 'refunded')`, bucketed by `payments.created_at`. A later refund does not remove the original payment from income.
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 475-481.

nodes.title: Screen 4 Widget 2 Revenue by Treatment attribution

attrs.statement: Chart type: Horizontal ranked bar chart (full list, paginated if >15); Y axis: Treatment name (all, not capped); X axis: Income amount; Secondary metric: % of total revenue; Drill-down: Click bar → Payments list filtered to that treatment; Data source: Income per the Refund Source of Truth rule, attributed to a treatment through payment → FR-006 Booking → FR-005 AcceptanceEvent → accepted parent quote's treatment. Each payment is attributed once. Payments that cannot be resolved to an accepted parent are shown as "Unattributed", not dropped or assigned to a guessed treatment. Screen 1 C2 uses the same attribution.
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 489-495. Referenced by Screen 1 C2 (line 230).

nodes.title: Screen 4 Widget 3 Revenue by Patient Country

attrs.statement: Chart type: Horizontal ranked bar chart; Y axis: Patient country (top 10 + Other); X axis: Income amount; Secondary metric: Patient count; Drill-down: Click bar → Payments list filtered to that country; Data source: `payments.patient_id → patients.location_id → countries.name`, with temporary fallback to legacy `patients.location` only for unmigrated rows.
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 503-509.

nodes.title: Screen 4 Widget 4 Commission and Income After Commission

attrs.statement: Chart type: Three KPI tiles + trend line (both on same chart); Tile 1: Total income (gross); Tile 2: Commission deducted; Tile 3: "Income after commission (before refunds)" = Total income (gross) − Commission deducted, for the same period; Trend: Gross income line + commission deducted area, stacked; Calculation: Commission deducted = sum of percentage-model deductions for each completed payment in range plus flat-rate deductions for each procedure completed in range (FR-010 completion, per FR-015). Each deduction uses the booking's commission snapshot taken at booking confirmation (FR-015 REQ-015-022, FR-029), not the provider's current commission settings: Percentage model: `payments.amount × (snapshot_commission_percentage / 100)`; Flat-rate model: `snapshot_commission_amount` once per completed procedure, regardless of procedure price, number of payments, or installments (FR-015); Gross, commission, and income after commission are displayed in provider currency. These tiles do not subtract refunds or reverse commission on refunded money; refunds are reported separately in Widget 5, and the platform reverses the commission on refunded money with the refund. Tile 3 tooltip: flat-rate commission is recognised at completion of the procedure.
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 517-528. Commission logic fixed in codebase (line 1511).

nodes.title: Screen 4 Widget 5 Refunds

attrs.statement: Chart type: Two KPI tiles + trend; Tile 1: Total refund amount (period); Tile 2: Refund rate = refund count ÷ captured payment count (both per the Refund Source of Truth rule); Trend: Monthly refund rate over selected range; Drill-down: Click → Payments list filtered to refund type; Data source: Refund rows only — `payments.payment_type = 'refund'` with `payment_status = 'completed'` (Refund Source of Truth rule). The original payment's `refunded` status is not counted as a second refund.
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 536-542.

nodes.title: Screen 4 Widget 6 Payment Option Split

attrs.statement: Chart type: Donut + KPI summary; Segments: Payment option chosen: Full payment · Deposit plus balance · Installment plan; KPI: Avg number of installments for installment plans; Trend: Monthly installment adoption rate = bookings first confirmed in the month whose payment is an FR-007B installment plan ÷ all bookings first confirmed in the month (one observation per booking); Drill-down: Click segment → Bookings list filtered to that payment option; Data source: the donut and the trend both count bookings by the payment option the patient chose at confirmation, one observation per booking, so the two values use the same unit; FR-007B installment plan records supply the average installment count.
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 550-556.

nodes.title: Screen 4 Widget 7 Cash-at-Risk Summary

attrs.statement: Chart type: KPI tile + link to Main Dashboard Section C3 for full aging detail; Value: Sum of accepted subquote total prices for selections awaiting initial payment with a valid hold; label as potential accepted booking value, not captured revenue or outstanding installment debt; Count: Distinct pending bookings/AcceptanceEvents in each aging bucket, following Screen 1 C3 exclusions and deadline checks; Note: This is a summary view; the full aging stacked bar is in Screen 1 Section C3. Snapshot tile: it ignores the time range filter. A booking revived by an admin counts again, aged from the start of its current hold
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 564-567.

nodes.title: Screen 4 Widget 8 Payout History and FR-017 status mapping

attrs.statement: Chart type: Column bar chart (monthly, full history) + paginated table below; Bar chart: Last 12 months of disbursed payouts; Table columns: Period · Amount · Status (Upcoming / Processing / Paid / Failed) · Paid date · Cadence (how the payout is released, see Assumption 5); All rows: Full history (not limited to the 2–3 rows shown in the Main Dashboard Section C4 inline table); fixed window, so this widget ignores the time range filter; Drill-down: Click bar or row → Payout statement detail (CSV/PDF export); Payout status mapping (FR-017): Upcoming: No statement yet for the period, or Pending Approval, Approved, or Overdue (internal admin review states are not shown to providers), or Waiting for clinic setup (`waiting_for_clinic_setup`, a Stripe Connect payout), shown with the note "Payout setup incomplete" and a link to the payout setup in provider settings; Processing: Processing (Stripe transfer initiated); Paid: Paid (`transfer.paid`); Paid date = webhook time; Failed: Failed (`transfer.failed`); returns to Processing when admin retries; (not shown): Voided — excluded from the provider's payout chart, table, totals, and exports. Voided is an internal admin audit state; the period appears as Upcoming again once FR-017 re-generates a statement on the next payout cycle
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 575-589. FR-017 dependency (line 1572: Voided excluded from provider-facing payout views and exports).

nodes.title: Commission from booking confirmation snapshot with period note

attrs.statement: Commission is calculated from each booking's commission snapshot taken at booking confirmation (FR-015 REQ-015-022), not from a single percentage-only field or the provider's current settings; provider screens must display a note clarifying whether the period includes percentage-based deductions, flat-rate deductions, or both
attrs.rationale: PRD line 596. Screen 4 Business Rules.

nodes.title: Finance amounts in provider currency with historical FX note

attrs.statement: All amounts in provider currency; FX rates locked at payment `created_at` date; footer note "Historical exchange rates applied"
attrs.rationale: PRD line 597. Screen 4 Business Rules.

nodes.title: Payout history shows each payout period with its display status

attrs.statement: Payout history shows each payout period with its provider display status (Upcoming, Processing, Paid or Failed) per the Payout status mapping above; future payouts beyond the next scheduled one are not projected
attrs.rationale: PRD line 598. Screen 4 Business Rules.

nodes.title: Screen 5 Widget 1 Average Accepted Price by Treatment

attrs.statement: Chart type: Bar chart + trend line; X axis: Treatment type; Y axis: Average accepted subquote total price (provider reporting currency); Trend overlay: Provider's own average accepted price over time, bucketed by AcceptanceEvent.acceptedAt; Drill-down: Click bar → Quotes list filtered to accepted selections for that treatment and acceptance period
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 615-619.

nodes.title: Screen 5 Widget 2 Accepted Price Distribution

attrs.statement: Chart type: Histogram; X axis: Accepted subquote total price (binned, e.g., 0–1k · 1k–2k · 2k–3k · 3k–5k · >5k; dynamic bins based on accepted-price range); Y axis: Accepted selection count (one observation per accepted parent quote); Reference lines: Median accepted price · Platform median accepted price (anonymised); Drill-down: Click bin → Quotes list filtered to accepted selections in that price range and acceptance period
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 627-631.

nodes.title: Screen 5 Widget 3 Accepted Price vs Acceptance Rate scatter

attrs.statement: Chart type: Scatter plot; X axis: Average accepted subquote price among accepted parents in the selected first-submission cohort, per treatment type; Y axis: Distinct accepted parent quotes ÷ all submitted parent quotes in that same cohort, per treatment type; Points: One point per treatment type (labelled); Reference lines: Platform median X (average accepted price) and platform median Y (parent-quote acceptance rate), using the same cohort and reporting cutoff; Purpose: Descriptive comparison of accepted prices and acceptance rates across treatments; does not show conversion probability at an offered price or prove a causal price effect; Note: A treatment needs a non-zero submitted-parent denominator and at least one accepted selection to have both coordinates. If fewer than 3 treatment types qualify, replace the chart with "Insufficient treatment variety to compare accepted prices and acceptance rates." Unaccepted parents remain in Y's denominator but contribute no amount to X; tooltips show both sample sizes and the first-submission cohort basis, which differs from acceptance-period pricing widgets.
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 639-646.

nodes.title: Screen 5 Widget 4 Platform Benchmark Comparison

attrs.statement: Chart type: Comparison table; Rows (metrics): TTFQ p50 · Overall booking conversion rate · Parent-quote acceptance rate · Average accepted price · Avg overall rating · Avg results rating; Columns: Provider value · Platform median · Variance (±%) · Percentile band (Bottom 25% / Mid 50% / Top 25%); Color coding: Per the Shared Benchmark Rule: Green = at or better than median · Amber = up to 10% worse · Red = more than 10% worse; TTFQ lower is better; average accepted price has no colour; Drill-down: Click metric row → corresponding detailed screen (e.g., TTFQ → Screen 2 Widget 5); Business rule: Benchmark pool follows the Shared Benchmark Rule in Analytics Counting & Time Basis (≥30 inquiries, rolling 12 months, minimum 5 providers). If pool is too small, display "Not enough peer providers to generate a meaningful benchmark yet."
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 654-660.

nodes.title: Benchmark data refreshes at the configured frequency

attrs.statement: Benchmark data refreshes at the FR-026 Analytics Configuration benchmark refresh frequency (default Weekly; not real-time)
attrs.rationale: PRD line 667. Screen 5 Business Rules.

nodes.title: Amount metrics use only immutable accepted-selection prices

attrs.statement: Amount metrics use only immutable accepted-selection prices, including the accepted promotion; never substitute a minimum, maximum, average, or sum of unaccepted alternatives. Historical acceptance remains an observation after later cancellation or hold expiry; those outcomes are measured separately.
attrs.rationale: PRD line 668. Screen 5 Business Rules.

nodes.title: Price widgets use acceptance-time cohort; scatter uses first-submission cohort

attrs.statement: Standalone price widgets use the acceptance-time cohort. The scatter explicitly uses the parent first-submission cohort so both axes refer to the same offered parent population.
attrs.rationale: PRD line 669. Screen 5 Business Rules.

nodes.title: Prices in provider reporting currency with preserved provenance

attrs.statement: Price displayed in provider reporting currency; preserve the accepted currency and locked exchange-rate provenance and apply Rule 10 for any additional reporting-currency conversion. Apply the same historical conversion basis to provider and peer amounts; current package prices or today's FX MUST NOT rewrite the accepted value.
attrs.rationale: PRD line 670. Screen 5 Business Rules.

nodes.title: Price benchmarks include only peers with accepted-price observations

attrs.statement: Price benchmarks include only peers with accepted-price observations; the existing minimum 5-provider benchmark pool still applies to that metric. Unaccepted parents are not zero-price observations.
attrs.rationale: PRD line 671. Screen 5 Business Rules.

nodes.title: Screen 6 export form fields and constraints

attrs.statement: Report type: Radio; Screens to include: Checkboxes for Screens 2 to 5 (a screen on which the user can see no widget cannot be selected); Date range: Date picker; Country filter: Dropdown; Treatment filter: Dropdown; Email delivery: Checkbox; Recipients: Multi-select; Schedule recurring: Checkbox + select
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 683-690. Screen 6 Data Fields.

nodes.title: Export contains only widgets the generating user may see

attrs.statement: Widget-level permission scope: an export contains only the widgets the generating user is permitted to see on each selected screen (Rules 15A, 15B and 15F); widgets the user cannot see are omitted, not shown empty or locked. Recurring runs re-resolve this scope against the configuration owner's permissions at run time. Each generated report records the user it was generated for: the requesting user for a one-off report, the configuration owner for a recurring run.
attrs.rationale: PRD line 694. Screen 6 Business Rules.

nodes.title: PDF uses provider logo and platform default palette

attrs.statement: PDF reports include provider logo sourced from `providers.profile_image`; no provider-specific color theming (platform default palette is used) — schema does not define brand color fields and this is intentional for v1
attrs.rationale: PRD line 695. Screen 6 Business Rules.

nodes.title: Export email: PDF attachment and 48-hour secure link via analytics.export_ready

attrs.statement: Email delivery: PDF attachment + secure link (expires 48 hours), sent through S-03 as the FR-030 `analytics.export_ready` event (email + in-app) to each recipient
attrs.rationale: PRD line 698. Screen 6 Business Rules. Restated by Communication Structure (line 59), S-03 dependency (line 1577) and Implementation Notes (line 1628).

nodes.title: Maximum 5 active recurring configurations per provider

attrs.statement: Max 5 active recurring configurations per provider
attrs.rationale: PRD line 699. Screen 6 Business Rules; restated by Tab 2 heading (line 722).

nodes.title: Recurring run covers previous full period, starts 06:00 provider time

attrs.statement: Recurring date range: each run covers the previous full period in the provider's timezone (`providers.timezone`): Monday–Sunday week, calendar month, or calendar quarter. Runs start at 06:00 provider local time on the first day after the period ends.
attrs.rationale: PRD line 700. Screen 6 Business Rules.

nodes.title: Recurring failures retried 3 times; no partial report emailed

attrs.statement: Recurring failures: a failed run is retried up to 3 times at 30-minute intervals; after the final failure the run shows as Failed in Report History with a manual retry action. No partial report is emailed. A run that fails its final retry also sends the configuration owner an in-app "recurring export failed" notice (FR-030 and FR-020 own the notice).
attrs.rationale: PRD line 701. Screen 6 Business Rules.

nodes.title: Recurring configurations can be edited, paused, resumed or deleted

attrs.statement: Recurring management: providers can edit, pause, resume, or delete a recurring configuration; edits apply from the next run. Recipients who are deactivated or lose permission are dropped automatically at the next run. Any user who can see every widget in a recurring configuration may edit or delete it. A configuration whose owner is removed, or loses access to every widget in it, is paused and the clinic Owner receives an in-app "recurring export paused" notice (FR-030 and FR-020 own the notice).
attrs.rationale: PRD line 702. Screen 6 Business Rules.

nodes.title: PDF and CSV state definitions, sample size, currency, FX basis and data-as-of

attrs.statement: PDF and CSV MUST use the same counting units, cohorts, cutoff, accepted-price eligibility, and financial deduplication as the included screens. State the metric definition, sample size, reporting currency, FX basis, and data-as-of time. For detailed quote/acceptance rows, retain authorized inquiry/provider IDs, parent/option/date-price/subquote IDs, AcceptanceEvent and booking IDs where present, accepted aggregate versions, and immutable price/currency provenance; unaccepted parent rows have no accepted amount or accepted-choice IDs.
attrs.rationale: PRD line 703. Screen 6 Business Rules.

nodes.title: Report History Tab 1 Generated Reports

attrs.statement: Tab 1 — Generated Reports (reports generated in the last 7 days, newest first, 20 per page): Generated at: Timestamp; Report type: Label; Screens included: Text list; Period covered: Date range; Trigger: Label; Status: Badge; Expires on: Date; Actions: Buttons
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 709, 713-720.

nodes.title: Report History Tab 2 Recurring Exports

attrs.statement: Tab 2 — Recurring Exports (all of the provider's recurring configurations, maximum 5 active): Frequency: Label; Report type and screens: Text; Recipients: Count + tooltip list; Next run: Timestamp; Last run status: Badge; Status: Badge; Actions: Buttons
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 722, 726-732.

nodes.title: Only users permitted for every widget see or download a report

attrs.statement: Only users permitted to view every widget in a report can see or download it (Rules 15A/15B); downloads use the same secure-link mechanism as email delivery.
attrs.rationale: PRD line 734. Report History rules.

nodes.title: Resuming a paused configuration does not back-fill runs

attrs.statement: Resuming a paused configuration does not back-fill runs missed while it was paused.
attrs.rationale: PRD line 735. Report History rules.

nodes.title: Report History empty states

attrs.statement: Empty states: "No reports generated in the last 7 days" and "No recurring exports set up".
attrs.rationale: PRD line 736. Report History rules.

nodes.title: Screen 7 Tile 1 Active Providers

attrs.statement: Value: Count of providers with `status = active` at the end of the selected period; Sub-value: New providers onboarded in period; Tap → Provider Management (FR-015)
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 756-758.

nodes.title: Screen 7 Tile 2 Total Inquiries

attrs.statement: Value: Platform-wide inquiry count in period; Sub-value: % change vs. prior equivalent period; a zero prior period shows "New" when the current count is above zero, otherwise N/A; Tap → Inquiries list (admin)
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 762-764.

nodes.title: Screen 7 Tile 3 New Patients Registered

attrs.statement: Value: `patients.created_at` count in period; Sub-value: % change vs. prior equivalent period, with the same zero-prior rule as Tile 2; Tap → Patient Management (FR-016)
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 768-769. FR-016 dependency (line 1571).

nodes.title: Screen 7 Tile 4 Provider TTFQ Health Distribution

attrs.statement: Chart: Donut (Green / Amber / Red provider counts); Value: Count and % in each tier; a provider with no TTFQ observation in the period is shown as a separate grey "No data" tier with a text label and its count, kept out of the donut slices and out of the percentages of the three colour tiers; Tap → Screen 8 filtered to Red tier; the No data count taps to Screen 8 filtered to the No data tier
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 773-775.

nodes.title: Screen 7 Tile 5 Provider Engagement Rate

attrs.statement: Value: % of active providers who first submitted at least 1 parent quote within the Dormant threshold window (FR-026 Analytics Configuration, default 30 days) ending at the period end. "Active providers" here means account `status = active` (the Tile 1 definition, FR-015), not the activity-based Active engagement status in Screen 8 Widget 3; Sub-values: Dormant providers (the Screen 8 Widget 3 Dormant count, as of now; it ignores the time range filter and so equals the Dormant count on the Screen 8 list it opens) and Non-responding providers (0 first-submitted parent quotes within the same Dormant threshold window; drafts, child records, edits, and resends do not count as new submissions). These are separate counts; a provider can be active but non-responding. Tap → Screen 8 engagement section filtered to dormant
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 779-781.

nodes.title: Screen 7 B1 Platform-Wide Conversion Funnel

attrs.statement: Chart: Funnel chart (same 4 stages as provider funnel, but distinct platform inquiries, not summed provider funnels); Shows: Count + Step % for each stage; Footer: Overall platform booking conversion = Confirmed booking inquiries ÷ Inquiries; Drill-down: click stage → admin Inquiries list filtered to that stage
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 789-792.

nodes.title: Screen 7 B2 Platform TTFQ Distribution

attrs.statement: Chart: Bullet chart (platform p50 + p90 vs SLA default target); Shows: Distribution across all providers; Drill-down: click → Screen 8 (Provider Performance & Engagement) sorted by TTFQ
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 796-798.

nodes.title: Screen 7 B3 Top Patient Origin Countries

attrs.statement: Chart: Donut (top 8 countries by inquiry volume + Other); Drill-down: click slice → Screen 9 filtered to that country
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 802-803.

nodes.title: Screen 7 B4 Treatment Type Distribution

attrs.statement: Chart: Donut (share of quoted inquiries by treatment type, from the FR-004 Parent Quote treatment; inquiries have no treatment until quoted); Drill-down: click slice → Screen 11 filtered to that treatment
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 807-808.

nodes.title: Screen 7 C1 Platform GMV

attrs.statement: Value: `SUM(payments.amount)` where `payment_type ≠ 'refund'` and `payment_status IN ('completed', 'refunded')`, period (same GMV rule as Screen 12 Widget 1 and the Refund Source of Truth rule); Sub-value: % change vs. prior period, with the same zero-prior rule as Tile 2; Drill-down → Screen 12
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 816-818.

nodes.title: Screen 7 C2 Commission Earned

attrs.statement: Value: Sum of effective provider commission deductions in period, using each booking's confirmation-time commission snapshot (FR-015 REQ-015-022): percentage per completed payment; flat rate once per completed procedure (FR-015); commission on refunded money is reversed with the refund, so the figure counts commission on money kept; Sub-value: As % of GMV; Drill-down → Screen 12
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 822-824.

nodes.title: Screen 7 C3 Upcoming Provider Payout Obligations

attrs.statement: Value: Total payout amount due to providers in next 30 days; Sub-value: Number of providers in next payout cycle; Fixed window (next 30 days): this tile ignores the time range filter; Drill-down → Screen 12
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 828-830.

nodes.title: Screen 7 C4 Platform Cash-at-Risk

attrs.statement: Value: Total accepted subquote value in active pending initial-payment holds, platform-wide; same eligibility as Screen 1 C3 and Screen 4 Widget 7; Sub-value: Count of active pending selections >14 days aging (may be zero under the default 48-hour hold); expired windows are not active cash risk; a booking revived by an admin counts again, aged from the start of its current hold; snapshot tile: it ignores the time range filter; Drill-down → Screen 12
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 834-836.

nodes.title: Provider TTFQ tiers use the platform-wide SLA; no per-provider overrides

attrs.statement: Provider TTFQ health tiers use the platform-wide SLA target (admin-configurable in the FR-026 Analytics Configuration, Screen 5e); there are no per-provider SLA overrides in this version
attrs.rationale: PRD line 843. Screen 7 Business Rules. Restated by Assumption 4 (line 1611) and Admin Editability (line 1500).

nodes.title: Screen 7 time range scope: Sections A and B and the GMV and commission tiles only

attrs.statement: Only Sections A and B and the GMV and commission tiles (C1 and C2) follow the time range filter; C3 (next 30 days) and C4 (snapshot) ignore it. In Section A: Tile 1 shows providers with `status = active` at the end of the selected period plus those onboarded within it; Tiles 2 and 3 count records created within the period, compared with the prior equivalent period; Tile 4 tiers providers from TTFQ observations in the period; Tile 5 rate and Non-responding count use the trailing Dormant threshold window (default 30 days) ending at the period end, while its Dormant sub-value is the Screen 8 Widget 3 Dormant count and ignores the time range filter
attrs.rationale: PRD line 844. Screen 7 Business Rules.

nodes.title: Screen 8 Widget 1 Provider League Table and health badge

attrs.statement: Provider: Name + country flag; TTFQ p50: Value + color badge; Conversion rate: Distinct provider inquiry cohort → Confirmed booking %; Quote acceptance rate: Distinct accepted parent quotes ÷ distinct submitted parent quotes in the same first-submission cohort; Avg overall rating: Star rating (from reviews); Quote response rate: Distinct distributed inquiries answered ÷ distinct inquiries distributed to this provider in the same distribution cohort; vs. Platform: Variance column for conversion rate (+/−%); Provider-fault replacements: Count of admin-authored replacement quotes created in the selected period for FR-006 provider-fault transfers away from this provider; shown on its own and never added to quote counts, conversion, or TTFQ; Status: Health badge: Red if TTFQ tier is Red or conversion is more than 10% below platform median; Amber if TTFQ tier is Amber or conversion is up to 10% below median; otherwise Green. If the provider has <30 inquiries (Rule 7), the badge uses TTFQ only and shows a low-sample marker. A provider with no TTFQ observation in the period shows the grey "No data" tier with a text label instead of a health badge. "Platform median" is the median of the Shared Benchmark Rule peer pool; Sortable by any column; Default sort: TTFQ status (Red first) then conversion rate ascending; Paginated: 20 per page; Drill-down: click row → provider's own analytics view (read-only admin view of provider's Screen 2)
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 860-875.

nodes.title: Screen 8 Widget 2 Performance Distribution scatter

attrs.statement: Chart type: Scatter plot; X axis: TTFQ p50 (minutes); Y axis: Conversion rate (%); Points: One per provider, labelled with the provider name (admin view, Rule 14); Reference lines: Platform median TTFQ · Platform median conversion rate (the Shared Benchmark Rule median); a provider with no TTFQ observation has no point on the scatter; Quadrants: Fast + High conversion (ideal) · Slow + Low conversion (needs support); Drill-down: Click point → that provider's detail
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 881-887.

nodes.title: Screen 8 Widget 3 Provider Activity Table and engagement status

attrs.statement: Provider: Name + country; Last active: `MAX(action_at)` from `provider_activity_logs` for that `provider_id`; for last login specifically use `MAX(action_at) WHERE action_type = 'login'`; Quotes this month: Distinct parent quotes first submitted in current calendar month; no extra counts for options, date-price records, versions, or resends; Inquiry response rate: Distinct distributed inquiries answered ÷ distinct inquiries distributed to this provider (last 30-day distribution cohort); Status: Based on Last active: Active (activity within the At Risk threshold, default 7d) · At Risk (between the At Risk and Dormant thresholds, default 7–30d) · Dormant (no activity beyond the Dormant threshold, default 30d). Thresholds come from FR-026 Screen 5e; Filter by status (Active / At Risk / Dormant); Fixed window: status is as of now, Quotes this month is the current calendar month and the response rate is the last 30-day distribution cohort, so this widget ignores the time range filter; the Screen 7 Tile 5 Dormant count uses this Dormant definition; Drill-down: click row → provider detail in FR-015
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 895-904.

nodes.title: Screen 8 Widget 4 New Provider Ramp

attrs.statement: Chart type: Line chart (multiple series); X axis: Days since onboarding (0–90 days); Y axis: Cumulative distinct parent quotes first submitted; Series: Each provider onboarded in the selected period (one line each, labelled with provider name per Rule 14); Reference line: Platform average ramp curve; Purpose: Identify new providers who are struggling to get started; Data source: Providers with `created_at` within the selected period; parent `first_sent_at − providers.created_at` (`first_sent_at` is set by FR-004 on first send and never changed by a re-send) for days-since-onboarding offset. Count each parent identity once, regardless of later versions, resends, or child record counts.
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 910-917.

nodes.title: Screen 8 Widget 5 Engagement Health Summary

attrs.statement: Chart type: Three KPI tiles; Tile 1: Active providers count (Screen 8 Widget 3 status; default activity in last 7 days); Tile 2: At-risk providers count (Screen 8 Widget 3 status; default 7–30 days no activity); Tile 3: Dormant providers count (Screen 8 Widget 3 status; default >30 days no activity); Fixed window: these counts use the Widget 3 statuses as of now and ignore the time range filter
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 923-926.

nodes.title: Last-activity data from provider_activity_logs.action_at

attrs.statement: Last-activity data is sourced from `provider_activity_logs.action_at` (canonical activity log); last active = `MAX(action_at)` per provider; last login = `MAX(action_at) WHERE action_type = 'login'` per provider user. Do not use `provider_users.last_login_at` — this field does not exist in the schema.
attrs.rationale: PRD line 945. Screen 8 Business Rules.

nodes.title: Inquiry response rate bounded 0-100%; unavailable when distribution missing

attrs.statement: "Inquiry response rate" follows the shared distinct-inquiry distribution cohort definition and MUST stay between 0% and 100%. If authoritative distribution records are unavailable, display "Response rate unavailable — distribution data missing"; do not substitute parent quote count or total platform inquiries as the denominator.
attrs.rationale: PRD line 946. Screen 8 Business Rules.

nodes.title: Screen 9 Widget 1 Inquiry Volume Trend

attrs.statement: Chart type: Area line chart; X axis: Week or month (toggle); Y axis: Inquiry count; Comparison overlay: Prior equivalent period (dashed line); Drill-down: Click period → admin Inquiries list for that period
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 954-958.

nodes.title: Screen 9 Widget 2 Platform Funnel Trend

attrs.statement: Chart type: Multi-line chart (one line per stage); X axis: Month; Y axis: Conversion % to that stage from Inquiries; Lines: Quoted % · Accepted % · Confirmed booking %; Purpose: Show whether platform-wide conversion is improving or declining; Drill-down: Click line point → admin Inquiries list filtered to that stage + month
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 966-971.

nodes.title: Screen 9 Widget 3 New vs Returning Patients (platform-wide)

attrs.statement: Chart type: Stacked bar chart (monthly) + KPI tiles; Bars: New patient count + Returning patient count per month; Tile 1: New patient rate (period); Tile 2: Returning patient rate (period); Definition: New = first inquiry ever · Returning = has prior inquiry on record; Drill-down: Click bar segment → Patient list filtered by type and period
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 979-984.

nodes.title: Screen 9 Widget 4 Platform Patient Journey Time

attrs.statement: Chart type: Two KPI tiles + distribution histogram; Tile 1: Platform median days inquiry → payment (p50); Tile 2: Platform p90 days inquiry → payment; Histogram: Distribution across all converting patients (same bins as Screen 3 Widget 3); Calculation: Same first successful booking-confirming payment and one-observation-per-inquiry rule as Screen 3 Widget 3, across the platform; distribution to multiple providers or later installments does not multiply observations.
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 992-997.

nodes.title: Screen 9 Widget 5 Inquiry Seasonality

attrs.statement: Chart type: Month × weekday heatmap (intensity = weekday average vs. monthly daily average); Layout: 12 rows (months) × 7 columns (Mon→Sun); Intensity: `average daily inquiries on that weekday in that month ÷ that month's overall daily average × 100`; Purpose: Identify seasonal peaks and campaign-worthy slow periods; Cell tooltip: `Inquiries on this weekday: N • Weekday avg: w • Month daily avg: m • Index: X%`
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 1005-1009.

nodes.title: Screen 9 Widget 6 Affiliate Acquisition

attrs.statement: Chart type: Three KPI tiles + ranked table; Tile 1: Affiliate-sourced bookings (count in period); Tile 2: Affiliate contribution rate = affiliate bookings ÷ total bookings; Tile 3: Avg affiliate booking value = sum of FR-018 Entity 3 `Booking Total` for the affiliate-sourced bookings counted in Tile 1 ÷ that booking count, in platform base currency (USD, Rule 10); Table columns: Affiliate name · Bookings · Revenue · Commission owed · Conversion rate (FR-018 definition: checkouts where the code was applied and resulted in a booking ÷ checkouts where the code was applied); Drill-down: Click affiliate row → affiliate detail in FR-018; Data source: FR-018 Entity 3 `Booking with Affiliate Attribution`. Affiliate-sourced = payment-confirmed booking with a validly captured affiliate-bound code or affiliate auto-apply referral link, per FR-018 Rule 11. Attribution is counted even when a higher-priority patient or provider discount controlled the final price, so bookings, revenue, and commission owed reconcile with FR-018 referral credit. The final discount applied is not the attribution source. Limitation note: Affiliate tracking begins when the affiliate code or referral link is captured in the booking journey, not at the inquiry stage. It is not possible to attribute an inquiry to an affiliate source.
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 1017-1026. FR-018 dependency (line 1573).

nodes.title: Seasonality heatmap always rolling 12 months

attrs.statement: Seasonality heatmap always shows a rolling 12-month view regardless of time range filter (for pattern recognition)
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1044. Screen 9 Business Rules.

nodes.title: Affiliate rows only for affiliates with a booking in period

attrs.statement: Affiliate rows show only affiliates with at least 1 booking in the selected period; inactive affiliates are filtered out
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1045. Screen 9 Business Rules.

nodes.title: Screen 10 Widget 1 Patient Demand Map

attrs.statement: Chart type: Choropleth map OR ranked table with flag icons (implementation choice); Value mapped: Inquiry count per patient country (in selected period); Color scale: 5-bin scale from low (cool) to high (warm); Tooltip: `Country · Inquiries: N · Confirmed bookings: B · Conversion rate: R%` (Confirmed booking stage per Analytics Counting & Time Basis); Drill-down: Click country → filtered admin Inquiries list
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 1049-1053.

nodes.title: Screen 10 Widget 2 Provider Coverage by Country

attrs.statement: Chart type: Ranked horizontal bar chart; Y axis: Country (provider country); X axis: Active provider count; Drill-down: Click bar → Provider list filtered to that country
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 1061-1064.

nodes.title: Screen 10 Widget 3 Demand vs Supply Gap

attrs.statement: Chart type: Ranked table; Columns: Patient country · Inquiry count · Provider count (in that country) · Inquiries per provider · Gap flag; Gap flag: "No coverage" if the country has 0 active providers (inquiries per provider is shown as "—", not N/A); otherwise flagged if inquiries per provider > platform median by ≥50%; Sort: Default: "No coverage" countries first (by inquiry count descending), then inquiries per provider descending (highest gap first); Purpose: Identify countries to target for provider recruitment; Note: "Provider country" = provider's registered location. The gap metric is an approximation — patients may travel internationally, so a high inquiries-per-provider ratio in one country does not necessarily mean patients cannot be served.
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 1072-1078.

nodes.title: Screen 10 Widget 4 Conversion Rate by Patient Country

attrs.statement: Chart type: Horizontal ranked bar chart; Y axis: Patient country (top 15 by inquiry volume); X axis: Booking conversion rate (Inquiries → Confirmed booking); Secondary bar: Inquiry count (for context); Reference line: Platform median conversion rate; Drill-down: Click bar → admin Inquiries list filtered to that country
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 1086-1091.

nodes.title: Screen 10 Widget 5 Emerging Patient Origins

attrs.statement: Chart type: Ranked table; Columns: Country · Inquiry count (current period) · Inquiry count (prior period) · Growth %; Filter: Countries with >10 inquiries in current period and >20% growth vs prior period; when the prior period is zero and the current period is above 10, Growth % shows "New" and the country qualifies, and any other country with a zero prior period shows N/A and does not qualify; Purpose: Spot new markets before they become dominant
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 1099-1102.

nodes.title: Patient country from patients.location_id with legacy fallback

attrs.statement: Country data is sourced canonically from `patients.location_id → countries.name`; if `location_id` is null for legacy rows, the UI may temporarily fall back to `patients.location` until migration cleanup is complete. No IP-geolocation fallback is assumed in this version.
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1120. Screen 10 Business Rules. Restated by Assumption 6 (line 1613) and the data source lines of Screen 2 Widget 3 (line 304), Screen 3 Widget 1 (line 385) and Screen 4 Widget 3 (line 509).

nodes.title: Screen 11 Widget 1 Treatment Completion Rate

attrs.statement: Chart type: Bar chart; X axis: Treatment type; Y axis: Completion rate = Confirmed bookings (FR-006) in the confirmation cohort whose procedure reached FR-010 completion by the reporting cutoff ÷ all Confirmed bookings in that cohort, by the accepted parent's treatment; Reference line: Platform average completion rate; Drill-down: Click bar → admin Bookings list filtered to that treatment
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 1126-1130.

nodes.title: Screen 11 Widget 2 Cancellation and No-Show by Treatment

attrs.statement: Chart type: Grouped bar chart; X axis: Treatment type; Y axis: Rate %; Groups: Cancellation rate · No-show rate, both on the confirmation cohort (bookings first confirmed in the period); Drill-down: Click Cancellation bar → admin Bookings list filtered to post-confirmation cancellations (FR-006) for that treatment; click No-show bar → admin Cases list filtered to FR-010 closure reason `No-show` for that treatment
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 1138-1142.

nodes.title: Screen 11 Widget 3 Treatment Volume Trend

attrs.statement: Chart type: Stacked area chart; X axis: Month; Y axis: Booking count; Areas: One per treatment type (dynamic, top 5 + Other); Purpose: Track which treatments are growing or declining in demand; Drill-down: Click area segment → admin Bookings list filtered to treatment + month
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 1150-1155.

nodes.title: Screen 11 Widget 4 Average Review Scores by Treatment

attrs.statement: Chart type: Grouped bar chart; X axis: Treatment type; Y axis: Score (1–5); Groups: Overall · Results · Staff · Facility · Value; Data source: FR-013 per-treatment sub-scores endpoint (REQ-013-023), keyed by `treatment_id`, Published or Flagged reviews only (REQ-013-023); Provider filter: Required. The endpoint returns one provider's sub-scores, so the widget renders only when a single provider is selected; with "All providers" it shows "Select a provider to view review scores by treatment"; Drill-down: Click bar → Reviews list filtered to that provider and treatment
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 1163-1169. FR-013 dependency (line 1569: the sub-scores endpoint is per provider).

nodes.title: Screen 11 Widget 5 Aftercare Activation Rate

attrs.statement: Chart type: KPI tile + trend line + bar by treatment type; KPI: Platform-wide aftercare activation rate = FR-011 aftercare records created for procedures completed in the period ÷ FR-010 completed procedures in the period, by the accepted parent's treatment; Bar chart: Activation rate broken down by treatment type; Drill-down: Click bar → Aftercare records list
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 1177-1180.

nodes.title: Screen 11 Widget 6 Provider Distribution by Treatment Specialisation

attrs.statement: Chart type: Stacked horizontal bar chart; Y axis: Treatment type; X axis: Provider count offering that treatment; Drill-down: Click bar → Provider list filtered to that treatment; Data source: Submitted parent quotes (FR-004) grouped by treatment and `provider_id`; a provider "offers" a treatment if they have first-submitted at least 1 parent quote for it in the last 12 months.
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen 11 Widget 6 (widget specification) and its Functional Requirements Summary line REQ-014-286.

nodes.title: Completion rate needs at least 5 Confirmed bookings per bar

attrs.statement: Completion rate needs at least 5 Confirmed bookings in the confirmation cohort for each bar, to avoid single-event noise. With a single provider selected, a treatment bar needs ≥5 of that provider's Confirmed bookings for the treatment. With all providers, each treatment bar and the platform average pool every provider's bookings and need ≥5 pooled bookings; low-volume providers are not dropped from the pooled rate. Below the minimum, the bar is marked as not enough data per Rule 8; the exact visual treatment of low-sample bars is a UX design decision
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1211. Screen 11 Business Rules.

nodes.title: No-show and cancellation rate sources

attrs.statement: No-show rate uses FR-010 case closures with closure reason `No-show` (admin-managed case closure label, not a booking pipeline status) over the bookings first confirmed in the period (the confirmation cohort, like Widget 1); cancellation rate uses post-confirmation cancellations from the FR-006 Booking lifecycle over the same cohort. A booking closed as No-show counts as a no-show, not a cancellation
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1212. Screen 11 Business Rules.

nodes.title: Estimated Grafts never presented as a clinical result

attrs.statement: Do NOT add any clinical outcome metrics (achieved graft count, hair density, success rates). FR-004 Estimated Grafts is a provider's quote estimate, not a clinical outcome, and must not be presented as a result
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1213. Screen 11 Business Rules; overlaps REQ-014-090.

nodes.title: Screen 12 Widget 1 Platform GMV and Net Revenue

attrs.statement: Chart type: Dual-line area chart; X axis: Month; Y₁ series: Platform GMV (gross payment volume); Y₂ series: Net revenue (platform commission earned in period, accrual basis); Tooltip: GMV · Refunds completed in period · Net GMV (GMV − refunds) · Net revenue; Drill-down: Click period → detailed payment records; Calculation: GMV = `SUM(payments.amount)` where `payment_type ≠ 'refund'` and `payment_status IN ('completed', 'refunded')` (gross captured volume; refund rows are neither added nor subtracted, and a later refund does not remove the original payment). Net GMV = GMV − completed refund rows in the same period, per the Refund Source of Truth rule, so each refund is subtracted exactly once. Net revenue = platform commission earned in the period, using the Widget 2 formula (percentage per completed payment; flat rate once per completed procedure). Net revenue is counted on money kept: the commission on a refunded amount is reversed with the refund. Payout timing does not affect net revenue.
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 1236-1243.

nodes.title: Screen 12 Widget 2 Commission Earned Trend

attrs.statement: Chart type: Bar chart (monthly); X axis: Month; Y axis: Commission earned = sum of effective provider commission deductions in period, using each booking's confirmation-time commission snapshot (FR-015 REQ-015-022): percentage per completed payment; flat rate once per completed procedure (FR-015); the commission on a refunded amount is reversed with the refund; Reference line: Target monthly commission (admin-configurable in FR-026; hidden until a target is set); Drill-down: Click bar → filtered payment records with commission breakdown
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 1232-1236.

nodes.title: Screen 12 Widget 3 Refund and Failed Payment Health

attrs.statement: Chart type: Four KPI tiles + trend; Tile 1: Refund volume (amount, period); Tile 2: Refund rate = refund count ÷ captured payment count (both per the Refund Source of Truth rule); Tile 3: Failed payment count (period); Tile 4: Failed payment rate = failed ÷ total attempted payments. Attempted = non-refund `payments` rows (`payment_type ≠ 'refund'`) created in the period with `payment_status IN ('completed', 'refunded', 'failed')`; failed = those rows with `payment_status = 'failed'`. `pending` rows are excluded until resolved. Each row counts once, so a retry that creates a new payment row is a new attempt; Trend: Monthly refund rate + failed rate (dual line); Drill-down: Click tile → filtered Payments list
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 1244-1250.

nodes.title: Screen 12 Widget 4 Platform-Wide Cash-at-Risk Aging

attrs.statement: Chart type: Stacked horizontal bar chart (same as provider C3, but all providers); Buckets: 0–24h · 1–3d · 4–7d · 8–14d · >14d; X axis: Distinct accepted selections awaiting initial payment with a valid payment-window hold (all providers); Optional legend: By provider country; Drill-down: Click bucket → admin Quotes list resolved to accepted subquote + pending booking and filtered by active hold + aging bucket; Calculation: Age from immutable `AcceptanceEvent.acceptedAt`, using the actual configured hold deadline and the Screen 1 C3 exclusions. Expired, superseded, and cancelled selections are retained in lifecycle history but excluded from active cash risk; a booking revived by an admin counts again, aged from the start of its current hold. Snapshot widget: it ignores the time range filter.
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 1258-1264.

nodes.title: Screen 12 Widget 5 Upcoming Provider Payout Obligations

attrs.statement: Chart type: KPI tile + table; KPI: Total upcoming payout amount (next 30 days), counting every status in the table, Waiting for clinic setup included; Table columns: Provider · Amount · Payout date · Cadence (how the payout is released, see Assumption 5) · Status (FR-017: Pending Approval / Approved / Overdue / Processing / Waiting for clinic setup); Sort: Payout date ascending. Fixed window (next 30 days): this widget ignores the time range filter; Drill-down: Click row → provider payout detail in FR-017
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 1272-1276.

nodes.title: Screen 12 Widget 6 Installment Plan Health
