attrs.statement: Chart type: Donut + KPI; Segments: Active · Canceled · Completed · Defaulted (FR-007B Plan Status labels; Overdue is a flag on a plan, not a status segment); KPI: Total outstanding installment balance (Active plans, including those flagged Overdue, and Defaulted plans); Data source: `installment_plans` table status, using the FR-007B Plan Status values unchanged; Drill-down: Click segment → Installment plans list filtered by status
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 1284-1288. FR-007B dependency (line 1565).

nodes.title: Screen 12 Widget 7 Affiliate Commission Obligations

attrs.statement: Chart type: KPI tile + upcoming table; KPI: Total affiliate commission owed (pending payout); Table: Affiliate · Commission owed · Next payout date; Drill-down: Click row → FR-017 affiliate billing
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 1296-1299.

nodes.title: Screen 12 Widget 8 Revenue by Currency

attrs.statement: Chart type: Donut; Segments: Per currency code (`payments.currency`); Value: GMV by currency; Purpose: FX exposure visibility — how much revenue is in non-base currencies
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 1307-1310.

nodes.title: Screen 12 amounts converted to fixed USD base currency

attrs.statement: All amounts converted to the platform base currency, USD, which is fixed by FR-029 / A-09 Currency Management (not admin-editable), using daily FX rates under Rule 10; raw currency amounts shown in tooltips
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1328. Screen 12 Business Rules. FR-029 dependency (line 1575).

nodes.title: Net revenue is accrual-based

attrs.statement: Net revenue is accrual-based (commission earned in the period) and does not depend on when payouts are disbursed. It is counted on money kept: commission on a refunded amount is reversed with the refund, the same principle as REQ-017-134 for affiliates
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1329. Screen 12 Business Rules.

nodes.title: Screen 12 only for admin roles holding the View Financial Analytics permission

attrs.statement: This screen is only accessible to admin roles holding the FR-031 permission "View Financial Analytics"
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1330. Screen 12 Business Rules. FR-031 dependency (line 1576).

nodes.title: Accepted quote amount never replaces financial transactions

attrs.statement: Payment, refund, commission, installment, and payout metrics aggregate their owning records once before joining the accepted selection. The accepted quote amount is not captured revenue and MUST NOT replace actual financial transactions.
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1331. Screen 12 Business Rules.

nodes.title: Screen 13 Widget 1 Average Accepted Price by Treatment

attrs.statement: Chart type: Bar chart; X axis: Treatment type; Y axis: Average accepted subquote total price (platform base currency); Error bars: p25–p75 range per treatment; Drill-down: Click bar → Quotes list filtered to accepted selections for that treatment and acceptance period
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 1335-1339.

nodes.title: Screen 13 Widget 2 Accepted Price Range per Treatment

attrs.statement: Chart type: Range bar chart (or box plot if supported); X axis: Treatment type; Ranges shown: Min · p25 · Median · p75 · Max; Purpose: Show the observed spread of accepted selection prices for each treatment, not the full offered-price market; Reference line: Platform median per treatment; Drill-down: Click bar → Quotes list of accepted selections for that treatment sorted by accepted price
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 1347-1352.

nodes.title: Screen 13 Widget 3 Accepted Price by Provider Country

attrs.statement: Chart type: Grouped bar chart; X axis: Provider country; Y axis: Average accepted subquote total price; Groups: Per treatment type (top 3 by volume); Purpose: Surface geographic pricing differences (e.g., Turkish providers vs. UK providers); Drill-down: Click bar → Quotes list filtered to accepted selections by provider country + treatment
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 1360-1365.

nodes.title: Screen 13 Widget 4 Accepted Selections by Price Bracket

attrs.statement: Chart type: Bar chart; X axis: Accepted subquote total price bracket (dynamic bins based on accepted-price distribution); Y axis: Accepted selection count; tooltip also shows share of all accepted selections in the filtered acceptance-time cohort; Reference line: None — this is a price distribution, not a conversion-rate chart; Purpose: Show which price brackets patients accepted, without assigning unaccepted parents an invented single price; Drill-down: Click bar → Quotes list filtered to accepted selections in that price bracket and acceptance period; Boundary: Offered-price conversion by bracket is deferred. It requires a separately approved price attribution/denominator policy for multi-option parents; dividing accepted selections by accepted selections would misleadingly produce 100% and is prohibited.
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 1373-1380.

nodes.title: Screen 13 Widget 5 Price Trend per Treatment

attrs.statement: Chart type: Multi-line chart; X axis: Month (last 12 months); Y axis: Average accepted subquote total price; Lines: One per treatment type (top 5 by volume + Other as grey line); Purpose: Track whether observed accepted prices are rising or falling; Drill-down: Click line point → Quotes list filtered to accepted selections for that treatment + acceptance month
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 1388-1393.

nodes.title: Screen 13 Widget 6 Price Outlier Providers

attrs.statement: Chart type: Ranked table; Columns: Provider · Treatment · Average accepted price · Platform accepted-price median · Variance % · Direction; Filter: Providers whose average accepted price is ≥30% above or below the platform accepted-price median for any treatment; Direction: "High" (priced above) or "Low" (priced below); Purpose: Flag descriptive deviations in accepted prices for review; does not conclude that a provider is pricing itself out of the market; Drill-down: Click row → that provider's detail in FR-015
attrs.rationale: PRD lines 1401-1406.

nodes.title: Screen 13 accepted prices converted to base currency with provenance

attrs.statement: All accepted prices converted to platform base currency under Rule 10, preserving immutable accepted currency/locked-rate provenance; raw accepted amounts and sample sizes shown in tooltips
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1424. Screen 13 Business Rules.

nodes.title: Only accepted subquote prices from immutable AcceptanceEvents

attrs.statement: Only accepted subquote prices from immutable AcceptanceEvents are included, one observation per accepted parent quote; current quote status or current package-library prices are not price sources. Use acceptance time for price ranges, trends, distributions, and outliers.
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1426. Screen 13 Business Rules.

nodes.title: Minimum 5 accepted selections per treatment per provider for outliers

attrs.statement: Minimum 5 accepted selections per treatment per provider required to include that provider in outlier detection; unaccepted parents do not satisfy this amount-sample threshold
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1427. Screen 13 Business Rules; overlaps REQ-014-104.

nodes.title: Unaccepted parents never assigned zero or an alternative's amount

attrs.statement: Unaccepted parents still count once in parent response volume and parent acceptance-rate denominators; they MUST NOT be assigned zero or an arbitrary alternative's amount for price charts.
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1428. Screen 13 Business Rules.

nodes.title: Provider team size and role distribution (Screen 8 Widget 6)

attrs.statement: System MUST display provider team size and role distribution across the platform (Screen 8 Widget 6), so admins can see how large each clinic team is and how team members are spread across the clinic roles
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-014-312 (Screen 8 Widget 6).

nodes.title: Cancellation and no-show rates use the confirmation cohort

attrs.statement: System MUST compute the cancellation and no-show rates (Screen 2 Widget 6, Screen 11 Widget 2) on the confirmation cohort: bookings first confirmed in the period are the denominator, and the cancellations and no-shows among those same bookings are the numerators.
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary, Access, Counting and Notice Rules.

nodes.title: Provider analytics entry point and empty state follow the role

attrs.statement: System MUST open the provider Analytics nav item on the first of Screens 2 to 5 the role can see, hide it when the role can see none, render on Screen 1 only the sections the role may see, and show "No analytics available for your role" when no section is visible.
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary, Access, Counting and Notice Rules.

nodes.title: Admins have no analytics export in this version

attrs.statement: System MUST NOT offer an analytics export to admins in this version; the FR-031 permission "Export Reports" gates nothing in FR-014.
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary, Access, Counting and Notice Rules.

nodes.title: Admin analytics screens each need one FR-031 permission

attrs.statement: System MUST require the FR-031 permission named for each of Screens 7 to 13 in Rule 15G, open the admin Analytics nav item on the first of those screens the admin may see, and hide it when the admin may see none.
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary, Access, Counting and Notice Rules.

nodes.title: Fixed-window and snapshot tiles ignore the time range filter

attrs.statement: System MUST ignore the time range filter on fixed-window and snapshot tiles: which keep their own windows: Screen 1 C3 and C4, Screen 4 Widgets 7 and 8, Screen 7 C3, C4 and the Tile 5 Dormant count, Screen 8 Widgets 3 and 5, and Screen 12 Widgets 4 and 5.
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary, Access, Counting and Notice Rules.

nodes.title: Inquiry Queue and Accepted Quotes drill-down read live records

attrs.statement: System MUST read the Inquiry Queue and the Accepted Quotes drill-down from live records, while charts and tiles read the pre-aggregated figures.
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary, Access, Counting and Notice Rules.

nodes.title: Parent Quote Responses and Subquote Selections are shown; Subquote Comparisons is not

attrs.statement: System MUST show Parent Quote Responses and Subquote Selections only; Subquote Comparisons is recorded by FR-005 and not shown in FR-014 in this version.
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary, Access, Counting and Notice Rules.

nodes.title: Provider with no TTFQ observation shows a grey No data tier

attrs.statement: System MUST show a provider with no TTFQ observation in a grey "No data" tier with a text label, and keep it out of the donut percentages and the scatter; Screen 8 offers No data as a TTFQ health tier filter option, which the Screen 7 Tile 4 No data count opens.
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary, Access, Counting and Notice Rules.

nodes.title: Growth from a zero prior period shows New or N/A

attrs.statement: System MUST show growth as "New" when the prior period is zero and the current period is above zero (above the stated minimum where the widget has one), and as N/A otherwise when the prior period is zero.
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary, Access, Counting and Notice Rules.

nodes.title: Recurring export with a removed owner or no widget access is paused

attrs.statement: System MUST pause a recurring export whose owner is removed or loses access to every widget in it, notify the clinic Owner, and keep it paused until a user who can see every widget in it saves an edit and so becomes the owner.
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary, Access, Counting and Notice Rules.

nodes.title: Failed recurring run sends the configuration owner an in-app notice

attrs.statement: System MUST send the configuration owner an in-app notice when a recurring run fails its final retry.
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary, Access, Counting and Notice Rules.

nodes.title: Any user who can see every widget may edit or delete a recurring export

attrs.statement: System MUST let any user who can see every widget in a recurring configuration edit or delete it; the user who last saves an edit becomes its owner.
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary, Access, Counting and Notice Rules.

nodes.title: Commission on refunded money is reversed with the refund

attrs.statement: System MUST reverse the commission on refunded money with the refund, so platform commission and Screen 12 net revenue are counted on money kept.
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary, Access, Counting and Notice Rules.

nodes.title: Screen 7 shows an admin only what the admin's permissions cover

attrs.statement: System MUST show an admin on Screen 7 only what the admin's permissions cover: financial tiles only with the permission that opens Screen 12, and a drill-down link only when the admin may open its destination (Screens 8, 9, 11, 12 and the FR-017 payout detail); otherwise the tile shows its value without a link, or is hidden when its data is financial.
attrs.rationale: Screen 7 mixes data of Screens 8, 9, 11 and 12, each behind its own FR-031 permission; the admin side follows the same principle as Rule 15B on the provider side.

nodes.title: Admins create providers through a multi-step wizard

attrs.statement: System MUST allow admins to create new provider accounts via a multi-step wizard, including profile (Bio, Languages, Awards), clinic details, seat limit (team member capacity), and commission settings.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 1193 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Provider creation is admin-initiated only

attrs.statement: System MUST enforce admin-initiated provider creation only (no self-service registration).
attrs.rationale: Restated by General Module Rule 1 (all provider accounts are created by admins, no self-service registration) and Business Process Assumption 1 (providers cannot register themselves; admins control network quality through manual vetting).

nodes.title: Provider lifecycle: Active, Suspended, Deactivated

attrs.statement: System MUST support provider status lifecycle with statuses Active, Suspended, and Deactivated only (no Draft): Active → Suspended (Screen 4), Suspended → Active via the Screen 5 reactivation modal, and Active or Suspended → Deactivated (Screen 4). Every transition requires a reason and admin re-authentication.
attrs.rationale: Restated by General Module Rule 3 (statuses, no Draft, allowed transitions, password not yet set tracked by password_set not by a status), Screen 5 (Suspended only) and the Implementation Notes state machine (cannot transition from Deactivated to any other status).

nodes.title: Providers and admins manage documents; documents never block activation

attrs.statement: System MUST allow providers to upload and manage their documents (license, certification, insurance) via FR-032. System MUST also allow admins to upload supplementary documents received externally. Documents are for record-keeping and do not block activation.
attrs.rationale: Executive Summary: document verification is performed externally and the system treats uploaded documents as pre-verified records.

nodes.title: Provider management actions go to an immutable audit trail

attrs.statement: System MUST log all provider management actions (creation, edits, status changes) in an immutable audit trail.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Security Considerations (audit logs immutable, cannot be edited or deleted by admins) and Tab 8.

nodes.title: Activation email with one-time link; resend rate limited

attrs.statement: System MUST send account activation email with one-time password setup link (expires 24 hours) when provider account is created. System MUST support activation email resend via self-service (provider login page) and admin manual resend (provider profile Quick Actions), with rate limiting (3 requests per hour per email) and automatic invalidation of previous links.
attrs.rationale: Main Flow steps 12 to 13 and Alternative Flow A1; the event is FR-020 provider.activation, mandatory and cannot be disabled.

nodes.title: Provider profile data aligned with FR-032 and synced in real time

attrs.statement: System MUST maintain provider profile data aligned with FR-032 (Bio, Languages, Awards, Profile Picture, Contact details, etc.). Changes made by providers in FR-032 must sync to admin view in real-time.
attrs.rationale: Provider-editable fields are listed under Admin Editability Rules; Screen 3 notes say provider changes reflect immediately in the admin view.

nodes.title: Provider documents stored in secure cloud storage (AES-256)

attrs.statement: System MUST store uploaded provider documents in secure cloud storage (AES-256).
attrs.rationale: Restated by Privacy Rule 2 (AES-256 at rest) and the Implementation Notes storage and encryption bullets.

nodes.title: Commission configuration stored per provider in the FR-029 record

attrs.statement: System MUST store commission configuration (Model: Percentage/Flat, Value, Flat Rate Currency, Effective Date) per provider in the FR-029 provider-specific commission record.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 1219 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Seat limit per provider: default 100, range 1-500

attrs.statement: System MUST store seat limit (maximum team members) per provider with default value of 100, adjustable range 1-500. Seat limit must be enforced by FR-009 when providers invite staff members.
attrs.rationale: Restated by General Module Rule 7 and the Screen 2 and Tab 1 Seat Limit rows. Seat usage counting is owned by FR-009 Rule 6.

nodes.title: Activation token, expiry and password_set stored; old tokens invalidated

attrs.statement: System MUST store activation token (one-time password setup link), token expiry timestamp (24 hours from generation), and the password_set status of the provider owner's login, all on the Provider record. System MUST invalidate previous tokens when new token is generated.
attrs.rationale: Key Entity 1 and REQ-015-011: password_set and the activation token stay on the Provider record.

nodes.title: Provider documents encrypted at rest and in transit

attrs.statement: System MUST encrypt provider documents at rest and in transit.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 1228 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Document access limited to authenticated users with role permissions

attrs.statement: System MUST restrict document access to authenticated users (providers can access their own documents, admins can access all provider documents) with role-based permissions (providers can edit their own uploads, admins can edit admin uploads only).
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 1229 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Login email and contact email uniqueness

attrs.statement: System MUST validate provider login Email against the FR-009 global provider email identity rule (Rule 3, REQ-009-008) on creation and on every change (blocking emails used by another provider organization as Owner, team member, or pending invitation), and MUST validate Contact Email uniqueness among Active and Suspended providers; Deactivated providers' emails are freed so a re-onboarded provider can reuse them.
attrs.rationale: Restated by General Module Rule 4 (Deactivated providers' emails freed), the Screen 2 and Tab 1 Email Address rows and the duplicate-email edge cases. The PRD at Tab 1 (Owner login email change) cites this rule where the FR-009 identity rule REQ-009-008 is meant.

nodes.title: Platform password policy and bcrypt hashing

attrs.statement: System MUST enforce the platform-wide password policy (see system PRD, Platform-Wide Rules: Password and one-time-code policy). Passwords MUST be hashed using bcrypt with a minimum cost factor of 12.
attrs.rationale: Main Flow steps 15 and 17.

nodes.title: Activation resend limited to 3 per hour per email

attrs.statement: System MUST rate limit activation email resend requests to 3 per hour per email address to prevent abuse and email flooding.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Alternative Flow A1 and the activation-resend edge case.

nodes.title: Suspension cascade: cancel unaccepted quotes, close pre-treatment bookings

attrs.statement: Effective provider suspension MUST automatically cancel the provider's unaccepted Parent Quotes with the FR-004 status `cancelled_provider_status` and close all related non-terminal Accepted and Confirmed cases under A5/Screen 4, while an accepted Parent Quote keeps `accepted`; release active reservations and block further payment. Closed accepted bookings MUST enter the FR-006 provider-fault transfer instead of cancelling their inquiry. In Progress bookings MUST NOT be closed automatically; they MUST stay `In Progress` with the cause and support marker until an admin moves them to `Aftercare` with aftercare reassignment or cancels them with a reason. Aftercare bookings and FR-011 standalone aftercare cases assigned to that provider MUST NOT be closed; they MUST keep their status, receive the cause and support marker, and move to admin aftercare reassignment with no new acceptance or payment. Effective deactivation MUST apply the same cascade scope with the `ProviderDeactivated` cause, without overwriting an earlier `ProviderSuspended` cause. Suspension and deactivation MUST also end every FR-037 monitoring assignment of the provider, as FR-037 Rule 5e (REQ-037-094) rules.
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow A5 steps 1 to 7 and the Screen 4 Suspension and Deactivation bullets restate this rule; deactivation runs the same cascade with ProviderDeactivated and also disables login.

nodes.title: Provider-caused cancellation causes and independent supportRequired marker

attrs.statement: System MUST distinguish ProviderSuspended and ProviderDeactivated cancellation causes from patient cancellation and payment-window expiry, and set an independent `supportRequired` marker on affected cases/inquiries. Shared unaccepted inquiries MUST retain unrelated providers' offers; an inquiry whose accepted booking is closed by the cascade MUST stay open for the FR-006 provider-fault transfer and MUST NOT be cancelled.
attrs.rationale: Restated by A5 step 4 and the Screen 4 Admin Support Required bullet.

nodes.title: Mandatory patient notices and admin support alerts

attrs.statement: System MUST notify affected patients and alert admins when a provider status change cancels or flags their cases, regardless of the optional Notify Provider checkbox. Recipients, content, variants and whether a notice can be switched off are defined once, in the FR-030 notification catalogue (`provider.status_cancellation_patient`, `booking.provider_fault_replacement`, `provider.status_cancellation_admin_support`). Support resolution MUST be audited before clearing the marker.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Communication Structure (in scope) and the Screen 4 Patient communication bullet.

nodes.title: Eligibility revalidation and idempotent cascade

attrs.statement: System MUST revalidate provider eligibility at allocation, submission, acceptance, booking confirmation, and the FR-006 admin actions admin Revive Booking, admin appointment change (reschedule), and admin acceptance of a replacement quote (FR-006 B5) (each requires an Active provider, per FR-006 REQ-006-020), prevent in-flight operations/callbacks from reviving cancelled cases, and deduplicate cascade processing by provider-status event and affected record. The status change and its provider status event MUST be written in one transaction; the cascade MUST run as an idempotent background job with a target completion within 5 minutes, and a reactivation MUST NOT stop a running cascade for the earlier event. The cascade MUST act only on records that existed at the effective time of the status event.
attrs.rationale: Restated by General Module Rule 9 and Integration 5. The A5 background job targets completion within 5 minutes of the effective time.

nodes.title: Status changes never rewrite history or reopen cancelled records

attrs.statement: Suspension, deactivation, or reactivation MUST NOT rewrite accepted snapshots/versions, erase clinical or financial history, or automatically reopen cancelled quotes/cases/payment windows. Admin support MUST retain access to the records needed for clinical continuity and financial resolution.
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 Reactivation bullet: reactivation permits new eligible activity only and does not restore cancelled quotes or cases, reopen accepted selections, reinstate reservations, restart payment windows, clear unresolved support markers or restore the Featured flag.

nodes.title: Commission snapshot at booking confirmation stays synchronized

attrs.statement: Effective commission configuration MUST be snapshotted at booking confirmation under FR-029 and retained for later transactions; edits in FR-015/FR-029 MUST stay synchronized without replacing existing booking snapshots. Percentage/Flat Rate models and the once-per-completed-procedure flat-fee rule remain unchanged.
attrs.rationale: Restated by General Module Rule 5 and Commission Rule 4: the effective model and value are resolved and snapshotted at booking confirmation; changes affect newly confirmed bookings only.

nodes.title: Completed Procedures counts distinct FR-010 completions

attrs.statement: Provider-profile Completed Procedures MUST count distinct FR-010 treatment completions, not quotes, options, accepted selections, payments, or final aftercare status. Later cancellation MUST NOT erase a recorded completion.
attrs.rationale: Tab 1 business rule: Completed Procedures uses the FR-010 treatment-completion milestone, not acceptance, payment confirmation or final aftercare completion, and cancellation during Aftercare does not erase a recorded completion.

nodes.title: Lifecycle impact references retained in existing owning entities

attrs.statement: System MUST retain provider-status event/effective-time references, affected record identifiers and prior stages, cancellation cause, support marker/resolution audit, slot-release outcome, and notification outcome for lifecycle impact and admin follow-up; storage remains with the existing owning entities rather than duplicating accepted data in Provider.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 1224 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Admin profile saves require a 10-500 character reason

attrs.statement: Admin saves to provider profile data (Screen 3 Tabs 1, 2, 4, 6 notes, and 7) MUST require a change reason of 10-500 characters that is stored in the Tab 8 audit entry; provider self-edits via FR-032 and Featured Provider set/unset actions are exempt.
attrs.rationale: Tab 1 business rule: the reason is stored with the audit entry and shown in Tab 8; the Featured Provider toggle and Set/Unset Featured quick actions never ask for it (Tab 8 still logs them).

nodes.title: Login as Provider rules

attrs.statement: Login as Provider MUST require a reason (min 20 characters) and admin re-authentication, show a persistent impersonation banner, block password/email/financial changes, log every action in Tab 8, and end after 30 minutes of inactivity. It MUST be blocked for a Deactivated provider and MUST be limited to the FR-032 Rule 6 read-only rules for a Suspended provider, whether the admin impersonates the Owner or a team member.
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 Login as Provider rules (see also the Super Admin and new-tab rule below).

nodes.title: Featured flag cleared on suspension or deactivation

attrs.statement: System MUST clear the Featured flag automatically when suspension or deactivation becomes effective and MUST NOT restore it on reactivation.
attrs.rationale: Restated by General Module Rule 6 and the Screen 4 Featured flag bullet (logged in Tab 8, frees a slot under the 10-provider cap).

nodes.title: Scheduled suspension and deactivation

attrs.statement: System MUST support scheduled suspension and deactivation: store at most one pending change per provider, show a "Scheduled" marker on Screen 1 and the Screen 3 header, allow admins to cancel it with a reason and re-authentication before the Effective Date, apply it automatically on that date with the A5 cascade recalculated at effective time, and log scheduling, cancellation, and application in Tab 8.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 1207 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Screen 4 links each affected record to its resolving screen

attrs.statement: Screen 4 MUST link each affected record to the admin screen that resolves it (provider-fault transfer, aftercare reassignment, or the FR-016 Admin Support Required view), and each of those actions MUST record a mandatory reason, confirmation, and audit entry.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 1208 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Creation requires every Required field of the wizard

attrs.statement: Provider creation (and therefore activation) requires every field marked Required in the Screen 2 wizard: First Name, Last Name, Email, Phone Number, Bio/Description (50-500 chars), Specialty, Medical License Number, Years of Experience, at least 1 Language, Clinic Name, Clinic Address, Contact Email, Medical License file, Commission Model and Value, Flat Rate Currency (when Commission Model = Flat Rate), Payout Method, and Commission Start Date. The Medical License file is a record-keeping baseline only; document authenticity or later document changes never block activation or change status. Payout readiness (the clinic's own Stripe sign-up being Ready) is not required for creation or activation (Payout Readiness Rule). A field marked "Required" in a screen table means it is needed to submit or save that screen only; it does not by itself make the stored provider attribute mandatory.
attrs.rationale: General Module Rule 2.

nodes.title: Provider without a password is excluded from inquiry distribution

attrs.statement: An Active provider with `password_set = false` is excluded from FR-003 inquiry distribution (including explicit patient selection and reassignment) until the password is set; it may still be featured or edited by admins. A Suspended provider is not eligible either, even with a password set (Rule 9); it becomes eligible only once reactivated.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Main Flow steps 12 and 21, FR-003 distribution (CR-aligned) and the Dependencies FR-003 entry.

nodes.title: Deactivation is permanent; new account needed to re-onboard

attrs.statement: Deactivation is permanent—deactivated providers cannot be reactivated; admin must create new provider account if re-onboarding required. Deactivation frees the provider's emails: Contact Email uniqueness counts only Active and Suspended providers, and login Email follows the FR-009 global provider email identity rule (Rule 3, REQ-009-008), under which the Owner, team member, and pending-invitation emails of a Deactivated provider are freed. The new account may reuse those emails; the deactivated record and its history are retained unchanged, and Screen 3 Tab 1 is read-only. For a Deactivated provider the Screen 3 header Edit Profile is hidden and all tabs are read-only; documents can still be viewed and downloaded and the activity log read. Tab 3 and Tab 7 keep their own rules (Tab 7 allows the Payout Method change of REQ-015-138), and review actions in Tab 5 are per FR-013.
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 describes deactivation as permanent and irreversible; Alternative Flow A7 adds that there is no separate Deleted status and that data is retained per FR-023.

nodes.title: Featured designation only for Active providers

attrs.statement: Featured provider designation only available for providers with status = "Active".
attrs.rationale: General Module Rule 6, first sentence.

nodes.title: At most 10 featured providers, enforced server-side

attrs.statement: At most 10 active providers may be featured. Admin can set or unset featured status from the Provider-list quick action or the Basic Information toggle, and can set it at creation with the Screen 2 Step 5 Featured Provider toggle; the limit applies to all three. A request to feature an eleventh provider must be rejected without changing data and must clearly tell the admin to unfeature another provider first, using the message: "Maximum of 10 featured providers reached. Unfeature another provider first." Featuring or unfeaturing does not require an admin change reason (Tab 8 still logs it). This limit must be enforced server-side for every write path.
attrs.rationale: General Module Rule 8; Alternative Flow A3 step 2 restates the Active and fewer-than-10 check.

nodes.title: Seat increase requests go through FR-009 and FR-034; admin edits Seat Limit

attrs.statement: Providers request seat limit increases via FR-009 "Request more seats", which opens an FR-034 support case pre-filled as a seat-increase request; if approved, the admin edits Seat Limit in Screen 3 Tab 1. Seat limit blocks staff invitations when reached (enforced by FR-009).
attrs.rationale: General Module Rule 7, second and third sentences.

nodes.title: Cascade ownership: A5 and Screen 4 own cancellation; FR-006 and FR-011 own transfers

attrs.statement: Screen 4 and Alternative Flow A5 own provider-status cancellation and support effects; FR-006 Alternative Flow B5 owns the replacement-provider transfer for accepted bookings before treatment starts, FR-006 Alternative Flow B7 (on Screen 6) owns the admin decision for `In Progress` bookings (move to Aftercare with reassignment, or cancel), and FR-006 Alternative Flow B6 with FR-011 owns only the aftercare reassignment. The cascade is provider-scoped, preserves immutable accepted context, and must not count alternatives as independent treatments or cancel unrelated providers' unaccepted offers.
attrs.rationale: General Module Rule 10. A5 Boundary: This admin-triggered suspension cascade is distinct from patient inquiry cancellation, normal payment-window expiry, and FR-010's provider-requested Cancel/Close Case flow. The replacement provider is chosen by an admin through FR-006 Alternative Flow B5, not selected automatically. This flow defines no refund or fund-release mechanics and does not erase completed care.

nodes.title: Provider contact details visible to admins only

attrs.statement: Provider contact information (email, phone) visible only to admins; patients see clinic phone/email.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 789 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Audit entries carry actor, reason and cancellation details

attrs.statement: All provider management actions logged with timestamp, admin user ID, action details, and the admin's reason or justification (Screen 3 Tab 1 admin change reason, Screens 4-5 status reasons, Login as Provider reason). Provider-status cancellation records include the triggering status event, effective time, affected inquiry/quote/booking/treatment identifiers, prior stage, cancellation cause, support marker, slot-release outcome, and notification outcome. Sensitive suspension reasons remain admin/provider context rather than patient notification content.
attrs.rationale: Near-duplicate of REQ-015-005 and REQ-015-024 within this FR.

nodes.title: Admin and provider editability of profile data

attrs.statement: Editable by Admin: provider basic information (name, specialty, bio, languages, awards); clinic information (name, address, phone, logo, contact email); commission configuration (Model: Percentage/Flat, Value, Flat Rate Currency, Effective Date); seat limit (maximum team members, range 1-500, default 100); document uploads (Add; Replace/Remove admin-uploaded documents only; provider-uploaded documents are managed by the provider via FR-032); provider status (Active, Suspended, Deactivated); featured provider designation. Editable by Provider (via FR-032): Profile Picture/Logo; Cover Image; Bio/Description; Languages Spoken; Awards & Recognition (add/edit/delete with images); Clinic Name; Contact Phone (Public); Contact Email; Location (City, Country); Website URL. Fixed in codebase: deactivation finality rule; encryption standards; commission calculation logic. Fields marked "Admin only" can only be edited by admin users with provider management permissions Admin can override any provider changes if needed (logged in audit trail)
attrs.rationale: Admin Editability Rules; Tab 1 business rules and notes.

nodes.title: Commissions apply to all provider earnings from patient bookings

attrs.statement: Commissions apply to all provider earnings from patient bookings.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 828 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Percentage commission formula and base

attrs.statement: Percentage Model: Calculated as `Booking Total * (Commission Rate / 100)`. The booking total is the accepted price after promotion, in the quote currency, read from the FR-005 acceptance snapshot; commission never reads the live quote or option record. The same base applies to every discount type, including discounts funded only by Hairline. The rate is the one fixed at booking confirmation (Commission Rule 4). When money is refunded to the patient, the commission on the refunded amount is reversed with it, in the same proportion, so Hairline keeps commission only on money the patient keeps; FR-017 owns the refund and payout mechanics (REQ-017-202).
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 829 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Flat Rate commission is a fixed deduction per completed procedure

attrs.statement: Flat Rate Model: Fixed amount deducted per completed procedure (e.g., £150 flat fee).
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow A2 restates this for the admin configuration step.

nodes.title: Cancellation by provider status leaves payment records intact; money follows FR-006 B5 and B7 payment terms

attrs.statement: Suspension or deactivation closes affected bookings and blocks further patient payment to that provider, but payment/refund/commission records remain intact. For a closed accepted booking, money follows the FR-006 Alternative Flow B5 payment terms: the patient is refunded in full everything paid, pays no cancellation fee, and the replacement booking takes a new payment. For an `In Progress` booking (treatment already started), an admin reviews each case and sets the patient refund amount, from zero up to the full amount paid, with a mandatory reason and an audit entry, and the provider's payout for that booking is held until the admin decides (FR-006 Alternative Flow B7 payment terms). Exact refund, fund-release, and allocation mechanics belong to FR-007, FR-007B, and FR-017; no new refund percentage or fee is defined here, and the payout method and payout-readiness rules below concern only a clinic's payout setup.

nodes.title: No per-clinic payout frequency; automatic release on Stripe Connect, one settlement period on the manual rail

attrs.statement: There is no per-clinic payout frequency. On the Stripe Connect rail, release to the clinic is automatic through FR-017. A clinic paid by manual bank transfer follows the one settlement-period setting owned by FR-029 (default weekly, Sunday cutoff, Wednesday payout), which applies to all manually paid clinics.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 833 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Documents never gate activation or change provider status

attrs.statement: A Medical License file is required once, when completing the Screen 2 wizard. After creation, the absence, replacement, or deletion of any document never changes provider status or blocks activity Documents are stored for internal record-keeping only; their authenticity or status is never checked by the system and never gates activation.
attrs.rationale: Main Flow step 7, Screen 2 Step 4 note and Tab 6.

nodes.title: Featured display to patients ships with FR-022 after MVP

attrs.statement: Provider appears in "Featured" lists in Patient App once FR-022 patient provider search (P2 - Post-MVP) is delivered; in MVP the flag is stored and enforced but not yet displayed to patients.
attrs.rationale: Module Scope: the admin featured flag and cap are MVP; the patient-facing display is P2.

nodes.title: Providers see profile, documents and commission read-only

attrs.statement: Providers view their own profile (synced with A-02). Providers see uploaded documents (for reference). Providers view configured commission rates (read-only) in the FR-032 Screen 4 Commission & Payout panel. Providers can edit profile fields (Bio, Languages, Awards, Profile Picture, Contact details) via FR-032: Provider Dashboard Settings & Profile Management, which updates the A-02 record. All editable fields must align between FR-015 and FR-032 to ensure consistency.
attrs.rationale: Module Scope, Multi-Tenant Breakdown, Provider Platform.

nodes.title: Failed notification emails retry and show an admin warning

attrs.statement: System retries the delivery under the FR-030 notification retry rule; admin sees warning message: "Notification queued but not yet delivered." Admin can manually resend via the "Resend Activation Email" button in Screen 3.
attrs.rationale: Dependencies External Service 1 and the failed-email edge case: retry follows the FR-030 notification retry rule; the warning and manual resend are the same for activation and provider status emails.

nodes.title: Provider status email recipients come from the notification catalogue

attrs.statement: Recipients of the provider status emails (`provider.suspended`, `provider.deactivated`, `provider.reactivated`, and `provider.scheduled_change_cancelled`) are set in the FR-030 notification catalogue. Team members learn of the status through the FR-032 Rule 6 banner or the deactivated-login message.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 732 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Provider status email timing and Notify Provider default

attrs.statement: For an immediate change the email is sent once. For a scheduled change with "Notify Provider" checked, the email is sent when the scheduled change is created (with the Effective Date) and again when it takes effect. If "Notify Provider" is unchecked, no provider email is sent at either point; patient messages and admin-support alerts are still mandatory. If "Notify Provider" checkbox enabled (default), system sends email (FR-020 `provider.suspended` or `provider.deactivated`). Its content is defined in the FR-030 notification catalogue.
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 Notification Email and Email timing bullets; Notify Provider is checked and locked for a closure-request deactivation.

nodes.title: Entry points for provider management

attrs.statement: Admin accesses "Provider Management" section in Admin Platform dashboard → selects "Add New Provider" to initiate provider creation workflow Admin opens "Providers" list view to see all providers across all statuses (active, suspended, deactivated) with filtering and search Provider logs into Provider Platform → views account status (FR-032 Rule 6 banner when Suspended), uploaded documents (FR-032 Tab 6: Documents), and commission configuration read-only in FR-032 Screen 4: Billing Settings (Commission & Payout panel, Owner role only)
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 96, 113.

nodes.title: Creation sets Active status, password_set false and the success message

attrs.statement: System creates provider record with status = "Active" and initializes provider credentials with `password_set = false`. Until the password is set, the provider is excluded from inquiry distribution (Rule 3). The admin sees the success message: "Provider [Clinic Name] created successfully. An activation email has been sent to [email]."
attrs.rationale: Main Flow step 12.

nodes.title: Activation email content and link

attrs.statement: System sends the account activation email (FR-020 `provider.activation`; mandatory and cannot be disabled) to the provider with a secure one-time link to set the password (expires in 24 hours). The rest of its content is defined in the FR-030 notification catalogue.
attrs.rationale: Main Flow step 13: the email content beyond the one-time link (24 hours) is defined in the FR-030 notification catalogue.

nodes.title: First login shows an onboarding screen prompting profile completion

attrs.statement: System displays "Welcome to Hairline" onboarding screen prompting provider to complete profile (via FR-032):
attrs.rationale: Main Flow steps 19 to 20: logo and cover image, bio, languages, awards, contact review via FR-032.

nodes.title: Missing required fields block the wizard step with a message

attrs.statement: System validates every field marked Required in the Screen 2 wizard tables on each step (see Rule 2). System displays error: "Please complete all required fields before proceeding" and highlights missing fields in red.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 1172 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Resend validates the account; responses never reveal whether the email exists

attrs.statement: System validates email exists in provider database, account status is Active or Suspended, and the password is not yet set. If provider email not found, the account is Deactivated, or the account already has a password set, system displays generic message: "If an account exists with this email, an activation link will be sent." (security: don't reveal if email exists).
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow A1 and the already-activated edge case (prevents email enumeration).

nodes.title: Expired activation link shows a message and offers a new email

attrs.statement: Provider can request new activation email via login page resend flow or contact admin. Admin can manually resend from provider profile. When provider clicks expired link, system displays: "This activation link has expired. Request a new activation email or contact support."
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 1177 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Admin Resend Activation Email visibility and permission

attrs.statement: "Resend Activation Email" (requires the FR-031 Edit Providers permission; visible only if password not yet set and status is Active or Suspended, so it is hidden for Deactivated providers; a Suspended clinic can set its password but stays read-only per FR-032 Rule 6; matches Alternative Flow A1; sends new one-time password setup link)
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 header quick action.

nodes.title: Document permissions by uploader

attrs.statement: Provider-uploaded documents: Admin can view, download, add notes, but cannot replace or delete (only provider can via FR-032) Admin-uploaded documents: Admin has full control (view, download, replace, delete, add notes) Replacing a document uploads the new file as the current version and archives the old file (soft-deleted and retained per the Soft Delete rule, logged in Tab 8). Replace does not require an admin change reason
attrs.rationale: Tab 6 business rules. Near-duplicate of the permission clause in REQ-015-013.

nodes.title: Replaced or deleted documents are archived by soft delete

attrs.statement: Deleted documents (by provider or admin) retained in archive for compliance; visible in Activity Log but not in main document list
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 606 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Document changes sync between FR-032 and FR-015 within 1 minute

attrs.statement: Provider uploads in FR-032 → Syncs to FR-015 within 1 minute. Admin uploads in FR-015 → Syncs to FR-032 within 1 minute
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 616 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: All document actions are logged with user and IP address

attrs.statement: All document actions (upload/view/download/replace/delete/note edits) logged in Tab 8: Activity Log with timestamp, user (admin/provider), action type, and IP address
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 605 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Document types and the admin upload modal

attrs.statement: Document types are Medical License, Board Certification, Insurance (general), Malpractice Insurance, Business License and Other. The Upload Document modal requires File (PDF, JPG, PNG, DOCX, XLSX; max 10MB) and Document Type, with optional Notes (max 500 chars); on save the system sets Document Name, File Size, Upload Date and Uploaded By.
attrs.rationale: Tab 6 data fields and Upload Document Modal Fields.

nodes.title: Upload errors show a specific inline message and save nothing

attrs.statement: Every admin file upload in this FR (wizard Steps 1, 2 and 4, the profile images and award images on the provider detail tabs, and the Tab 6 Upload Document modal and Replace) validates the file before saving it and shows one inline message under the field. The file is not saved. Wrong format: "Unsupported file type. Allowed: {types}." ({types} is the field's list, e.g. "JPEG, PNG" or "PDF, JPG, PNG, DOCX, XLSX") Too large: "File is too large. Maximum size is {limit} MB." ({limit}: Profile Picture / Logo 5, Cover Image 10, award image 2, documents 10) Below the minimum dimensions (Profile Picture / Logo only): "Image is too small. Minimum size is 200 × 200 pixels."
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 371.

nodes.title: Uploaded files are scanned for malware before storage

attrs.statement: File upload validation (max 10MB per file, only PDF, JPG, PNG, DOCX, and XLSX allowed, matching FR-032; malware scanning via antivirus integration before storage)
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 1082 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Provider creation is rate limited per admin

attrs.statement: Rate limiting on provider creation API (max 10 provider creations per admin per hour) to prevent bulk account creation abuse. The limit is a fixed platform setting; it is not editable in the admin console and is not listed on FR-026 Screen 8.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 1081 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Sensitive contact data protected by database encryption, not application-level

attrs.statement: Provider sensitive data (email, phone, medical license number) is stored in the database protected by database/disk encryption at rest, HTTPS/TLS in transit, and access control. It is not encrypted at application level, so the Screen 1 partial search and the login email uniqueness check keep working
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 1077 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Deactivated provider data retained for the platform retention period, never hard-deleted

attrs.statement: Deactivated providers' data is retained for legal/audit purposes (retention follows the system PRD, Platform-Wide Rules: One 10-year retention period), then archived; it is never hard-deleted. GDPR/data deletion requests are handled via separate data privacy workflows (not in-scope for A-02)
attrs.rationale: Also stated in Security Considerations (Compliance) and the Screen 4 Deactivation bullet (data retained for audit and legal purposes but marked deactivated).

nodes.title: Admin actions require the matching FR-031 permission

attrs.statement: Each action checks its FR-031 permission: View Providers (read-only access), Onboard Providers (create), Edit Providers (profile, documents, commission, seat limit, featured flag), Suspend Providers (all status changes, and Reject Request on an account-closure request). Resend Activation Email requires Edit Providers. Login as Provider is Super Admin only. Roles are defined in FR-031, not in this FR
attrs.rationale: Dependencies FR-031 entry lists the same permissions per screen.

nodes.title: Duplicate email shows an in-use validation error

attrs.statement: Login email follows the FR-009 global provider email identity rule (Rule 3, REQ-009-008); Deactivated providers' emails are freed (see Rule 4). If another provider organization uses the email as Owner, team member, or pending invitation, system displays validation error: "Email address already in use by another provider (Provider Name: [existing provider]). Please use a different email or edit the existing provider." Provider creation blocked until unique email provided.
attrs.rationale: Duplicate-provider edge case restates this for an Active or Suspended provider with the same Owner login.

nodes.title: Acceptance or payment racing a suspension is checked and never revives a cancelled selection

attrs.statement: Eligibility must be checked against the effective provider status. No cancelled selection may be confirmed or revived; any real captured payment remains recorded and is routed to admin financial resolution.
attrs.rationale: Edge case; related FR-005 and FR-006 rules own the matching blocks.

nodes.title: Cascade retries keep eligibility revoked and failures stay visible

attrs.statement: Keep provider eligibility revoked and cancelled records cancelled. Retry incomplete work using the same status event/case references without duplicate cancellations, alerts, or slot releases; retain visible unresolved processing failures for admins.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 1182 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: A quote's alternatives are cancelled once, not per alternative

attrs.statement: They remain alternatives of the same Parent Quote. Cancel its availability once; do not create a treatment or support item per unselected alternative.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 1183 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Suspension never cancels an Aftercare case after completed procedure

attrs.statement: The case is not cancelled. It keeps its status, the FR-010 completion milestone, and its single Completed Procedures count; an admin reassigns aftercare to another provider or the Hairline aftercare team through the FR-011 aftercare reassignment screen. Performed care and payment history are not erased.

nodes.title: Deactivation after suspension keeps the earlier cancellation reason

attrs.statement: Do not overwrite ProviderSuspended or create another cancellation for terminal records; retain unresolved support markers and the original audit chain.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 1184 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Deactivation disables login for the account and all team members

attrs.statement: Provider login disabled immediately for the provider account and all of its FR-009 team members
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 722 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Suspended provider keeps read-only access with an Account Suspended banner

attrs.statement: Provider can still log in to Provider Platform but sees "Account Suspended" banner; the same applies to all of the provider's FR-009 team members. The banner and the suspended read-only behavior are specified in FR-032 (Rule 6). Read-only includes `In Progress` bookings: the suspended provider cannot check in, end treatment, or edit the treatment plan; the admin decides the case through FR-006 Alternative Flow B7. The suspended provider may still chat with patients on its open `In Progress` and `Aftercare` cases. Clinical notes, photos, and aftercare answers and actions stay blocked until the admin reassigns or decides the case
attrs.rationale: The banner and read-only behavior are specified in FR-032 Rule 6.

nodes.title: Admin Support Required is an independent marker resolved by audited admin action

attrs.statement: This is an independent support marker, not a new patient journey stage or provider account status. Affected cases/inquiries must be identifiable and filterable through FR-016's admin workflow, with mandatory admin alerts through FR-020. The FR-020 admin-support alert goes to admins with the FR-031 Respond to Support permission. Opening the FR-016 list requires FR-031 View Patients, and Resolve Support requires Respond to Support. Admin resolution records a reason and audit event before clearing the marker; the cancellation cause remains. An inquiry's marker stays set while any linked provider-caused impact is unresolved. If an FR-034 support case is created/linked during assistance, retain its existing Open → In Progress → Resolved → Closed workflow. Automatic ticket creation is not introduced here.
attrs.rationale: Near-duplicate of REQ-015-018 and REQ-015-019 in this FR.

nodes.title: Reactivation permits new eligible activity only

attrs.statement: Performed through Screen 5 (Suspended providers only). Reactivation cancels any pending scheduled suspension or deactivation and permits new eligible activity only. It must not restore cancelled quotes/cases, reopen accepted selections, reinstate old reservations, restart payment windows, clear unresolved support markers, or restore the Featured flag.
attrs.rationale: Near-duplicate of REQ-015-021 and REQ-015-027 in this FR.

nodes.title: Reactivation modal rules

attrs.statement: Available only when provider status = Suspended; Deactivated providers can never be reactivated (Rule 4) The reason is required, 20 to 500 characters; the admin re-authenticates with the acting admin's password (MFA once the FR-026 and FR-031 MFA stack is delivered) and must check "I confirm this action" to enable submit; Notify Provider is checked by default and sends the reactivation email to the provider Owner including the reason On submit, status changes to Active immediately; the status event (reason, admin, timestamp) is logged in Tab 8 On submit, any pending scheduled suspension or deactivation is cancelled automatically; the cancellation is logged in Tab 8 with the reactivation reason and admin, and the reactivation email states that the scheduled change no longer applies (if the provider had been notified of it)
attrs.rationale: Screen 5 business rules and Alternative Flow A6 (reason 20-500 chars, admin password, confirm checkbox, Notify Provider default checked).

nodes.title: Status change modal requires reason, password and confirmation

attrs.statement: Admin cannot suspend or deactivate provider without providing detailed reason (minimum 20 characters) Admin must explicitly check "I confirm this action" checkbox before "Submit" button enabled (prevents accidental suspension/deactivation) Reason is 20 to 500 characters; re-authentication is the acting admin's password (MFA once the FR-026 and FR-031 MFA stack is delivered).
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 data fields and business rules.

nodes.title: Effective Date: blank or today is immediate; a future date schedules

attrs.statement: A blank or today's Effective Date is treated as immediate and is never queued for the midnight UTC job. If admin selects a future Effective Date, the suspension or deactivation is stored as pending and applied automatically on that date (job processes scheduled suspensions and deactivations daily at midnight UTC), recalculating affected records at that time (A5). Until then the provider keeps its current status, and Screen 1 and the Screen 3 header show "Scheduled: Suspend/Deactivate on DD-MM-YYYY". Only one pending change per provider is allowed; an immediate suspension or deactivation replaces any pending change. Reactivating a provider through Screen 5 cancels any pending change automatically (logged in Tab 8 with the reactivation reason).
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 Scheduled Status Change bullet. Near-duplicate of REQ-015-028 in this FR.

nodes.title: Cancelling a scheduled change needs a reason, re-authentication and logging

attrs.statement: Before the Effective Date, an admin can cancel the pending change from Screen 1 or the Screen 3 header by entering a reason (min 20 chars) and re-authenticating. Scheduling, cancellation, and application are logged in Tab 8; the provider Owner is emailed about the cancellation (FR-020 `provider.scheduled_change_cancelled`) if they were notified of the scheduled change.
attrs.rationale: Near-duplicate of REQ-015-028 in this FR.

nodes.title: Affected cases and quotes are previewed before confirmation

attrs.statement: Before confirmation, show the affected provider's outstanding quotes and treatment cases, grouped by current FR-006 booking stage. Include `Accepted`, `Confirmed`, `In Progress`, and `Aftercare`, including FR-011 standalone aftercare cases assigned to this provider; exclude already terminal cases.
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow A5 step 1 and the Screen 4 Affected Cases and Quotes field.

nodes.title: Terminal cases are not relabelled; care and money history is retained

attrs.statement: `Completed`, already `Cancelled`, and `Payment Window Expired` cases are not relabelled as new suspension or deactivation cancellations. Retain clinical notes, photos, completion milestones, accepted identifiers/versions, and payment/refund history. In Progress bookings awaiting the admin decision and Aftercare reassignments caused by suspension or deactivation must reach admins for clinical continuity and recovery support; automatic lifecycle cancellation does not itself transfer care or settle money; the admin replacement-provider transfer and its payment terms (full refund, no cancellation fee, new payment on the replacement booking) follow FR-006 Alternative Flow B5, and the aftercare reassignment follows FR-006 Alternative Flow B6 with no new acceptance or payment.
attrs.rationale: Near-duplicate of REQ-015-021 in this FR.

nodes.title: Account-closure request approval path

attrs.statement: Admin clicks "Deactivate Provider", which opens Screen 4 with Deactivate selected and the reason pre-filled as "Provider requested account closure on [date]" (editable, min 20 chars). Admin chooses immediate or scheduled deactivation, re-authenticates, and confirms. "Notify Provider" is checked and locked, because FR-032 promised the provider an email once the account is deactivated. When the deactivation takes effect, the system marks the FR-032 closure request Approved, links it to the deactivation status event, and logs both in Tab 8. If the admin scheduled the deactivation for a future Effective Date, the request stays Pending Admin Review until that date, and the Screen 1 marker reads "Closure requested, deactivation scheduled DD-MM-YYYY". If the scheduled deactivation is cancelled before it takes effect, the request stays Pending Admin Review, the marker returns to "Closure Requested", and no rejection email is sent.
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow A7 steps 2, 3 and 5. There is no self-service deactivation.

nodes.title: Account-closure request rejection needs review notes

attrs.statement: If the admin rejects the request instead (e.g., the provider withdraws it) with "Reject Request" on the Closure request notice in the Screen 3 header, which requires the FR-031 Suspend Providers permission (the same as the deactivation it declines), the admin enters review notes (required, min 20 chars); the request is marked Rejected, the provider keeps its current status, the Closure Requested marker clears, and the provider receives the FR-020 `provider.closure_rejected` email with the review notes (mandatory).
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow A7 step 6.

nodes.title: Closure Requested marker on the provider list

attrs.statement: Rows with a pending FR-032 account-closure request show a "Closure Requested — DD-MM-YYYY" badge (request date) next to the status badge, linking to the request in the provider profile (A7). While a deactivation scheduled from the request is pending, the badge reads "Closure requested, deactivation scheduled DD-MM-YYYY" (Effective Date). The marker clears when the request is Approved (the deactivation has taken effect) or Rejected
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 business rule.

nodes.title: Dashboard default view and search

attrs.statement: Dashboard displays all providers with status = "Active" by default on initial load Search queries match against provider name, clinic name, email, medical license number (case-insensitive) Search Bar accepts at most 200 characters; Status Filter allows multiple selections; Featured Filter, when switched on, shows only featured providers; Commission Type Filter is Percentage, Flat Rate or All; Closure Requested Filter shows providers with a pending FR-032 closure request.
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 data fields and business rules.

nodes.title: Dashboard quick actions depend on provider status

attrs.statement: Each row includes action buttons: "View Profile", "Edit", "Set Featured" (if active and not featured), "Unset Featured" (if featured), "Suspend" (if active), "Reactivate" (if suspended; opens Screen 5), "Deactivate" (if active/suspended), "Cancel Scheduled Change" (if a scheduled suspension/deactivation is pending)
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 281 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Commission rate sorting groups by model

attrs.statement: Table columns sortable by name (alphabetical), created date (chronological), and commission rate. Commission rate sorting groups by model: all Percentage providers first, ordered by percentage value, then all Flat Rate providers, ordered by Flat Rate Currency (ISO code) and then amount. Descending order reverses the value order within each group; amounts in different currencies are never compared. A provider on the FR-029 global default sorts by the default value, in the group of the default model
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 284 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Commission Rate column shows the effective rate with Default and Scheduled tags

attrs.statement: Shows the provider's current effective commission. A provider on the FR-029 global default shows the default rate with "(Default)", for example "15% (Default)". A provider whose only provider-specific configuration is future-dated shows its current effective rate (the global default until the Effective Date) plus a "Scheduled" tag
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 285 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Last Activity Date derivation and date filter

attrs.statement: Last Activity Date is system-derived: the most recent of the provider's last FR-004 Parent Quote submission and last FR-006 booking confirmation (empty if neither has occurred); providers with no Last Activity Date are excluded when filtering by it. The Date Range Filter filters by provider creation date or Last Activity Date and needs a valid date range.
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 Date Range Filter field.

nodes.title: Status count tiles count all providers regardless of filters

attrs.statement: Status Count Tiles show counts of Active, Suspended and Deactivated providers above the table (SC-012), calculated from provider status; they count all providers regardless of active filters and refresh with real-time status updates.
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 data fields.

nodes.title: Dashboard badges, featured star and pagination

attrs.statement: Active (green), Suspended (yellow), Deactivated (red) Gold star icon displayed next to provider name if featured = true Display 50 providers per page, with page navigation controls
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 280.

nodes.title: Wizard and profile field limits

attrs.statement: First Name and Last Name max 50 chars; Bio/Description min 50, max 500 chars; Years of Experience numeric 0-60; Medical License Number max 50 chars; Clinic Name min 3, max 200 chars; Location City max 100 chars; Website URL valid http/https (https:// is prepended when missing); Profile Picture/Logo max 5MB, JPEG/PNG, min 200x200px; Cover Image max 10MB, JPEG/PNG; each award has name (max 100 chars), issuer (max 150 chars, optional), description (max 300 chars), year (1900 to current) and image (max 2MB, JPEG/PNG).
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 Steps 1 to 3 and Screen 3 Tabs 1 and 4 validation columns.

nodes.title: Specialty and country values come from managed lists

attrs.statement: Specialty values come from the centrally managed Provider Specialties list (FR-026 Screen 5f), active values only; a stored value later deactivated in FR-026 still displays but cannot be newly selected. Location country values come from the centrally managed country list (FR-026).
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 Step 2 and 3; Tab 1.

nodes.title: Languages: at least one, from the FR-021 catalog

attrs.statement: At least 1 language must be selected (validation prevents removing last language); attempting to save with none shows: "At least one language is required." Language list consumed from the FR-021 central language catalog; chips mean languages spoken at the clinic, not UI language A stored language later removed from the catalog still displays but cannot be newly selected.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 Step 2, Tab 2 and the FR-021 dependency.

nodes.title: The wizard saves no drafts and warns before leaving

attrs.statement: The wizard does not save drafts. If the admin has entered any data and tries to leave the wizard before "Create Provider" succeeds (in-app navigation, browser Back, or closing/reloading the tab), the system shows the FR-032 unsaved-changes message text, "You have unsaved changes. Are you sure you want to leave?", with only "Stay" and "Leave" actions. The FR-032 Save option is not offered, because the wizard has no drafts. "Leave" discards all entered data; for tab close or reload the browser's native leave-page prompt is used.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 369 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Commission and payout inputs: model, value, currency, start date, payout method

attrs.statement: Commission Model is Percentage (default) or Flat Rate. Percentage value is 0-100 with 0.1% precision; Flat Rate value is greater than 0 in the Flat Rate Currency's minor units, per FR-029. Flat Rate Currency is required for Flat Rate, taken from the FR-029 enabled currency list and defaulting to the system default currency. Commission Start Date is required, today (current UTC date) or a future date. Payout Method is required (Stripe Connect or Manual bank transfer) with no preselected value. System displays client-side validation error immediately: "Percentage must be between 0-100%" or "Flat rate must be greater than 0." Server-side validation also enforces rules; the API returns a 422 validation error whose field message uses the same PRD wording if an invalid rate is submitted.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 Step 5 and Tab 7 data fields; Implementation Notes validation applies on client and server.

nodes.title: Commission edit eligibility by provider status

attrs.statement: Commission settings can be edited for Active and Suspended providers (so terms can be fixed before reactivation). For Deactivated providers Tab 7 is read-only; history stays visible. FR-029 Screen 5 applies the same rule (CR-FR029-20261015-02). When a deactivation takes effect, the system automatically cancels any pending Scheduled Configuration and logs the cancellation in Commission History
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 647 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Scheduled commission configuration: at most one pending

attrs.statement: "Today" means the current UTC date (the same calendar used by the midnight UTC jobs). An edit with an Effective Date of today applies immediately to newly confirmed bookings. An edit with a future Effective Date is stored as the provider's Scheduled Configuration; at most one may be pending per provider. Saving another future-dated edit replaces the pending one (the replacement is logged in Commission History with both values). On its Effective Date the scheduled configuration becomes the current configuration automatically. The pending configuration is shown read-only to the provider in the FR-032 Screen 4 Commission & Payout panel.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 652 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Commission edit removes the provider from a shared FR-029 scope

attrs.statement: A provider belongs to at most one active provider-specific commission scope. If this provider is currently covered by an FR-029 scope shared with other providers, saving a commission edit here removes this provider from that shared scope and creates a single-provider scope for it with the new values; the other providers in the shared scope are unchanged. The tab warns the admin before saving, and the split is logged in Commission History and the FR-029 audit trail.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 655 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Commission and payout changes are logged with old and new values

attrs.statement: All changes to commission and payout settings logged in history with timestamp, admin user, old/new values
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 656 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Provider-specific commission stays synchronized with FR-029 Screen 5

attrs.statement: Changes made to provider-specific commission values here MUST stay synchronized with the provider-specific commission data shown in FR-029 Screen 5 for the same provider
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 654 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Tab 7 is the single-provider commission surface; Tab 1 shows commission read-only

attrs.statement: FR-029 / A-09 owns the central commission-settings screen (global default + provider-specific commission scopes) and the booking-time snapshot policy; this tab remains the single-provider management surface for provider-specific commission configuration. Commission is edited only in Tab 7; Tab 1 shows it read-only as the Commission Summary, with a "Manage in Commission & Financials" link to Tab 7.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 649 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Commission edits apply to bookings confirmed after the Effective Date

attrs.statement: Commission edits apply to bookings confirmed after the configuration becomes effective, not to every later payment transaction. Resolve the effective provider-specific configuration (or global default) and snapshot its model/value (and Flat Rate currency) at FR-006 booking confirmation under FR-029. Until a new configuration's Effective Date, the previous configuration remains effective. Existing confirmed bookings retain that snapshot for subsequent installments, deductions, and payout reconciliation. Patient price/currency/exchange-rate context is locked at FR-005 acceptance; commission is locked at booking confirmation; nothing is fixed at quote creation. An accepted-but-unpaid selection has not yet fixed its commission snapshot. The Percentage and Flat Rate models remain unchanged; a flat fee remains one deduction per completed procedure, not one per package, Subquote, or installment.
attrs.rationale: Near-duplicate of REQ-015-022 and General Module Rule 5 in this FR.

nodes.title: Commission and payout edits require admin re-authentication

attrs.statement: Admin can edit commission settings (requires re-authentication). In MVP this is implemented as password re-entry; once the shared MFA stack from FR-026 / FR-031 is delivered, these actions MUST use MFA-based re-authentication and any MFA references in this FR are to be understood as future (non-MVP) behavior.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 648 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Seat limit changes require admin re-authentication

attrs.statement: Seat Limit changes require admin re-authentication for security. In MVP this is implemented as password re-entry; once the shared MFA stack from FR-026 / FR-031 is delivered, these actions MUST use MFA-based re-authentication and any MFA references in this FR are to be understood as future (non-MVP) behavior.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 458 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Saves apply changed fields only; last save wins

attrs.statement: An admin save (FR-015) or provider save (FR-032) applies only the fields the user changed; untouched fields are not rewritten. Last save wins only when two people change the same field. There is no conflict check and no conflict message.
attrs.rationale: Concurrent-edit edge case: no conflict check and no conflict message.

nodes.title: Profile edits never alter accepted snapshots or booking commission snapshots

attrs.statement: Current profile edits must not alter an FR-005 accepted snapshot, historical appointment/price/package context, or an FR-006 booking commission snapshot. This does not prevent normal current-profile synchronization with FR-032.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 451 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Owner login email change

attrs.statement: Changing the Email Address (the Owner's login ID) requires admin password re-authentication and a reason (the admin change reason above). The new address is validated against the FR-009 global provider email identity rule (REQ-015-014) before saving. The Owner does not confirm the new address. On save, the system: sends FR-020 `provider.login_email_changed` (mandatory security notice) to the old address, saying the login email was changed to the new address (partly masked) by a Hairline admin, with the date and time and a prompt to contact support if unexpected, and to the new address, saying it is now the login email for the clinic; signs the Owner out of all sessions and revokes the Owner's tokens; if `password_set` is false, invalidates the pending activation link and sends a new activation email (FR-020 `provider.activation`) to the new address; this email is sent only when the provider status is Active or Suspended, because Tab 1 is read-only for a Deactivated provider. An admin Owner handover (FR-009 Rule 11, REQ-009-174) applies these same steps to the new Owner's email: admin re-authentication, a reason, notices to the old and new address, and the old Owner signed out; if `password_set` is false, the pending activation link is invalidated and a new activation email goes to the new Owner automatically.
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 454.

nodes.title: Seat limit below current team size warns and needs admin confirmation

attrs.statement: System validates seat limit against current team size, meaning FR-009 seat usage (non-Owner team members with status Active or Suspended plus invitations with status Pending that are not past expiry; the Owner, Removed members, and Expired, Cancelled, or Accepted invitations do not count (FR-009 Rule 6, CR-FR009-20261028-01)). If seat limit is set below current count (e.g., provider has 50 staff but admin sets limit to 30), system displays warning: "Current team size (50) exceeds new seat limit (30). Existing team members will not be removed, but no new invitations can be sent until limit is increased or team size is reduced." Admin must confirm to proceed. Existing team members remain active; only new invitations are blocked.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 1175 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Staff tab: invite blocked at the seat limit or when not Active

attrs.statement: Invite is blocked when the provider's Seat Limit (Rule 7) is reached and when provider status is Suspended or Deactivated. "Invite Staff Member": admin enters an email and selects one of the provider's existing roles (not Owner); the invitation uses FR-009's normal invitation email, acceptance, and expiry flow.
