Requires the FR-031 "Edit Providers" permission; the invite and the inviting admin are logged in FR-009's audit trail and Tab 8. The FR-009 admin actions (force suspend member, reset invitation, Owner handover, view audit log, impersonate) remain available for Active and Suspended providers; for a Deactivated provider only "view audit log" remains, and impersonation follows the Login as Provider rules (REQ-015-121). Owner handover (FR-009 REQ-009-174) is available for Active and Suspended providers and unavailable for Deactivated providers, and needs the Edit Providers permission and admin re-authentication.
attrs.rationale: Tab 3 embeds FR-009 Screen 12. Overlaps FR-009 REQ-009-024 and REQ-009-143.

nodes.title: Reviews tab defers review actions to FR-013

attrs.statement: Admin insert, edit, and remove actions follow FR-013 (including the "Verified Off-platform" label, verification source/date, and audit trail); FR-015 does not define its own review editing rules Providers cannot edit or delete reviews; they can only respond via FR-013 Screen 6
attrs.rationale: Tab 5 business rules.

nodes.title: Activity log content, immutability, filters

attrs.statement: Activity log displays all actions: profile edits, status changes, document uploads, logins, commission changes Each log entry includes: timestamp, user (admin or provider via FR-032), action type, changed fields, IP address Logs are immutable (cannot be edited or deleted) Admin can filter by action type, date range, user
attrs.rationale: Tab 8 business rules.

nodes.title: Suspension entries link affected records and show Admin Support Required

attrs.statement: Suspension/deactivation entries must link the affected case/inquiry references, prior stages, cancellation causes, support markers, slot-release results, and notification outcomes. Display `Admin Support Required` for unresolved provider-caused cancellations with a link to the existing FR-016 patient intervention/support context; do not add a case-management editor to this tab.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 682 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Activity log CSV export

attrs.statement: Admin can export the activity log for compliance reporting as a CSV file of the rows matching the current filters. Export is available to every admin who can view Tab 8 (FR-031 View Providers). IP addresses are included unmasked. The export action itself is logged in Tab 8
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 684 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Login as Provider is Super Admin only and opens in a new tab

attrs.statement: Login as Provider is allowed when the provider is Active or Suspended. It is blocked when the provider is Deactivated, with the message: "Login as Provider is not available for a deactivated provider." These rules apply both to impersonating the Owner and to impersonating a team member (FR-009 REQ-009-023). The impersonation session opens in a new browser tab; the admin's own Admin Platform tab stays open. Session start (with reason), end, and every write action performed during the session are logged in Tab 8: Activity Log, attributed to the admin user acting as the provider. Login as Provider is Super Admin only (Screen 3 header quick actions; Security Considerations Authorization).
attrs.rationale: Overlaps REQ-015-026 and FR-009 REQ-009-023.

nodes.title: Header quick actions: Edit Profile opens all tabs in edit mode; the others are shown only for the matching status

attrs.statement: "Edit Profile" opens all tabs in edit mode. "Reactivate" (visible only if Suspended; opens Screen 5) "Cancel Scheduled Change" (visible only if a scheduled suspension/deactivation is pending; see Screen 4)
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 281 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Admin save of provider data keeps per-tab permission and reason

attrs.statement: Fields marked "Both" can be edited by provider via FR-032 and changes sync to admin view in real-time
attrs.rationale: Tab 1 business rules; Both-fields sync in real time.

nodes.title: Admin chooses the clinic's payout method at creation

attrs.statement: The admin MUST choose the clinic's payout method (Stripe Connect or Manual bank transfer) when creating the clinic in Screen 2 Step 5. The clinic sees its payout method and payout readiness read-only and completes Stripe's own sign-up itself.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 Step 5 Payout Method row and Payout Method Rule.

nodes.title: Only an admin changes the payout method after go-live

attrs.statement: After go-live, only an admin MUST be able to change a clinic's payout method (Tab 7); a clinic that wants a change asks Hairline.
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 Tab 7 Payout Method row and Payout Method Rule.

nodes.title: Activation does not wait for payout readiness

attrs.statement: Clinic creation and activation MUST NOT wait for payout readiness; a clinic can go live before its Stripe payout setup is Ready.
attrs.rationale: Rule 2 and Payout Readiness Rule.

nodes.title: A share due to a clinic that is not Ready stays with Hairline until Ready

attrs.statement: When a booking's share is due to move to a clinic whose Stripe payout setup is not Ready, the share MUST stay with Hairline, the clinic and the admin MUST be told, and the share MUST move once the clinic becomes Ready. Nothing is paid out to the clinic before then, even after treatment.
attrs.rationale: Payout Readiness Rule; Tab 7 Payout Readiness field.

nodes.title: No per-clinic payout frequency; one settlement period on the manual rail

attrs.statement: There MUST be no per-clinic payout frequency. On the manual bank transfer rail, one settlement-period setting owned by FR-029 (default weekly, Sunday cutoff, Wednesday payout) applies to all manually paid clinics; on the Stripe Connect rail, release is automatic.
attrs.rationale: Billing Rule 1.

nodes.title: Phone numbers must be valid; the public phone is a country code plus a numeric number

attrs.statement: The provider Phone Number MUST be a valid phone number with country code (Screen 2 Step 1, Tab 1). The public Contact Phone has a Country Code (dropdown from FR-026) and a Number (numeric only, length validated per country code).
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 314, 337, 423, 432 (Phone Number valid format with country code; Contact Phone (Public) country code dropdown plus numeric number).

nodes.title: Languages can be reordered by drag and drop

attrs.statement: On the Languages tab the admin can reorder the clinic's languages by drag and drop to prioritise them.
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 490 (Tab 2 notes: drag-and-drop reordering supported to prioritize languages).

nodes.title: Awards can be reordered by drag and drop and images uploaded by drag and drop

attrs.statement: On the Awards tab the admin can reorder awards by drag and drop to prioritise the most important ones, and the award image upload supports drag and drop (max 2MB, JPEG/PNG only).
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 524, 525 (Tab 4 business rules: drag-and-drop reordering; award image upload supports drag-and-drop).

nodes.title: Tab 6 document list sort and filter options

attrs.statement: The Tab 6 document list is sorted by Upload Date (newest first, the default), Document Type or Uploaded By, and can be filtered by Document Type and by Uploaded By (Provider or Admin).
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 576, 608, 609, 610 (Tab 6 Document List sortable/filterable; Sort/Filter Options).

nodes.title: Document upload failure shows an error and retries automatically

attrs.statement: If a document upload fails, the admin sees the error "Document upload failed. Please retry." The upload is retried automatically up to 3 times before it fails, and an interrupted upload (for example a network interruption) can be retried by the admin; the system supports resumable uploads and may resume from the last successful chunk if implemented, otherwise it restarts the upload.
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 972, 1168 (External Service 3 failure handling; edge case upload fails mid-upload).

nodes.title: Reactivation modal shows the count of unresolved support items

attrs.statement: Screen 5 shows the number of this provider's affected inquiries and cases (bookings, In Progress or Aftercare cases, standalone aftercare) still marked Admin Support Required. Each affected record counts once, matching the FR-020 `provider.status_cancellation_admin_support` unit (one per affected inquiry or case). The count links to the FR-016 list filtered to this provider and Admin Support Required. It is informational and does not block reactivation.
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 757 (Screen 5 Unresolved Support Items row).

nodes.title: Tab 7 shows the clinic's payout readiness read-only

attrs.statement: For a Stripe Connect clinic, Tab 7 shows Payout Readiness read-only as one of four states: Not started, In progress, Ready, Restricted. The clinic completes Stripe's own sign-up itself and sees the same status read-only in its own dashboard.
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 636 (Tab 7 Payout Readiness row), 1240 (Key Entity 1 relationships: payout readiness shown to admins and the clinic read-only).

nodes.title: Creation also makes the Owner's team-member and org-role records

attrs.statement: When the provider is created, the system also creates, in the same transaction, the Owner's team-member record (ownership flag set; the Owner does not count toward the Seat Limit, FR-009 Rule 6) and the Owner's org-role record (FR-009 REQ-009-196).
attrs.rationale: Main Flow step 12. FR-009 relies on FR-015 creating both records at onboarding.

nodes.title: Deactivation cancels the provider's Pending team invitations

attrs.statement: Deactivation cancels every Pending team invitation of the provider (FR-009 REQ-009-194) in the same transaction as the status change, with an audit entry in Tab 8; a scheduled deactivation does this on the Effective Date.
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow A5 Deactivation, Screen 4 Deactivation rules and General Module Rule 4.

nodes.title: Earnings on normally completed bookings are released by an admin; a Deactivated clinic's Payout Method stays editable while shares are unpaid

attrs.statement: Money earned on bookings completed normally before a suspension or deactivation is not touched by the status cascade and gets no automatic statement (FR-017 REQ-017-062). An admin releases it through the FR-017 admin financial resolution route, whatever the clinic's status. While unpaid shares remain, an admin may change the Payout Method of a Deactivated clinic in Tab 7.
attrs.rationale: Payment and Billing Rules (Earnings Release Rule) and Tab 7 edit eligibility. Owner default 253.

nodes.title: Provider suspension and deactivation make conversations read-only

attrs.statement: Suspension and deactivation also make the provider's conversations with patients read-only, history kept, as FR-012 REQ-012-018 rules. A suspended provider may still chat on its open `In Progress` and `Aftercare` cases (REQ-015-077); a deactivated provider cannot, because its login is disabled.
attrs.rationale: Provider status effects; the read-only rule itself is owned by FR-012 REQ-012-018.

nodes.title: Aftercare Participation is a yes or no setting on the provider profile

attrs.statement: Aftercare Participation is a yes or no setting on the provider profile, default On, that an admin sets when creating the provider (Screen 2 Step 5) and can change later in Tab 1 while the provider is Active or Suspended. When On, FR-011 assigns a patient's aftercare to this clinic while it is Active; when Off, to the Hairline aftercare team (FR-011 REQ-011-054). A change applies to aftercare assigned afterwards.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 Step 5 and Screen 3 Tab 1; the assignment rule is owned by FR-011 REQ-011-054.

nodes.title: Provider record carries an Email delivery issue flag shown read-only to admins

attrs.statement: System MUST keep an "Email delivery issue" flag on the Provider record, set by the FR-030 bounce handling (Workflow B1 step 7, REQ-030-156) exactly as for the patient account, and MUST show it read-only to admins on Screen 3 Tab 1 beside Email Address. No admin action on Screen 3 sets or clears it, and the provider does not see it.
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 Tab 1 row Email Delivery Issue; Data Requirements. FR-030 REQ-030-156 owns the setting of the flag for every account type; the patient equivalent is ENT-patient.email_delivery_issue.

nodes.title: Provider record keeps copies of clinic address, country and avatar and the activation email counters

attrs.statement: System MUST keep on the Provider record a copy of the clinic address (Clinic Address), the clinic country (Location - Country) and the clinic avatar (Profile Picture / Logo), so that other FRs read them together with the provider, and MUST keep each copy in step with the profile value whenever an admin (Screens 2 and 3) or the provider (FR-032) changes it. The Provider record also keeps the activation email send count and the time of the last activation email, which serve the REQ-015-016 resend limit.
attrs.rationale: Data Requirements. The graph descriptions of ENT-provider.address, ENT-provider.country and ENT-provider.avatar already call them copies of the profile values; REQ-015-007 requires profile data to stay in sync; REQ-015-016 is the resend limit.

nodes.title: System immediately revokes patient authentication tokens

attrs.statement: System immediately revokes patient authentication tokens, which ends every existing session of the patient on every device (FR-001 REQ-001-182)
attrs.rationale: Stated in prd.md, Alternative Flows (line 247).

nodes.title: Patient receives a suspension notification that tells them to contact support to appeal

attrs.statement: System sends suspension notification to patient; the notice tells the patient to contact support to appeal, which creates an FR-034 support ticket
attrs.rationale: Stated in prd.md, Alternative Flows (line 249).

nodes.title: Booking changes and cancellations happen on the case detail page, not in the intervention flow

attrs.statement: Note: Booking modifications or cancellations occur on the dedicated case/inquiry detail page; the intervention flow links admins there rather than duplicating controls.
attrs.rationale: Stated in prd.md, Alternative Flows (line 253).

nodes.title: After subquote acceptance the patient requests cancellation through Contact Support

attrs.statement: From subquote acceptance onward the patient has no in-app booking cancellation; the patient uses Contact Support on the FR-006 booking screens, and the request is logged as an FR-034 support case of type booking cancellation or booking change
attrs.rationale: Stated in prd.md, Alternative Flows (line 257).

nodes.title: Provider suspension or deactivation cancels patient cases and flags Admin Support Required

attrs.statement: FR-015 provider suspension or deactivation (FR-015 Alternative Flow A5 and Screen 4) cancels a patient's case/inquiry or provider participation, or closes an accepted booking for the FR-006 provider-fault transfer while the inquiry stays open, with cause `ProviderSuspended` or `ProviderDeactivated` and sets `supportRequired` ("Admin Support Required"); admin receives the mandatory FR-020 admin-support alert (sent to admins with the FR-031 Respond to Support permission)
attrs.rationale: Stated in prd.md, Alternative Flows (line 269).

nodes.title: Admin Support Required view needs View Patients; Resolve Support needs Respond to Support

attrs.statement: Viewing the Admin Support Required list and the patient's Provider-Caused Impacts requires FR-031 View Patients; Resolve Support requires FR-031 Respond to Support (default roles Super Admin, Aftercare Coordinator, and Support Staff)
attrs.rationale: Stated in prd.md, Alternative Flows (line 270).

nodes.title: Admin assists the patient through existing owners; no automatic rebooking, refund or ticket

attrs.statement: Admin assists the patient through existing owners (rebooking, refunds, care continuity, FR-034 support case if created); FR-016 adds no automatic rebooking, refund, or ticket creation
attrs.rationale: Stated in prd.md, Alternative Flows (line 274).

nodes.title: Data deletion request handling: the admin reviews the request on Screen 8; FR-023 owns the process

attrs.statement: The patient submits a deletion request from Delete Account (FR-001) and it appears on Screen 8 as Pending Admin Review; the admin reviews it and may contact the patient. The process, statuses, deadline and notices are owned by FR-023
attrs.rationale: Stated in prd.md, Note: Patient Support Center / Ticketing (line 289).

nodes.title: On approval FR-023 runs the deletion; the data is anonymized in place

attrs.statement: After approval FR-023 runs the rest: the request becomes In Progress; mark account for anonymization; Remove PII (name, email, phone, address); Retain anonymized medical records and archive transaction history (retention follows the system PRD, Platform-Wide Rules: One 10-year retention period)
attrs.rationale: Stated in prd.md, Alternative Flows, patient data deletion request.

nodes.title: The Fulfilled request with the actions taken is the audit evidence; no separate certificate

attrs.statement: The request ends Fulfilled with the actions taken recorded on the request; that record is the audit evidence and no separate deletion certificate is produced
attrs.rationale: Stated in prd.md, Note: Patient Support Center / Ticketing (line 299).

nodes.title: The patient receives one outcome notice and the request ends Fulfilled

attrs.statement: System notifies the patient of the deletion outcome, listing the actions taken and the legal basis for any retained records (per FR-023); the request ends Fulfilled
attrs.rationale: Stated in prd.md, Note: Patient Support Center / Ticketing (line 300).

nodes.title: Concurrent admin edits use optimistic locking; the second admin must reload

attrs.statement: System uses optimistic locking; first admin's change succeeds, second admin receives error: "This booking was just modified by [Admin Name]. Please refresh and retry."; forces second admin to reload current state before making changes
attrs.rationale: Stated in prd.md, Edge Cases (line 1078).

nodes.title: A new support escalation from the patient alerts the admin dashboard in real time

attrs.statement: System pushes real-time notification to admin's dashboard: "New support escalation from this patient"; admin can click notification to open the Support Center case without losing current context; escalation appears in patient's overview section (via link to Support Center)
attrs.rationale: Stated in prd.md, Edge Cases (line 1081).

nodes.title: Banner and conflict warning when the patient is active during an admin edit

attrs.statement: Admin sees banner: "Patient currently active on platform (last activity: 30 seconds ago)"; admin's view refreshes automatically when patient makes changes; if admin attempts modification, system warns: "Patient is actively using the platform - your changes may conflict"
attrs.rationale: Stated in prd.md, Edge Cases (line 1084).

nodes.title: Deletion is blocked while the patient has a pending refund

attrs.statement: The request stays Pending Admin Review, marked blocked by obligation, and the patient is told the expected timeline (for example, "a pending refund of USD 500 must complete first"); when the refund completes, the system clears the mark and notifies the admins, who then approve or deny; the 30-day deadline keeps running (FR-023 Alternative Flow A3)
attrs.rationale: Stated in prd.md, Edge Cases (Edge Case 5); the handling follows FR-023 Alternative Flow A3.

nodes.title: Failed refunds retry automatically, then alert the admin after one hour

attrs.statement: System queues refund for automatic retry (exponential backoff: 1 min, 5 min, 15 min); admin sees status "Refund Pending"; if all retries fail after 1 hour, system alerts admin: "Refund failed - manual intervention required"; admin can review Stripe error and retry manually
attrs.rationale: Stated in prd.md, Edge Cases (line 1093).

nodes.title: Admins may edit questionnaire responses with a logged reason; scans stay unchanged

attrs.statement: Admins MAY edit a patient's medical questionnaire responses and alerts (FR-003 admin edit capability), but only with a typed reason that is logged in the audit trail with the edit. Patient scans MUST NOT be modified by admins; scan media is immutable except by patients
attrs.rationale: Stated in prd.md, Business Rules, General Module Rule 2.

nodes.title: Admin visibility and edit rights follow FR-031 role permissions

attrs.statement: Admin visibility and edit rights follow the FR-031 role permissions: View Patients grants patient visibility (all default roles), Edit Patients grants patient edits (Super Admin by default), Manage Aftercare covers aftercare actions and access to medical data and scans (Super Admin and Aftercare Coordinator by default), View Support Center and Respond to Support cover support actions (Super Admin, Aftercare Coordinator, and Support Staff by default), Issue Refunds covers refunds, and Delete Patients covers approving deletion requests. Actions the FR-031 list does not name map as follows: Reset Password, Unlock Account, Lift Suspension, and Take Action on a flagged conversation need Edit Patients; Payment Retry needs the FR-031 Retry Charge permission and Send Payment Reminder needs Send Payment Reminders; Super Admin and Billing Admin hold both by default, and the Payment Retry button calls the FR-007B Retry Charge action; Send Notification needs Respond to Support; the Payments tab needs View Patient Billing; the Communications tab needs View Provider-Patient Messages, and flagging a conversation needs Flag Communications
attrs.rationale: Stated in prd.md, General Module Rules (line 683).

nodes.title: Admin booking interventions use FR-006 actions and notify patient and provider within 5 minutes

attrs.statement: Admin interventions that affect bookings (reschedule, cancel) MUST go through the FR-006 Change Appointment or Cancel Booking action and MUST notify both patient and provider within 5 minutes through `booking.rescheduled` or `booking.cancelled`
attrs.rationale: Stated in prd.md, General Module Rules (line 687).

nodes.title: Only Manage Aftercare admins can view and download patient scans, with downloads logged

nodes.title: Admins can cancel a booking only through the FR-006 Cancel Booking action

attrs.statement: Editable by admin: Booking cancellation only through the FR-006 Cancel Booking action: allowed for `Accepted`, `Payment Window Expired`, and `Confirmed` bookings (`In Progress` goes through FR-006 Screen 11, Alternative Flow B7, and `Aftercare` has no cancel button), on an admin decision or a support-routed patient request, with a mandatory reason, confirmation, and audit entry (Flow A8, Screen 9)

Restated: prd.md line 261: "For a cancellation request, admin opens the FR-006 Cancel Booking action (FR-006 Screen 9), which applies to any booking state from `Accepted` to `Aftercare`, enters the mandatory reason, and confirms; the booking and inquiry become `Cancelled`, the accepted quote stays accepted, the patient and provider receive `booking.cancelled`, and refunds follow the refund rules in FR-006 (Payment & Billing Rules: the refund ladder set in FR-029, or the provider-fault terms where the provider is at fault)"

attrs.rationale: Stated in prd.md, Screen 9: Booking Support Requests (Cancellation and Change), Business Rules.

nodes.title: Patient list location filter uses the admin settings country list

nodes.title: Admin audit log carries tamper-proof checksums and is append-only

attrs.statement: The admin audit log carries tamper-proof checksums that ensure the integrity of its entries, and its entries are append-only
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 603 (Screen 7 Notes: tamper-proof checksums ensure log integrity), 934 (Security Considerations: audit trail with tamper-proof checksums, immutable and append-only)

nodes.title: Milestone card summary shows provider, location and payment amount in one or two lines

attrs.statement: Each milestone card on the Treatment Journey tab shows a summary of one to two lines with the key datapoints: provider, location and payment amount
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 426 (Screen 3 Summary row)

nodes.title: Additional patient documents: PDF and image files only, at most 5

attrs.statement: A patient may upload additional documents besides head photos and scans as PDF or image files only, at most 5 files per patient; each file follows the existing patient upload size limits.
attrs.rationale: prd.md Screen 4 Medical Data tab, Uploaded Documents field and business rules; owner answer 2026-11-22

nodes.title: A suspension cancels only bookings in the FR-006 cancel states and lists the others

attrs.statement: A suspension cancels only the patient's bookings in `Accepted`, `Payment Window Expired`, and `Confirmed`; `In Progress` and `Aftercare` bookings are left untouched and listed on the suspension confirmation dialog for admin follow-up. The suspension audit entry lists the booking ids cancelled, failed and left untouched.
attrs.rationale: General Module Rules, Rule 10; Alternative Flow A6 steps 5 and 10; User Story 7 scenario 4.

nodes.title: If a suspension cancellation fails, the suspension still applies

attrs.statement: If a booking cancellation in a suspension fails, the suspension still applies, the failed bookings are listed for admin follow-up and marked "Cancellation failed" on the patient's Overview tab, and the admin retries each through the FR-006 cancel action.
attrs.rationale: General Module Rules, Rule 10; Alternative Flow A6 step 11.

nodes.title: Suspension cancellations send a fixed neutral reason; the justification stays in the audit entry

attrs.statement: The cancellation cause in a suspension cascade is "Patient account suspended" (admin-initiated, request source Admin, the acting admin carried from this flow); the reason sent to the patient and the provider is the fixed text "Booking cancelled because the patient account was suspended"; the admin justification stays in the audit entry only.
attrs.rationale: General Module Rules, Rule 10; Alternative Flow A6 step 10.

nodes.title: An admin can lift a suspension early and unlock a Locked account; the appeal is a support contact

attrs.statement: An admin with Edit Patients can lift a suspension early with a justification; the system logs Suspension Lifted and notifies the patient. Lift Suspension is shown on the patient Overview only while the account is Suspended and Unlock Account only while it is Locked. The appeal is the patient contacting support, which creates an FR-034 ticket; this module has no appeal queue.
attrs.rationale: General Module Rules, Rule 11; Screen 2 quick actions and notes; Module Scope.

nodes.title: The $1,000 refund threshold is in US dollars; other currencies are converted at the FR-007 rate

attrs.statement: The enhanced-confirmation threshold for refunds is 1,000 US dollars; an amount in another currency is converted at the rate FR-007 applies to that payment before it is compared.
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow A3 step 4; Screen 5; General Module Rules, Rule 4.

nodes.title: Screen 8 shows status badges for Overdue, Blocked by obligation, Jurisdiction review and Needs attention

attrs.statement: Each deletion request row shows a badge only while its condition applies: Overdue (past the SLA due date), Blocked by obligation, Jurisdiction review, and Needs attention (the open inquiry could not be cancelled; the signal is owned by FR-023 and has no field in this module).
attrs.rationale: Screen 8 table columns; FR-023 queue requirements.

nodes.title: A password reset never changes a Suspended status; only a Locked account becomes Active after a reset

attrs.statement: A password reset never changes a Suspended status and the Reset Password button is hidden for a Suspended patient; a Locked account becomes Active after a reset, and any other status is unchanged.
attrs.rationale: General Module Rules, Rule 12; Alternative Flow A4 step 2; User Story 4 scenario 4; Screen 2 quick actions.

nodes.title: While a patient is suspended, conversations are read-only and open inquiries and quotes stay as they are

attrs.statement: While a patient is suspended, their conversations are read-only; their open inquiries and quotes stay as they are and follow their own expiry; nothing is cancelled except the bookings in the suspension cascade. When the suspension is lifted or ends, the conversations reopen.
attrs.rationale: General Module Rules, Rule 10; Alternative Flow A6 step 14; Alternative Flow A9 step 3. The FR-012 side is queued for FR-012.

nodes.title: Take Action on a flagged conversation offers a formal warning to the patient or a suspension

attrs.statement: Take Action on a flagged conversation offers one step: send a formal warning to the patient, or suspend the account through the existing suspension flow; it needs Edit Patients, and provider warnings are not sent from the patient page.
attrs.rationale: Screen 6 Business Rules; Alternative Flow A12; User Story 5 scenario 4; General Module Rule 3.

nodes.title: Admin email change is saved unverified and shown on the Overview

attrs.statement: An email change made with Edit Patient is saved as unverified, a notice goes to the old address, and the patient confirms a code sent to the new address at the next login (FR-001 REQ-001-184); an address already in use is refused. The Overview shows the verification state and an "Email change pending" mark
attrs.rationale: Edit Patient and Overview Email Verified row; the verification flow is owned by FR-001 REQ-001-184.

nodes.title: Support Case Reference is a plain reference without View Support Center

attrs.statement: On Booking Support Requests the Support Case Reference opens the support case for an admin with View Support Center; for an admin without it the reference is plain text with no link (FR-034 REQ-034-094)
attrs.rationale: Booking Support Requests screen; the access rule is owned by FR-034 REQ-034-094.

nodes.title: Admins view all patient invoices filtered by payment status

attrs.statement: System MUST allow admins to view all patient invoices with filtering by Payment Status (Unpaid, Deposit only, Installments active, Full paid, Refunded), Final Payment Status (Not Due, Due, Overdue) and the At Risk flag
attrs.rationale: PRD id REQ-017-001 (prd.md line 1764). Restated by Admin Platform scope Patient Billing (line 69) and Screen 4 (lines 544-612).

nodes.title: Admins view the manual-rail payment schedule and process payouts

attrs.statement: System MUST allow admins to view the manual-rail provider payment schedule (the one platform-wide weekly settlement period) and process payouts with itemized treatment breakdowns
attrs.rationale: PRD id REQ-017-002 (prd.md line 1765). Restated by Admin Platform scope Provider Billing (line 70) and Screens 2 and 3.

nodes.title: Admins view discount usage, fee split, revenue and ROI

attrs.statement: System MUST allow admins to view discount code usage, fee split, attributed revenue, and ROI for discounts created and managed in FR-019 / A-06
attrs.rationale: PRD id REQ-017-003 (prd.md line 1766). Restated by Admin Platform scope Discount Usage & ROI Tracking (line 72) and Screen 5.

nodes.title: Invoice PDFs on payment; one invoice per booking from the accepted snapshot

attrs.statement: System MUST automatically generate invoice/payment PDFs upon successful patient payment, retaining one invoice record per booking and updating its payment history for later installments/final payments. Invoice amounts and itemization use the accepted subquote snapshot via FR-006, including the promotion and price after promotion frozen at acceptance; billing never recalculates the promotion, and unaccepted alternatives are not billed.
attrs.rationale: PRD id REQ-017-004 (prd.md line 1767). Restated by Billing Rule 1 (line 1235: initial successful payment creates the booking's invoice; later successful payments update that same invoice and generate the payment PDF or receipt; mere subquote acceptance or unpaid options create no invoice), Screen 4 business rules (lines 588-589: invoice generated when the patient completes booking payment, deposit or full; an eligible first installment also confirms the booking and generates its invoice), Data Dependencies Entity 1 (line 1374) and Key Entity 1 relationships (one invoice per booking).

nodes.title: Installments charged on configured dates with 3 retries

attrs.statement: System MUST automatically schedule and charge installment payments on configured dates, with 3 retry attempts for failed charges
attrs.rationale: PRD id REQ-017-005 (prd.md line 1768). Restated by Entry Points automated triggers (lines 124 and 127: installment cron daily at 3 AM UTC; failed payment events trigger admin alerts and retry mechanisms) and Shared Services S-02 (lines 81-83).

nodes.title: Provider payouts from Completed or Aftercare treatments less commission

attrs.statement: System MUST calculate provider payouts based on completed treatments (status "Completed" or "Aftercare"), deducting platform commission
attrs.rationale: PRD id REQ-017-006 (prd.md line 1769). Restated by Main Flow step 2 (line 147: eligible earnings are completed/aftercare treatments, commission from each booking's confirmation-time snapshot, net payout amount).

nodes.title: Consume the acceptance-locked exchange rate; never relock

attrs.statement: System MUST consume the currency/exchange-rate snapshot locked at FR-005 subquote acceptance and retained by FR-006 for all applicable multi-currency billing transactions; payment must not relock it.
attrs.rationale: PRD id REQ-017-007 (prd.md line 1770). Restated by Currency Rule 2 (line 1241: locked at subquote acceptance, recorded with the rate's timestamp, never relocked; no fluctuation risk to patient or provider), Screen 3 rule (line 492: no fluctuation risk to provider during payout), Screen 10 rule (line 1160) and the edge case on exchange-rate API downtime (lines 1716-1720: FR-017 never fetches or relocks a rate at payment, invoice or payout).

nodes.title: Financial dashboard with real-time metrics

attrs.statement: System MUST generate financial dashboard with real-time metrics: total revenue, platform commission, provider payouts, outstanding invoices
attrs.rationale: PRD id REQ-017-008 (prd.md line 1771). Restated by Admin Platform scope Financial Reporting (line 73) and Screen 1.

nodes.title: Track affiliate commissions and process monthly payouts

attrs.statement: System MUST track affiliate commissions based on discount code usage and process monthly payouts with failure and retry visibility
attrs.rationale: PRD id REQ-017-009 (prd.md line 1765). Restated by Admin Platform scope Affiliate Billing (line 71) and Screen 6.

nodes.title: Payment reminders 3 days before due and 7 days if overdue

attrs.statement: System MUST send payment reminder emails 3 days before installment due date and 7 days if overdue
attrs.rationale: PRD id REQ-017-010 (prd.md line 1773). Restated by the Communication Structure row Payment due reminder (line 94: sent 3 days before due date) and Admin Editability (line 1209: reminder timing configured in FR-030; A-05 triggers the events that S-03 dispatches).

nodes.title: Complete transaction history resolving provenance through the booking

attrs.statement: System MUST maintain complete transaction history for all payments, refunds, and payouts with timestamp, amount, currency, and affected parties, resolving acceptance provenance through the associated FR-006 booking without duplicating/mutating the accepted quote aggregate.
attrs.rationale: PRD id REQ-017-011 (prd.md line 1777). Restated by the Executive Summary (line 18: financial records remain booking-based).

nodes.title: Provider bank details encrypted and masked to last 4 digits

attrs.statement: System MUST store provider bank account details encrypted at rest (AES-256) and display masked (last 4 digits only) in UI
attrs.rationale: PRD id REQ-017-012 (prd.md line 1778). Restated by Privacy Rule 2 (line 1192). Near-duplicate of REQ-017-021, kept because both carry PRD ids.

nodes.title: Discount usage metrics

attrs.statement: System MUST track discount code usage with metrics: times used, total discount amount, bookings generated, ROI
attrs.rationale: PRD id REQ-017-013 (prd.md line 1772).

nodes.title: Read-only projection of the locked rate per booking

attrs.statement: System MUST keep, per booking, a read-only projection of the exchange rate and its timestamp from the FR-005 acceptance snapshot, linked to the AcceptanceEvent, for multi-currency transactions (rate never changes after subquote acceptance)
attrs.rationale: PRD id REQ-017-014 (prd.md line 1780). Restated by Key Entity 7 lock origin (line 1829: never written independently, edited, or relocked at payment, invoice, or payout).

nodes.title: Separate payout records for providers and affiliates

attrs.statement: System MUST maintain separate payout records for providers and affiliates with status tracking: a settlement statement and a Stripe Connect per-booking payout carry the states of REQ-017-186 and REQ-017-187, and an affiliate payout is Pending, Processing, Paid or Failed
attrs.rationale: PRD id REQ-017-015 (prd.md line 1781).

nodes.title: Re-authentication for financial operations

attrs.statement: In MVP, system MUST require admin password re-authentication for financial operations (payout approval, refund processing). Once FR-026 / FR-031 shared MFA is delivered, these actions MUST require MFA-based re-authentication
attrs.rationale: PRD id REQ-017-016 (prd.md line 1785). Restated by Security Considerations Authentication (line 1474) and every confirmation modal's Re-authentication element (Screens 3, 4, 4b, 6).

nodes.title: Billing RBAC roles

attrs.statement: System MUST implement role-based access control (RBAC) with the FR-031 permissions: Process Payouts and View Transactions (the read-only finance permission) are held by Super Admin and Billing Admin by default, and Issue Refunds by Super Admin by default; read-only finance access is granted by permission, not by a named role
attrs.rationale: PRD id REQ-017-017 (prd.md line 1786). Restated by Security Considerations Authorization (lines 1475-1478: Billing Viewer cannot approve payouts or refunds; Super Admin has the same refund flow as Billing Admin).

nodes.title: Audit trail for all financial actions

attrs.statement: System MUST log ALL financial actions with audit trail: admin ID, timestamp, IP address, action type, before/after values
attrs.rationale: PRD id REQ-017-018 (prd.md line 1787). Restated by the Audit Rule (line 1194: all admin actions logged with admin ID, timestamp, action type and affected records), Security Considerations Audit trail (line 1480) and Main Flow step 20 (line 181: timestamp, payout amount, provider ID, statement ID).

nodes.title: Mask patient payment methods in the UI

attrs.statement: System MUST mask patient payment methods in UI (display "Visa ending in 1234" NOT full card number)
attrs.rationale: PRD id REQ-017-019 (prd.md line 1788). Restated by Security Considerations Sensitive data masking (line 1486) and the Screen 4 Payment Method field (line 563).

nodes.title: Soft delete financial records; retention follows the platform rule

attrs.statement: System MUST soft-delete financial records (no hard deletion); retention follows the system PRD, Platform-Wide Rules: One 10-year retention period
attrs.rationale: PRD id REQ-017-020 (prd.md line 1789). Restated by Data Retention (line 1195: healthcare and tax compliance), Fixed in Codebase (line 1221: audit log retention 7 years) and Security Considerations Data retention (line 1485).

nodes.title: Bank details decrypted only during payout processing

attrs.statement: System MUST encrypt provider bank account details at rest using AES-256; decrypt ONLY during payout processing
attrs.rationale: PRD id REQ-017-021 (prd.md line 1790). Restated by Security Considerations Encryption (line 1479). Near-duplicate of REQ-017-012, kept because both carry PRD ids.

nodes.title: Integrate with the Stripe Payment API

attrs.statement: System MUST integrate with Stripe Payment API for payment intents, transfers, refunds, and webhook event processing
attrs.rationale: PRD id REQ-017-023 (prd.md line 1795). Integration Points (line 1437) narrow this: Stripe payment intents and patient-payment webhooks are owned by FR-007; A-05 consumes payment completion events and payout-specific webhooks only.

nodes.title: Integrate with a currency exchange API, hourly with 1-hour cache

attrs.statement: System MUST integrate with Currency Exchange API (xe.com or equivalent) with hourly rate updates and 1-hour caching
attrs.rationale: PRD id REQ-017-024 (prd.md line 1796). Restated by External Service 2 (lines 1360-1363).

nodes.title: Idempotent Stripe calls

attrs.statement: System MUST use idempotent Stripe API calls (unique idempotency keys per transaction) to prevent duplicate charges/transfers
attrs.rationale: PRD id REQ-017-025 (prd.md line 1797). Restated by Technical Considerations Idempotency (line 1429).

nodes.title: Process Stripe webhooks asynchronously

attrs.statement: System MUST process Stripe webhook events asynchronously via job queue (Redis Queue or AWS SQS)
attrs.rationale: PRD id REQ-017-026 (prd.md line 1798). Restated by Technical Considerations Async Processing (line 1430).

nodes.title: Read-only API for provider payout history and earnings

attrs.statement: System MUST provide read-only API for Provider Platform to query payout history and earnings analytics
attrs.rationale: PRD id REQ-017-027 (prd.md line 1799). Restated by Integration 3 (lines 1449-1452: no direct database access across tenant boundaries; read-only RBAC for providers).

nodes.title: Payment captured after provider-status cancellation

attrs.statement: System MUST record a payment captured after an FR-015 `ProviderSuspended` / `ProviderDeactivated` cancellation as a real transaction, MUST NOT confirm a booking or revive the case from it, MUST exclude it from provider earnings, payout, and commission recognition, and MUST flag it "Captured after provider cancellation" with links to the case/inquiry and the provider-status event until admin resolves it through the existing refund/adjustment workflow with reason and audit entry
attrs.rationale: PRD id REQ-017-028 (prd.md line 1800). Restated by Rule 14 (line 1185, adds that it does not count toward platform or affiliate commission and that no new refund percentage, fee or payout rail is introduced), Workflow B3 steps 4-9 (lines 271-288: recorded against the booking invoice, or the cancelled case or inquiry when no booking exists; the audit entry clears the flag) and the provider-suspension edge case (line 1740).

nodes.title: Cancel remaining installments after provider-status cancellation

attrs.statement: System MUST cancel all remaining unpaid scheduled installments when a booking is cancelled by provider suspension or deactivation, keep already-paid installments recorded for admin financial resolution, and hold the booking's amounts from provider payout statements until that resolution is recorded
attrs.rationale: PRD id REQ-017-029 (prd.md line 1801). Restated by Rule 15 (line 1186: no further automatic charges or retries run; Payment Rule 3 does not apply), Workflow B3 steps 2-3 and 7 and the provider-suspension edge case (line 1739).

nodes.title: Percentage commission base is the accepted price after promotion

attrs.statement: System MUST calculate Percentage platform commission on the accepted price after promotion, in the quote currency, read from the acceptance snapshot, for every discount type including Hairline Only discounts, using the commission model and value fixed at booking confirmation; the exchange rate used is the one locked at subquote acceptance
attrs.rationale: PRD id REQ-017-030 (prd.md line 1802). Restated by the Screen 3 rule (line 491: the result is converted to the payout currency at the rate locked at subquote acceptance, if applicable).

nodes.title: One promotion code per named subquote before acceptance

attrs.statement: Patients may apply one promotion code to one named subquote before acceptance (FR-005 / FR-019); no code can be entered, removed, or replaced at checkout or after acceptance
attrs.rationale: Module Scope, Patient Platform (prd.md line 47). Restated by Key Entity 4 relationships (line 1813: one booking has at most one promotion, frozen at acceptance) and the promotion usage-limit edge case (line 1714: no code is entered or revalidated at checkout).

nodes.title: Patients receive invoices by email; in-app invoice history is backlog

attrs.statement: [BACKLOG — Future Phase] In-app invoice history and receipt viewing for patients: not included in the MVP mobile flow. Patients receive invoices via email (PDF) at payment confirmation; in-app access deferred to a future release.
attrs.rationale: Module Scope, Patient Platform (prd.md line 49). Restated by Communication Out of Scope (line 110), the Screen Specifications tenant scope (line 298) and User Behavior Assumption 3 (line 1400).

nodes.title: Providers see per-case earnings read-only

attrs.statement: Providers view earnings per completed treatment case (booking-level income visibility). Providers view commission structure and breakdown per booking. Providers can see running total of pending earnings yet to be paid out. All earnings data is read-only (providers cannot modify financial records)
attrs.rationale: Module Scope, Provider Platform Stage 1 (prd.md lines 55-58). Screen 9 implements it.

nodes.title: Admin consolidates earnings into manual-rail payout statements

attrs.statement: Payouts follow the clinic's payout rail (see Business Rules, Fund Release and Payout Rails): a Stripe Connect clinic is paid one payout per released booking, at release; a manual-rail clinic has its eligible earnings consolidated by admin into a payout statement on the one platform-wide settlement period. Providers view their upcoming payout schedule and expected payout amounts. Providers view payout history (completed payouts with itemised breakdown). Providers download invoices for completed payouts (PDF, generated after admin processes payout)
attrs.rationale: Module Scope, Provider Platform Stage 2 (prd.md lines 62-65). Screen 10 implements it.

nodes.title: FR-017 defines billing events; FR-020 delivers them

attrs.statement: FR-017 is the authoritative source for billing events; FR-020 / S-03 handles delivery, channels, and user preferences. Channels: Email and in-app push (notification dropdown) for both admin and provider platforms. SMS is deferred to a future phase. In-app chat for payment disputes is handled by FR-034 / A-10; provider-patient direct communication about payments is routed through admin support.
attrs.rationale: Communication Structure (prd.md lines 88-108). The eight event rows (lines 92-99) are Event nodes. Notification preferences: admin in FR-030, provider in FR-032 / PR-06 (line 104).

nodes.title: Entry points to Billing & Finance

attrs.statement: Admin logs into Admin Platform → navigates to "Billing & Finance" section. Dashboard displays: upcoming payouts, outstanding patient invoices, pending provider payments, affiliate commissions due. Provider logs into Provider Platform → navigates to "Financial Management" section.
attrs.rationale: Entry Points (prd.md lines 114-117 and 131). Admin uses Screens 1 to 8; the provider uses Screens 9 and 10 inside the FR-032 navigation shell (line 297).

nodes.title: Treatment completion adds earnings as Pending release

attrs.statement: Treatment completion triggers provider payout eligibility calculation; eligible earnings are added to the provider's running earnings total as Pending release, and become Released when the booking's funds are released: the confirmation window ends with no open problem case, or an admin resolves the case (REQ-017-189); the clinic's share of a retained patient cancellation fee is a Released earning at once (REQ-017-200)
attrs.rationale: Entry Points, Automated Triggers (prd.md line 121). Data Dependencies Entity 2 (lines 1376-1378): the provider platform updates treatment status and the financial module monitors status changes.

nodes.title: Cron generates Pending Approval statements on the cutoff day

attrs.statement: Scheduled cron job runs on the platform-wide cutoff day (Sunday by default) for manual-rail clinics: for each active clinic with eligible earnings, the system generates a payout statement with status "Pending Approval"; admin notified to review and approve newly generated statements. The review time is the gap between the cutoff day and the payout day
attrs.rationale: Entry Points, Automated Triggers (prd.md line 122). Restated by Main Flow steps 1-3 (lines 146-148: statement is a dashboard view only, no PDF generated) and Screen 2 rules (lines 399-401: providers appear in the list only once a statement is generated; each provider has its own payout frequency; there is no single platform-wide schedule).

nodes.title: Stripe transfer webhooks drive payout status

attrs.statement: Stripe webhook events (`transfer.created`, `transfer.paid`, `transfer.failed`) trigger real-time status updates of Stripe Connect per-booking payouts and affiliate payouts, never of a settlement statement. `transfer.created` — confirms payout initiated; update status "Pending" → "Processing". `transfer.paid` — confirms provider/affiliate received funds; update status "Processing" → "Paid". `transfer.failed` — trigger retry logic and `payout.failed` notification event
attrs.rationale: Entry Points, Automated Triggers (prd.md line 126) and Integration Points payout webhooks (lines 1444-1446). Main Flow steps 16-17 (lines 166-172).

nodes.title: Providers never see draft statements

attrs.statement: Stage 1 (earnings tracking): Provider sees per-treatment earnings accumulate in real time as treatments complete — this is always visible. Stage 2 (payout visibility): Provider sees a confirmed payout entry ONLY after the payout is confirmed: a Stripe Connect payout once its transfer is initiated, a manual-rail statement once the admin marks it as paid — providers do NOT see draft statements during the review window between the cutoff day and the payout day
attrs.rationale: Entry Points, Provider Access (prd.md lines 132-133). Restated by Main Flow step 5 (line 150: the statement is internal to the admin review workflow) and Screen 9 rule (line 1099: provider cannot see the payout statement, buffer window status, or admin approval action).

nodes.title: Admin told how many statements await review

attrs.statement: System notifies admin via push + email: "X statements ready for review. Payout date: [date]"
attrs.rationale: Main Flow step 4 (prd.md line 158).

nodes.title: Failed transfer marks the payout Failed and alerts admin

attrs.statement: A failed Stripe Connect payout is marked "Failed" and the admin is notified: "Payout failed for [Provider Name]". After three failed attempts it is set to Manual Review Required. Invalid bank account: Admin contacts provider (A-10); provider updates bank details in FR-032 / PR-06 Billing Settings; admin retries the payout. Other Stripe error: Admin investigates error; resolves; retries transfer. A settlement statement never has a Failed state
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow B4 and Release Rule 4: Failed belongs to a Stripe Connect per-booking payout, never to a settlement statement; three automatic attempts, then manual review (REQ-017-143, REQ-017-170, REQ-017-194).

nodes.title: Provider notified of a paid payout with the invoice attached

attrs.statement: System sends email + push notification to provider with invoice attachment. Provider Financial Management dashboard updates — confirmed payout and invoice download available
attrs.rationale: Main Flow steps 18-19 (prd.md lines 173-174).

nodes.title: Provider payout disputes resolved by booking reference

attrs.statement: Admin searches disputed Booking Reference in A-05 transaction history. If not found, admin escalates to technical investigation — booking may be missing due to system error; documents in audit trail. If already included in a prior payout, admin confirms booking was correctly included; shares payout reference with provider as evidence. If missing, admin adds booking to next scheduled payout with internal note: "Missed booking — added retroactively"; admin notifies provider: "Booking included in next payout [date]". System logs dispute resolution in audit trail
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow B1 (prd.md lines 227-246). Screen 7 Tab 1 Dispute Resolution Panel implements it.

nodes.title: Rate fluctuation above threshold flags bookings and alerts admin

attrs.statement: System monitors all configured currency pairs (FR-029) via external API (hourly). If the rate fluctuation exceeds the configured alert threshold, system flags pending bookings with locked rates approaching their payout date and sends admin alert: "Currency fluctuation alert: [pair] +X% in 24h. Review payouts for potential loss exposure." System logs admin decision and action taken in audit trail
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow B2 steps 1-4 and 8 (prd.md lines 255-266). Screen 8 implements the decision. Contact-providers outcome (line 263): any agreed change is a separate authorized finance adjustment; the accepted snapshot and AcceptanceEvent stay unchanged.

nodes.title: Read-only finance access is a permission; money-moving actions need re-authentication

attrs.statement: Admin access follows the FR-031 permissions: Process Payouts covers the money-moving payout actions (payout approvals, retries, overrides and bulk actions) and View Transactions is the read-only finance permission that opens every admin financial screen; Super Admin and Billing Admin hold both by default. A refund needs Issue Refunds, which Super Admin holds by default and Billing Admin does not. Read-only finance access is the View Transactions permission, not a named role. An admin who holds only View Transactions can access the same screens in read-only mode, but selection checkboxes, money-moving buttons, retry buttons, override buttons, and confirmation modals are hidden. Any action that moves money or changes a financial status MUST invoke the financial re-authentication step before the final confirm action is enabled
attrs.rationale: Admin Platform Screens, Role-Based Action Visibility (prd.md lines 307-309).

nodes.title: Dashboard amounts in the selected currency, default from FR-029

attrs.statement: All currency amounts displayed in selected currency (with real-time conversion if multi-currency). Currency selector initializes to the system default currency configured in FR-029 / A-09 Currency Management; MVP environments seed this default to USD unless an admin changes it later
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 business rules (prd.md lines 342-343).

nodes.title: Active Currency Alerts counts alerts without a decision

attrs.statement: "Active Currency Alerts" count reflects alerts triggered by FR-029 / A-09 rate monitoring that have not yet had a decision recorded via Screen 8; count resets to 0 once all active alerts have a confirmed admin decision
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 business rules (prd.md line 333).

nodes.title: Outstanding Patient Invoices statuses

attrs.statement: "Outstanding Patient Invoices" includes ONLY invoices of bookings whose FR-007 Payment Status is "Unpaid", "Deposit only" or "Installments active" (an unpaid balance remains); "Overdue" is read from the booking's Final Payment Status and "At Risk" is a separate flag, neither is a Payment Status
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 business rules (prd.md line 334).

nodes.title: Overdue aging buckets from the day after the Due Date

attrs.statement: Overdue aging buckets count from the day after the invoice Due Date (the day the Final Payment Status becomes Overdue, FR-007) to today: 0–30 days, 31–60 days, 60+ days; the "At Risk" flag (all installment retries exhausted) is shown as a separate row regardless of age
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 business rules (prd.md line 335).

nodes.title: Pending Provider Payouts are unpaid Completed or Aftercare treatments

attrs.statement: "Pending Provider Payouts" includes treatments with status "Completed" or "Aftercare" not yet paid, split into "Pending release" and "Released"; only released funds can enter a statement or a per-booking payout
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 business rules (prd.md line 336).

nodes.title: Failed Payout Count covers provider and affiliate payouts

attrs.statement: "Failed Payout Count" includes failed Stripe Connect per-booking payouts and failed affiliate payouts currently awaiting retry or manual resolution; a statement has no Failed state
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 business rules (prd.md line 337).

nodes.title: Revenue by Country uses patient location

attrs.statement: Revenue by Country based on patient location (not provider location)
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 business rules (prd.md line 338).

nodes.title: Revenue by Treatment Type excludes refunded bookings

attrs.statement: Revenue by Treatment Type excludes refunded bookings
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 business rules (prd.md line 339).

nodes.title: Refund Trend includes full and partial refunds

attrs.statement: Refund Trend includes full and partial refunds and supports drill-down into Screen 4a
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 business rules (prd.md line 340).

nodes.title: Top Providers sortable by revenue, count, average value

attrs.statement: Top Providers table sortable by: revenue, booking count, average booking value
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 business rules (prd.md line 341).

nodes.title: Dashboard discount usage shows code, uses, discount and ROI

attrs.statement: Discount Usage table shows: code name, times used, total discount amount, estimated ROI (bookings generated vs. discount cost)
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 business rules (prd.md line 342).

nodes.title: Conversion Rate is bookings over inquiries

attrs.statement: (Bookings / Inquiries) × 100. Inquiries count sourced from FR-003 / P-02: Quote Request & Management.
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 field Conversion Rate (prd.md line 327).

nodes.title: Dashboard filtering, export, comparison and anomaly warnings

attrs.statement: Charts interactive: clicking segment filters dashboard to that subset (e.g., click "Turkey" → filters to Turkey bookings). Provide "Export Full Report" button to download PDF/CSV with all dashboard data. Support comparison mode: "Compare to previous period" (e.g., last 30 days vs. previous 30 days). Display warning icons for anomalies: sudden revenue drop, high refund rate, unusual currency fluctuations
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 business rules and notes (prd.md lines 354 and 358-360).

nodes.title: Payout includes all released Completed or Aftercare treatments of the period

attrs.statement: Payout amount MUST include all treatments with status "Completed" or "Aftercare" completed since the last payout cycle whose funds are released: the confirmation window has ended with no open problem case, or an admin has resolved the case. Treatments with status "Scheduled", "In Progress", or "Cancelled" are NOT included; the clinic's share of a retained patient cancellation fee is the one exception, an earning of its own that enters the next statement (REQ-017-200)
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 business rules (prd.md lines 390-391). Restated by the Screen 3 rule (line 485: ALL treatments with status Completed or Aftercare within the payout period).

nodes.title: No statements for Suspended or Deactivated providers

attrs.statement: Providers with status "Suspended" or "Deactivated" do NOT have statements generated; an admin releases their earnings with the Release earnings resolution on Screen 7
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 business rules (prd.md line 392). Restated by the provider-suspension edge case (line 1738).

nodes.title: Commission comes from the booking-confirmation snapshot

attrs.statement: Commission shown in this list comes from the commission snapshot captured at booking confirmation (FR-006): provider-specific commission configuration managed in FR-015 / A-02 or FR-029 / A-09 when defined, otherwise the FR-029 / A-09 global default; supported models are Percentage and Flat Rate where applicable
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 business rules (prd.md line 393). Restated by the Screen 3 rule (line 490: the model, value and Flat Rate currency are fixed at booking confirmation from the effective configuration at that moment; nothing is fixed at quote creation) and Admin Editability (line 1206).

nodes.title: Missing or invalid bank details block approval

attrs.statement: Bank account details shown ONLY if provider has a valid bank account on file in FR-032 Billing Settings. Statements with missing or invalid bank details remain visible in the list for operational follow-up, but Payout Readiness is not "Ready" and approval controls remain disabled until the provider updates payout details in FR-032 / PR-06. A Suspended clinic's Owner can still update the bank details in FR-032 (REQ-032-067); a Deactivated clinic has no portal access, so an admin collects the corrected bank details outside the platform and records them as for a manually paid clinic, after which Payout Readiness follows the stored details as usual
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 business rules (prd.md lines 397-398).

nodes.title: When Approve Payout is enabled

attrs.statement: "Approve Payout" button enabled ONLY for statements with status "Pending Approval" or "Overdue", and not while Payout Readiness is "Manual Review Required". "Approve Payout" is enabled ONLY when Payout Readiness = "Ready", the admin holds Process Payouts, and financial re-authentication succeeds
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 business rules (prd.md line 408) and Screen 3 business rules (line 495).

nodes.title: Retry Payout only for Failed Stripe Connect payouts

attrs.statement: "Retry Payout" button is shown only in the Stripe Connect payouts section and is enabled ONLY for a Failed per-booking payout that is not in "Manual Review Required"; clicking it re-initiates the Stripe transfer; retry is logged in audit trail with admin ID, timestamp, and failure reason from prior attempt. A failed Stripe Connect payout first gets 3 automatic attempts with exponential backoff and then goes to Manual Review Required; once an admin clears it with a review note, the payout returns to Failed and this button is available for the manual retry. A statement has no retry: an admin marks it as paid
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 business rules (prd.md line 399). Retry Payout Confirmation Modal (lines 525-534): shows prior failure reason, current payout readiness and destination last 4 digits; confirm re-initiates the transfer after successful re-authentication.

nodes.title: Unapprove only before payout day, with reason

attrs.statement: "Unapprove" button enabled ONLY for statements with status "Approved" and ONLY before the payout day (it is not offered once the payout day has passed); on click, admin must enter a mandatory reason (max 500 chars); statement reverts to "Pending Approval"; action logged in audit trail with action_type "Payout Unapproved"
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 business rules (prd.md line 400).

nodes.title: Void a Pending Approval or Overdue statement, or an Approved one past its payout day, with reason

attrs.statement: "Void Statement" button enabled ONLY for statements with status "Pending Approval" or "Overdue", and for an "Approved" statement that has passed its payout day unpaid; on click, admin must enter a mandatory reason (max 500 chars); statement is marked "Voided" and permanently removed from auto-processing; action logged with action_type "Payout Voided"; a new statement can be re-generated on the next payout cycle, and the bookings of a voided statement return to the next cycle's statement; voided statements remain visible in list with "Voided" status badge for audit history
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 business rules (prd.md line 401).

nodes.title: Admin-only internal notes on payouts at any status

attrs.statement: "Add Note" button available for all statements at any status (for audit documentation). Internal notes visible ONLY to admins (never exposed to provider)
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 business rules (prd.md line 412) and Screen 3 business rules (line 494). Restated by Main Flow step 8a (line 155: max 500 characters, attached to the payout record) and Admin Editability (line 1212: internal notes on payouts and invoices, admin-only visibility).

nodes.title: Batch approval only for Ready Pending Approval or Overdue statements

attrs.statement: Batch selection is allowed ONLY for statements with Status = "Pending Approval" or "Overdue" and Payout Readiness = "Ready". Clicking "Approve All Selected Payouts" opens a batch confirmation modal showing selected count, total net payout amount, and a financial re-authentication challenge; confirm remains disabled until re-authentication succeeds
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 business rules (prd.md lines 413-414). Restated by Alternative Flow A1 steps 1-6 (lines 193-198: Select All selects Pending Approval statements of the current cycle; admin may exclude some) and the Batch Approval Confirmation Modal (lines 502-513).

nodes.title: Batch approval is sequential and ends with a result summary

attrs.statement: System marks each selected statement as Approved sequentially; displays live progress: "Approving X of Y statements...". After batch approval, the UI MUST show a batch result summary with: total selected, total approved, total failed, and error details per failed statement. Failed statements remain in "Pending Approval" for individual retry
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow A1 steps 7-11 (prd.md lines 199-206), Screen 2 business rules (line 415) and the Batch Approval Confirmation Modal Result Summary (line 513).

nodes.title: Overdue section on top of the payout list; Failed Stripe Connect payouts in their own part

attrs.statement: Statements with status "Overdue" are surfaced at the top of the list in a dedicated "Overdue" section. Failed Stripe Connect payouts are surfaced in a dedicated "Failed" part of the Stripe Connect payouts section, which sits below "Upcoming / Pending Approval"
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 business rules (prd.md lines 407-408) and notes (line 419). Restated by Main Flow step 13b (line 163).

nodes.title: Payout list filtering, sorting and CSV export

attrs.statement: List should support filtering by: status, payment schedule, date range, provider name/ID. List should support sorting by: payout date, net payout amount (ascending/descending). Export to CSV functionality for batch processing and accounting reconciliation
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 notes (prd.md lines 420-423).

nodes.title: Payout period follows the platform-wide settlement period

attrs.statement: Payout period determined by the one platform-wide settlement period for manual-rail clinics (weekly by default, ending on the Sunday cutoff day; set in admin payment settings). Per-clinic payout frequency no longer applies; Stripe Connect clinics are paid per released booking, have no statement and are listed in the Stripe Connect payouts section of Screen 2
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 business rules (prd.md lines 477-480).

nodes.title: Refund after payout deducted on the next statement and carried forward

attrs.statement: If a patient refund is processed AFTER the provider has already been paid, the next provider payout statement MUST include a row in `Payout Adjustments` labelled `Adjustment: Refund deducted — [Booking Reference] — [Date]`. If a refund deduction exceeds the provider's current payout amount, the unapplied balance remains visible in `Remaining Balance` and carries forward to the next payout cycle until fully recovered; the same applies to every entry of the clinic balance record, on either rail. A debt with no further payout coming stays open on the clinic's balance until an admin writes it off
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 business rules (prd.md lines 492-493). Restated by the refund-after-payout edge case (lines 1729-1736: no immediate clawback; the commission-adjusted amount is deducted from the next cycle; never silently absorbed by Hairline; the audit trail records the refund event, deduction amount, affected payout statement ID and admin ID).

nodes.title: Approve marks the statement Approved; an Overdue one is payable at once

attrs.statement: "Approve Payout" button marks the statement as "Approved"; no payment is started by the review action. An approved statement is paid by the admin by bank transfer outside the platform and marked as paid. An Overdue statement that is approved is payable at once and does not wait for the next payout day
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 business rules and Billing Rule 5: an Overdue statement is payable at once on approval, and Unapprove is not offered once the payout day has passed.

nodes.title: Transfer ID and failure reason stay blank until set

attrs.statement: Stripe Transfer ID of a Stripe Connect payout remains blank until Stripe confirms `transfer.created`; failure reason remains blank unless Stripe or validation returns a blocking error
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 business rules (prd.md line 488).

nodes.title: Approve confirmation shows amount and destination

attrs.statement: "Approve payout of [Net Payout amount] to [Provider Name]?" Destination: "Bank account ending in [last 4 digits]". Confirm button "Yes, Approve" — marks statement "Approved". Enabled ONLY after successful re-authentication
attrs.rationale: Approve Confirmation Modal (prd.md lines 515-523). Restated by Main Flow step 9 (line 157).

nodes.title: Payout detail links bookings and exports a report

attrs.statement: Clicking on "Booking Reference" opens booking detail view in A-01: Patient Management & Oversight. Provide "Download Detailed Report" button to export payout breakdown as PDF for provider records. Highlight any bookings with special conditions (refunds, partial payments) with warning icon
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 notes (prd.md lines 538-540).

nodes.title: Manual reminder type follows invoice status

attrs.statement: Reminder Type: Auto-selected based on invoice status: "Upcoming Due Reminder" (Final Payment Status Not Due or Due), "Overdue Reminder" (Final Payment Status Overdue), "At Risk — Final Notice" (At Risk flag). The four reminder types are Upcoming Due, Overdue, At Risk - Final Notice, and Manual Reminder. Display-only; not editable by admin. Channel: "Via: Email + Push Notification"
attrs.rationale: Send Reminder Confirmation Modal (prd.md lines 568-580). The Screen 4a Reminder History lists different type values; see the product owner question.

nodes.title: Manual reminder content from FR-020; history updated; automated schedule untouched

attrs.statement: Reminder content and template are determined by FR-020 / S-03 based on the reminder type; admin cannot customize the message text. On confirm: FR-020 notification event is triggered; Reminder History table on Screen 4a is updated with: type, channel, sent timestamp, delivery status. Admin sees a success toast: "Reminder sent to [Patient Name]" (or an error toast if FR-020 returns a failure). Sending a manual reminder does NOT reset or interfere with any automated reminder schedule
attrs.rationale: Send Reminder business rules (prd.md lines 581-584).

nodes.title: Installment invoices show installments paid

attrs.statement: Invoices with installment plans display: "X of Y installments paid"
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 business rules (prd.md line 578).

nodes.title: Invoice Overdue from the day after the due date

attrs.statement: "Overdue" is read from the booking's Final Payment Status in FR-007 and shows from the day after the due date while a balance is unpaid; FR-017 does not compute it. The 7 days named in reminders and alerts is only their cadence
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 business rules (prd.md line 579).

nodes.title: Invoice carries the At Risk flag when all installment retries fail

attrs.statement: The "At Risk" flag (not a payment status) is raised when all 3 retry attempts for any installment have failed; booking is flagged for admin review. Admin MUST manually follow up with patient (contact via support, update payment method, or cancel booking)
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 business rules (prd.md line 580). Restated by Payment Rule 3 (line 1234) and the Screen 4a At Risk banner rule (line 708).

nodes.title: Send Reminder only for invoices with an unpaid balance

attrs.statement: "Send Reminder" button available ONLY for invoices with an unpaid balance (Payment Status "Unpaid", "Deposit only" or "Installments active"), including those whose Final Payment Status is "Overdue" or that carry the "At Risk" flag
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 business rules (prd.md line 581).

nodes.title: Process Refund only for invoices with money paid and not all returned

attrs.statement: "Process Refund" button available ONLY for invoices with Payment Status "Deposit only", "Installments active" or "Full paid" (money has been paid and not all of it returned); it opens FR-007 Screen 6 (Refund Processing) through the launcher on Screen 4b, and the refund amount, reason and approval belong to FR-007. A part refund keeps the previous Payment Status and shows as a row in the refund history
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 business rules (prd.md line 582).

nodes.title: Invoice PDF with Hairline branding

attrs.statement: Clicking "Download Invoice" generates PDF with Hairline branding, itemized breakdown, and payment instructions
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 business rules (prd.md line 584). Fixed in Codebase (line 1220): invoice PDF template structure, branding and layout, is fixed.

nodes.title: Manual payment status override with reason and audit

attrs.statement: Admin can manually override a payment status when the Stripe webhook fails, is delayed, or when an off-system payment adjustment is needed. "Override Status" button available for ANY invoice (all statuses). On click: admin selects the new Payment Status from the dropdown (the FR-007 list: "Unpaid", "Deposit only", "Installments active", "Full paid", "Refunded"), enters mandatory reason (free text, max 500 characters), and confirms. Override is logged to audit trail with: admin ID, timestamp, previous status, new status, reason entered. Overridden invoices display a warning badge: "Status manually adjusted — [date]" visible to admins only
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 business rules (prd.md lines 598-602). Restated by Admin Editability (line 1211).

nodes.title: Override moves no money and needs re-authentication

attrs.statement: Override does NOT automatically trigger Stripe refund or charge — admin is responsible for ensuring any off-system action is completed separately. "Override Status" REQUIRES financial re-authentication (password re-entry in MVP; MFA challenge after FR-026 / FR-031) before the Confirm button is enabled
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 business rules (prd.md lines 603-604).

nodes.title: At Risk and flagged invoices surface at the top

attrs.statement: Invoices with a Reconciliation Flag are surfaced in a dedicated exceptions section alongside invoices that carry the "At Risk" flag until resolved. Invoices with the "At Risk" flag are surfaced at top of list in a dedicated section, similar to Overdue pattern in Screen 2. Display warning icon for installments with upcoming payment dates (within 7 days)
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 notes (prd.md lines 609, 611, 612).

nodes.title: Invoice filtering and bulk actions

attrs.statement: Implement advanced filtering: date range, payment status, currency, installment vs. full payment, patient name/ID, and Reconciliation Flag ("Captured after provider cancellation"). Support bulk actions: "Send reminders to all overdue invoices", "Export selected invoices to CSV"
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 notes (prd.md lines 608 and 610).

nodes.title: Invoice detail read-only with conditional tables

attrs.statement: All data on this screen is read-only except via action buttons. Installment Schedule Table visible ONLY if `installment_plan_id` is set on the invoice. Refund History Table visible ONLY if at least one refund exists for this invoice. Reminder History Table visible ONLY if at least one automated or manual reminder event exists for this invoice. Status Override History Table visible ONLY if at least one manual override has been applied. Discount Code Applied: if no discount was used, display "None — no discount applied"
attrs.rationale: Screen 4a business rules (prd.md lines 702 and 704-707, 709).

nodes.title: At Risk invoices show a warning banner

attrs.statement: Invoices with the "At Risk" flag display a prominent warning banner at the top of the detail view: "All payment retries have been exhausted. Please contact the patient to resolve."
attrs.rationale: Screen 4a business rules (prd.md line 696).

nodes.title: Discount usage screen is read-only and derived

attrs.statement: This screen is read-only; all discount management actions route to FR-019 / A-06. Data here is derived from booking and invoice records; no source-of-truth discount records are stored in A-05
attrs.rationale: Screen 5 business rules (prd.md lines 771-772). Screen 5 notes (line 778): used primarily for financial reconciliation.

nodes.title: Hairline Cost and Provider Cost split

attrs.statement: "Hairline Cost" and "Provider Cost" splits reflect the commission effect plus, for Both Fees discounts only, the Hairline share % that FR-019 defines on the program (fixed at send and frozen at acceptance). FR-019 owns that definition; FR-017 applies it in payout settlement and defines no split of its own. Because commission is calculated on the price after promotion for every discount type, Provider Cost is non-zero for Hairline Only discounts as well as Both Fees discounts. Payout mechanics for the reimbursement belong to the payment work
attrs.rationale: Screen 5 business rules (prd.md line 763) and field Hairline Cost (line 765).

nodes.title: Discount usage deep link, filters, search and export

attrs.statement: "View in A-06" deep-link on each row opens the discount's management page in FR-019. Implement filtering by: Status (the program lifecycle state), Program Type (Admin-via-Provider / Provider Self-Created / Hairline-Funded and Direct-Issued), and Active Window date range (codes valid within a given period). Support free-text search by discount code or campaign name. Export to CSV button for finance reconciliation (includes all visible columns for the filtered result set)
attrs.rationale: Screen 5 notes (prd.md lines 777-783).

nodes.title: Affiliate payouts monthly on the 7th

attrs.statement: Affiliate payouts processed MONTHLY (default: 7th of each month for previous month's earnings). Payouts with status "Pending" become eligible for processing on scheduled payout date
attrs.rationale: Screen 6 business rules (prd.md lines 820 and 823). Restated by User Behavior Assumption 4 (line 1401).

nodes.title: Affiliate commission amounts come from FR-018

attrs.statement: Commission amounts displayed here are calculated by FR-018 (A-07: Affiliate Program Management) — A-05 reads these values for affiliate billing and payout execution; it does not recalculate them. Commission rate and referral attribution are managed in FR-018; any disputes on commission amounts must be resolved in FR-018 before admin processes payout here
