attrs.rationale: Screen 6 business rules (prd.md lines 821-822). Restated by the affiliate-plus-provider-code edge case (line 1727: FR-017 processes affiliate payout execution using the FR-018 commission output for the preserved affiliate attribution).

nodes.title: When Process Payout and Retry Payout are enabled for affiliates

attrs.statement: "Process Payout" button enabled ONLY for payouts that are payable (status "Pending" and the payable condition of REQ-017-197) and after successful financial re-authentication. "Retry Payout" button enabled ONLY for payouts with status "Failed", Payout Readiness = "Ready", and successful financial re-authentication
attrs.rationale: Screen 6 business rules (prd.md lines 812-813). Process and Retry Payout Confirmation Modals (lines 858-880).

nodes.title: Admin-only notes on affiliate payouts

attrs.statement: "Add Note" button available for all affiliate payouts at any status (admin-only internal notes, max 500 characters, not visible to affiliate); note saved and logged in audit trail with action_type "Note Added"
attrs.rationale: Screen 6 business rules (prd.md line 814).

nodes.title: Affiliates view their earnings in FR-018

attrs.statement: Affiliates track their own earnings via the Affiliate Platform (read-only dashboard, managed in FR-018)
attrs.rationale: Screen 6 business rules (prd.md line 815). Restated by the Screen Specifications tenant scope (line 299: no affiliate-facing screens in this FR).

nodes.title: Bulk affiliate payouts: selection and sequential processing

attrs.statement: Batch selection is allowed ONLY for affiliate payouts that are payable under the same condition as "Process Payout". Processing is sequential; failures for individual affiliates do not block processing of others. After batch completes, failed rows are pinned in the Failed / Requires Retry section for individual follow-up
attrs.rationale: Bulk affiliate payout business rules (prd.md lines 852-854). Bulk Payout Toolbar and Confirmation Modal (lines 829-850): confirm initiates Stripe transfers sequentially, status Processing for each, enabled only after re-authentication; result summary "X payouts initiated. Y failed."

nodes.title: Affiliate payouts split into Pending and Paid tabs

attrs.statement: Two-tab layout required: Screen 6 MUST display affiliates in two separate tabs: "Pending Payouts" (status: Pending plus Failed rows pinned in a dedicated Failed / Requires Retry section) and "Paid Payouts" (status: Processing or Paid). Default view opens on "Pending Payouts".
attrs.rationale: Screen 6 notes (prd.md line 885), a client request quoted in the PRD from a transcription that is not in the source register.

nodes.title: Affiliate payout details, report, bulk by date and filters

attrs.statement: Clicking "View Details" opens the Referral Booking Sub-Table above. "Download Report" generates PDF summary for affiliate records (includes per-booking breakdown). Support bulk payout processing for all affiliates due on the same date. Support filtering by payout month/period and affiliate name/ID within each tab
attrs.rationale: Screen 6 notes (prd.md lines 896-899).

nodes.title: Transaction search trigger, scope, order and empty state

attrs.statement: Search triggers on minimum 3 characters or on pressing Enter/clicking Search. Booking Reference search returns ALL financial records linked to that booking (invoice, installments, any refunds, payout inclusion). Results sorted by date descending by default. Clicking any row opens the relevant detail screen (Screen 3 for provider payouts, Screen 4a for invoices, etc.). If no results found: display "No financial records found for '[search term]'. Check the reference and try again."
attrs.rationale: Screen 7 Tab 1 business rules (prd.md lines 962-965 and 968).

nodes.title: Add to Next Payout (manual rail) only for unpaid, now-eligible bookings

attrs.statement: "Add to Next Payout" is available ONLY when the booking was not already paid, is now eligible for payout, and the admin has provided an Internal Note and target payout cycle; it applies to a manual-rail clinic, and a Stripe Connect clinic gets Pay Now instead (REQ-017-201)
attrs.rationale: Screen 7 Tab 1 business rules (prd.md line 957). Dispute Panel Target Payout Cycle accepts a Pending Approval or future cycle only.

nodes.title: Saving a dispute resolution audits it and notifies the provider

attrs.statement: Saving a dispute resolution writes an audit log entry; when Resolution Action = "Add to Next Payout", provider notification is mandatory and sent automatically. For other resolution actions, notification is sent only when selected
attrs.rationale: Screen 7 Tab 1 business rules (prd.md line 958).

nodes.title: Audit log is read-only, exportable, retained per the platform rule

attrs.statement: Audit log is read-only; no editing or deletion of log entries is permitted. Audit-log retention follows the system PRD, Platform-Wide Rules: One 10-year retention period, enforced at storage level; UI displays entries for the full retention period. Export to CSV button available for compliance reporting. Log entries link back to the affected entity's detail screen
attrs.rationale: Screen 7 Tab 2 business rules (prd.md lines 1001-1004).

nodes.title: Currency alert lists bookings paying out within 14 days

attrs.statement: Affected bookings table shows ONLY bookings with a payout date within the next 14 days (i.e., at risk of being affected by the current rate movement)
attrs.rationale: Screen 8 business rules (prd.md line 1042).

nodes.title: Currency alert decision with mandatory notes

attrs.statement: Decision: Radio: "Accept risk — proceed with payouts at locked rates" / "Contact providers (any agreed change is a separate finance adjustment)" / "Adjust commission configuration (FR-015 single-provider / FR-029 global-or-bulk)". Notes: mandatory if any decision is selected. Max 500 chars. Documents rationale. Decision and notes logged in Transaction Audit Log (Entity 5) with action_type = "Currency Alert Decision". Alert dismissed from notification dropdown once admin confirms a decision; re-surfaces if the rate continues to diverge and a new alert fires
attrs.rationale: Screen 8 Admin Decision Panel (prd.md lines 1043-1047) and business rules (lines 1054-1055). Restated by Alternative Flow B2 steps 6-8.

nodes.title: Adjust commission routes to FR-015 or FR-029

attrs.statement: "Adjust commission configuration (FR-015 single-provider / FR-029 global-or-bulk)" routes admin to the appropriate management surface: FR-015 / A-02 for single-provider profile edits, or FR-029 / A-09 for the central global / provider-scope commission settings screen. This screen does not initiate the edit directly. Commission configuration changes never alter bookings already confirmed, whose commission was fixed at booking confirmation
attrs.rationale: Screen 8 business rules (prd.md line 1043). Restated by Alternative Flow B2 step 7c (line 264).

nodes.title: No currency alert decision changes the snapshot or locked rate

attrs.statement: No decision changes the accepted snapshot, the AcceptanceEvent, or a locked rate
attrs.rationale: Screen 8 business rules (prd.md line 1044). Restated by Alternative Flow B2 step 7b (line 263).

nodes.title: Earnings tracker lists Completed or Aftercare treatments in real time

attrs.statement: Only treatments with status "Completed" or "Aftercare" appear in this list. Each row is directly linked to its treatment case via Booking Reference (→ FR-001 booking record / A-01 Patient Management). Earnings update in real time as treatment status changes. Treatments are never removed from this list; older entries remain visible for historical reference
attrs.rationale: Screen 9 business rules (prd.md lines 1096-1098 and 1105).

nodes.title: Earnings payout status follows the payment

attrs.statement: Manual rail: once the admin has marked the statement as paid, affected treatments update to Payout Status "Included in Payout — [Date]". Stripe Connect: once the per-booking payout is initiated at release, the booking updates to "Included in Payout — [Date]". If a Stripe Connect transfer fails (`transfer.failed` webhook), the booking updates to Payout Status "Payout Failed — [Date]" and displays a warning icon; it reverts once the admin retries and the transfer succeeds. A statement never fails
attrs.rationale: Screen 9 business rules (prd.md lines 1092-1093). The revert-to-Pending wording after a successful retry is raised as a product owner question.

nodes.title: Refund before payout zeroes the earning

attrs.statement: If a patient refund is processed on a booking that had not yet been paid out, the treatment row is updated to show Net Earning as £0.00 with a "Refunded" label and a strikethrough on the original amount. The treatment is excluded from the Total Pending Earnings calculation. If the refund is partial (e.g., only add-on packages refunded), Net Earning is recalculated based on the adjusted booking amount
attrs.rationale: Screen 9 business rules (prd.md line 1093).

nodes.title: Refund after payout shows a negative deduction

attrs.statement: If a patient refund is processed AFTER the provider has already been paid, the original treatment row remains visible with Adjustment Marker "Refunded — Deducted from Next Payout" and Net Earning showing the negative deduction amount clearly; if the deduction spans multiple cycles, the tooltip explains the remaining carry-forward balance. Adjustment Marker opens a provider-friendly explanation tooltip (e.g., "Adjusted due to partial refund on 12-04-2026"); no internal admin notes are exposed
attrs.rationale: Screen 9 business rules (prd.md lines 1094-1095). Restated by the refund-after-payout edge case (line 1733).

nodes.title: Earnings tracker filters, sorts and CSV export

attrs.statement: Support filtering by: treatment status, payout status, date range. Support sorting by: treatment date, net earning (ascending/descending). "Export" button to download earnings history as CSV
attrs.rationale: Screen 9 notes (prd.md lines 1109-1111).

nodes.title: Payout history filters, sorts and CSV export

attrs.statement: Support filtering by: status, date range. Support sorting by: payout date, net payout amount (ascending/descending). "Export History" button to download full payout history as CSV
attrs.rationale: Screen 10 notes (prd.md lines 1164-1166).

nodes.title: Payout history entries appear when the payout starts or is marked paid

attrs.statement: Payout entries appear in this list as soon as the Stripe transfer is initiated (status: "Processing"); they remain visible through "Paid" and "Failed" states. A manual-rail payout appears once an admin has marked it as paid. Each payout entry links to all treatment cases included in that payout period (Booking Reference → FR-001 / A-01). Retry Resolution History remains visible even after a failed payout later resolves to "Paid", so providers can understand why timing changed. Provider has read-only access to all data on this screen; no approval or editing actions are available
attrs.rationale: Screen 10 business rules (prd.md lines 1154, 1156, 1158, 1159).

nodes.title: Failed payout message to the provider

attrs.statement: "Failed" entries appear with a warning icon and a message: "Your payout of [amount] for [period] could not be processed. Hairline is investigating. You will be notified once resolved."
attrs.rationale: Screen 10 business rules (prd.md line 1146).

nodes.title: Provider invoice PDF only after the payout is confirmed

attrs.statement: Invoice PDF is generated only after Stripe `transfer.paid` confirmation for a Stripe Connect payout, and when the admin marks a manual-rail statement as paid; the Download button is disabled during "Processing" status
attrs.rationale: Screen 10 business rules (prd.md line 1148). Restated by Main Flow step 17 (line 172), Entry Points (line 134: providers download invoice PDFs after the Stripe transfer is complete) and Billing Rule 2 second sentence (line 1236).

nodes.title: Payout history in the provider payout currency at the locked rate

attrs.statement: All amounts displayed in the provider's configured payout currency; exchange rate used is the rate locked at subquote acceptance (FR-005 AcceptanceEvent)
attrs.rationale: Screen 10 business rules (prd.md line 1151).

nodes.title: All financial transactions logged with affected parties

attrs.statement: All financial transactions MUST be logged with timestamp, admin user ID, transaction amount, and affected parties (patient/provider/affiliate)
attrs.rationale: General Module Rule 1 (prd.md line 1163).

nodes.title: Every payment record traces to its booking and acceptance

attrs.statement: Every payment record (patient invoice, provider payout, affiliate commission) MUST maintain a traceable link to the treatment case(s) that generated it via Booking Reference and, through FR-006, the accepted subquote/parent IDs, equal accepted aggregate versions, and AcceptanceEvent snapshot. Patient invoices link 1:1 to a booking; payout/commission periods aggregate their existing booking-linked records, never unaccepted quote alternatives. This provenance supports audit, dispute resolution, and commission verification without duplicating the quote aggregate in billing.
attrs.rationale: General Module Rule 2 (prd.md line 1164). Restated by the Executive Summary (line 18: one patient invoice resolves through its FR-006 Booking to one accepted subquote and immutable AcceptanceEvent; parent quote alternatives are not billable cases or invoice lines) and Key Entity 1 commercial source (line 1805).

nodes.title: All payment processing through Stripe; no card storage

attrs.statement: All payment processing MUST use Stripe API (PCI-DSS compliant); NO direct credit card storage
attrs.rationale: General Module Rule 3 (prd.md line 1165). Restated by Security Considerations PCI-DSS (line 1484) and Data Dependencies Entity 5 (line 1390: tokens stored in Stripe, not in the Hairline database).

nodes.title: Rates locked at acceptance; USD base; pairs from FR-029

attrs.statement: Currency exchange rates are locked at subquote acceptance (FR-005 AcceptanceEvent) and read from the acceptance snapshot; NO rate changes during payout cycle. USD is the base currency — all conversions route through USD (e.g., GBP→USD→TRY; no direct non-USD pair rates). The list of supported currency pairs is dynamic and admin-configurable in FR-029 / A-09: Payment System Configuration. FR-017 supports any currency pair that is enabled in FR-029; it does not restrict or define which pairs are available.
attrs.rationale: General Module Rule 4 (prd.md line 1166). Restated by Fixed in Codebase (line 1218: exchange API source in environment variables; USD fixed base currency).

nodes.title: Payouts only after Completed or Aftercare

attrs.statement: Provider payouts processed ONLY after treatment status changes to "Completed" or "Aftercare" and the booking's funds have been released (see Fund Release and Payout Rules)
attrs.rationale: General Module Rule 5 (prd.md line 1167). Restated by Data Dependencies Entity 2 (line 1377). Meeting sources ask for a patient-confirmation step before release; see the product owner question.

nodes.title: Installments complete by the cutoff before treatment

attrs.statement: Installment payments MUST complete by the cutoff date before scheduled treatment (cutoff days configured in FR-029 / A-09; default: 30 days). See FR-007B: Split Payment / Installment Plans.
attrs.rationale: General Module Rule 6 (prd.md line 1168). Restated by Admin Editability (line 1207: FR-017 reads this value at runtime to determine installment eligibility).

nodes.title: Refunds follow the platform-wide refund ladder

attrs.statement: Refunds follow the refund ladder, a platform-wide setting owned by FR-029 / A-09: Payment System Configuration (default: >30 days = 90%, 15-30 days = 50%, <15 days = 0%). The data model allows a per-clinic ladder later. Provider-status cancellations follow Rule 13, and an interrupted treatment follows Rule 19
attrs.rationale: General Module Rule 7 (prd.md line 1169). Restated by Screen 4b field Cancellation Policy Applied (line 726) and Admin Editability (line 1213: refund initiation and approval subject to cancellation policy). Meeting sources call the ladder illustrative and configurable; see the product owner question.

nodes.title: Affiliate commissions on net revenue only

attrs.statement: Affiliate commissions calculated ONLY on net revenue (after discounts and refunds)
attrs.rationale: General Module Rule 10 (prd.md line 1172).

nodes.title: Patients see their currency; providers paid in theirs

attrs.statement: Multi-currency bookings display amounts in patient's selected currency; providers receive payouts in their configured currency
attrs.rationale: General Module Rule 11 (prd.md line 1173).

nodes.title: Billing reads one accepted subquote's immutable commercial base

attrs.statement: Billing reads one accepted subquote's immutable commercial base through FR-006, not a parent range, sibling option/date rows, the live quote, or live library/promotion prices. The promotion and price after promotion are frozen at acceptance; billing never adds, removes, replaces, or recalculates a promotion after acceptance. The only exception is the FR-006 provider-fault transfer, which creates a new linked acceptance record that billing reads in place of the superseded one. The FR-019 application record is linked to the AcceptanceEvent; authorized finance interventions remain separate records; attribution, refund, installment, and payout policies are unchanged.
attrs.rationale: General Module Rule 12 (prd.md line 1174). Restated by Screen 4a business rule (line 703: itemized invoice and PDF content from the acceptance snapshot via FR-006; the FR-019 application record is provenance only and never re-prices the invoice), Data Dependencies Entity 4 (line 1386) and the promotion usage-limit edge case (line 1714).

nodes.title: Provider-status cancellations: full refund started by the system; admin resolution of captured payments

attrs.statement: Bookings cancelled by an FR-015 provider suspension or deactivation (cause `ProviderSuspended` / `ProviderDeactivated`) are excluded from provider payout calculation like other cancelled bookings. The Rule 7 refund ladder is not applied. As when the clinic withdraws or drops out, the patient is always refunded in full everything paid and pays no cancellation fee, so no fee share arises for the clinic (REQ-017-200); the system starts the full refund through the FR-007 refund flow without waiting for an admin. A replacement booking through the FR-006 provider-fault transfer takes a new payment. The fixed clinic cancellation charge applies to a clinic withdrawal or drop-out only, not to a provider suspension or deactivation (FR-006 Alternative Flow B4). Captured patient payments on these bookings, including payments captured while the cancellation cascade was running, remain recorded against the booking invoice and are routed to admin financial resolution through the refund launcher (Screen 4b, which opens FR-007 Screen 6) and the existing adjustment controls (mandatory reason, audit trail). Provider reactivation does not restore cancelled bookings or their payout eligibility
attrs.rationale: General Module Rule 13 (prd.md line 1175). Restated by the provider-suspension edge case (lines 1743-1751: a procedure already recorded as completed under FR-010 is not erased by the cancellation). Owner ruling 2026-11-22: a provider-status cancellation takes the same payment terms as a provider withdrawal or drop-out (FR-006 Alternative Flow B4 and B5): full refund of everything paid, no cancellation fee, new payment on the replacement booking; the fixed clinic charge is not extended to it.

nodes.title: Provider-status cancellation amounts held from payout until resolved

attrs.statement: Amounts on bookings cancelled by provider suspension or deactivation, including any procedure already recorded as completed under FR-010 and any Rule 14 late capture, are held from provider payout statements until admin financial resolution is recorded. Release to a payout uses the existing "Add to Next Payout" resolution (Screen 7) while the clinic is active, and the "Release earnings" resolution (REQ-017-193) when the clinic is Suspended or Deactivated; payout timing is otherwise unchanged. The earnings of a removed clinic are never forfeited: an admin always settles them through this rule and the Release earnings route
attrs.rationale: General Module Rule 16 (prd.md line 1178).

nodes.title: Patient names in financial records only after payment confirmation

attrs.statement: Patient full names and contact details visible in financial records ONLY after booking payment confirmation
attrs.rationale: Privacy Rule 1 (prd.md line 1184). Restated by the Screen 3 treatment sub-table Patient Name (shown post-payment).

nodes.title: Transaction logs hold masked payment methods

attrs.statement: Financial transaction logs MUST include masked payment method (e.g., "Visa ending in 1234") NOT full card numbers
attrs.rationale: Privacy Rule 3 (prd.md line 1186).

nodes.title: Patient deletion anonymizes PII but keeps financial records

attrs.statement: Patient data deletion requests MUST result in PII anonymization while preserving financial records for audit (replace name with "Patient #ID")
attrs.rationale: GDPR/Compliance (prd.md line 1189).

nodes.title: Overdue statements payable at once on approval

attrs.statement: Payout statement approval during the review time between the cutoff day and the payout day, and during overdue review; an approved statement is payable on the payout day and an Overdue statement is payable at once when approved, and the admin pays it and marks it paid
attrs.rationale: Admin Editability, Editable by Admin (prd.md line 1203). Restated by Billing Rule 5 (line 1239) and User Behavior Assumption 1 (line 1398).

nodes.title: Stripe Connect payout retry fixed at 3 attempts

attrs.statement: Payout retry logic for Stripe Connect payouts (3 attempts with exponential backoff - hardcoded)
attrs.rationale: Fixed in Codebase (prd.md line 1216). Payment Rule 3 (line 1234: day 1, day 3, day 7) and External Service 1 (line 1358: 1 hour, 6 hours, 24 hours) give different schedules; see the product owner question.

nodes.title: Manual payout adjustment only with justification

attrs.statement: Admin can manually adjust payout amounts ONLY with documented justification (audit trail required)
attrs.rationale: Configurable with Restrictions (prd.md line 1220).

nodes.title: Initial payment required for booking confirmation

attrs.statement: Initial payment is REQUIRED for booking confirmation: deposit (20-30% of total under existing configuration), eligible first installment per FR-007B, or the existing full-payment alternative. Existing treatment-completion fund-holding policy is unchanged.
attrs.rationale: Payment Rule 1 (prd.md line 1226).

nodes.title: Final payment 7 days before treatment or last installment 30 days before

attrs.statement: Final payment due 7 days before treatment date OR last installment 30 days before treatment (whichever is configured)
attrs.rationale: Payment Rule 2 (prd.md line 1227). Restated by the Screen 4 Due Date field.

nodes.title: Failed installments retried 3 times (waits of 1, 3 and 7 days) then flagged

attrs.statement: Failed installment payments trigger 3 automatic retry attempts after waits of 1, 3 and 7 days (see FR-007B); if all fail, booking flagged for admin review
attrs.rationale: Payment Rule 3 (prd.md line 1228). External Service 1 failure handling (line 1358) gives 1 hour, 6 hours, 24 hours; see the product owner question.

nodes.title: Payout statements and provider invoices are distinct artefacts

attrs.statement: Provider payout statements (dashboard view) for manual-rail clinics are auto-generated on the platform-wide cutoff day. Provider invoice PDFs are generated separately only after the payout is confirmed (post-payout): when the admin marks a statement as paid, or on `transfer.paid` for a Stripe Connect payout. Statements and invoices are two distinct artefacts.
attrs.rationale: Billing Rule 2 (prd.md line 1230). Restated by Main Flow step 3 (line 148).

nodes.title: Affiliate invoices on the monthly affiliate payout day

attrs.statement: Affiliate invoices are generated on the monthly affiliate payout day (a platform setting owned by FR-018, default the 7th); no payout buffer window applies (see Billing Rule 4)
attrs.rationale: Billing Rule 3 (prd.md line 1231). Restated by Entry Points (line 125: monthly affiliate payout summaries generated at the start of the buffer period).

nodes.title: Cutoff day replaces the payout buffer window

attrs.statement: The platform-wide cutoff day replaces the payout buffer window; the FR-029 buffer setting no longer exists. The review time is the gap between the cutoff day and the payout day. For example, with a Sunday cutoff and a Wednesday payout, the statement is generated on Sunday and the admin has until Wednesday to review it.
attrs.rationale: Billing Rule 4 (prd.md line 1232). Restated by Admin Editability (line 1208).

nodes.title: Approve between cutoff and payout day; payout day makes only Approved payable

attrs.statement: Admin must approve payout statements during the review time between the cutoff day and the payout day. On payout day only "Approved" statements are payable: the admin pays them and marks them paid. Any statement still in "Pending Approval" at that point moves to "Overdue" and is NOT payable. An Overdue statement can be approved at any time outside the normal cycle; on approval it is payable at once, the admin pays it and marks it paid, and it never waits for the next payout day. Unapprove is not offered after the payout day. Delay is recorded in the audit trail.
attrs.rationale: Billing Rule 5 (prd.md line 1233). Restated by Entry Points (line 123: payout-day cron, e.g. Friday 6 AM UTC), Main Flow steps 11-14 (lines 159-165) and the Screen 3 rule (line 497: status Processing then Paid after the Stripe confirmation webhook).

nodes.title: Hairline absorbs currency conversion costs

attrs.statement: Patients charged in their selected currency; providers paid in their configured currency; Hairline absorbs currency conversion costs
attrs.rationale: Currency Rule 1 (prd.md line 1234). Restated by Business Process Assumption 5 (line 1415: no pass-through to patients or providers).

nodes.title: Commission before payout; lock points; Flat Rate per completed procedure

attrs.statement: Platform commission calculated BEFORE provider payout. Lock points: the exchange rate is locked at subquote acceptance; the commission model and value, with the deposit and installment settings, are fixed at booking confirmation; nothing is fixed at quote creation. The Percentage commission base is the accepted price after promotion, in the quote currency, read from the acceptance snapshot, for every discount type, including Hairline Only discounts; Flat Rate commission is a fixed deduction once per FR-010 completed procedure, independent of procedure price
attrs.rationale: Commission Rule 1 (prd.md line 1236). Restated by the Screen 3 Flat Rate rule (line 491: later changes to the commission configuration do not alter existing snapshots) and Fixed in Codebase (line 1217: formulas fixed in business logic).

nodes.title: HTML invoice by email when PDF generation fails

attrs.statement: If PDF generation fails, provide HTML invoice via email; retry PDF generation asynchronously
attrs.rationale: External Service 3 failure handling (prd.md line 1375).

nodes.title: Stale exchange-rate cache alerts admin only

attrs.statement: If API unavailable, use last cached rate; flag admin if cache >24 hours stale (alert only; acceptance is never paused and locked snapshot rates are never changed)
attrs.rationale: External Service 2 failure handling (prd.md line 1370). Restated by Integration 2 error handling (line 1447).

nodes.title: Bank validation done in FR-032; no per-payout re-verification

attrs.statement: Provider bank account validation is completed in FR-032 Billing Settings before payout processing; no additional per-payout re-verification is required beyond readiness checks
attrs.rationale: Business Process Assumption 1 (prd.md line 1420), promoted because it states a rule. The closed-bank-account edge case (line 1707) says admin verifies the new account; see the product owner question.

nodes.title: Payout processing is transactional and race-free

attrs.statement: Financial module requires high data integrity; use database transactions (BEGIN/COMMIT/ROLLBACK) for all payment processing. Prevent race conditions in payout processing; use row-level locking when calculating provider earnings
attrs.rationale: Technical Considerations Architecture and Concurrency (prd.md lines 1427-1428), promoted as a concurrency rule (checklist step 2).

nodes.title: Fraud flags on discounts, payouts and refunds

attrs.statement: Flag sudden high-value discount codes for review (>50% off or >£500). Flag provider payouts exceeding 2x average payout amount for manual review. Implement rate limiting on refund API endpoints (max 10 refunds per admin per hour). Of these flags only the payout flag sets a statement or a Stripe Connect payout to Manual Review Required (REQ-017-194); the discount code flag and refund rate limiting do not
attrs.rationale: Security Considerations Fraud prevention (prd.md lines 1481-1483).

nodes.title: Expired card: patient emailed; retry on next attempt

attrs.statement: System sends email to patient: "Payment method expired. Please update card to continue installment plan." System retries charge with updated card on next scheduled attempt
attrs.rationale: Edge case, card expires before installment due (prd.md lines 1696-1700). The patient updates the card in P-01 (FR-001).

nodes.title: Partial refund recalculates Percentage commission only

attrs.statement: Provider payout adjusted: under the Percentage model, original commission calculated on £2,700, recalculated on £2,000; under the Flat Rate model, the per-procedure deduction is unchanged because the base procedure is still completed
attrs.rationale: Edge case, partial refund of add-on packages (prd.md lines 1743-1749: Stripe refund for the add-ons; invoice shows Partial Refund and New Total).

nodes.title: Active Currency Alerts tile opens the filtered alert list

attrs.statement: Clicking the Active Currency Alerts figure on the dashboard opens the notification list filtered to unresolved currency alerts; each alert links to the Currency Alert Detail Modal (Screen 8); the badge is hidden when the count is zero.
attrs.rationale: Screen 1, Active Currency Alerts widget (PRD line 316).

nodes.title: Retry Payout modal shows prior failure reason and payout readiness

attrs.statement: The Retry Payout modal shows the prior failure reason and the current payout readiness state of the statement before the admin confirms the retry.
attrs.rationale: Screen 3, Retry Payout modal (PRD lines 525-534).

nodes.title: Invoice PDF template is fixed in code

attrs.statement: The invoice PDF template structure (branding and layout) is fixed in the codebase and is not editable by admins.
attrs.rationale: Admin Editability Rules, Fixed in Codebase (PRD line 1220).

nodes.title: Commission formulas are fixed in code

attrs.statement: The Percentage and Flat Rate commission calculation formulas are fixed in business logic and are not editable by admins; the active model and value come from the effective provider commission configuration resolved from FR-015 and FR-029.
attrs.rationale: Admin Editability Rules, Fixed in Codebase (PRD line 1210).

nodes.title: Exchange API source is set in environment variables

attrs.statement: The currency exchange API source (xe.com or equivalent) is configured in environment variables and is not editable by admins; USD is the fixed base currency.
attrs.rationale: Admin Editability Rules, Fixed in Codebase (PRD line 1211), first two clauses. The currency-pairs clause is REQ-017-171 (decision D52 split).

nodes.title: Stripe connection parameters live in the secrets vault

attrs.statement: Stripe account connection parameters (API keys) are managed through the secrets vault and are not editable by admins.
attrs.rationale: Admin Editability Rules, Fixed in Codebase (PRD line 1213).

nodes.title: Failed Stripe transfers are retried up to 3 times

attrs.statement: A failed Stripe transfer for a provider or affiliate payout is retried up to 3 times; if all retries fail the payout is set to Manual Review Required and the payout failed event is triggered.
attrs.rationale: Implementation Notes, Integration 1: Stripe Transfers API (PRD line 1443).

nodes.title: Supported currency pairs are configurable in FR-029

attrs.statement: Supported currency pairs are dynamically configurable in FR-029.
attrs.rationale: Admin Editability Rules, Fixed in Codebase (PRD line 1212), last clause (FR-029 / A-09). Split from REQ-017-168 under decision D52.

nodes.title: FR-017 owns financial reconciliation

attrs.statement: Hairline admins can view reconciliation dashboards, export payment and commission reports, and monitor financial reconciliation data and payment operations. FR-017 owns financial reconciliation; FR-007 points here for it
attrs.rationale: FR-017 PRD, General Module Rule 17.

nodes.title: Funds are released per booking at Treatment, then paid out per provider

attrs.statement: Funds are released per booking at Treatment, then paid out per provider. The provider marks the procedure complete; the patient confirms or disputes within a confirmation window (default 7 days, an editable admin setting); no answer means automatic release; a dispute pauses release until an admin resolves it. A booking's funds count as released when the window ends with no open case, or when an admin resolves the case; until then its earnings show as Pending release. Any admin with support access can resolve a completion problem case and choose the money outcome; there is no time limit. A completion problem case ends in one of three outcomes: release in full, refund in full, or refund in part and release the rest
attrs.rationale: FR-017 PRD, Fund Release and Payout Rules, Release Rule 1.

nodes.title: Two payout rails, chosen by the admin when the clinic is created

attrs.statement: There are two payout rails: Stripe Connect, and a manual rail (manual first, Revolut later). The admin chooses the rail when creating the clinic (FR-015); the clinic sees the method and its readiness read-only and completes Stripe's own sign-up itself
attrs.rationale: FR-017 PRD, Fund Release and Payout Rules, Release Rule 2.

nodes.title: Manual rail runs one platform-wide weekly cycle

attrs.statement: The manual rail runs one platform-wide weekly cycle: Sunday cutoff, Wednesday payout (both admin-editable). The admin records each payment by marking the statement as paid. A manually paid clinic is "Ready" once the admin has set its payout method to manual bank transfer and saved valid bank details. A booking with an open problem case leaves the unpaid settlement statement until the admin decides. A bank charge on a manual transfer is borne by the clinic and entered when the admin marks the statement as paid; it is recorded as a Bank Charge entry of the clinic balance record and applied to the clinic's next payout, and the statement being marked as paid keeps its approved amount
attrs.rationale: FR-017 PRD, Fund Release and Payout Rules, Release Rule 3.

nodes.title: A Stripe Connect clinic is paid one payout per released booking

attrs.statement: A Stripe Connect clinic is paid one payout per released booking, at release, recorded on the booking ledger; the weekly cycle does not apply to it. A failed Stripe Connect payout gets 3 automatic attempts with exponential backoff, then goes to manual review, and the Retry Payout button on the Stripe Connect payouts list (Screen 2) stays available. Manual Review Required is also set, on either rail, by the payout flag (REQ-017-161); while it is set, approval and retry are disabled until an admin clears it with a review note, which is audited, and a cleared Stripe Connect payout returns to Failed so Retry Payout applies
attrs.rationale: FR-017 PRD, Fund Release and Payout Rules, Release Rule 4.

nodes.title: Hairline is the seller; the clinic share moves 60 days before treatment

attrs.statement: On a card payment through Stripe Connect the seller is Hairline: its balance pays refunds, chargebacks and Stripe fees first and recovers the clinic's part afterwards. Hairline holds the payment; the clinic's share moves to the clinic's locked Stripe balance 60 days before treatment (30 days for instalments once fully paid) and is paid out at release. The deposit's share moves 60 days before the scheduled treatment date, the balance share moves when the balance is paid, and a fully paid instalment plan moves 30 days before; payout happens only at release. If fewer than 60 days remain at payment (30 for a fully paid instalment plan), the clinic share moves at once to the clinic's locked Stripe balance and is paid out only at release after completion
attrs.rationale: FR-017 PRD, Fund Release and Payout Rules, Release Rule 5.

nodes.title: The clinic share waits until Ready; pulled back on cancellation or reschedule

attrs.statement: When a clinic's Stripe payout setup is not Ready at the time its share is due to move, the share stays with Hairline, the clinic and the admin are told, it moves when the clinic becomes Ready, and nothing is paid out before then, even after treatment. If the patient cancels after the share has moved, Hairline refunds the patient per the refund ladder, pulls the share back from the clinic's locked balance, and records any shortfall as a refund deduction on the clinic's balance. If the treatment is rescheduled after the share has moved, the share is always pulled back and moved again 60 or 30 days before the new date; this also keeps the share inside Stripe's 90-day limit. The share can be pulled back to Hairline before Stripe's 90-day limit and moved again later; there is no deadline for moving it again
attrs.rationale: FR-017 PRD, Fund Release and Payout Rules, Release Rule 6.

nodes.title: Clinic cancellation deduction from FR-029 Screen 7 and patient cancellation fee split

attrs.statement: When a clinic cancels, the fixed amount set in FR-029 Screen 7 is deducted from the clinic's next payout, only while it is set, in its Fee Currency converted to the payout currency, as an entry on the clinic balance. A patient cancellation fee is split between Hairline and the clinic by a percentage set in admin settings; the clinic's share of a retained fee is an earning of its own, released into the clinic's next payout, and the Hairline share is not an earning (REQ-017-200). The refund ladder is one global ladder now (General Module Rule 7)
attrs.rationale: FR-017 PRD, Fund Release and Payout Rules, Release Rule 7.

nodes.title: Bookings Completed or in Aftercare at go-live follow the old payout rule

attrs.statement: Bookings that are Completed or Aftercare at go-live follow the old payout rule and are payable as they are
attrs.rationale: FR-017 PRD, Fund Release and Payout Rules, Release Rule 8.

nodes.title: Outstanding invoice alert after the overdue threshold

attrs.statement: The admin gets an internal alert (email and push) for an overdue patient invoice once the invoice has been overdue for the alert threshold. The threshold is an admin setting expressed in days overdue, and it defaults to 7 days.
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 98, 1201 (Notification table and Admin Editability).

nodes.title: Hourly installment job in the clinic's timezone

attrs.statement: One scheduled job runs hourly and acts on each installment plan whose due day has started in the clinic's timezone; payment reminders use the same day boundary at 9 AM clinic time, 3 days before the due date.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 124 (Automated Triggers).

nodes.title: Affiliate Retry Payout modal shows the failure context

attrs.statement: The Retry Payout confirmation modal on the Affiliate Billing screen shows the prior failure reason and the current payout readiness state of the affiliate payout before the admin confirms the retry.
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 858-865 (Screen 6 Retry Payout Confirmation Modal, Failure context row at line 863).

nodes.title: Interrupted treatment: admin sets the refund, payout held until the FR-006 route completes

attrs.statement: When a treatment already started is interrupted by the provider's fault (FR-006 Alternative Flow B7, booking `In Progress`), the Rule 7 refund ladder is not applied. An admin reviews each case and sets the patient refund amount in the FR-006 decision, from zero up to the full amount paid, with a mandatory reason and an audit entry; the refund is executed through the refund launcher (Screen 4b), which opens FR-007 Screen 6 with that amount. The provider's payout for that booking is held, and stays off the unpaid statement and the per-booking payout, from the fault until the FR-006 route the admin chose completes (FR-006 REQ-006-019); no confirmation window applies and the Screen 7 outcomes, which are for Completed bookings only, are not used. The refund is taken from the held payout, a shortfall becomes a clinic balance entry (REQ-017-191), and the rest is released.
attrs.rationale: General Module Rule 19 (prd.md line 1181), added by the owner ruling 2026-11-22 for FR-006 Alternative Flow B7 (provider fault while the booking is In Progress). Restated by the provider-suspension edge case (In Progress bullet) and the Screen 4b business rules on provider-fault refunds.

nodes.title: A settlement statement is manual-rail only, with five states

attrs.statement: A settlement statement exists only for a manual-rail clinic and has five states: Pending Approval, Approved, Overdue, Paid (set when the admin marks it paid) and Voided. A statement never has Processing or Failed, and Stripe webhooks never change it.
attrs.rationale: Main Flow rail scope note; Screen 2 and Screen 3 status rules; Entry Points.

nodes.title: A Stripe Connect payout has its own states and is listed on Screen 2

attrs.statement: A Stripe Connect clinic is paid one payout per released booking, listed in the Stripe Connect payouts section of Screen 2. That payout has the states Waiting for clinic setup, Processing, Paid and Failed, moved by the Stripe transfer webhooks; Retry Payout and the three automatic attempts belong to it. When Stripe reports an invalid bank account, the clinic corrects its payout details through the Complete Stripe sign-up link in the status panel of its Billing Settings (FR-032 REQ-032-146) and the admin then retries the payout.
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow B4; Screen 2 Stripe Connect payouts section; Release Rules 4 and 11.

nodes.title: Mark as Paid records a manual payment on Screen 3

attrs.statement: A manual-rail statement in Approved status, or an Overdue one just approved, is marked paid by the admin on Screen 3 with financial re-authentication, a bank reference, a payment date (not in the future) and an optional bank charge. Marking it paid sets the statement to Paid at its approved amount, records a bank charge as a Bank Charge entry of the clinic balance record for the clinic's next payout (never deducted from this statement), writes the audit entry Payout Marked Paid, notifies the clinic and generates the invoice document.
attrs.rationale: Main Flow steps 14 to 16; Screen 3 Mark as Paid modal; Release Rule 3.

nodes.title: Earnings are Pending release until the booking's funds are released

attrs.statement: A booking's earnings are Pending release until its funds are released, and Released afterwards. Funds are released when the confirmation window ends with no open problem case, or when an admin resolves the case. Only released earnings enter a statement, the running total available for payout, or a per-booking payout.
attrs.rationale: Entry Points; Screen 1 Pending Provider Payouts; Screen 9 summary; Release Rule 1.

nodes.title: Screen 7 carries the three outcomes of a completion problem case

attrs.statement: Screen 7 carries the three outcomes of a completion problem case. Release in full releases the held amount; refund in full, and refund in part with release of the rest, open FR-007 Screen 6 with an admin-set refund amount from zero to the full amount paid, a reason and an audit entry. Each outcome needs an internal note and writes an audit entry. These outcomes are for a Completed booking only; an interrupted treatment ends its payout hold through the FR-006 route (REQ-017-185).
attrs.rationale: Screen 7 business rules; Alternative Flow B4; Screen 4b rules; Rule 19.

nodes.title: One clinic balance record of signed entries, applied to the next payout

attrs.statement: Each clinic has one balance record of signed entries: refund deduction, chargeback recovery, clinic cancellation deduction and bank charge. Open entries are applied to the clinic's next payout on either rail and are shown on Screens 2, 3 and 9. A bank charge of a manual transfer is entered when the statement is marked as paid and applied to the clinic's next payout.
attrs.rationale: Release Rule 9; Alternative Flow B5; Screens 2, 3 and 9 balance rows.

nodes.title: An open clinic debt is written off by an admin with a reason

attrs.statement: A clinic debt with no further payout coming stays open on the clinic's balance until an admin writes it off with a mandatory reason; the write-off is recorded in the audit trail.
attrs.rationale: Release Rule 9; Alternative Flow B5; Screen 2 Open clinic balances.

nodes.title: Release earnings resolves a Suspended or Deactivated clinic's money

attrs.statement: For a Suspended or Deactivated clinic, an admin releases earnings with a Release earnings resolution on Screen 7 that needs no target payout cycle: a manual-rail clinic gets a one-off manual statement and a Stripe Connect clinic a direct per-booking payout, with an internal note and an audit entry. It covers bookings completed normally and bookings held under General Module Rule 16 once the admin has resolved them. The one-off statement is created Approved (the admin's release is the approval), sits outside the weekly cycle and is paid with Mark as Paid like any other statement. The release asks for financial re-authentication before it is confirmed (REQ-017-047) and the payout is checked against the payout flag (REQ-017-194).
attrs.rationale: Screen 7 business rules; General Module Rule 16; Alternative Flow B4.

nodes.title: Manual Review Required blocks approval and retry until an admin clears it

attrs.statement: Payout Readiness becomes Manual Review Required on either rail when the payout flag of REQ-017-161 is raised (a payout over 2x the clinic's average payout amount), and on a Stripe Connect payout also after three failed payout attempts. Approval and retry are disabled while it is set. An admin clears it on a statement or on a Stripe Connect payout with a review note, recorded in the audit trail as Manual Review Cleared; a statement then returns to the state it had before the flag (Pending Approval or Approved) and a Stripe Connect payout returns to Failed, so Retry Payout applies (REQ-017-066).
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 business rules; Screen 3 Manual Review Note; Release Rule 4.

nodes.title: Hairline discount reimbursement is its own payout row

attrs.statement: A Hairline-funded discount is reimbursed to the clinic as its own row on the statement and on the per-booking payout, read from the frozen booking snapshot (REQ-019-017) and shown on Screen 3.
attrs.rationale: Release Rule 10; Screen 3 reimbursement rows.

nodes.title: Stripe Connect readiness: Not onboarded, Restricted, Ready

attrs.statement: A Stripe Connect clinic's payout setup is shown as Not onboarded, Restricted or Ready. A booking whose clinic is not Ready shows Waiting for clinic setup on the per-booking payout list until the clinic is Ready.
attrs.rationale: Release Rule 11; Screen 2 Payout Readiness and Stripe Connect payouts section.

nodes.title: When an affiliate payout is payable on Screen 6

attrs.statement: An affiliate payout is payable on Screen 6 only when the payout month is closed, the unpaid balance is at or above the USD 50 minimum (an Inactive affiliate has no minimum), Payout Readiness is Ready and no hold applies. Screen 6 shows a Held or Flagged column: Held for the unpaid commission of a Suspended affiliate, Flagged for a payout with a booking that still breaches the margin check. An Inactive affiliate without a ban flag stays in the monthly run for any month with unpaid commission: the whole unpaid balance, including commission confirmed after the offboarding, is paid in the next run with no USD 50 minimum, a normal offboarding clears any hold, and there is no admin-initiated final payout on this screen
attrs.rationale: Screen 6 business rules; FR-018 payout and margin guard rules.

nodes.title: Affiliate payout readiness comes from FR-018; the USD floor is checked in USD

attrs.statement: The affiliate payout readiness shown on Screen 6 is derived from ENT-affiliate-payout.payout_readiness, set by FR-018; FR-017 does not recompute it. The USD 50 minimum is checked in USD after conversion at the locked rate, with one threshold for all affiliates.
attrs.rationale: Screen 6 Payout Readiness row and business rules; FR-018 REQ-018-311.

nodes.title: Process Refund is a launcher into FR-007 Screen 6

attrs.statement: Process Refund is a launcher on Screen 4b into FR-007 Screen 6 with the invoice and booking prefilled; FR-007 owns the refund amount, reason, re-authentication, Stripe refund and any approval. FR-017 keeps the effect on the invoice (a refund row in the refund history; a full refund sets Payment Status Refunded) and on the clinic's payout. The closure refund of General Module Rule 13 is started by the system through FR-007.
attrs.rationale: Screen 4b; Screen 4 Process Refund rule; General Module Rule 13.

nodes.title: The clinic's share of a retained patient cancellation fee is an earning released into the next payout

attrs.statement: When a patient cancellation retains a fee, the clinic's share of it (the split percentage set in admin settings) creates an earning for the clinic. The earning has no confirmation window and is released into the clinic's next payout: the next statement on the manual rail, a direct per-booking payout on Stripe Connect. The Hairline share is not an earning. The treatment amount of a cancelled booking stays excluded from payout calculation, and a provider-fault cancellation carries no fee and so no share.
attrs.rationale: Release Rule 7; General Module Rule 13; Screen 2 business rules.

nodes.title: Pay Now replaces Add to Next Payout for a Stripe Connect clinic on Screen 7

attrs.statement: On Screen 7, for a Stripe Connect clinic the Target Payout Cycle field is hidden and Pay Now replaces Add to Next Payout. Pay Now is available only when the booking was not already paid, its funds are released and the admin has provided an Internal Note; it starts a direct per-booking payout, which shows Waiting for clinic setup until the clinic's Stripe setup is Ready, asks for financial re-authentication before it is confirmed (REQ-017-047) and is checked against the payout flag (REQ-017-194), and the provider notification is mandatory. Confirm Already Paid and Escalate Technical Investigation stay for both rails.
attrs.rationale: Screen 7 Dispute Resolution Panel and business rules; Alternative Flow B4.

nodes.title: A refund reverses commission in proportion, including an aftercare plan refund

attrs.statement: A refund reverses the commission on the refunded money in the same proportion, so the clinic's matching amount is the refunded money less the reversed commission; this holds for a part refund, a patient cancellation refund and the pro-rata refund of the unused full months of an aftercare plan paid in full, and the payout effect follows REQ-017-075 and REQ-017-191
attrs.rationale: Payout effect of a refund on Screen 5; the aftercare refund amount is owned by FR-011 REQ-011-097 and the commission principle by FR-015 REQ-015-041.

nodes.title: A handover fee is a credit entry on the clinic balance record

attrs.statement: A handover fee that Hairline owes a provider after an aftercare handover (FR-011) is a credit entry of type Handover Fee on the clinic's balance record, created only when the admin-set fee is above zero; it is paid by Hairline, never taken from a patient price or from the provider's earnings, carries no commission, and is added to the clinic's next payout on either rail
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 payout adjustments; the fee amount and the handover are owned by FR-011 REQ-011-057.

nodes.title: allow admins to onboard affiliates with unique email, bank account details, and commission structure...

attrs.statement: System MUST allow admins to onboard affiliates with unique email, bank account details, and commission structure (percentage or fixed amount)
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary, prd.md line 1606

nodes.title: generate unique affiliate discount codes with configurable parameters (discount amount, expiration date, usage limits)

attrs.statement: System MUST generate unique affiliate discount codes with configurable parameters (discount amount, expiration date, usage limits)
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary, prd.md line 1607

nodes.title: validate affiliate-bound codes/links during the patient booking journey, apply the affiliate discount like any other FR-019 discount...

attrs.statement: System MUST validate affiliate-bound codes/links during the patient booking journey, apply the affiliate discount like any other FR-019 discount (commission is calculated on the price after the promotion) when it is the final price discount, and preserve valid affiliate referral attribution for commission/reporting when another higher-priority discount controls the final price
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary, prd.md line 1608

nodes.title: count a code's usage caps (Maximum Usage Count, Per-Patient Usage Limit) as active reservations plus consumed...

attrs.statement: System MUST count a code's usage caps (Maximum Usage Count, Per-Patient Usage Limit) as active reservations plus consumed uses, exactly as FR-019 rules (REQ-019-088, REQ-019-116), where "applied" means the FR-019 Application made at quote acceptance and "completed" means the final payment is confirmed

nodes.title: Affiliate referral attribution is preserved separately from price discount priority

attrs.statement: Affiliate commission and referral credit are earned when a valid affiliate-bound code or affiliate auto-apply referral link is captured for the patient's booking journey and the booking completes with payment confirmation; "valid" means the affiliate is Active at the moment the quote is accepted, and a capture for an affiliate that is not Active at acceptance earns no credit and no commission, even if the final price discount applied at quote acceptance is a higher-priority patient or provider promotion under FR-019's priority order (Rule 3). The attribution goes to the last valid affiliate code or affiliate link the patient used before accepting the quote: a link click counts for 30 days, a typed affiliate code replaces an earlier link, the link carries the affiliate's newest Active Auto-apply code that is not disabled by account status (if there is none, an old link opens the normal landing page with no code and no attribution), and the capture is stored with the patient's inquiry journey and read by FR-019 at acceptance. The single-discount rule still controls the patient's price and provider/Hairline discount impact; it does not erase affiliate referral attribution. This protects affiliates from losing commission because a provider-side promotion is applied outside the patient's knowledge. FR-017 and FR-019 MUST consume the FR-018/FR-019 attribution result separately from the final applied discount line.
attrs.rationale: PRD General Module Rules, prd.md line 1188

nodes.title: Affiliate lifecycle states

attrs.statement: An affiliate has four states: Pending (account created, password not yet set), Active (password set, transacting), Suspended (temporary and reversible; codes disabled by account status, unpaid commission held, B3) and Inactive (permanent end of the partnership; codes revoked, portal read-only, final balance settled, forfeited or written off, B5). Only these transitions are allowed: Pending to Active (password set, Screen 10.1), Pending to Inactive (Screen 3.3), Active to Suspended (Screen 3.1), Suspended to Active (Screen 3.1), Active to Inactive (Screen 3.3) and Suspended to Inactive (Screen 3.3). Inactive is terminal and is not silently reversed (resuming requires re-onboarding as a new affiliate record, Screen 2). Setting the password changes the status only from Pending.
attrs.rationale: PRD General Module Rules, prd.md line 1189

nodes.title: Usage-limit basis

attrs.statement: A code's `Maximum Usage Count` and `Per-Patient Usage Limit` count active reservations plus consumed uses, exactly as FR-019 rules (REQ-019-088 for the total cap, REQ-019-116 per patient). "Applied" means the FR-019 Application made when the patient accepts a quote with the code. FR-018 adds no separate rate limit on applied events.
attrs.rationale: PRD General Module Rules, prd.md line 1190

nodes.title: Commission base

attrs.statement: Percentage commissions are calculated as a percentage of the completed booking's net revenue (the booking total after discounts and refunds, in USD per the Currency Rule) — not as a percentage of Hairline's net commission. Fixed-amount commissions are a flat USD amount per completed booking, independent of booking value. In both cases the commission is funded from (deducted from) Hairline's commission, never the provider's payout (Rule 2). The affiliate discount only lowers the price that both shares are calculated on (Rule 2); the affiliate commission is a separate Hairline-borne cost against the same booking.
attrs.rationale: PRD General Module Rules, prd.md line 1191

nodes.title: Commission ceiling

attrs.statement: On any single booking, the affiliate commission (Rule 14) is meant to stay within Hairline's own commission earned on that booking. For a percentage commission the system checks that `commission % ≤ the platform default Hairline commission %` and blocks the save with the shortfall shown; the discount is not part of the test, because it is already reflected in the price both shares are calculated on (Rule 2). The check runs at affiliate code creation/generation (Screen 4), when the commission is set at onboarding (Screen 2) and when it is edited on Screen 3.2. The admin can save past a breach only by ticking "Override" and entering a required "Approval reference" text, which is stored in the audit entry; nothing is disabled automatically, and who may override follows the FR-031 permission matrix. Fixed-amount commissions (where the ceiling depends on booking value) raise a review warning rather than a hard block. At accrual, a booking whose commission is still more than Hairline's commission on that booking is paid in full and flagged for admin review on the commission list. This rule complements Assumption 4 (aggregate program cost at most 10% of Hairline commission revenue)
attrs.rationale: PRD General Module Rules, prd.md line 1192

nodes.title: All affiliate amounts in USD; FX only through FR-029

attrs.statement: Currency Rule: All affiliate amounts (commission accrual, unpaid balances, thresholds, and payouts) are denominated in USD — the platform base currency owned by FR-029 (Payment System Configuration). When a booking is transacted in a non-USD currency, its value is converted to USD using FR-029's currency service, supported-currency list, and locked exchange-rate/markup logic — FR-018 never defines, caches, or overrides its own FX rate. The conversion rate applied to a commission is the rate locked for that booking per FR-029 (no discrepancy with billing/finance figures). Affiliates are responsible for any onward conversion from USD on their side. Note on client figures: GBP amounts in the client transcription (e.g., "£50", "£200") are illustrative of intended incentive magnitudes; the platform base currency is USD (per FR-029), so this PRD's literal thresholds and minimums (e.g., the $50 minimum fixed commission and $50 payout threshold) are stated in USD and are not a direct GBP→USD conversion of those examples.

nodes.title: One-click copy of a discount code

attrs.statement: On the affiliate Promo Codes tab, the discount code is read-only and has a one-click copy action; copying an active code puts the code text (or the auto-apply referral link) on the clipboard. While a code carries the disabled-by-account-status marker, a read-only "Disabled by account status" badge is shown and copying is blocked (a Suspended affiliate can log in and view but cannot copy codes or links)
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 913 and 953 (Screen 9.2 Discount Code, Validation Rules, and acceptance criterion 3)

nodes.title: First code is generated at activation from the settings stored at onboarding

attrs.statement: System MUST store the first code's settings (code name, discount type and amount, expiry, maximum usage, application method) with the affiliate account at onboarding and generate, validate and save the first code only after the affiliate becomes Active (password set), so a code never exists for a Pending affiliate; if the first code cannot be generated or registered, the affiliate stays Active with no code, the failure and reason are recorded in the audit panel and shown on Screen 3, and the admin creates the code from Screen 4 with the stored settings, which stay editable until a code exists
attrs.rationale: PRD Main Flow and Business Rules, REQ-018-307

nodes.title: Attribution goes to the last valid affiliate code or link before quote acceptance

attrs.statement: System MUST give the referral attribution to the last valid affiliate code or affiliate link the patient used before quote acceptance: a link click counts for 30 days, a typed affiliate code replaces an earlier link, the link carries the affiliate's newest Active Auto-apply code that is not disabled by account status (if there is none, an old link opens the normal landing page with no code and no attribution), and the capture is stored with the patient's inquiry journey and read by FR-019 at acceptance; the affiliate must be Active at the moment the quote is accepted, otherwise the capture earns no credit and no commission
attrs.rationale: PRD Business Rules, Rule 11

nodes.title: A completed booking means the payment that leaves the booking fully paid is confirmed

attrs.statement: System MUST treat a booking as completed in FR-018 when the payment that leaves it fully paid is confirmed in FR-007 (pay in full, final balance or last installment; REQ-007-083, REQ-007-084, REQ-007B-049), and use that event for the accrual month, the effective-date test for commission changes, and Total Referrals
attrs.rationale: PRD Business Rules, Rule 1 and Payment Rule 1

nodes.title: Account status disables codes through a marker separate from the admin Inactive toggle

attrs.statement: System MUST mark an affiliate's codes "disabled by account status" on suspension or offboarding, separate from the admin Inactive toggle, and clear the marker on reinstatement so codes that were Active before suspension work again; Revoked is the permanent result of offboarding or ban, Inactive is the admin switch-off, and Expired is past the expiry date; the affiliate sees a read-only "Disabled by account status" badge on the code and copying is blocked while the marker is set
attrs.rationale: PRD Screens 3.1, 3.3, 5 and 6; workflows B3 and B5

nodes.title: Suspension holds the unpaid commission with payout readiness Manual Review Required

attrs.statement: System MUST set payout readiness of a suspended affiliate's unpaid commission to Manual Review Required with the suspension reason, list it as held in the monthly run without paying it, and clear the hold on reinstatement so all held commission is paid in the next run under the normal $50 threshold, or on a normal offboarding so readiness follows the stored bank details; only a ban forfeits. Ready, Missing Destination and Invalid Destination are set by the system from the stored bank details
attrs.rationale: PRD Business Rules, Payment Rule 4; Screen 7

nodes.title: A booking accepted before a status change keeps its commission outcome

attrs.statement: System MUST keep earning commission for a booking whose quote was accepted with the affiliate's code or link before a status change and whose final payment is confirmed later, but only when the affiliate was Active when the quote was accepted: held while Suspended, paid in the next run after a normal offboarding, forfeited after a ban
attrs.rationale: PRD Business Rules, Payment Rule 5

nodes.title: Final balance settles in the next scheduled run and refund reversals carry forward

attrs.statement: System MUST settle an Inactive affiliate's final balance in the next scheduled run with readiness following the stored bank details, and carry forward a reversal created by a refund after a payout was Paid, deducting it from later payouts of an active affiliate until it is cleared
attrs.rationale: PRD Business Rules, Payment Rules 2 and 6

nodes.title: Screen 1 Affiliate Program Settings panel edits the payout day and the performance tier bands

attrs.statement: System MUST provide an Affiliate Program Settings panel on Screen 1 with the payout day (whole number 1 to 28, applied from the next run) and the performance tier bands, writing an audit entry on each save; who may edit follows the FR-031 permission matrix
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen 1, Affiliate Program Settings Panel

nodes.title: Affiliate account emails are sent through the notification service

attrs.statement: System MUST send affiliate account emails through the platform notification service
attrs.rationale: PRD Business Rules, Rule 17

nodes.title: Generated codes are registered with FR-019, which owns the rejection reasons; FR-018 owns the code on/off status

attrs.statement: System MUST register codes generated in FR-018 under the affiliate-bound program FR-019 holds, show the reason FR-019 returns on a failed row with retry, keep the FR-018 code status as its own on/off record that FR-019 validation reads, and read usage state from FR-019
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen 4 and Integration Points

nodes.title: Offboarding type selector and ban flag on Screen 3.3

attrs.statement: System MUST require an Offboarding type (Normal offboarding or Permanent ban) on Screen 3.3; Permanent ban sets Settlement Outcome to "Forfeit whole balance (ban)" and stores a ban flag on the affiliate; the Permanent ban option is hidden while the affiliate is Pending, and the Settlement Outcome of a Pending affiliate reads "Nothing to settle"
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen 3.3, Business Rules, Rule 16

nodes.title: Inactive affiliate: whole unpaid balance paid in the next run with no threshold

attrs.statement: System MUST keep an Inactive affiliate without a ban flag in the monthly cycle list for any month with unpaid commission, pay in the next run the whole unpaid balance earned up to the offboarding (including the current month's part) and any commission confirmed after the offboarding with no $50 threshold, and write off with an audit entry a refund reversal that arrives after the affiliate is Inactive. The $50 forfeiture at the moment of deactivation stays
attrs.rationale: PRD Payment Rule 7, Screen 3.3, Screen 7

nodes.title: Attach promotions at send; validate patient code on one named subquote; one discount per subquote

attrs.rationale: Restated by the Provider and Patient scope lines, Scope Boundaries, Entry Points, Alternative Flows A3 and A4 and General Module Rules. PRD lines 38, 57, 75-76, 143-152, 721.

attrs.rationale: Restated by Scope Boundaries (stacking out of scope), Alternative Flows B2 and B3 and General Module Rules. PRD lines 64, 121-133, 721, 724.

attrs.rationale: Restated by the Admin Platform scope, Main Flow step 5 and Screens 6 and 10. PRD lines 45, 60, 94.

nodes.title: Application links to quote, version, subquote, acceptance event, booking and participants

attrs.statement: System MUST link each Application to the parent quote and version, the accepted option/date-price row (subquote), the AcceptanceEvent, the booking, and participant entities.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Alternative Flow A5 and the Application entity. PRD lines 157, 950.

nodes.title: Restrict create, approve and apply actions to authorised roles

attrs.rationale: Restated by Screen 1 (RBAC per FR-031) and Data and Privacy Rules. PRD lines 248, 739, 777.

nodes.title: Encrypt sensitive data; tamper-evident audit logs
