nodes.title: Provider approval notice uses the FR-030 approval-requested event and the FR-020 notification service

attrs.statement: System MUST notify targeted providers when a platform discount awaits their approval (on publish and on Re-invite), using the approval-requested event of the FR-030 notification catalogue and the notification service defined in FR-020. System MUST also notify the adopting providers when the terms of an adopted program change and when an admin Force-Revokes, pauses or resumes an adopted program, and MUST notify admins when a provider revokes its own adoption; each notice is its own event in that catalogue.
attrs.rationale: Integration Requirements and Shared Services. The approval-requested event is one event in the FR-030 catalogue.

nodes.title: Integrate with calculation and settlement services for consistent totals

attrs.statement: System MUST integrate with calculation/settlement services for consistent totals.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Shared Services S-02 and Internal Dependencies. PRD lines 50, 766-770.

nodes.title: Copy promotion terms into the sent quote version; later program changes never change a sent row

attrs.statement: System MUST copy each row's promotion terms into the sent quote version at send; later program changes MUST NOT change a sent row.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Scope Boundaries, Entry Points, Alternative Flow A3 outcome, Screen 2 acceptance criterion 3 and General Module Rules. PRD lines 57, 76, 145, 314, 722, 900.

nodes.title: Freeze promotion and discounted price at acceptance; reject later change

attrs.statement: System MUST freeze the promotion and discounted price of an accepted subquote in the AcceptanceEvent snapshot and MUST reject any later removal, replacement, code entry, price-changing revalidation, or admin void, except through the FR-006 provider-fault transfer, which creates a new linked record.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Scope Boundaries (out of scope), Alternative Flow B4, Screens 6, 10 and 11 and General Module Rules. PRD lines 65, 162-164, 502, 652, 680, 730.

nodes.title: Provider-selected and patient-code use: reserve at acceptance, consume at first payment, release on expiry or cancellation

attrs.statement: For provider-selected promotions and patient-entered codes, System MUST reserve one promotion use at acceptance, consume it at the first successful payment, release it on `Payment Window Expired` or cancellation, and re-reserve it on an admin revive, rejecting the revive if the usage limit is exhausted; an accepted revive returns the Application from Voided to its Active status and clears `use_returned_at`. On release or void, System MUST drop the code's In-Progress count and return a single-use code to Unused; a refund after the first payment MUST NOT return the use, which returns only on a release before the first payment or when a provider-fault transfer replaces the booking (Superseded).
attrs.rationale: Restated by Scope Boundaries and General Module Rules. PRD lines 58, 726.

nodes.title: Auto-applied use: reserve at send, one per sent quote, release or consume by outcome

attrs.statement: For an auto-applied promotion, System MUST reserve one use when a quote carrying it is sent, MUST hold at most one reserved use per sent quote across re-sent versions (keeping the existing reservation, creating one only when a new version newly carries the promotion, and releasing it when a new version no longer carries the promotion), MUST release the reservation when the quote expires, is withdrawn, is archived (`archived`), ends Not Selected, drops the promotion in a re-sent version, or is cancelled before acceptance because the inquiry was cancelled or the provider's status changed, or when a subquote of that quote is accepted that does not carry the promotion (`not_applied`), and MUST consume it when the accepted subquote carries the promotion. If the booking reaches `Payment Window Expired` or is cancelled before the first payment, System MUST return the consumed use to the limit; on an admin revive, System MUST take the use again if the limit has room and otherwise MUST reject the revive, so the accepted price never changes; an accepted revive returns the Application from Voided to its Active status and clears `use_returned_at`. Restoring an archived quote MUST re-check the promotion and take a new reservation, and the restore MUST be refused when the limit is used up or the promotion has ended (FR-004 REQ-004-105). Usage limits MUST count active reservations plus consumed uses so that a limit can never be exceeded.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Scope Boundaries, Alternative Flows A3 and A5, Screen 6 rules and General Module Rules. PRD lines 58, 144-145, 157, 727, 729.

nodes.title: Commission on the accepted price after the promotion for every discount type

attrs.statement: System MUST calculate commission on the accepted price after the promotion, in the quote currency and read from the acceptance snapshot, for every discount type, including Hairline-funded programs; no program keeps commission on the price before the promotion. FR-029 carries the matching Rule REQ-029-054.
attrs.rationale: General Module Rules, Alternative Flows A2 and C1 and Core Requirements. FR-029 carries the matching Rule REQ-029-054; the owner kept both on purpose, so they are reviewed and kept as different Rules.

nodes.title: Hairline share percent on Both Fees programs, fixed at send, given to FR-017

attrs.statement: System MUST record a Hairline share % from 0 to 100 on every Both Fees program, copy it into the terms fixed at send, and provide it to FR-017, which reimburses that share of the discount to the provider at payout on top of the commission effect.
attrs.rationale: Restated by the Screen Specifications overview, Screen 2 and General Module Rules. PRD lines 176, 288, 306, 732.

nodes.title: Fixed-amount discount converted to the quote currency at the send-time FR-029 rate

attrs.statement: System MUST convert a fixed-amount discount into the quote currency at the FR-029 conversion rate in effect at send (for a patient-entered code, in effect when the code is validated) and keep the converted amount in the terms fixed at send.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Screen 2 business rules. PRD line 307.

nodes.title: No automatic promotion on an admin-authored replacement quote

attrs.statement: System MUST NOT attach an automatic promotion to an admin-authored replacement quote (FR-004 Workflow 7) or reserve a use for it; the admin sets the replacement price directly, the replacement carries no promotion, the original Application MUST be marked Superseded, and the use it held MUST return to the usage limit.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Alternative Flow A3 exception and Screen 2 business rules. PRD lines 146, 305.

nodes.title: Patient sees the discount on each subquote and may enter a code before acceptance

attrs.statement: Patient Platform (P-03 overlay): See the discount on each offered subquote; enter a discount code on one named subquote before acceptance when enabled; view the final price breakdown, which is read-only after acceptance.
attrs.rationale: Patient Platform scope. PRD lines 22, 31-32. Screen 11 carries the code entry.

nodes.title: Providers accept or decline both-fees programs; provider-only discounts become active automatically

attrs.statement: Accept/decline platform both‑fees discounts per program; auto‑active provider‑only discounts.
attrs.rationale: Provider Platform scope. PRD line 37.

nodes.title: Admin manages the both-fees approval workflow and monitors provider responses

attrs.statement: Manage approval workflow for both‑fees discounts; monitor provider responses.
attrs.rationale: Admin Platform scope. PRD line 44. Screen 3 (Provider Adoption Manager) is where responses are monitored.

nodes.title: Program lifecycle in scope: five states, with usage limits and date windows

attrs.statement: Discount code definition and lifecycle (draft, active, paused, expired, archived), with usage limits and date windows; approval of an Admin-via-Provider program is per provider adoption, not a program state.
attrs.rationale: Scope Boundaries. Matches the Screen 2 lifecycle field; there is no program-level Pending Approval state.

nodes.title: Payment and refund mechanics, loyalty and referral rewards, and tax changes are out of scope

attrs.statement: Payment, refund, and fund-release mechanics (FR-007, FR-007b, FR-017). Loyalty points and referral rewards (covered elsewhere). Tax/VAT calculation changes (handled by billing/finance rules).
attrs.rationale: Scope Boundaries, out of scope. PRD lines 66-68. Owned by FR-007, FR-007b, FR-017 and billing rules.

nodes.title: Affiliate code generation, assignment, dashboard and payout attribution belong to FR-018; FR-019 owns the shared engine

attrs.statement: Affiliate-specific promo code generation, bulk assignment to affiliates, affiliate dashboard display, and affiliate payout attribution are owned by FR-018 / A-07. FR-019 owns the shared promotion engine: validation, active windows, usage limits, single-discount conflict behavior, applied/completed redemption state, and financial-impact logging.
attrs.rationale: Scope Boundaries, out of scope. PRD line 69, Screen 5 business rules (line 437) and Alternative Flow C1 (line 138) repeat the boundary; Screen 5 acceptance criterion 1 (line 444) agrees: FR-018 completes generation and FR-019 registers the codes.

nodes.title: Entry points: admin creates a platform discount, provider creates a discount, patient enters a code, provider sends a quote

attrs.statement: Admin creates a platform discount in A-06; if both‑fees, providers receive approval requests. Provider creates a provider discount in PR-02/PR-05; becomes active per dates/limits. Patient enters a code (if enabled) on one named subquote before acceptance (FR-005 Alternative Flow A8); system validates it for that subquote and shows the discounted price if eligible. Provider sends a quote; system attaches the selected promotion and any eligible automatic promotion to each option/date-price row and copies the promotion terms into the sent quote version.
attrs.rationale: Entry Points. PRD lines 73-76.

nodes.title: Admin publishes a both-fees discount; it is Active and targeted providers are notified

attrs.statement: Admin defines discount (type, value, Hairline share %, dates, usage limit, targeted providers). Admin publishes the discount; the system sets it Active and notifies targeted providers (approval-requested event of the FR-030 notification catalogue). Approval is per provider: the discount applies only to providers whose adoption is Accepted.
attrs.rationale: Main Flow steps 1-2. Screen 2 business rules and acceptance criterion 1 repeat the Active outcome and the notification.

nodes.title: Providers accept or decline a both-fees discount and the system logs the response

attrs.statement: Providers accept or decline; system logs responses. A provider who does not answer within the auto-decline window is Auto-Declined. If every provider declines, the program stays Active with no participants until an admin archives it.
attrs.rationale: Main Flow step 3. PRD line 92, Screen 7 business rules (line 533: all decisions logged with timestamp and user) repeat it.

nodes.title: An accepting provider makes the discount eligible for its option/date-price rows during the active window

attrs.statement: When provider accepts, discount becomes eligible for that provider’s option/date-price rows during the active window; the campaign moves to the Active tab and becomes selectable in quote creation within 5 seconds.
attrs.rationale: Main Flow step 4. PRD line 93, Screen 7 acceptance criterion 1 (line 539: selectable in quote creation within 5 seconds).

nodes.title: Provider-only reusable discount activates per dates and limits with no approval

attrs.statement: Trigger: Provider creates their own discount from the standalone Promotion Detail screen (Screen 9). Steps: System validates inputs, persists the program with `scope = REUSABLE`, and activates per dates/limits; no approval needed. Outcome: Discount immediately eligible for **list-selection** during the provider's quote creation flow (FR-004 Screen 1).
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow A1a. PRD lines 100-102. Screen 9 business rule (line 602) repeats that no admin approval is needed in either mode; acceptance criterion 1 (line 607) repeats list selection within the active window.

nodes.title: Inline provider discount is bound to one quote and one option/date-price row

attrs.statement: Trigger: Provider opens the inline promotion creator from within FR-004 Screen 1 during quote drafting. Steps: Provider enters name, type, value, applies-to, and optional code in a mini-form for one FR-004 option/date-price row; system creates a new `PromotionProgram` with `scope = AD_HOC_QUOTE_BOUND`, `bound_quote_id` set to the parent quote, and `bound_quote_option_date_price_id` set to that row. Provider may toggle "Save as reusable program for future quotes" to promote the record to `scope = REUSABLE`. Outcome: Discount is attached through `QuoteOptionDatePrice.promotionId` and is governed by the same caps, validation, and admin-override rules as A1a. Ad-hoc records appear in FR-019 Screen 1 Hub (filterable by `scope`) and Screen 4 Portfolio.
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow A1b. PRD lines 106-108. Screen 9 acceptance criteria 3 and 5 (lines 609, 611) repeat the binding and the rejection of use on another row or quote.

nodes.title: Hairline-only discount is hidden from providers; commission is on the price after the promotion

attrs.statement: Trigger: Admin creates a Hairline‑funded discount. Steps: System applies the discount to the patient's price; the program is not visible to providers in selection UIs. Commission is calculated on the accepted price after the promotion, as for every discount type. Outcome: Both the platform commission and the provider's payout are reduced; the provider bears most of the discount. The funding of each program is defined in General Module Rules; FR-017 applies it in payout settlement.
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow A2. PRD lines 112-114. Screen 2 business rules (line 304) and acceptance criterion 2 (line 313) repeat that Hairline-funded programs do not appear in provider selection UIs or adoption inboxes.

nodes.title: Invalid, expired or limit-reached code returns a reason and no discount is applied

attrs.statement: Trigger: A patient enters an invalid, expired or limit-reached code, or a provider picks from the list a promotion that no longer qualifies for the row (a provider types no code: FR-004 Screen 1 offers a select-or-create Promotion field). Steps: System returns reason; prevents application. Outcome: No discount applied; user can retry. On the patient screen (Screen 11), the patient gets clear feedback for an invalid, expired, limit-reached or segment-mismatched code.
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow B1. PRD lines 118-120. Screen 11 business rules (line 681) add segment-mismatched codes to the list of reasons shown.

nodes.title: A second discount entered by the user prompts a replace-or-keep choice

attrs.statement: Trigger: Before the quote is sent, the provider picks a second promotion for an option/date-price row that already has one; or before the subquote is accepted, the patient enters a code on a subquote (option/date-price row) that already carries a promotion. Steps: System blocks the new entry; prompts the user to confirm replacement or keep the existing discount. A patient's replacement applies only to the patient's selection on that subquote and never changes the provider's promotion. A patient code replaces the promotion the row carries, including an automatic one (Alternative Flow A5 states the reservation outcome). Outcome: Exactly one discount per subquote; the user's confirmed choice is applied. After acceptance no entry, selection, or replacement is accepted (Alternative Flow B4).
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow B2. PRD lines 124-126. Screen 11 business rule (line 677) and acceptance criterion 2 (line 688: audit records both events) repeat it for the patient.

nodes.title: Auto-applied conflicts resolve silently by priority, with no user prompt

attrs.statement: Trigger: When a quote is sent, more than one automatic promotion is eligible for the quote, or an automatic promotion is eligible for an option/date-price row that already carries another discount. Steps: A quote carries at most one automatic promotion. System silently resolves the conflict using the priority order: patient-entered code > provider discount (provider-selected or provider auto-applied) > Hairline-funded discount > affiliate discount. The usage limit is checked before ranking: an automatic program whose limit is fully reserved or consumed, or whose per-patient limit is reached for a known patient, is skipped, and the next-ranked qualifying program may attach. When several automatic programs qualify, only the highest-ranked remaining one attaches, to every row it is eligible for; the others attach to no row of that quote and reserve no use. On a row that already carries a higher-ranked discount, the automatic promotion is not applied to that row; a provider-selected promotion wins over a provider auto-applied one on the same row. No user prompt is shown. Example: A Hairline-funded automatic program and a provider's automatic program are both eligible when a quote is sent. The provider's program ranks higher, so it attaches to every row it is eligible for and one use is reserved for it; the Hairline-funded program attaches to no row of that quote and no use is reserved for it.
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow B3. PRD lines 130-132. General Module Rules (line 721) repeat the priority order.

nodes.title: Exactly one discount affects the price; audit records applied and superseded programs; affiliate attribution is preserved

attrs.statement: Exactly one discount affects the patient's final price; audit records which program was applied and which was superseded. If a valid affiliate-bound code/link was already captured as the patient acquisition source, FR-019 preserves that affiliate attribution metadata for FR-018 even when a provider-side promotion wins the price-discount priority. The capture is stored with the patient's inquiry journey (FR-018 REQ-018-308) and FR-019 reads it at quote acceptance; it is honoured only when the affiliate is Active at that moment, otherwise it earns no credit, no commission and no attribution.
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow B3 outcome. PRD line 133.

nodes.title: Direct-issued code is validated against its binding and redemption is recorded against the issuing channel

attrs.statement: Trigger: Admin issues a Hairline-funded code (open code, segment-bound, or affiliate-distributed) and the patient enters it on one named subquote before acceptance. Steps: System validates the code against issuance binding (open vs recipient-bound), records the redemption against the issuing channel (e.g., affiliate id), and calculates commission on the accepted price after the promotion, as for every discount type. For affiliate-bound codes, code generation and affiliate assignment are initiated from FR-018; FR-019 receives the registered code and manages redemption lifecycle. Outcome: Patient receives discount; the platform commission and the provider's payout are both reduced, with the provider bearing most of the discount; affiliate (if applicable) accrues the configured incentive (see FR-018), where a percentage affiliate commission is calculated on net revenue after discounts and refunds.
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow C1. PRD lines 137-139.

nodes.title: Automatic promotion attaches at send to every eligible row; the provider price stays and the discount shows as a separate line

attrs.statement: Trigger: A provider sends a quote while an auto-applied program is active and eligible for one or more of its option/date-price rows. Steps: A quote carries at most one automatic promotion; when several qualify, Alternative Flow B3 picks one. System attaches that program to every eligible option/date-price row of the sent quote and copies its terms into the sent quote version. The provider's entered price on each row stays unchanged, and the discount is shown as a separate line next to it. Rows that are not eligible receive no automatic promotion. Conflicts with another discount on the same row are resolved by Alternative Flow B3. Sending a quote carrying the automatic promotion reserves one use against the program's usage limits. A sent quote holds at most one reserved use: re-sending a new version keeps the existing reservation, creates one only if the new version newly carries the promotion, and releases it if the new version no longer carries the promotion. An admin edit that creates a new version of a sent quote (FR-004) counts as a re-send for these rules. If the limit is already fully reserved or consumed, or the per-patient limit is reached for a known patient, that program is skipped and Alternative Flow B3 picks the next-ranked qualifying program, if any; a promotion never attaches past a full limit.
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow A3. PRD lines 143-146, General Module Rules (line 724). Outcome and exception lines are carried by REQ-019-012, REQ-019-015 and REQ-019-019.

nodes.title: Patient code is validated for the named subquote only and never written to the provider promotion

attrs.statement: Trigger: While reviewing one named subquote and before confirming acceptance, the patient enters a code (FR-005 Alternative Flow A8). Steps: System validates the code for that subquote only (active window, eligibility, total and per-patient usage limits, recipient binding, and, for a fixed amount, that the converted amount stays below the row's offered price). If valid, the discounted price is shown next to the provider's offered price; if invalid, the reason is shown and the price stays what the row carried at send, including its attached promotion. The code is held with the open subquote view and stored only on the AcceptanceEvent at acceptance; it is never written to the provider's promotion or quote records. Opening another subquote does not carry the code over. Outcome: On acceptance, the discounted price and the applied promotion are frozen into the AcceptanceEvent snapshot.
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow A4. PRD lines 150-152. Screen 11 business rule (line 678) and acceptance criterion 3 (line 688) repeat that the code is not carried to another subquote.

nodes.title: Accepting a subquote with a promotion creates one Application atomically and reserves or consumes a use

attrs.statement: Trigger: The patient accepts a subquote that carries a promotion attached at send or a valid patient-entered code. Steps: In the same atomic step as the acceptance, the system creates one Application linked to the AcceptanceEvent, the parent quote and version, and the accepted option/date-price row, and reserves one use against the program's usage limits. For an automatic promotion attached at send, the use already reserved at send is consumed instead. If the accepted subquote does not carry the automatic promotion that reserved a use for its parent quote, that reservation is released with reason `not_applied` and the use returns to the limit. Sibling subquotes marked Not Selected and competing quotes never create an Application; any use reserved for them at send is released. A patient code replaces the promotion the row carried: when the replaced promotion is the automatic one, its reservation is released with reason `not_applied` and the code's use is reserved instead. If the total or per-patient usage limit of a provider-selected promotion is used up when the patient confirms, it is handled like an invalid code (FR-005 REQ-005-026): the acceptance does not happen, the reason is shown, and the patient returns to the subquote detail, which shows the row without that promotion. Pausing, revoking or ending the program after send does not affect a sent quote (General Module Rules); only the usage limit can refuse it at acceptance. A patient code entered on a subquote that was not accepted is discarded. Outcome: The Application is in state Applied with its use reserved, or consumed for an automatic promotion; the discounted price is read from the acceptance snapshot by every later step.
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow A5. PRD lines 156-158, Implementation Notes (line 814).

nodes.title: Any promotion change attempted after acceptance is rejected and logged

attrs.statement: Trigger: Any actor (patient, provider, or admin) tries to remove, replace, enter, or revalidate a promotion on an accepted subquote, including at checkout or booking. Steps: System rejects the action, leaves the Application and the AcceptanceEvent snapshot unchanged, and logs the attempt. Outcome: The accepted price stands. The only exception is the provider-fault transfer in FR-006 (Alternative Flow B5), which creates a new linked acceptance record; promotion handling for that case follows the post-acceptance freeze rule in General Module Rules.
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow B4. PRD lines 162-164. Screen 11 business rule (line 680) and Screen 11 acceptance criterion 4 (line 689) repeat the rejection at checkout and payment.

nodes.title: Three program types share one governance model

attrs.statement: This module exposes **three promotion programs** under one unified governance model: **Admin-via-Provider** — Admin defines a campaign that affects both Hairline and provider fees; targeted providers must opt-in before the code becomes selectable on their quotes. **Provider Self-Created** — Provider defines a discount on their own quotes; no admin approval required. **Hairline-Funded & Direct-Issued** — Admin defines a Hairline-only discount that is issued directly to patients (open-entry code, patient-segment-bound, affiliate-distributed, or individually issued); providers are not involved in approval.
attrs.rationale: Screen Specifications overview. PRD lines 170-176.

nodes.title: Admin may pause or revoke adoption on any program and record a refund; no actor may change the promotion on an accepted subquote

attrs.statement: All three program types share a single `PromotionProgram` entity (ENT-promotion-program) and are managed through a unified screen system with type-aware filters, forms, and analytics. Admin retains override authority on every program (pause, revoke adoption) and may record a refund through FR-017 regardless of program type. An admin can never force a provider to take part in a program; the overrides an admin has on a provider's adoption are Force-Revoke and Re-invite. No actor, including admin, may void, remove, or change the promotion on an accepted subquote (Alternative Flow B4).
attrs.rationale: Screen Specifications overview. PRD line 178.

nodes.title: The hub lists every program type in one catalog with a default sort and result count; filters combine as AND

attrs.statement: All three program types appear in this hub; the Program Type filter narrows the view. Given the admin opens the Hub, when the screen loads, then the system shows all program types in one list with the default descending Last Updated sort and the result count for the default query. Given the admin applies any combination of Program Type, Status, Funding Model, Provider Participation, Date Range, Usage, and ROI filters, then the catalog returns only rows satisfying all active filters and updates the result count. Given the admin selects a row, then the system opens Screen 2 for that program without losing catalog context.
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 (Promotion Program Hub) business rules and acceptance criteria 1-3. PRD lines 245, 252-254.

nodes.title: Admin monitors provider self-created programs and may pause or archive them; editing stays with the provider

attrs.statement: Provider Self-Created programs appear here so admins can monitor and intervene; admins may pause or archive any program and may change a provider-owned definition only as a logged governance override (see Screen 4). Admin may open Screen 2 in read-only mode for provider self-created programs; editing is reserved for the provider unless an override is needed (governance action, logged in audit). Admin may pause or archive any provider self-created program via row action with mandatory reason text.
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 business rules and Screen 4 business rules. PRD lines 246, 397-398. Screen 4 notes (lines 400-402) record that this goes beyond the client transcription.

nodes.title: Hub search, filter, result count and reset behaviour stay aligned with FR-022

attrs.statement: Search, filter, result count, and reset behavior must stay aligned with FR-022 control standards. Search and filter field definitions are co-owned with FR-022. Any change must be updated in both FR-019 and FR-022.
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 business rules and notes. PRD lines 247, 259. FR-022 co-owns the field definitions.

nodes.title: Pausing a program keeps redemptions intact and stops new attachment and code validation

attrs.statement: Given the admin triggers Pause on an Active program row, then the program lifecycle transitions to Paused, all existing redemptions remain intact, the program is not attached to newly sent quotes and does not validate new patient codes, and option/date-price rows already sent keep the terms copied at send.
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 acceptance criterion 4. PRD line 255. Sent rows keep the terms copied at send (REQ-019-012).

nodes.title: Program form limits: name and description length, end not before start, usage limits non-negative

attrs.statement: Program Name: 3–120 chars. Description: ≤ 1000 chars. Start / End Date: End ≥ Start. Total Usage Limit: ≥ 0; blank = unlimited. Per-User Usage Limit: ≥ 0; blank = unlimited.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 common data fields, validation column, composed from table cells. PRD lines 271-280. Screen 9 rows 585-593 repeat the same limits.

nodes.title: Program lifecycle state moves forward only, except Pause and Resume

attrs.statement: Lifecycle State: Draft → Active → Paused → Expired → Archived; Forward transitions only, except Pause and Resume; only the side that paused (admin or provider) may resume, and who paused is recorded.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 common data fields. Pause and Resume on Screens 1 and 8 are the allowed exception; there is no program-level Pending Approval state.

nodes.title: Funding model is derived from the program type and cannot be set independently

attrs.statement: `Funding Model` is derived from `Program Type` and cannot be set independently.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 business rules. PRD lines 302, 287, 381, 601 (Provider Only is fixed on the provider form).

nodes.title: Publishing an Admin-via-Provider program notifies targeted providers, who each accept or decline

attrs.statement: For Admin-via-Provider, publishing the program (Draft to Active) notifies targeted providers, who each accept or decline (S-03; approval-requested event of the FR-030 notification catalogue). There is no program-level Pending Approval: approval is per provider adoption, and the program applies only to providers whose adoption is Accepted. If every provider declines, the program stays Active with no participants until archived.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 business rules; same outcome as the Main Flow step 2 rule.

nodes.title: Auto-applied mode is allowed only for Hairline Only or Provider Only programs and never on a replacement quote

attrs.statement: `Application Mode = Auto-applied` is only allowed for programs with `Funding Model = Hairline Only` or `Provider Only` and only when the program's own fields on this screen define who it applies to: Start / End Date, the usage limits and, for a Hairline Only program, Issuance Channel and Recipient Binding (together the eligibility checked at send and at code validation); it cannot be auto-applied across multiple providers without consent. A Hairline Only program may use only Auto-applied or Code-only: List-selection and Either are not offered for it, because providers never see it in selection UIs. Auto-applied programs attach when a quote is sent (Alternative Flow A3). They never attach to an admin-authored replacement quote, and no use is reserved for one.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 business rules. PRD line 305, acceptance criterion 4 (line 315: message "Auto-applied is not permitted for Both-Fees programs.").

nodes.title: Hairline share percent is required for Both Fees programs, 0 to 100, audited, and part of the terms fixed at send

attrs.statement: `Hairline Share %` is required for Both Fees programs and must be a number from 0 to 100; it is hidden for other funding models. It is part of the terms fixed at send and frozen at acceptance, so an edit applies only to quotes sent afterwards. Every change is recorded in the Audit Trail Panel with actor, timestamp, and old and new values.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 business rules. PRD line 306, acceptance criterion 5 (line 316).

nodes.title: Bulk upload and bulk edit are available for campaign management

attrs.statement: Bulk upload / bulk edit available for campaign management.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 business rules. PRD line 308.

nodes.title: A single open code is redeemable by any patient as soon as the program is published

attrs.statement: Given the admin creates a Hairline-Funded program with `Issuance Channel = Open code` and a single code, when the program is published, then the code is immediately redeemable by any patient on a named subquote before acceptance and the program does not appear in any provider's adoption inbox.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 acceptance criterion 2. PRD line 313.

nodes.title: Application Mode choices follow the funding model: Hairline Only programs offer only Auto-applied or Code-only

attrs.statement: Application Mode choices follow the funding model. Both Fees programs offer `List-selection / Code-only / Either` and never `Auto-applied`. Hairline Only programs offer only `Auto-applied / Code-only`, because Hairline-Funded programs do not appear in provider selection UIs and List-selection or Either would never reach a patient. Provider Self-Created programs offer all four choices, with `Auto-applied` limited as stated on Screen 2. A provider selects an admin program on a quote only from the list of programs the provider has adopted through the approval workflow (Screen 7), never before adoption.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 notes and Screen 9 Application Mode field (same four choices as Screen 2).

nodes.title: All state changes, edits, approvals and overrides are listed in time order with actor, time and reason

attrs.statement: All state changes, edits, approvals, and override actions are listed in chronological order with actor, timestamp, reason, and the old and new values for edits.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 audit trail panel. PRD line 298.

nodes.title: Bulk code generation creates N unique codes, quantity 1 to 10,000

attrs.statement: Bulk Generate Codes: Generate N unique codes for distribution; quantity 1–10,000
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 type-specific fields, composed from the table row. PRD line 294.

nodes.title: Force-Revoke removes the program from the provider's selection list at once and keeps in-flight quotes

attrs.statement: Force-Revoke immediately removes the program from the provider's quote-creation selection list; in-flight quotes with the program already applied are preserved. When an admin Force-Revokes an Accepted provider with a reason, the provider's status changes to Revoked-by-Admin and the program disappears from that provider's quote-creation list within 5 seconds.
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 business rules. PRD line 350, acceptance criterion 1 (line 356: within 5 seconds).

nodes.title: Re-invite resets a declined, auto-declined or revoked provider to Pending and re-sends the notification

attrs.statement: Re-invite resets the provider's status from Declined, Auto-Declined, Revoked-by-Provider or Revoked-by-Admin back to Pending and re-sends the S-03 notification.
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 business rules. PRD line 351.

nodes.title: Every admin override requires reason text in the audit trail

attrs.statement: All admin overrides are logged with mandatory reason text in the audit trail.
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 business rules. PRD line 352.

nodes.title: An approval request with no response auto-declines after the window and is visible in audit

attrs.statement: Given the program's Auto-Decline Window elapses without a provider decision, then the provider's status updates to Auto-Declined and is visible in this manager. Auto-Decline triggers if the Auto-Decline Window (Screen 2) elapses without a decision.
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 acceptance criterion 2, Screen 7 business rules and edge cases. PRD lines 357, 535, 902.

nodes.title: An open code serves any eligible patient until the total usage limit is reached

attrs.statement: Open codes have one code that any eligible patient may use until the total usage limit is reached.
attrs.rationale: Screen 5 business rules. PRD line 436.

nodes.title: Segment-bound codes validate the patient against the segment at entry time

attrs.statement: Segment-bound codes validate the patient against the segment definition at entry time.
attrs.rationale: Screen 5 business rules. PRD line 438.

nodes.title: Individually-issued codes are single-use and bound to one patient

attrs.statement: Individually-issued codes are single-use and bound to a specific patient identifier.
attrs.rationale: Screen 5 business rules. PRD line 439.

nodes.title: Revoking a code stops validation on unaccepted subquotes but not a reserved use

attrs.statement: Revoking a code stops it from validating on any subquote not yet accepted. A use already reserved by an accepted subquote (`In-Progress`) stays frozen with the acceptance and is not cancelled by the revoke.
attrs.rationale: Screen 5 business rules. PRD line 440. Bulk Revoke needs a mandatory reason (line 418).

nodes.title: Affiliate-bound code generation in FR-018 for 50 affiliates registers 50 unique codes, one per affiliate

attrs.statement: Given the admin starts affiliate-bound code generation in FR-018 for 50 selected affiliates and the program's channel = Affiliate-bound, when FR-018 completes generation, then 50 unique codes are registered with this program, each bound to exactly one affiliate, and each appears in the table with status = Unused.
attrs.rationale: Screen 5 acceptance criterion 1. FR-018 owns generation and one-affiliate-per-code assignment; FR-019 owns validation and redemption state.

nodes.title: First successful payment on an affiliate-bound code marks it Redeemed and triggers the affiliate incentive event

attrs.statement: FR-018: Affiliate Management – Affiliate-bound code redemptions accrue incentive to the linked affiliate; FR-019 triggers the incentive event consumed by FR-018. Affiliate codes follow the same usage rule as every code: one use is reserved at acceptance and consumed at the first payment, and there is no code entry at checkout. Given a patient enters an Affiliate-bound code on a named subquote and accepts it, when the first payment succeeds, then the corresponding row updates to Redeemed and the affiliate's incentive accrual (per FR-018) is triggered.
attrs.rationale: Internal Dependencies (FR-018) and Screen 5 acceptance criterion 2. PRD lines 437, 445, 775.

nodes.title: Applied and Completed are two distinct redemption states

attrs.statement: The two-state distinction (Applied vs Completed) is preserved per client request (Admin Part 1 L341–344). Applied = the subquote carrying the promotion has been accepted and, for a provider-selected promotion or patient code, one use is reserved at that moment (entering a code never counts against a limit); Completed = the first payment for that booking has succeeded and that reserved use is consumed. For an automatic promotion the use is already consumed at acceptance, so Completed only marks the first payment.
attrs.rationale: Screen 6 business rules. PRD line 498.

nodes.title: Voided and Superseded are set only by the system; there is no admin Void

attrs.statement: Voided is set only by the system, when the booking reaches `Payment Window Expired` or is cancelled, except for a provider-fault transfer, where Superseded takes precedence; the reserved use is then released. For an automatic promotion, the use consumed at acceptance returns to the usage limit when the row is Voided before the first payment. Superseded is set only by the system when a provider-fault transfer replaces the accepted record, and the use it held returns to the usage limit. A Voided Application returns to its Active status only through an admin revive of the booking, which also clears `use_returned_at`. There is no admin Void action.
attrs.rationale: Screen 6 business rules. PRD line 499, acceptance criteria 3 and 4 (lines 501-502).

nodes.title: Refund is logged with a reason, integrates with FR-017 and never changes the accepted price

attrs.statement: Refund actions are logged with mandatory reason and integrate with FR-017 (Billing & Finance) for monetary reconciliation. They never change the accepted price or the AcceptanceEvent snapshot.
attrs.rationale: Screen 6 business rules and acceptance criterion 2 (status Refunded, FR-017 receives a reconciliation event).

nodes.title: The first successful payment moves Applied to Completed and consumes the reserved use

attrs.statement: Given an accepted subquote with an Applied redemption, when the first payment for the booking succeeds, then the redemption row transitions from State = Applied to State = Completed, the reserved use is consumed (for an automatic promotion the use was already consumed at acceptance and is not counted again), and the change is reflected in Overview KPIs within 5 seconds.
attrs.rationale: Screen 6 acceptance criterion 1. PRD line 499, Screen 6 rule on automatic promotions (line 492).

nodes.title: Revoking an adoption does not affect quotes that already have the program applied

attrs.statement: Revoking adoption does not affect quotes that already have the program applied; only new selections are blocked.
attrs.rationale: Screen 7 business rules. PRD line 540.

nodes.title: Revoking an adoption requires a reason and ends in Revoked-by-Provider

attrs.statement: Given an Active campaign, when the provider clicks Revoke Adoption with reason, then the campaign moves to Past with state = Revoked-by-Provider and is no longer offered in quote creation.
attrs.rationale: Screen 7 acceptance criterion 2. PRD line 546.

nodes.title: A provider may run many self-created promotions at once, subject to one discount per subquote

attrs.statement: Provider may have an arbitrary number of self-created promotions concurrently active, subject to the platform's single-discount-per-subquote rule at redemption time.
attrs.rationale: Screen 8 business rules. PRD line 572.

nodes.title: Codes are unique platform-wide

attrs.statement: Code uniqueness enforced platform-wide (cannot collide with admin codes or other providers' codes).
attrs.rationale: Screen 8 business rules. PRD line 573, Screen 2 field rows (lines 276, 589). Format policy is admin configurable (PRD line 745).

nodes.title: The code is optional on provider self-created promotions; the default mode is list selection

attrs.statement: The **Code field is optional** per a deliberate scope decision. The client transcription (Provider Part 2 L27–33) stated codes are not relevant for provider self-created discounts since providers select them from a list during quote creation. This FR retains the field as **optional** so providers may also issue code-based promotions for marketing distribution (e.g., flyer codes, partner promos). Default Application Mode is `List-selection during quote`.
attrs.rationale: Screen 9 business rules. PRD line 604, scope note (line 615). A scope extension beyond the client transcription (open item).

nodes.title: Ad-hoc records are scoped to one quote and hidden from other quotes' pickers

attrs.statement: **Mode 2 ad-hoc records** are scoped to a single quote and are not shown in the list-selection picker on other quotes' creation screens. They remain visible to admin in Screen 1 Hub (Scope filter = Ad-Hoc Quote-Bound) and Screen 4 Portfolio.
attrs.rationale: Screen 9 business rules. PRD line 605.

nodes.title: A promotion on a row changes only while the quote is drafted or revised before acceptance

attrs.statement: A promotion selected on an option/date-price row may be changed only while the quote is drafted or revised in FR-004 before acceptance. Its terms are copied into the sent quote version when the quote is sent, and a promotion can apply only to a row it was attached to at send.
attrs.rationale: Screen 9 business rules and Screen 10 business rules. PRD lines 609, 658.

nodes.title: A code-only promotion is hidden from the quote picker and redeemable by code on a named subquote

attrs.statement: Given the provider saves a Mode 1 promotion with a Code and Application Mode = Code-only, then the promotion is not shown in the quote-creation selection list but is redeemable when the patient enters the code on a named subquote of that provider's quote before acceptance.
attrs.rationale: Screen 9 acceptance criterion 2. PRD line 614.

nodes.title: Saving an ad-hoc promotion as reusable clears both bindings and makes it selectable on future quotes

attrs.statement: Given the provider saves a Mode 2 ad-hoc promotion with "Save as reusable" enabled, then `scope = REUSABLE` is recorded and the promotion becomes selectable on future quotes within its active window.
attrs.rationale: Screen 9 acceptance criterion 4. PRD line 616.

nodes.title: Ad-hoc promotion defaults: active window of the bound quote, total limit 1 unless saved as reusable

attrs.statement: Start / End Date: Mode 1: end ≥ start. Mode 2: defaults to the active window of the bound quote. Total Usage Limit: ≥ 0; blank = unlimited. Mode 2 forces total limit = 1 unless "Save as reusable" is toggled.
attrs.rationale: Screen 9 data fields, composed from table cells. PRD lines 591-592.

nodes.title: A provider cannot refund a Completed redemption; that authority is admin's

attrs.statement: The provider cannot refund a Completed redemption; that authority sits with admin (Screen 6).
attrs.rationale: Screen 10 business rules. PRD line 659.

nodes.title: A code is validated at entry and again when the patient confirms acceptance

attrs.statement: Validation occurs when the code is entered and again when the patient confirms acceptance. A fixed amount is converted at the rate in effect at each validation, and the amount shown at confirm is the one frozen at acceptance. On acceptance, the discounted price is frozen into the AcceptanceEvent snapshot.
attrs.rationale: Screen 11 business rules. PRD line 685, edge case on a code no longer valid at confirmation.

nodes.title: A discount shows as one separate line that reduces the whole price

attrs.statement: The discount is shown as one separate line that reduces the whole price. When a valid code is applied, for 95% of valid codes the price breakdown updates within 1 second and shows the discount as a separate line.
attrs.rationale: Screen 11 business rules and acceptance criterion 1.

nodes.title: Active dates, eligibility and usage limits are checked at attach, at code validation and at confirmation; send-time and restore failures are handled

attrs.statement: Active dates, eligibility, and usage limits (the total limit and the per-patient limit, REQ-019-116) are checked when a promotion is attached to a row at send (the per-patient limit only for a known patient), when a patient code is validated before acceptance, and, for the usage limits of a provider-selected promotion, when the patient confirms acceptance (Alternative Flow A5). If a promotion the provider selected cannot attach at send (its limit is used up, the program is paused or ended, the provider's adoption is revoked, or its fixed amount equals or exceeds the row's offered price), the provider sees the reason and the quote is sent without that promotion only after the provider confirms; a draft quote that holds a revoked or paused program drops it the same way. An archived quote that is restored re-checks its promotion and takes a new reservation, and the restore is refused when the limit is used up or the promotion has ended (FR-004 REQ-004-105).
attrs.rationale: General Module Rules. PRD line 729.

nodes.title: A promotion applies only to the row it was attached to at send or the one named subquote

attrs.statement: A promotion applies only to an option/date-price row it was attached to at send, or to the one named subquote on which the patient entered a code. Any other application is rejected.
attrs.rationale: General Module Rules. PRD line 731, Screen 9 acceptance criterion 5 (line 611), User Story 4 scenario 4.

nodes.title: A fully reserved or consumed limit blocks attach at send and fails code validation

attrs.statement: Usage limits count active reservations plus consumed uses, so a limit can never be exceeded. A promotion whose limit is fully reserved or consumed does not attach at send and fails code validation.
attrs.rationale: General Module Rules. PRD line 734; the counting sentence is also in REQ-019-015.

nodes.title: On a provider-fault transfer the original Application is kept as Superseded and the replacement carries no promotion

attrs.statement: Post-acceptance freeze: after acceptance, the promotion and discounted price of the accepted subquote are frozen in the AcceptanceEvent snapshot. No removal, replacement, code entry at checkout or booking, price-changing revalidation, or admin void is allowed. The only exception is the provider-fault transfer in FR-006 (Alternative Flow B5): the replacement quote carries no promotion, the original Application is kept as history and marked Superseded (Superseded takes precedence over Voided when the original booking is cancelled for the transfer), and the use it held returns to the usage limit. Money handling for that transfer is defined by FR-006, FR-007, FR-007b, and FR-017.
attrs.rationale: General Module Rules, post-acceptance freeze exception. PRD line 736. FR-006 Alternative Flow B5 owns the transfer.

nodes.title: All discount creations, approvals, applications and removals are auditable

attrs.statement: All discount creations, approvals, applications, and removals are auditable.
attrs.rationale: General Module Rules. PRD line 740.

nodes.title: Patients see only non-sensitive discount information; cost splits stay internal

attrs.statement: Display only non‑sensitive discount info to patients; provider/Hairline cost splits remain internal.
attrs.rationale: Data and Privacy Rules. PRD line 744.

nodes.title: Admin edits discount categories, code format policy, max value caps, dates, targeting, approval routing and templates

attrs.statement: Discount categories, code format policy, the maximum discount value (one Setting; applies to percentage discounts only and starts at 50 percent; fixed amounts have no cap), and campaign dates. Targeting rules (all providers vs. subsets) and approval routing. Notification templates for approvals and status: managed in FR-030 (setting: promotion notification templates). Minimum number of quotes on each side before Conversion Lift is shown (launch default: 20 quotes on each side).
attrs.rationale: Admin Editability Rules. PRD lines 745-747.

nodes.title: Max discount value per policy and region and the auto-decline window are configurable with restrictions

attrs.statement: Maximum discount value per policy and region (the same single Setting as above). Auto‑decline window for unresponded provider approvals.
attrs.rationale: Admin Editability Rules. PRD lines 757-758.

nodes.title: Single-discount rule, priority order, terms fixed at send and calculation order are fixed in code

attrs.statement: Single‑discount rule and priority order (apply to the whole platform). Promotion terms fixed at send and frozen at acceptance. Calculation order of operations (base → discounts → taxes/fees).
attrs.rationale: Admin Editability Rules. PRD lines 751-753, Implementation Notes (line 813: base price, then single discount, then taxes and fees; idempotent validation).

nodes.title: The Application and the usage reservation are created atomically with acceptance; payment never recomputes the price

attrs.statement: Create the Application and reserve usage atomically with the subquote acceptance. Payment and booking read the discounted price from the acceptance snapshot and never revalidate or recompute it.
attrs.rationale: Implementation Notes. PRD line 824.

nodes.title: Treatment changes never change the accepted promotion

attrs.statement: FR-010: Treatment & Recovery Case Management – Screen 10 Applications tab links redemptions to FR-010 treatment case entities; treatment changes never change the accepted promotion.
attrs.rationale: Internal Dependencies (FR-010). PRD line 788.

nodes.title: Simultaneous code attempts on one subquote: the last confirmed wins and both are audited

attrs.statement: Simultaneous attempts to apply codes on one subquote before acceptance: last confirmed selection wins; audit both attempts. Attempts after acceptance are rejected.
attrs.rationale: Edge cases. PRD line 909.

nodes.title: If the code is no longer valid at confirmation, the acceptance does not happen and the patient returns to the subquote detail

attrs.statement: Patient code no longer valid when the patient confirms acceptance (for example, its usage limit was reached): the acceptance does not happen, the reason is shown, and the patient returns to the subquote detail, where the patient may accept without the code or enter another; the price falls back to what the row carried at send, including its attached promotion (FR-005 REQ-005-026).
attrs.rationale: Edge cases. PRD line 911.

nodes.title: Admin program form hides sections that do not apply to the program type

attrs.statement: The form must hide irrelevant sections based on Program Type to reduce cognitive load (e.g., no Approval Routing for Hairline-Funded).
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 320 (Screen 2 notes).

nodes.title: Drilling from an Overview KPI card filters the Applications tab

attrs.statement: Drilling from a KPI card on the Overview tab filters the Applications tab accordingly.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 501 (Screen 6 business rules).

nodes.title: Auto-applied mode on a Both-Fees program is rejected with an inline error

attrs.statement: Given the admin sets `Application Mode = Auto-applied` on an Admin-via-Provider program and attempts to save, then the system rejects the submission with an inline validation error: "Auto-applied is not permitted for Both-Fees programs."
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 315 (Screen 2 acceptance criterion 4).

nodes.title: Bulk Revoke of selected codes requires a mandatory reason

attrs.statement: Bulk Revoke of selected codes requires a mandatory reason.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 418 (Screen 5 data fields: Bulk Revoke, validation Mandatory reason).

nodes.title: The Code-only application mode requires a Code; the other modes leave it optional

attrs.statement: An Application Mode of Code-only requires the Code(s) field to be filled; the field is optional for the other modes, on the admin form (Screen 2) and the provider form (Screen 9).
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 Code(s) field and Screen 9 Application Mode field (Code-only requires Code field).

nodes.title: The adoption decision comment is optional and at most 500 characters

attrs.statement: The deciding actor's comment on an adoption is optional and at most 500 characters.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 344 (Screen 3 adoption columns: Comment, 500 characters).

nodes.title: Hub search needs at least 2 characters, debounces 500 ms and matches case-insensitively with fuzzy matching

attrs.statement: Hub code or keyword search needs at least 2 characters, debounces 500 ms and matches case-insensitively with fuzzy matching.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 208 (Screen 1 data fields: Code / keyword search).

nodes.title: An edited program value applies only from then on; prior redemptions keep their original values in audit

attrs.statement: Given the admin edits the Value of a Paused program and republishes, then the new value applies only to quotes sent and patient codes validated from that point forward; quotes already sent keep the terms copied at send, and prior redemptions retain their original values in audit.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 314 (Screen 2 acceptance criterion 3).

nodes.title: An admin can never force a provider into a program; the overrides are Force-Revoke and Re-invite

attrs.statement: System MUST NOT let an admin force a provider to take part in a program; the overrides an admin has on a provider's adoption are Force-Revoke and Re-invite.
attrs.rationale: FR-019 PRD, Functional Requirements Summary and the module overview. Moved in from FR-017 (former REQ-017-145).

nodes.title: Hairline and provider portions of a discount follow the commission effect; Both Fees adds a reimbursement

attrs.statement: System MUST record the Hairline portion and the provider portion of every Application's discount value according to the commission effect for every program type, and for a Both Fees program MUST add Hairline's reimbursement of the Hairline share % on top.
attrs.rationale: FR-019 PRD, Functional Requirements Summary, General Module Rules (funding split of each Application) and Screen 6 Funding Split.

nodes.title: ROI Estimate is net gain over discount cost and reads Not yet calculated until the first redemption

attrs.statement: ROI Estimate (per program): net gain over discount cost, shown as a percentage: (revenue from bookings that used the program minus the discount given) divided by the discount given. Admin screens count Hairline's share of the revenue and the discount; provider screens count the provider's share. It shows `Not yet calculated` until the program has at least one redemption. The ROI Tier on Screen 1 is the admin-defined band that the ROI falls in.
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 469 (Analytics Definitions: ROI Estimate), 232 (Screen 1 ROI Tier column).

nodes.title: Conversion Lift compares acceptance of quotes with and without the program and is hidden below the minimum quote count

attrs.statement: Conversion Lift: the acceptance percentage of quotes carrying the program minus the acceptance percentage of quotes without any promotion, for the same provider (the whole platform on admin screens) and the same period, in percentage points. It is shown only where both sides have at least the admin-set minimum number of quotes (launch default: 20 quotes on each side); below that the lift is not shown.
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 470 (Analytics Definitions: Conversion Lift), 634 (Screen 10), 755 (Admin Editability Rules).

nodes.title: Financial Impact Preview is the provider's last 30 days of booking value times the discount percent times the provider's funded share

attrs.statement: Financial Impact Preview (Screen 7): the provider's booking value in the last 30 days x the discount % x the provider's funded share of the discount.
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 471 (Analytics Definitions: Financial Impact Preview), 532 (Screen 7 campaign card).

nodes.title: Discount Value: percentage 1 to 100 under the configurable cap; fixed amount above 0

attrs.statement: The Value of a promotion program is required. A percentage discount must be from 1 to 100 and not above the configurable maximum discount value, which starts at 50 percent; a fixed-amount discount must be above 0 and has no cap, but it is not applied to a row whose offered price it equals or exceeds (REQ-019-117). The same applies on the admin form and the provider form.
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 274 (Screen 2 Value), 593 (Screen 9 Value); owner answer 2026-11-22 set the ranges and the starting cap.

nodes.title: A promotion program is disabled softly, without losing data

attrs.statement: System MUST soft-disable a promotion program without data loss: disabling a program never deletes its definition, approvals, usage records or audit trail.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 825 (Implementation Notes, Technical Considerations: audit trail for all state changes; soft-disable discounts without data loss).

nodes.title: The per-patient usage limit counts reserved plus consumed uses by the same patient and is checked where the total limit is checked

attrs.statement: The per-patient usage limit counts the reserved plus consumed uses by the same patient on the same program, the same basis as the total limit, and is checked at the same points: when a promotion is attached at send (for a known patient), when a patient code is validated, and when the patient confirms acceptance. A promotion whose per-patient limit the patient has reached does not attach and fails code validation.
attrs.rationale: General Module Rules, per-patient usage limit bullet; the Per-User Usage Limit field on Screens 2 and 9.

nodes.title: A fixed amount that equals or exceeds the row's offered price is not attached and the code is refused

attrs.statement: When a fixed-amount discount, after conversion to the quote currency, would be equal to or more than the offered price of the row, System MUST NOT attach the promotion (or MUST refuse the patient's code), MUST show the reason, and MUST leave the price unchanged.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 business rules (fixed amount) and the Value validation row.

nodes.title: A change to the Value or Hairline Share % of an adopted Both Fees program notifies every adopting provider and applies to later quotes only

attrs.statement: When an admin changes the Value or the Hairline Share % of a Both Fees program that providers have adopted, System MUST notify every adopting provider with the old and new terms; the change applies only to quotes sent afterwards, each adoption stays Accepted, and the provider may revoke it as before.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 business rules and acceptance criterion 7. The notice is a new row in the FR-030 notification catalogue.

nodes.title: A generated affiliate code is rejected with a named reason when its text already exists or its program is not Affiliate-bound

attrs.statement: When FR-018 registers a generated code, FR-019 rejects the registration with a named reason when the code text already exists on the platform (REQ-019-076) or the chosen program is not an Affiliate-bound program; FR-018 shows the returned reason on that row and the admin retries.

nodes.title: Email sent for key events per templates

attrs.statement: System MUST send email for key events per templates.
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary, prd.md line 489.

nodes.title: Push notifications sent to the mobile app

attrs.statement: System MUST send push notifications to the patient mobile app on iOS and Android. No other push platform is supported.
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary, prd.md line 490.

nodes.title: Optional SMS for urgent events

attrs.statement: Post-MVP (future phase): System MUST support optional/configurable SMS for urgent events. SMS is not available in MVP; no SMS is sent until a later phase enables it.
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary. Marked Post-MVP, consistent with REQ-020-030: SMS is not available in MVP.

nodes.title: Patients configure global Email and Push toggles

attrs.statement: System MUST allow patients to configure notification preferences (MVP: global Email/Push toggles managed in FR-001: Patient Authentication & Profile Management).
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary, prd.md line 492. Also stated at line 299 (Business Rules, Patient Preferences: global Email/Push toggles in MVP, category preferences deferred to V2) and line 124. Screen owned by FR-001.

nodes.title: Supported event types follow the FR-030 catalog

attrs.statement: System MUST support notification event types in the FR-030 MVP event catalog (Admin-Configurable Notification Event Types), routed to enabled channels and templates.
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary, prd.md line 493.

nodes.title: Notifications throttled and suppression logged

attrs.statement: System MUST throttle notifications to prevent spam and log suppression.
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary, prd.md line 494. Alternative Flow B1 (line 164) and line 331.

nodes.title: Delivery status tracked and exposed per attempt

attrs.statement: System MUST track and expose delivery status per attempt.
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary, prd.md line 495.

nodes.title: Patient notification listing screen, 20 per page

attrs.statement: System MUST provide notification listing screen for patients to view notification history (paginated, 20 per page).
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary, prd.md line 496. Screen: SCR-020-01.

nodes.title: Provider notification dropdown, infinite scroll, 20 per batch

attrs.statement: System MUST provide notification dropdown in provider dashboard header with infinite scroll (loads 20 notifications per batch, no separate listing screen).
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary, prd.md line 497. Screen: SCR-020-02. Screen Business Rules lines 227 to 231 repeat the infinite scroll behaviour.

nodes.title: Admin notification dropdown, infinite scroll, 20 per batch

attrs.statement: System MUST provide notification dropdown in admin dashboard header with infinite scroll (loads 20 notifications per batch, no separate listing screen).
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary, prd.md line 498. Screen: SCR-020-03. Screen Business Rules lines 263 to 268 repeat the infinite scroll behaviour.

nodes.title: Admins notified for enabled FR-030 events they receive

attrs.statement: System MUST send notifications to admins for any enabled FR-030 event types where Admin is a primary or optional recipient (per rule configuration).
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary, prd.md line 499. Also stated at line 301.

nodes.title: quote.accepted outcomes routed per sent parent quote

attrs.statement: System MUST route FR-005 acceptance outcomes through `quote.accepted` with an explicit `outcome` code and recipient-scoped payload, sending one provider notice per sent parent quote (de-duplicated on acceptance record + parent quote + recipient) and no notice for unsent drafts; the selected-provider and not-selected-provider outcomes MUST NOT be disableable. Non-selected providers MUST receive only their own outcome context and MUST NOT receive the selected provider identity or accepted price; `quote.declined` MUST NOT represent FR-005 system-generated sibling or competing-parent outcomes.
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary, prd.md line 500. Also stated at line 305 (privacy allowlist) and lines 308, 309.

nodes.title: Mandatory provider-status cancellation notices

attrs.statement: System MUST send mandatory provider.status_cancellation_patient and provider.status_cancellation_admin_support notifications for each record affected by an FR-015 provider suspension/deactivation, regardless of the Notify Provider checkbox, with privacy-safe patient content (no patient-cancelled wording, no payment instruction, no confidential reason), and MUST use the FR-003 pre-acceptance variants (Workflow 2 Alternative Flow B4, REQ-003-021): in this order: (1) "[Clinic] is no longer available. Your other offers are still open." when other live offers remain; (2) a confirmation request first, with Confirm and Decline deep links to FR-003 Screen 8, when no live offer remains and the patient had explicitly selected the affected provider; (3) "[Clinic] is no longer available. We are finding new offers for you." when no live offer remains and the patient made no explicit selection. When the patient has not answered after 48 hours, one mandatory reminder provider.status_redistribution_reminder follows (REQ-020-159).
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary, prd.md line 501. Also stated at line 302 (Business Rules, Provider-Status Cancellation Notifications): patient content uses provider-caused wording and a Contact Admin/Support action, with the three pre-acceptance variants from FR-003 REQ-003-021 (CR links in the PRD line are not read).

nodes.title: Provider-status email retry without duplicates and recipients

attrs.statement: System MUST retry failed provider-status notifications (per Flow B2) without duplicates per provider-status event + affected record + recipient, and a retry MUST NOT restore a cancelled record; System MUST send `provider.suspended` / `provider.deactivated` email to the provider Owner only when "Notify Provider" is checked; for a scheduled change, the email MUST be sent when the change is created and again when it takes effect. `provider.status_cancellation_admin_support` MUST go to admins with the FR-031 Respond to Support permission, and `provider.reactivated` and `provider.scheduled_change_cancelled` MUST go to the provider Owner only.
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary. Carries the never-restore-a-cancelled-record clause of the merged REQ-020-151; the Business Rules Provider-Status Cancellation bullet points here.

nodes.title: Mandatory provider.activation and login-email notices

attrs.statement: System MUST always send `provider.activation` (non-disableable) when FR-015 creates a provider or a resend is requested, and MUST send `provider.reactivated` and `provider.scheduled_change_cancelled` to the provider when FR-015's "Notify Provider" applies; these events MUST NOT be suppressed by FR-030 toggles or FR-032 category preferences. System MUST always send `provider.login_email_changed` to the old and the new address when an admin changes the Owner login email in FR-015.
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary, prd.md line 503. Also stated at line 304: provider.activation is mandatory because without it a new provider cannot set a password; provider.login_email_changed is a security notice to the old and the new address.

nodes.title: Closure request and rejection notices are mandatory

attrs.statement: System MUST send `provider.closure_requested` to admins when a provider submits an FR-032 account-closure request and `provider.closure_rejected` to the provider when an admin rejects it, and MUST always send `provider.deactivated` for a deactivation that processes a closure request; these events MUST NOT be suppressed by FR-030 toggles or FR-032 category preferences.
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary, prd.md line 504. Also stated at line 304 (account-closure events).

nodes.title: Mandatory quote and booking events; admin-configurable reminders

attrs.statement: System MUST send `quote.withdrawn` (before and after acceptance), `booking.payment_window_expired`, `booking.revived`, `booking.provider_fault_replacement` and `treatment.plan_changed` as mandatory notifications that FR-030 toggles cannot disable, and MUST send `quote.expiring_soon` and `booking.hold_expiring_soon` at the FR-026 lead times when enabled in FR-030.
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary, prd.md line 505. Locks restated at line 313.

nodes.title: Quote and booking notices use parent-level and snapshot variables

nodes.title: Acceptance sends the patient only booking.scheduled

attrs.statement: At acceptance, System MUST send the patient only `booking.scheduled` and no `quote.accepted` notice, MUST send `quote.accepted` only to the accepted provider and the not-selected providers, and MUST NOT send an admin notification for the acceptance. Admins MUST be alerted only for the exceptions `booking.hold_expiring_soon`, `booking.payment_window_expired`, `booking.provider_fault_replacement` and `quote.withdrawn` when the withdrawn quote was already accepted; `quote.withdrawn` MUST always reach the patient and MUST NOT alert admins for a withdrawal before acceptance.
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary, prd.md line 507. Also stated at lines 314 and 315: admins are alerted only for exceptions on the quote-to-booking path (a slot hold expiring while the first payment is unpaid, Payment Window Expired, provider fault, and a provider withdrawing a quote that was already accepted), and routine acceptances are visible on admin dashboards only; the same applies to an admin-authored replacement acceptance in the FR-006 provider-fault transfer.

nodes.title: quote.cancelled_inquiry goes only to quote-holding providers and is critical

The reason is patient-private: a patient cancellation says only Inquiry cancelled by patient; the deletion cancellation shows no reason. The notice is critical (REQ-020-158): its target is a first send attempt within 5 minutes, and a failed first attempt is retried under the FR-030 retry rule (up to 3 retries, 1 hour apart by default), so 5 minutes is a target, not a guarantee.
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary and the quote.cancelled_inquiry catalogue row (a pointer to REQ-030-039). FR-030 and FR-003 are queued to align REQ-030-039, REQ-030-219 and REQ-003-100.

nodes.title: A1: disabled channel suppressed, others still attempted

A deferred notice returns to step 3 when its hold ends; a notice merged into another ends with status coalesced. A critical notice (REQ-020-158) is never coalesced or deferred.

nodes.title: B2: failed channel attempts retried under the FR-030 retry rule

Outcome: Failed attempts are retried under the FR-030 retry rule (up to 3 retries, 1 hour apart by default), each retry returning to step 4; status reflects failure cause; after the last retry the notice ends with status failed. A notice counts as complete when its first attempt has been handed to a channel or it has ended failed after the last retry.
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow B2. The failover clause is removed; the retry rule is owned by FR-030.

The in-app record is the notification record itself and has no attempt row, so an attempt's channel is email, push or sms. An email attempt row also carries an opened marker, the time the recipient opened the email; opened applies to email only, and the FR-030 escalation condition Not opened reads it.

nodes.title: quote.accepted recipient matrix by population

attrs.statement: `quote.accepted` recipient matrix (provider P has sent parent quotes A and B, and the patient accepts one subquote in A): Accepted subquote in parent A: One notice to P for parent A (mandatory); outcome `selected_subquote_accepted`; payload allowlist: Accepted subquote details from the accepted snapshot. Other subquotes in parent A (siblings): No separate notice; listed inside P's parent A notice; outcome `sibling_subquote_not_selected`; payload allowlist: P's own parent A subquote references and outcome. Other sent parent quote of the same provider (parent B): One separate notice to P for parent B (mandatory); outcome `competing_parent_cancelled_other_subquote_accepted`; payload allowlist: Parent B quote and subquote references, outcome and reason. Sent parent quote of any other provider: One notice per parent quote to that provider (mandatory); outcome `competing_parent_cancelled_other_subquote_accepted`; payload allowlist: That provider's own parent quote and subquote references, outcome and reason; no selected provider identity and no accepted price. Unsent draft parent quote of any provider: No notice (draft cancelled silently by FR-004); outcome None; payload allowlist: None. The patient receives no `quote.accepted` notice; at acceptance the patient receives only `booking.scheduled` (Booking Accepted — Slot Held (Pending Payment)) and never receives sibling or competing outcomes. Admins receive no acceptance notice.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 318. Statement assembled from the five matrix rows and the closing paragraph (lines 322 to 328).

nodes.title: The notification Rule is the one place for recipients, content and switch-off

attrs.statement: For each notice, the notification Rule (the one in this PRD, or the FR-030 catalogue Rule where this PRD's catalogue row is a pointer) is the one place that states recipients, content and whether the notice can be switched off. A feature FR states only what is its own (when the event happens, what the screen does, what is audited) and points to the notification Rule.
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 305 (Business Rules, Notification Rule Owns the Details)

nodes.title: An event that produces a notification belongs to the FR-030 catalogue

attrs.statement: An event that produces a notification belongs to the FR-030 catalogue, and this PRD cites it. This includes the provider.* events, `inquiry.ttfq_sla_breached` and `analytics.export_ready`. An event that produces no notification belongs to the FR that triggers it.
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 307 (Business Rules, Event Ownership); also line 38

nodes.title: A locked notice is critical and is never held back

attrs.statement: A notice whose toggle is locked (mandatory) is critical. A critical notice is sent at once and is exempt from quiet hours, the hourly rate limit and coalescing. The Urgency badge on the admin dropdown only displays a level and drives none of these. Single exception: legal.acceptance_reminder is locked but not critical; it respects quiet hours and the rate limit.
attrs.rationale: Business Rules, Critical Notices. Closes the gap between the locked toggle in FR-030 and the throttling flow (B1), which named no exemption.

Sent once, when the patient has not answered the confirm variant of provider.status_cancellation_patient after 48 hours; same Confirm and Decline deep links to FR-003 Screen 8 and the Contact Admin/Support action; no second reminder. The reminder is not sent, and a pending one is dropped, when the redistribution is no longer awaiting the patient's confirmation (the patient answered, the inquiry was cancelled, an Admin reassigned providers or reran distribution, or the support marker was cleared). Primary recipients: Patient. Notes: FR-023 REQ-023-008. Status notices on a deletion request: identity proof insufficient (the patient provides more), approved and processing, completed (with the actions taken and the legal basis of any retained records), denied (with the reason), approval blocked by an active obligation (with the expected timeline). The outcome notices dsr.fulfilled and dsr.denied are mandatory; admin cannot disable them. dsr.fulfilled is sent by email only, to the contact address FR-023 captured (REQ-023-033), is critical and creates no in-app record; when the email still fails after all retries, the captured address is deleted anyway and the Admin sees the failure in the delivery log.

nodes.title: Admin configures machine-translation provider credentials

nodes.title: Machine-translation credentials encrypted, masked, access-controlled, never exported

nodes.title: All system-controlled text is externalized into translation keys

nodes.title: Translation keys are stable identifiers

attrs.statement: Translation keys must be stable identifiers and should not be based on mutable display copy.
