nodes.title: Active keys require an English source value

attrs.statement: Active keys require an English source value.
attrs.rationale: PRD Business Rules (prd.md line 652).

nodes.title: Keys carry surface and group metadata

attrs.statement: Keys must include tenant/surface and group/namespace metadata.
attrs.rationale: PRD Business Rules (prd.md line 653).

nodes.title: Edits save as draft; imports default to draft; import and publish is gated

attrs.statement: Inline text edits save draft changes only; JSON imports default to Import as Draft, with Import and Publish Version allowed only when no row was skipped for an error and the target is not the English source locale, after full validation preview, publish-summary entry, and Super Admin authorization. attrs.rationale: PRD Business Rules (prd.md line 654).

nodes.title: Fallback chain: selected locale, fallback locale, default locale

attrs.statement: Fallback applies per key: the selected locale first, then that locale's configured fallback locale, then always the English source locale.
attrs.rationale: PRD Business Rules (prd.md line 658).

nodes.title: Locale direction metadata is stored

attrs.statement: Locale direction metadata must be stored so future RTL support is not blocked.
attrs.rationale: PRD Business Rules (prd.md line 659).

nodes.title: Machine-generated translations are draft only and Review Needed

attrs.statement: Machine-generated translations save as draft only, must be marked Review Needed, and cannot be served to runtime clients until published.
attrs.rationale: PRD Business Rules (prd.md line 660).

nodes.title: Machine translation can target a whole non-English language, never English

attrs.statement: Machine translation generation can target a whole non-English language by missing keys or full-language replacement scope; English/source locale is never replaced by machine translation.
attrs.rationale: PRD Business Rules (prd.md line 661).

nodes.title: Clients revalidate bundles; stale window after publish or rollback is bounded

attrs.statement: Clients MUST revalidate translation bundles against version metadata (ETag/hash or equivalent) on each fetch cycle. After a publish or rollback, the maximum acceptable stale window is a platform-configurable interval, recommended at 5 minutes or less, ensuring clients do not serve outdated bundles for an indeterminate period after a version change.
attrs.rationale: PRD Business Rules (prd.md line 662).

nodes.title: Import and export files hold system-controlled text only

attrs.statement: Import/export files must contain system-controlled text only unless another owning FR explicitly permits additional metadata.
attrs.rationale: PRD Business Rules (prd.md line 670).

nodes.title: Audit log content for localization changes

attrs.statement: System must log locale changes, protected source edits, imports, publishes, rollbacks, and missing-translation events with actor, timestamp, scope, and reason where applicable.
attrs.rationale: PRD Business Rules (prd.md line 672).

nodes.title: Version history and audit trail retention

attrs.statement: Published version history and audit trail must be retained according to platform audit-retention policy.
attrs.rationale: PRD Business Rules (prd.md line 673).

nodes.title: Published versions are immutable and stay inspectable after rollback

attrs.statement: Published versions are immutable and must remain inspectable after rollback.
attrs.rationale: PRD Business Rules (prd.md line 674).

nodes.title: Items editable by Admin

attrs.statement: Editable by Admin: Supported locales, native names, deactivation, fallback locale, and locale direction metadata; Translation values for non-source locales; Translation key metadata such as description/context and group where allowed; Draft translation changes and import confirmations (publish and rollback are Super Admin only); Machine-translation draft generation jobs; Currency display configuration where already owned by A-09/S-02. attrs.rationale: PRD Business Rules (prd.md line 673). Restated at: Editable list: translation values (line 674); Editable list: key metadata (line 675); Editable list: publish and rollback (line 676); Editable list: MT credentials and jobs (line 677); Editable list: currency display (line 678).

nodes.title: Items fixed in code and not editable by Admin

attrs.statement: Fixed in codebase (not editable by Admin): Locale formatting library behavior; Runtime bundle fetch protocol; Mandatory system keys required by application code; Notification variable contracts owned by FR-030; Security and audit-retention mechanisms.
attrs.rationale: PRD Business Rules (prd.md line 682). Restated at: Fixed list: bundle fetch protocol (line 683); Fixed list: mandatory system keys (line 684); Fixed list: notification variables (line 685); Fixed list: security and retention mechanisms (line 686).

nodes.title: Key identifiers after first publish change only by controlled migration

attrs.statement: Translation key identifiers after first publish require controlled migration rather than casual editing.
attrs.rationale: PRD Business Rules (prd.md line 699).

nodes.title: Default locale change needs Super Admin approval alone and cannot deactivate the source locale

attrs.statement: Default locale changes require approval by the Super Admin alone (no second approver); the new default locale must be Active, and English always remains the last-resort fallback. The default locale is the language shown to a user who has no stored language preference and whose device language is not a supported locale.
attrs.rationale: PRD Business Rules, Admin Editability (prd.md line 700).

nodes.title: Historical versions and audit records cannot be deleted by Admin

attrs.statement: Historical versions and audit records cannot be deleted through normal admin controls.
attrs.rationale: PRD Business Rules (prd.md line 702).

nodes.title: Elevated authorization means Super Admin for four protected operations

attrs.statement: Elevated authorization means the Super Admin role as defined in FR-031. Only Super Admin role holders may edit English source values (including by import into the English locale), change the default locale, publish translation versions, and perform rollback operations. These four protected operations cannot be delegated. Moving any locale to Active (REQ-021-125), the free-text translation switch and its budget, and machine-translation provider credentials and activation (REQ-021-122) are also Super Admin only. The exact per-operation permission scope must be aligned with FR-031 configuration at implementation time.
attrs.rationale: PRD Business Rules (prd.md line 704). Restated at: Dependency FR-031 (line 777); Integration note: HTTP 403 (line 879); Security: authorization (line 902).

nodes.title: Currency display uses configured rules and never stores them in translation files

nodes.title: Locale-aware number formatting is owned by S-02 and consumed by FR-021

Locale-aware number formatting (decimal separator, symbol position, digit grouping, and RTL currency rendering) is owned by S-02 as a shared service capability and consumed by FR-021; neither FR-021 nor FR-029 duplicates this formatting logic.
attrs.rationale: PRD Business Rules (prd.md line 709).

nodes.title: Selected language does not override timezone or currency

attrs.statement: User-selected language does not automatically override timezone or currency unless product rules explicitly map country/locale defaults.
attrs.rationale: PRD Business Rules (prd.md line 710).

nodes.title: Only authenticated Admin users reach localization management

attrs.statement: Only authenticated admins holding the Manage Localization permission can access localization-management Screens 4 to 10; the Screen 3 language selector is open to every authenticated admin.
attrs.rationale: PRD Implementation Notes (prd.md line 909).

nodes.title: User-generated content is not automatically translated, except the free text covered by REQ-021-119

attrs.statement: Out of scope: Machine translation of uploaded documents, and of any user-generated content other than the free text listed in General Module Rule 15.
attrs.rationale: PRD Module Scope, Out of Scope (prd.md line 86). The covered free text is set by REQ-021-119.

nodes.title: Full RTL layout is not part of V1

attrs.rationale: PRD Executive Summary (prd.md line 25). Restated at: Out of scope list: RTL (line 88); Business Assumption 3: Arabic (line 846).

nodes.title: Patient language selection is stored on the patient profile

attrs.statement: Language selection is stored on the patient profile/account preference.
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen Specifications, Screen 1 (prd.md line 243).

nodes.title: Each runtime surface loads the latest published bundle for the user's locale and its own surface

attrs.rationale: PRD General Module Rule 14 (prd.md line 663). Restated at: Screens 1, 2 and 3 bundle-loading bullets. Merged: REQ-021-065 (Provider Dashboard) and REQ-021-068 (Admin Platform).

nodes.title: Deactivated locale: patients fall back without losing their preference

attrs.rationale: PRD Screen Specifications, Screen 1 (prd.md line 247).

nodes.title: Patient timezone must be a value from the FR-026 GMT list

attrs.rationale: PRD Screen Specifications, Screen 1 (prd.md line 238).

nodes.title: Region/locale sets date, number and currency formatting context

attrs.rationale: PRD Screen Specifications, Screen 1 (prd.md line 237).

nodes.title: Author's text stays in the language entered; the reader may see a translation

nodes.title: Provider language choice applies to dashboard text and provider-facing notifications

nodes.title: Inactive provider locale falls back to the fallback locale

nodes.title: Localization screens show several languages regardless of Admin UI language

nodes.title: Admin UI language does not change the registry default locale

attrs.rationale: PRD Screen Specifications, Screen 3 (prd.md line 308).

nodes.title: Draft changes are visible in localization screens but not used in the Admin UI

nodes.title: A language with history is never hard-deleted

nodes.title: English is the initial default and source locale

attrs.statement: English (`en`) is always the source locale and is the initial default locale; only the default locale can be changed, and only by a Super Admin.
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen Specifications, Screen 4 (prd.md line 344).

nodes.title: New languages start in Preparation state

nodes.title: Only Active locales appear in language selectors

attrs.statement: Only Active locales appear in the Patient, Provider, and Admin interface-language selectors; Inactive and Preparation locales are hidden from them. attrs.rationale: PRD Screen Specifications, Screen 4 (prd.md line 346). Restated at: Screen 1 rule (line 246); Screen 2 row: available languages (line 268); Screen 3 row: available languages (line 298); Alternative flow A1 step 2 (line 176).

nodes.title: Locale code is unique and follows the locale-code format

attrs.statement: Locale code must be unique and must follow the supported locale-code format

nodes.title: Exactly one default locale; it cannot be deactivated or removed

attrs.statement: Exactly one default locale exists; the default locale must be Active and cannot be removed.
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen Specifications, Screen 4 (prd.md line 329). Restated at: Screen 4 row: status (line 328); Screen 4 note: default protected (line 350).

nodes.title: Machine translation route is offered only for non-English languages and authorized Admins

nodes.title: Export does not modify system state

nodes.title: An export identifies whether it is draft or published

attrs.statement: Export JSON action: Must identify draft vs published export
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen Specifications, Screen 5 (prd.md line 372).

nodes.title: Key inventory is a baseline; implementation keys may change within the model

attrs.statement: Developers may add, remove, split, or rename implementation keys without first updating this PRD when the change stays within the documented localization model, follows naming conventions, and is captured in the implementation registry/audit trail.

nodes.title: Shared keys are reused only when meaning is identical; others stay tenant-scoped

nodes.title: Key detail shows all active language values for the selected key

nodes.title: Saving is blocked when placeholders are removed, renamed or malformed

attrs.statement: System must block saving if placeholders are removed, renamed, or malformed.
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen Specifications, Screen 7 (prd.md line 519).

nodes.title: Change reason is required for English source edits

attrs.statement: Change reason: Required when editing English source. The reason for a publish or rollback is the Change summary (REQ-021-102).
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen Specifications, Screen 7 (prd.md line 508).

nodes.title: Character length guidance does not block unless a screen limit exists

attrs.statement: Character guidance: Non-blocking unless a screen-specific limit exists
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen Specifications, Screen 7 (prd.md line 507).

nodes.title: Validation failure blocks save, import or publish and shows errors

attrs.statement: System blocks save, import, or publish when validation fails and shows errors for correction
attrs.rationale: PRD Main Flow (prd.md line 136).

nodes.title: Import preview is required before a confirmed import

attrs.statement: Import preview is required before confirmed import.
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen Specifications, Screen 8 (prd.md line 554).

nodes.title: Import validates syntax, known and duplicate keys, placeholders, ICU, locale and orphans

attrs.statement: System must validate JSON syntax, known keys, duplicate keys, placeholder consistency, ICU syntax, target-locale compatibility, and unsupported/orphaned keys.
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen Specifications, Screen 8 (prd.md line 555). Restated at: Screen 8 row: file (line 539); Security consideration: threat mitigation (line 906).

nodes.title: Every confirmed import creates an import record

attrs.rationale: PRD Screen Specifications, Screen 8 (prd.md line 556).

nodes.title: Import and publish creates an import record and an immutable version

attrs.rationale: PRD Screen Specifications, Screen 8 (prd.md line 557).

nodes.title: Unknown keys are blocked; a new key comes only from an English source import

attrs.statement: Unknown keys are blocked. A new key can be created only by an import into the English source locale, with its English value in that file (library text from the FR-024 treatment form is the one other route, REQ-021-127); an unknown key in any other locale's file is an error.

nodes.title: Row-level import errors: import valid rows only or cancel

nodes.title: Publishing creates a new active bundle for the language, surface and group scope

attrs.statement: Publishing creates a new active bundle version for selected language, tenant/surface, and group scope.
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen Specifications, Screen 9 (prd.md line 591).

nodes.title: Cache is invalidated after publish and rollback

nodes.title: Publish and rollback record actor, time, reason, keys, scope and previous version

attrs.rationale: PRD Screen Specifications, Screen 9 (prd.md line 591).

nodes.title: Publishing is blocked by required validation errors

attrs.rationale: PRD Screen Specifications, Screen 9 (prd.md line 595). Restated at: Screen 9 row: publish action (line 581); External dependency: translator files (line 790).

nodes.title: Rollback requires a reason and confirmation after an impact warning

attrs.statement: Before rollback the system displays the impacted locale, tenant/surface, groups, keys, and a rollback warning; rollback requires a reason and confirmation
attrs.rationale: PRD Main Flow (prd.md line 123). Restated at: Main flow step 4R (line 121); Screen 9 row: rollback action (line 582).

nodes.title: Version comparison is limited to one language and surface scope

attrs.statement: Compare versions action: Versions must share language/surface scope
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen Specifications, Screen 9 (prd.md line 586).

nodes.title: Publish and rollback require a change summary

attrs.statement: Change summary: Required for publish/rollback. It is the one reason input for a publish or rollback, including the publish summary entered on Import and Publish Version and the rollback reason.
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen Specifications, Screen 9 (prd.md line 580). Restated at: Main flow step 11 (line 157).

nodes.title: Machine translation of system text is a draft-generation tool, not a runtime path; free-text translation is separate

attrs.statement: Machine translation of system-controlled text is a draft-generation tool, not a runtime translation path. Free-text translation for the reader is the separate case in General Module Rule 15.
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen Specifications, Screen 10 (prd.md line 627). Restated at: Out of Scope (line 89).

nodes.title: Machine translation targets non-English locales only

attrs.statement: Machine translation can only target non-English locales; English/source values remain human-authored and governed by source-edit protections.
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen Specifications, Screen 10 (prd.md line 629). Restated at: Screen 10 row: target language (line 613); Screen 10 row: generation mode (line 616).

nodes.title: Machine-generated values stay Review Needed until reviewed or accepted

attrs.statement: All machine-generated values are marked Review Needed until Admin saves a reviewed value or selects Accept as reviewed on Screen 7.
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen Specifications, Screen 10 (prd.md line 632).

nodes.title: Machine-generated values pass the same validation as JSON imports

attrs.statement: Generated values must pass the same placeholder, ICU syntax, key-existence, target-locale compatibility, and publish validation rules as JSON imports.
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen Specifications, Screen 10 (prd.md line 633). Restated at: Main flow step 8M (line 151).

nodes.title: Provider configuration changes and translation jobs are audited

attrs.statement: Every provider configuration change and machine-translation job must be audited with actor, timestamp, provider, target language, mode, scope, counts, and reason.
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen Specifications, Screen 10 (prd.md line 636).

nodes.title: A custom machine-translation provider needs an existing integration

attrs.statement: Custom machine-translation provider is allowed only if an integration exists
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen Specifications, Screen 10 (prd.md line 612).

nodes.title: Adding a provider stores the credential encrypted and verifies the connection

attrs.statement: When the Super Admin adds a provider, the system stores the encrypted credential and verifies the connection. A failed connection sets the provider status to Error and stops; no job starts unless the provider is Connected. The Super Admin can enable or disable a provider; a Disabled provider cannot start a job, and enabling it verifies the connection again.
attrs.rationale: PRD Alternative Flows (prd.md line 209).

nodes.title: Starting a translation job needs an active provider, preview, reason and authorization

attrs.statement: Generate draft action: Requires a Connected and enabled provider, preview, confirmation, and the Manage Localization permission. Preview counts and a confirmation reason are required before generation.
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen Specifications, Screen 10 (prd.md line 619). Restated at: Screen 10 row: preview counts (line 617); Screen 10 row: confirmation reason (line 618).

nodes.title: Translation job failures are recorded and create no publishable values

attrs.statement: Provider errors, quota limits, unsupported languages, placeholder mismatches, or malformed outputs are recorded in job history; accepted results remain draft and cannot publish until validation passes. Job status is one of Queued, Running, Completed, Partially failed, or Failed. Only one job per language runs at a time; a new job is refused while one is Queued or Running.
attrs.rationale: PRD Dependencies (prd.md line 803). Restated at: Integration note: machine translation errors (line 889).

nodes.title: Protected endpoints return HTTP 403 to non-Super-Admin

attrs.statement: Protected endpoints (publish, rollback, English source edit, default locale change) must return HTTP 403 with the platform-standard error format when called by a non-Super-Admin role.
attrs.rationale: PRD Integration Points, Admin Platform localization management (prd.md line 887).

nodes.title: Runtime clients fetch published bundles on defined triggers

attrs.statement: Runtime clients fetch published translation bundles on app start, language change, cache revalidation, or version change.
attrs.rationale: PRD Entry Points (prd.md line 104).

nodes.title: Bundle fetch falls back to the cached bundle, else the English source bundle

attrs.statement: When a bundle fetch fails, use the cached bundle, else the English source bundle.
attrs.rationale: PRD Integration Points, Patient App and Provider Dashboard bundle fetch (prd.md lines 869 and 874).

nodes.title: Notification delivery uses fallback locale template

attrs.statement: When the recipient's locale template is missing, follow the Rule 9 order: that locale's fallback locale, then English. FR-021 supplies the locale catalog and fallback locale to FR-030; notification wording lives only in FR-030 templates, not in a translation bundle.
attrs.rationale: PRD Integration Points, Notification Service (prd.md line 892).

nodes.title: Provider dashboard language preference persists before re-render

attrs.statement: The save/apply action applies the selected language to the dashboard session and profile preference and must persist the preference before refresh/re-render.
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen 2 Save/apply action validation (prd.md line 272).

nodes.title: Admin language preference persists on apply

attrs.statement: The apply action applies the selected language to the admin session and preference and must persist the preference.
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen 3 Apply action validation (prd.md line 299).

nodes.title: Fallback notice is shown only when a fallback has occurred

attrs.statement: The fallback notice on Patient App Language & Region Settings MUST be shown only when a fallback has occurred.
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary (prd.md line 1067). PRD id REQ-021-118. Restated at: Screen 1 rules (line 249).

nodes.title: Free text between users is machine-translated for the reader when the Admin switch is on

attrs.statement: When free-text translation is switched on, free text written by one user for another (messages, free-text fields in an inquiry, provider-authored package names and descriptions, support messages and notes, and reviews) MUST be machine-translated into the reader's own language using the provider the Super Admin chooses for free text, or the single Connected provider when none is chosen; when no provider is Connected, free text MUST be shown untranslated. Uploaded documents MUST NOT be translated. The switch is one platform-wide setting controlled by the Super Admin from the Free-text translation panel on Screen 10 and MUST be off by default.
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary (prd.md line 1068). PRD id REQ-021-119. Restated at: General Module Rule 15 (line 664); Module Scope (lines 46, 62, 82, 86).

nodes.title: Free-text translation has a monthly budget; at the limit text is shown untranslated

attrs.statement: The Super Admin MUST be able to configure a monthly budget for free-text translation in the Free-text translation panel on Screen 10 (no default figure), in the platform currency and counted per calendar month in UTC; a blank budget means free text is shown untranslated, a budget of zero stops translation, and when the monthly limit is reached the Super Admin MUST be notified once and free text MUST be shown untranslated until the next month.
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary (prd.md line 1069). PRD id REQ-021-120. Restated at: General Module Rule 16 (line 665).

nodes.title: Only an admin holding the Manage Localization permission may use the machine-translation route

attrs.statement: Only an admin holding the Manage Localization permission MUST be able to use the machine-translation route for translation drafts.
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary (prd.md line 1070). PRD id REQ-021-121. Restated at: Screen 10 business rules (line 628).

nodes.title: Manage Localization permission covers every Admin-editable item; Super Admin only items stay with the Super Admin

attrs.statement: The Manage Localization permission MUST cover every item editable by Admin in REQ-021-046: editing non-English translation values, importing JSON as a draft, generating machine-translation drafts, and managing locales other than the Super Admin-only changes. The Super Admin holds it and MAY grant it to another admin role in the FR-031 permission matrix. Editing the English source, changing the default locale, moving a locale to Active, publishing, rollback, the free-text translation switch and its budget, and provider credentials and activation MUST stay Super Admin only.
attrs.rationale: Pass 1 logic review. Stated in the PRD Functional Requirements Summary and restated at the screen or rule that applies it.

nodes.title: Import into the English source locale is an English source edit

attrs.statement: An import into the English source locale MUST be treated as an English source edit with the REQ-021-020 controls: Super Admin only, with a change reason, and only Import as Draft is offered (publish later from Screen 9). A new key can be created only by such an import, and its row MUST carry the English value or the row is an error.
attrs.rationale: Pass 1 logic review. Stated in the PRD Functional Requirements Summary and restated at the screen or rule that applies it.

nodes.title: Review Needed values do not block publish; the publish confirmation shows the count

attrs.statement: Review Needed values MUST NOT block publish; the Screen 9 publish confirmation MUST show how many values remain flagged.
attrs.rationale: Pass 1 logic review. Stated in the PRD Functional Requirements Summary and restated at the screen or rule that applies it.

nodes.title: Moving a locale to Active is Super Admin only and needs a published bundle for every surface

attrs.statement: Moving a locale to Active, from Preparation or from Inactive, MUST be Super Admin only and MUST require a published bundle for every surface (Patient App, Provider Dashboard, Admin Platform); Active to Preparation is not offered. The default locale MUST be Active.
attrs.rationale: Pass 1 logic review. Stated in the PRD Functional Requirements Summary and restated at the screen or rule that applies it.

nodes.title: Provider and admin screens format dates and numbers by the selected locale

attrs.statement: Provider and admin screens MUST format dates and numbers by the selected locale. Provider screens MUST use the provider timezone set in FR-032 (a value from the FR-026 GMT list); admin screens MUST use the admin's browser timezone with the zone named beside the time (FR-026 General Module Rule 5).
attrs.rationale: Pass 1 logic review. Stated in the PRD Functional Requirements Summary and restated at the screen or rule that applies it.

nodes.title: Admin-authored library text is registered as translation key groups

attrs.statement: Admin-authored library text (treatment type descriptions and technique specifications) MUST be registered as translation key groups on the Patient App and Provider Dashboard inventories. The FR-024 treatment form is the authoring screen for this English text: saving it MUST write the key's English source value (creating the key if new) and mark dependent translations Review Needed; it is exempt from the Super Admin-only source-edit rule because it is not a registry edit, and translation and publish stay in FR-021. Provider-authored package names and descriptions are free text under REQ-021-119 and are not keys.
attrs.rationale: Pass 1 logic review. Stated in the PRD Functional Requirements Summary and restated at the screen or rule that applies it.

nodes.title: After a rollback the registry's published values follow the rolled-back version; each publish builds from the active bundle plus drafts

attrs.statement: After a rollback, the registry's published values for that scope MUST be set to the rolled-back version's values and pending drafts MUST stay as drafts; each publish MUST build its bundle from the active bundle plus the drafts in scope.
attrs.rationale: Pass 2 logic review. Stated in the PRD Functional Requirements Summary and General Module Rule 18.

nodes.title: Inactive admin locale falls back to the fallback locale

attrs.statement: If an admin's selected locale becomes inactive, the Admin Platform falls back to the configured fallback locale.
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen 3 business rules; same behavior as REQ-021-060 (Patient App) and REQ-021-067 (Provider Dashboard) and General Module Rule 9.

nodes.title: Admin searches patients by name, email, phone and HPID

attrs.statement: System MUST allow admins to search patients by name, email, phone number, and patient ID (HPID format)
attrs.rationale: Restated by Module Scope A-01 (line 60) and Main Flow 1 keyword node. Screen criteria: FR-016 / Screen 1 rule.

nodes.title: Admin filters patients by status, location, registration date and provider

attrs.statement: System MUST allow admins to filter patients by status, location, registration date range, and provider
attrs.rationale: Restated by Module Scope A-01 (line 60) and Main Flow 1 filter node. Screen criteria: FR-016 / Screen 1 rule.

nodes.title: Admin searches providers by name, clinic, email and licence number

attrs.statement: System MUST allow admins to search providers by provider name, clinic name, email, and license number
attrs.rationale: Restated by Module Scope A-02 (line 61) and Main Flow 2 keyword node. Screen criteria: FR-015 / Screen 1 rule.

nodes.title: Admin filters providers by status, featured, commission type and date

attrs.statement: System MUST allow admins to filter providers by status, featured flag, commission type, closure-requested flag, and date range
attrs.rationale: Restated by Module Scope A-02 (line 61) and Main Flow 2 filter node. Screen criteria: FR-015 / Screen 1 rule.

nodes.title: Search results within 300ms at p95

attrs.statement: System MUST return search results within 300ms for 95% of queries (p95 latency)
attrs.rationale: Restated by Search Performance Rule 1 (Search queries MUST complete within 300ms for p95 of requests) and Success Criterion SC-009.

nodes.title: Search results paginated (page-size setting for admin and provider lists, 10 patient mobile)

attrs.statement: System MUST paginate search results: admin and provider lists default to the page-size setting (default 25 per page, range 10 to 100), except where the owning screen states its own page size or selector, which wins (FR-015 Screen 1 at 50, FR-016 selectable 25, 50 or 100, FR-024 at 20); the patient app is fixed at 10 per page
attrs.rationale: Restated by General Module Rule 3 and Search Performance Rule 3 (pagination); Edge Case 2 shows the first page of 25. Admin-editable page size: SET-search-results-page-size.

nodes.title: Case-insensitive fuzzy matching on all text search fields

attrs.statement: System MUST support case-insensitive fuzzy matching for all text search fields
attrs.rationale: Restated by General Module Rule 1 (all search queries MUST be case-insensitive) and Alternative Flow A2 (partial information, fuzzy matching, multiple matches). Accent-insensitive matching and full-text index basis are in the General Module Rule 2 rule.

nodes.title: Filters combine with AND logic

attrs.statement: System MUST apply filters cumulatively using AND logic (all active criteria must match)
attrs.rationale: Restated by Alternative Flow A1 (all active criteria must match), Control Behavior Standards Filter Active row and User Story 3 scenario 2. Within-field OR is a separate rule.

nodes.title: Patient results show status, location and last activity

attrs.statement: System MUST display patient status, location, and last activity date in search results
attrs.rationale: Restated by Main Flow 1 results node (name, ID, status, location, recent activity), General Module Rule 5 (admin results display status prominently) and User Story 1 scenario 1.

nodes.title: Provider results show status, location, rating and active patients

attrs.statement: System MUST display provider status, location, rating, and active patient count in search results
attrs.rationale: Restated by Main Flow 2 results node (name, location, status, rating, active patients) and General Module Rule 5 (status displayed prominently).

nodes.title: Search input debounce 300-500ms

attrs.statement: System MUST implement search input debounce (300–500ms depending on screen) to reduce server load
attrs.rationale: Restated by General Module Rule 6 and Implementation Notes debouncing. Fixed split 300ms local / 500ms server-query is its own rule.

nodes.title: Patient searches providers by name and specialty [P2]

attrs.statement: System MUST allow patients to search providers by name and specialty [P2 - Post-MVP]
attrs.rationale: Restated by Multi-Tenant Breakdown Patient P-02 (line 44) and Main Flow 3 keyword node. Screen criteria: FR-003 / Screen 7a rule.

nodes.title: Patient filters providers by country, rating and specialty [P2]

attrs.statement: System MUST allow patients to filter providers by country, rating, and specialty [P2 - Post-MVP]
attrs.rationale: Restated by Multi-Tenant Breakdown Patient P-02 (line 44) and Main Flow 3 destination/filters nodes; User Story 4 scenario 3 (4.5+ stars). Screen criteria: FR-003 / Screen 7a rule.

nodes.title: Location autocomplete, max 10 suggestions [P2]

attrs.statement: System MUST support autocomplete suggestions for location searches (max 10 suggestions) [P2 - Post-MVP]
attrs.rationale: Restated by Alternative Flow A3 (patient autocomplete for location: suggestions in real time, selection populates location and filters provider list). Autocomplete limit is fixed in codebase (Admin Editability Rules).

nodes.title: At most 5 providers per quote request [P2]

attrs.statement: System MUST limit patient provider selection to maximum 5 providers per quote request; the patient continues with 1 to 5 selected, can deselect a selected provider, and at 5 selected the remaining cards cannot be selected [P2 - Post-MVP]
attrs.rationale: Restated by Main Flow 3 (up to 5 providers, limit reached finalises recipients), User Story 4 scenario 5 and Admin Editability Rules fixed in codebase (5 providers).

nodes.title: Provider card content [P2]

attrs.statement: System MUST display provider card with name, location, rating, starting price, before/after photo [P2 - Post-MVP]
attrs.rationale: Restated by Main Flow 3 cards node (name, location, rating, price indicator) and User Story 4 scenario 1 (starting prices in the patient's local currency).

nodes.title: Infinite scroll for patient mobile, 10 per page [P2]

attrs.statement: System MUST support infinite scroll pagination for patient mobile app (10 results per page) [P2 - Post-MVP]
attrs.rationale: Restated by Technology Assumption 5 (client-side pagination and infinite scroll).

nodes.title: Search endpoints require valid JWT authentication

attrs.statement: System MUST require valid JWT authentication for all search endpoints
attrs.rationale: Restated by Security Considerations Authentication and the FR-031 internal dependency (admin JWT verified on every search API request).

nodes.title: Patient and provider search is admin-only (RBAC)

attrs.statement: System MUST enforce role-based access control (admin-only for patient/provider search)
attrs.rationale: Restated by Security Considerations Authorization and the FR-031 internal dependency (role-based access control enforced per FR-031).

nodes.title: Admin searches for patient and provider records logged with user, time, terms and result count

attrs.statement: System MUST log all admin searches for patient and provider records with user ID, timestamp, search type (patient or provider), search terms, filters applied, and result count; the log is written for admin searches only, not for patient or provider searches
attrs.rationale: Restated by the Data & Privacy Audit Rule (admin user ID, timestamp, search terms, result count) and Privacy Rule 2 (retained for audit purposes: who searched for whom, when). Stored as ENT-search-audit-log, a back-office record with no screen in any application (owner ruling of 2026-11-25; see REQ-022-140).

nodes.title: Search inputs sanitised against SQL injection and XSS

attrs.statement: System MUST sanitize all search inputs to prevent SQL injection and XSS attacks
attrs.rationale: Restated by Security Considerations Input validation and Edge Case 3 (special characters removed or escaped; user sees results or 'No matches found.').

nodes.title: Search rate limit 100 per hour per user

attrs.statement: System MUST rate-limit search queries to 100 per hour per user; a search past the limit is declined (Alternative Flow B2)
attrs.rationale: Restated by Security Considerations Rate limiting (to prevent abuse/scraping).

nodes.title: Patient names anonymised in results until payment confirmed

attrs.statement: System MUST show providers only the Patient ID and a masked patient name in search results at every stage until the patient has confirmed payment; provider search stays by Patient ID, plus inquiry or quote ID and message content on the Messages list, and never by patient name
attrs.rationale: Restated by Data & Privacy Rule 1: patient names MUST be excluded from provider-facing search fields and results until booking is confirmed and paid; provider search for inquiries and quotes is restricted to Patient ID as the only patient identifier prior to payment confirmation (FR-003/Screen 9 and FR-004/Screen 2). See also REQ-022-033 and REQ-022-035.

nodes.title: Search audit logs encrypted

attrs.statement: System MUST encrypt the search audit log (the history of admin searches for patient and provider records)
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 2153 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Indexes on all searchable fields

attrs.statement: System MUST create database indexes on all searchable fields for query optimization
attrs.rationale: Restated by Search Performance Rule 2 and Implementation Notes Database Indexing.

nodes.title: Autocomplete results cached 5 minutes

attrs.statement: System MUST cache autocomplete results for 5 minutes to reduce database load
attrs.rationale: Restated by Search Performance Rule 4 and Implementation Notes Caching (5-minute TTL).

nodes.title: 100 concurrent admin searches without degradation

attrs.statement: System MUST handle 100 concurrent admin searches without performance degradation
attrs.rationale: Restated by SC-010 and Technology Assumption 4.

nodes.title: 500 concurrent patient searches without degradation [P2]

attrs.statement: System MUST handle 500 concurrent patient searches without performance degradation [P2 - Post-MVP]
attrs.rationale: Restated by SC-011.

nodes.title: Indexed database queries under 100ms

attrs.statement: System MUST complete database queries in under 100ms for indexed searches
attrs.rationale: Restated by SC-013.

nodes.title: Provider inquiry search by patient ID only

attrs.statement: System MUST allow providers to search their inquiry list by patient ID only (patient name excluded from provider-facing search until booking payment confirmation)
attrs.rationale: Restated by Multi-Tenant Breakdown PR-02 (line 51) and Privacy Rule 1. Screen criteria: FR-003 / Screen 9 rule.

nodes.title: Provider inquiry filters

attrs.statement: System MUST allow providers to filter inquiries by concern, age range, date range, medical alerts, and patient location
attrs.rationale: Screen criteria: FR-003 / Screen 9 rule.

nodes.title: Provider quote list search fields; no patient name before payment

attrs.statement: System MUST allow providers to search their quote list across patient ID, inquiry, treatment, date, status, and location fields (patient name excluded until booking payment confirmation)
attrs.rationale: Restated by Multi-Tenant Breakdown PR-02 (line 51) and Privacy Rule 1. Screen criteria: FR-004 / Screen 2 rule (graph screen SCR-004-02).

nodes.title: Provider quote list filters

attrs.statement: System MUST allow providers to filter quotes by status, date range, concern, patient location, and medical alerts
attrs.rationale: Screen criteria: FR-004 / Screen 2 rule (graph screen SCR-004-02).

nodes.title: Provider treatment case search

attrs.statement: System MUST allow providers to search treatment cases by patient ID, name, and booking reference
attrs.rationale: Restated by Multi-Tenant Breakdown PR-03 (line 52). Screen criteria: FR-010 / Screen 3 rule.

nodes.title: Provider treatment case filters

attrs.statement: System MUST allow providers to filter treatment cases by procedure date range and clinician
attrs.rationale: Restated by Multi-Tenant Breakdown PR-03 (line 52). Screen criteria: FR-010 / Screen 3 rule.

nodes.title: Provider aftercare case search and filters

attrs.statement: System MUST allow providers to search and filter aftercare cases by patient name/ID, milestone, status, and date range
attrs.rationale: Restated by Multi-Tenant Breakdown PR-04 (line 53). The specialist filter is admin-only (FR-011 / Screen 13). Screen criteria: FR-011 / Screen 8 rule.

nodes.title: Provider analytics filters

attrs.statement: System MUST allow providers to filter their analytics dashboard by date range and country on its header (FR-014 / Screen 1) and to filter the Performance & Conversion screen (FR-014 / Screen 2) by treatment type as well; the filters are owned by FR-014 (REQ-014-181)
attrs.rationale: Restated by Multi-Tenant Breakdown PR-05 (line 54). Screen criteria: FR-014 / Screen 1 rule.

nodes.title: Provider package list search and status filter

attrs.statement: System MUST allow providers to search their package list by name and filter it by package status (Active, Draft or Inactive)
attrs.rationale: Screen criteria: FR-024 / Screen 4 rule.

nodes.title: Provider review filter by star rating

attrs.statement: System MUST allow providers to filter their reviews by star rating
attrs.rationale: Restated by Multi-Tenant Breakdown PR-06 (line 55). Screen criteria: FR-032 / Screen 1 / Tab 5 rule.

nodes.title: Provider support case search and filters

attrs.statement: System MUST allow providers to search their support cases by case ID, title, description and message content and filter them by status (Open, In Progress, Resolved, Closed), type (Support Request, Feedback) and creation date range; the criteria are owned by FR-032 (REQ-032-107) and the default view by FR-034 (REQ-034-114)
attrs.rationale: Restated by Multi-Tenant Breakdown PR-06 (line 55). Screen criteria: FR-032 / Screen 5.7 rule.

nodes.title: Provider team member search

attrs.statement: System MUST allow providers to search team members by name and email and filter them by role and status
attrs.rationale: Restated by Multi-Tenant Breakdown PR-01 (line 50). Screen criteria: FR-009 / Screen 10 rule.

nodes.title: Patient help centre full-text search with auto-suggest

attrs.statement: System MUST allow patients to search help center content with full-text search and auto-suggest
attrs.rationale: Restated by Multi-Tenant Breakdown P-08 (line 46). Screen criteria: FR-035 / Screen 1 and Screen 2 rules.

nodes.title: Patient help centre content-type filter

attrs.statement: System MUST allow patients to filter help center by content type (FAQs, Articles, Resources, Videos)
attrs.rationale: Screen criteria: FR-035 / Screen 2 rule.

nodes.title: Result count after every search or filter

attrs.statement: System MUST display a result count after every search or filter operation
attrs.rationale: Restated by Control Behavior Standards Filter Active row (result count updates) and User Story 5 scenario 2.

nodes.title: Active filter chips, removable one by one

attrs.statement: System MUST show active filter chips for every applied filter and allow individual chip removal
attrs.rationale: Restated by Control Behavior Standards Filter Active row (active filter chips shown below filter bar).

nodes.title: Reset / Clear All control

attrs.statement: System MUST provide a "Reset" or "Clear All" control to clear all active filters at once
attrs.rationale: Restated by Control Behavior Standards Reset Filter row, Main Flows 1-3 Reset all nodes and User Story 3 scenario 3.

nodes.title: Patient sorts and filters FR-005 subquotes

attrs.statement: System MUST allow patients to sort FR-005 subquotes by price, inherited graft count, inherited provider rating, appointment date, or parent quote date and to filter them by the patient-submitted date range selected by each subquote.
attrs.rationale: Restated by User Story 5 scenarios 1-2 and the FR-005 / Screen 1 criteria (graph screen SCR-005-01). Near-duplicate of REQ-005-012 and REQ-005-053 (FR-005).

nodes.title: Patient-facing price order uses display-currency conversion

attrs.statement: System MUST order any patient-facing price sort or price filter by each price converted to the patient's display currency at the current rate, for ordering and filtering only; each card carrying a quote MUST keep showing its own quote currency, and the price order MUST be labelled approximate when the listed items use more than one currency.
attrs.rationale: Restated by General Module Rule 9 (identical wording in rule form), the FR-005 / Screen 1 sort basis and User Story 5 scenario 5. Near-duplicate of REQ-005-027 (FR-005), which is limited to subquote price sorting.

nodes.title: Entry points to search and filter

attrs.statement: Patient Platform: [P2] Provider Search is accessed when the patient begins the quote request flow and needs to select destination/providers, is triggered from the "Choose Destination" or "Select Providers" screens, and is available throughout the quote request journey for comparison; [P1] Messaging search is accessed from the patient communications inbox; [P1] Help & Support search is accessed from the Help & Support hub, Help Center, and My Support Tickets screens. Provider Platform: PR-01 (Team) from Provider Dashboard → Team tab → Team Management Dashboard (FR-009/Screen 1); PR-02 (Inquiries/Quotes) from Provider Dashboard → Inquiries tab → Inquiry List (FR-003/Screen 9) and Quotes List (FR-004/Screen 2); PR-03 (Treatment) from Provider Dashboard → Treatments tab → In Progress Cases (FR-010/Screen 3); PR-04 (Aftercare) from Provider Dashboard → Aftercare tab → Aftercare Cases List (FR-011/Screen 8); PR-05 (Analytics) from Provider Dashboard → Analytics tab → Analytics Dashboard (FR-014/Screen 1); PR-06 (Profile/Settings) from Provider Dashboard → Profile/Settings section — Packages (FR-024/Screen 4), Help Centre (FR-032/Screen 5), Reviews (FR-032/Screen 1 Tab 5), Support Cases (FR-032/Screen 5.7); PR-07 (Messaging) [P1 - MVP] from the provider secure messaging inbox. Admin Platform [P1 - MVP]: each admin module (A-01 through A-10) provides context-specific search and filtering within its own interface.
attrs.rationale: Entry Points (prd.md lines 86-110). Business Process Assumption 3: patient searches for providers occur during the quote request flow, not as standalone exploration [P2]. Change log 2.7 removed admin global/cross-module search entry points.

nodes.title: Keyword and filters evaluated together in real time

attrs.statement: Search and filter controls are available simultaneously; the System evaluates the active keyword AND active filters together in real-time (Main Flow 1 admin patient search, Main Flow 2 admin provider search). In patient provider discovery the System evaluates destination, keyword, and filters together in real-time (Main Flow 3 [P2 - Post-MVP]).
attrs.rationale: Main Flows 1-3 CTRL and QUERY nodes (prd.md lines 127-188).

nodes.title: Default list and reset per search flow

attrs.statement: Admin opens Patients module — full patient list shown by default; Reset all clears all inputs and restores the full patient list (Main Flow 1). Admin opens Providers module — Active providers shown by default (FR-015 Screen 1); Reset all restores the default Active-only list (Main Flow 2). Patient Reset all clears all inputs and restores the full country list (Main Flow 3 [P2 - Post-MVP]).
attrs.rationale: Main Flows 1-3 NAV and RESET nodes (prd.md lines 124-199). FR-015 / Screen 1 Status filter default Active (line 1140).

nodes.title: No-results feedback with refinement guidance

attrs.statement: When a search term or filter combination matches no records, the System displays 'No results found' with refinement guidance: check spelling or try different keywords; remove one or more filters. In patient provider discovery the System displays 'No providers found' with refinement guidance.
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow B1 (prd.md lines 275-295); Main Flows 1-3 EMPTY nodes.

nodes.title: Search unavailable: message, retry, engineering alert

attrs.statement: If the backend database connection fails during a search query, the System displays 'Search temporarily unavailable. Please try again.', logs the error and alerts the engineering team; the user (patient, clinic user or admin) can retry or abandon the search, and a patient or clinic user can also contact support.
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow B2 (prd.md lines 295-314): abandoning is open to patient, clinic user and admin; contacting support is for patient and clinic user only.

nodes.title: Search control states

attrs.statement: Search Inactive (default; no input in search field): placeholder text shown; full default list visible; no query fired; dimmed placeholder text and neutral input border. Search Active (user types in search field): typed text visible; clear (×) button appears; debounced query fires (300–500ms per screen spec); list filters to matching results; active input border. These states apply uniformly to every screen; any screen-specific deviation is noted inline under that screen.
attrs.rationale: Control Behavior Standards table rows Search Inactive and Search Active (prd.md lines 394-395).

nodes.title: Filter control states and reset to defaults

attrs.statement: Filter Inactive (default; no filters applied): filter button neutral; no filter chips; default query runs; full result set shown. Filter Active (one or more filter controls changed from default): active filter chips shown below filter bar; filter button highlighted; AND-logic applied across all active filters; list narrows; result count updates. Reset Filter (user taps "Clear Filters" / "Reset" / selects default option): all filter controls return to their default values; chips cleared; all filter parameters cleared; default result set restored; filter icon returns to neutral.
attrs.rationale: Control Behavior Standards table rows Filter Inactive, Filter Active and Reset Filter (prd.md lines 396-398). Related: REQ-022-008, REQ-022-054, REQ-022-055, REQ-022-056.

nodes.title: Within-field OR, across-field AND

attrs.statement: AND logic applies across different active filter types simultaneously — a result must satisfy all active filter conditions at once. Within a single multi-select filter field, selected values are combined with OR logic — a result matches if it satisfies any of the selected values for that field.
attrs.rationale: Control Behavior Standards Filter Logic Note (line 400); change log 2.3 item 4.

nodes.title: Subquote price sort basis, tie-break and ineligible placement

attrs.statement: Price sorts use each subquote's price after promotion where a promotion applies, otherwise its offered price, both as shown on FR-005 / Screen 1 (the offered price is the price before any promotion, REQ-005-050); the price per graft is not used for price sorting. For ordering only, each price is converted to the patient's display currency at the current rate; each card still shows its own quote currency, and when the listed subquotes use more than one currency the price order is labelled approximate. Subquotes with the same sort value are ordered by parent quote send date (most recent first), then by option order within the parent quote, then by date range start. Subquotes that cannot currently be accepted (Not Selected, Expired, Withdrawn or Cancelled) stay in the list, shown disabled as in FR-005, and sort after all eligible subquotes. Each list row and each counted result is one subquote.
attrs.rationale: FR-005 / Screen 1 Sort basis paragraph (line 457). Restated by User Story 5 scenarios 1, 3, 4 and 5. Overlaps REQ-022-058 and REQ-005-027 on currency conversion.

nodes.title: No active providers in the selected country [P2]

nodes.title: Many results: first page, total count and narrowing banner

Use filters to narrow down by location, status, or patient ID."

nodes.title: Search timeout after 10 seconds

nodes.title: Duplicate patient accounts all returned and flagged

nodes.title: Patient email and phone shown only to authorised admins

nodes.title: Admin search logs retained for audit
