attrs.statement: The audience of each document type is fixed: Terms & Conditions and Privacy Policy, patients and provider team members; general Consent, patients only; Cancellation Policy, nobody. Admin uses the acceptance rules in the Legal settings panel on Screen 1 (REQ-027-059) only to switch the acceptance requirement of a type off for an audience; the setting cannot widen the audience or change the gated actions (REQ-027-033), and while it is unset the fixed audience applies.
attrs.rationale: Owner default 88. The earlier wording left open who accepts which type and what the setting could change, since who is fixed by the base (REQ-027-053) and when by the gating (REQ-027-033). A provider team member is not asked for the patient consent.

nodes.title: Publishing Admin notified when publication succeeds

attrs.statement: System notifies the Admin who published when publication succeeds.
attrs.rationale: Communication Structure and Main Flow step 5. The recipient is the publishing Admin.

nodes.title: Admins holding A-09 Edit Settings notified when the Acceptance Rate is below the threshold

attrs.statement: System notifies the Admins holding A-09 Edit Settings when the Acceptance Rate of a Current version is below the Admin-set threshold.
attrs.rationale: Communication scope. The alert is raised by the daily job, which has no acting Admin, so the recipients are the Admins who can change the settings. Coverage is the accepted share, so the alert fires when it is low. The evaluation time is in REQ-027-063.

nodes.title: Warning banner on the document list when the Acceptance Rate is below the Admin-set threshold

attrs.statement: Screen 1 (Admin Legal Documents List, SCR-027-01) shows a warning banner when the Acceptance Rate of the Current version is below the Admin-set threshold, from 14 days after the version became Current (the same start as the alert in REQ-027-063).
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 notes. The threshold is set in the Legal settings panel; unset means no banner (REQ-027-059). The banner waits as the alert does, because the rate is 0 percent at publication.

nodes.title: Out of scope: real-time chat, legal counsel workflows, external e-signature, Admin Terms of Service

attrs.statement: Out of scope: real-time chat or legal counsel workflows; external e-signature platforms (future consideration); Admin Terms of Service acceptance (FR-031).
attrs.rationale: Admin Terms of Service acceptance at account creation is owned by FR-031 and is not tracked in the FR-027 ledger.

nodes.title: Cancellation Policy is read-only information and never needs acceptance

attrs.statement: Cancellation Policy is a read-only informational document that has no per-version acceptance record in FR-027 acceptance tracking. It uses the same versioning and publishing pipeline, but Material Change is fixed to No and not editable and Requires Acceptance is always No. It is shown through the full policy link on the FR-006 booking and payment screens; the refund ladder numbers come from FR-029 and the legal text MUST NOT restate them. The one exception is the booking flow: the patient ticks the Cancellation Policy acknowledgment checkbox on the FR-006 booking and payment screen at every booking (REQ-006-038). That per-booking acknowledgment is owned and stored by FR-006 with the booking and records which policy version was shown; it is not a legal document acceptance under this module, creates no acceptance ledger record, and is not counted in acceptance rates, the Pending set or reminders.
attrs.rationale: Owner default 86, refined by the owner ruling of 2026-11-25. FR-005 does not carry cancellation terms; FR-006 shows the policy before payment and owns the per-booking checkbox; the percentages must have one source.

nodes.title: Requires Acceptance is tied to the Material Change flag

attrs.statement: Requires Acceptance indicates whether material change gating applies and is tied to the Material flag from the draft; for the Cancellation Policy it is always No.
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 Requires Acceptance field (line 140). Computes ENT-legal-document.requires_acceptance.

nodes.title: Material versus minor changes

attrs.statement: Material includes changes to obligations, data use/sharing, user rights, or liability; Minor includes formatting, typo fixes, or clarifications without policy change. Only material changes require re-acceptance; Admin marks the publish accordingly.
attrs.rationale: CL-2 (line 350) and Edge Cases (line 311: non-material edits may not require re-acceptance; material changes do; rules configurable).

nodes.title: One Current version per document type; the prior Current is archived when the new version becomes Current

attrs.statement: Only one Current version per document type at a time; when a newly published version becomes Current, the prior Current is auto-archived.
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 business rules and Status validation. Restated by Main Flow step 4 and Screen 3 business rule. A published version with a future effective date is Scheduled and the previous version stays Current until then.

nodes.title: A future effective date keeps the previous version Current until then, then activates the new version and starts prompts

attrs.statement: When Admin publishes with a future effective date, System marks the new version Scheduled and the previous version stays Current; on the effective date the new version becomes Current, the previous version is archived, and prompts begin when Material Change = Yes and Requires Acceptance = Yes. Prompts start only when the version is Current.
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow A1. Publish and the audit entry run at the Publish click on both branches; the main flow no longer prompts for a version that is not yet Current.

nodes.title: Restoring an earlier text is a new draft published as a new version; no revert button; prompts updated and audit entries recorded

attrs.statement: There is no revert button. To go back to an earlier text, Admin creates a new draft from the old version (Create draft from this version on a Current or Archived row of Screen 1) and publishes it as a new version through the normal publishing flow with Material Change fixed to Yes (No for the Cancellation Policy); Screen 2 shows the Material Change field fixed and not editable on such a draft, and the audit entries of the normal publish are recorded (REQ-027-013).
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow B1. The restore reuses the main edit, preview and publish steps; the audit and prompt steps are those of the normal flow.

nodes.title: Restoring an earlier text keeps existing acceptance records; users with no row for the restored version or its source version accept the restored one

attrs.statement: When an earlier text is restored it is published as a new version; existing acceptance records are preserved, a base member with a ledger row for the version the text was restored from counts as accepted, and every other base member is Pending and is asked to accept it (REQ-027-053).
attrs.rationale: Edge Cases. A restored version is always material, so one population decides who is prompted, reminded and counted; a user who already holds the original version is not asked again.

nodes.title: Core actions blocked until acceptance; read-only where safe

attrs.statement: Until acceptance, a patient cannot submit an inquiry, accept a quote or start a payment, and a provider cannot accept an inquiry or submit a quote; everything else stays available, including aftercare, messaging, scheduled installments and viewing. A user who does not accept stays in this limited state and may sign out or use the FR-001 account-deletion route. Gating occurs at sign-in and at those actions.
attrs.rationale: Owner default 84. CL-1 named no enforcer and no list of core actions; the neighbour checks in FR-003, FR-004, FR-005 and FR-007 are neighbour changes.

nodes.title: Users with pending procedures keep read-only access until acceptance

attrs.statement: Users with pending procedures keep access to aftercare, messaging, scheduled installments and viewing until acceptance; prompts are shown at sign-in and at the blocked actions in REQ-027-033.
attrs.rationale: Edge Cases (line 312).

nodes.title: No further prompts after acceptance until the next required version

attrs.statement: After the user accepts, System resumes normal access without further prompts until the next required version; acceptance is once per version, so FR-003 asks again at an inquiry only when the Current Terms & Conditions are not accepted. A user must accept the Current text of a type while the latest Material Change = Yes version up to and including it is not accepted by them; first run asks for the Current text whatever its flag.
attrs.rationale: Owner default 82. Main Flow step 6 of User Accepts New Version and User Story 2 scenario 2. A minor version therefore does not cancel an earlier material requirement. The FR-003 checkbox change is a neighbour change.

nodes.title: Missing translation falls back to the platform default language (English) with a notice; publishing needs complete English (en-US) content

attrs.statement: If a localized version is unavailable, fall back to the platform default language (English) and display a discreet notice. When a version is published globally, the system validates that at least the English (en-US) locale content is complete; if other locales are configured, the Admin UI summarises their completeness and publishing proceeds with the platform default language (English, en-US) version as the single fallback where a locale is missing or incomplete (as per CL-3). Legal-content fallback is fixed to English (en-US) and does not follow the FR-021 fallback order, because publication needs a complete English text.
attrs.rationale: CL-3, Edge Cases (locale mismatch), Assumptions and Screen 3 business rule. The platform default language (English) is the single fallback. Merged from REQ-027-039.

nodes.title: Missing locale logs a task for the Admin

attrs.statement: When a user is served the fallback text, Screen 1 shows a Locale gap badge on that version's row; Admin may add the missing locale text to a Current version, which clears the badge. The addition is audited as edit, creates no new version and needs no re-acceptance; existing locale texts of a Current version stay view-only.
attrs.rationale: Owner default 87. CL-3 and Edge Cases. The task for the Admin is a badge on the existing list; a translation of unchanged text should not churn version labels or acceptance coverage.

nodes.title: Acceptance using the fallback locale is valid

attrs.statement: Acceptance using the fallback is considered valid.
attrs.rationale: CL-3 (line 351).

nodes.title: Version label unique per document type

attrs.statement: Version label must be unique per document type; all locale texts of a version share it (REQ-027-061).
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 Version (line 137) and Screen 2 Version Label (line 172: must be unique per type).

nodes.title: Effective date is a UTC date and time, checked at save and again at Publish

attrs.statement: Effective Date is a date and time stored in UTC and shown in the Admin's time zone; at save it cannot be in the past; it is checked again at Publish, and a time already past at Publish makes the version Current immediately.
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 and Screen 2 gave different types and no time zone, and a stale draft could be published with a past date.

nodes.title: Content between 200 and 50,000 characters

attrs.statement: Content must have at least 200 and at most 50,000 characters.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 Content (line 168: Min 200 chars; max 50k chars).

nodes.title: Change summary required, at most 500 characters

attrs.statement: Change Summary is required and is at most 500 characters.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 Change Summary (line 169).

nodes.title: Document type locked after version creation

attrs.statement: Document Type is locked after version creation.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 Document Type (line 166).

nodes.title: Material Change flag required to set acceptance gating

attrs.statement: Material Change is required to set acceptance gating.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 Material Change (line 170).

nodes.title: Locale must be a supported locale

attrs.statement: Locale must be a supported locale.
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 Locale (line 136), Screen 2 Locale (line 167: multiple locales can exist for a single version) and Screen 4A Locale (line 256). Locale is for translation only, not regional content (REQ-027-008).

nodes.title: Drafts autosave; warn on unsaved changes

attrs.statement: Autosave drafts; warn on unsaved changes before exit.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 business rules (line 176).

nodes.title: Effective date controls activation; content stays Draft until published

attrs.statement: Effective Date controls activation; content remains Draft until published.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 business rules (line 178).

nodes.title: Edit opens only Draft versions; Current and Archived are view-only, except adding a missing locale text to a Current version

attrs.statement: Edit opens only Draft versions; Scheduled, Current and Archived versions are view-only (preview/history), except that Admin may add a missing locale text to a Current version (REQ-027-037). Create draft from this version is offered on Current and Archived rows; View history filters the list to that document type.
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 business rules and Actions field: Edit is shown for Draft versions only.

nodes.title: Publish disabled until the draft passes validation

attrs.statement: Publish is disabled unless the draft passes validation, which is repeated at Publish; the preview shows the effective date and Material Change exactly as set in the draft, and the version diff summary must be generated from the draft; for the first version of a document type the summary reads Initial version and does not block Publish.
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 Actions (line 142), Screen 3 Effective Date, Material Change, Version Diff Summary and Publish Button (lines 197-200).

nodes.title: Editor limits: headings, lists, links, tables; block quotes disabled

attrs.statement: Editor supports toolbar for headings, lists, links, tables; allows paste with cleanup; block quotes disabled to avoid nesting signatures.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 notes (line 184).

nodes.title: Preview shows how many users must re-accept

attrs.statement: Preview & Publish shows an acceptance impact summary: the number of users who would be Pending under REQ-027-053 if the version became Current now.
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 notes (line 211). Computes ENT-legal-document.reaccept_user_count.

nodes.title: Acceptance Rate base is the users who must accept that document, computed from the ledger; Pending Users are those who must accept and have not

attrs.statement: For a version, the acceptance base is the Active patient accounts and the team members of Active providers, in that document type's audience (REQ-027-021), that existed when the version became Current. Accepted are the base members with a ledger row for this version or, for a restored version, for the version it was restored from; Pending are the rest of the base. An account that leaves Active leaves the base and is prompted at its next sign-in if it returns; an account created after the version became Current accepts at first run and is not in the base. Acceptance Rate is the accepted share of the base. Prompts, reminders, the Screen 3 re-accept count and the rate all use this Pending set; a user still required under REQ-027-035 is also prompted and reminded when the rate is not applicable. For the Cancellation Policy and any version with Material Change = No, rate and pending are shown as not applicable.
attrs.rationale: Owner default 80, restated with a snapshot base so that accepting does not remove a user from the base and an Archived version does not change as users accept newer ones. The ledger holds only acceptances, so the population needed a definition; one Pending set serves prompts, reminders, the Screen 3 count (REQ-027-052) and the rate.

nodes.title: Acceptance dashboard and detail data is read-only

attrs.statement: Acceptance dashboard and acceptance detail data is read-only.
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 business rules (line 234), Screen 4 Published/Eff. Dates, Material Change and Reminders Sent (lines 226-230) and Screen 4A Acceptance Timestamp, Channel and Reminder Status (lines 257-259).

nodes.title: CSV export of pending users and the filtered acceptance list, limited by role and rate

attrs.statement: Admin can export the pending users list and the current filtered acceptance set as CSV; export is constrained by role permissions and rate limits.
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 notes (line 239), Screen 4 Pending Users (line 229: supports pagination/export), Screen 4A Export (line 260) and business rules (line 266). The rate limit value is not stated.

nodes.title: Detail list mirrors dashboard filters and defaults to Pending

attrs.statement: Acceptance Detail List mirrors the filters from Screen 4, inherits the selected version and type, and defaults the status filter to Pending to focus on outstanding users.
attrs.rationale: Screen 4A Status Filter (line 255) and business rules (lines 264-265). Reached by drilldown from Pending Users or a View Details link (line 270); paginated and sortable by acceptance timestamp and user ID (line 271). Search and filter criteria are owned by FR-022 (REQ-022-111).

nodes.title: User filter input sanitized

attrs.statement: User filter input (name, email or user ID) is sanitized.
attrs.rationale: Screen 4A User Filter (line 254).

nodes.title: Acceptance prompt screen shared by the patient app and the provider portal

attrs.statement: The acceptance prompt MUST list each document that needs acceptance with its version and effective date, MUST enable Accept for a document only after its full text has been opened, MUST give one Accept per document, MUST show the fallback-language notice when REQ-027-036 applies, and MUST at sign-in offer Continue with limited access, sign-out and the FR-001 account-deletion link. At a gated action (REQ-027-033) it MUST be shown again with a blocked state until every listed document is accepted, and with an accepted state afterwards.
attrs.rationale: The user-facing half of the flow had no screen, so the acceptance steps could not be built or tested. One spec serves the patient app and the provider portal (REQ-027-012, REQ-027-015). The blocked state applies only at the gated actions, so a user who does not accept keeps the open features of REQ-027-033.

nodes.title: Admin edits the four legal settings in a panel on Screen 1; behaviour while a value is unset

attrs.statement: Admin MUST edit the acceptance rules, the coverage threshold (percent), the reminder limit (reminders per user per version) and the export limit (exports per Admin per day) in a Legal settings panel on Screen 1; each change is audited. While a value is unset there is no banner or alert (threshold), no reminders (reminder limit) and CSV export is blocked (export limit); while the acceptance rules are unset, a version with Material Change = Yes gates the fixed audience of its document type (REQ-027-021).
attrs.rationale: Owner default 77. The four values had no screen and no behaviour while unset, so the gating rule, the banner, the alert, the reminders and the export could not be built. Unset values switch the optional features off, and the acceptance rules fall back to the strictest reading so a material change is never silently ungated.

nodes.title: A Scheduled version is view-only, one per document type, and can be withdrawn to Draft

attrs.statement: A Scheduled version is view-only. There MUST be at most one Scheduled version per document type; a second Publish for the type is rejected until the Scheduled version is withdrawn or has gone live. Admin MAY withdraw a Scheduled version back to Draft; the withdrawal is audited.
attrs.rationale: Owner default 78. Scheduled could be entered but not left except by going live, so a wrong text could only wait to be published and then be restored. Withdrawal returns it to Draft before any user sees it.

nodes.title: Version-level attributes belong to the version; locale texts are children of it

attrs.statement: Version label, status, effective date, Material Change and change summary belong to the version, and each locale text is a child of the version. Version uniqueness and the one-Current rule apply per document type and version, never per locale.
attrs.rationale: Screens 1 and 2 give each row a locale and a version, so uniqueness and the one-Current rule were undetermined when two locales share a version. The graph entity fields are not restructured; this rule states the model.

nodes.title: First-run acceptance at registration and at invitation acceptance

attrs.statement: A new patient at registration and a new provider team member at invitation acceptance, including a new member of an Active clinic, MUST accept the Current Terms & Conditions and the Current Privacy Policy; a new patient is asked for the general consent at the first sign-in, and a provider team member is not (REQ-027-021). A Scheduled version is never shown or recorded before its effective date.
attrs.rationale: Owner default 81. The first-run entry points had no step and FR-001 records only the Terms checkbox. A new member of an Active clinic is at the clinic stage STG-provider-03-active, a clinic's first user at STG-provider-01-invited. Accounts created after a version became Current accept at first run and are not in the base (REQ-027-053).

nodes.title: Daily job sends reminders and checks coverage

attrs.statement: A daily system job MUST send each user in the Pending set (REQ-027-053) one reminder at most every 7 days, up to the reminder limit, and MUST evaluate the Acceptance Rate of the Current version of each document type daily from 14 days after it became Current, raising the coverage alert once per version while the rate is below the threshold; the Screen 1 banner uses the same start (REQ-027-024). reminders_sent_count is the count of the version's legal reminder records.
attrs.rationale: Owner default 85. Reminders and the coverage alert had no trigger, cadence or producer, and at publication the rate is 0 percent so the alert would have fired at once. The 14-day wait removes that, for the alert and the banner.

nodes.title: Admin creates regional groupings with name, countries and location order

attrs.statement: System MUST allow admins to create regional groupings by selecting group name, countries, and location presentation order
attrs.rationale: Restated by Main Flow step 2-7 (113-124) and Screen 1 (331-347).

nodes.title: Admin configures starting price per location per currency

attrs.statement: System MUST allow admins to configure starting price estimates per location per currency
attrs.rationale: Restated by Main Flow: Admin Configures Starting Prices Per Location (185-213) and Screen 2 (367-384).

nodes.title: Regional grouping applied to the patient destination list by the profile country

attrs.statement: System MUST apply regional grouping to the patient destination list by matching the patient's country in the profile (ENT-patient.country) to an active regional grouping; there is no IP geolocation
attrs.rationale: Patient Entry Point and Main Flow: Patient Views Personalized Location Recommendations steps 2 to 4. The patient screen is FR-003 Screen 2 (SCR-003-02). Overlaps REQ-003-032.

nodes.title: Starting price in the patient's currency; the lookup chain applies when it has none

attrs.statement: System MUST display starting prices in the patient's currency; where that currency has no price for the location, the lookup chain of REQ-028-040 applies
attrs.rationale: Main Flow: Patient Views Personalized Location Recommendations step 8 and A6. The chain is REQ-028-040. Overlaps REQ-003-033.

nodes.title: Configuration changes reach patient APIs within 1 minute by cache invalidation

attrs.statement: System MUST propagate configuration changes to patient-facing APIs within 1 minute via cache invalidation
attrs.rationale: Restated by Communication Structure (78), Entry Points (92), Main Flow step 10-11 (127-128), Screen 1 Cache Propagation (353), General Module Rule 4 (459: cache TTL = 60 seconds) and SC-009, SC-013. The system clears the location presentation cache on every save (step 10, A1 step 6, A2 step 4).

nodes.title: A country belongs to at most one active regional grouping, enforced at configuration time

attrs.statement: System MUST prevent overlapping active regional groupings by enforcing one-to-one mapping between country and active regional grouping at configuration time
attrs.rationale: General Module Rule 1, Main Flow step 4 and Screen 1 Unique Membership. Inactive groupings release their countries (REQ-028-029). The error text is REQ-028-021.

nodes.title: Fallback pricing chosen by the patient's country when the patient's currency is not configured

attrs.statement: System MUST support fallback pricing for locations when patient's specific currency is not configured; the fallback price is chosen by the patient's country
attrs.rationale: Restated by Screen 2 Fallback Priority (391: fallback prices apply when the patient's location-currency combination is not configured), A3 (217-228), A5 (306-314) and User Story 3 (694-706). Configuration steps are REQ-028-056.

nodes.title: Admin previews configuration before saving

attrs.statement: System MUST let admins preview configuration before saving (the Screen 1 preview pane for a grouping and the formatted amount on Screen 2 for a price); the Location Display Preview tab simulates saved configuration only
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 preview pane (Main Flow step 5), Screen 2 formatted amount (Main Flow: Starting Prices step 6) and Screen 3, which shows saved configuration only. User Story 5.

nodes.title: Regional grouping stored with name, country list, location order, destinations shown first and status

attrs.statement: System MUST store regional grouping configuration with grouping name, country list, location ordering, number of destinations shown first, and status (active/inactive)
attrs.rationale: Restated by Key Entities, Entity 1 (800-802) and Screen 1 data fields (337-347).

nodes.title: Starting price stored with location, currency, amount, dates, fallback flag and fallback patient country

attrs.statement: System MUST store starting price configuration with location, currency, amount, effective date, expiry date, fallback flag, and (for a fallback price) the patient country it applies to
attrs.rationale: Restated by Key Entities, Entity 2 (804-806) and Screen 2 data fields (373-384).

nodes.title: Regional configuration restricted to admins with the Manage App Data permission

attrs.statement: System MUST restrict regional configuration and pricing management to admin users with the FR-031 permission "Manage App Data", which guards both regional groupings and starting prices
attrs.rationale: Entry Points, Dependencies FR-031 and Security Considerations Authentication and Authorization (read-only roles cannot modify regional groupings or pricing).

nodes.title: Every configuration change logged with user id, timestamp, IP address, reason and details

attrs.statement: System MUST log all configuration changes with admin user ID, timestamp, IP address, change reason, and full change details for audit trail
attrs.rationale: Security Considerations Audit Trail (old value to new value). Includes the earlier audit trail rule REQ-028-011, merged here; it covers groupings, location ordering, starting prices, default currencies and the system-wide default price.

nodes.title: All admin inputs validated server-side

attrs.statement: System MUST validate all admin inputs server-side (country codes, currency codes, positive pricing amounts) to prevent invalid configurations
attrs.rationale: Restated by Security Considerations Input Validation (649).

nodes.title: Country selection uses the FR-026 country list

attrs.statement: System MUST integrate with FR-026 country list API for country selection in regional grouping configuration
attrs.rationale: Restated by Internal Dependencies FR-026 (542-544), Data Dependencies Entity 2 (572-574) and Integration 3 (630-633).

nodes.title: Currency validation and conversion rates come from FR-029

attrs.statement: System MUST integrate with FR-029 currency API for currency validation and conversion rate retrieval
attrs.rationale: Restated by Internal Dependencies FR-029 (554-556), Data Dependencies Entity 3 (576-578) and External Dependencies (564).

nodes.title: REST API gives patient apps location order and starting prices

attrs.statement: System MUST provide REST API for patient apps to fetch regional configuration (location ordering + starting prices) based on patient location and currency
attrs.rationale: Restated by Integration 1 (620-623).

nodes.title: Admin configuration API with role-based access control

attrs.statement: System MUST expose admin configuration API for CRUD operations on regional groupings and starting prices with role-based access control
attrs.rationale: Restated by Integration 2 (625-628) and Security Considerations Authorization (646).

nodes.title: Conflicting country assignment blocked with the conflicting groupings listed

attrs.statement: System MUST block selection or save of a country that already belongs to another active regional grouping and MUST show the error "Each country can only belong to one regional grouping. Remove it from the other grouping first." together with the list of conflicting groupings.
attrs.rationale: Main Flow step 4 (118), Screen 1 Unique Membership (351) and the first edge case (746). The no-overlap rule itself is REQ-028-006.

nodes.title: Grouping needs at least one country

attrs.statement: System MUST NOT save a regional grouping with no country selected and MUST show "At least one country must be selected for this regional grouping."
attrs.rationale: Main Flow step 4 and 8 (117, 125), B1 (156-163) and Screen 1 Countries validation (341).

nodes.title: Grouping needs at least one ordered destination

attrs.statement: System MUST NOT save a regional grouping without a destination order and MUST show "At least one destination must be ordered for this regional grouping."
attrs.rationale: B2 (165-172) and Screen 1 Location Order validation (342).

nodes.title: Every create, update and archive needs a change reason of 10-500 characters

attrs.statement: All create/update/archive actions require a change reason (10-500 chars). System MUST NOT save a regional grouping change or a price change without it and MUST show "Change reason is required (10-500 characters)."
attrs.rationale: General Module Rule 7 (462), Main Flow steps 6 and 8 (123, 125), A1 step 4 (140), A2 step 3 (151), B3 (174-181), pricing steps 7 and 9 (204, 210), A3 step 5 (225), A4 step 6 (239), B5 (262-269) and the Change Reason fields of Screen 1 and Screen 2 (344, 384).

nodes.title: Grouping name unique and at most 100 characters; description at most 500

attrs.statement: A regional grouping name is required, MUST be unique and at most 100 characters; the description is optional (internal purpose of the grouping) and at most 500 characters.
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 data fields Grouping Name and Description (339-340).

nodes.title: Editing an existing grouping follows the creation steps

attrs.statement: When an admin edits an existing regional grouping, System shows the current countries and location order, requires a change reason, and then validates, saves, clears the cache and confirms as for a new grouping; patients from the affected region see the updated order within 1 minute.
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow A1 (133-143).

nodes.title: Deleting a grouping warns, needs a reason and confirmation

attrs.statement: Before a regional grouping is deleted, System MUST warn "Deleting this grouping will affect patients from [X countries]. They will fall back to proximity-based destination ordering. Continue?" and the admin MUST enter a change reason and confirm.
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow A2 steps 2-3 (150-151).

nodes.title: Deleted groupings are archived, never permanently deleted

attrs.statement: Deleting a regional grouping MUST archive it (soft delete), never remove it permanently, so the audit trail stays complete; an archived grouping is an inactive grouping; System clears the cache and confirms "Regional grouping archived. Patients from affected countries will now see proximity-based destination ordering."
attrs.rationale: A2 steps 4-5 (152-154) and Screen 1 Soft Delete (355).

nodes.title: Inactive and archived groupings are one state, not applied, and release their countries

attrs.statement: Inactive and archived regional groupings are one state: retained in the system but not applied to patient location presentation, and their countries are released to other groupings. Switching a grouping back to Active re-runs the country check and the unique name check and is blocked with the error of REQ-028-021 while a country of the grouping sits in another active grouping, or while another active grouping has the same name (REQ-028-025).
attrs.rationale: General Module Rule 6, Screen 1 Status field and Alternative Flow A7.

nodes.title: At the 51st regional grouping the admin is warned and may continue

attrs.statement: At the 51st active regional grouping System warns the admin, who may continue; inactive and archived groupings do not count; the number 50 is fixed in the code.
attrs.rationale: General Module Rule 5, Admin Editability Fixed in Codebase and the Add step of the main grouping flow.

nodes.title: Cache timing, the proximity distance table and the grouping warning number are fixed in the codebase

attrs.statement: Cache propagation timing (1-minute TTL), the country-to-country distance table used for proximity ordering and the number of regional groupings that triggers the warning (50) are fixed in the codebase and not editable by admin.
attrs.rationale: Admin Editability, Fixed in Codebase. Decimal places are not fixed here; they come from the FR-029 currency catalogue (REQ-028-055).

nodes.title: Admin-editable items

attrs.statement: Admins can edit regional grouping names, countries and location ordering; starting price amounts for any location-currency combination; fallback pricing configuration per location; regional grouping active or inactive status; price effective and expiry dates; the number of destinations shown first per regional grouping; the default currency per destination location; and the system-wide default starting price.
attrs.rationale: Admin Editability, Editable by Admin (475-482). Per-item behaviour is in the rules of this module; Admin Platform scope (61-67).

nodes.title: Number of destinations shown first per grouping: default 10, range 5-20, the rest behind Show all destinations

attrs.statement: The number of destinations shown first is set per regional grouping by the admin (default 10, allowed range 5-20; any other value is refused with "Destinations shown first must be a whole number from 5 to 20."). It only decides how many destinations show first; the rest sit behind "Show all destinations". A patient with no matching grouping gets the default 10.
attrs.rationale: Admin Editability, Screen 1 field Locations Displayed and the display cap step of the patient flow. Stored on ENT-regional-grouping.locations_displayed.

nodes.title: No matching grouping: destinations ordered by proximity from a fixed distance table

attrs.statement: If no active regional grouping matches the patient's country (or the grouping was deleted or is inactive), System orders destinations by proximity of countries using a fixed country-to-country distance table kept in the product code and not editable by admin; the first 10 show first and the rest sit behind "Show all destinations".
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 Default Fallback, A5 steps 1 to 3, A2 outcome and the third edge case.

nodes.title: Configured order first; other locations after, by proximity to the patient's country

attrs.statement: System shows destinations in the matched grouping's configured order (first position first, second position second, and so on); locations not in the configured order appear at the end, ordered by proximity to the patient's country (REQ-028-035).
attrs.rationale: Main Flow: Patient Views Personalized Location Recommendations steps 5-6 (285-290) and Main Flow: Regional Presentation step 5 (119-121).

nodes.title: Destination list shows name, flag, starting price, description and provider count

attrs.statement: System displays each destination to the patient with the location name and flag, the starting price in the patient's currency ("Starting from £2,500"), a brief location description and the number of providers available in the location (0 when the country has no provider).
attrs.rationale: Main Flow: Patient Views Personalized Location Recommendations step 8 (297-301). The screen is FR-003 Screen 2 (SCR-003-02); the patient then selects destinations (step 9).

nodes.title: Patient currency from the profile, else the FR-029 system default currency

attrs.statement: System identifies the patient's currency from the patient profile preference, else from the FR-029 system default currency; it is one currency for the whole destination list, and the location default currency is used only as step 4 of the lookup chain (REQ-028-040).
attrs.rationale: Main Flow: Patient Views Personalized Location Recommendations step 8.

nodes.title: Starting price lookup follows the chain of REQ-028-040

attrs.statement: For each destination the patient sees, including destinations revealed behind Show all destinations, System looks up the starting price by the chain of REQ-028-040.
attrs.rationale: Main Flow: Patient Views Personalized Location Recommendations step 8. The chain is stated once in REQ-028-040.

nodes.title: Starting price lookup chain, always shown in the patient's currency

attrs.statement: System follows one lookup chain for the starting price of a displayed location, always shown in the patient's currency: (1) the price for the location in the patient's currency; (2) else the fallback price for the patient's country, where a fallback row already in the patient's currency is preferred and, when none is, the row in the location's default currency is used, else the row in the FR-029 system default currency, else the earliest created; (3) else the system-wide default starting price; (4) else the price in the location's default currency; (5) else "Price available on request" with an error logged for admin review (REQ-028-041). A price found in another currency at steps 2 to 4 is converted with the FR-029 conversion rate with markup and marked "approx." ("Starting from approx. £2,500"). A step whose price cannot be shown (no conversion rate, or no price row in that currency) passes to the next step, so "Price available on request" shows only when step 4 also fails.
attrs.rationale: A6 and the second edge case. This is the only statement of the chain; REQ-028-004, REQ-028-039, REQ-028-085 and REQ-028-087 point to it.

nodes.title: No price can be shown: Price available on request, error logged, banner on Screen 2

attrs.statement: When no step of the chain of REQ-028-040 can show a price (including the price in the location's default currency), System displays the location without a starting price, shows the text "Price available on request" to the patient and logs an error for admin review; Screen 2 shows the banner "[Location] missing fallback pricing - patients seeing no price estimate."
attrs.rationale: Sixth edge case (756).

nodes.title: Location ordering is advisory only

attrs.statement: Location ordering is strictly advisory for patient presentation - it does not restrict which locations patients can select or providers can serve.
attrs.rationale: General Module Rule 2 (457).

nodes.title: Starting prices are estimates and do not constrain provider quotes

attrs.statement: Starting prices are estimates only and do not constrain provider quote pricing. Providers can quote higher or lower than starting prices.
attrs.rationale: General Module Rule 3 (458) and Provider Platform scope (57: quote submission pricing is provider-controlled).

nodes.title: Patients only consume the configuration; providers have no interaction with it

attrs.statement: The Patient platform only consumes the admin-configured regional configuration and has no editing capability; the Provider platform has no direct interaction with regional configuration settings.
attrs.rationale: Multi-Tenant Breakdown, Patient Platform and Provider Platform (45-57).

nodes.title: Future phase: admin can enable or disable specific destinations for specific patient regions

attrs.statement: In a future phase, admins will be able to enable or disable specific destinations for specific patient regions.
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 66 (Future phase: Enable/disable specific destinations for specific patient regions). The PRD marks it a future phase and gives it no screen, field or flow.

nodes.title: The save confirmation is the on-screen message only

attrs.statement: The save confirmation of any configuration change (grouping, starting price, default currency or system-wide default) is the on-screen message only; System sends no separate notification.
attrs.rationale: Communication Structure, In Scope.

nodes.title: Out of scope: patient and provider notices and real-time exchange-rate pricing

attrs.statement: This module does not send patients notifications about pricing changes (general notification system), does not notify providers about regional configuration updates (providers are unaffected), and does not update prices in real time from exchange rates (FR-029).
attrs.rationale: Communication Structure, Out of Scope (80-84).

nodes.title: Pricing display only; no payment processing

attrs.statement: FR-028 configures pricing display only, not actual payment processing.
attrs.rationale: Business Rules, Payment & Billing Rules (497).

nodes.title: Entry points to regional configuration, pricing and preview

attrs.statement: Admin reaches the configuration at Settings > General Settings, on the Location Presentation by Country tab, the Location Pricing tab or the Location Display Preview tab, with the FR-031 permission "Manage App Data", and changes take effect on save within the 1-minute cache propagation. Patient reaches it through the "Choose Your Destination" screen of the quote request flow, where System reads the patient's country from the profile, applies the regional configuration to order the destinations, and shows starting prices in the patient's currency.
attrs.rationale: Entry Points; the PRD names the three tabs.

nodes.title: Save confirmation messages

attrs.statement: After a successful save System confirms: "Regional grouping saved. Changes will be live for patients within 1 minute." for a grouping; "Starting price for [Location] in [Currency] set to [Amount]." for a price; "Fallback pricing enabled for [Location]. Patients from [Country] without specific pricing will see these prices." for fallback pricing; "[X] currency prices updated for [Location]." for a bulk update; an on-screen success message for a location default currency and for the system-wide default starting price.
attrs.rationale: Main Flow step 11 (128) and 11 (212), A3 step 7 (227), A4 step 8 (241) and Screen 2 bulk modal banner (415).

nodes.title: Pricing view shows configured currencies and marks missing ones Not Set

attrs.statement: After the admin selects a destination, System shows the current pricing configuration for it: the currencies with configured starting prices, with currencies that have no configured price marked "Not Set".
attrs.rationale: Main Flow: Starting Prices step 2-3 (195-198).

nodes.title: Currency list read-only from FR-029; no inline currency creation

attrs.statement: The currency dropdown for starting prices is populated from the FR-029 supported currency list (Settings > Billing Settings > Currency Management); currencies are not created or edited on this screen, and currency support must be configured in FR-029 before location pricing can be configured.
attrs.rationale: Main Flow: Starting Prices step 1 (194), Screen 2 notes (407-408) and Admin Editability, Configurable with Restrictions (493).

nodes.title: Only supported currencies; unsupported currency refused with a pointer to Currency Management

attrs.statement: Only currencies configured in the system can be selected for a starting price; when the admin tries to save a price for an unsupported currency System shows "[Currency] is not currently supported. Add currency to system first via Currency Management." and does not save the price.
attrs.rationale: Main Flow: Starting Prices step 9 (207), B4 (253-260) and Screen 2 Currency Validation (388).

nodes.title: Starting price must be a positive number greater than 0

attrs.statement: A starting price MUST be a positive number greater than 0; for a non-numeric or negative value System shows "Starting price must be a positive number." and does not save it, and shows the format guidance "Enter base starting price (e.g., 2500 for £2,500)".
attrs.rationale: Main Flow: Starting Prices steps 6 and 9 (202-208), B3 (244-251) and Screen 2 Positive Values Only (390).

nodes.title: Decimal places follow the currency's minor units in the FR-029 catalogue

attrs.statement: System enforces the decimal places of the currency's minor units in the FR-029 currency catalogue (ENT-currency.minor_units) for every starting price, including fallback prices and bulk-updated prices.
attrs.rationale: Main Flow: Starting Prices step 10 and Screen 2 Decimal Precision.

nodes.title: Fallback pricing configuration

attrs.statement: To set fallback pricing the admin goes to Location Pricing > Fallback Pricing, selects the destination, enables the fallback pricing option, selects the patient country the fallback price applies to, enters the fallback price per currency and a change reason; System saves the fallback configuration.
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow A3 (217-228) and Screen 2 Fallback Price field (381). Application of fallback prices is REQ-028-007.

nodes.title: Bulk price update by percentage or fixed amount

attrs.statement: Admins can update all currency prices of one destination at once by a percentage increase or decrease or a fixed amount adjustment; System shows a preview of the new prices for all currencies, the admin enters a change reason and confirms, and System saves all currency price updates simultaneously. A bulk apply whose result would break the amount, decimals or currency checks (REQ-028-053 to REQ-028-055) is blocked.
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow A4 (230-242), Screen 2 Bulk Update (393) and User Story 4 (710-723).

nodes.title: Bulk update modal inputs

attrs.statement: The bulk update modal has a method selector (percentage increase or decrease, or fixed amount adjustment), an adjustment value input that is numeric and may be negative for a decrease, an optional rounding rule (round to the nearest 5, 10 or 50 of the currency unit), a preview table of current versus new prices per currency, and a required change reason logged in the audit trail.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 notes, Bulk Update modal (409-415).

nodes.title: Bulk update action visible on the pricing screen, enabled only with a destination or rows selected

attrs.statement: The Bulk Update Pricing action is visible on the pricing screen and enabled only when a destination is selected or at least one pricing row is checked; the bulk update modal (percentage or fixed adjustment, no CSV import or export) requires a change reason before apply.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 field Bulk Update Pricing (380) and notes (400).

nodes.title: A future effective date keeps the current price in use until then, as a new row

attrs.statement: If a price's effective date is in the future, the change is a new row (REQ-028-090) and the current pricing remains in use until the effective date; without an effective date pricing is effective immediately.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 Effective Dating (395) and field Price Effective Date (378).

nodes.title: Expiry date after effective date; banner on Screen 2 7 days before expiry

attrs.statement: A price expiry date, when set, MUST be after the effective date, and a banner on Screen 2 warns the admin 7 days before the price expiry date.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 field Price Expiry Date (379) and Expiry Warning (396).

nodes.title: Price without expiry stays active indefinitely

attrs.statement: When an effective date is set without an expiry date, the pricing remains active indefinitely until the admin updates it or sets an expiry; System shows the info note "No expiry set - pricing active indefinitely." in the pricing table and enforces no automatic expiration.
attrs.rationale: Seventh edge case. When a set expiry date has passed, the price stops showing and the next step of the lookup chain applies (REQ-028-087).

nodes.title: Price history is read from the configuration change audit log

attrs.statement: System keeps no separate price history; the history of all price changes for audit and trend analysis is read from the configuration change audit log (REQ-028-014) and shown in the read-only Change history panel of Screens 1 and 2.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 Price History (392). Retention periods are REQ-028-012 and REQ-028-064.

nodes.title: Pricing history and configuration audit logs retained 10 years

attrs.statement: Pricing history and configuration change audit logs are retained for 10 years (Constitution compliance).
attrs.rationale: Data & Privacy Retention Rule, which keeps pricing history and audit logs and points to the system PRD for the one 10-year retention period (REQ-SYS-002). The former 3-year pricing history Rule (REQ-028-012) is merged here.

nodes.title: Patient location for matching is stored in the patient profile under PHI encryption

attrs.statement: Patient location data used for regional matching is stored in the patient profile, which is already compliant with the PHI encryption requirements (Principle II).
attrs.rationale: Data & Privacy Privacy Rule 1 (466).

nodes.title: Starting price estimates are public data; no encryption required

attrs.statement: Starting price estimates are public data and are not subject to encryption requirements; regional configuration data (location display rules and public pricing estimates) is not sensitive.
attrs.rationale: Data & Privacy Privacy Rule 2 (467) and Security Considerations Data Protection (647).

nodes.title: Pricing history names the admin, never patient-level pricing

attrs.statement: Pricing history includes the admin user who made each change for accountability, but not patient-level pricing data.
attrs.rationale: Data & Privacy Privacy Rule 3 (468).

nodes.title: Patient location data follows FR-001 GDPR requirements

attrs.statement: Patient location data handling follows the existing GDPR requirements of FR-001, with no additional requirements.
attrs.rationale: Data & Privacy GDPR Compliance (471).

nodes.title: Preview updates immediately when patient location or currency changes

attrs.statement: The location display preview updates immediately when the admin selects a different patient location or currency.
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 Real-Time Preview (436) and User Story 5 scenarios 2-3 (738-739).

nodes.title: Preview shows which grouping and pricing rules were applied

attrs.statement: The preview shows which regional grouping and which pricing rules were applied for the simulated patient.
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 Applied Config Display (437) and field Applied Regional Grouping (431).

nodes.title: Preview highlights locations using fallback pricing

attrs.statement: Locations using fallback pricing are visually distinguished in the preview (for example italic text or an info icon with the tooltip "Using fallback pricing - AUD pricing not configured for this location").
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 Fallback Highlighting (438), field Fallback Indicators (432) and User Story 3 scenario 3 (706).

nodes.title: Preview warns when a location has no price for the preview currency

attrs.statement: If any location has no pricing for the preview currency, the preview displays a warning.
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 Missing Price Warning (439).

nodes.title: Preview shows the actual provider count per location

attrs.statement: The preview shows the number of available providers per location, using actual counts from the provider database.
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 Provider Count Display (440).

nodes.title: Admin can refresh the preview manually

attrs.statement: The admin can manually refresh the preview to see the latest data after configuration changes.
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 Refresh Button (441).

nodes.title: Preview inputs: a valid country and a currency defaulting to the FR-029 system default currency

attrs.statement: The preview requires a patient country that is valid in the system and a patient currency preference, which defaults to the FR-029 system default currency.
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 fields Preview Patient Location and Preview Currency (427-428).

nodes.title: Grouping screen aids: drag and drop, preview pane, flags, assigned countries marked

attrs.statement: The regional grouping screen provides a drag-and-drop interface for location ordering, a preview pane showing how patients from the selected countries will see the location list, country flags next to country names, and a disabled or visibly marked state (for example greyed out with the tooltip "Already assigned to [Grouping Name]") for countries already assigned to another grouping.
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 notes (359-362) and Main Flow step 5 (120-122).

nodes.title: Grouping screen bulk actions: duplicate, export, import from template

attrs.statement: The regional grouping screen provides bulk actions: duplicate grouping, export configuration, and import from template. A duplicated or imported grouping is a new grouping and MUST be saved only through the checks of a newly created grouping: one active grouping per country (REQ-028-021), unique name (REQ-028-025), the 51st-active-grouping warning (REQ-028-030) and a change reason (REQ-028-024).
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 notes (363).

nodes.title: Pricing table: locations as rows, currencies as columns, missing prices highlighted

attrs.statement: The pricing screen shows a table with locations as rows and currencies as columns, highlights cells without configured pricing in yellow, and shows the last updated timestamp and admin name on hover for each price.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 notes (401-403).

nodes.title: Exchange rate reference and price calculator for admins

attrs.statement: The pricing screen displays an exchange rate reference for admin guidance from the FR-029 currency service, and a calculator that suggests prices for other currencies from a price entered in one currency, based on exchange rates.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 notes (405-406).

nodes.title: Preview aids: side-by-side comparison, tooltips, cache status

attrs.statement: The preview screen lets the admin compare two patient locations side by side, shows a tooltip explaining why a location is in its position (the regional grouping rule), and shows a cache status indicator with the time patient-facing data was last refreshed.
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 notes.

nodes.title: Concurrent edits: a stale-edit warning before overwriting

attrs.statement: When another admin saved the same regional grouping (including a status change or archive), price row (including a fallback price row), destination default currency or system-wide default starting price since this admin opened it (or since the bulk update preview), System warns "This [grouping, price or default] was modified by [Admin Name] at [Time]. Your changes will overwrite theirs. Continue?" and saves only when the admin confirms.
attrs.rationale: Fourth edge case, A1 step 5, Main Flow: Starting Prices step 9 and A4 step 7.

nodes.title: A country deactivated in FR-026 is flagged on the grouping edit screen; nothing is forced

attrs.statement: When a country is deactivated in FR-026, regional groupings and price rows that reference it keep applying, and the grouping edit screen warns "[Country] is deactivated. Remove from ordering?"; nothing is forced, and an existing grouping or row of a deactivated country can still be saved (REQ-028-092). FR-026 also warns the admin before the deactivation and lists the groupings and price rows that use the country (REQ-026-129).
attrs.rationale: Edge case on a country deactivated in FR-026. FR-026 deactivates countries and never removes them.

nodes.title: Deleted grouping: cached sessions served up to 60 seconds, then default ordering, no errors

attrs.statement: When a regional grouping is deleted while patients are viewing destinations, cached data serves existing sessions for up to 60 seconds; after cache expiry patients see the default location ordering, with no errors displayed to patients.
attrs.rationale: Third edge case (750).

nodes.title: Configuration unavailable: default ordering and Price available on request

attrs.statement: If the regional configuration is unavailable, System falls back to default location ordering and shows "Price available on request" (REQ-028-041).
attrs.rationale: Integration 1 error handling (623).

nodes.title: A destination is a country from the FR-026 active country list

attrs.statement: The destination chosen for a starting price, and each destination in a grouping's location order, MUST be a country from the FR-026 active country list when it is newly selected (an existing grouping or row of a deactivated country keeps applying, REQ-028-092), the same key as the inquiry treatment countries (ENT-inquiry.treatment_countries). Every active FR-026 country is listed to patients as a destination, with a provider count of 0 where it has no provider.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 field Destination Location and Main Flow step 5 of the grouping flow.

nodes.title: Price stops showing after its expiry date; the next step of the lookup chain shows

attrs.statement: After a starting price's expiry date has passed, patients MUST no longer see that price; the next step of the lookup chain (REQ-028-040) applies. Prices with no expiry date stay active until an admin changes them
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 Price Expiry business rule and Functional Requirements Summary. Prices with no expiry date are REQ-028-062.

nodes.title: System-wide default starting price, set on the pricing screen, empty at launch

attrs.statement: System MUST provide one system-wide default starting price, stored with its amount and currency, set by admins on the pricing screen; it is empty until an admin sets it
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 field System-Wide Default Starting Price and Functional Requirements Summary. Where it sits in the price lookup is REQ-028-039 and REQ-028-040.

nodes.title: Default currency set per destination location, stored once per destination

attrs.statement: System MUST let admins set a default currency for each destination location; it is stored once per destination, not on each price row
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 field Location Default Currency and Functional Requirements Summary. The converted price that uses it is REQ-028-040.

nodes.title: A future-dated price change is a new dated row; rows may not overlap; the lookup uses the row whose window contains today

attrs.statement: A future-dated price change MUST be saved as a new row for the same destination and currency; the lookup picks the row whose window contains the current day, dates are UTC and the expiry day is included, and price history is read from the configuration change audit log. Rows for the same destination and currency (and patient country on a fallback row) MUST NOT overlap in dates: a new dated row ends the previous open row the day before its effective date, and a bulk update changes the row current today
attrs.rationale: Main Flow: Starting Prices step 7 and Screen 2 Effective Dating. Effective and expiry date rules are REQ-028-060 to REQ-028-062.

nodes.title: A grouping with an assigned Stripe account cannot be set inactive, archived or lose a country

attrs.statement: Setting a regional grouping Inactive, archiving it, or removing a country from it, MUST be blocked while a Stripe account is assigned to the grouping (FR-029), and the screen names the account
attrs.rationale: General Module Rule 8 and Dependencies FR-029. The account assignment itself is owned by FR-029.

nodes.title: A deactivated country keeps applying in groupings and starting prices until an admin edits them

attrs.statement: A country deactivated in FR-026 MUST keep applying in regional groupings and starting prices (destination rows and fallback rows) until an admin edits them; the active check runs only when a country is newly selected, so an existing grouping or row of a deactivated country can still be saved, for example to set an expiry date; FR-026 warns before the deactivation and lists the regional groupings and fallback price rows that use the country (REQ-026-129)
attrs.rationale: General Module Rule 9 and Dependencies FR-026.

nodes.title: A currency disabled in FR-029 leaves existing prices and defaults as stored

attrs.statement: A currency disabled in FR-029 MUST NOT change existing configuration: starting price rows (destination and fallback rows), a destination default currency and the system-wide default starting price keep their stored currency and keep applying in the lookup chain of REQ-028-040 until an admin edits them (REQ-029-125); the supported-currency check of REQ-028-053 applies when a currency is newly selected; FR-029 warns before the disable when location starting prices use the currency (REQ-029-124)

nodes.title: Allow admins to add, edit, and manage multiple Stripe accounts with API credentials

attrs.statement: System MUST allow admins to add, edit, and manage multiple Stripe accounts with API credentials (publishable key, secret key, webhook secret)
attrs.rationale: Also stated by the Add Stripe Account flow and Screen 1.

nodes.title: Allow admins to assign Stripe accounts to specific countries or regional groupings

attrs.statement: System MUST allow admins to assign Stripe accounts to specific countries or regional groupings (multi-select assignment)

nodes.title: Validate Stripe API credentials by testing connection to Stripe API before activating...

attrs.statement: System MUST validate Stripe API credentials by testing connection to Stripe API before activating account
attrs.rationale: Restates Screen 1 rule on credential validation and the Add Stripe Account flow step 5.

nodes.title: Route payment transactions to appropriate Stripe account based on patient's country...

attrs.statement: System MUST route payment transactions to the appropriate Stripe account based on the country on the patient's profile (not the patient's current physical location), and a booking MUST keep the account that took its first payment for every later charge and refund
attrs.rationale: FR-029 PRD, Payment Rule 1 and the no-Stripe-account edge case: the profile country decides the Stripe account.

nodes.title: Support multiple currencies per Stripe account and allow admins to configure supported...

attrs.statement: System MUST support multiple currencies per Stripe account and allow admins to configure supported currencies
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 1195 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Allow admins to manage rate sources

attrs.statement: System MUST allow admins to manage rate sources (add, edit, delete) where each source bundles a provider type (xe.com, fixer.io) with its API credentials. Source creation requires a successful test connection before saving. Source deletion is blocked if currency pairs reference it; admin must reassign or convert affected pairs first.
attrs.rationale: Deletion of a referenced source is contradicted inside the PRD; see product owner decision.

nodes.title: Allow admins to set a global default markup percentage

attrs.statement: System MUST allow admins to set a global default markup percentage (0-20% range) and optionally override it per currency pair (0-20% range). If a pair has no per-pair markup, the global default applies.
attrs.rationale: Restated by REQ-029-038 (validation) and Screen 2A, 2B.

nodes.title: Fetch currency conversion rates automatically for each auto-fetch pair on its...

attrs.statement: System MUST fetch currency conversion rates automatically for each auto-fetch pair on its configured sync schedule (per-pair or inherited global frequency). Manual-mode pairs are not synced.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 1200 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Calculate and display the effective rate for each pair as

attrs.statement: System MUST calculate and display the effective rate for each pair as: Base Rate × (1 + Markup %). This effective rate is applied to patient-facing prices.
attrs.rationale: Calculates the effective rate of a pair.

nodes.title: Allow admins to configure a global rate protection threshold

attrs.statement: System MUST allow admins to configure a global rate protection threshold (1-50% range). System monitors each auto-fetch pair independently and marks the pair's status as yellow/warning and sends an alert notification when the pair's rate differs from its rate 24 hours earlier by more than the threshold. The warning clears only when an admin acknowledges it. After an acknowledgement the pair is compared with the rate at that moment until the change against the rate 24 hours earlier is again within the threshold, and no comparison runs for 24 hours after a pair is created or switched between modes
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 1202 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Require a successful "Test Connection & Fetch Rate" action before saving any new...

attrs.statement: System MUST require a successful "Test Connection & Fetch Rate" action before saving any new auto-fetch currency pair. The Save button is disabled until this test succeeds.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 1203 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Gracefully handle per-pair rate source failures by keeping the last successfully...

attrs.statement: System MUST gracefully handle per-pair rate source failures by keeping the last successfully fetched rate, marking the pair's status as red/error on the pair list, and alerting admin. Deleting a rate source MUST be blocked while any pair still references it; the admin must first reassign those pairs to another source or convert them to manual mode (with the last fetched rate pre-filled), and no pair switches to manual mode automatically.
attrs.rationale: FR-029 PRD, REQ-029-012 and Screen 2B: deleting a source is blocked while pairs use it; no automatic switch to manual mode.

nodes.title: Allow admins to configure deposit rate percentage

attrs.statement: System MUST allow admins to configure deposit rate percentage (20-30% range) globally for all providers

nodes.title: Allow admins to configure provider-specific deposit rates that override global default...

attrs.statement: System MUST allow admins to configure provider-specific deposit rates that override global default for selected providers

nodes.title: Apply deposit rate changes to new bookings only

attrs.statement: System MUST apply deposit rate changes to new bookings only (existing bookings retain original deposit rate). Once a booking has been confirmed, its installment settings are locked: later changes to installment configuration never alter that booking
attrs.rationale: Restated by Screen 3 and Screen 4 rules.

nodes.title: Calculate deposit amount by multiplying booking total by configured deposit rate...

attrs.statement: System MUST calculate deposit amount by multiplying booking total by configured deposit rate percentage
attrs.rationale: Restated by Payment Rule 4 (rounded to 2 decimal places).

nodes.title: Allow admins to enable or disable split payment

attrs.statement: System MUST allow admins to enable or disable split payment (installment) feature globally. The split payment configuration is one global record: there are no tiers and no separate installment plan by booking amount or by region

nodes.title: Allow admins to select available installment options

attrs.statement: System MUST allow admins to select available installment options (2-9 installments) via multi-select checkboxes

nodes.title: Allow admins to configure cutoff days

attrs.statement: System MUST allow admins to configure cutoff days (30-90 day range): the last installment is due on or before the cutoff date
attrs.rationale: The PRD gives a default of 30 days (Screen 4).

nodes.title: Allow admins to configure minimum booking amount

attrs.statement: System MUST allow admins to configure minimum booking amount ($100-$10,000 range) required to qualify for installments
attrs.rationale: Stated in USD; see product owner decision on the currency of the minimum.

nodes.title: Automatically calculate available installment options based on booking date, procedure...

attrs.statement: System MUST automatically calculate available installment options based on booking date, procedure date, and cutoff days, with a minimum lead time of cutoff + 30 days, and MUST show the minimum lead time on the configuration screen
attrs.rationale: Restated by Payment Rule 5 and Screen 4.

nodes.title: Generate installment payment schedules using equal-split amounts

attrs.statement: System MUST generate installment payment schedules using equal-split amounts: booking total ÷ installment count (rounded to each currency's own minor units; last installment absorbs rounding difference)
attrs.rationale: Restated by Billing Rule 1 and Screen 4. Rounding follows each currency's own minor units.

nodes.title: Allow admins to configure late payment grace period

attrs.statement: System MUST allow admins to configure the late payment grace period (0-14 days, starting at 0), counted from the installment due date. The late fee is charged once, after the grace period and the automatic retries have ended

nodes.title: Persist all payment configuration data

nodes.title: Lock currency conversion rates

nodes.title: Snapshot the effective commission model and value

attrs.rationale: Indicative commission also stated by the Indicative Commission Rule. The FR-004 quote screen is owned by FR-004.

nodes.title: Block disabling a currency while any non-terminal sent quote, unpaid accepted booking,...

nodes.title: Create a new FR-026 Quote Configuration version whenever the Default Currency changes

nodes.title: Calculate commission on the price after promotion for every discount type, including...

attrs.statement: System MUST calculate commission on the accepted price after the promotion, in the quote currency and read from the acceptance snapshot, for every discount type, including discounts funded only by Hairline; no program keeps commission on the price before the promotion.

nodes.title: Global Fallback account covers unmapped countries and a failing mapped account

nodes.title: Allow admins to set a global default sync frequency

nodes.title: A currency with no pair is collected in USD from the locked rate set

The alert is sent once per country per day, however many patients try. A patient whose profile has no country is asked to add one before payment, with no alert.

nodes.title: Stripe authentication failure after configuration

attrs.statement: How to manage admin accidentally entering incorrect Stripe secret key that initially validates but later fails during actual payment processing? During configuration, system validates Stripe credentials by making test API call to Stripe. If credentials are syntactically correct but have insufficient permissions or are later revoked by Stripe, first payment attempt will fail. Payment Processing Service logs error: "Stripe authentication failed for account [name]." System sends urgent alert to admin: "Stripe account [name] failed authentication. Verify API keys are active and have required permissions." System temporarily routes new bookings to Global Fallback (if configured) and displays error banner to admin; a booking already taken on the failing account keeps that account and its charges are retried once the keys are fixed. Routing returns to the account when its next Test Connection passes; if the failing account is the Global Fallback itself, or no fallback exists, payment is blocked with the Boundary Flow B6 error and alert.
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1182: payments are temporarily routed to the Global Fallback when configured.

nodes.title: Stripe API unavailable queues payments

nodes.title: Pair status badge definitions

attrs.statement: Status badges update automatically: green when last fetch succeeded and rate change is within threshold; yellow when the last sync breached the rate protection threshold or the source is degraded; red when last fetch failed or source is down. A yellow rate-protection badge clears only when an admin clicks "Acknowledge" on the pair; a later normal sync does not clear it, and after the acknowledgement the badge returns only if the rate moves above the threshold from the acknowledged rate. A yellow badge caused by a degraded source clears when the source is healthy again.
attrs.rationale: Status of a pair is calculated by this rule. A yellow badge returns to green on the next normal sync; there is no acknowledge action.

nodes.title: Each pair tracks its own status

attrs.statement: Each pair independently tracks its own status. A source failure affects only pairs using that source; manual pairs are unaffected.

nodes.title: Deleting a referenced rate source is blocked

Manual → Auto: System requires admin to select a source and run "Test Connection & Fetch Rate" before saving. The fetched rate replaces the manual rate.
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 548-549 (checked against the PRD text).

nodes.title: Effective rate preview updates live

nodes.title: Failed sync retries with backoff and alerts

attrs.statement: System retries sync after exponential backoff (e.g., retry in 15 minutes, then 30 minutes, then 1 hour)
attrs.rationale: Part of the failed-sync alternative flow (B2). The source status also turns red when the source stays down.

nodes.title: Rate protection breach handling

attrs.statement: System detects the USD/EUR rate changed by 4.5% in the last 24 hours (exceeds the 3% global threshold) Admin decides to increase the per-pair markup from 5% to 7% to protect against the unfavorable rate
attrs.rationale: Breach alternative flow (B5): yellow status, urgent alert, admin reviews and adjusts the per-pair markup.

nodes.title: One rate alert per pair per six hours

attrs.statement: How does system handle rapid currency fluctuation exceeding rate protection threshold multiple times in single day for one pair (e.g., USD/EUR changes 3% at 8am, another 3% at 2pm, another 3% at 8pm)? System compares each sync with the pair's rate 24 hours earlier. It sends the first alert at 8am when the 3% threshold is crossed and marks the pair's status as yellow/warning on the pair list. System applies rate-limiting to alerts (maximum one alert per currency pair per 6 hours) to prevent alert fatigue, and sends the second alert at 2pm showing the change against the rate 24 hours earlier: "USD/EUR changed 6% in 24 hours." The yellow badge stays until an admin clicks Acknowledge; a later normal sync does not clear it. After the acknowledgement the pair is compared with the rate at that moment until the change against the rate 24 hours earlier is again within the threshold. Admin receives summary of all rate changes across all pairs in daily digest email.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 1178 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Daily digest of source outages

attrs.statement: How does system handle a rate source being completely unavailable for 24+ hours? For each auto-fetch pair using the affected source: system continues using the pair's last successfully cached rate, marks the pair's status as red/error on the pair list (Screen 2A), and marks the source's status as red in the Sources section. System sends daily email digest to admin summarizing the source outage and listing all affected pairs. When the source recovers, the next scheduled sync for each affected pair fetches the latest rate and restores green status. Admin can also switch affected pairs to a different source or manual mode at any time during the outage.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 1170 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Rate history of 30 days
