nodes.title: Booking total definition

attrs.statement: Booking Total Rule: Throughout this FR, "booking total" means the accepted subquote price after any promotion, in the quote currency, read from the FR-005 acceptance snapshot. The same rule applies to every discount type, including discounts funded only by Hairline: commission is always calculated on the price after promotion. It is never recomputed from the live quote, option, or date-range price. This single figure is the base for the Percentage commission, the deposit amount, and the installment split; any display or charge in another currency uses the rate set locked under Currency Rule 2. (REQ-029-100)
attrs.rationale: Same rule applies to every discount type, including discounts funded only by Hairline (see REQ-029-054).

nodes.title: Configuration locks only at named lock points

attrs.statement: Rule 1: Payment configuration changes never alter a value that has already been locked. Each configuration is locked at a named point: (a) the currency conversion rate set (base rates and markups, each with its timestamp) is locked when the patient accepts a subquote in FR-005 and is stored in the acceptance snapshot (Currency Rule 2); (b) the effective commission configuration, the deposit rate, and the split payment (installment) settings are locked at FR-006 booking confirmation and stored with the booking; (c) no payment configuration is frozen when a parent quote or subquote is created or sent in FR-004; (d) the refund ladder, the rescheduling fee, the late payment fee (a fixed amount together with its currency code; Not set stays Not set), the late payment grace period, the balance due days (kept as a balance due date stored on the booking), the unpaid balance cancellation point and the installment cutoff are locked at FR-006 booking confirmation, while Hairline's share of a patient cancellation fee, the clinic cancellation deduction and the patient confirmation window are read on the day the event happens and are not locked; (e) the Stripe account that takes a booking's first payment is stored with the booking and used for every later charge and refund of that booking; (f) a locked rate set survives the deletion of any of its currency pairs. Before its lock point, a quote or accepted-but-unconfirmed subquote follows the configuration that is effective at that moment, and an active installment plan keeps the settings locked at its booking confirmation. When FR-019 expresses a fixed-amount promotion in the quote currency at quote send, it uses the currency conversion rate (including markup) in effect at send; this sets the promotion amount on the quote only and does not lock the conversion rate for payment, which stays locked at acceptance under (a). (REQ-029-101)
attrs.rationale: Restated by REQ-029-049 (near duplicate). The lock point for the commission is booking confirmation in FR-006.

nodes.title: Use last known good configuration when unavailable

attrs.statement: Rule 4: System must gracefully handle payment processing when configuration data is unavailable (use last known good configuration, alert the admin, and retry with exponential backoff)
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 766 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Markup applies to all conversions

attrs.statement: Payment Rule 3: Currency conversion markup applies to all transactions involving currency conversion, including the USD fallback charge (protects against bank rate differences). A price shown in a currency that is neither the quote currency nor USD is derived via USD with the markup applied once, on the pair for the shown currency (REQ-029-103)
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 820 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Prices shown in the patient's selected currency

attrs.statement: Currency Rule 1: Prices always displayed to patients in their selected currency using admin-configured conversion rates with markup; a price in a currency that is neither the quote currency nor USD goes via USD with the markup applied once
attrs.rationale: Display in the selected currency uses the admin-configured conversion rates with markup.

nodes.title: A missed installment brings reminders, retries and an admin flag; the cancellation point cancels an unpaid booking

attrs.statement: Payment Rule 6: A missed installment is followed by reminders and automatic payment retries (timing owned by FR-007B); when the retries have failed, an admin is flagged to follow up. The late payment fee is charged once, after the grace period and the retries have ended (Late Fee Rule). A booking whose balance is still unpaid at the unpaid balance cancellation point (Screen 7, counted in days after the oldest unpaid due date) is cancelled: this wins over pending retries and the Defaulted state, covers any unpaid balance (deposit and balance, or installments), applies only to bookings confirmed after the point was set, and does nothing while the point is not set (REQ-029-105)
attrs.rationale: FR-029 PRD, Payment Rule 6.

nodes.title: No installment option is offered below cutoff plus 30 days

attrs.statement: What happens when a patient books 35 days before the procedure with a 30-day cutoff enabled? The installment schedule starts on the booking day and then falls due every 30 days, so 2 installments need at least 60 days (cutoff + 30) and none fits at 35 days. No installment option is offered; the patient sees the other payment options (pay in full now, or deposit now and balance later) and no message offers installments. The same booking would be offered installments only from 60 days out (2 installments), 90 days (3), and so on.
attrs.rationale: PRD line 1176: the patient must select fewer installments or pay deposit plus the remaining balance immediately.

nodes.title: Minimum 30-day cutoff

attrs.statement: System enforces a minimum 30-day cutoff before procedure date (per system booking/payment rules); admins may increase the cutoff up to 90 days
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 626 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Fewer installments offered when time is short

attrs.statement: If time between booking and procedure is insufficient for an installment count given the cutoff, that count is not offered; if even 2 installments do not fit, the patient sees the other payment options only
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 619 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Refunds follow the refund ladder

attrs.statement: Refund Rule: Refunds on a cancelled booking follow the refund ladder set on Screen 7 and locked at booking confirmation: the refund percentage depends on how many days before the procedure date the booking is cancelled. The launch default is more than 30 days, 90 percent; 15 to 30 days, 50 percent; under 15 days, 0 percent. It is one global setting that FR-006, FR-007, FR-007B and FR-017 read; each provider's own cancellation terms do not replace it. The refund is that percentage of the amount the patient has paid so far, excluding late fees (FR-007B REQ-007B-022; FR-006 and FR-007 compute it)
attrs.rationale: FR-029 PRD, Refund Rule; the ladder itself is REQ-029-142.

nodes.title: Values fixed in code

attrs.statement: Deposit rate allowed range (20-30% hard-coded business rule) Split payment installment range (2-9 installments hard-coded limit) Cutoff days allowed range (30-90 days hard-coded limits) Installment frequency (monthly; 30-day intervals) Payment audit logging requirements (always enabled, cannot be disabled)
attrs.rationale: Fixed values, not admin-editable (PRD Admin Editability Rules).

nodes.title: Provider commission scope takes precedence

attrs.statement: Provider-specific commission scopes take precedence over the global default at booking confirmation
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 661 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Commission scope covers one or more providers and can be archived

attrs.statement: A provider-specific commission scope may cover one or multiple providers and may be archived when no longer needed
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 664 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Single-provider commission edit from FR-015 splits the scope

attrs.statement: Single-provider edit from FR-015: When an admin edits commission in FR-015 Tab 7 for a provider covered by a scope shared with other providers, the system removes that provider from the shared scope and creates a single-provider scope for it with the new values; the shared scope and its other providers are unchanged. The split is audit-logged with before/after state.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 666 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: One pending future-dated commission configuration per provider

attrs.statement: Scheduled configuration: Each provider has at most one pending future-dated configuration. Saving another future-dated configuration for the same provider replaces the pending one (logged); on its Effective Date the pending configuration becomes the active one automatically. Screen 5 and FR-015 Tab 7 show the same pending configuration, which FR-032 Screen 4 displays read-only to the provider.
attrs.rationale: Same statement as REQ-029-048 second half (near duplicate).

nodes.title: Provider eligibility for a commission scope

attrs.statement: System validates selected providers have status Active or Suspended (Deactivated providers cannot be selected; their existing scopes are read-only) and the commission value matches the selected model: Percentage 0-100% (0.1% precision); Flat Rate amount > 0 in an enabled currency
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 197 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Percentage commission formula

attrs.statement: Percentage model (global default or provider scope): commission amount = booking total (the accepted subquote price after promotion, in the quote currency, from the acceptance snapshot) × snapshotted commission percentage (rounded to the quote currency's own minor units; last payment absorbs rounding difference if needed)
attrs.rationale: Part of the commission calculation; see REQ-029-050 for the booking total. Rounding follows the quote currency's minor units.

nodes.title: Flat Rate commission formula

attrs.statement: Flat Rate model (provider scope only): commission amount = the snapshotted fixed amount, deducted once per completed procedure (FR-010 completion milestone), regardless of procedure price; it is not charged per package, per Subquote, or per installment
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 670 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Flat Rate amount kept in its configured currency

attrs.statement: Flat Rate amounts are stored and snapshotted in their configured currency; this screen introduces no new currency conversion rule, and any conversion follows the existing FR-029 currency configuration and downstream FR-017 reconciliation handling
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 671 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Global commission is percentage only

attrs.statement: The global default is percentage-only; the Flat Rate model is available for provider-specific scopes only
attrs.rationale: Restated by REQ-029-043.

nodes.title: Currency codes are immutable

attrs.statement: Currency codes are immutable and come from a system-maintained catalog; admins cannot add non-ISO or custom codes.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 701 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: One default currency and at least one enabled

attrs.statement: At least one currency must remain enabled at all times. Exactly one enabled currency must be set as the system default.
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 702-703 (checked against the PRD text).

nodes.title: Disabling a referenced currency warns with a resolution path

attrs.statement: If an admin attempts to disable a currency referenced only by configuration items (e.g., used in Stripe account supported currencies, location starting prices, or active pricing configs), the system MUST warn and provide a safe resolution path (e.g., update dependent configs first) before allowing the disable. A currency still used by quotes, bookings or instalment plans is not a warning case: it is blocked by the rule below.
attrs.rationale: Overlaps REQ-029-052 (blocked while in use). The warning covers configuration items only; records in use are blocked by REQ-029-052.

nodes.title: Currency enable and disable affects new choices only

attrs.statement: Enabling/disabling currencies affects new configuration choices immediately; existing records retain their stored currency codes.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 705 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Currency management is the source of truth for dropdowns

attrs.statement: This screen is the source of truth for currency dropdowns across Admin/Provider/Patient experiences (where applicable). FR-017 Screen 1 ("Financial Reporting - Revenue Dashboard") initializes its reporting currency selector from this system default currency; the MVP seed value is USD unless an admin changes it later.
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 712-713 (checked against the PRD text).

nodes.title: Email service failure handling

attrs.statement: Failure handling: If email service unavailable, log notification failures and display in-app notification to admin, retry with queue
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 943 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: A cutoff above 60 days shows a warning

attrs.statement: What occurs if admin configures a high cutoff (e.g., 90 days)? Screen 4 shows the minimum lead time at all times (cutoff + 30 days, here 120 days) and, because the cutoff is above 60 days, displays warning: "With a cutoff of [90 days], only bookings made [120] or more days before the procedure can use installments." Admin can choose to proceed or adjust to a lower value (e.g., 30 days). System logs warning to admin activity log.
attrs.rationale: Overlaps REQ-029-042. The admin may proceed and a warning is logged to the admin activity log.

nodes.title: Revived booking resolves commission, deposit and split settings at the later confirmation

attrs.statement: When the revived booking is confirmed, commission, deposit rate, and split payment settings are resolved from the configuration effective at that confirmation, and the currency conversion rate stays the one locked in the original acceptance snapshot, because a revive keeps the original acceptance unchanged. If the patient instead starts a new inquiry, that inquiry's own acceptance locks its own rate.
attrs.rationale: Edge Cases, accepted subquote reaches Payment Window Expired and is revived (PRD line 1160)

nodes.title: Stripe Account Name validation

attrs.statement: Max 100 chars, must be unique
attrs.rationale: Screen 1, Account Name, Validation Rules column (PRD line 395)

nodes.title: Stripe Publishable Key validation

attrs.statement: Must start with "pk_test_" or "pk_live_", max 200 chars
attrs.rationale: Screen 1, Publishable Key, Validation Rules column (PRD line 385)

nodes.title: Stripe Secret Key validation

attrs.statement: Must start with "sk_test_" or "sk_live_", max 200 chars
attrs.rationale: Screen 1, Secret Key, Validation Rules column (PRD line 385)

nodes.title: Stripe Webhook Secret validation

attrs.statement: Min 32 chars, max 200 chars
attrs.rationale: Screen 1, Webhook Secret, Validation Rules column (PRD line 398)

nodes.title: Stripe Default Currency validation

attrs.statement: Must be one of selected supported currencies
attrs.rationale: Screen 1, Default Currency, Validation Rules column (PRD line 391)

nodes.title: Manual Base Rate validation

attrs.statement: Required if Rate Mode = Manual. Must be > 0, decimal precision: 6 digits.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2B, Manual Base Rate, Validation Rules column (PRD line 520)

nodes.title: Flat Rate Currency validation

attrs.statement: Required for Flat Rate; must be an enabled currency from Screen 6; defaults to the system default currency
attrs.rationale: Screen 5, Flat Rate Currency, Validation Rules column (PRD line 653)

nodes.title: Commission Effective Date validation

attrs.statement: Today or future date
attrs.rationale: Screen 5, Effective Date, Validation Rules column (PRD line 654)

nodes.title: Global Fallback account conditions

attrs.statement: If enabled: Assigned Countries must be empty, Account Status must be Active and Account Mode must be Live on a production deployment and Test elsewhere. The flag must be moved to another account before this account can be set Inactive or Archived.
attrs.rationale: Screen 1, Global Fallback, Validation Rules column (PRD line 388)

nodes.title: Booking total compared with the installment minimum in USD

attrs.statement: System MUST compare the booking total with the Minimum Booking Amount for installments in USD: a booking total in another currency is converted to USD with the quote-to-USD base rate in the rate set locked at FR-005 subquote acceptance, without markup, before the comparison.
attrs.rationale: FR-029 PRD, Minimum Booking Conversion Rule; Screen 4.

nodes.title: Admins enable or disable payment methods per region and currency

attrs.statement: System MUST allow admins to enable or disable the payment methods offered to patients, per region and currency (Screen 1), and FR-007 offers a patient only the methods enabled for the patient's region and the charge currency (USD when the USD fallback applies, checked after the fallback); FR-007 reads this setting, and FR-007B owns the payment-method records.
attrs.rationale: FR-029 PRD, Screen 1 Enabled Payment Methods.

nodes.title: Admins edit the refund ladder, locked at confirmation

attrs.statement: System MUST allow admins to edit the refund ladder (refund percentage by how many days before the procedure date the booking is cancelled) on Screen 7. The launch default is: more than 30 days, 90 percent; 15 to 30 days, 50 percent; under 15 days, 0 percent. The ladder is locked at booking confirmation. FR-006, FR-007, FR-007B and FR-017 read this setting.
attrs.rationale: FR-029 PRD, Screen 7 Refund Ladder; Refund Rule.

nodes.title: Admins set the late payment fee and the rescheduling fee, locked at confirmation

attrs.statement: System MUST allow admins to set a late payment fee and a rescheduling fee on Screen 7. For each fee the admin chooses the type (fixed amount or percentage) and enters the value; both fees start as Not set, and no such fee is charged while it is not set. A fixed amount must be above 0, is stated in the Fee Currency and is converted via USD with the rate set locked at quote acceptance; the late fee percentage is of the late installment. Both fees are locked at booking confirmation (a fixed amount with its currency code; a booking confirmed while a fee is Not set keeps no such fee). Hairline keeps both fees; they change no provider payout. The rescheduling fee never applies to a change an admin makes in V1.
attrs.rationale: FR-029 PRD, Screen 7; Late Fee Rule.

nodes.title: Late payment fee is charged once, after the grace period and the retries

attrs.statement: System MUST charge the late payment fee once, when the late payment grace period (counted from the due date) has passed with the installment unpaid and the automatic retries have ended; it is collected with the next successful charge and stays outside the clinic share and the refund base. No fee is charged while the late payment fee is Not set.
attrs.rationale: FR-029 PRD, Late Fee Rule; Screen 4 grace period.

nodes.title: One weekly settlement period for all manually paid clinics

attrs.statement: System MUST allow admins to set the settlement cutoff day and payout day for all manually paid clinics on Screen 7. The period is weekly only in V1, defaulting to a Sunday cutoff and a Wednesday payout; the two days must differ. There is no per-clinic payout frequency; on the Stripe Connect rail release is automatic. FR-015 and FR-017 point to this setting.
attrs.rationale: FR-029 PRD, Screen 7 Settlement Period; Settlement Period Rule.

nodes.title: Balance due days default to 7, range from 1 to 30 and lock at booking confirmation

attrs.statement: System MUST treat the balance of the deposit-now, balance-later option as due 7 days before the procedure date by default, MUST allow admins to edit it on Screen 7 within 1 to 30 days, and MUST lock it at booking confirmation as a balance due date stored on the booking (FR-007), so a later change never moves it. A booking confirmed with this many days left, or fewer, gets full payment only.
attrs.rationale: FR-029 PRD, Screen 7 Balance Due Days.

nodes.title: Unpaid balance cancellation point is 1 to 30 days and may be Not set

attrs.statement: System MUST allow admins to set, on Screen 7, the unpaid balance cancellation point: 1 to 30 days after the oldest unpaid due date (the due date of the oldest installment or balance that is unpaid right now; paying it late restarts the count from the next unpaid one), at which a booking with any unpaid balance (deposit and balance, or installments) is cancelled. It applies only to bookings confirmed after it is set, wins over pending retries and the Defaulted state, and does nothing while it is not set. It must be smaller than the balance due days and smaller than the installment cutoff.
attrs.rationale: FR-029 PRD, Screen 7 Unpaid Balance Cancellation Point.

nodes.title: Hairline's share of a patient cancellation fee may be Not set

attrs.statement: System MUST allow admins to set Hairline's share of a patient cancellation fee on Screen 7. It has no starting value and may be Not set; while it is not set Hairline keeps the whole fee and holders of the Screen 7 permission see a banner on the admin dashboard asking them to set it, which clears when the share is saved.
attrs.rationale: FR-029 PRD, Screen 7 Hairline Share of Patient Cancellation Fee.

nodes.title: Patient confirmation window is 1 to 30 days, default 7

attrs.statement: System MUST allow admins to set the patient confirmation window on Screen 7 (1 to 30 days, default 7).
attrs.rationale: FR-029 PRD, Screen 7 Patient Confirmation Window.

nodes.title: Admins set the clinic cancellation deduction as a fixed amount with no starting value

attrs.statement: System MUST allow admins to set the clinic cancellation deduction on Screen 7: a fixed amount above 0 in the Fee Currency with no starting value, which FR-017 reads; no deduction is made while it is not set.
attrs.rationale: FR-029 PRD, Screen 7 Clinic Cancellation Deduction.

nodes.title: Screen 7 refuses a save that breaks a range or ordering check

attrs.statement: System MUST refuse a Screen 7 save, naming the field, when balance due days are outside 1 to 30, when a set cancellation point is outside 1 to 30 or is not smaller than both the balance due days and the installment cutoff, when the confirmation window is outside 1 to 30, or when the settlement cutoff day and payout day are the same.
attrs.rationale: FR-029 PRD, Screen 7 validation rules.

nodes.title: Only accounts of the deployment mode are routed, and the Global Fallback is Active

attrs.statement: System MUST consider only Live-mode Stripe accounts for routing on a production deployment and only Test-mode accounts elsewhere. The Global Fallback account MUST be Active and Live on production (Test elsewhere) and cannot be set Inactive or Archived. A country held by an Inactive or Archived account MUST be treated as unassigned for routing, and such an account may hold no countries. An override that would leave a non-fallback account with no countries MUST be refused at the confirmation step of Alternative Flow A1.
attrs.rationale: FR-029 PRD, Screen 1, Business Rules and Boundary Flow B6.

nodes.title: A routed account that does not support the booking currency is charged in USD from the locked rate set

attrs.statement: System MUST charge a booking in USD when the routed Stripe account does not support the booking currency, converting at the quote-to-USD rate in the booking's locked rate set with the markup per Payment Rule 3, and MUST check the payment methods against the charge currency after that fallback.
attrs.rationale: FR-029 PRD, Payment & Billing Rules.

nodes.title: A third-currency price goes via USD with the markup applied once, and a locked rate set survives pair deletion

attrs.statement: System MUST derive a price shown in a currency that is neither the quote currency nor USD via USD, applying the markup once on the pair for the shown currency, and MUST keep a booking's locked rate set valid after any of its currency pairs is deleted.
attrs.rationale: FR-029 PRD, Payment Rule 3 and General Module Rule 1.

nodes.title: An admin acknowledges a rate-protection warning to clear it

attrs.statement: System MUST let an admin acknowledge a pair's rate-protection warning on Screen 2B, log the acknowledgement, and clear the warning only by that action; afterwards the pair is compared with the rate at that moment until the change against the rate 24 hours earlier is again within the threshold. No comparison runs for 24 hours after a pair is created or switched between manual and auto-fetch mode.
attrs.rationale: FR-029 PRD, Boundary Flow B5 and Screen 2B.

nodes.title: Fixed fee amounts are stored with their currency and re-entered when the Default Currency changes

attrs.statement: System MUST state each fixed fee amount on Screen 7 (late payment fee, rescheduling fee, clinic cancellation deduction) in the Fee Currency, store and lock it together with its currency code, and MUST NOT reinterpret it when the Default Currency changes: after a Default Currency change Screen 7 cannot be saved until each fixed amount that is set has been re-entered in the new currency, and a currency in use as the Fee Currency cannot be disabled.
attrs.rationale: FR-029 PRD, Admin Editability Rules and Screen 7 Fee Currency.

nodes.title: A cancellation point that falls before the late fee day is warned about, not blocked

attrs.statement: System MUST warn, without blocking the save, on Screen 4 and on Screen 7 when a set unpaid balance cancellation point is smaller than the day the late payment fee would be charged (the later of the end of the grace period and the day the last automatic retry runs, as set by FR-007B), because a booking cancelled at the point never pays the fee.
attrs.rationale: FR-029 PRD, Screen 4 late payment fee note and Main Flow: Configure Refund, Fees and Settlement.

nodes.title: A provider-specific deposit rate is reset to the global default, never deleted

attrs.statement: System MUST let an admin remove a provider-specific deposit rate with the action "Reset to global default" on Screen 3, with a confirmation and an audit entry; the provider then follows the global rate for new bookings and existing bookings keep their own rate.
attrs.rationale: FR-029 PRD, Screen 3 and Alternative Flow A2b.

nodes.title: Admins create notification rules per event

attrs.statement: System MUST allow admins to create notification rules by selecting event type, configuring recipient targeting, enabling delivery channels (email, push, and SMS in future phases), selecting templates per channel, and defining delivery timing. In MVP, only email and push can actually be enabled; SMS is reserved for later phases once S‑03 SMS support is implemented.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 930 (REQ-030-001, verbatim). Restating bullets merged here: Module Scope admin bullets and S-03 consumption of rules (50, 51, 52, 53, 59).

nodes.title: Evaluate notification rules in real time

attrs.statement: System MUST evaluate notification rules in real-time (<30 seconds) when system events occur and trigger notifications for all matching rules
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 931 (REQ-030-002, verbatim).

nodes.title: Email delivery within 2 minutes

attrs.statement: System MUST deliver email notifications via SMTP service within 2 minutes of trigger for 95% of emails
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 932 (REQ-030-003, verbatim).

nodes.title: Push delivery within 1 minute

attrs.statement: System MUST deliver push notifications via FCM/Web Push within 1 minute of trigger for 95% of push notifications
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 933 (REQ-030-004, verbatim).

nodes.title: Optional SMS for selected events, not in MVP

attrs.statement: System MUST support optional SMS notifications for selected events (payment reminders, appointment alerts) with admin approval and cost tracking in post‑MVP phases; MVP does not send SMS.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 934 (REQ-030-005, verbatim).

nodes.title: Template editor with variables and languages

attrs.statement: System MUST provide notification template editor supporting rich text (email), plain text (push, SMS), dynamic variables, and multi-language content. SMS templates, if configured, are only used when SMS delivery is enabled in a later phase.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 935 (REQ-030-006, verbatim). Restating bullets merged here: Screen 3 business rules on formatting and variable syntax (475, 476, 477, 478). Multi-language content follows the language the reader prefers (SRC-MTG-003-D06).

nodes.title: Validate templates before activation

attrs.statement: System MUST validate notification templates before activation to ensure all variables exist in event payload and template syntax is valid
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 936 (REQ-030-007, verbatim). Restating bullets merged here: Alternative Flow B2 and Screen 3 variable validation (340, 341, 342, 343, 479).

nodes.title: General retry rule for failed notification deliveries

attrs.statement: System MUST automatically retry failed notification deliveries using the general retry rule (General Module Rule 7): by default up to 3 retries at one interval of 1 hour; an admin may set 1 to 5 attempts and a different interval for an individual notification
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary and General Module Rule 7. The general retry rule is written once; the separate 1, 3 and 6 hour sequence rule is merged here.

nodes.title: Log every notification delivery

attrs.statement: System MUST log all notification deliveries (successful and failed), as a view of the FR-020 notification record and attempt rows, with recipient (masked), event, channel, timestamp, delivery status, and failure reason (if applicable)
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 938 (REQ-030-009, verbatim). Restating bullets merged here: Alternative Flow B1 step 3 logs failed deliveries with error code and timestamp (326).

nodes.title: Real-time delivery analytics dashboard

attrs.statement: System MUST provide real-time notification delivery analytics dashboard with metrics: total sent, delivered, failed, opened (email), clicked (email), grouped by event type, channel, recipient type
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 939 (REQ-030-010, verbatim). Restating bullets merged here: S-03 provides delivery logs and metrics to A-09 (64).

nodes.title: Store notification rules

attrs.statement: System MUST store notification rules with: event type, recipient targeting rules, channel preferences, template IDs, delivery timing, retry configuration, escalation rules, rule status (active/paused/draft)
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 943 (REQ-030-011, verbatim).

nodes.title: Store notification templates

attrs.statement: System MUST store notification templates with: template name, event type, channel type, language, content (subject, body), variables, status (active/draft/archived), version history
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 944 (REQ-030-012, verbatim).

nodes.title: Delivery logs kept 90 days then archived, never hard deleted

attrs.statement: System MUST maintain notification delivery logs for 90 days in operational database; archive logs for audit/compliance retention (no hard delete). If a user requests deletion, the system MUST anonymize/redact personal identifiers in those logs per platform retention/compliance policy (see FR-023).
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 945 (REQ-030-013, verbatim). Restating bullets merged here: Privacy Rule 6 (513).

nodes.title: Track email opens and clicks

attrs.statement: System MUST track notification engagement metrics (email opens, email clicks) via pixel tracking and link tracking from SMTP service
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 946 (REQ-030-014, verbatim).

nodes.title: Encrypt templates at rest

attrs.statement: System MUST encrypt notification templates at rest using AES-256; decrypt only during template rendering in S-03 Notification Service
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 950 (REQ-030-015, verbatim). Restating bullets merged here: Privacy Rule 3 and the security considerations (510, 785).

nodes.title: Mask recipient contact in admin interfaces

attrs.statement: System MUST mask recipient contact information (email, phone) in admin interfaces to protect privacy (e.g., "mar*@example.com", "+44*1234")
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 951 (REQ-030-016, verbatim). Restating bullets merged here: Privacy Rule 1 (508).

nodes.title: Rate limit notifications per recipient, limit set by admins

attrs.statement: System MUST enforce rate limiting to prevent notification spam: a maximum number of notifications per hour per recipient, set by admins with a default of 10 (notices over the limit are held and sent in order in the next hour; critical notices are never held)
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary and General Module Rule 6. The limit is admin-editable (Screen 1 field Notification Rate Limit); it is no longer on the Fixed list.

nodes.title: HTML-escape template variables

attrs.statement: System MUST HTML-escape all template variables during rendering to prevent XSS attacks from user-generated content
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 953 (REQ-030-018, verbatim). Restating bullets merged here: Implementation Notes technology and threat mitigation (746, 789).

nodes.title: Respect opt-out for non-critical notifications

attrs.statement: System MUST respect recipient opt-out preferences for notifications that are not locked (marketing, general updates); locked notices are always sent by email despite opt-out, with in-app explanation, while push follows the recipient's own setting
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 954 (REQ-030-019, verbatim). Restating bullets merged here: Privacy Rule 4 (511).

nodes.title: Audit trail of every notification rule change

attrs.statement: System MUST record every notification rule change in the audit trail with admin user ID, timestamp, change summary, old and new configuration, IP address and reason (if provided); audit log retention follows the system PRD, Platform-Wide Rules: One 10-year retention period
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary. General Module Rule 1 and the Security Considerations audit trail point here; the separate old and new configuration and reason Rules are merged into this one.

nodes.title: Integrate with SMTP service

attrs.statement: System MUST integrate with SMTP service (SendGrid, Amazon SES, Mailgun) for email delivery via RESTful API or SMTP protocol
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 930 (REQ-030-021, verbatim).

nodes.title: Integrate with push notification services

attrs.statement: System MUST integrate with push notification services (Firebase Cloud Messaging for mobile, Web Push API for web) for push notification delivery
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 960 (REQ-030-022, verbatim).

nodes.title: Integrate with SMS gateway

attrs.statement: System MUST integrate with SMS gateway (Twilio, Vonage) for SMS delivery via RESTful API (optional, admin-enabled)
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 961 (REQ-030-023, verbatim).

nodes.title: Verify delivery status webhooks

attrs.statement: System MUST receive delivery status updates (bounces, opens, clicks) from external services via webhooks; webhook signature verification: See system PRD, Platform-Wide Rules: No card numbers stored
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary. The webhook signature part is stated once in the system PRD; delivery status updates stay here.

nodes.title: Publish notification events to audit log service

attrs.statement: System MUST publish notification events to audit log service (Elasticsearch, CloudWatch Logs) for compliance and troubleshooting
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 963 (REQ-030-025, verbatim).

nodes.title: Mandatory aftercare reassignment event; provider-status cancellation escalation

attrs.statement: System MUST list `aftercare.provider_reassigned` (FR-011 producer; Patient and new aftercare provider) as a locked mandatory event that FR-032 preferences cannot suppress, and MUST raise `provider.status_cancellation_admin_support`, never `booking.provider_fault_replacement`, when a provider-status event leaves an `In Progress` booking open with `supportRequired` for an admin decision
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 964 (REQ-030-026, verbatim).

nodes.title: Catalog event: Email Verification / OTP Code

attrs.statement: Email Verification / OTP Code (account.email_verification_code) is an admin-configurable notification event. Primary recipients: Patient, Provider, Admin. Extends FR-026 OTP templates; security-critical and non-disableable by default
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 124. Category: Account/Auth. Event nodes: EVT-verification-otp-sent (existing node). Lock rule (prd.md line 541): Account/Auth notifications (OTP verification, password reset) are security-critical and MUST be non-disableable by default in the admin UI (toggle locked; no pause).

nodes.title: Catalog event: Password Reset Code / Link

attrs.statement: Password Reset Code / Link (account.password_reset) is an admin-configurable notification event. Primary recipients: Patient, Provider, Admin. Security-critical and non-disableable by default
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 124. Category: Account/Auth. Event nodes: EVT-password-reset-otp-sent (existing node). Lock rule (prd.md line 541): Account/Auth notifications (OTP verification, password reset) are security-critical and MUST be non-disableable by default in the admin UI (toggle locked; no pause).

nodes.title: Catalog event: New Account Created (Welcome / Onboarding)

attrs.statement: Provider-Caused Cancellation / Offer Unavailable (provider.status_cancellation_patient) is an admin-configurable notification event. Primary recipients: Patient. One per affected inquiry/case when provider suspension (`ProviderSuspended`) or deactivation (`ProviderDeactivated`) cancels the patient's case or the provider's offer before acceptance. For a case already accepted, the patient instead receives `booking.provider_fault_replacement`. Before acceptance, three variants apply, checked in this order (FR-003 Workflow 2 Alternative Flow B4, REQ-003-021): (1) when other live offers remain open, the notice says "[Clinic] is no longer available. attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 869, 870, 871, 872. Fields retry_with_secondary_contact and send_to_both_contacts record the per-rule options.

nodes.title: Scheduled notifications are calculated at delivery time using the recipient's current timezone

attrs.statement: System automatically adjusts delivery timing based on recipient's current timezone setting at time of delivery If recipient travels to different timezone and updates profile, future notifications use new timezone Scheduled notifications (e.g., a Schedule Time in recipient local time) calculated dynamically at delivery time, not statically when notification scheduled

nodes.title: Pausing a rule keeps queued notices; the Purge Queue button cancels them

attrs.statement: System immediately stops adding new notifications for the paused rule: events that occur during the pause are skipped for good. Notifications already queued (not yet delivered) remain in queue and are delivered as scheduled. To cancel queued notifications, the admin uses the Purge Queue button on the rule screen (Screen 2), with confirmation prompt: "This will cancel X pending notifications. Continue?"

nodes.title: Locked notices are always sent by email despite opt-out and show an in-app banner

attrs.statement: System respects recipient opt-out for notifications that are not locked (marketing, general updates) and does not deliver. A locked notice is critical: it is sent at once, is exempt from quiet hours, the hourly rate limit and coalescing, and is always sent by email whatever the recipient's opt-out, while push (and any other optional channel) follows the recipient's own setting (the app displays a banner explaining why the email was sent despite opt-out). The one exception is legal.acceptance_reminder, which is locked but not critical: it respects quiet hours and the rate limit, and, like every locked notice, is still sent by email despite opt-out. The locked list is fixed in the codebase: an admin cannot mark any other notice as critical
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 884, 885, 886, 887. Field critical_cannot_opt_out records the per-rule designation.

nodes.title: Prolonged outage: hold for 24 hours then mark Failed - Service Outage and alert admin

attrs.statement: System holds notifications for up to 24 hours and retries them at the retry interval If service restored within 24 hours, queued notifications delivered (may result in burst of deliveries) If outage exceeds 24 hours, system marks notifications as "Failed - Service Outage" without using up their retries, and alerts admin After service is restored, admin uses Retry on the failed notices in the Failed Deliveries list, or switches to backup notification provider if configured
attrs.rationale: Edge case, prolonged external service outage. No exponential backoff; retries use the one retry interval.

nodes.title: Template revert creates a new version

attrs.statement: “revert” creates a **new** version copied from a selected prior version and requires admin confirmation
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 589 (Configurable with Restrictions, Template versioning), copied verbatim from the clause after the last semicolon. Previously present only in the rationale of REQ-030-183.

nodes.title: Out of scope: real-time chat between users

attrs.statement: Out of scope: Real-time chat/messaging between users (handled by P-06: Communication)
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 85 (Communication Structure, Out of Scope, heading line 82). The other four bullets (lines 85 to 88) are REQ-030-214 to 217 (decision D52: one Rule per bullet).

attrs.statement: Out of scope: Video consultation notifications (covered under aftercare-specific notifications)
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 86 (Communication Structure, Out of Scope, heading line 82). One Rule per bullet under decision D52.

nodes.title: Out of scope: user-to-user notification forwarding

attrs.statement: Out of scope: User-to-user notification forwarding or sharing
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 88 (Communication Structure, Out of Scope, heading line 82). One Rule per bullet under decision D52.

nodes.title: Catalog event: Quote Restored

attrs.statement: Quote Restored (quote.restored) is an admin-configurable notification event. Primary recipients: Patient, Provider. Fired by FR-004 when an admin restores an expired quote (a reason is required). The quote returns to sent status with a fresh full expiry window: the restore time plus the FR-026 quote validity window in force. The patient is told the quote is available again with its new expiry date; the provider is told the quote was restored and its new expiry date. MVP default channels: Email + Push
attrs.rationale: Event Catalog table, Quote category. Event node: EVT-quote-restored.

nodes.title: A provider with a quote on a cancelled inquiry gets only the quote-cancelled notice

attrs.statement: Providers are not recipients of inquiry.cancelled. A provider that holds a draft, sent or expired quote on a cancelled inquiry receives only quote.cancelled_inquiry, and a provider that never quoted is told nothing
attrs.rationale: Event Catalog table, rows inquiry.cancelled and quote.cancelled_inquiry.

nodes.title: Catalog event: Payout Paused, Problem Raised

attrs.statement: Payout Paused — Problem Raised (payout.paused_problem_raised) is an admin-configurable notification event. Primary recipients: Admin. Fired when a problem is raised on a completed treatment and the clinic's money for that booking is paused; tells admins which booking and clinic are affected, with a link to the support request. MVP default channels: Email + Push
attrs.rationale: Event Catalog table, Billing/Payouts category. No Event node: the PRD names no producer stage, so the Rule sits at the Stage where the catalogue rules without a producer sit.

nodes.title: Catalog event: Funds Released to Clinic

attrs.statement: Funds Released to Clinic (payout.funds_released) is an admin-configurable notification event. Primary recipients: Provider. Fired when money held for a booking is released to the clinic; states the booking and the amount released. MVP default channels: Email + Push
attrs.rationale: Event Catalog table, Billing/Payouts category. No Event node: the PRD names no producer stage, so the Rule sits at the Stage where the catalogue rules without a producer sit.

nodes.title: Catalog event: Cancellation Charge Deducted

attrs.statement: Cancellation Charge Deducted (payout.cancellation_charge_deducted) is an admin-configurable notification event. Primary recipients: Provider. Fired when a cancellation charge is deducted from the clinic's money; states the booking, the amount deducted and that the reason is a cancellation. MVP default channels: Email + Push
attrs.rationale: Event Catalog table, Billing/Payouts category. No Event node: the PRD names no producer stage, so the Rule sits at the Stage where the catalogue rules without a producer sit.

nodes.title: Catalog event: Monitoring Aftercare Conversion Started

attrs.statement: Monitoring Aftercare Conversion Started (monitoring.aftercare_conversion_started) is an admin-configurable notification event. Primary recipients: Patient. Fired by FR-038 when the patient selects Switch to Aftercare Package on a transplant-progress case, before the aftercare request is created; tells the patient the switch has started. Patient only; sent immediately
attrs.rationale: Event Catalog table, Monitoring category. Event node: EVT-transplant-progress-conversion-started.

nodes.title: One platform-wide quiet-hours period, set only by admins

attrs.statement: Admins set one platform-wide quiet-hours period during which non-critical notifications are held and sent in order when it ends. It is set only on the Rules Dashboard by an admin; recipients and providers cannot set their own. Default: 10 PM to 7 AM in the recipient's local time; start and end must differ; critical notices are never held; the hourly rate limit still applies to the release
attrs.rationale: Scope and Screen 1 field Quiet Hours. Replaces the retired provider business hours Rule REQ-030-110.

nodes.title: Transplant progress reminder schedule is set in the admin notification settings

attrs.statement: Admins set how often the default patient progress reminder is sent on a transplant-progress case, and for how long, counted from the case creation date. Default: once a month for 12 months from the case creation date. The patient may change or switch off their own reminders; FR-038 refers to this schedule
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 field Transplant Progress Reminder Schedule and the Editable by Admin list.

nodes.title: Rules Dashboard shows Notification Analytics and a Failed Deliveries drill-down

attrs.statement: Notification Analytics shows delivery metrics for the selected period: total sent, delivered, failed, opened (email) and clicked (email), grouped by event type, channel and recipient type; display only, with a date range filter, read from the delivery logs. Failed Deliveries opens from the failed count and lists each failed delivery with masked recipient, event type, channel, failure reason, status (Failed - Permanent or Failed - Service Outage) and timestamp; admin can filter by failure reason and export to CSV. Each row has one action, Retry, which sends that failed notice again, is allowed only for status Failed and is logged. Recipient contact is masked.
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 fields Notification Analytics and Failed Deliveries; REQ-030-010 states the analytics requirement.

nodes.title: Rule Editor shows Critical - Cannot Opt Out as a read-only indicator

attrs.statement: Critical - Cannot Opt Out is a read-only indicator that shows Yes for every event on the locked list: a locked notice is always sent by email even when the recipient has opted out, while push follows the recipient's own setting. Critical notices (all locked notices except legal.acceptance_reminder) are also exempt from quiet hours and the rate limit (REQ-030-208). An admin cannot mark an event critical; the indicator follows the locked list.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 field table.

nodes.title: Add Rule action starts another Draft rule for an event

attrs.statement: Add Rule starts a new rule in Draft status for a chosen event from the event catalog, including an event that already has a rule (see Workflow B3). Visible by permission; Rule Name must be unique for that event.
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 field Add Rule and Workflow B3, Admin Adds Another Rule for the Same Event.

nodes.title: Catalog event: Monitoring Converted to Aftercare

attrs.statement: Monitoring Converted to Aftercare (monitoring.converted_to_aftercare) is an admin-configurable notification event. Primary recipients: Patient. Fired by FR-038 when the standalone aftercare request from the Switch to Aftercare Package flow is successfully created; tells the patient the switch is complete. Patient only (FR-037/FR-038)
attrs.rationale: Event Catalog table, Monitoring category. Event node: EVT-transplant-progress-converted. This Rule has no number in the apply result; the next free number was used.

nodes.title: Rules are never deleted, only switched off

attrs.statement: Notification rules are never deleted, only switched off (paused). A rule for an event on the Non-Disableable list cannot be paused
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 517 (General Module Rule 2).

nodes.title: Save Draft saves without activating, Save and Activate activates immediately

attrs.statement: In the Rule Editor, Save Draft saves a rule without activating it; Save & Activate activates it immediately
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 464 (Screen 2 Notes). Activation still follows the confirmation prompt of the Entry Points activation method.

nodes.title: Pausing a rule on the dashboard needs a confirmation prompt

attrs.statement: Pausing a rule requires a confirmation prompt: "Events that occur while this rule is paused will not send notifications. Notices already queued are still delivered. Continue?"
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 401 (Screen 1 Business Rules). Workflow A2 step 3 (prd.md line 304) words its pause prompt differently: "Paused rules will not trigger notifications. Reactivate when ready." (REQ-030-151).

nodes.title: Every event that produces a notification is owned by FR-030

attrs.statement: Event ownership: every event that produces a notification is owned by FR-030 and listed in this catalog, including events triggered by other features (the producing feature is named in the Notes). An event that produces no notification is owned by the feature that triggers it and is not listed here. Affiliate account emails (activation, code created, commission change, suspension, offboarding) go through the notification service as emails to the affiliate (FR-018 Rule 17, REQ-018-315); they are not catalogue events, and `payout.affiliate_processed` is the one affiliate event listed.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 111 (Core Rule, Event ownership).

nodes.title: With Email and Push both off, only the in-app entry is created

attrs.statement: When a recipient has both Email and Push switched off, nothing is sent by email or push, and the in-app entry is still always created; it is built from the push title and body of the rule's push template, or from the event's catalogue default title and body when the rule has no push template, and there is no separate in-app template; dsr.fulfilled creates no in-app entry
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 915, 916 (Edge Cases). The owning FR was unconfirmed in the 2026-11-20 apply result; the line is in this PRD.

nodes.title: Catalog event: Account Deletion Requested

attrs.statement: Account Deletion Requested (account.deletion_requested) is an admin-configurable notification event. Primary recipients: Patient, Admin. Fired when a patient's account deletion request is submitted through FR-001 (FR-023 REQ-023-029). One event with two recipients: the patient receives the submission confirmation, which is the mandatory notice, and the admins are told of the new request. The toggle is locked
attrs.rationale: Event Catalog table, row account.deletion_requested. Category: Account/Auth. Event nodes: EVT-account-deletion-requested.

nodes.title: Catalog event: Data Request Status Notices

attrs.statement: Data Request Status Notices (dsr.verification_required, dsr.in_progress, dsr.fulfilled, dsr.denied, dsr.blocked_by_obligation) is an admin-configurable notification event. Primary recipients: Patient. Status notices on a deletion request (FR-023 REQ-023-008): identity proof insufficient, approved and processing, completed (with the actions taken and the legal basis of any retained records), denied (with the reason), approval blocked by an active obligation (with the expected timeline). `dsr.fulfilled` and `dsr.denied` are mandatory — admin cannot disable them; the other three are admin-switchable. `dsr.fulfilled` is sent by email only, to the contact address FR-023 captured, is critical and creates no in-app record
attrs.rationale: Event Catalog table, row dsr.verification_required, dsr.in_progress, dsr.fulfilled, dsr.denied, dsr.blocked_by_obligation. Category: Account/Auth. Event nodes: EVT-dsr-verification-required, EVT-dsr-in-progress, EVT-dsr-fulfilled, EVT-dsr-denied, EVT-dsr-blocked-by-obligation.

nodes.title: Catalog event: Data Request Deadline Approaching

attrs.statement: Data Request Deadline Approaching (dsr.deadline_approaching) is an admin-configurable notification event. Primary recipients: Admin. Sent 7 calendar days before the deadline of a deletion request that is still open (FR-023 REQ-023-029)
attrs.rationale: Event Catalog table, row dsr.deadline_approaching. Category: Account/Auth. Event nodes: EVT-dsr-deadline-approaching.

nodes.title: Catalog event: Data Request Obligation Block Ended

attrs.statement: Data Request Obligation Block Ended (dsr.obligation_block_ended) is an admin-configurable notification event. Primary recipients: Admin. Sent when the obligation that blocked approval of a deletion request ends, saying the request can be approved (FR-023 REQ-023-029 and Main Flow step 3). FR-023 owns the emitting step
attrs.rationale: Event Catalog table, row dsr.obligation_block_ended. Category: Account/Auth. Event nodes: none (FR-023 owns the emitting step).

nodes.title: Catalog event: Legal Version Published

attrs.statement: Legal Version Published (legal.version_published) is an admin-configurable notification event. Primary recipients: Admin (the publishing Admin). Sent to the Admin who published the version once publication succeeds (FR-027 REQ-027-022)
attrs.rationale: Event Catalog table, row legal.version_published. Category: System/Operations. Event nodes: EVT-legal-version-published.

nodes.title: Catalog event: Legal Acceptance Coverage Below Threshold

attrs.statement: Legal Acceptance Coverage Below Threshold (legal.coverage_below_threshold) is an admin-configurable notification event. Primary recipients: Admin (holders of the A-09 Edit Settings permission). Sent once per version when the acceptance rate of a Current version is below the Admin-set threshold; evaluated daily from 14 days after the version became Current (FR-027 REQ-027-023)
attrs.rationale: Event Catalog table, row legal.coverage_below_threshold. Category: System/Operations. Event nodes: EVT-legal-coverage-below-threshold.

nodes.title: Catalog event: Legal Acceptance Reminder

attrs.statement: Legal Acceptance Reminder (legal.acceptance_reminder) is an admin-configurable notification event. Primary recipients: Patient, Provider (team members in the Pending set). One reminder to each user in the Pending set; FR-027 owns the cadence (REQ-027-063). Locked: the toggle cannot be switched off. It is the one locked notice that is not critical: it respects quiet hours and the rate limit, but, like every locked notice, it is still sent by email despite opt-out, while push follows the user's own setting
attrs.rationale: Event Catalog table, row legal.acceptance_reminder. Category: System/Operations. Event nodes: EVT-legal-acceptance-reminder.

nodes.title: Catalog event: Installment Charge Failed

attrs.statement: Installment Charge Failed (installment.failed) is an admin-configurable notification event. Primary recipients: Patient. Immediate notice that an installment charge failed, with a clear error message (FR-007B REQ-007B-017). On the day after the due date the overdue notice replaces that day's failure notice
attrs.rationale: Event Catalog table, row installment.failed. Category: Payment. Event nodes: EVT-installment-failed.

nodes.title: Catalog event: Installment Overdue

attrs.statement: Installment Overdue (installment.overdue_notice) is an admin-configurable notification event. Primary recipients: Patient, Admin (billing admins). One notice to the patient and one to the billing admins on the day after a due date passes unpaid, after that day's retry; the patient notice states the booking cancellation date when the cancellation point is set. The provider sees the Overdue banner only and gets no notice (FR-007B REQ-007B-101)
attrs.rationale: Event Catalog table, row installment.overdue_notice. Category: Payment. Event nodes: EVT-installment-overdue-notice.

nodes.title: Catalog event: Installment Plan Defaulted

attrs.statement: Installment Plan Defaulted (installment.plan_defaulted) is an admin-configurable notification event. Primary recipients: Admin, Patient, Provider. Sent when a plan becomes Defaulted; the admin notice is for intervention (FR-007B REQ-007B-020)
attrs.rationale: Event Catalog table, row installment.plan_defaulted. Category: Payment. Event nodes: EVT-installment-plan-defaulted.

nodes.title: Catalog event: Installment Charged

attrs.statement: Installment Charged (installment.charged) is an admin-configurable notification event. Primary recipients: Patient. Confirmation after a successful installment charge, by email and push (FR-007B REQ-007B-016)
attrs.rationale: Event Catalog table, row installment.charged. Category: Payment. Event nodes: EVT-installment-charged.

nodes.title: Catalog event: Installment Plan Completed

attrs.statement: Installment Plan Completed (installment.plan_completed) is an admin-configurable notification event. Primary recipients: Patient. Sent when the final installment completes and the booking status changes (FR-007B REQ-007B-093)
attrs.rationale: Event Catalog table, row installment.plan_completed. Category: Payment. Event nodes: EVT-installment-plan-completed.

nodes.title: Catalog event: Payment Overdue Notice

attrs.statement: Payment Overdue Notice (payment.overdue_notice) is an admin-configurable notification event. Primary recipients: Patient, Admin (billing admins). Sent when a booking balance enters Overdue (FR-007 REQ-007-036): the billing admins are notified and the patient receives one overdue notice
attrs.rationale: Event Catalog table, row payment.overdue_notice. Category: Payment. Event nodes: EVT-patient-payment-overdue-notice.

nodes.title: Catalog event: Refund Approval Overdue

attrs.statement: Refund Approval Overdue (refund.approval_escalated) is an admin-configurable notification event. Primary recipients: Admin (super-admin). Sent to a super-admin when a refund approval is still open after 2 business days (FR-007 REQ-007-015)
attrs.rationale: Event Catalog table, row refund.approval_escalated. Category: Payment. Event nodes: EVT-refund-approval-escalated.

nodes.title: Catalog event: Redistribution Confirmation Reminder

attrs.statement: Redistribution Confirmation Reminder (provider.status_redistribution_reminder) is an admin-configurable notification event. Primary recipients: Patient. Sent once, 48 hours after the confirm variant of `provider.status_cancellation_patient` is left unanswered (FR-020 REQ-020-159). It carries the same Confirm and Decline links and the Contact Admin/Support action. It is dropped when the patient has answered, the inquiry was cancelled, an admin reassigned or reran distribution, or the support marker was cleared. Mandatory — admin cannot disable this event (see Non-Disableable by Default section)
attrs.rationale: Event Catalog table, row provider.status_redistribution_reminder. Category: Provider/Compliance. Event nodes: EVT-provider-status-redistribution-reminder.

nodes.title: Catalog event: Provider Response Removed

attrs.statement: Provider Response Removed (review.response_removed) is an admin-configurable notification event. Primary recipients: Provider. Fired by FR-013 when an admin removes the provider's public response to a review; tells the provider the response was removed and gives the removal reason. Informational; admin-switchable
attrs.rationale: Event Catalog table, row review.response_removed. Category: Reviews. Event nodes: EVT-review-response-removed.

nodes.title: Catalog event: Monitoring Progress Reminder

attrs.statement: Monitoring Progress Reminder (monitoring.progress_reminder) is an admin-configurable notification event. Primary recipients: Patient. Default patient reminder on a transplant-progress case (FR-038) only; hair-loss monitoring cases (FR-037) have no reminders. By default sent once a month for 12 months from the case creation date (schedule set on Screen 1) and stopped when the case is completed or converted. The patient can change the schedule or switch it off; admin-switchable
attrs.rationale: Event Catalog table, row monitoring.progress_reminder. Category: Monitoring. Event nodes: EVT-monitoring-progress-reminder.

nodes.title: Aftercare progress reminder schedule is set in the admin notification settings

attrs.statement: Admins set how often the default patient progress reminder is sent during aftercare, and for how long, counted from the treatment completion date. Default: once a month for 12 months after treatment. The patient may change or switch off their own reminders; the default is the FR-011 setting (REQ-011-088)
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 field Aftercare Progress Reminder Schedule and the Editable by Admin list. The transplant-progress schedule (REQ-030-225) counts from the case creation date instead.

nodes.title: Catalog event: Email Change Code

attrs.statement: Email Change Code (account.email_change_code) is an admin-configurable notification event. Primary recipients: Patient. 6-digit code sent to the new address when a patient changes the profile email (FR-001); its own event, separate from the registration code; security-critical and non-disableable by default
attrs.rationale: Event Catalog table, row account.email_change_code. Category: Account/Auth. Event nodes: EVT-email-change-otp-sent. Lock rule: Account/Auth notifications (OTP verification, email change code, password reset) are security-critical and non-disableable by default.

nodes.title: Catalog event: Monitoring Assignment Ended

attrs.statement: Monitoring Assignment Ended (monitoring.assignment_ended) is an admin-configurable notification event. Primary recipients: Patient, Admin, Provider (only when an Admin ends the assignment). Fires when a monitoring assignment ends other than by the provider's own withdrawal, which uses `monitoring.provider_withdrawn`. The patient and the Admin are always notified. The provider is notified only when an Admin ends the assignment, in neutral wording that does not show the reason; the provider gets no notice on completion or conversion (FR-037 REQ-037-078, REQ-037-079)
attrs.rationale: Event Catalog table, row monitoring.assignment_ended. Category: Monitoring. Event nodes: EVT-monitoring-assignment-ended.

nodes.title: Catalog event: Admin Intervention Notice

attrs.statement: Admin Intervention Notice (message.admin_intervention) is an admin-configurable notification event. Primary recipients: Patient, Provider. Sent to both parties of a conversation when an Admin intervenes in it (FR-012 REQ-012-007). Locked: the toggle cannot be switched off and the notice is held for no one
attrs.rationale: Event Catalog table, row message.admin_intervention. Category: Messaging/Support. Event nodes: EVT-admin-intervention-sent.

nodes.title: Catalog event: Keyword Flag Raised

attrs.statement: Keyword Flag Raised (message.keyword_flag_raised) is an admin-configurable notification event. Primary recipients: Admin. Sent to Admins when a conversation is flagged for a policy keyword, with a link to the flagged conversation (FR-012 REQ-012-094, REQ-012-026). The patient and the provider are not told. Locked: the toggle cannot be switched off
attrs.rationale: Event Catalog table, row message.keyword_flag_raised. Category: Messaging/Support. Event nodes: EVT-keyword-flag-raised.

nodes.title: Catalog event: Provider Response Reminder

attrs.statement: Provider Response Reminder (message.provider_response_reminder) is an admin-configurable notification event. Primary recipients: Provider. Sent when a patient message has had no provider reply for 48 hours, once per unanswered stretch and not while the conversation is read-only; if there is still no reply at 72 hours further reminders follow (FR-012 REQ-012-098)
attrs.rationale: Event Catalog table, row message.provider_response_reminder. Category: Messaging/Support. Event nodes: EVT-provider-response-reminder, EVT-provider-response-escalated.

nodes.title: Catalog event: Urgent Case Unassigned Alert

attrs.statement: Urgent Case Unassigned Alert (support.urgent_case_unassigned) is an admin-configurable notification event. Primary recipients: Admin (Support Staff pool). Sent when an Open or In Progress Urgent case is still unassigned 1 hour after the Urgent clock started (FR-034 REQ-034-092, REQ-034-173)
attrs.rationale: Event Catalog table, row support.urgent_case_unassigned. Category: Messaging/Support. Event nodes: none (Rule only).

nodes.title: Catalog event: Support Case Orphaned

attrs.statement: Support Case Orphaned (support.case_orphaned) is an admin-configurable notification event. Primary recipients: Admin (Support Staff pool). Sent when the assigned admin of a case is deactivated and the case becomes unassigned, so that the case can be reassigned (FR-034 REQ-034-108)
attrs.rationale: Event Catalog table, row support.case_orphaned. Category: Messaging/Support. Event nodes: none (Rule only).

nodes.title: Catalog event: Support Notice Delivery Failed

attrs.statement: Support Notice Delivery Failed (support.notice_delivery_failed) is an admin-configurable notification event. Primary recipients: Admin (the assigned admin, or the Support Staff pool when the case is unassigned). Sent when a support notice to a patient or provider still fails once the retry rule is exhausted, so that the admin contacts the person manually (FR-034 REQ-034-113)
attrs.rationale: Event Catalog table, row support.notice_delivery_failed. Category: Messaging/Support. Event nodes: none (Rule only).

nodes.title: Catalog event: Payout Dispute Resolved

attrs.statement: Payout Dispute Resolved (payout.dispute_resolved) is an admin-configurable notification event. Primary recipients: Provider. Sent when an admin saves a dispute resolution (FR-017 REQ-017-111): automatic and mandatory for Add to Next Payout and Pay Now, and for the other resolution actions only when the admin ticks Notify Provider. Locked: the toggle cannot be switched off
attrs.rationale: Event Catalog table, row payout.dispute_resolved. Category: Billing/Payouts. Event nodes: EVT-billing-dispute-payout-added.

nodes.title: Catalog event: Identity Re-verification Code

attrs.statement: Identity Re-verification Code (account.reauth_code) is an admin-configurable notification event. Primary recipients: Patient. 6-digit code sent to the patient's registered email when the patient re-verifies identity before a sensitive change (FR-001 Screen 18); its own event, separate from the registration code; security-critical and non-disableable by default
attrs.rationale: Event Catalog table, row account.reauth_code. Category: Account/Auth. Event nodes: EVT-reauth-otp-sent.

nodes.title: Catalog event: Patient Profile Changed by Admin

attrs.statement: Patient Profile Changed by Admin (account.profile_changed_by_admin) is an admin-configurable notification event. Primary recipients: Patient. Sent by email after every admin edit of the patient profile; the notice lists the changed fields and the patient has no review screen (FR-001 REQ-001-034, REQ-001-035)
attrs.rationale: Event Catalog table, row account.profile_changed_by_admin. Category: Account/Auth. Event nodes: EVT-patient-profile-changed-by-admin.

nodes.title: Catalog event: Formal Warning to Patient

attrs.statement: Formal Warning to Patient (account.formal_warning) is an admin-configurable notification event. Primary recipients: Patient. Sent when an admin sends a formal warning from Take Action on a flagged conversation (FR-016 REQ-016-225)
attrs.rationale: Event Catalog table, row account.formal_warning. Category: Account/Auth. Event nodes: none (Rule only).

nodes.title: Catalog event: Travel Information Requested

attrs.statement: Travel Information Requested (travel.request_sent) is an admin-configurable notification event. Primary recipients: Patient. Email and in-app (FR-008 REQ-008-071). Covers the initial passport request, the initial flight and hotel request, an admin Re-notify and the passport Incomplete notice
attrs.rationale: Event Catalog table, row travel.request_sent. Category: Travel. Event nodes: EVT-travel-request-sent.

nodes.title: Catalog event: Travel Record Submitted

attrs.statement: Travel Record Submitted (travel.record_submitted) is an admin-configurable notification event. Primary recipients: Provider. The clinic is told by email and in-app that its patient has handed in flight or hotel details (FR-008 REQ-008-071)
attrs.rationale: Event Catalog table, row travel.record_submitted. Category: Travel. Event nodes: EVT-travel-record-submitted.

nodes.title: Catalog event: Travel Record Entered

attrs.statement: Travel Record Entered (travel.record_entered) is an admin-configurable notification event. Primary recipients: Patient. Asks the patient to check travel details that the clinic typed in on the patient's behalf; email and in-app (FR-008 REQ-008-071)
attrs.rationale: Event Catalog table, row travel.record_entered. Category: Travel. Event nodes: EVT-travel-record-entered.

nodes.title: Catalog event: Travel Record Corrected

attrs.statement: Travel Record Corrected (travel.record_corrected) is an admin-configurable notification event. Primary recipients: Patient, Provider. Goes to both sides after a Hairline admin has corrected stored travel details; channels email and in-app (FR-008 REQ-008-071)
attrs.rationale: Event Catalog table, row travel.record_corrected. Category: Travel. Event nodes: EVT-travel-record-corrected.

nodes.title: Catalog event: Travel Date Review Required

attrs.statement: Travel Date Review Required (travel.date_review_required) is an admin-configurable notification event. Primary recipients: Patient, Provider, Admin. Email and in-app (FR-008 REQ-008-071). Sent when a change of treatment date means the travel dates must be reviewed
attrs.rationale: Event Catalog table, row travel.date_review_required. Category: Travel. Event nodes: EVT-travel-date-review-required.

nodes.title: Catalog event: No Travel Declared

attrs.statement: No Travel Declared (travel.no_travel_declared) is an admin-configurable notification event. Primary recipients: Provider. Email and in-app (FR-008 REQ-008-071). Sent when the patient declares that no travel is needed and when an admin overrides that declaration (FR-008 REQ-008-059)
attrs.rationale: Event Catalog table, row travel.no_travel_declared. Category: Travel. Event nodes: none (Rule only).

nodes.title: Catalog event: Travel Record Re-entry Requested

attrs.statement: Travel Record Re-entry Requested (travel.record_reentry_requested) is an admin-configurable notification event. Primary recipients: Patient or Provider (the owner of the item). Email and in-app (FR-008 REQ-008-071). Sent after an admin soft-deletes a travel or passport item, asking its owner to enter it again (FR-008 REQ-008-067, REQ-008-076)
attrs.rationale: Event Catalog table, row travel.record_reentry_requested. Category: Travel. Event nodes: none (Rule only).

nodes.title: Catalog event: Treatment Added to Catalog

attrs.statement: Treatment Added to Catalog (treatment.added) is an admin-configurable notification event. Primary recipients: Provider. Sent to all active providers the first time a treatment becomes Active, by any route; a treatment saved as Draft or Inactive sends nothing until then (FR-024 REQ-024-041)
attrs.rationale: Event Catalog table, row treatment.added. Category: Treatment Catalog. Event nodes: EVT-treatment-added.

nodes.title: Catalog event: Treatment Updated in Catalog

attrs.statement: Treatment Updated in Catalog (treatment.updated) is an admin-configurable notification event. Primary recipients: Provider. Sent to the providers who currently offer the treatment when an admin updates an Active treatment; an edit of a Draft, Inactive or Pending Media Upload treatment sends nothing. When an Inactive treatment that has been Active before is switched back to Active, the notice reads that the treatment is available again and goes only to providers with a pricing configuration for it; the same event is used (FR-024 REQ-024-042)
attrs.rationale: Event Catalog table, row treatment.updated. Category: Treatment Catalog. Event nodes: EVT-treatment-updated.

nodes.title: Catalog event: Treatment Deactivated in Catalog

attrs.statement: Treatment Deactivated in Catalog (treatment.deactivated) is an admin-configurable notification event. Primary recipients: Provider. Sent to the providers who offer the treatment when an admin deactivates it (FR-024 REQ-024-043)
attrs.rationale: Event Catalog table, row treatment.deactivated. Category: Treatment Catalog. Event nodes: EVT-treatment-deactivated.

nodes.title: Catalog event: Promotion Terms Changed

attrs.statement: Promotion Terms Changed (promotion.terms_changed) is an admin-configurable notification event. Primary recipients: Provider (every adopting provider). Sent when an admin edits the Value or the Hairline Share % of an adopted Both Fees program; the notice shows the old and the new terms, and each adoption stays Accepted (FR-019 REQ-019-118, REQ-019-010)
attrs.rationale: Event Catalog table, row promotion.terms_changed. Category: Promotions/Discounts. Event nodes: none (Rule only).

nodes.title: Catalog event: Promotion Adoption Force-Revoked, Program Paused or Resumed

attrs.rationale: Event Catalog table, row promotion.adoption_force_revoked / promotion.program_paused / promotion.program_resumed. Category: Promotions/Discounts. Event nodes: none (Rule only).

nodes.title: Catalog event: Promotion Adoption Revoked by Provider

attrs.statement: Promotion Adoption Revoked by Provider (promotion.adoption_revoked_by_provider) is an admin-configurable notification event. Primary recipients: Admin. Sent to admins when a provider revokes its own adoption of a program (FR-019 REQ-019-010)
attrs.rationale: Event Catalog table, row promotion.adoption_revoked_by_provider. Category: Promotions/Discounts. Event nodes: none (Rule only).

nodes.title: Catalog event: Team Invitation Sent

attrs.statement: Team Invitation Sent (team.invitation_sent) is an admin-configurable notification event. Primary recipients: Team invitee. Invitation email to a person invited to join a provider team (FR-009)
attrs.rationale: Event Catalog table, row team.invitation_sent. Category: Provider Team. Event nodes: EVT-team-invitation-sent.

nodes.title: Catalog event: Team Invitation Accepted

attrs.rationale: Event Catalog table, row team.invitation_accepted. Category: Provider Team. Event nodes: EVT-team-invitation-accepted.

nodes.title: Catalog event: Team Member Role Changed

attrs.statement: Team Member Role Changed (team.member_role_changed) is an admin-configurable notification event. Primary recipients: Provider (the affected team member). Email telling the member the new role (FR-009 REQ-009-058)
attrs.rationale: Event Catalog table, row team.member_role_changed. Category: Provider Team. Event nodes: EVT-team-member-role-changed.

nodes.title: Catalog event: Team Member Removed

attrs.statement: Team Member Removed (team.member_removed) is an admin-configurable notification event. Primary recipients: Provider (the removed member), Provider Owner. Sent when a member is removed from the team (FR-009 REQ-009-081)
attrs.rationale: Event Catalog table, row team.member_removed. Category: Provider Team. Event nodes: EVT-team-member-removed.

nodes.title: Catalog event: Team Member Suspended or Reactivated

attrs.statement: Team Member Suspended or Reactivated (team.member_suspended / team.member_reactivated) is an admin-configurable notification event. Primary recipients: Provider (the affected team member). Sent to the member when a suspension is set and again when it is lifted (FR-009 REQ-009-082, REQ-009-192)
attrs.rationale: Event Catalog table, row team.member_suspended / team.member_reactivated. Category: Provider Team. Event nodes: EVT-team-member-suspended.

nodes.title: Catalog event: Owner Role Handed Over

attrs.statement: Owner Role Handed Over (team.owner_handover) is an admin-configurable notification event. Primary recipients: Provider Owner (the new Owner and the previous Owner). Email to both when a Hairline admin hands the Owner role to another team member (FR-009 REQ-009-174)
attrs.rationale: Event Catalog table, row team.owner_handover. Category: Provider Team. Event nodes: none (Rule only).

nodes.title: Catalog event: Team Invitation Delivery Failed

attrs.statement: Team Invitation Delivery Failed (team.invitation_delivery_failed) is an admin-configurable notification event. Primary recipients: Admin. Sent when an invitation email still fails once the retry rule is exhausted (FR-009 REQ-009-055)
attrs.rationale: Event Catalog table, row team.invitation_delivery_failed. Category: Provider Team. Event nodes: EVT-team-invitation-delivery-failed.

nodes.title: Catalog event: Aftercare Request Assigned

attrs.statement: Aftercare Request Assigned (aftercare.request_assigned) is an admin-configurable notification event. Primary recipients: Provider. Sent to the provider an aftercare request is assigned to (FR-011)
attrs.rationale: Event Catalog table, row aftercare.request_assigned. Category: Aftercare. Event nodes: EVT-aftercare-request-assigned.

nodes.title: Catalog event: Aftercare Payment Due

attrs.statement: Aftercare Payment Due (aftercare.payment_due) is an admin-configurable notification event. Primary recipients: Patient. Sent when payment for an aftercare request is due (FR-011)
attrs.rationale: Event Catalog table, row aftercare.payment_due. Category: Aftercare. Event nodes: EVT-aftercare-payment-due.

nodes.title: Catalog event: Aftercare Request Rejected or Expired
