Sent when an aftercare request is rejected or expires; for a request converted from a monitoring case the notice says the patient may start a new standalone request pre-filled from the same source data (FR-011 REQ-011-094)
attrs.rationale: Event Catalog table, row aftercare.request_rejected / aftercare.request_expired. Category: Aftercare. Event nodes: EVT-aftercare-request-rejected, EVT-aftercare-request-expired.

nodes.title: Catalog event: Aftercare Awaiting Provider Availability

attrs.statement: Aftercare Awaiting Provider Availability (aftercare.awaiting_availability) is an admin-configurable notification event. Primary recipients: Patient. Sent when an aftercare request is waiting for a provider to become available (FR-011)
attrs.rationale: Event Catalog table, row aftercare.awaiting_availability. Category: Aftercare. Event nodes: EVT-aftercare-awaiting-availability.

nodes.title: Catalog event: Aftercare Provider Withdrawn

attrs.statement: Aftercare Provider Withdrawn (aftercare.provider_withdrawn) is an admin-configurable notification event. Primary recipients: Admin. Sent when the provider of an aftercare case withdraws (FR-011)
attrs.rationale: Event Catalog table, row aftercare.provider_withdrawn. Category: Aftercare. Event nodes: EVT-aftercare-provider-withdrawn.

nodes.title: Catalog event: Aftercare Assigned to Hairline Team

attrs.statement: Aftercare Assigned to Hairline Team (aftercare.team_assigned) is an admin-configurable notification event. Primary recipients: Admin, aftercare team. Sent when an aftercare case is assigned to the Hairline team (FR-011)
attrs.rationale: Event Catalog table, row aftercare.team_assigned. Category: Aftercare. Event nodes: EVT-aftercare-team-assigned.

nodes.title: Catalog event: Aftercare Plan Setup Reminder and Escalation

attrs.statement: Aftercare Plan Setup Reminder and Escalation (aftercare.plan_setup_reminder / aftercare.plan_setup_escalated) is an admin-configurable notification event. Primary recipients: Provider (reminder), Admin (escalation). Sent when an aftercare plan is not finished: the assignee is reminded after 2 days and the case is escalated to the admin after 4 days; both day counts are admin settings (FR-011 REQ-011-090)
attrs.rationale: Event Catalog table, row aftercare.plan_setup_reminder / aftercare.plan_setup_escalated. Category: Aftercare. Event nodes: none (Rule only).

nodes.title: Catalog event: Provider Role Sync Failed

attrs.statement: Provider Role Sync Failed (system.role_sync_failed) is an admin-configurable notification event. Primary recipients: Admin (all Super Admins). In-app alert sent when a provider role permission change fails to reach the Provider Platform after the automatic retries (FR-031 REQ-031-130)
attrs.rationale: Event Catalog table, row system.role_sync_failed. Category: System/Operations. Event nodes: none (Rule only).

nodes.title: Catalog event: Recurring Export Paused

attrs.statement: Recurring Export Paused (analytics.recurring_export_paused) is an admin-configurable notification event. Primary recipients: Provider (the clinic Owner). In-app notice sent when a recurring export is paused because its owner was removed or lost access to a widget in it (FR-014 REQ-014-322)
attrs.rationale: Event Catalog table, row analytics.recurring_export_paused. Category: System/Operations. Event nodes: none (Rule only).

nodes.title: Catalog event: Recurring Export Failed

attrs.statement: Recurring Export Failed (analytics.recurring_export_failed) is an admin-configurable notification event. Primary recipients: Provider (the configuration owner). After the last retry of a scheduled run has failed, the person who set up the export gets an in-app notice (FR-014 REQ-014-323)
attrs.rationale: Event Catalog table, row analytics.recurring_export_failed. Category: System/Operations. Event nodes: none (Rule only).

nodes.title: Catalog event: Aftercare Team Message

attrs.statement: Aftercare Team Message (aftercare.team_message) is an admin-configurable notification event. Primary recipients: Patient. Sent when the aftercare team sends the patient a message or replies to the patient's Contact Support message (FR-011 REQ-011-103). Channels push and email; it opens the Messages list on the patient Aftercare Dashboard
attrs.rationale: Event Catalog table, row aftercare.team_message. Category: Aftercare.

nodes.title: Catalog event: Team Member Compliance Flag Raised

attrs.statement: Team Member Compliance Flag Raised (team.compliance_flag_raised) is an admin-configurable notification event. Primary recipients: Admin (compliance team). Sent to the admin compliance team when a compliance flag is raised on a provider team member (FR-009 REQ-009-135)
attrs.rationale: Event Catalog table, row team.compliance_flag_raised. Category: Provider Team. Event nodes: EVT-team-compliance-flag-raised.

nodes.title: Catalog event: Payout Statements Ready for Review

attrs.statement: Payout Statements Ready for Review (payout.statements_ready_for_review) is an admin-configurable notification event. Primary recipients: Admin. Sent when the cutoff-day job has created the payout statements for review: the notice says how many statements are ready and gives the payout date (FR-017 REQ-017-041). MVP default channels: Email + Push
attrs.rationale: Event Catalog table, row payout.statements_ready_for_review. Category: Billing/Payouts. Event nodes: EVT-billing-statements-ready-for-review.

nodes.title: Catalog event: Overdue Payout Alert

attrs.statement: Overdue Payout Alert (payout.statement_overdue) is an admin-configurable notification event. Primary recipients: Admin. Sent on payout day when a statement was not approved between the cutoff day and the payout day and became Overdue (FR-017 REQ-017-153, REQ-017-035). MVP default channels: Email + Push
attrs.rationale: Event Catalog table, row payout.statement_overdue. Category: Billing/Payouts. Event nodes: EVT-billing-overdue-payout-alert.

nodes.title: Catalog event: Outstanding Invoice Alert

attrs.statement: Outstanding Invoice Alert (payment.outstanding_invoice_alert) is an admin-configurable notification event. Primary recipients: Admin. Internal alert sent when a patient invoice has been overdue for the alert threshold, an admin setting in days overdue (default 7) (FR-017 REQ-017-182). MVP default channels: Email + Push
attrs.rationale: Event Catalog table, row payment.outstanding_invoice_alert. Category: Billing/Payouts. Event nodes: EVT-billing-outstanding-invoice-alert.

nodes.title: Super Admins invite admin team members by email

attrs.statement: System MUST allow Super Admins to invite new admin team members via email with role assignment; the invitation email is sent within 1 minute
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-031-001.

nodes.title: Custom roles with per-module granular permissions

attrs.statement: System MUST support creation of custom roles with granular permission assignment per admin module (A-01 through A-10)
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-031-002.

nodes.title: Role-based access control on every admin endpoint and component

attrs.statement: System MUST enforce role-based access control on all admin API endpoints and UI components
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-031-003.

nodes.title: Four predefined admin roles

attrs.statement: System MUST provide predefined admin roles: Super Admin, Aftercare Coordinator, Billing Admin, Support Staff
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-031-004.

nodes.title: Central configuration of provider role permissions

attrs.statement: System MUST provide centralized configuration for the permissions of the four provider roles (Owner, Manager, Clinical Staff, Billing Staff); no other provider roles exist
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-031-005; Tab 3 business rules.

nodes.title: Provider role permission changes sync to Provider Platform within 5 seconds

attrs.statement: System MUST automatically sync provider role permission changes to Provider Platform (FR-009) within 5 seconds
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-031-006. Sync indicator and timing wording: see the sync and propagation rules; other propagation wordings conflict (migration report decision list).

nodes.title: Owner role permissions cannot be reduced

attrs.statement: System MUST prevent modification of Owner role permissions that would remove full access to provider features, with the message: "Owner role must maintain full access to all provider features"
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-031-007.

nodes.title: Administrative actions logged in an immutable audit trail

attrs.statement: System MUST log all administrative actions (role changes, permission grants, user suspensions, access denials) in immutable audit trail
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-031-008. Business Rule 5 repeats this requirement (role changes, permission grants, user suspensions logged in the audit trail); merged here.

nodes.title: Super Admin accounts are never suspended, removed, demoted or self-deactivated in the product

attrs.statement: System MUST NOT allow a Super Admin account to be suspended by another user, or removed, demoted or self-deactivated inside the product (system protection; if ever needed, this is done outside the product). When another admin tries to suspend one, including one Super Admin trying to suspend another, the action is blocked with "A Super Admin account cannot be suspended. Super Admin accounts can only be changed outside the product." and both accounts stay active; when a Super Admin tries to change their own role or deactivate their own account, the action is blocked with "A Super Admin account cannot be demoted or deactivated in the product. This can only be done outside the product." The Admin Users tab shows no Change Role, Suspend or Delete action on a Super Admin row. An invitation for a Super Admin role is not yet an account: it can be cancelled or resent until it is accepted (REQ-031-127).
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-031-009; Tab 2 business rules; Business Rule 7; User Story 6. Business Rule 4 (at least one active Super Admin must exist at all times, system protection against lockout) is merged here. prd.md lines 1304-1310 (User Story 6 scenarios 1 to 3 give the two messages).

nodes.title: Email notifications for invitations, role changes, resets and denials

attrs.statement: System MUST send email notifications for: new invitations, role changes, password resets, repeated access denials
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-031-010.

nodes.title: Role changes carry an Effective From date and time

attrs.statement: System MUST support role assignment changes with **Effective From** date/time tracking (stored and auditable); the current role stays in force until Effective From
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-031-011. Business Rule 8 repeats this (role assignments stored with an Effective From timestamp; enforcement respects that date/time on authorization checks); merged here.

nodes.title: Admin user account data

attrs.statement: System MUST maintain admin user accounts with: email, name, password hash, assigned role, role effective date/time, pending role and its effective date/time, role change acknowledgement time, status (active/invited/suspended/deleted), creation date, last login timestamp
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-031-012; Key Entities, Entity 1. One admin user has one assigned role (Business Rule 1).

nodes.title: Role definition data

attrs.statement: System MUST maintain role definitions with: guard-scoped role name, description, assigned permissions (as permission matrix), and system/custom status (custom roles exist for admin roles only)
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-031-013. Key Entities, Entity 2.

nodes.title: Audit trail entry data

attrs.statement: System MUST maintain audit trail entries with: timestamp, user ID, action type (the access-control events listed on the user detail screen), action details, IP address, outcome (success/failed/denied)
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-031-014. Privacy Rule 2 (IP addresses logged for security audit purposes, GDPR-compliant logging) merged here. Key Entities, Entity 3.

nodes.title: Audit trail retention follows the platform retention period

attrs.statement: Audit trail retention follows the system PRD, Platform-Wide Rules: One 10-year retention period
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-031-015; Privacy Rule 1; Admin Editability (fixed in codebase). The period is owned by the system Rule One 10-year retention period.

nodes.title: MFA-ready architecture

attrs.statement: System MUST be architected to support Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) integration as a planned Post-MVP requirement (per Constitution Principle II)
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-031-016.

nodes.title: bcrypt password hashing

attrs.statement: System MUST use bcrypt (cost factor 12+) for password hashing
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-031-017. Technical requirement, kept because the PRD numbers it; Admin Editability lists the algorithm as fixed in codebase.

nodes.title: JWT tokens signed with RS256

attrs.statement: System MUST sign JWT tokens with RS256 (asymmetric encryption) to prevent tampering
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-031-019. Technical requirement, kept because the PRD numbers it.

nodes.title: Authorization evaluated server-side on every call

attrs.statement: System MUST perform server-side authorization evaluation on each API call based on current role assignments and permission matrices; JWT tokens MUST NOT be the authoritative source of permissions
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-031-020. Business Rule 3 repeats this (latest role assignment and permission matrix evaluated on every API call; caching allowed only if invalidated within 5 seconds; enforcement reflects changes on the next API call after invalidation); merged here.

nodes.title: Suspended accounts rejected from the next request

attrs.statement: System MUST invalidate active sessions (and/or reject access tokens) immediately upon account suspension; at minimum, all API calls MUST be rejected for suspended accounts starting with the next request
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-031-021.

nodes.title: Admin PII anonymised on deletion request

attrs.statement: System MUST anonymize admin user PII (email, name) on account deletion request, while preserving audit trail with anonymized identifier
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-031-022. The GDPR Compliance line in Data and Privacy Rules (email and name anonymised, audit trail preserved with anonymised identifiers) is merged here.

nodes.title: Email delivery through the Notification Service

attrs.statement: System MUST send the admin invitation, role change and password reset emails through the platform notification service defined in FR-020
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-031-023. Cross-FR citation: FR-020 Notification Service (S-03); the general duty to send through the service is the FR-020 Rule.

nodes.title: Permission check API for admin modules

attrs.statement: System MUST provide permission check API for all admin modules to enforce access control
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-031-024. Technical requirement, kept because the PRD numbers it.

nodes.title: Permission matrix cached for fast checks

attrs.statement: System MUST cache permission matrix in memory for fast authorization checks (< 50ms per check)
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-031-025. Technical requirement, kept because the PRD numbers it.

nodes.title: Permission cache invalidated within 5 seconds

attrs.statement: System MUST invalidate permission cache within 5 seconds of role or permission changes
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-031-026. Business Rule 3 also states the 5-second invalidation limit.

nodes.title: Entry points to access control

attrs.statement: Super Admins access this module via "Settings > User Roles & Permissions" in the Admin Platform. The module is hidden from non-Super Admin users. The first Super Admin account is created during platform deployment/installation; later admin accounts are created through the invitation flow. Super Admins configure role permissions and invite admin team members; provider owners invite their team members (FR-009) but cannot configure role permissions.
attrs.rationale: Entry Points section; Data Dependencies (Admin User Accounts).

nodes.title: Module restricted to Super Admins

attrs.statement: Only Super Admins can access this module; regular admin users and providers cannot view or modify role permissions. The module is a Super Admin-only configuration tool and the single source of truth for role definitions and permission matrices across the platform.
attrs.rationale: Stated in the Executive Summary, Admin Platform scope, Entry Points and Screen 4 Access Control.

nodes.title: Provider Platform only enforces, never configures

attrs.statement: Provider Platform consumes and enforces the RBAC rules defined in the Admin Platform (FR-031) and has no configuration UI: provider users do not see or access role permission configuration, and Provider Platform reads permission matrices read-only and applies them when provider team members access features.
attrs.rationale: Provider Platform scope. Provider team member invitation and role assignment stay in FR-009; the permission definitions for those roles come from FR-031.

nodes.title: MVP exclusions for admin notifications and sign-in

attrs.statement: No SMS admin notifications are available in MVP; SMS will only be enabled if and when S-03 adds SMS delivery in a later phase. Real-time permission updates via WebSocket and external identity provider integration (OAuth, SAML) are V2 enhancements and out of scope.
attrs.rationale: Communication Structure, Out of Scope.

nodes.title: Permission changes notified by email to affected admin users

attrs.statement: System sends an email notification to the affected admin users when the permissions of their role change.
attrs.rationale: Communication Structure lists permission-change email as in scope; REQ-031-010 names invitations, role changes, password resets and repeated access denials but not permission changes.

nodes.title: Invitation form fields and limits

attrs.statement: The invitation form requires first name, last name, email address and an assigned role. First and last name are 2 to 50 characters (letters, spaces, hyphens only); the email is converted to lowercase; phone number is optional (E.164 format); personal message is optional but recommended for first-time team setup (max 500 characters, included in the invitation email). The form cannot be submitted until all required fields pass validation.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 data fields and business rules; Main Flow steps 6 to 7. prd.md lines 429 (personal message is optional but recommended for first-time team setup).

nodes.title: Invitation email format validated inline

attrs.statement: System validates the email format on blur or submit and shows the inline error "Please enter a valid email address"; after the Super Admin corrects it, the system re-validates and allows submission. Only valid email addresses are accepted.
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow B1; Screen 2 validation messages.

nodes.title: Duplicate admin email blocked

attrs.statement: System checks the invitation email against all admin users (active, suspended, invited) and pending invitations; a duplicate is blocked with the error "This email is already associated with an admin account. Please use a different email or check existing team members." and the system suggests "View team member" or, if the invitation is pending, "Resend invitation". The existing record is kept.
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow B2 and Screen 2 (one message in both places).

nodes.title: Any admin role can be assigned

attrs.statement: The role dropdown on the invitation form is populated from the admin roles, including custom admin roles, and shows role name plus a brief description on hover; an expandable role permission summary is shown below it, and a role must be selected ("Please select a role for this team member."). Every existing role can be assigned to new or existing users; roles have no active or inactive status and cannot be deactivated.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 business rules and notes; Data Dependencies (State: Active Roles).

nodes.title: Invitation token expiry

attrs.statement: Invitation tokens expire after the configured invitation expiry (7 days, 168 hours, at launch), which a Super Admin can set through A-09 settings within a range of 1 to 30 days.
attrs.rationale: Business Rule 6; Screen 2; Admin Editability (Editable and Configurable with Restrictions); Main Flow step 10.

nodes.title: Invitation email content and preview

attrs.statement: The invitation email carries the invitation link, Hairline Admin Platform branding and the role being offered, plus the personal message when provided. Before sending, the form can preview the email (invitee name, role, personal message, invitation link placeholder) and shows "Invitation will expire in [N] days on [date] at [time]". After sending, it shows "Invitation sent to [email]. They have [N] days to accept." N is the configured invitation expiry.
attrs.rationale: Main Flow steps 10 to 13; Screen 2 actions and notes.

nodes.title: Invitation status on the account

attrs.statement: When an invitation is sent, System creates the new admin user's account with the assigned role and status "Invited" and records the invitation on it. The invitation shows "Accepted" when the account is set up (the account then becomes Active), "Expired" when the token has passed its expiry, when Cancel is used on Admin Account Setup, or when it still cannot be sent 24 hours after it was created, and "Pending Send" while the email cannot be delivered. The Pending Invitations sub-tab shows each invitation's status.
attrs.rationale: Main Flow steps 12 and 21; Alternative Flows A1 and B4; Screen 3 Cancel. The account status before acceptance is "Pending"; "Pending Send" is the invitation status while sending fails (REQ-031-043).

nodes.title: Invitation link validated before the setup form

attrs.statement: When the invitee opens the invitation link, System validates the token (not expired, not already used) before showing the Admin Account Setup screen pre-filled with email, first name and last name. An expired or invalid token redirects to an error page with a "Request New Invitation" option. Request New Invitation notifies all Super Admins (REQ-031-128).
attrs.rationale: Main Flow steps 15 to 16; Screen 3 business rules.

nodes.title: Used invitation link shows a login message

attrs.statement: If the invitation link was already accepted, System shows "This invitation has already been used. Please log in with your existing credentials." and a login link, so no duplicate account is created.
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow B3.

nodes.title: Super Admin can resend an invitation

attrs.statement: A Super Admin can resend an invitation for an invitation that is still pending (Invited or Pending Send) or has expired: System generates a new token, sends a new email, and invalidates the old token. The invitee receives a fresh invitation with a new expiry. The Pending Invitations sub-tab shows a notification dot when invitations are about to expire (< 24 hours).
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow A1; Admin Editability (re-send invitation emails for pending accounts); Screen 2 B2 suggestion; Screen 1 Tab 2 notes.

nodes.title: Invitation email delivery failure follows the FR-030 retry rule

attrs.statement: If the invitation email fails to send, System logs each failed delivery in the audit trail and retries under the notification retry rule owned by FR-030 (this flow sets no retry count or interval of its own). From the first failed delivery the invitation shows "Pending Send" and the Super Admin is warned "Invitation created but the email could not be sent yet. The system retries under the notification rule, and you can resend the invitation yourself. The invitation expires if it is still unsent after 24 hours."; if the invitation still cannot be sent 24 hours after it was created, it becomes "Expired" and the system alerts the admin team. The Super Admin can resend the invitation.
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow B4; Edge Case 3; External Dependencies (failure handling); Integration 2. The retry rule is FR-030 General Module Rule 7.

nodes.title: Account setup pre-filled fields

attrs.statement: On Admin Account Setup, the email is pre-filled from the invitation and cannot be edited; first and last name are required, pre-filled but editable (2-50 characters; letters, spaces, hyphens only). The screen shows the assigned role ("You've been invited as [Role Name]"), the Super Admin's personal message when provided, and an invitation expiry countdown when less than 24 hours remain.
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 data fields, business rules and notes. The invitation form (Screen 2) allows names up to 50 characters without a 2-character minimum. prd.md lines 459-460 (First Name and Last Name: Required Yes).

nodes.title: Password confirmation and weak-password messages

attrs.statement: On Admin Account Setup, Password and Confirm Password are required and Confirm Password must match Password exactly ("Passwords do not match."). A password that does not meet the policy is rejected with "Password must be at least 12 characters with uppercase, lowercase, number, and special character from !@#$%^&(),.?\":{}|<>."
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 data fields and validation messages. The password policy itself is REQ-031-018 (defined in FR-026). prd.md lines 462-463 (Password and Confirm Password: Required Yes).

nodes.title: Admin Terms of Service acceptance required

attrs.statement: The new admin user must accept the Admin Terms of Service ("You must accept the Admin Terms of Service to continue."); "Create Account" stays disabled until all required fields are valid and terms are accepted. Acceptance belongs to this feature; the legal text is managed in FR-027.
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 data fields and business rules; Main Flow step 17 and 19.

nodes.title: Cancelling account setup invalidates the invitation

attrs.statement: Cancel on Admin Account Setup returns to the login page and invalidates the invitation token; the invitation then shows as "Expired".
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 actions. The Super Admin can resend the invitation (Alternative Flow A1).

nodes.title: Phone optional until MFA arrives

attrs.statement: The phone number is optional for now (E.164 format) because MFA enrollment will be added in a future enhancement; Admin Account Setup shows an MFA enrollment section marked "Coming Soon" with the note "Multi-factor authentication will be required in future updates".
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 and Screen 3 business rules and notes. Related to REQ-031-016.

nodes.title: Account creation completes onboarding

attrs.statement: When the new admin user clicks Create Account, System validates all inputs, sets the account Active with the role from the invitation, marks the invitation "Accepted", logs the account creation in the audit trail, sends a confirmation email to both the new admin user and the Super Admin who sent the invitation, shows "Account created successfully! Redirecting to login..." and redirects to the admin login page after 3 seconds. The new admin user can log in immediately.
attrs.rationale: Main Flow steps 17 to 25; Screen 3 Success Flow. User Story 1 expects the invitation email within 1 minute and the account status "Pending" before acceptance.

nodes.title: Every admin user holds exactly one role

attrs.statement: All admin users MUST have exactly one role assigned (no "roleless" accounts); one role can be assigned to many admin users.
attrs.rationale: Business Rule 1; Key Entities, Entity 1 (one admin user has one assigned role).

nodes.title: Super Admin role is locked to full access

attrs.statement: The Super Admin role MUST always have full system access and cannot be restricted: its permissions cannot be edited or removed, its checkboxes are disabled, and it stays locked in the matrix view.
attrs.rationale: Business Rule 2; Screen 1 Tab 1 rules; Screen 4 Admin Role Protection and Matrix Mode rules; Admin Editability (fixed in codebase).

nodes.title: Super Admin row actions

attrs.statement: Edit Permissions and Clone Role are disabled for the Super Admin role; View Users stays available.
attrs.rationale: Tab 1 data fields (Actions).

nodes.title: Suspended admin users cannot log in

attrs.statement: Suspended admin users cannot log in but their accounts remain in the system (soft suspension); Super Admin accounts are never suspended inside the product. Super Admins can suspend (with a required reason), reactivate, and delete a suspended non-Super Admin account (REQ-031-126).
attrs.rationale: Business Rule 7; Tab 2 business rules and actions; Admin Editability. REQ-031-021 covers rejection of API calls.

nodes.title: Super Admins assign and change admin roles

attrs.statement: A Super Admin can assign or change the role of any admin user except Super Admin accounts.
attrs.rationale: Admin Editability (Editable by Super Admin); Alternative Flow A2.

nodes.title: System role names are immutable

attrs.statement: Role names of system-defined roles (admin and provider) MUST be immutable (not editable or renamable); the system admin roles are Super Admin, Aftercare Coordinator, Billing Admin and Support Staff, and the protected provider roles are Owner, Manager, Clinical Staff and Billing Staff. Only custom admin roles can be renamed.
attrs.rationale: Business Rule 9; Screen 4 role name field (locked for system-defined roles); Admin Editability (fixed in codebase); Tab 1 and Tab 3 role name rules.

nodes.title: System roles cannot be deleted

attrs.statement: System admin roles (Super Admin, Aftercare Coordinator, Billing Admin, Support Staff) cannot be deleted; all of them except Super Admin can be edited. The four provider roles cannot be renamed or removed.
attrs.rationale: Tab 1 and Tab 3 business rules.

nodes.title: Custom admin roles lifecycle

attrs.statement: Custom admin roles can be created, edited, and deleted (deleted only while no admin user, including an Invited account, and no pending role change holds the role). A role name is unique within the role's guard (max 50 characters) and a role description is required (max 500 characters). Clone Role creates a new custom admin role based on an existing role, named "Copy of [role name]" and cut to 50 characters.
attrs.rationale: Tab 1 business rules and actions; Screen 4 data fields; Admin Editability. Custom roles exist for admin roles only; the four provider roles are fixed.

nodes.title: Create custom admin role

attrs.statement: To create a custom admin role the Super Admin enters a role name and description and selects permissions in the permission matrix; System shows a permission summary with potential conflicts and warnings, validates a unique role name and at least one permission, saves the role, logs the creation in the audit trail, and lists the role in the Admin Roles tab and in the role dropdown for team member assignment.
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow A3.

nodes.title: Configured matrix outranks the FR-009 default role descriptions

attrs.statement: Provider role descriptions in FR-009 are recommended defaults; the permission matrix configured in FR-031 is authoritative and may grant additional access (for example, Clinical Staff granted read-only financial reporting).
attrs.rationale: Provider Role Permission Rules (Provider Rule 1).

nodes.title: Core permission categories fixed

attrs.statement: Core permission categories (such as Patient Management, Provider Management and Billing) cannot be renamed or removed.
attrs.rationale: Admin Editability (fixed in codebase).

nodes.title: Provider permission changes reach every holder of the role

attrs.statement: Provider role permission changes affect all provider team members with that role across all providers and are enforced on their next API call.
attrs.rationale: Tab 3 business rules; Alternative Flow A4 step 16 and outcome.

nodes.title: Super Admin-only permissions

attrs.statement: The admin permissions Edit Settings, Manage Users and Manage Roles are write permissions reserved for Super Admin only. The following actions are also Super Admin only: the Manage Localization actions of FR-021 (editing English source values, changing the default language, publishing, rollback, moving a language to Active, the free-text translation switch and budget, and machine translation credentials), the Affiliate Program Settings panel and the commission ceiling override under Manage Affiliates, Login as Provider (REQ-015-069), and the Support Center settings (Screen 7 of FR-034) and the support audit export (REQ-034-094).
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 System Settings category (A-09); permission field is_super_admin_only.

nodes.title: Provider permissions limited to named roles

attrs.statement: Provider permissions Edit Billing Settings and Edit Settings are Owner only; Document Treatment is limited to Owner or Clinical Staff (not Manager); Remove Team Members is limited to Owner (any non-Owner member) or Manager (Clinical Staff and Billing Staff only); Invite Team Members and Edit Team Member Roles (non-Owner) are limited to Owner or Manager, and a Manager may invite or set only Clinical Staff and Billing Staff and cannot create a Manager.
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 provider permission categories (PR-03, PR-05, PR-06, PR-01). Owner ruling 2026-11-25: Edit Billing Settings stays Owner only and cannot be granted to any other role; only View Billing Settings is grantable (REQ-031-118).

nodes.title: Issue Refunds requires approval

attrs.statement: The admin permission Issue Refunds is a write permission that requires approval by another admin holding the permission, never the requester; FR-007 owns the approval step and its 2-business-day escalation. While only one admin holds the permission, a refund that needs approval stays "awaiting approval" until a second holder exists.
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 Billing & Financial category (A-05), access level "Write (requires approval)". FR-007 owns the approval rule (REQ-007-015).

nodes.title: A write permission selects its View automatically

attrs.statement: Permission dependencies apply across all roles: selecting any write permission that has a matching View permission (such as Edit Patients, Manage Aftercare or Moderate Reviews) automatically selects that View permission (for example "Edit Patients" requires "View Patients") and the dependency is highlighted.
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 Both Modes and Validation; Matrix Mode business rules; Alternative Flow A6 (dependency validation).

nodes.title: A role cannot be saved with zero permissions

attrs.statement: System prevents saving a role with zero permissions: at least one permission is required.
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 Both Modes; Single Role data fields (Permission Categories).

nodes.title: Permissions organised by module code

attrs.statement: Permissions are organised by module code (A-01, A-02 for admin; PR-01, PR-02 for provider) for traceability, and a Select All checkbox is available for each category. Select All skips the Super Admin-only permissions.
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 Both Modes.

nodes.title: Sensitive permission warning

attrs.statement: When a permission matrix is saved with a newly granted sensitive permission, and again when a role holding one is assigned to a user, System shows a warning modal "This role grants access to sensitive features: [Issue Refunds, Process Payouts, Manage Users]. Confirm?" together with the full permission summary; the Super Admin either confirms or cancels. Sensitive permissions are all financial write permissions (refunds, payouts, payment settings), Manage Roles, Manage Users and Delete Patients.
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow B6; Screen 4 Validation. Key Entities Permission has no sensitive flag; ENT-permission.is_sensitive was added (orphan field).

nodes.title: Impact confirmation before saving permission changes

attrs.statement: Before saving, System shows a confirmation "This will affect [X] users. Continue?"; for provider roles "This will affect [Y] team members across [Z] provider organizations. Continue?" and the headers warn "Changes will affect all provider organizations". When removing critical permissions it warns "This will remove access to [feature] for all Clinical Staff members" and shows the count of affected provider team members. In matrix mode the confirmation lists all affected roles and user counts.
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow A4 steps 8, 9; Screen 4 Validation and header; Tab 3 business rules and notes ("This change will affect [X] providers and [Y] team members"); Matrix Mode business rules.

nodes.title: Permission comparison shown before confirming

attrs.statement: System shows a permission comparison before a change is confirmed: current versus new role permissions with the effective date/time on a role change, and additions and removals on a provider permission edit. After a provider role save it shows "Provider role permissions updated. Changes reach all [Role] members within 5 seconds and apply on their next request."
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flows A2 step 7 and A4 steps 7 and 15. The "next page load" wording conflicts with next API call and 5 seconds elsewhere; see the migration report decision list.

nodes.title: Reset to Default and Preview Impact

attrs.statement: In Single Role Mode, Reset to Default resets a predefined role to its default permissions (the full default tables, REQ-031-134) and is not offered on custom roles, and Preview Impact shows which users and providers will be affected by the changes. In matrix mode, Reset Role to Default resets the selected predefined roles and asks for confirmation when unsaved changes exist.
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 modal actions (both modes).

nodes.title: Matrix comparison view

attrs.statement: The matrix view shows permissions as rows grouped by category/module and all roles of the same type (Admin or Provider, including custom admin roles) as columns, with checkboxes or access-level indicators. Super Admins can edit several roles at once and save all changes together; bulk actions are Select All on a column header, Select All on a row header, and Select Category, all of which skip the Super Admin-only permissions (their cells stay disabled for every role other than Super Admin); locked cells (Super Admin, Owner) show a lock icon and a disabled checkbox. The matrix can be filtered by category, searched by permission name, set to show only differences, sorted by role or permission, and exported to CSV or Excel.
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 View Mode 2 (layout, features, modal actions, business rules). The example matrices are illustrative; see the migration report decision list.

nodes.title: Unsaved permission changes are protected

attrs.statement: System tracks all permission changes against the saved state and shows a confirmation dialog ("Unsaved Changes" / "You have unsaved changes. Are you sure you want to discard them?" with Discard Changes, Save Changes and Cancel) when the user clicks Cancel, closes the modal with X or a backdrop click, switches between Single Role and Matrix view, or navigates away from the page. With no changes the modal closes immediately; the header shows an "Unsaved changes" indicator while changes exist.
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 Unsaved Changes Protection.

nodes.title: Provider sync status shown

attrs.statement: The Provider Roles tab shows "Last synced to Provider Platform: [timestamp]". A role whose sync failed shows "Sync failed" and "not yet applied" until a retry succeeds (REQ-031-130).
attrs.rationale: Tab 3 notes.

nodes.title: Role user counts displayed

attrs.statement: Users Count (admin roles) and Total Users (provider roles) show, display-only, the number of admin users holding the role or the number of provider team members holding it across all providers. On the admin tab the count can be clicked to filter the Admin Users tab; View Users on a provider role links to FR-015 (Provider Management).
attrs.rationale: Tab 1 and Tab 3 data fields and actions.

nodes.title: Permission change audit content

attrs.statement: A permission change is logged in the audit trail with a before/after permission comparison: role name, permissions added and removed, affected provider count where applicable, timestamp and actor.
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 Both Modes; Alternative Flow A4 step 13; User Story 3 scenario 4.

nodes.title: Role change for an existing admin user

attrs.statement: To change an admin user's role, the Super Admin opens Change Role, picks the new role and sets Effective From (default now); System shows the permission comparison and effective date/time, requires confirmation, validates that Effective From is not before now, and stores the new role as the user's pending role with its Effective From; the current role stays in force until then and a second change made before then replaces the pending one (REQ-031-125). At Effective From the pending role becomes the user's role and System enforces its permissions on the first API call at or after that time.
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow A2; Business Rule 8 and REQ-031-011.

nodes.title: Role change audit entry

attrs.statement: System logs a role change in the audit trail with who changed it, the old role, the new role, effective_from and the timestamp.
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow A2 step 11.

nodes.title: Role change email content

attrs.statement: System emails the affected user about a role change, including the effective date/time, the old role, the new role and a summary of permission changes; User Story 5 expects it within 5 minutes. When a user then opens a feature they no longer have, access is denied with "Your permissions have changed. You no longer have access to this feature."
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow A2 step 12; User Story 5 scenarios 1 and 3.

nodes.title: Warning banner while only one Super Admin exists

attrs.statement: A warning banner "Warning: Only one Super Admin account. Consider adding backup admin. Refunds that need approval are blocked until a second admin holds Issue Refunds." is shown on the Admin Users tab while only one Active Super Admin account exists (Invited, Suspended and Deleted accounts do not count). No Super Admin can be demoted, removed or deactivated inside the product (REQ-031-009).
attrs.rationale: User Story 6 scenario 3; Tab 2 notes.

nodes.title: Concurrent role changes

attrs.statement: If two Super Admins change the same user's role at once, database-level locking prevents concurrent updates: the second Super Admin receives "Role change failed - this user's role was just updated by another admin. Refresh and try again." and the audit trail logs both attempts with their outcomes (success, failed).
attrs.rationale: Edge Case 2.

nodes.title: Active session survives a role change until the next API call

attrs.statement: When a role changes during an active session, the session stays valid until the next API call; that call checks the updated permissions and enforces the new role (the user may see a permission-denied result) and the session is not forcibly terminated.
attrs.rationale: Edge Case 1.

nodes.title: Hide first, deny second

attrs.statement: On page load, System checks the user's permissions and hides menu items, buttons, tabs and sections for features the user cannot access, on both the Admin and Provider platforms. Only when hiding is not feasible (direct URL access, shared pages with partial access) does it deny access.
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow B5 step 1, 2 and Note; Screen 4 UI Enforcement.

nodes.title: Access denial message and log

attrs.statement: When access is denied System shows "Access Denied: You do not have permission to access this feature. Contact your administrator if you need access." and logs the denial in the audit trail (user, feature, timestamp, IP address).
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow B5 steps 4 and 5; Screen 5 business rules (requested feature/endpoint). User Story 4 scenario 2 lists the same fields.

nodes.title: Repeated access denial alerts Super Admin

attrs.statement: System sends an alert to Super Admin when one admin is refused access 5 times within 10 minutes (launch default; the count and the time window are each an admin setting in A-09; potential security issue).
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow B5 step 6; Communication Structure (system notifications for access denial attempts); Admin Editability (Configurable with Restrictions).

nodes.title: Sensitive feature access logged

attrs.statement: All access to sensitive features (billing, patient medical data, provider financial data) MUST be logged with timestamp, user ID, action, IP address and outcome.
attrs.rationale: Data & Privacy Rules (Audit Rule).

nodes.title: Password reset requests logged

attrs.statement: Password reset requests are logged in the audit trail with the requester's identity.
attrs.rationale: Data & Privacy Rules (Privacy Rule 3).

nodes.title: Super Admin sends a password reset

attrs.statement: Super Admins can send a password reset from the user detail page, which forces a password reset on the user's next login. An account still in the Invited status does not support password reset (no password set yet): the user must request a new invitation from a Super Admin, and the original invitation token is invalidated to prevent duplicate accounts.
attrs.rationale: Screen 5 notes; Edge Case 4.

nodes.title: Audit trail view

attrs.statement: The audit trail on the user detail page shows the last 30 days by default, 100 rows at a time with a Load More option, and the date range filter reaches further back; it shows access-control events only (REQ-031-132). Each row shows timestamp, action type (Login, Role Change, Permission Grant, Access Denied, Password Reset, User Suspended, User Reactivated, User Deleted, Account Created, Role Created, Role Deleted, Role Permissions Edited, Invitation Sent, Invitation Resent, Invitation Cancelled, Invitation Delivery Failed, Sensitive Access), details, IP address and outcome (Success, Failed, Denied). Sensitive actions (role changes, permission grants) are highlighted, and role change events offer a comparison of old and new role permissions. Login failures are logged with the reason (invalid password, account suspended, and so on).
attrs.rationale: Screen 5. Filtering by action type, date range and outcome is specified in FR-022 REQ-022-117 (cited, not restated). The PRD names six action types in Key Entities but four on the screen.

nodes.title: Audit trail export

attrs.statement: The audit trail can be exported to CSV for compliance reporting, with all entries and the columns timestamp, user, action, details, IP address and outcome.
attrs.rationale: Screen 5 business rules; User Story 4 scenario 3.

nodes.title: Suspicious activity alerts on user detail

attrs.statement: The user detail page displays security alerts when suspicious activity is detected (multiple failed logins, unusual access patterns).
attrs.rationale: Screen 5 notes. No thresholds are defined.

nodes.title: Audit write failure blocks critical admin actions

attrs.statement: If an audit trail write fails, critical actions (role changes, suspensions) are buffered in memory and retried on database reconnection; if the buffer is full or the database is unavailable for an extended period, admin actions are temporarily blocked with "System maintenance in progress. Please try again shortly." and an alert goes to the infrastructure team immediately (audit trail failure is a critical security issue).
attrs.rationale: Edge Case 5; Implementation Notes (audit writes buffered, alert on audit write failure).

nodes.title: Admin user list paging, sorting and export

attrs.statement: The Admin Users list shows 25 users per page with a Load More option and can be sorted by Name (A-Z), Last Login (most recent first) and Role (alphabetical); the user list can be exported to CSV with all columns and the applied filters. Search and filters are specified in FR-022 REQ-022-115.
attrs.rationale: Tab 2 business rules and notes.

nodes.title: Authentication limits configurable in A-09

attrs.statement: The maximum failed login attempts before lockout (default 5 failed attempts with a 15-minute lockout, the same setting as FR-001; the admin login rate limit of REQ-031-100 is a separate control and whichever trips first applies, REQ-026-116), the session timeout duration (the admin inactivity timeout of A-09, whole minutes from 5 to 240, default 30) and the number of concurrent sessions per admin user (default 3, range 1-5; at the limit a new sign-in ends the oldest session; a change to the limit or to the inactivity timeout applies from each open session's next request, and sessions above a lowered limit end oldest first; REQ-026-116) are configurable in A-09 Authentication Settings.
attrs.rationale: Admin Editability (Configurable with Restrictions). The session timeout is the admin inactivity timeout SET-admin-inactivity-timeout (FR-026); the lockout default is the FR-001 / FR-026 lockout setting. The admin login rate limit (REQ-031-100) is a separate control.

nodes.title: Admin login rate limit

attrs.statement: The admin login endpoint is rate-limited to prevent brute-force attacks (max 5 attempts per 15 minutes).
attrs.rationale: Implementation Notes, Security Considerations (threat mitigation). Promoted as a business rule because it states a numeric limit. How it relates to the configurable lockout threshold is unstated; see the migration report decision list.

nodes.title: Admin permissions: Dashboard & Overview (A-01)

attrs.statement: Permission category "Dashboard & Overview" (A-01) in the admin permission matrix offers: View Dashboard (Access main admin dashboard; Read); View Patient Overview (View patients across all lifecycle stages; Read).
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 permission matrix structure, admin platform categories. Rows copied from the PRD table (Permission, Description, Access Level).

nodes.title: Admin permissions: Patient Management (A-01)

attrs.statement: Permission category "Patient Management" (A-01) in the admin permission matrix offers: View Patients (View patient list and profiles; Read); Edit Patients (Modify patient information and run patient account actions: reset password, unlock account, lift suspension and take action on a flagged conversation (FR-016); Write); Delete Patients (Approve patient account deletion requests (FR-016); Delete).
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 permission matrix structure, admin platform categories. Rows copied from the PRD table (Permission, Description, Access Level).

nodes.title: Admin permissions: Provider Management (A-02)

attrs.statement: Permission category "Provider Management" (A-02) in the admin permission matrix offers: View Providers (View provider list and profiles; Read); Edit Providers (Modify provider information; Write); Onboard Providers (Create new provider accounts; Write); Suspend Providers (Suspend/activate provider accounts, including Reject Request on an account-closure request; Delete).
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 permission matrix structure, admin platform categories. Rows copied from the PRD table (Permission, Description, Access Level).

nodes.title: Admin permissions: Aftercare Management (A-03)

attrs.statement: Permission category "Aftercare Management" (A-03) in the admin permission matrix offers: View Aftercare Cases (View aftercare patient list; Read); Manage Aftercare (Assign specialists, edit plans; Write); Chat with Patients (Access aftercare chat; Write); Schedule Consultations (Book video consultations; Write). When the Hairline team delivers a case, the Aftercare Coordinator uses these permissions on the FR-011 admin aftercare Screens 13 to 19, including Screen 14 Tab 4 (plan configuration, extension or change proposals and the urgent flag); no separate coordinator screens exist (REQ-011-004).
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 permission matrix structure, admin platform categories. Rows copied from the PRD table (Permission, Description, Access Level).

nodes.title: Admin permissions: Quotes & Inquiries Oversight (A-01)

attrs.statement: Permission category "Quotes & Inquiries Oversight" (A-01) in the admin permission matrix offers: View Inquiries Overview (View all inquiries across lifecycle stages; Read); View Quote Details (View all quotes per inquiry; Read); Edit Quotes (Modify quotes (provider cancellations, rescheduling); Write); Reassign Providers (Manually assign/reassign providers to inquiries; Write).
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 permission matrix structure, admin platform categories. Rows copied from the PRD table (Permission, Description, Access Level).

nodes.title: Admin permissions: Reviews & Ratings Management (A-01)

attrs.statement: Permission category "Reviews & Ratings Management" (A-01) in the admin permission matrix offers: View Reviews (View all patient reviews; Read); Moderate Reviews (Decide takedown requests, remove a review, remove a provider response and resolve a flag; Write); Add Reviews (Import authenticated reviews for providers; Write); Manage Review Categories (Configure review categories and labels; Write); Manage Review Settings (Configure photo guidelines, the removal reason catalog, flagging and the takedown decision deadline; Write); Export Reviews (Export review data (audited); Read).
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 permission matrix structure, admin platform categories. Rows copied from the PRD table (Permission, Description, Access Level).

nodes.title: Admin permissions: Billing & Financial (A-05)

attrs.statement: Permission category "Billing & Financial" (A-05) in the admin permission matrix offers: View Transactions (View patient and provider transactions; Read); Process Payouts (Run provider payout actions in FR-017: approve, unapprove, void, mark as paid, retry, release earnings, clear Manual Review Required, write off a clinic balance and override a payout status; each money-moving action asks for financial re-authentication (REQ-017-047); Write); Issue Refunds (Process patient refunds; Write (requires approval by another admin holding this permission, never the requester; the approval step and its 2-business-day escalation are defined in FR-007; while only one admin holds this permission, a refund that needs approval stays awaiting approval until a second holder exists)); View Financial Reports (Access revenue analytics; Read); View Patient Billing (View patient invoices and payment status; Read); Send Payment Reminders (Send payment reminders to patients (FR-007, FR-016); held by default by the same roles as Retry Charge; Write); Retry Charge (Retry a failed patient payment charge (FR-007B); Write); Resolve Installments (Record a manual bank transfer for an unpaid installment and approve one entered by a colleague; the approver is never the requester; Write); Download Invoices (Download patient/provider invoices; Read).
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 permission matrix structure, admin platform categories. Rows copied from the PRD table (Permission, Description, Access Level).

nodes.title: Admin permissions: Promotions & Discounts (A-06)

attrs.statement: Permission category "Promotions & Discounts" (A-06) in the admin permission matrix offers: View Discounts (View all discount codes (Hairline and provider); Read); Create Discounts (Create platform-wide discount codes; Write); Edit Discounts (Modify discount parameters; Write); Track Discount Usage (View discount statistics and ROI; Read); Manage Admin Campaign Adoptions (Manage provider accept/decline participation and admin override actions for admin-created both-fees campaigns; Write).
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 permission matrix structure, admin platform categories. Rows copied from the PRD table (Permission, Description, Access Level).

nodes.title: Admin permissions: Affiliate Management (A-07)

attrs.statement: Permission category "Affiliate Management" (A-07) in the admin permission matrix offers: View Affiliates (View affiliate list and details; Read); Manage Affiliates (Add affiliates, edit profiles and commission rules, generate codes, suspend, reinstate, offboard and ban; Write (the Affiliate Program Settings panel and the commission ceiling override stay Super Admin only)); Process Affiliate Payouts (Process affiliate commission payments; Write); View Affiliate Performance (View referral counts and conversions; Read).
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 permission matrix structure, admin platform categories. Rows copied from the PRD table (Permission, Description, Access Level).

nodes.title: Admin permissions: Analytics & Reporting (A-08)

attrs.statement: Permission category "Analytics & Reporting" (A-08) in the admin permission matrix offers: View Analytics Dashboard (Access platform-wide analytics overview; Read); View Provider Analytics (View provider performance metrics; Read); View Financial Analytics (View revenue and conversion analytics; Read); Export Reports (Export analytics reports (PDF/CSV); gates nothing yet, because FR-014 offers admins no analytics export (REQ-014-315); Read); View Treatment Outcomes (Access treatment outcomes analytics; Read).
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 permission matrix structure, admin platform categories. Rows copied from the PRD table (Permission, Description, Access Level).

nodes.title: Admin permissions: Communication & Support (A-10)

attrs.statement: Permission category "Communication & Support" (A-10) in the admin permission matrix offers: View Support Center (Access patient support cases; Read); Respond to Support (Send messages to patients/providers; Write); View Provider-Patient Messages (Read patient and provider conversations for monitoring; Read); Flag Communications (Flag suspicious or policy-violating messages; Write); Enable Emergency Intervention (Step into a conversation as an emergency intervention (FR-012); Write); Export Conversation Transcripts (Export chat transcripts for compliance (deferred to a future phase; conversation export is not available yet); Read).
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 permission matrix structure, admin platform categories. Rows copied from the PRD table (Permission, Description, Access Level).

nodes.title: Admin permissions: Travel Management (A-04)

attrs.statement: Permission category "Travel Management" (A-04) in the admin permission matrix offers: View Travel Bookings (View flight and hotel bookings; Read); Manage Travel Settings (Configure travel API settings and commissions; Write); View Travel Reports (View travel booking analytics; Read).
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 permission matrix structure, admin platform categories. Rows copied from the PRD table (Permission, Description, Access Level).

nodes.title: Admin permissions: System Settings (A-09)

attrs.statement: Permission category "System Settings" (A-09) in the admin permission matrix offers: View Settings (View system configuration; Read); Edit Settings (Modify system settings; Write (Super Admin only)); Manage Users (Create/edit admin accounts; Write (Super Admin only)); Manage Roles (Create/edit roles and permissions; Write (Super Admin only)); Manage App Data (Edit the FR-026 App Data lists (countries and calling codes, discovery questions, inquiry cancellation reasons, account deletion reasons, inquiry configuration and provider specialties), location presentation and starting prices; Write); Manage Treatment Catalog (Create, edit and deactivate treatments, manage the treatment types list and the medication and post-op instruction templates; provider packages are view-only for admins; Write); Manage Aftercare Templates (Create/edit aftercare milestone templates; Write); Manage Notification Templates (Edit email templates (OTP, confirmations); Write); Configure Payment Settings (Manage Stripe accounts, commission rates, split pay (the permission FR-029 calls PaymentConfigAdmin); Write); Manage Help Centre (Create/edit Help Centre content for providers and patients; Write); View Sensitive Settings (View the full value of sensitive settings (for example API keys); Read); Manage Authentication Policies (Edit authentication policy settings (for example lockout, the admin session limit and inactivity timeout, and the one-time-code (OTP) settings); Write); Manage Localization (Manage languages, translations and machine translation (FR-021); Write (editing English source values, changing the default language, publishing, rollback, moving a language to Active, the free-text translation switch and budget, and machine translation credentials stay Super Admin only)).
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 permission matrix structure, admin platform categories. Rows copied from the PRD table (Permission, Description, Access Level).

nodes.title: Provider permissions: Patient Inquiries & Quotes (PR-02)

attrs.statement: Permission category "Patient Inquiries & Quotes" (PR-02) in the provider permission matrix offers: View Inquiries (View patient inquiry list and details; Read); Respond to Inquiries (Submit quotes and respond to inquiries; Write); Edit Quotes (Modify submitted quotes; Write); Accept/Decline Quotes (Accept or decline patient quote acceptances; Write); View Quote History (View all quotes for inquiries; Read).
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 permission matrix structure, provider platform categories. Rows copied from the PRD table (Permission, Description, Access Level).

nodes.title: Provider permissions: Appointments & Scheduling (PR-02)

attrs.statement: Permission category "Appointments & Scheduling" (PR-02) in the provider permission matrix offers: View Appointments (View scheduled appointments; Read); Schedule Appointments (Create and schedule appointments; Write); Edit Appointments (Modify appointment details; Write); Cancel Appointments (Cancel scheduled appointments; Write); View Calendar (Access provider calendar view; Read).
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 permission matrix structure, provider platform categories. Rows copied from the PRD table (Permission, Description, Access Level).

nodes.title: Provider permissions: Treatment & Procedures (PR-03)

attrs.statement: Permission category "Treatment & Procedures" (PR-03) in the provider permission matrix offers: View In-Progress Cases (View patients currently in treatment; Read); Document Treatment (Add treatment notes, scans, photos; Write (Owner or Clinical Staff only)); Update Treatment Status (Change patient treatment stage; Write); View Treatment History (Access historical treatment records; Read).
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 permission matrix structure, provider platform categories. Rows copied from the PRD table (Permission, Description, Access Level).

nodes.title: Provider permissions: Aftercare Management (PR-04)

attrs.statement: Permission category "Aftercare Management" (PR-04) in the provider permission matrix offers: View Aftercare Cases (View aftercare patient list; Read); Manage Aftercare Plans (Create and edit aftercare plans; Write); Chat with Patients (Access aftercare messaging; Write); Schedule Consultations (Book video consultations; Write); View Progress Reports (Access patient progress data; Read).
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 permission matrix structure, provider platform categories. Rows copied from the PRD table (Permission, Description, Access Level).

nodes.title: Provider permissions: Financial & Billing (PR-05)

attrs.statement: Permission category "Financial & Billing" (PR-05) in the provider permission matrix offers: View Financial Dashboard (View revenue and earnings; Read); View Payouts (View payment history and upcoming payouts; Read); View Billing Settings (View the provider billing settings tab read-only, including bank account details, the account number stays masked; Read, grantable, default holders Owner and Billing Staff); Edit Billing Settings (Edit the provider billing settings, including bank account details; Write, Owner only, not grantable to any other role, the Owner always has View Billing Settings too); View Financial Reports (Access financial analytics; Read).
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 permission matrix structure, provider platform categories. Rows copied from the PRD table (Permission, Description, Access Level). Owner ruling 2026-11-25 split View and Edit Billing Settings into two permissions.

nodes.title: Provider permissions: Team Management (PR-01)

attrs.statement: Permission category "Team Management" (PR-01) in the provider permission matrix offers: View Team Members (View team member list; Read); Invite Team Members (Send team member invitations; Write (a Manager may invite Clinical Staff and Billing Staff only)); Edit Team Member Roles (Change team member roles (non-Owner); Write (Owner or Manager only; a Manager may set only Clinical Staff and Billing Staff and cannot create a Manager)); Remove Team Members (Remove or suspend team members; Write (Owner: any non-Owner member; Manager: Clinical Staff and Billing Staff only)); View Team Activity (Access team activity logs; Read).
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 permission matrix structure, provider platform categories. Rows copied from the PRD table (Permission, Description, Access Level).

nodes.title: Provider permissions: Provider Settings (PR-06)

attrs.statement: Permission category "Provider Settings" (PR-06) in the provider permission matrix offers: View Profile (View provider profile information; Read); Edit Profile (Update provider profile details; Write); Manage Treatments (Set a treatment Offered or Not Offered and configure its pricing, including Quick Copy Pricing (FR-024); Write); Manage Packages (Create, edit, clone and deactivate packages and use quick price edit (FR-024); Write); Manage Promotions (Create and edit discount codes; Write); View Settings (View provider settings; Read); Edit Settings (Modify provider settings; Write (Owner only)); Edit Notification Settings (Change the clinic's notification preferences; Write; default holders Owner and Manager).
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 permission matrix structure, provider platform categories. Rows copied from the PRD table (Permission, Description, Access Level).

nodes.title: Invalid phone number message

attrs.statement: Invalid phone format: "Please enter a valid phone number (e.g., +1234567890)."
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 460 and 515 (Screen 2 and Screen 3 validation messages), verbatim.

nodes.title: Admin Account Setup branding

attrs.statement: Display provider branding (Hairline Admin Platform logo and name)
attrs.rationale: prd.md Screen 3 Notes, line 531, verbatim.

nodes.title: Admin Account Setup security notice

attrs.statement: Security notice: "Strong password required. All admin actions are logged for security."
attrs.rationale: prd.md Screen 3 Notes, line 535, verbatim.

nodes.title: Role change must be acknowledged within 24 hours

attrs.statement: System MUST ask an admin user to acknowledge a role change within 24 hours of it taking effect; the acknowledgement time is stored on the account and shown to Super Admins, who see an "Overdue" flag when it is late; nothing is blocked and no reminder is sent.
attrs.rationale: PRD Functional Requirements Summary, REQ-031-124; Business Rule 10; Alternative Flow A2 step 13 (Acknowledge role change action as a banner after sign-in and a link in the email); Tab 2 notes; Screen 5 field Role Change Acknowledged; Key Entity 1.

nodes.title: A role change waits as a pending role until its Effective From

attrs.statement: System MUST store a role change as a pending role with its Effective From (never earlier than now); the current role applies until Effective From, and a second change made before then replaces the pending one.
attrs.rationale: PRD Business Rule 8; Alternative Flow A2 steps 6 to 14; Tab 2 pending-role note; Core Requirements.

nodes.title: Suspend, reactivate and delete admin accounts

attrs.statement: System MUST let a Super Admin suspend an Active account (with a required reason), reactivate a Suspended account back to Active, and delete a Suspended non-Super Admin account; suspension ends the user's sessions and emails the user, reactivation returns the account to Active and emails the user, and deletion anonymises the account under REQ-031-022, keeps the audit entries and sets the status to Deleted. A Deleted account is hidden from the Admin Users list unless the Status filter "Deleted" is chosen, offers only View Audit, cannot be reactivated and is not counted as a role holder (REQ-031-129) or as a Super Admin (REQ-031-085). An Invited account is removed only with Cancel (REQ-031-127) and has no Change Role action. A Super Admin account can never be suspended, demoted or deleted inside the product.
attrs.rationale: PRD Alternative Flow A8; Tab 2 actions; Business Rule 7; Admin Editability.

nodes.title: Pending Invitations sub-tab with resend and cancel

attrs.statement: System MUST list every invitation not yet accepted (Invited, Expired or Pending Send) in a Pending Invitations sub-tab of the Admin Users tab, with Name, Email, Role, Invited by, Expires at and Status; a Super Admin can resend an invitation (REQ-031-042) or cancel it, including an invitation for a Super Admin role until it is accepted, and cancelling removes the Invited account, invalidates the invitation link and writes an audit entry.
attrs.rationale: PRD Alternative Flows A1 and A9; Tab 2 Pending Invitations sub-tab.

nodes.title: Request New Invitation notifies all Super Admins

attrs.statement: System MUST notify all Super Admins by email and in the app when an invitee uses Request New Invitation on an expired or invalid invitation link, with a link to the invitation row in the Pending Invitations sub-tab.
attrs.rationale: PRD Alternative Flow A10; Screen 3 notes.

nodes.title: Delete and clone custom admin roles

attrs.statement: System MUST let a Super Admin delete a custom admin role only while no admin user (including an Invited account, but not a Deleted one) and no pending role change holds it, and MUST name a cloned role "Copy of [role name]", editable and cut to 50 characters; a cloned role is an independent copy, so later edits to either role do not change the other; roles have no active or inactive status.
attrs.rationale: PRD Alternative Flow A11; Tab 1 actions and rules.

nodes.title: Provider role sync failure is shown and retried

attrs.statement: System MUST, when a provider role permission change fails to reach the Provider Platform, mark the role "Sync failed", retry automatically 3 times, send an in-app alert to all Super Admins, and show the role as "not yet applied" on the Provider Roles tab until a retry succeeds. After the 3 automatic tries fail the role stays "Sync failed / not yet applied"; a Super Admin can press "Retry sync" on the Provider Roles tab (saving the matrix again also re-sends it), and every attempt is logged in the audit trail.
attrs.rationale: PRD Alternative Flow A4 steps 17 to 19; Tab 3 sync indicator.

nodes.title: Editing an admin role applies to all its holders

attrs.statement: System MUST let a Super Admin edit the permissions of an admin role other than Super Admin, show the sensitive-permission warning when needed, log the change with before and after, email every admin user holding the role, and apply the new permissions to everyone holding it from their next request without ending any session.
attrs.rationale: PRD Alternative Flow A7.

nodes.title: User detail audit trail shows access-control events only

attrs.statement: The audit trail on the admin user detail screen shows access-control events only (sign-ins, access denials, invitations, role and permission changes, suspensions, reactivations and deletions); actions on patient accounts, reviews and other records stay in the logs of their own features, such as the FR-016 patient action log.
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen 5 purpose and business rules.

nodes.title: Admin Terms of Service acceptance belongs to this feature

attrs.statement: System MUST ask a new admin to accept the Admin Terms of Service when setting up the account; acceptance is recorded by this feature, while the legal text is edited under Edit Settings and viewed under View Settings in FR-027.
attrs.rationale: PRD Main Flow steps 17 and 19; Screen 3 notes.

nodes.title: Default permission tables are complete defaults

attrs.statement: System MUST define each predefined role's default permissions as a full table: Super Admin holds every admin permission, Owner holds every provider permission, and for every other predefined role a permission not listed in its default table is off; Reset to Default restores exactly that table.
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen 4 default permission tables and Reset to Default.

nodes.title: Resolve Installments permission

attrs.statement: System MUST offer the admin write permission Resolve Installments (record a manual bank transfer for an unpaid installment and approve one entered by a colleague; the approver is never the requester), held by default by Super Admin and Billing Admin.
attrs.rationale: PRD Screen 4 Billing & Financial category (A-05) and the admin default permission table; FR-007B uses the permission for manual bank transfers.

nodes.title: Upload clinic logo

attrs.statement: System MUST allow providers to upload and update clinic logo/profile picture (max 5MB, JPEG/PNG, min 200x200px); an image over 5MB is rejected with the message "Image too large. Maximum size is 5MB. Please compress or choose a smaller image." and the upload is prevented until a valid image is selected
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 Tab 1 Profile Picture validation adds "recommended 500x500px". Alternative flow B1 and Edge Cases: an oversized image is rejected with "Image too large. Maximum size is 5MB. Please compress or choose a smaller image." Screen: SCR-032-01.

nodes.title: Select supported languages from the central list

attrs.statement: System MUST allow providers to select supported languages using the centrally managed system language options owned by FR-021 (Multi-Language & Localization), which are surfaced via FR-026 App Settings. The list offers Active and Preparation locales, shows every catalog locale already saved, and keeps a saved entry when its locale becomes Inactive (REQ-032-147).
attrs.rationale: Restated by Module Scope ("Providers select supported languages from system language options"), Main Flow step 6 and Alternative Flow A3 ("System displays all available languages from the FR-021 language/locale catalog surfaced through settings"). Screen: SCR-032-02.

nodes.title: Manage awards with image upload

attrs.statement: System MUST allow providers to add, edit, delete awards with direct image upload (name, description, year, award image max 2MB)
attrs.rationale: Alternative flows A1 (edit award) and A2 (delete award with confirmation "Are you sure you want to delete this award?"). Screen: SCR-032-03.

nodes.title: Update basic clinic information

attrs.statement: System MUST allow providers to update basic clinic information (name, description, contact email)
attrs.rationale: Module Scope: "Providers update basic clinic information (name, description, contact)". Main Flow step 7 adds Location - City. Screen: SCR-032-01.

nodes.title: Phone number with country code

attrs.statement: System MUST allow each team member to configure their own phone number with worldwide country code selection (FR-026 country codes)
attrs.rationale: Main Flow step 7: "System validates phone number format for selected country code"; Alternative Flow B5 example error "Invalid phone number for United States. Expected format: (XXX) XXX-XXXX". Screen: SCR-032-06.

nodes.title: Select timezone

attrs.statement: System MUST allow each team member to select their own timezone from the FR-026 list of fixed-offset options (GMT-12 to GMT+14)
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 notes: timezone options show offset and city examples, e.g. "(GMT+3) Istanbul". Screen: SCR-032-06.

nodes.title: Change password with verification

attrs.statement: System MUST allow each team member to change their own password with current password verification and the platform password policy (REQ-SYS-007)
attrs.rationale: Screen 2: "New password must meet password policy from FR-026 (FIXED in codebase, not admin-editable)". Alternative flows B6 ("Current password is incorrect") and B7 (policy error message). Screen: SCR-032-06.

nodes.title: Configure notification preferences

attrs.statement: System MUST allow providers to configure unified notification preferences (individual notification type toggles for quote, schedule, treatment start, aftercare, review, and promotion/discount notifications + global channel preferences: email, push)
attrs.rationale: Main Flow "Configure Notification Preferences" steps 4-5 and Screen 3 list the six type toggles and two channel toggles, all default enabled. Screen: SCR-032-07.

nodes.title: S-03 enforces notification preferences

attrs.statement: System MUST enforce notification preferences via S-03 Notification Service (FR-020 integration)
attrs.rationale: Business Rule 2 restates this with the exemptions in REQ-032-031 and REQ-032-071. Dependencies: "S-03 checks preferences before sending each notification".

nodes.title: Owner manages billing settings

attrs.statement: System MUST allow provider Owners to manage billing settings (bank account details for payouts, FR-017 integration)
attrs.rationale: Billing Rule 2: "Bank account details used by FR-017 billing workflow for provider payouts (admin-triggered after treatment completion)". Screen: SCR-032-08.

nodes.title: Billing settings are viewed under View Billing Settings and edited under Edit Billing Settings

attrs.statement: System MUST restrict billing settings access to the holders of the permission "View Billing Settings" (default Owner and Billing Staff) and MUST allow only the Owner, the only holder of "Edit Billing Settings" (not grantable to any other role), to change them, both held by FR-031 (REQ-031-005); a View-only user gets the read-only screen with no edit, save or cancel controls and no unmasked account number
attrs.rationale: Restated by Business Rule 4, Billing Rule 3, Screen 4 and Alternative Flows A8 and B9. Same rule as REQ-032-022. Owner ruling 2026-11-25: Billing Staff can view billing settings read-only by default; only the Owner can edit. Screen: SCR-032-08.

nodes.title: Access the admin-managed Help Centre

attrs.statement: System MUST allow providers to access Help Centre with admin-managed content (FR-033 integration)
attrs.rationale: Screen 5: "All Help Centre content is read-only for providers (content managed exclusively by admins via FR-033)". Screen: SCR-032-09.

nodes.title: Owner requests account closure

attrs.statement: System MUST allow the Owner to request account closure; the request is processed by an admin, who deactivates the provider through FR-015 (no self-service deactivation)
