attrs.rationale: Module Scope (Provider and Admin platform bullets) and Admin Editability "Fixed in Codebase": "Account closure workflow: admin deactivation through FR-015 only (no "Deleted" status)". Screen: SCR-032-06 (Account Closure card).

nodes.title: Persist and propagate provider profile

attrs.statement: System MUST persist provider profile data (logo, name, description, languages, awards) and propagate to patient quote comparison view within 1 minute
attrs.rationale: Business Rule 1 restates it. Module Scope: patients view provider profiles "which may be initially curated by admin but subsequent provider-made changes propagate directly". Screen 1: "Profile updates propagate to patient app within 1 minute".

nodes.title: Persist account settings

attrs.statement: System MUST persist account settings per person on the team member record (phone number in international format, timezone, password hash), for every role
attrs.rationale: Screen 2: "Phone number country code and number stored together in international format (e.g., +44 7700 900123)".

nodes.title: Persist and sync notification preferences

attrs.statement: System MUST persist notification preferences and synchronize with S-03 Notification Service within 1 minute
attrs.rationale: Screen 3: "Preference updates propagate to S-03 within 1 minute". Failure handling in REQ-032-074.

nodes.title: Bank details encrypted and masked

attrs.statement: System MUST persist bank account details encrypted at rest (AES-256) and mask in UI (last 4 digits visible)
attrs.rationale: Restated by Privacy Rule 1, Billing Rule 4 and Screen 4. Screen: SCR-032-08.

nodes.title: Encrypt bank account details

attrs.statement: System MUST encrypt bank account details at rest using AES-256
attrs.rationale: Restated by Privacy Rule 1 and Admin Editability "Fixed in Codebase: Encryption algorithms: AES-256 for data at rest".

nodes.title: Hash passwords with bcrypt

attrs.statement: System MUST hash passwords using bcrypt (cost factor 12+) and never store plain text passwords
attrs.rationale: Restated by Privacy Rule 2 and Admin Editability "Fixed in Codebase: Password hash algorithm: bcrypt with cost factor 12+".

nodes.title: Audit log of settings changes

attrs.statement: System MUST log all profile changes, account settings changes, billing settings changes, and account closure requests in audit trail (timestamp, user ID, IP address, action, and old/new values; bank details, password, phone and email values are masked)
attrs.rationale: Restated by the Audit Rule (adds old value and new value), Business Rule 3 (account settings changes with timestamp, user ID, IP address), the per-screen audit lines on Screens 1-4 and closure Main Flow step 9 (user, timestamp, reason).

nodes.title: Password change security email

attrs.statement: System MUST send email notification to provider after password change (security alert)
attrs.rationale: Account Settings Main Flow step 22: email text "Your password was changed on [date] at [time]".

nodes.title: Permission-based access to billing settings

attrs.statement: System MUST enforce role-based access control for billing settings (permissions "View Billing Settings", default Owner and Billing Staff, and "Edit Billing Settings", held by the Owner only, not grantable to any other role, FR-031; roles without View cannot see or access the billing settings tab, and View-only users see it read-only)
attrs.rationale: Same rule as REQ-032-011 (Security & Privacy restatement), kept because the PRD numbers it separately. Edge case on Owner role change: REQ-032-079.

nodes.title: Approved closure is FR-015 deactivation

attrs.statement: System MUST process approved account-closure requests as FR-015 deactivation (account status = "Deactivated", standard FR-015 cascade, data archived; retention follows the system PRD, Platform-Wide Rules: One 10-year retention period)
attrs.rationale: Restated by Privacy Rule 3. Closure Main Flow step 14 lists the FR-015 cascade: status Deactivated, login blocked with the Rule 6 message, profile hidden from patients and new inquiries, non-terminal inquiries, quotes and bookings cancelled with notifications, captured payments reconciled by FR-017, data archived per FR-023 (minimum 7 years), bank account details encrypted and archived.

nodes.title: Integrate with S-03 for preferences

attrs.statement: System MUST integrate with S-03 Notification Service to enforce provider notification preferences (FR-020)
attrs.rationale: Integration restatement of REQ-032-009.

nodes.title: S-02 validates bank details format

attrs.statement: System MUST integrate with S-02 Payment Service to validate bank account details format before saving
attrs.rationale: Billing Rule 1: "format validation only, no funds verification". Admin Editability: "S-02 Payment Service validates bank account format per country, admin cannot modify validation logic". Screen: SCR-032-08.

nodes.title: Language options from FR-026/FR-021

attrs.statement: System MUST integrate with FR-026/FR-021 language configuration to provide centrally managed language options in profile language selection (FR-021 is canonical for supported locales; FR-026 surfaces these via App Settings)
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 Tab 2 notes: "Language list consumed from FR-021; FR-026 may surface the list through the broader settings shell but does not own provider language-capacity semantics."

nodes.title: Country codes and timezones from FR-026

attrs.statement: System MUST integrate with FR-026 to provide country codes and fixed-offset timezone options in account settings
attrs.rationale: Integration restatement of REQ-032-005 and REQ-032-006.

nodes.title: Help Centre content from FR-033

attrs.statement: System MUST integrate with FR-033 to display admin-managed Help Centre content
attrs.rationale: Integration restatement of REQ-032-012.

nodes.title: Read-only Commission & Payout panel

attrs.statement: System MUST show provider Owners a read-only Commission & Payout panel in Screen 4 with commission model, value, Flat Rate Currency, Effective Date, any scheduled configuration, and payout timing (automatic release on the Stripe Connect rail; the one platform-wide settlement period owned by FR-029 on the manual rail; there is no per-clinic payout frequency), plus the payout method (chosen by the admin when the clinic is created in FR-015) and payout readiness
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 Commission & Payout panel fields: Commission Model, Commission Value, Effective Date, Scheduled Configuration (hidden when none pending), Payout Frequency. Screen: SCR-032-08.

nodes.title: Rule 6 provider status behaviour

attrs.statement: System MUST apply Rule 6: show a persistent Account Suspended banner with the admin reason to all provider users while suspended, restrict editing to the listed exceptions, and block login with a deactivation message once deactivated
attrs.rationale: Summary of Business Rule 6; the Suspended, Deactivated and Reactivated sub-rules are REQ-032-045, REQ-032-046 and REQ-032-047.

nodes.title: Mandatory notices have no toggle and are always sent by email

attrs.statement: System MUST NOT offer a provider notification preference toggle for any mandatory provider notice, and MUST always send each mandatory notice to the affected provider by email, whatever the notification type toggles and the Email channel preference; Push and any other optional channel follow the provider's own setting, and the in-app record in notification history is always created (FR-020 REQ-020-038). Which notices are mandatory, to whom they go and what they say is defined by the notification Rules: FR-020 REQ-020-020 for the inquiry-cancelled quote notice (`quote.cancelled_inquiry`) and FR-030 Non-Disableable by Default for the others
attrs.rationale: Restated by Business Rule 2, Screen 3 (no toggle; neither the Quote or Schedule toggles, "Disable All" nor the Email channel preference can suppress the email), Main Flow step 4 toggle notes and Alternative Flow A5 step 6. Product owner decision log mtg002-quote-model-decisions-2026-10-16 Q12, Q42 and Q47 record these notices as mandatory. Owner ruling 2026-11-25: a locked notice guarantees email only (FR-030 REQ-030-208). Screen: SCR-032-07.

nodes.title: Entry points to provider settings, Help Centre and billing

attrs.statement: Provider navigates to "Settings & Support > Settings" from main dashboard navigation; Provider clicks on notification icon to configure preferences; Provider accesses Help Centre from footer or help icon; Provider Owner role accesses billing settings from financial dashboard; System prompts provider to complete profile setup during onboarding; System sends notification approval requests when admin creates platform-wide discount
attrs.rationale: Entry Points section. The onboarding prompt applies at the onboarding stage.

nodes.title: Profile required fields and length limits

attrs.statement: System validates all required fields for the current tab (clinic name, description); Clinic Name: Max 200 chars, min 3 chars; About/Description: Max 500 chars, min 50 chars; Location - City: Max 100 chars
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow B2: missing clinic name is highlighted with "Clinic name is required" and the save is blocked. Screen: SCR-032-01.

nodes.title: Cover image banner and limits

attrs.statement: Cover image displayed as a banner on the top of the provider profile in patient app; Cover Image: Max 10MB, JPEG/PNG only, recommended 1920x300px
attrs.rationale: Screen: SCR-032-01.

nodes.title: Initials fallback when no logo

attrs.statement: If no logo uploaded, system displays clinic name initials as fallback
attrs.rationale: Screen: SCR-032-01.

nodes.title: Contact email uniqueness among providers

attrs.statement: Contact Email: Valid email format; must be unique among Active and Suspended providers if changed (Deactivated records ignored, per FR-015 Rule 4)
attrs.rationale: Screen: SCR-032-01. The uniqueness rule is FR-015 Rule 4.

nodes.title: Public clinic phone format

attrs.statement: Contact Phone (Public): Contains `Country Code` (dropdown, FR-026) and `Number` (text, numeric only, length validated per country code)
attrs.rationale: Screen: SCR-032-01. Public-facing phone shown in the profile "About" section.

nodes.title: Clinic country from central country list

attrs.statement: Location - Country: Values from centrally managed country list (FR-026); optional but recommended
attrs.rationale: Screen: SCR-032-01.

nodes.title: Website URL format

attrs.statement: Website URL: Valid URL format (http/https); auto-prepends https:// if protocol missing
attrs.rationale: Screen: SCR-032-01.

nodes.title: Per-tab save and unsaved-changes reminder

attrs.statement: Each tab can be saved independently; System displays unsaved changes indicator (e.g., dot or asterisk) on tabs with unsaved edits; when provider attempts to navigate away or quit, system displays reminder dialog "You have unsaved changes. Are you sure you want to leave?" with options to save, discard, or cancel; If provider navigates away with unsaved message content, system prompts: "You have unsaved changes. Discard?"
attrs.rationale: Unsaved Changes Rule (Data & Privacy Rules), restated under Screen 1 General Business Rules, Screen 2 notes and Screen 3. The last part is the Screen 5.8 support reply variant. Screens: SCR-032-01 to SCR-032-08 and SCR-032-16.

nodes.title: Provider-editable fields versus read-only module views

attrs.statement: Rule 5: All profile, language, awards, account, and notification fields documented in this FR are editable within the Provider Dashboard by the roles in the who-edits-what table (REQ-032-141); reviews content and Help Centre articles are read-only views fed by their respective modules (staff roster managed by FR-009); providers may post responses to reviews via FR-013 Screen 6 response composer but cannot edit or delete review records
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 General Business Rules "Tab Editability": Tabs 1, 2, 4 and 6 fully editable; Tab 3 (Staff List) displays FR-009 Screen 1; Tab 5 (Reviews) read/respond.

nodes.title: Last save wins on concurrent profile edits

attrs.statement: Concurrent Edits Rule: Provider profile saves are last-save-wins. If a provider user and an admin (FR-015), or two provider users, edit the same fields at the same time, the later save overwrites the earlier one; there is no conflict check and no conflict message. A save applies only the fields the user changed; untouched fields are not rewritten, so last save wins only when two people change the same field. Every save is logged in the audit trail with old and new values
attrs.rationale: Data & Privacy Rules.

nodes.title: At least one supported language

attrs.statement: At least 1 language must be selected (validation prevents removing last language)
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 Tab 2; removing the last chip requires confirmation. Screen: SCR-032-02.

nodes.title: Language priority order

attrs.statement: Chips support drag-and-drop reordering to prioritize languages (most important first)
attrs.rationale: Screen: SCR-032-02.

nodes.title: Award field limits

attrs.statement: Awards List: Each award: name (max 100 chars), issuer/organization (max 150 chars, optional), description (max 300 chars), year (1900-current year), award image (max 2MB, JPEG/PNG)
attrs.rationale: Screen: SCR-032-03.

nodes.title: Award deletion is a soft delete

attrs.statement: System removes award from profile (soft-delete, retained in archive)
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow A2, after confirmation "Are you sure you want to delete this award?". Screen: SCR-032-03.

nodes.title: Award priority order

attrs.statement: Awards support drag-and-drop reordering to prioritize most important awards
attrs.rationale: Screen: SCR-032-03.

nodes.title: Malicious image upload is blocked

attrs.statement: System scans uploaded image using anti-virus/malware scanning service (e.g., ClamAV), detects malicious content, deletes uploaded file, displays error "Image upload blocked due to security concerns. Please try a different image or contact support if this was a mistake.", logs security event for admin review, and prevents award image from being saved
attrs.rationale: Edge Cases.

nodes.title: Upload and password-change rate limits

attrs.statement: Rate limiting on password change endpoint (max 5 attempts/hour/user) to prevent brute force attacks; rate limiting on image upload endpoint (max 10 uploads/hour/user) to prevent abuse
attrs.rationale: Promoted from Implementation Notes, Security Considerations (threat mitigation).

nodes.title: Reviews are read-only with FR-013 responses

attrs.statement: Review content (ratings, feedback, photos) is read-only — providers cannot edit or delete patient-submitted reviews; Providers may post a public response to any published review via the inline response composer defined in FR-013 Screen 6; see FR-013 for response rules and immutability
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 Tab 5. Screen: SCR-032-04.

nodes.title: Review notification highlights the review

attrs.statement: Clicking a review notification (from notifications) opens this tab with relevant review auto-highlighted
attrs.rationale: Supporting Flow "Browse Reviews" step 5. Screen: SCR-032-04.

nodes.title: Provider document ownership and permissions

attrs.statement: Provider Document Management: Providers can upload, replace, delete, and view their own documents; Document Permissions: Providers can only delete/replace documents they uploaded; Admin-uploaded documents display "View Only" (providers cannot delete/replace, but can download)
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 Tab 6. Screen: SCR-032-05.

nodes.title: Admin-uploaded provider documents

attrs.statement: Admin Oversight: Admins can upload additional documents via FR-015 Tab 6 (e.g., documents received via email, external verifications). Admin-uploaded documents display "Admin" badge
attrs.rationale: Screen: SCR-032-05.

nodes.title: Document sync to admin within 1 minute

attrs.statement: Document Sync: Documents uploaded by provider in FR-032 sync to FR-015 within 1 minute for admin visibility
attrs.rationale: Screen: SCR-032-05.

nodes.title: Document replace archives the old version

attrs.statement: Replace Document: Clicking "Replace" on a document card opens file picker; uploading new file replaces current version; old version archived (soft delete) with timestamp
attrs.rationale: Notes: old versions are not shown to the provider; admin can view them in FR-015. Screen: SCR-032-05.

nodes.title: Document delete is a soft delete

attrs.statement: Delete Document: Clicking "Delete" opens confirmation dialog; on confirm, document soft-deleted (not permanently removed); admin can view deleted documents in FR-015 for audit purposes
attrs.rationale: Screen: SCR-032-05.

nodes.title: Document actions audit log

attrs.statement: Audit Logging: All document actions (upload/replace/delete/view/download) logged with timestamp, user, action type, and IP address (visible in FR-015 Tab 8: Activity Log)
attrs.rationale: Screen: SCR-032-05.

nodes.title: Document links are signed and time-limited

attrs.statement: Security: Document URLs are secure, time-limited signed URLs; direct file access not allowed
attrs.rationale: Screen: SCR-032-05.

nodes.title: Document file validation and virus scan

attrs.statement: Accepted formats: PDF, JPG, PNG, DOCX, XLSX; Max file size: 10MB per document; File name sanitization: Remove special characters, limit to 200 chars; Virus scanning: All uploaded files scanned before storage; Notes: Max 500 chars; editable
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 Tab 6 File Validation. Screen: SCR-032-05.

nodes.title: Owner account name synced from clinic name

attrs.statement: Account Name field is read-only for Owner role; it automatically syncs when clinic name is updated in Tab 1; If Owner updates clinic name in Tab 1, Account Name in Tab 2 updates automatically (within 1 minute); when the Owner role is handed over (REQ-009-174) the new Owner's Account Name is set to the clinic name and the previous Owner's is reset to First Name + Last Name
attrs.rationale: Screen 2: "Owner account represents the clinic organization, so account name should match clinic name for consistency across the platform". Screen: SCR-032-06.

nodes.title: Staff account name is a personal display name

attrs.statement: For Staff roles (Manager, Clinical Staff, Billing Staff): Account Name is editable and independent from clinic name; Default Account Name for staff is "First Name + Last Name" (e.g., "John Smith"), set when the account is created (FR-009 account setup); Staff Account Name changes do not affect clinic name or other staff members' account names
attrs.rationale: Screen 2: staff account name is used in dashboard, notifications, activity logs and team member listings. Screen: SCR-032-06.

nodes.title: Account name, user name and login email validation

attrs.statement: Account Name: Max 200 chars; First Name and Last Name: 2-50 characters, letters, spaces, hyphens (same as FR-009); Account Email: Valid email format, unique per FR-009 Rule 3 (an email belongs to at most one provider organization at a time); Account Email is read-only for every role (REQ-032-144)
attrs.rationale: Screen 2. First Name and Last Name share the same limit. Screen: SCR-032-06.

nodes.title: Timezone drives display, storage stays UTC

attrs.statement: Timezone is saved per person and applies to all date/time displays in that person's provider dashboard session; at first login it is set without a prompt to the listed whole-hour offset nearest to the browser time zone, or UTC when the browser zone cannot be read (REQ-032-145); existing timestamps in the database remain in UTC, converted for display with the fixed offsets of the FR-026 timezone list (REQ-026-121)
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow A7. Screen: SCR-032-06.

nodes.title: Password confirmation and change checks

attrs.statement: Confirm New Password: Must match New Password field; System validates new password ≠ current password, detects match, displays error "New password must be different from current password", and prevents password change until different password entered
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow B8 ("Password confirmation does not match") and Edge Cases. Screen: SCR-032-06.

nodes.title: Suspended provider: banner and view-only access

attrs.statement: Suspended: The Owner and every FR-009 team member can still log in and see a persistent, non-dismissible banner on every Provider Platform page: "Your account is temporarily suspended. Reason: [admin-provided reason]. Contact support@hairlineapp.com for assistance." The reason is the Screen 4 reason recorded in FR-015. While suspended, the provider cannot receive new inquiries, submit quotes, or accept new work (FR-015 Rule 9); profile, documents, reviews, billing, and team management (FR-009 Rule 10) are view-only, except that the Owner can still update the bank details (audit-logged). Account security (password change), notification preferences, Help Centre, and support cases (Screens 5.5–5.9) remain available so the provider can contact admins, and the Owner can still submit the account closure request. A Suspended Owner who has not yet set a password can still use the activation link; the status stays Suspended afterwards (FR-015). Chat with patients on the provider's open `In Progress` and `Aftercare` cases also stays available. Clinical notes, photos, and aftercare answers and actions are blocked until the admin reassigns or decides the case (FR-015 Screen 4).
attrs.rationale: Business Rule 6 (provider account status is owned by FR-015).

nodes.title: Deactivated provider: login blocked

attrs.statement: Deactivated: Login is disabled for the Owner and all team members. A login attempt shows "This account has been deactivated. Contact support@hairlineapp.com for assistance." and no session is created.
attrs.rationale: Business Rule 6.

nodes.title: Reactivated provider: banner removed

attrs.statement: Reactivated: The banner is removed on the next page load and normal editing returns; nothing cancelled by the suspension is restored (FR-015 Screen 5).
attrs.rationale: Business Rule 6.

nodes.title: Closure request needs explicit acknowledgement

attrs.statement: [Checkbox] "I understand that closing my account is permanent and my account data will be archived."; Reason for closure: [textarea] (optional); System closes dialog without creating closure request
attrs.rationale: Closure Main Flow steps 4-5 (warning dialog text: permanent deactivation, cannot be reversed, open inquiries/quotes/bookings cancelled and patients notified, captured payments reconciled, data archived) and Alternative Flow A17 (cancel). Screen: SCR-032-06.

nodes.title: One pending closure request per provider

attrs.statement: System creates account closure request record with status "Pending Admin Review" (only one pending request per provider; no booking or payout check blocks submission). While a request is Pending Admin Review the closure card shows "Closure requested on DD-MM-YYYY, awaiting admin review" (plus "Deactivation scheduled for DD-MM-YYYY" when the admin scheduled a date) with the button disabled, and returns to normal when the request is Rejected; a second submission while one is pending is refused with "A closure request is already pending."
attrs.rationale: Key Entities Entity 5: "only one "Pending" at a time".

nodes.title: Closure request notifies admins

attrs.statement: System notifies admins of the request (FR-020 `provider.closure_requested`, a mandatory notice; recipients and content are defined by the notification Rules REQ-020-016 and REQ-030-101), and FR-015 Screen 1 shows the provider with the Closure Requested marker and filter
attrs.rationale: Closure Main Flow step 10.

nodes.title: Closure confirmation states the 5-business-day review target

attrs.statement: System displays confirmation to provider "Account closure request submitted. We aim to review and process your request within 5 business days. You will receive an email once your account is deactivated."
attrs.rationale: Business Process Assumption 2: "Admins review and process provider account closure requests within 5 business days".

nodes.title: Account keeps its status while closure is pending

attrs.statement: Provider account keeps its current status until admin processes the request. If the admin schedules the deactivation for a future date, the request stays "Pending Admin Review" until the deactivation takes effect; if the scheduled deactivation is cancelled, the request stays "Pending Admin Review" and no rejection email is sent
attrs.rationale: Closure Main Flow steps 12-13 (admin processes per FR-015 Alternative Flow A7 via FR-015 Screen 4).

nodes.title: Closure approved when deactivation takes effect

attrs.statement: When the deactivation takes effect, the system sets the closure request status to "Approved", links it to the FR-015 deactivation status event, and sends the FR-015 deactivation email (`provider.deactivated`, FR-020). FR-015 locks "Notify Provider" on for closure deactivations, so this email is always sent, as step 11 promises
attrs.rationale: Closure Main Flow step 15.

nodes.title: Closure rejection keeps the account status

attrs.statement: If the admin rejects the request instead (e.g., the provider asks to withdraw it), the system sets the request status to "Rejected" with review notes, the provider account keeps its current status, and the provider receives the FR-020 `provider.closure_rejected` email with the review notes (mandatory). The provider may submit a new request later
attrs.rationale: Closure Main Flow step 16.

nodes.title: Closure request is the erasure path

attrs.statement: GDPR Compliance: Provider account closure request gives the provider a path to request erasure (FR-015 deactivation with data archival per FR-023, not permanent deletion)
attrs.rationale: Data & Privacy Rules; Implementation Notes Compliance restates it.

nodes.title: Notification preferences apply to the whole organization

attrs.statement: Notification preferences are profile-specific (apply to entire provider organization, not individual team members); only the Owner and a Manager can change them, other roles see them read-only (REQ-032-142)
attrs.rationale: Screen: SCR-032-07.

nodes.title: Disable-all needs confirmation

attrs.statement: If all notification types are disabled, the system shows a confirmation dialog "Warning: You have disabled all notifications. You may miss important updates about inquiries, appointments, and reviews. Are you sure?" before saving. Email and Push may both be off for a type, and a mandatory notice is still sent by email while Push follows the provider's own setting (REQ-032-143)
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow A5 dialog: "Warning: You have disabled all notifications. You may miss important updates about inquiries, appointments, and reviews. Are you sure?" Screen: SCR-032-07.

nodes.title: Channel preferences override type toggles

attrs.statement: Global channel preferences override individual notification types (e.g., if Email disabled, no notifications sent via email regardless of individual toggles); mandatory notices are the exception for email (REQ-032-143)
attrs.rationale: Screen: SCR-032-07.

nodes.title: Critical system alerts are mandatory: always sent by email

attrs.statement: Critical system alerts (e.g., payment failure, security breach) are mandatory notices: always sent by email whatever the provider's preferences, while Push and any other optional channel follow the provider's own setting (FR-020 REQ-020-038, FR-030 REQ-030-208)
attrs.rationale: Screen 3; Business Rule 2. Owner ruling 2026-11-25: a locked notice guarantees email only.

nodes.title: Notification preference changes are audited

attrs.statement: Preference changes are logged in the audit trail with the user who made them (REQ-032-142)
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 and Main Flow step 10.

nodes.title: Preference sync retry when S-03 is down

attrs.statement: System attempts to update S-03 with new preferences, detects S-03 unavailable (timeout or 5xx error), queues preference update for retry (exponential backoff), displays success message to provider "Notification preferences updated" (optimistic UI), logs error for admin monitoring, and retries preference update every 1 minute for up to 5 minutes; if S-03 still unavailable after 5 minutes, admin receives alert
attrs.rationale: Edge Cases; External Dependencies S-03 failure handling ("preferences may take up to 5 minutes to propagate").

nodes.title: Core notification types cannot be removed

attrs.statement: Notification preference options: admins can add/remove notification types via system configuration, but core notification types (quote, schedule, treatment, aftercare, review) are required
attrs.rationale: Admin Editability "Configurable with Restrictions".

nodes.title: Billing field formats

attrs.statement: Account Holder Name: Max 200 chars, alphabetic and spaces only; Routing/SWIFT Code: 8-11 chars for SWIFT, 9 digits for USA routing; IBAN: Format validated per country (e.g., Turkey = 26 chars)
attrs.rationale: Screen 4; Alternative Flow B10 example "Invalid IBAN format. Turkey IBAN must be 26 characters". Bank Name max 200 chars. Screen: SCR-032-08.

nodes.title: Account number unmasked only in edit mode

attrs.statement: Account number masked in read-only view (e.g., ●●●●●●1234), unmasked in edit mode
attrs.rationale: Screen 4; Main Flow step 5. Screen: SCR-032-08.

nodes.title: Failed S-02 validation blocks the save

attrs.statement: If bank account validation fails, display error message from S-02 and prevent saving
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow B11: "Bank account validation failed: [error detail from S-02]. Please verify your bank details and try again." Screen: SCR-032-08.

nodes.title: Bank detail change confirmation email

attrs.statement: Email confirmation sent to Owner after bank account details updated
attrs.rationale: Main Flow step 14. Screen: SCR-032-08.

nodes.title: Bank details survive an Owner role change

attrs.statement: Existing bank account details stay with the clinic and are accessible to the new Owner after a role change
attrs.rationale: Edge Cases: when the Owner role changes via FR-009, the Billing tab is hidden for the former Owner on next navigation.

nodes.title: Commission panel is read-only

attrs.statement: Commission & Payout panel: Read-only; values are set by admins in FR-015 Tab 7 and synchronized with FR-029. Providers cannot edit them and must contact support to discuss changes. The panel notes that existing confirmed bookings keep the commission snapshot taken at their confirmation (FR-029)
attrs.rationale: Screen 4. Commission snapshot rule is REQ-029-045; at most one pending configuration is REQ-029-116. Screen: SCR-032-08.

nodes.title: Help Centre content propagates within 1 minute

attrs.statement: Help Centre content updates (from admin) propagate to providers within 1 minute
attrs.rationale: Screen: SCR-032-09.

nodes.title: Most popular and recently updated lists

attrs.statement: Most Popular Articles: Top 5 most viewed/helpful articles across all categories; Recently Updated: Latest 5 updated articles across all categories
attrs.rationale: Screen: SCR-032-09.

nodes.title: Was-this-helpful feedback is recorded

attrs.statement: Feedback (Yes/No) recorded per FAQ for admin analytics; System records feedback for admin analytics
attrs.rationale: Help Centre Main Flow steps 11-12; Screens 5.1, 5.2 and 5.4 ("Feedback recorded for admin analytics"). Screens: SCR-032-10, SCR-032-11, SCR-032-13.

nodes.title: Content-gap feedback goes to FR-034

attrs.statement: System records feedback with reference to the viewed content item and provider account; System forwards feedback to admin/content team via FR-034 (e.g., as a low-priority ticket or feedback case)
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow B13.

nodes.title: Failed file load can be reported as a case

attrs.statement: System creates an issue/support case in FR-034 including file identifier, provider, and error details
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow B14: the error message offers retry and "Report issue"; the system confirms the issue was reported.

nodes.title: Cached Help Centre content when loading fails

attrs.statement: displays cached version of Help Centre content (if available) with warning banner "Content may be outdated. Please refresh to load latest updates.", and provides "Retry" button for manual refresh
attrs.rationale: Edge Cases; Alternative Flow B12 ("Unable to load Help Centre content. Please check your connection and try again."); Integration Points: retry after 1 minute.

nodes.title: Resource download count

attrs.statement: Download initiates file download; download count incremented
attrs.rationale: Screen 5.3; preview available for PDF and image files. Screen: SCR-032-12.

nodes.title: Video view counted after 30 seconds

attrs.statement: View count incremented when video plays for >30 seconds
attrs.rationale: Screen: SCR-032-13.

nodes.title: Support and feedback forms create FR-034 cases

attrs.statement: Form submissions automatically create support cases in FR-034 Support Center & Ticketing System with status 'Open'; case management, admin responses, and status updates are handled in FR-034; Form submissions automatically create feedback cases in FR-034 Support Center & Ticketing System with status 'Open'; case tracking, admin responses, and resolution status are handled in FR-034; Form submissions create support cases with provider ID linked and Ticket Source = "Provider Portal", Submitter Type = "Provider"
attrs.rationale: Screens 5.5 and 5.6; Internal Dependencies FR-034. Screens: SCR-032-14, SCR-032-15.

nodes.title: Support form pre-fills provider contact details

attrs.statement: Support contact form auto-populates provider contact information (name, email, clinic name)
attrs.rationale: Screen: SCR-032-14.

nodes.title: Contact support form limits

attrs.statement: Support Request Form - Subject: Min 10, max 200 chars (FR-034 REQ-034-130); Support Request Form - Message: Max 5000 chars, min 20 chars; Support Request Form - Priority: Default: Medium; Support Request Form - Attachments: Up to 5 files, 10MB each, formats JPG, PNG, PDF, DOC, DOCX (FR-034 REQ-034-036, REQ-034-037)
attrs.rationale: Screen 5.5. Help Centre Main Flow step 20 lists only subject, message and attachment. Screen: SCR-032-14.

nodes.title: Support request confirmation and response time

attrs.statement: Support request confirmation displayed: "Support request submitted. Case #[number]. We aim to respond within 24 hours on business days."
attrs.rationale: Screen 5.5; Help Centre Main Flow step 23. Screen: SCR-032-14.

nodes.title: Feedback form limits

attrs.statement: Feedback Form - Title: Min 10, max 100 chars (FR-034 REQ-034-130); Feedback Form - Description: Max 5000 chars, min 20 chars; Feedback Form - Priority: Default: Low
attrs.rationale: Screen 5.6; confirmation "Thank you for your feedback! We'll review your submission." Screen: SCR-032-15.

nodes.title: Unified support case status workflow

attrs.statement: Status updates follow unified workflow: Open → In Progress → Resolved → Closed (feedback resolution outcome—Implemented, Planned, Declined, Under Review—tracked separately in FR-034)
attrs.rationale: Screens 5.5 and 5.6. The workflow is owned by FR-034; held here because the provider screens state it.

nodes.title: Support case search and filters

attrs.statement: Search Bar: Min 3 chars to trigger search, real-time search; searches across Case ID, Title, Description, Message content; Filters are cumulative (AND logic between different filter types); Filter options: Status (Open, In Progress, Resolved, Closed; default Open and In Progress), Type (Support Request, Feedback; default all types), Date Range (custom range on the case creation date; default last 90 days); several selections within one filter combine as OR; filter selections persist during the session
attrs.rationale: Screen 5.7; Alternative Flow A15. Screen: SCR-032-16.

nodes.title: Unread admin messages and read marking

attrs.statement: Unread Messages indicator shows count of admin messages provider hasn't viewed yet (e.g., "2 new"); System marks messages as read when provider opens case detail view
attrs.rationale: Screens 5.7 and 5.8; Support Main Flow steps 5 and 8. Screens: SCR-032-16, SCR-032-17.

nodes.title: Replies allowed on Open, In Progress and Resolved cases

attrs.statement: Providers can reply to admin messages for Open, In Progress and Resolved cases via Reply Message Box; a reply to a Resolved case reopens it (banner: "This case was marked as resolved. Replying will reopen it."); for Closed cases, Reply Message Box is disabled; provider can only click "Request Reopen" button
attrs.rationale: Screen 5.8; Support Main Flow step 18 ("not empty, case is Open or In Progress"). Screen: SCR-032-17.

nodes.title: Support reply limits

attrs.statement: Reply Message Box: Max 5000 chars; enabled for Open, In Progress and Resolved cases, disabled for Closed cases; Character counter displayed; Attach Files Button: Max 5 files, 10MB per file, formats: JPG, PNG, PDF, DOC, DOCX; Attachment files validated before upload (file type, size, virus scan)
attrs.rationale: Screen: SCR-032-17.

nodes.title: Support reply notifications

attrs.statement: An admin reply notifies the provider (support.case_admin_reply) and a provider reply notifies the assigned admin, or all support staff if unassigned (support.case_user_reply); recipients, content and channels are defined by the notification catalogue (FR-030 REQ-030-065 and REQ-030-066); email notification sent to provider when admin responds or updates status
attrs.rationale: Screens 5.5 and 5.8; Support Main Flow steps 20-21 and 25.

nodes.title: Admin reply link opens the case

attrs.statement: System opens the provider platform and opens the case directly on Screen 5.8, whatever the filters of the case list, with the new reply in the Communication Thread
attrs.rationale: Support Alternative Flow A16 (email link "View case in My Support Cases"). Screen: SCR-032-16.

nodes.title: Reopen request needs a reason

attrs.statement: Modal only accessible from Screen 5.8 when viewing Closed cases; Reopening reason required (min 20 chars) to prevent accidental/spam reopening; Reopening Reason: Min 20 chars, max 500 chars; the reason and, optionally, the requested priority are sent to FR-034 as a flagged reopen-request message in the case thread (text)
attrs.rationale: Screen 5.9; Support Alternative Flow A14. Screen: SCR-032-18.

nodes.title: Reopen request is sent to the admin and the case stays Closed

attrs.statement: The reopen request is sent to FR-034 as a flagged message in the case thread; the case stays Closed until the admin reopens it; the provider sees "Request sent, awaiting admin" with the reply box disabled; FR-034 notifies the admin through the user-reply notice (support.case_user_reply, REQ-034-178). When an admin accepts the request, the admin reopens the case in FR-034 (status Open, REQ-034-145), which enables the reply box again; when an admin answers but keeps the case Closed, the "Request sent, awaiting admin" banner clears and the Request Reopen button returns, so the provider may ask again
attrs.rationale: Screen 5.9; Support Alternative Flow A14 step 11. Reply Message Box is enabled again after reopening. Screen: SCR-032-18.

nodes.title: Service status updates; subscription is a future enhancement

attrs.statement: Status updates automatically when admin updates status via admin platform; status update notifications by email are a future enhancement, not in this release (FR-033 REQ-033-032)
attrs.rationale: Screen 5.10; Alternative Flow A13 (Service Status), subscription "if enabled per FR-020/notifications". Screen: SCR-032-19.

nodes.title: Review rating on the profile opens the Reviews tab

attrs.statement: Review rating displays average rating (e.g., "4.8/5.0") with total review count (e.g., "Based on 127 reviews"); clicking navigates to Reviews tab
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 Tab 1, Business Rules (PRD line 824).

nodes.title: My Support Cases Quick Stats bar is independent of the current filters

attrs.statement: Quick Stats bar shows the counts Open, In Progress, Resolved and Unread Messages over all of the clinic's cases, independent of the current filters
attrs.rationale: Screen 5.7, Business Rules (PRD line 1466).

nodes.title: Provider support case list shows 20 cases per page

attrs.statement: The case list shows 20 cases per page by default
attrs.rationale: Screen 5.7 Business Rules. Detail kept from the former default-view Rule REQ-032-106, which is merged into REQ-034-114. Screen: SCR-032-16.

nodes.title: The Edit Profile button on the Basic Information tab switches every editable field in the

attrs.statement: The Edit Profile button on the Basic Information tab switches every editable field in the tab into edit mode at once; while edit mode is on the button reads "Cancel Edit", and the provider can edit several fields and then save them all together with the Save All button.
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 813, 839 (Tab 1 Edit Profile Button row and Bulk Edit Mode note). Screen: SCR-032-01.

nodes.title: When the provider has no awards, the Awards tab shows the message "No awards added yet. Cl

attrs.statement: When the provider has no awards, the Awards tab shows the message "No awards added yet. Click '+ Add Award' to showcase your achievements."
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 911 (Tab 4 Notes, empty state). Screen: SCR-032-03.

nodes.title: When the provider has no reviews, the Reviews tab shows the message "No reviews yet. Revie

attrs.statement: When the provider has no reviews, the Reviews tab shows the message "No reviews yet. Reviews will appear here once patients leave feedback."
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 946 (Tab 5 Notes, empty state). Screen: SCR-032-04.

nodes.title: The review list on the Reviews tab is paged: the provider moves between pages with page nu

attrs.statement: The review list on the Reviews tab is paged: the provider moves between pages with page numbers and next and previous buttons, and can choose a page size of 10, 20 or 50 reviews; the chosen page and page size persist during the session.
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 928, 945 (Tab 5 Pagination Controls row and Notes). Screen: SCR-032-04.

nodes.title: If the document list cannot be loaded, the Documents tab shows the message "Unable to load

attrs.statement: If the document list cannot be loaded, the Documents tab shows the message "Unable to load documents. Please refresh or contact support."
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 1004 (Tab 6 Notes, error state). Screen: SCR-032-05.

nodes.title: The provider can drag files onto the Documents tab to upload them

attrs.statement: The provider can drag files onto the Documents tab to upload them; the upload dialog then opens with the dropped file already selected.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 1006 (Tab 6 Notes, drag-and-drop upload). Screen: SCR-032-05.

nodes.title: Phone number and country code are required; the number is unique and a changed number is verified

attrs.statement: A phone number with its country code is required on Account Settings: it can be replaced but not removed; it is unique per user within the provider, and a changed number is verified as in FR-009 (REQ-009-113).
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 1037 (Screen 2 Phone Number - Country Code row, Required "Yes (if phone provided)"). Screen: SCR-032-06.

nodes.title: The Notification Preferences tab offers Enable All and Disable All buttons that turn all n

attrs.statement: The Notification Preferences tab offers Enable All and Disable All buttons that turn all notification-type toggles on or off in one action.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 1124 (Screen 3 Notes). Screen: SCR-032-07.

nodes.title: The Notification Preferences tab offers a Test Notification button that sends the provider

attrs.statement: The Notification Preferences tab offers a Test Notification button that sends the provider a sample notification so the provider can check that the settings work.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 1127 (Screen 3 Notes). Screen: SCR-032-07.

nodes.title: The Billing tab has a country selector

attrs.statement: The Billing tab has a country selector; the selected country decides which bank fields are required, for example an IBAN for EU countries and a routing number for the USA.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 1175 (Screen 4 Notes). Screen: SCR-032-08.

nodes.title: The Billing tab has a Verify Bank Account button that tests the entered bank details with

attrs.statement: The Billing tab has a Verify Bank Account button that tests the entered bank details with the S-02 Payment Service before the provider saves them.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 1177 (Screen 4 Notes). Screen: SCR-032-08.

nodes.title: When a Help Centre search returns no results, the system shows "No results for '[query]'.

attrs.statement: When a Help Centre search returns no results, the system shows "No results for '[query]'. Try different keywords or Contact Support." (the same message as the patient Help Centre, FR-035).
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 1205 (Screen 5 Business Rules). Screen: SCR-032-09.

nodes.title: The Resource Library offers a Preview button for PDF and image files

attrs.statement: The Resource Library offers a Preview button for PDF and image files; the preview opens in a modal or in a new tab.
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 1293, 1300 (Screen 5.3 Preview Button row and Business Rules). Screen: SCR-032-12.

nodes.title: The Back to List button on Case Detail returns the provider to My Support Cases with the p

attrs.statement: The Back to List button on Case Detail returns the provider to My Support Cases with the provider's filter selections still applied.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 1505 (Screen 5.8 Back to List Button row). Screen: SCR-032-17.

nodes.title: When no case matches the current filters, My Support Cases shows "No cases found. Try adju

attrs.statement: When no case matches the current filters, My Support Cases shows "No cases found. Try adjusting your filters or submit a new request via Contact Support."; when the provider has no cases at all it shows "You haven't submitted any support cases yet. Visit Contact Support or Feedback & Suggestions to get help."
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 1472, 1473 (Screen 5.7 Notes, empty states). Screen: SCR-032-16.

nodes.title: My Support Cases shows the number of cases that match the current filters at the top of th

attrs.statement: My Support Cases shows the number of cases that match the current filters at the top of the table, in the form "Showing X cases".
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 1474 (Screen 5.7 Notes, total count). Screen: SCR-032-16.

nodes.title: If no documents have been uploaded yet, the Documents tab shows the message "No documents

attrs.statement: If no documents have been uploaded yet, the Documents tab shows the message "No documents on file. Upload your clinic documents (medical license, certifications, insurance) to get started." together with a prominent Upload Document button.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 977 (Tab 6 Business Rules, empty state). Screen: SCR-032-05.

nodes.title: After a successful reply the system shows the confirmation "Reply sent. The support team w

attrs.statement: After a successful reply the system shows the confirmation "Reply sent. The support team will respond soon."
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 682, 1531 (main flow step 22 and Screen 5.8 Business Rules). Screen: SCR-032-17.

nodes.title: After a reopen request is submitted the system shows the confirmation "Reopen request subm

attrs.statement: After a reopen request is submitted the system shows the confirmation "Reopen request submitted. We'll review your case shortly."
attrs.rationale: Support Alternative Flow A14 step 10 and Screen 5.9 Business Rules. Screen: SCR-032-18.

nodes.title: If the case was recently closed (for example within 24 hours), the reopen dialog shows the

attrs.statement: If the case was recently closed (for example within 24 hours), the reopen dialog shows the warning "This case was recently closed. Are you sure the issue persists?"
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 1582 (Screen 5.9 Notes). Screen: SCR-032-18.

nodes.title: An article offers share options: the provider can copy the article link or email the link.

attrs.statement: An article offers share options: the provider can copy the article link or email the link.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 1276 (Screen 5.2 Business Rules). Screen: SCR-032-11.

nodes.title: Who edits what is fixed per area

attrs.statement: System MUST apply the who-edits-what table in Screen 1 (General Business Rules): clinic profile, languages, awards and documents are edited by the Owner and a Manager by default, gated by the FR-031 permission "Edit Profile"; notification settings are gated by "Edit Notification Settings" (REQ-032-142); the account closure request by the Owner only; personal account settings by every role for their own account only; billing settings are viewed under "View Billing Settings" (default Owner and Billing Staff) and edited under "Edit Billing Settings" (held by the Owner only, not grantable to any other role), both held by FR-031 (REQ-031-005)
attrs.rationale: One table replaces the scattered role wording. The billing permissions are owned by FR-031, not FR-009.

nodes.title: Holders of Edit Notification Settings change the notification settings

attrs.statement: System MUST let only the holders of the FR-031 permission "Edit Notification Settings" (by default the Owner and a Manager) change the clinic's notification settings; other roles see them read-only; every change is audit-logged with the user who made it.
attrs.rationale: Notification settings are clinic-wide, so they follow the same editors as the clinic profile.

nodes.title: Support case notices are always sent by email

attrs.statement: System MUST send support case notices (admin reply, status change, resolved) always, with no toggle; Email and Push MAY both be off for a notification type, but a mandatory notice is still always sent by email, while Push follows the provider's own setting (FR-020 REQ-020-038).
attrs.rationale: A provider must not miss an admin answer on a support case.

nodes.title: Account Email is read-only for every role

attrs.statement: System MUST show Account Email read-only for every role. The Owner's login email is changed only by a Hairline admin (FR-015, REQ-015-114); a team member's email is changed by contacting support.
attrs.rationale: The login email is the identity key and is unique per FR-009; changing it needs an admin check.

nodes.title: Timezone is saved per person and set silently at first login

attrs.statement: System MUST save the timezone per person; at a person's first login System MUST set it without a prompt to the listed whole-hour offset nearest to the browser time zone (UTC when the browser zone cannot be read), and the person can change it on Screen 2 at any time; dates display with the fixed offsets of the FR-026 timezone list (REQ-026-121).
attrs.rationale: Team members work from different places; one clinic-wide value would show wrong times to some of them.

nodes.title: Bank form only for Manual bank transfer

attrs.statement: System MUST show and require the bank form only when the Payout Method is Manual bank transfer; for Stripe Connect it MUST show a status panel and a "Complete Stripe sign-up" link; Payout Readiness is display only and owned by FR-017 (REQ-017-064).
attrs.rationale: A Stripe Connect clinic has no bank form to fill; FR-017 owns the payout method and readiness.

nodes.title: Language list offers Active and Preparation locales

attrs.statement: System MUST offer Active and Preparation locales in the language list, display every catalog locale already saved, and keep a saved entry when its locale becomes Inactive.
attrs.rationale: A provider's saved language must not vanish when FR-021 retires a locale.

nodes.title: Reviews tab filters, sorts and pages on the server

attrs.statement: System MUST run Reviews tab filter, sort and paging on the server over the whole review list, show the Edited marker (FR-013 REQ-013-032), and link to the FR-013 provider review list and review detail screens.
attrs.rationale: Paging on the client would filter only the loaded page; FR-013 owns the review list and detail screens.

nodes.title: Separate provider and patient Help Centre content repositories

attrs.statement: System MUST provide Help Centre content management for TWO distinct audiences: Providers and Patients, with completely separated content repositories
attrs.rationale: Restated by Rule 1, Rule 7 and Privacy Rule 3 (repositories completely separated by audience; no sharing across audiences without manual re-creation), Admin Editability (audience types fixed to Provider and Patient) and the Content Separation note (separate tables or repositories).

nodes.title: Ten-category provider Help Centre taxonomy

attrs.statement: System MUST support the 10-category provider Help Centre taxonomy (FAQ's, Tutorial Guides, Contact Support, Troubleshooting Tips, Resource Library, Community Forum, Feedback & Suggestions, Service Status, Policy Information, Video Tutorials) aligned with FR-032, backed by underlying content types and integrations (Contact Support/Feedback routed to FR-034)
attrs.rationale: Restated by Multi-Tenant Breakdown (provider Help Centre includes 10 categories) and Screen 1.1 (taxonomy fixed; admins configure labels, order, visibility and routing). Contact Support, Feedback & Suggestions and Community Forum are only configured in FR-033; submissions and forum interactions are handled outside it.

nodes.title: Four patient content types, no Service Status

attrs.statement: System MUST support 4 Help Centre content types for patients (FAQs, Articles, Resources, Videos - NO Service Status) displayed via FR-035 patient app
attrs.rationale: Restated by Multi-Tenant Breakdown (patient Help Centre: FAQs, Tutorial Guides, Troubleshooting Tips, Resource Library, Video Tutorials; no Service Status page for patients), Admin Editability (4 content types for patients) and Screen 8 to 13 (Service Status management excluded for patients).

nodes.title: Admin creates content with audience, kind, body, attachments, tags and status

attrs.statement: Admins MUST be able to create Help Centre content with audience selection (Provider or Patient), content kind (which decides the Help Centre section it appears in), title, rich text body, file attachments, tags, and publish status
attrs.rationale: Restated by Main Flow steps 1 to 15, Rule 7 (admin must explicitly select the audience) and Admin Editability (title, body, attachments, content kind, publish status, audience type are editable).

nodes.title: Six content types; Policy Document is provider-only

attrs.statement: System MUST support multiple content types (FAQ, Tutorial Guide, Troubleshooting Tip, Video Tutorial, Resource Document, Policy Document) applicable to both audiences, except that Policy Document is for the provider audience only (REQ-033-036).
attrs.rationale: Restated by Admin Editability (content type options are fixed in code).

nodes.title: FAQ topic sections with drag-and-drop reordering

attrs.statement: Admins MUST be able to organize FAQ content into collapsible topic sections with drag-and-drop reordering for both provider and patient FAQs separately
attrs.rationale: Restated by Alternative Flow A3, Screen 2 and Screen 2.2 rules, Admin Editability (FAQ topic organisation and FAQ item assignment) and User Story 5.

nodes.title: Providers read provider Help Centre categories read-only via FR-032

attrs.statement: Providers MUST be able to access provider-specific Help Centre categories in read-only mode via FR-032 with category-appropriate layouts (accordion FAQs, article views, file viewer, video player, status page)
attrs.rationale: Restated by Provider Consumption workflow (FR-032 loads the category registry and published provider-audience content; providers interact read-only; feedback and support submissions go through FR-032 and FR-034), Multi-Tenant Breakdown and Rule 2 (providers and patients have read-only access).

nodes.title: Patients read patient Help Centre content read-only via FR-035

attrs.statement: Patients MUST be able to access patient-specific Help Centre content in read-only mode via FR-035 (Patient Help Center & Support Submission)
attrs.rationale: Restated by Multi-Tenant Breakdown and Rule 2 (providers and patients have read-only access to their respective content).

nodes.title: Rich text editing for content creation

attrs.statement: System MUST support rich text editing for content creation with formatting (bold, italic, lists, links, images, tables) for both audiences
attrs.rationale: Restated by Dependencies (rich text editor library). If the editor library fails to load the PRD falls back to a plain textarea with markdown support (not migrated as a rule: technical fallback).

nodes.title: File upload size limits by upload kind

attrs.statement: System MUST support file uploads for Help Centre content with a size limit per upload kind (resource file 50MB whatever its type, uploaded video 500MB, resource thumbnail 1MB, video thumbnail 2MB, image placed inside article or FAQ text 10MB) for both audiences.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Alternative Flow B2, Admin Editability (upload size limits fixed in code) and Edge Cases (upload over the limit).

nodes.title: Preview content as the audience will see it before publishing

attrs.statement: System MUST provide content preview functionality allowing admins to view content exactly as target audience will see it before publishing
attrs.rationale: Restated by Main Flow steps 9 and 10 and Screen 7.

nodes.title: Content versioning with admin identity, timestamp, audience type and version notes

attrs.statement: System MUST support content versioning tracking all changes with admin identity, timestamp, audience type, and version notes
attrs.rationale: Restated by Alternative Flow A2 steps 5 to 9 and Admin Editability (versioning enabled by default and cannot be disabled).

nodes.title: Content record metadata

attrs.statement: System MUST store Help Centre content with metadata including audience type (Provider/Patient), content type, title, body, tags, publish status, created date, updated date, created by admin, updated by admin
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 1371 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Provider-only Service Status data

attrs.statement: System MUST store provider-specific Service Status data with metadata (overall status, service components with statuses, incidents with timeline, maintenance windows with schedules) - NOT applicable to patient content
attrs.rationale: Restated by Multi-Tenant Breakdown (no Service Status page for patients) and Key Entities 6 to 8.

nodes.title: Audit trail for content creation, editing, publishing, unpublishing and deletion

attrs.statement: System MUST maintain audit trail logging all content creation, editing, publishing, unpublishing, and deletion actions with admin identity, audience type, and timestamp
attrs.rationale: Restated by Rule 5 (audit also records audience type and action type), the Audit Rule, Main Flow step 13, Alternative Flows A2 and A5 (unpublish logged with reason), Screen 1.1 (category configuration changes recorded with old and new value) and Security Considerations (adds the admin IP address; PRD line 1247).

nodes.title: Soft delete to Archived status for both audiences

attrs.statement: System MUST support soft-delete for content (move to "Archived" status) not permanent deletion for both audiences; service components and incidents are also soft-deleted
attrs.rationale: Restated by Rule 6 (soft delete supports recovery and audit compliance), Data Retention (archived content retained indefinitely) and the delete rules of Screens 2 to 6.

nodes.title: File attachments stored in media storage with audience tags

attrs.statement: System MUST store file attachments in media storage service (S-05) with references in Help Centre content records and audience type tags
attrs.rationale: Restated by Security Considerations (files tagged with audience type for access control).

nodes.title: Content view analytics tracked separately per audience

attrs.statement: System MUST track content view analytics (total views per content item, views over time) separately for provider and patient audiences
attrs.rationale: Restated by Privacy Rule 2 (provider analytics at organisation level; patient analytics aggregated), Content Separation (analytics and view counts tracked separately per audience) and Shared Admin Capabilities (view counts, search queries, popular topics by audience).

nodes.title: Authentication required for Help Centre access

attrs.statement: System MUST enforce authentication for Help Centre access (providers, patients, and admins must be logged in)
attrs.rationale: Restated by Security Considerations (authentication).

nodes.title: Only admins with Help Centre permissions manage content

attrs.statement: System MUST enforce authorization for content management (only admins with Help Centre management permissions can create/edit/publish content for both audiences)
attrs.rationale: Restated by Rule 2 (only admins create, edit or delete Help Centre content; providers and patients have read-only access), Dependencies (FR-031 admin role permissions) and Security Considerations (authorization).

nodes.title: Audience-based access control

attrs.statement: System MUST enforce audience-based access control preventing providers from accessing patient content and patients from accessing provider content
attrs.rationale: Restated by Privacy Rule 3 and Security Considerations (audience separation enforced at API level).

nodes.title: Virus scan before files are made available

attrs.statement: System MUST scan all uploaded files for viruses before making available to users
attrs.rationale: Restated by Dependencies, external service 3 (if the scanner is unavailable uploads are quarantined and the admin notified; files are not made available until the scan completes) and Security Considerations (file upload).

nodes.title: Sanitise rich text HTML

attrs.statement: System MUST sanitize rich text HTML input to prevent XSS attacks (strip dangerous tags: script, iframe, object)
attrs.rationale: Restated by Security Considerations (content injection: strip script and iframe tags before saving; Content Security Policy headers are a technical measure and not migrated).

nodes.title: File type whitelist for uploads

attrs.statement: System MUST enforce one allowed-file list per upload kind, rejecting all other file types: resources (PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PNG, JPG), videos (MP4, MOV), and images such as thumbnails (PNG, JPG)
attrs.rationale: Restated by Security Considerations (File Upload Security) and Screen 4.

nodes.title: REST API for provider platform content

attrs.statement: System MUST provide REST API for provider platform (FR-032) to fetch provider-specific Help Centre content with authentication
attrs.rationale: Integration Point 1 (JSON payload, endpoint, provider session token) is technical and not migrated.

nodes.title: REST API for patient app content

attrs.statement: System MUST provide REST API for patient app (FR-035) to fetch patient-specific Help Centre content with authentication
attrs.rationale: Integration Point 2 (JSON payload, endpoint, patient session token) is technical and not migrated.

nodes.title: Media storage integration with audience tagging

attrs.statement: System MUST integrate with media storage service (S-05) for file upload, retrieval, and deletion with audience type tagging
attrs.rationale: Integration Point 4 (signed upload URLs; retry) is technical; the retry outcome is a separate rule.

nodes.title: Rich text editor library integration

attrs.statement: System MUST integrate with rich text editor library (Quill/TinyMCE/CKEditor) for content creation interface
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 1392 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Virus scanning service integration

attrs.statement: System MUST integrate with virus scanning service for file upload security validation
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 1393 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Service Status management for providers only

attrs.statement: Admins MUST be able to manage Service Status components, incidents, and maintenance windows for provider audience only (not applicable to patient audience)
attrs.rationale: Restated by Multi-Tenant Breakdown, Screens 8 to 13 (excluded for patients) and Assumption 4 of Business Process (service status updates are made by Hairline technical operations).

nodes.title: Entry points to Help Centre management and the provider Help Centre

attrs.statement: Admins access Help Centre management via Settings > Help Centre Management, with quick access from the admin dashboard. Providers access the Help Centre via the "Help Centre" menu item in provider platform navigation and a direct link from the provider dashboard settings page (FR-032 integration point).
attrs.rationale: Context-sensitive help links from provider platform screens are a future enhancement (not migrated). PRD: Entry Points (102-115); Dependencies FR-032 (1115-1117).

nodes.title: Out of scope: support submissions, live chat, forum, chatbot, notifications

attrs.statement: FR-033 does not handle Provider Contact Support or Feedback & Suggestions form submissions or patient support submissions (FR-034 Support Center & Ticketing creates the support cases), real-time chat between providers and admin (separate communication module A-10), provider-to-provider community forum interactions (FR-033 can only configure category presentation and routing) or automated chatbot responses (future V2). Content update notifications and email digest subscriptions are future enhancements.
attrs.rationale: FR-033 provides read-only Help Centre content; FR-034 handles all support ticket and feedback case management for providers and patients. PRD: Communication Structure (86-100); Dependencies FR-034 (1131-1133).

nodes.title: Category registry and service status changes reach providers within 1 minute

attrs.statement: Changes to the category registry and status updates to service components, incidents and maintenance propagate to provider Help Centre navigation and the provider Service Status subscreen within 1 minute.
attrs.rationale: Content update propagation within 1 minute is stated by REQ-032-092 (provider) and REQ-035-028 (patient); no separate FR-033 node was created for it. PRD: Screen 1.1 (343); Screen 6 (833); Alternative Flow A6 step 9 (276).

nodes.title: Publish, edit, unpublish, delete and reorder take effect in the provider and patient Help Centre within 1 minute

attrs.statement: Publishing content, editing published content, reordering FAQ topics or FAQs, unpublishing content, and deleting a Published item take effect in the provider Help Centre (via FR-032) and the patient Help Centre (via FR-035, REQ-035-028) within 1 minute.
attrs.rationale: Main Flow step 14, A2 step 10, A3 step 11, A5 step 7 (all say within 1 minute).

nodes.title: Full-text search across all Help Centre content, scoped to the audience

attrs.statement: Full-text search across all content (title, body, tags) is required for P1 and scoped to the selected audience (provider or patient). Database full-text indexing is the minimum implementation baseline; a dedicated search engine remains an optional later enhancement.
attrs.rationale: Also stated in Multi-Tenant Breakdown (search across all provider Help Centre content, line 54) and Content Separation (search and filtering scoped to the selected audience). PRD: Implementation Notes Search (1205); Multi-Tenant Breakdown (54).

nodes.title: Content tagged with audience and kind; the kind decides the section

attrs.statement: Content must be tagged with audience type (Provider or Patient) and with its kind (FAQ, Tutorial Guide, Troubleshooting Tip, Video Tutorial, Resource Document, Policy Document); the kind decides the Help Centre section the content appears in, and admins do not pick a section separately; Policy Document is for the provider audience only and is blocked for the patient audience, whose Article Type values are Tutorial Guide and Troubleshooting Tip.
attrs.rationale: Business Rules, General Module Rules, Rule 3.

nodes.title: Content states: Draft, Published, Unpublished, Archived

attrs.statement: Content can exist in four states: Draft (admin-only), Published (audience-visible), Unpublished (admin-only, previously published), Archived (admin-only, set when content is deleted).
attrs.rationale: Business Rules, General Module Rules, Rule 4. REQ-033-016 sets the Archived state on delete.

nodes.title: Help Centre content is non-sensitive and open to all users of the audience

attrs.statement: Help Centre content is non-sensitive and accessible to all users within their respective audience (all provider staff see provider content; all patients see patient content; no role-based content restrictions).
attrs.rationale: Dependencies FR-009 (all provider roles can access the provider Help Centre). PRD: Data & Privacy Rules, Privacy Rule 1 (1021).

nodes.title: Analytics at organisation level for providers, aggregated for patients

attrs.statement: Content view analytics are tracked at organization level for providers (clinic), and aggregated for patients (not individual user level).
attrs.rationale: Privacy Rule 2. prd.md lines 1025 (Data & Privacy Rules, Privacy Rule 2).

nodes.title: Archived content and audit log retained indefinitely

attrs.statement: Archived content is retained indefinitely for historical reference and audit compliance; the audit log is retained indefinitely for compliance.
attrs.rationale: Data Retention rule and Admin Editability (audit log retention period fixed in code). PRD: Data Retention (1025); Admin Editability (1058).

nodes.title: Fixed in code: categories, content types, audiences, size and character limits

attrs.statement: These are fixed in code and not editable by admins: the 10 provider Help Centre categories; 5 content types for providers and 4 for patients (no Service Status); the audience types Provider and Patient (no new audience types); the content type options (FAQ, Tutorial Guide, Troubleshooting Tip, Video Tutorial, Resource Document, Policy Document); the file upload size limits per upload kind (resource file 50MB, uploaded video 500MB, resource thumbnail 1MB, video thumbnail 2MB, image placed inside article or FAQ text 10MB); the content body character limits (max 5000 characters for FAQ answers, max 10,000 characters for tutorial guides); the audit log retention period.
attrs.rationale: Admin Editability, Fixed in Codebase. No Setting node is created because the PRD names none as configurable. PRD: Admin Editability, Fixed in Codebase (1052-1058).

nodes.title: Content versioning is always on

attrs.statement: Content versioning is enabled by default; admins cannot disable version control, for provider and patient content alike.
attrs.rationale: Configurable with Restrictions. PRD: Admin Editability, Configurable with Restrictions (1062).

nodes.title: Admins reorder and hide categories but cannot add or remove them

attrs.statement: Provider Help Centre categories are fixed to the 10-category taxonomy in system-prd.md; admins can reorder and toggle visibility but cannot add or remove categories. Categories are predefined and cannot be deleted.
attrs.rationale: Screen 1.1 rules and Admin Editability (category visibility applies to provider content only; the four patient sections are fixed). prd.md lines 329, 341, 1064.

nodes.title: Every category hide needs admin confirmation

attrs.statement: Every hide of a Help Centre category (any of the 10 categories) asks the admin for confirmation.
attrs.rationale: Screen 1.1 Visibility Toggle validation and Admin Editability Rules (Configurable with Restrictions).

nodes.title: Contact Support and Feedback & Suggestions route to FR-034 ticket forms

attrs.statement: For Contact Support and Feedback & Suggestions, Routing Type MUST be Ticket Form and MUST route to the FR-034-backed submission flows exposed in provider UX (FR-032 integration).
attrs.rationale: Routing Type options are Content List, Ticket Form, External Link and Coming Soon. PRD: Screen 1.1 rules (342).

nodes.title: Community Forum defaults to Coming Soon; External Link needs an HTTPS URL

attrs.statement: For Community Forum, Routing Type defaults to Coming Soon in MVP; if set to External Link, the External URL is required and must be a valid HTTPS URL.
attrs.rationale: PRD: Screen 1.1 data fields (331) and rules (343).

nodes.title: Category configuration changes are versioned and audited with old and new value

attrs.statement: All category configuration changes are versioned and recorded in audit trail (who/when/old value/new value).
attrs.rationale: Near the general audit rule REQ-033-015, which lists content actions only. PRD: Screen 1.1 rules (344).

nodes.title: Category label and description limits

attrs.statement: Category Label is required (max 50 characters); Category Description is optional (max 200 characters); Contact Support and Feedback & Suggestions intro copy is optional admin-managed rich text with sanitized HTML, shown above the submission CTA/form.
attrs.rationale: PRD: Screen 1.1 data fields (326-332).

nodes.title: Dashboard category navigation routes to the matching management screen

attrs.statement: The dashboard provides category navigation matching the provider Help Centre taxonomy (10 categories): FAQs open FAQ Management; Tutorial Guides, Troubleshooting Tips and Policy Information open Article Management filtered to that Article Type; Resources open Resource Management; Videos open Video Management; Service Status opens Service Status Management; Contact Support, Feedback & Suggestions and Community Forum open Category Configuration.
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 rules and notes. Patient Screen 8 mirrors it. PRD: Screen 1 rules (305-313).

nodes.title: Dashboard quick stats and recent activity

attrs.statement: Quick stats (total content, published content, draft content, total views) are calculated, read-only and update in real time as aggregate metrics across all content types. Recent activity shows content created, edited and published, category configuration changes and service status updates, sorted by date.
attrs.rationale: PRD: Screen 1 data fields and rules (297-315).

nodes.title: Patient content management screens mirror the provider screens, admin-only

attrs.statement: Patient Help Centre content management screens (Screens 8 to 13) are admin-only screens on the Admin Platform that mirror the provider content management screens (Screens 1 to 7) in structure and functionality, except that patients have no Service Status management; the audience of content managed there is displayed to patients via FR-035.
attrs.rationale: Version 2.1 change log: patient screens are admin-only, not patient app screens. PRD: Patient Help Centre Content Management note (977-996).

nodes.title: Admin UI labels audience; no copying between audiences

attrs.statement: Admin UI clearly labels content as "Patient Content" or "Provider Content" throughout the interface; search and filtering are scoped to the selected audience; content cannot be copied or shared between provider and patient repositories (manual re-creation required).
attrs.rationale: Content Separation note and Rule 7. PRD: Content Separation (999-1004).

nodes.title: Saved content carries a status and timestamps, with a success confirmation

attrs.statement: System saves content with status (Draft or Published) and timestamps and displays a success confirmation; for published content the confirmation links to the published content.
attrs.rationale: Main Flow steps 11, 12 and 15. PRD: Main Flow 11-15 (158-162).

nodes.title: Editing content creates a version on save; optional version note

attrs.statement: When an admin edits existing content, the editor is pre-filled with the existing content; the system creates a new version on save (opening the editor or cancelling creates none); the admin may add an optional "Version note" describing what changed; the system updates the content version and logs the change in the audit trail; if two admins edit the same item, the last save wins and both saves are versions.
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow A2. PRD: Alternative Flow A2 (171-186).

nodes.title: Unpublish needs confirmation and a reason; content stays in admin view

attrs.statement: To unpublish content the admin must confirm and enter a reason; the status changes from Published to Unpublished, the content is removed from the audience's Help Centre view within 1 minute (REQ-033-034), the action is logged in the audit trail with the reason, and the content remains in admin view as Unpublished for editing or re-publishing.
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow A5. PRD: Alternative Flow A5 (222-233).

nodes.title: Save as Draft and Publish run the same required-field check

attrs.statement: On Save as Draft and on Publish the system runs the same check of the required fields for the content kind (FAQ: question, answer, topic; article: title, content, article type; resource: name, file; video: title, source type) and of file formats, highlights missing or invalid fields with an error message, and saves or publishes only after the admin corrects them and re-submits.
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow B1; Screen forms validate required fields before saving. PRD: Alternative Flow B1 (235-247).

nodes.title: Over-limit upload shows the limit and alternatives

attrs.statement: When a file exceeds the size limit of its upload kind (resource file 50MB, uploaded video 500MB, resource thumbnail 1MB, video thumbnail 2MB, image placed inside article or FAQ text 10MB) the system displays an error message with the limit and suggested alternatives (compress the file, use external video hosting); the admin may re-upload a smaller file or add an external video embed link (YouTube or Vimeo).
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow B2. PRD: Alternative Flow B2 (249-262).

nodes.title: Failed media upload after retries notifies the admin and saves a draft

attrs.statement: If an upload to media storage fails after 3 retry attempts with exponential backoff, the system notifies the admin and saves the content as draft.
attrs.rationale: Promoted from Integration Point 4 (error handling). PRD: Integration Points, Integration 4 (1230).

nodes.title: Deleting content asks for confirmation and is a soft delete

attrs.statement: Deleting a FAQ, article, resource or video prompts the admin for confirmation before deletion, and the deletion is a soft delete.
attrs.rationale: Near REQ-033-016, which states the soft-delete outcome without the confirmation prompt. PRD: Screen 2 (366); Screen 3 (497); Screen 4 (588); Screen 5 (696).

nodes.title: Add/Edit forms: pre-fill, defaults, return to list, cancel discards

attrs.statement: Add/Edit forms open pre-filled with current data when editing and empty with default values (Draft status) when creating; on save the item is created or updated and the admin returns to the list with the updated list; on cancel changes are discarded and the admin returns to the list.
