attrs.rationale: Business rules of Screens 2.1, 3.1, 4.1, 5.1, 6.1, 6.2 and 6.3 (service status forms default to their own initial status, see the service status rules). PRD: Screens 2.1 (410-418), 3.1 (535-545), 4.1 (629-641), 5.1 (736-760).

nodes.title: Rich text formats supported by content type

attrs.statement: The FAQ answer editor supports bold, italic, lists, links and images; the article editor also supports headings (H1 to H6), tables and code blocks, with image upload inline within the editor.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2.1 and Screen 3 / 3.1 rules. PRD: Screen 2.1 (415); Screen 3 (498-506); Screen 3.1 (539).

nodes.title: Bulk operations on content

attrs.statement: Admins can run bulk operations: assign multiple FAQs to a topic, change status for multiple FAQs, articles, resources or videos (Publish and Unpublish only; a bulk Unpublish takes one shared reason for all selected items), delete multiple items (following the single-item delete rules), and upload multiple resource files at once; multiple FAQs can be edited in batch.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2, 3, 4 and 5 rules and notes; Shared Admin Capabilities (bulk operations). PRD: Screen 2 (368, 386); Screen 3 (515); Screen 4 (607); Screen 5 (704).

nodes.title: Related content assigned manually or auto-suggested

attrs.statement: Related articles and related videos can be assigned manually or auto-suggested based on tags or category; related content references other items of the same Help Centre.
attrs.rationale: Screens 3, 3.1, 5 and 5.1. PRD: Screen 3 (503); Screen 5 (703).

nodes.title: FAQ list organised by topic with drag-and-drop ordering

attrs.statement: The FAQ list displays all FAQs organized by topics with expandable topic sections; FAQs can be reordered by drag-and-drop within topics; the Preview button shows the exact accordion layout providers will see; the FAQ editor is optimized for accordion display (question as header, answer as expandable content).
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 rules. List filtering and search are owned by REQ-022-118. PRD: Screen 2 rules (360-370).

nodes.title: FAQ field rules

attrs.statement: FAQ question is required (max 200 characters); FAQ answer is required (max 5000 characters, HTML formatting supported); FAQ topic is required and chosen from pre-defined topics or a newly created one; display order is optional (an integer, auto-incremented within the topic if not specified); publish status is Draft or Published (an Unpublished item can only move to Published, REQ-033-099) and defaults to Draft; question, answer and topic are required before saving, with the same check for Save as Draft and for Publish.
attrs.rationale: Screens 2 and 2.1. PRD: Screen 2 (352-359); Screen 2.1 (398-418).

nodes.title: FAQ topic fields, uniqueness and ordering

attrs.statement: A topic name is required (max 100 characters) and unique within the audience; a topic description is optional (max 250 characters); display order is a required positive integer and topics can be reordered by drag-and-drop; Save Order persists the order and the provider Help Centre FAQ accordion reflects the updated topic order; Cancel discards unsaved changes.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2.2. PRD: Screen 2.2 (440-457).

nodes.title: A topic with FAQs cannot be deleted

attrs.statement: A topic that has assigned FAQs cannot be hard-deleted: the system blocks deletion and prompts the admin to reassign or remove the FAQs first; a topic may be soft-deleted only when no FAQs are assigned.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2.2. PRD: Screen 2.2 (450-452).

nodes.title: Topic shows the number of FAQs assigned

attrs.statement: Each topic shows the number of FAQs currently assigned to it; the number is read-only and calculated.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2.2 Number of FAQs. PRD: Screen 2.2 (440, 446).

nodes.title: Article list organised by type

attrs.statement: The article list displays all articles organized by type (Tutorial Guide, Troubleshooting Tip, Policy Information); the Preview button shows the exact article layout providers will see; the editor is optimized for article layout (full-width content with formatted text, images, code blocks); print-friendly view is available in preview.
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 rules. List filtering and search are owned by REQ-022-119. PRD: Screen 3 rules (493-506).

nodes.title: Article field rules

attrs.statement: Article title is required (max 200 characters); article content is required (max 10,000 characters; HTML, headings, lists, images and tables supported); article type is required (Tutorial Guide, Troubleshooting Tip or Policy Information; patient articles use Tutorial Guide or Troubleshooting Tip only, REQ-033-036); tags and related articles are optional; publish status defaults to Draft; title, content and article type are required before saving, with the same check for Save as Draft and for Publish.
attrs.rationale: Screens 3 and 3.1. PRD: Screen 3 (474-483); Screen 3.1 (522-545).

nodes.title: Table of contents generated for long articles

attrs.statement: A table of contents is auto-generated from headings on save for articles with multiple headings (articles over 1000 words); it is read-only.
attrs.rationale: Screens 3 and 3.1. PRD: Screen 3 (481, 500); Screen 3.1 (542).

nodes.title: Resource field rules

attrs.statement: Resource name is required (max 200 characters); description is optional (max 500 characters); the resource file is required for new resources (max 50MB whatever the file type; whitelist PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PNG, JPG); resource category is optional and chosen from Templates, Documents or Forms; thumbnail or icon is optional (max 1MB, PNG or JPG, 128x128px recommended); publish status defaults to Draft; name and file are required before saving.
attrs.rationale: Screens 4 and 4.1. The resource whitelist is the same list as REQ-033-024. prd.md lines 575, 622, 638, 1245.

nodes.title: Resource file validation, type and size detection, thumbnail generation

attrs.statement: File type and file size are detected from the upload automatically (read-only); the upload is validated for size, format and virus scan; the thumbnail is auto-generated from the PDF first page or uploaded by the admin; a file type icon is assigned automatically when no custom thumbnail exists.
attrs.rationale: Screens 4 and 4.1. PRD: Screen 4 (589-603); Screen 4.1 (636-641).

nodes.title: Replacing a file keeps the same record

attrs.statement: An existing resource's file cannot be changed, only replaced; the "Replace File" option replaces the file while keeping the same resource record, and for Upload File videos the "Replace Video" option replaces the file while keeping the same video record.
attrs.rationale: Screens 4.1 and 5.1. PRD: Screen 4.1 (630, 639); Screen 5.1 (756).

nodes.title: Admin can download resources and preview PDF and image files

attrs.statement: Admins can download a resource file; preview is available for PDF and image files and opens in a modal.
attrs.rationale: Screen 4. The download count increment is stated by REQ-032-098. PRD: Screen 4 (590, 598-599).

nodes.title: Video field rules

attrs.statement: Video title is required (max 200 characters); description is optional (max 500 characters); the video source type is required (Upload File or Embed from Third-Party); transcript is optional but recommended for accessibility, regardless of source type (max 10,000 characters); thumbnail is optional (max 2MB, PNG or JPG, 16:9 recommended); publish status defaults to Draft; title and source type are always required.
attrs.rationale: Screens 5 and 5.1. PRD: Screen 5 (672-684); Screen 5.1 (722-760).

nodes.title: Upload File videos: format, size, processing, duration, thumbnail and publish gate

attrs.statement: For Upload File videos the video file is required for new videos (MP4 or MOV, max 500MB) with a progress indicator; after upload a background job processes the video for streaming optimization (transcoding, thumbnail generation); the video duration is auto-extracted (read-only); the thumbnail is auto-generated from the video frame at the 10% mark unless the admin uploads a custom one; a processing status (uploading, processing, ready, failed) is shown; an uploaded video cannot be published until its processing status is ready (embedded videos are exempt); if processing fails the status becomes failed, the admin is told and can re-upload, and a new item stays Draft; when the file of a Published video is replaced or its source is switched, the previous video stays live for viewers until the new one is Ready, and if the new file fails the old one stays in place and the admin is told.
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow A4, Screens 5 and 5.1. PRD: Alternative Flow A4 (200-217); Screen 5.1 (741-752).

nodes.title: Embedded videos: allowed providers, URL only, thumbnail

attrs.statement: For Embed from Third-Party videos the embed URL is required and the system validates that it is a valid URL whose domain is in the allowed provider list (for example YouTube or Vimeo, or an approved provider); only the URL or ID is stored, not the video file; no video file is uploaded; the thumbnail is either a custom upload or the provider thumbnail (if supported); the duration may be fetched from the provider API or left manual or optional.
attrs.rationale: Screens 5 and 5.1; the duration handling is left as an implementation detail by the PRD. PRD: Screen 5 (697-700); Screen 5.1 (747-754).

nodes.title: Video analytics

attrs.statement: Video analytics comprise view count, average watch time and completion rate. A video view counts when the video plays for more than 30 seconds, regardless of source type.
attrs.rationale: Screen 5 notes and rules. The 30-second view count is also stated by REQ-032-099. PRD: Screen 5 (700, 713).

nodes.title: Overall service status is calculated from components

attrs.statement: The overall status is calculated automatically from the statuses of the active service components only and recalculated when a component changes; open incidents and maintenance in progress do not change it. A Degraded component does not count: if no active component is Down the overall status is All Systems Operational, if some but not all active components are Down it is Partial Outage, and if all active components are Down (including the case of a single active component) it is Major Outage; with no active component the page shows "Status not available" unless an admin sets the overall status by hand (see REQ-033-093); the options are All Systems Operational, Partial Outage and Major Outage.
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow A6 step 4, Screen 6 Data Fields (Overall Status) and Business Rules, Screen 6.1 and 6.2 rules.

nodes.title: Service component management

attrs.statement: Admins can create, edit and delete service components; delete prompts confirmation before deletion and archives the component instead of erasing it (it stays on past incidents and maintenance windows and is shown there as removed); a component on an open incident (not Resolved) or on a Scheduled or In Progress maintenance window cannot be deleted, and the message names the incident or window; the component name is required (max 100 characters); the component status is Operational, Degraded or Down and defaults to Operational for a new component; component status updates in real time and affects the overall platform status.
attrs.rationale: Screens 6 and 6.1. PRD: Screen 6 (808-811, 826); Screen 6.1 (843-859).

nodes.title: Incident management

attrs.statement: Admins can create, edit and delete incidents (delete prompts confirmation); the incident title is required (max 200 characters); the description is required (max 2000 characters); the status is Investigating, Identified, Monitoring or Resolved and defaults to Investigating; at least one affected service is required; the start time defaults to the current time; the end time is optional and must be after the start time; an incident can be marked as resolved.
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow A6 steps 5 to 8 and Screens 6 and 6.2. PRD: Screen 6 (812-815, 827); Screen 6.2 (875-899).

nodes.title: Incident status changes are logged on the timeline automatically

attrs.statement: The system automatically logs every incident status change with a timestamp in the incident timeline (Investigating, Identified, Monitoring, Resolved) and adds each new incident to the incident history timeline.
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow A6 steps 6 to 8, Screens 6 and 6.2. PRD: A6 (270-274); Screen 6 (828); Screen 6.2 (897).

nodes.title: Maintenance window management

attrs.statement: Admins can schedule, edit, cancel and mark as completed maintenance windows; title and description are required (title max 200 characters, description max 2000 characters); scheduled start and end times are required and the end must be after the start; scheduled times must be in the future for new maintenance windows; at least one affected service is required; the status is Scheduled, In Progress, Completed or Cancelled and defaults to Scheduled; the status changes only by admin action, and a window past its end time stays as the admin left it.
attrs.rationale: Screens 6 and 6.3. Screen 6 and 6.3 data fields and rules limit the future start time to new windows. prd.md lines 801, 816-818, 918-921, 930.

nodes.title: Past incidents and completed maintenance are retained

attrs.statement: Past incidents and completed maintenance are retained for historical reference.
attrs.rationale: Screen 6 notes. PRD: Screen 6 (836).

nodes.title: Preview renders the audience-facing layout and updates live

attrs.statement: Preview renders content in the exact audience-facing layout for the selected subscreen type (FAQ accordion with expand and collapse, article layout with table of contents, resource file viewer, video player, service status page), updates in real time as the admin edits, and includes all formatting, images and interactive elements; a print preview is available for article content.
attrs.rationale: Screen 7 (mirrored by Screen 13). PRD: Screen 7 rules (955-964).

nodes.title: Helpfulness rating is aggregated Yes/No feedback, read-only

attrs.statement: The helpfulness rating shown to admins is the aggregated Yes/No feedback counts from provider feedback (or aggregated patient feedback), read-only, and tracked per FAQ, article, resource and video for analytics; how a vote is recorded is stated by REQ-033-096.
attrs.rationale: Screens 2, 3 and 5. Recording the feedback is stated by REQ-032-094 and REQ-035-007. PRD: Screen 2 (356, 371); Screen 3 (480); Screen 5 (683).

nodes.title: Patient content avoids medical advice

attrs.statement: Patient content is curated to avoid medical advice and to focus on platform usage, appointment management and general information.
attrs.rationale: Promoted from Business Process Assumption 5 because it constrains what content admins publish. PRD: Assumptions, Business Process Assumption 5 (1194).

nodes.title: Related Content links to deleted (archived) content are removed

attrs.statement: When Help Centre content is deleted (archived), System MUST remove the Related Content links that point to it from other items
attrs.rationale: General Module Rules, Rule 8; Edge Cases (Related Content). PRD: FR-033.

nodes.title: A hand-set overall service status stays until an admin switches back to automatic

attrs.statement: When an admin sets the overall service status by hand, System MUST keep that value until an admin switches the overall status back to automatic; Service Status Management MUST provide a control to switch back to automatic
attrs.rationale: Screen 6 Data Fields (Overall Status, Return to Automatic) and Business Rules. PRD: FR-033.

nodes.title: Changing the source type of an existing video needs a new file or URL and a replace confirmation

attrs.statement: Admins MUST be able to change the source type of an existing video (uploaded file or third-party link) by providing the new file or URL and confirming that the old one is replaced; the video keeps its view counts; for a Published video the previous video stays live for viewers until the new one is Ready, and if the new file fails the old one stays in place and the admin is told
attrs.rationale: Screen 5.1 (video source type). PRD: FR-033.

nodes.title: Helpfulness ratings are kept as counts only, with no user identity

attrs.statement: Helpfulness ratings on Help Centre content (Yes and No) are kept as counts only: no user identity is stored (patients are anonymous; providers are counted at clinic level at most), and the ratings are not publicly displayed.
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 1248 (Security Considerations, Data Privacy: ratings kept as Yes/No counts only, no user identity stored, not publicly displayed), 1414 (content analytics: Yes and No counts only, no user identity).

nodes.title: A helpful vote is one anonymous Yes or No; repeat votes count

attrs.statement: A "Was this helpful?" vote on a FAQ, article, resource or video is one anonymous Yes or No added to the item's helpfulness count, written through the FR-032 and FR-035 content interfaces; no identity is kept, so repeat votes count.
attrs.rationale: Core Requirements and Data & Privacy. Recording the vote on the audience side is stated by REQ-032-094 and REQ-035-007.

nodes.title: Views of FAQs, articles and resources are counted per open and stored with their date

attrs.statement: A view of a FAQ, article or resource is counted each time its detail (or the FAQ answer) is opened, for both audiences; a video view keeps the 30-second rule (REQ-033-079); a resource download is counted for both audiences; each view is stored with its date so views over time (REQ-033-018) and the FR-035 30-day popular list can be derived.
attrs.rationale: Core Requirements and Data & Privacy (View records). FR-032 keeps REQ-032-098 (download) and REQ-032-099 (video view) as the calculating rules of the two counters.

nodes.title: A file that fails the virus scan is rejected and not stored

attrs.statement: A file that fails the virus scan MUST be rejected and not stored; the admin sees "File failed security scan. Upload a clean file." and the event is written to the audit trail.
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow B2 step 8 and the security rules. Extends REQ-033-022 and REQ-033-029.

nodes.title: Content status moves are limited; Published is left only by Unpublish or Delete

attrs.statement: Content status moves are limited to Draft to Published, Published to Unpublished (only through the Unpublish action with its reason), Unpublished to Published, and any state to Archived by Delete; the Publish Status dropdown offers Draft and Published only, Draft is not selectable for an Unpublished item, and the dropdown is read-only while the item is Published.
attrs.rationale: General Rule 4 and the Publish Status rows on the content forms.

nodes.title: Admins can filter archived content and restore it as Draft

attrs.statement: Each content list MUST have an admin-only "Archived" filter, and a Restore action MUST return an archived item as Draft; Related Content links removed at deletion (REQ-033-092) are not put back.
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow A7 and General Rule 6 (soft delete supports recovery).

nodes.title: Admin platform API unavailable: queue changes locally, sync, notify admin of sync failures

attrs.statement: If the API is unavailable when the admin platform saves Help Centre content, System MUST queue the content changes locally and sync them when the API is available, and MUST notify the admin of sync failures
attrs.rationale: Business Rules, Integration Failure Handling, Integration 3 (carried PRD line).

nodes.title: Provide admin interface for creating support cases

attrs.statement: System MUST provide admin interface for creating support cases with title (always required, no auto-generation), category (from centralized managed list), priority (from centralized managed list), ticket source, submitter type, patient/provider linkage, description, feedback resolution (optional), and attachments
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary (prd.md line 1187). Restated at prd.md lines 424, 185 (Screen 2 form fields and Main Flow step 5).

nodes.title: Assign unique case IDs in format CASE-YYYY-#####

attrs.statement: System MUST assign unique case IDs in format CASE-YYYY-##### (year and sequential number)
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary (prd.md line 1188). Restated at prd.md lines 747, 192 (Business Rule 1).

nodes.title: Unified status workflow

attrs.statement: **Unified Status Workflow**: System MUST support case lifecycle progression: Open → In Progress → Resolved → Closed (consistent across all ticket types and sources)
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary (prd.md line 1189). Restated at prd.md lines 81, 748, 452, 540 (Module Scope, Business Rule 2, Screen 2 and Screen 3).

nodes.title: Track Ticket Source

attrs.statement: System MUST track Ticket Source (Patient App, Provider Portal, Manual Admin Entry) for all support cases
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary (prd.md line 1190). Restated at prd.md lines 750 (Business Rule 4).

nodes.title: Track Submitter Type

attrs.statement: System MUST track Submitter Type (Patient, Provider, Admin) for all support cases
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary (prd.md line 1180). Restated at prd.md lines 751 (Business Rule 5).

nodes.title: Support optional Feedback Resolution tracking

attrs.statement: System MUST support optional Feedback Resolution tracking (Implemented, Planned, Declined, Under Review) for feedback/feature request tickets independently of case status
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary (prd.md line 1192). Restated at prd.md lines 752 (Business Rule 6).

nodes.title: Assign cases to admin users (informational)

attrs.statement: System MUST allow admin staff to assign cases to specific admin users for informational purposes only (assignment does not restrict access - all admins can view and work on all cases)
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary (prd.md line 1193). Restated at prd.md lines 80, 755, 454, 617 (Module Scope, Business Rule 9, Screen 2 and Screen 5).

nodes.title: Maintain immutable comprehensive case timeline

attrs.statement: System MUST maintain immutable comprehensive case timeline with all events showing full context and details (not just milestones): creation, status changes with reasons, feedback resolution changes, assignments, reassignments with reasons, notes, messages, attachments, account interventions with details, case reopening with reasons - each logged with timestamp and admin/patient/provider attribution
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary (prd.md line 1194). Restated at prd.md lines 757, 534 (Business Rule 11 and Screen 3).

nodes.title: Allow admins to link support cases to patient records by HPID, email, or

attrs.statement: System MUST allow admins to link support cases to patient records by HPID, email, or phone number
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary (prd.md line 1195). Restated at prd.md lines 86, 188 (Module Scope and Main Flow step 5).

nodes.title: Allow admins to link support cases to provider records by provider ID or

attrs.statement: System MUST allow admins to link support cases to provider records by provider ID or clinic name
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary (prd.md line 1196).

nodes.title: Provide deep-linking from support case to patient management module

attrs.statement: System MUST provide deep-linking from support case to patient management module (A-01) for account interventions when case is linked to patient record
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary (prd.md line 1197).

nodes.title: Provide deep-linking from support case to provider management module

attrs.statement: System MUST provide deep-linking from support case to provider management module (A-02) for provider record access when case is linked to provider record
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary (prd.md line 1187).

nodes.title: Allow admins to add internal notes to cases that are not visible to

attrs.statement: System MUST allow admins to add internal notes to cases that are not visible to patients/providers
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary (prd.md line 1199). Restated at prd.md lines 200, 450 (Main Flow step 15 and Screen 2).

nodes.title: Support two-way threaded communication between admin and patient/provider

attrs.statement: System MUST support two-way threaded communication between admin and patient/provider within case, allowing patient/provider to reply to admin messages from their apps (FR-035, FR-032)
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary (prd.md line 1200). Restated at prd.md lines 756, 535 (Business Rule 10 and Screen 3).

nodes.title: Display Communication Thread showing all messages from admin, patient, and

attrs.statement: System MUST display Communication Thread showing all messages from admin, patient, and provider in chronological order with sender identification
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary (prd.md line 1190). Restated at prd.md lines 532 (Screen 3 business rules).

nodes.title: Allow admins to reassign cases to other admin users

attrs.statement: System MUST allow admins to reassign cases to other admin users with reason tracking
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary (prd.md line 1191). Restated at prd.md lines 88, 320 (Module Scope and alternative flow B2).

nodes.title: Allow admins to reopen closed cases

attrs.statement: System MUST allow admins to reopen closed cases with reopening reason when patient/provider indicates issue not resolved
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary (prd.md line 1203). Restated at prd.md lines 749, 327 (Business Rule 3 and alternative flow B3).

nodes.title: Use centralized managed lists for case categories

attrs.statement: System MUST use centralized managed lists for case categories to ensure consistency across all submissions
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary (prd.md line 1204). Restated at prd.md lines 753 (Business Rule 7).

nodes.title: Use centralized managed lists for case priorities

attrs.statement: System MUST use centralized managed lists for case priorities to ensure consistency across system
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary (prd.md line 1194). Restated at prd.md lines 754 (Business Rule 8).

nodes.title: Require case title field

attrs.statement: System MUST require case title field with no auto-generation (admin must provide title manually)
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary (prd.md line 1206). Restated at prd.md lines 441 (Screen 2 business rules).

nodes.title: Automatically create support cases

attrs.statement: System MUST automatically create support cases when patients submit Contact Support or Feedback requests via patient app (FR-035)
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary (prd.md line 1196). Restated at prd.md lines 156, 762, 272 (System-Triggered Entry, Business Rule 16 and alternative flow A5).

nodes.title: Automatically create support cases

attrs.statement: System MUST automatically create support cases when providers submit Contact Support requests via Help Centre (FR-032 Screen 5.5)
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary (prd.md line 1208). Restated at prd.md lines 157, 232 (System-Triggered Entry and alternative flow A3).

nodes.title: Automatically create support cases

attrs.statement: System MUST automatically create support cases when providers submit Feedback & Suggestions via Help Centre (FR-032 Screen 5.6)
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary (prd.md line 1209). Restated at prd.md lines 158, 252 (System-Triggered Entry and alternative flow A4).

nodes.title: Automatically link patient-submitted cases to patient records

attrs.statement: System MUST automatically link patient-submitted cases to patient records using logged-in patient session and set Ticket Source = "Patient App", Submitter Type = "Patient"
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary (prd.md line 1210).

nodes.title: Automatically link provider-submitted cases to provider records

attrs.statement: System MUST automatically link provider-submitted cases to provider records using logged-in provider session and set Ticket Source = "Provider Portal", Submitter Type = "Provider"
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary (prd.md line 1211).

nodes.title: Allow patients to view status, feedback resolution, communication thread, and

attrs.statement: System MUST allow patients to view status, feedback resolution, communication thread, and reply to admin messages for their submitted support cases in patient app (FR-035)
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary (prd.md line 1201). Restated at prd.md lines 58, 290 (Patient Platform breakdown and alternative flow A5 step 15).

nodes.title: Allow providers to view status, feedback resolution, communication thread,

attrs.statement: System MUST allow providers to view status, feedback resolution, communication thread, and reply to admin messages for their submitted support cases and feedback in Help Centre (FR-032 Screen 5.5 and 5.6)
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary (prd.md line 1213). Restated at prd.md lines 68, 249 (Provider Platform breakdown and alternative flows A3 and A4).

nodes.title: Send email notifications to patients

attrs.statement: System MUST send email notifications to patients when admin responds to their submissions or updates case status (via S-03)
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary (prd.md line 1214).

nodes.title: Send email notifications to providers

attrs.statement: System MUST send email notifications to providers when admin responds to their submissions or updates case status (via S-03)
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary (prd.md line 1215).

nodes.title: Support case categories: Technical Issue, Account Access, Payment Question,

attrs.statement: System MUST support case categories: Technical Issue, Account Access, Payment Question, Booking Issue, General Inquiry, Provider Support, Patient Support, Feature Request, Bug Report, Feedback
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary (prd.md line 1220).

nodes.title: Support priority levels: Low, Medium, High, Urgent

attrs.statement: System MUST support priority levels: Low, Medium, High, Urgent
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary (prd.md line 1209).

nodes.title: Support Ticket Source options: Patient App, Provider Portal, Manual Admin

attrs.statement: System MUST support Ticket Source options: Patient App, Provider Portal, Manual Admin Entry
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary (prd.md line 1210).

nodes.title: Support Submitter Type options: Patient, Provider, Admin

attrs.statement: System MUST support Submitter Type options: Patient, Provider, Admin
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary (prd.md line 1211).

nodes.title: Support Feedback Resolution options: Implemented, Planned, Declined, Under

attrs.statement: System MUST support Feedback Resolution options: Implemented, Planned, Declined, Under Review (optional field for feedback/feature request tickets)
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary (prd.md line 1212).

nodes.title: Store case description

attrs.statement: System MUST store case description with minimum 20 characters and maximum 5000 characters
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary (prd.md line 1225). Restated at prd.md lines 431 (Screen 2 validation).

nodes.title: Support file attachments up to 10MB per file, 5 files per message

attrs.statement: System MUST support file attachments up to 10MB per file, with up to 5 files per message (replies included)
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary (prd.md line 1226). Restated at prd.md lines 433, 344 (Screen 2 and alternative flow B4).

nodes.title: Support attachment formats: JPG, PNG, PDF, DOC, DOCX

attrs.statement: System MUST support attachment formats: JPG, PNG, PDF, DOC, DOCX
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary (prd.md line 1215).

nodes.title: Retain all case data

attrs.statement: System MUST retain all case data per the system PRD, Platform-Wide Rules: One 10-year retention period (archive after closure, do not hard delete)
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary (prd.md line 1228). Restated at prd.md lines 774, 205 (Data Retention rule and Main Flow step 20).

nodes.title: Capture resolution details: resolution summary, resolution category, feedback

attrs.statement: System MUST capture resolution details: resolution summary, resolution category, feedback resolution (optional), root cause (optional), and resolution timestamp
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary (prd.md line 1229). Restated at prd.md lines 568, 571 (Screen 4 fields).

nodes.title: Encrypt all case data at rest

attrs.statement: System MUST encrypt all case data at rest using AES-256 encryption
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary (prd.md line 1238). Restated at prd.md lines 768, 1022 (Privacy Rule 2 and Security Considerations).

nodes.title: Encrypt all case data in transit

attrs.statement: System MUST encrypt all case data in transit using TLS 1.3
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary (prd.md line 1239). Restated at prd.md lines 768, 1022 (Privacy Rule 2 and Security Considerations).

nodes.title: Enforce RBAC permissions for case access

attrs.statement: System MUST enforce RBAC permissions for case access on the FR-031 permissions View Support Center and Respond to Support, with the Screen 7 settings and the audit export limited to Super Admin (REQ-034-094)
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary, Security and Privacy. REQ-034-094 lists what each permission allows.

nodes.title: Log all case access and modifications

attrs.statement: System MUST log all case access and modifications with timestamp, admin user ID, IP address, and action performed
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary (prd.md line 1241). Restated at prd.md lines 772, 1023 (Audit Rule and Security Considerations).

nodes.title: Scan uploaded attachments for viruses/malware

attrs.statement: System MUST scan uploaded attachments for viruses/malware before accepting; when the scanner is unavailable the file is refused with a "try again later" message and the case, reply or note can be saved without it
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary, Screen 2, Edge Cases and Alternative Flow B4a. FR-035 states the same behaviour for the patient app.

nodes.title: Prevent case deletion

attrs.statement: System MUST prevent case deletion (soft delete/archive only) to maintain immutable audit trail
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary (prd.md line 1243). Restated at prd.md lines 769, 1021 (Privacy Rule 3 and Security Considerations).

nodes.title: Mark Internal Notes as admin-only and prevent patient/provider access

attrs.statement: System MUST mark Internal Notes as admin-only and prevent patient/provider access
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary (prd.md line 1244). Restated at prd.md lines 770, 450, 538 (Privacy Rule 4, Screen 2 and Screen 3).

nodes.title: Integrate with S-03 Notification Service for support events

attrs.statement: System MUST integrate with S-03 Notification Service to send notifications for support case events (case created, assigned, status changed, admin reply, user reply, resolved, reopened, closed, escalated) based on notification rules configured in FR-030
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary (prd.md line 1248).

nodes.title: Publish support case notification events to S-03

attrs.statement: System MUST publish support case notification events to S-03 with complete case context (case ID, title, status, submitter info, message content, etc.) for template rendering
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary (prd.md line 1249).

nodes.title: Support all notification delivery channels configured in FR-030 for support

attrs.statement: System MUST support all notification delivery channels configured in FR-030 for support case events (email, push; SMS in future phases)
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary (prd.md line 1250).

nodes.title: Determine notification recipients

attrs.statement: System MUST determine notification recipients based on case attributes (submitter type, assigned admin, case priority, escalation rules) and FR-030 recipient rules
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary (prd.md line 1251).

nodes.title: Rely on S-03 retry logic for failed notification deliveries

attrs.statement: System MUST rely on S-03 retry logic for failed notification deliveries (retry logic configured in FR-030, not FR-034)
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary (prd.md line 1252).

nodes.title: Log notification events in case timeline

attrs.statement: System MUST log notification events in case timeline (notification sent, delivery status) for audit trail
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary (prd.md line 1253). Restated at prd.md lines 1166, 1005 (Edge Cases and Integration Points).

nodes.title: Provide RESTful API for case creation, retrieval, update, and search

attrs.statement: System MUST provide RESTful API for case creation, retrieval, update, and search operations
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary (prd.md line 1254).

nodes.title: Provide Support Center case listing screen as primary view

attrs.statement: System MUST provide Support Center case listing screen as primary view with quick stats bar displaying: open cases count, in progress count, urgent cases count, unassigned cases count
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary (prd.md line 1261). Restated at prd.md lines 366, 412 (Screen 1 quick stats).

nodes.title: Display case list

attrs.statement: System MUST display case list with comprehensive filters: status, priority, category, ticket source, submitter type, request type, request status, date range, assigned admin, and search functionality
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary. Restated in the Screen 1 filter bar.

nodes.title: Support keyword search across case ID, title, description, names, email and phone

attrs.statement: System MUST support keyword search across case ID, case title, description, patient name, provider name, email address, and phone number (internal notes are not searched)
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary (prd.md line 1263). Restated at prd.md lines 402 (Screen 1 search).

nodes.title: Highlight urgent cases in dashboard and case lists

attrs.statement: System MUST highlight urgent cases in dashboard and case lists with visual indicators (red badges, alert icons)
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary (prd.md line 1264). Restated at prd.md lines 552, 400 (Screen 3 notes).

nodes.title: Display warning for cases with no activity beyond the Case Inactivity Threshold

attrs.statement: System MUST display warning for Open and In Progress cases with no activity for longer than the Case Inactivity Threshold (Screen 7, default 14 days); activity means any reply, note, status change or reassignment
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary. Restated in Screen 1 and Screen 3 (REQ-034-078).

nodes.title: Require resolution summary

attrs.statement: System MUST require resolution summary (min 20 chars, max 1000 chars) before case can be marked Resolved
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary (prd.md line 1269). Restated at prd.md lines 568, 589 (Screen 4 business rules and fields).

nodes.title: Send resolution email to patient/provider

attrs.statement: System MUST send resolution email to patient/provider when case marked Resolved (if "Send Resolution Email" option enabled)
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary (prd.md line 1270). Restated at prd.md lines 572, 580 (Screen 4).

nodes.title: Support auto-closure period: Immediately, 3, 7, or 14 days

attrs.statement: System MUST support auto-closure period: Immediately, 3, 7, or 14 days after case marked Resolved (default 7 days)
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary (prd.md line 1271). Restated at prd.md lines 573, 786 (Screen 4 Auto-Close After and Admin Editability).

nodes.title: Automatically close case

attrs.statement: System MUST automatically close case after auto-closure period expires if patient/provider doesn't respond
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary (prd.md line 1272). Restated at prd.md lines 585, 203, 975 (Screen 4, Main Flow step 18 and Assumptions).

nodes.title: Log reopening reason in case timeline

attrs.statement: System MUST log reopening reason in case timeline when case is reopened
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary (prd.md line 1274). Restated at prd.md lines 652, 336 (Screen 6 business rules and alternative flow B3).

nodes.title: Complete case creation within 2 seconds for 95% of requests

attrs.statement: System MUST complete case creation within 2 seconds for 95% of requests
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary (prd.md line 1279).

nodes.title: Load case detail view

attrs.statement: System MUST load case detail view (including timeline) within 2 seconds
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary (prd.md line 1261).

nodes.title: Return case search results within 1 second for keyword searches

attrs.statement: System MUST return case search results within 1 second for keyword searches
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary (prd.md line 1262).

nodes.title: Support 50 concurrent admin users managing cases without performance

attrs.statement: System MUST support 50 concurrent admin users managing cases without performance degradation
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary (prd.md line 1282).

nodes.title: Handle up to 500 case creations per day at launch, scalable to 1000+ cases

attrs.statement: System MUST handle the expected 100 to 200 case creations per day at launch, absorb peaks of up to 500 per day, and scale to 1000 cases per day within 12 months
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary (prd.md line 1264).

nodes.title: Entry points to the Support Center

attrs.statement: Patients access Contact Support and Feedback submission forms from patient app Help Center (FR-035: Patient Help Center & Support Submission); Providers access Contact Support form from Help Centre (FR-032 Screen 5.5) to submit support requests; Providers access Feedback & Suggestions form from Help Centre (FR-032 Screen 5.6) to submit feedback; Admin staff access Support Center module from main admin navigation menu; Default view shows case listing screen with all cases (Open and In Progress by default); Admin can create new support case manually from case listing screen via "Create New Case" button; Super Admin accesses Support Center Configuration via Settings > Support Center path to manage centralized lists (categories, priorities, resolution categories, root causes, tags)
attrs.rationale: Entry Points (prd.md lines 131 to 162), including the Admin Platform, patient app, provider Help Centre and Settings routes; Support Center Configuration is Super Admin only (prd.md line 152). The case-listing default view is also stated on Screen 1 (prd.md line 395).

nodes.title: Admin notified of new or assigned case

attrs.statement: Admin receives email notification when new support case is created or assigned to them
attrs.rationale: Entry Points, Admin Platform Entry (prd.md line 150). Also stated for assignment in Business Rules Notification Rule 3 and Main Flow step 10; the new-case trigger appears only here and in Alternative Flows A3 to A5 step 12.

nodes.title: Linked cases visible from patient and provider records

attrs.statement: Admins accessing patient records can view linked support cases for that patient; Support case context appears in patient detail view (e.g., "3 open support cases" with links); Support cases linkable from patient management module (A-01) - admins view patient's support history; Support cases linkable from provider management module (A-02) - admins view provider's support history
attrs.rationale: Module Scope A-01 breakdown and Entry Points, Integration Entry (prd.md lines 94, 164, 165). FR-016 and FR-015 own the patient and provider detail screens; this FR owns the requirement as the PRD states it.

nodes.title: Account interventions logged on both sides

attrs.statement: Admins can initiate account interventions (password reset, account suspension) directly from support cases; System logs intervention in both support case timeline and patient account audit trail; System logs intervention in both support case timeline and provider account audit trail
attrs.rationale: Module Scope A-01 breakdown and Alternative Flows A2 (patient) and A6 (provider) (prd.md lines 96, 229, 302). The provider flow shows the record link only when the case is linked to a provider (prd.md line 298).

nodes.title: Out of scope for support cases

attrs.statement: Out of scope: Real-time in-app chat between patient and admin (future enhancement); Real-time in-app chat between provider and admin (future enhancement); Aftercare-specific communications (handled by FR-011: Aftercare & Recovery Management); Provider ↔ Patient secure messaging (handled by FR-012: Secure Messaging); Video consultations for support (future enhancement); SMS notifications for support case updates (future enhancement - S-03 SMS integration); Phone call integration or VoIP (future enhancement); Support cases distinct from aftercare communications (FR-011) and provider-patient messaging (FR-012)
attrs.rationale: Communication Structure, Out of Scope list (prd.md lines 123 to 129) and Business Rule 14 (prd.md line 760).

nodes.title: Resolution time targets

attrs.statement: Maximum case resolution time target: 48 hours for Urgent, 5 business days for High, 10 business days for Medium/Low priority; a target only, with no system behaviour when it passes
attrs.rationale: General Module Rules, Rule 12. Success criteria state a 5 business day target for non-urgent cases; see migration report.

nodes.title: Inactive cases flagged for review

attrs.statement: Open and In Progress cases with no activity for longer than the Case Inactivity Threshold (Screen 7, default 14 days) are flagged for admin review and potential closure; the same threshold drives the warning shown in the case list and case detail view; activity means any reply, note, status change or reassignment
attrs.rationale: General Module Rules, Rule 13. The 14-day figure is configurable on Screen 7 (Case Inactivity Threshold).

nodes.title: Multiple cases per patient or provider

attrs.statement: Admin staff can link multiple cases to same patient/provider for trend analysis
attrs.rationale: General Module Rules, Rule 15 (prd.md line 761).

nodes.title: Reply notifies assigned admin or all support staff

attrs.statement: When patient/provider replies to case, message appears in Communication Thread and triggers email notification to assigned admin (or all support staff if unassigned)
attrs.rationale: General Module Rules, Rule 17 (prd.md line 769). Notification Rule 3 names the same event as a reopening of a closed case (prd.md line 839); see migration report.

nodes.title: Case data visible to authorized admins

attrs.statement: Patient full names, contact details, and medical information visible to admin users granted Support Center access via RBAC; within Support Center, all cases are visible regardless of assignment
attrs.rationale: Data and Privacy Rules, Privacy Rule 1 (prd.md line 776).

nodes.title: Timeline and messages append-only

attrs.statement: Case timeline and all messages logged with immutable audit trail (cannot be deleted, only appended)
attrs.rationale: Data and Privacy Rules, Privacy Rule 3 (prd.md line 778). Also listed as fixed in the codebase under Admin Editability (audit trail structure and immutability).

nodes.title: Internal notes need a permission

attrs.statement: Internal Notes visible to every admin staff member with the "View Support Center" permission (not visible to patients/providers)
attrs.rationale: Data and Privacy Rules, Privacy Rule 4 (prd.md line 779). REQ-034-046 states the admin-only part without the permission name.

nodes.title: Cases handled as protected health information

attrs.statement: Support cases may contain medical information; handle as PHI with healthcare-grade security
attrs.rationale: Data and Privacy Rules, HIPAA/GDPR (prd.md line 782).

nodes.title: Attributes admins can edit

attrs.statement: Editable by Admin (via Admin Platform UI): Case category, priority, title, description (per-case editing in Screen 2); status changes follow REQ-034-102; Case assignment (transfer to another admin user via Screen 5); Internal notes and admin-only comments (in Screen 3); Patient/provider linkage (add, modify, or remove linked records in Screen 2); Case tags and labels (per-case in Screen 2); Resolution summary and resolution category (in Screen 4); Auto-close period (Immediately, 3, 7, or 14 days after resolution in Screen 4)
attrs.rationale: Business Rules, Admin Editability (prd.md lines 787 to 795). Screens 2, 3, 4 and 5 are named in the line items.

nodes.title: Lists Super Admin can configure

attrs.statement: Configurable by Super Admin (via Settings > Support Center - Screen 7): Case categories list (built-in list: edit label and reorder only; categories cannot be added, deactivated or deleted); Case priorities list (the four built-in priorities Low, Medium, High, Urgent cannot be renamed, deactivated or deleted; other priorities can be added, edited, deactivated and reordered; color coding); Resolution categories list (add, edit, deactivate, reorder); Root cause options list (add, edit, deactivate, reorder); Case tags master list (add, edit, delete, color coding); Auto-escalation thresholds (configurable within defined ranges: 1-48 hours for urgent cases, 12-72 hours for high priority, 7-90 days for inactivity); Reopen reason templates (add, edit, delete)
attrs.rationale: Business Rules, Admin Editability (prd.md lines 790 to 796). Screen 7 business rules restate the access, immediate effect and deletion limits (prd.md lines 718 to 728).

nodes.title: Values fixed in the codebase

attrs.statement: Fixed in Codebase (Not Editable): Case lifecycle stages (Open, In Progress, Resolved, Closed); Feedback Resolution options (Implemented, Planned, Declined, Under Review); Case ID format and generation logic (CASE-YYYY-#####); Ticket Source options (Patient App, Provider Portal, Manual Admin Entry); Submitter Type options (Patient, Provider, Admin); Audit trail structure and immutability; Encryption algorithms (AES-256 for data at rest, TLS 1.3 for data in transit); Maximum attachment size (10MB per file)
attrs.rationale: Business Rules, Admin Editability (prd.md lines 800 to 807). Screen 7 restates that Feedback Resolution options are fixed (prd.md line 725).

nodes.title: Notification content managed in FR-030

attrs.statement: Configurable with Restrictions (via FR-030: Notification Rules & Configuration): Email notification templates for support case events (content editable, trigger logic fixed):; Notification timing and retry logic for support case notifications; ; Note: Notification templates, delivery timing, channel preferences, and recipient rules for all support case notifications are managed centrally in FR-030 (Notification Rules & Configuration), not in FR-034. Admin configures these via Settings → Alerts & Notifications → Messaging/Support category.
attrs.rationale: Business Rules, Admin Editability (prd.md lines 811, 822, 823) and the note after the Integration Requirements (prd.md line 1239). The nine event templates listed at prd.md lines 812 to 820 mirror REQ-034-047. FR-030 owns templates, channels, timing and retry; the PRD boundary is recorded as stated.

nodes.title: Patient email notifications

attrs.statement: Patients receive email notifications when: Support case created (optional confirmation); Case status changes to "In Progress" (admin is working on it); Admin sends message/reply to patient; Case marked "Resolved" with resolution summary; Case closed
attrs.rationale: Business Rules, Notification Rule 1 (prd.md lines 826 to 831). Module Scope S-03 lists a different set of patient notices (prd.md lines 100 to 103); see migration report.

nodes.title: Provider email notifications

attrs.statement: Providers receive email notifications when: Support case created for their inquiry; Case status changes; Admin sends message/reply to provider; Case marked "Resolved" with resolution summary; Case closed
attrs.rationale: Business Rules, Notification Rule 2 (prd.md lines 841 to 846).

nodes.title: Admin email notifications

attrs.statement: Admin staff receive email notifications when: Case assigned to them; Case escalated to them (an escalation always goes to a Super Admin, and a system escalation goes to all Super Admins); Patient/provider replies to a case (one email per reply); A case is reopened (a separate reopening notice, in addition to the reply email); An Open or In Progress Urgent case is still unassigned 1 hour after the Urgent clock started (the FR-030 notice `support.urgent_case_unassigned` to the Support Staff pool, REQ-030-258, with the 1-hour wait fixed; if the case is still unassigned at the Urgent Case Unassigned Threshold in Screen 7, default 24 hours, the system escalates it to Super Admin); The assigned admin of a case is deactivated and the case becomes unassigned (the FR-030 notice `support.case_orphaned` to the Support Staff pool, REQ-030-259, to reassign it); A notice to the patient or provider still fails once the FR-030 retry rule is exhausted (the FR-030 notice `support.notice_delivery_failed` to the assigned admin, or to the Support Staff pool when the case is unassigned, REQ-030-260, to contact the patient or provider by hand)
attrs.rationale: Business Rules, Notification Rule 3. The 1-hour alert is fixed; the Screen 7 threshold is the point where the system escalates the case (REQ-034-173).

nodes.title: Notification content

attrs.statement: Email notifications include case ID, title, status, and direct link to admin case view (for admin recipients)
attrs.rationale: Business Rules, Notification Rule 5 (prd.md line 854). Notification Rule 4 (S-03 with retry) is restated by REQ-034-047 and REQ-034-051 (prd.md line 841).

nodes.title: Support Center permissions

attrs.statement: View Support Center: open and read cases, including internal notes; Respond to Support: reply, add internal notes, create, edit, reassign, resolve, close and reopen cases (assignment is informational only and does not restrict access); assignee lists show active admins with this permission; the Support Staff pool, the recipient of every notice sent to the pool, is all active admin users who hold this permission, whatever their FR-031 role (the pool is not limited to the FR-031 role named Support Staff); Super Admin only: Support Center configuration (Screen 7), receipt of escalations and audit log export (no hard delete; archive only); There is no Support Manager role and no "Manage Support Configuration" permission; A user without View Support Center who sees a case row in FR-016 Screen 9 gets the case reference without a link
attrs.rationale: Data and Privacy Rules, Authorization. The two permission names are the FR-031 Communication and Support permissions (REQ-031-111); FR-031 owns the role definitions.

nodes.title: Case creation rate limit

attrs.statement: Rate limiting on case creation API (max 60 cases/hour per admin user) to prevent abuse
attrs.rationale: Implementation Notes, Security Considerations (prd.md line 1035). Kept as a rule because it limits what an admin may do.

nodes.title: New case defaults

attrs.statement: Status defaults to "Open" for new cases; Priority defaults to "Medium" for new cases; System validates inputs and creates support case record with status "Open"
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 business rules and Main Flow step 6 (prd.md lines 451, 453, 191). Alternative Flows A3 to A5 set status Open for submitted cases (prd.md lines 243, 263, 283).

nodes.title: Creation records creator and time

attrs.statement: System records case creation timestamp and admin user who created it
attrs.rationale: Main Flow step 8 (prd.md line 193).

nodes.title: Submission confirmation shown to submitter

attrs.statement: System displays confirmation to patient: "Support request submitted. Case #[number]. Our team will respond within 24 hours on business days."; System displays confirmation to provider: "Support request submitted. Case #[number]. Our team will respond within 24 hours on business days."; System displays confirmation to provider: "Thank you for your feedback! Case #[number]. We'll review your submission."
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flows A5, A3 and A4 step 10. The quoted wording is template copy and is not modelled; the 24-hours-on-business-days commitment is the first-response target (REQ-034-175), worded as in FR-035 REQ-035-054.

nodes.title: Submission confirmation email and admin notice

attrs.statement: System sends confirmation email to patient with case reference number (via S-03); System sends confirmation email to provider with case reference number (via S-03); System sends notification to the Support Staff pool
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flows A5, A3 and A4 steps 11 and 12 (prd.md lines 286, 287, 246, 247, 266, 267). Main Flow steps 10 and 11 state the optional version for manually created cases (prd.md lines 195, 196).

nodes.title: Default team by submission type

attrs.statement: System sets case status to "Open" and routes it to the Support Staff pool for patient, provider and feedback submissions (team is a routing label only)
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flows A5, A3 and A4 step 8 (prd.md lines 283, 243, 263). Assignment is informational only (Business Rule 9); the team is a routing label, not an assignee.

nodes.title: Category and priority from the submitter

attrs.statement: System sets case category based on the patient's selection from the categories visible to patients; System sets case priority based on patient's selection (Low, Medium, High, Urgent); System sets case category based on the provider's selection from the categories visible to providers; System sets case priority based on provider's selection (Low, Medium, High, Urgent); System sets case category from the feedback type: Feature Request and Bug Report keep their own categories, Suggestion and Other are filed under category Feedback (no new categories); System sets case priority based on provider's suggested priority (Low, Medium, High, Urgent); Each built-in category has a fixed Visible To value (patient and provider, patient, provider, or admin only) that decides which submission forms offer it; the membership is the table on Screen 7 and is not editable
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flows A5, A3 and A4 steps 6 and 7, and Screen 7. The feedback-type mapping in A4 is separate from the Visible To value, which governs the category choices a form offers.

nodes.title: No skipped stages, no closing before Resolved

attrs.statement: Status follows unified workflow: Open → In Progress → Resolved → Closed (cannot skip stages except for case reopening); Case cannot be marked "Closed" until status is "Resolved" (validation rule); System prevents closing case unless status is "Resolved" first; Status is Open on create and is not editable on Screen 2 when a case is edited; the Update Status modal offers Open to In Progress only; Resolved is reached only through Resolve Case (Screen 4, resolution summary required), Closed only through Close Case, and Closed or Resolved to Open only through Reopen Case
attrs.rationale: Screen 2, Screen 3 and Business Rule 2. Each later stage has one control that carries its own required input.

nodes.title: Escalate a case

attrs.statement: Admin clicks "Reassign Case" (there is no separate escalation button or form); System displays the Reassign Case modal (Screen 5); Admin ticks "Escalate", selects a Super Admin as the new assignee (the list shows active Super Admin users only), and enters the required reassignment reason; System sets the case priority to the "High" or "Urgent" the admin chose, from the values at or above the current priority only (a case that is already Urgent stays Urgent and no choice is shown), writes it to the case priority and shows it on the timeline; System sends the escalation notice to the chosen Super Admin; System logs the reassignment in case timeline, marked as an escalation; Case reassigned to a Super Admin at the chosen priority, never lower than before
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow A1. Escalation is the Escalate tick in the Reassign Case modal (Screen 5); it has no separate screen or form, and it always goes to a Super Admin.

nodes.title: Invalid patient identifier

attrs.statement: System validates patient identifier against patient database; System displays error message: "Patient not found. Please verify identifier or create case without patient link."; Admin corrects identifier or selects "No Patient Link" option for anonymous inquiries; System allows case creation without patient linkage; Case created for inquiry from non-registered user or with corrected patient identifier
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow B1 (prd.md lines 309 to 313). Screen 2 says the identifier is required when Submitter Type is Patient (prd.md line 429); see migration report.

nodes.title: Reassignment flow

attrs.statement: Admin manager or colleague opens case; Admin clicks "Reassign Case" button; System displays team member list; Admin selects new assignee and enters reassignment reason; System updates case assignment and notifies new assignee; System logs reassignment action in case timeline
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow B2. Screen 5 rules add the logging and notification detail. Assignee availability status is out of scope.

nodes.title: Rejected attachments

attrs.statement: System validates file size (max 10MB per file) and format (images, PDFs, documents); System displays error: "File exceeds 10MB limit" or "Unsupported file format"; If malware detected, system rejects upload and displays error: "File rejected due to security scan failure"; Admin notified to request patient/provider send file via alternative secure method
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow B4 and Edge Cases (prd.md lines 344, 345, 1151, 1152).

nodes.title: Duplicate email on patient link

attrs.statement: System displays list of all patients with matching email and prompts admin to select correct patient by HPID; Admin can choose to create case without patient link if ambiguous
attrs.rationale: Edge Cases (prd.md lines 1136, 1137).

nodes.title: Deactivated admin leaves cases unassigned

attrs.statement: System automatically detects deactivated admin accounts and marks their assigned cases as "Unassigned"; The Support Staff pool receives the FR-030 notice `support.case_orphaned` (REQ-030-259) to reassign orphaned cases; Case timeline logs admin account deactivation event
attrs.rationale: Edge Cases (prd.md lines 1150 to 1153). The timeline event list includes Admin Deactivated (prd.md line 529).

nodes.title: Case kept when patient account is deleted

attrs.statement: Support case remains in system with anonymized patient identifier for audit trail compliance; Case marked with "Patient Account Deleted" badge; Admin cannot deep-link to patient record but can still take the case to Resolved with a resolution summary and then Closed; If patient record deleted, support case retains anonymized copy of patient name/email for audit trail, and the anonymisation follows FR-023; No email of any kind is sent to a deleted patient, and the email checkboxes on Screens 4 and 6 show unchecked and disabled
attrs.rationale: Edge Cases and Data and Privacy Rules. FR-035 REQ-035-075 states the matching rule for the patient app: notices stop.

nodes.title: Case kept when provider is deactivated

attrs.statement: If provider record deactivated, support case retains provider name for historical reference
attrs.rationale: Implementation Notes, Integration 2 (prd.md line 1011).

nodes.title: Concurrent edits: last write wins

attrs.statement: System uses optimistic locking with "last write wins" strategy; If conflict detected, admin receives warning: "This case was modified by another admin. Please review recent changes before saving."; Admin can review other admin's changes and decide whether to overwrite or discard their edits
attrs.rationale: Edge Cases (prd.md lines 1155 to 1157).

nodes.title: Search input sanitized

attrs.statement: System sanitizes all search input to prevent SQL injection attacks; Special characters escaped before executing search query; Search limited to alphanumeric characters, spaces, and common punctuation
attrs.rationale: Edge Cases (prd.md lines 1160 to 1162).

nodes.title: Failed notifications retried and flagged

attrs.statement: System queues the notification for retry following the FR-030 retry rule (FR-030 owns the retry schedule and count); Case timeline logs notification failure with timestamp; Admin dashboard displays notification status indicator (sent, pending, failed); If the notification still fails once the FR-030 retry rule is exhausted, the assigned admin (or the Support Staff pool when the case is unassigned) receives the FR-030 notice `support.notice_delivery_failed` (REQ-030-260) to manually contact the patient/provider
attrs.rationale: Edge Cases (prd.md lines 1165 to 1168) and Implementation Notes, Integration 3 (prd.md line 1005). REQ-034-051 says retry logic is configured in FR-030, not FR-034; see migration report.

nodes.title: Default listing view

attrs.statement: Default view shows Open and In Progress cases from last 90 days, sorted by Last Updated descending; the provider My Support Cases list (FR-032 Screen 5.7) uses this same default and refers to this rule, while its 20-cases-per-page detail is a separate rule in FR-032
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 business rules (prd.md line 395). Entry Points state the same default (prd.md line 148).

nodes.title: Urgent cases sorted to the top

attrs.statement: Urgent cases always sorted to top of list regardless of other sort order
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 business rules (prd.md line 400). REQ-034-057 states the highlight part.

nodes.title: Listing filters and defaults

attrs.statement: Filter Bar: Comprehensive filtering controls including: Status Filter (multi-select dropdown: Open, In Progress, Resolved, Closed; Default: Open + In Progress), Priority Filter (multi-select dropdown: Low, Medium, High, Urgent; Default: All priorities), Category Filter (multi-select dropdown from centralized category list; Default: All categories), Ticket Source Filter (multi-select dropdown: Patient App, Provider Portal, Manual Admin Entry; Default: All sources), Submitter Type Filter (multi-select dropdown: Patient, Provider, Admin; Default: All types), Date Range Filter (date picker for creation date range; Default: Last 90 days), Assigned To Filter (dropdown select: All Users, specific user; Default: All Users), Request Type Filter (multi-select dropdown: Booking Cancellation, Booking Change; Default: All types), Request Status Filter (multi-select dropdown: Open, Resolved, Declined; Default: All statuses); Filters are cumulative (AND logic between different filter types); Filter selections persist during session
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 filter bar and business rules (prd.md lines 365, 403, 365). REQ-034-055 lists the filters without defaults.

nodes.title: Listing search

attrs.statement: Search is real-time and searches across: Case ID, Case Title, Description, Patient Name, Provider Name, Email, Phone; Search Bar: Min 3 chars to trigger search, real-time search
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 business rules and search bar (prd.md lines 402, 364). REQ-034-056 names a different field list (notes instead of case ID, email and phone); see migration report.

nodes.title: Row actions by status

attrs.statement: View: Opens case detail view (Screen 3); Reassign: Opens reassignment modal (Screen 5) - only for Open/In Progress cases; Resolve: Opens resolution modal (Screen 4) - only for In Progress cases; Reopen: Reopens case (changes status from Closed to Open) - only for Closed cases; Close: Closes case - only for Resolved cases; Actions column: View, Reassign, Resolve, Reopen, Close; Buttons shown/hidden based on case status; Not sortable
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 quick actions and Actions column.

nodes.title: Bulk assign and bulk close

attrs.statement: Bulk Assign: Assign selected cases to one admin user through the Screen 5 modal, opened once for all selected cases, with one new assignee and one required reason (Enabled only if cases selected); only Open and In Progress cases are included, the others are skipped and the count skipped is shown; there is no Escalate option in bulk; each case gets the normal assignment notice and timeline entry; Bulk Close: Close selected cases (only if all are Resolved status) (Enabled only if cases selected and all Resolved)
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 data fields and Screen 5 business rules. Bulk assign uses the same modal and the same required reason as single reassignment, so the assignment history stays complete.

nodes.title: Listing paging and sorting

attrs.statement: Case List Table: Displays cases matching filters with 13 columns (see below); 50 cases per page default; Sortable columns, paginated; default sort by Last Updated descending; Pagination: 50 cases per page default; Shows: Previous, 1, 2, 3, ..., Next
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 data fields (prd.md lines 367, 383).

nodes.title: Listing count and empty state

attrs.statement: Display empty state message if no cases match filters: "No cases found. Try adjusting your filters or create a new case."; Show total case count matching current filters at top of table: "Showing X cases"; Display "Quick Stats" bar above table: Open (X) | In Progress (X) | Urgent (X) | Unassigned (X)
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 notes (prd.md lines 409, 410, 412). The quick stats are also required by REQ-034-054.

nodes.title: Status and priority colours

attrs.statement: Status badges color-coded (Open=blue, In Progress=yellow, Resolved=green, Closed=gray); Priority badges color-coded (Low=gray, Medium=blue, High=orange, Urgent=red)
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 business rules (prd.md lines 398, 399). Screen 7 lets Super Admin set the priority colour (prd.md line 685).

nodes.title: Patient and provider identifier requirements

attrs.statement: Patient Identifier: HPID, email, or phone to link case to patient record (Must match existing patient if provided; optional field; Required if Submitter Type = Patient, unless No Patient Link is chosen); Provider Identifier: Provider ID or clinic name (if case is provider-related) (Must match existing provider if provided; optional field; Required if Submitter Type = Provider); If patient identifier provided, system displays patient name and HPID for confirmation; If provider identifier provided, system displays provider clinic name and ID for confirmation; Linking case to patient/provider record enables "View Patient Record" or "View Provider Record" button for deep-linking to A-01 or A-02
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 data fields and business rules (prd.md lines 429, 430, 443 to 446). Alternative flow B1 (create without a patient link) is the stated exception to the required-if rule.

nodes.title: Source and submitter read-only on auto-created cases

attrs.statement: Ticket Source automatically set based on submission origin: Patient App (FR-035), Provider Portal (FR-032), or Manual Admin Entry; readonly for auto-created tickets, editable for manual entries; Submitter Type automatically set based on submission origin (Patient, Provider, or Admin); readonly for auto-created tickets, editable for manual entries
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 business rules (prd.md lines 447, 448). REQ-034-024 and REQ-034-025 state the automatic values for app submissions.

nodes.title: Feedback resolution only for feedback categories

attrs.statement: Feedback Resolution field only visible and applicable when Category = Feature Request, Bug Report, or Feedback; Feedback Resolution optional but recommended for feedback-type tickets; tracks outcome independently of case status; Feedback Resolution field only visible when case Category = Feature Request, Bug Report, or Feedback; Feedback Resolution tracks outcome independently of case status (e.g., case can be Resolved with Feedback Resolution = Planned)
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 and Screen 4 business rules (prd.md lines 455, 456, 581, 582). Business Rule 6 and REQ-034-006 state the same category limit; kept as a near-duplicate pair.

nodes.title: Assignee optional on creation

attrs.statement: Assigned To field optional on creation; can be assigned later (assignment is informational only - all admins can work on all cases); Assigned To: List of active admin users with the Respond to Support permission
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 data fields and business rules. The permission name comes from FR-031 (REQ-031-111).

nodes.title: Description editor and counters

attrs.statement: Display character count for Title and Description fields; Description: Min 20 chars, max 5000 chars, supports plain text
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 notes and data fields. Description stays plain text.

nodes.title: Field changes logged

attrs.statement: System logs all field changes with timestamp and admin user for audit trail
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 business rules (prd.md line 458). REQ-034-043 states the access and modification log.

nodes.title: Create and edit form input limits

attrs.statement: Case Title: Max 200 chars, min 10 chars, NO auto-generation; Internal Notes: Max 2000 chars per note entry; Tags: Max 5 tags per case; Attachments: Max 5 files, 10MB per file, formats: JPG, PNG, PDF, DOC, DOCX
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 data fields (prd.md lines 424, 432, 437, 433). The title minimum (10) is not stated in the Functional Requirements Summary.

nodes.title: Thread and timeline ordering

attrs.statement: Communication Thread displays messages in chronological order (oldest first) to show conversation flow; Timeline displays events in reverse chronological order (newest first) to show latest updates
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 business rules (prd.md lines 532, 533). REQ-034-015 states the thread order.

nodes.title: Messages appear in thread and timeline

attrs.statement: When patient/provider replies, message appears in Communication Thread and timeline logged as "Message Received from [Patient/Provider]"; Admin messages sent via "Reply to Patient/Provider" button appear in Communication Thread and trigger email notification via S-03; Messages to patient/provider logged in both Communication Thread and Timeline
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 business rules (prd.md lines 536, 537, 539). Business Rule 17 states the reply notification.

nodes.title: Timeline event context

attrs.statement: Case Created: Shows who created it, initial description, category, priority, and linked patient/provider; Status Changed: Shows old status → new status, who changed it, and reason/context if provided; Feedback Resolution Updated: Shows old resolution → new resolution, who updated it, and notes; Case Assigned: Shows previous assignee → new assignee, who performed assignment, and reason; Case Reassigned: Shows reassignment details with full reason and context; Internal Note Added: Shows full note content (admin-only), who added it, marked with "Admin Only" badge; Message Sent: Shows full message content, sender (admin/patient/provider), recipient type; Message Received: Shows full message content from patient/provider in response to admin; Attachment Uploaded: Shows attachment name, size, who uploaded it, download link; Account Intervention: Shows what intervention was performed (password reset, account unlock, etc.), who performed it, link to patient/provider record; Case Resolved: Shows resolution summary, resolution category, feedback resolution (if applicable), who resolved it; Case Reopened: Shows who reopened it (an admin, or System for an automatic reopen), reason for reopening, previous resolution summary; Case Closed: Shows who closed it, auto-close vs manual close indicator; Case Escalated: Shows the reassignment marked as an escalation, the reason, and the raised priority; Notification Sent / Notification Failed: Shows the notification, its recipient, and its delivery result; Admin Deactivated: Shows that the assigned admin account was deactivated and the case became unassigned
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 timeline event types (prd.md lines 514 to 529).

nodes.title: Detail view action visibility

attrs.statement: Linked Patient/Provider names clickable to deep-link to patient/provider management modules (only if case is linked); Deep-link buttons only visible when case is linked to patient or provider record; "Reopen Case" button only visible when case status is "Closed"; "Resolve Case" button only visible when case status is "In Progress"; Close Case Button: Confirmation required
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 business rules and data fields (prd.md lines 542 to 545, 500).

nodes.title: Unread message count badge

attrs.statement: Show unread message count badge (required) if patient/provider has sent new messages since last admin view
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 notes. The read flag is stored for each message; an admin-facing display of whether the patient/provider has viewed a message is a future enhancement.

nodes.title: Resolution details logged

attrs.statement: Resolution Category and Root Cause are captured on the case resolution record; this module has no analytics view that reads them; System logs resolution timestamp, feedback resolution (if applicable), and admin user who marked case resolved
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 business rules (prd.md lines 587, 588). REQ-034-039 lists the resolution details.

nodes.title: Resolution email content

attrs.statement: Resolution Summary included in email sent to patient/provider (if Send Resolution Email checked); Feedback Resolution included in resolution email to submitter if populated
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 business rules (prd.md lines 581, 584). REQ-034-060 states the send option.

nodes.title: Internal resolution notes admin-only

attrs.statement: Internal Resolution Notes only visible to admin staff (not included in patient/provider-facing communications); Internal Resolution Notes: Max 2000 chars
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 business rules and data fields (prd.md lines 585, 575).

nodes.title: Reply during auto-close period reopens the case

attrs.statement: System automatically closes a Resolved case after the specified auto-close period if the patient/provider doesn't respond; If the patient/provider replies while the case is Resolved (before the auto-close period expires), the case is reopened automatically and the system records a Reopening by System with the reason "User replied"; A reply to a Closed case does not reopen it automatically: it goes to an admin, who decides whether to reopen it; A provider replies through FR-032 Screen 5.8 (Case Detail) and the same rules apply
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 business rules. Admins reopen Closed cases (REQ-034-017); the automatic reopen applies only while the case is Resolved (REQ-034-165).

nodes.title: Auto-close period options

attrs.statement: Auto-Close After: Days to wait before auto-closing case (Options: Immediately, 3 days, 7 days, 14 days (default: 7 days))
