attrs.rationale: Screen 4 data fields (prd.md line 574). REQ-034-061 and Admin Editability list only 3, 7 or 14 days; Immediately appears only here. See migration report.

nodes.title: Slow-case warning and email preview

attrs.statement: Preview resolution email content before sending (including Feedback Resolution if applicable); Display warning if case was open for >14 days: "This case took longer than average to resolve. Consider documenting learnings."
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 notes (prd.md lines 595, 596).

nodes.title: Reassignment logged and notified

attrs.statement: System logs reassignment in case timeline with timestamp, old assignee, new assignee, reason, and admin who performed reassignment; If "Notify New Assignee" checked, system sends email notification via S-03 with case details and reassignment reason; System displays reassignment history in case timeline to track case ownership changes
attrs.rationale: Screen 5 business rules (prd.md lines 618, 619, 622). REQ-034-016 states the reason tracking.

nodes.title: Reassignment keeps status and access

attrs.statement: Reassignment does not change case status or restrict access for other admins; Admin can reassign case to themselves or to another team member
attrs.rationale: Screen 5 business rules (prd.md lines 620, 621).

nodes.title: Reassign modal inputs

attrs.statement: New Assignee: List of active admin users with the Respond to Support permission (active Super Admin users only when Escalate is ticked); cannot select current assignee; Reassignment Reason: Min 10 chars, max 500 chars; Display new assignee's current case load (number of Open/In Progress cases) to help with workload balancing
attrs.rationale: Screen 5 data fields and notes. An escalation goes to a Super Admin (REQ-034-103).

nodes.title: Reopen sets Open and logs the reason

attrs.statement: Case status changes from "Closed" (or "Resolved") to "Open" when reopened; System logs reopening in case timeline with timestamp, reopening reason, admin who reopened it, and reference to previous resolution; Previous resolution summary remains in case history for reference; Case timeline shows clear "Case Reopened" event with full context of why it was reopened
attrs.rationale: Screen 6 business rules (prd.md lines 651 to 656) and alternative flow B3 steps 4 to 6 (prd.md lines 334 to 336).

nodes.title: Reopen notifies the submitter

attrs.statement: If "Notify Patient/Provider" checked, system sends email notification via S-03 acknowledging case reopening
attrs.rationale: Screen 6 business rules (prd.md line 657).

nodes.title: Reopened case returns to default listing

attrs.statement: Reopened case appears in default case listing view (Open status); the patient app shows it as Open with the reply box again (FR-035 REQ-035-071)
attrs.rationale: Screen 6 business rules (prd.md line 658).

nodes.title: Reopen priority and assignee

attrs.statement: Admin can adjust priority when reopening to reflect urgency (e.g., escalate if issue was marked resolved incorrectly); Assign To: List of active admin users with the Respond to Support permission (REQ-034-094); optional, defaults to previous assignee if available; New Priority: Options: Low, Medium, High, Urgent; defaults to previous priority; Reopening Reason: Min 20 chars, max 1000 chars
attrs.rationale: Screen 6 data fields and business rules (prd.md lines 657, 643, 644, 642).

nodes.title: Configuration access

attrs.statement: Only Super Admin can access this screen (there is no Support Manager role and no "Manage Support Configuration" permission); Configuration screen accessible via Settings > Support Center path in admin navigation
attrs.rationale: Screen 7 business rules (prd.md lines 722, 723). FR-031 owns the role definitions.

nodes.title: Configuration changes apply immediately

attrs.statement: All changes to centralized lists take effect immediately for new case creation and case updates
attrs.rationale: Screen 7 business rules (prd.md line 724).

nodes.title: Deleting and deactivating list items

attrs.statement: Cannot delete categories, priorities, or resolution categories that are currently used by active cases (status = Open or In Progress); resolution categories, root causes, and reopen reason templates also cannot be deleted while in use, and Deactivate is offered instead; Can deactivate items instead of deleting; deactivated items hidden from dropdowns but preserved for historical data; Tag List Table: Sortable by tag name; can delete tags even if used (removes from cases)
attrs.rationale: Screen 7 business rules, tag table and reopen template table (prd.md lines 705, 714, 725, 728).

nodes.title: Used count

attrs.statement: Used Count shows number of cases currently using each option (helps prevent accidental deletion of important items)
attrs.rationale: Screen 7 business rules (prd.md line 729). Calculates used_count on the managed list entities.

nodes.title: Display order of list items

attrs.statement: Display Order determines the sequence items appear in dropdown lists throughout Support Center; Category Display Order: Sort order for dropdown display (1-100); Priority Display Order: Sort order for dropdown display (1-10)
attrs.rationale: Screen 7 business rules and modal fields (prd.md lines 724, 679, 686).

nodes.title: List item names unique with length limits

attrs.statement: System validates uniqueness of names within each category to prevent duplicates; Category Name: Max 50 chars; must be unique; Priority Name: Max 20 chars; must be unique; Resolution Category Name: Max 50 chars; must be unique; Root Cause Name: Max 50 chars; must be unique; Tag Name: Max 30 chars; must be unique; Template Text: Max 200 chars; Examples: "Issue persists", "New information received", "Resolution did not work", "Patient reported problem still occurring"
attrs.rationale: Screen 7 business rules and modal fields (prd.md lines 678 to 712).

nodes.title: Auto-escalation thresholds

attrs.statement: Auto-escalation thresholds configurable within defined ranges to prevent overly aggressive or too lenient escalation; Urgent Case Unassigned Threshold: Hours before an Open or In Progress urgent case that is still unassigned auto-escalates once to Super Admin (REQ-034-173), counted from when the case is Urgent and unassigned and stopped on assignment, after the FR-030 notice `support.urgent_case_unassigned` (REQ-030-258) to the Support Staff pool at a fixed 1 hour (Min: 1, Max: 48, Default: 24 hours); High Priority Case Threshold: Hours before an Open or In Progress high priority case auto-escalates once to Super Admin (REQ-034-173) if no status change, counted from when the case is High and restarted on any status change; a stall alarm, separate from the resolution targets of Rule 12 (Min: 12, Max: 72, Default: 48 hours); Case Inactivity Threshold: Days before an Open or In Progress case with no activity is flagged for admin review, also the one clock behind the inactivity warnings in the case list and case detail view (Min: 7, Max: 90, Default: 14 days)
attrs.rationale: Screen 7, Section 6. Notification Rule 3 states the 1-hour alert and the escalation to Super Admin; Alternative Flow A7 is the escalation itself.

nodes.title: Configuration changes audited

attrs.statement: All configuration changes logged in audit trail with timestamp, admin user ID, and change description
attrs.rationale: Screen 7 business rules (prd.md line 733).

nodes.title: Reopen reason templates optional

attrs.statement: Reopen Reason Templates are optional; admins can always enter custom reasons even if templates exist; Reopen Reason Templates Table: Optional feature; admins can also enter custom reasons
attrs.rationale: Screen 7 business rules and templates table (prd.md lines 729, 710). The templates are also called a future enhancement on Screen 6 (prd.md line 662); see migration report.

nodes.title: Deletion warning shows usage

attrs.statement: Show warning when attempting to delete item with active usage: "X cases currently use this [category/priority]. Please deactivate instead."
attrs.rationale: Screen 7 notes (prd.md line 741).

nodes.title: Configuration item history and bulk actions

attrs.statement: Show last modified timestamp and admin user for each configuration item; Provide bulk actions for activating/deactivating multiple items at once
attrs.rationale: Screen 7 notes (prd.md lines 738, 739).

nodes.title: Case list truncates long case titles

attrs.statement: The Case Title column is truncated with ellipsis if over 50 characters; the full title is shown on hover.
attrs.rationale: Screen 1, Table Column 3 (PRD line 370; the line moved up from 371).

nodes.title: Send Resolution Email defaults to checked

attrs.statement: The Send Resolution Email checkbox is checked by default.
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 (PRD line 573).

nodes.title: Notify New Assignee defaults to checked

attrs.statement: The Notify New Assignee checkbox is checked by default.
attrs.rationale: Screen 5 (PRD line 614).

nodes.title: Notify Patient/Provider on reopening defaults to checked

attrs.statement: The Notify Patient/Provider checkbox is checked by default.
attrs.rationale: Screen 6 (PRD line 649).

nodes.title: Report a problem (device details attached, submissions throttled)

attrs.statement: Report a problem: FR-034 owns the Report a problem rule for the patient app (FR-035 and FR-001 point to it). A problem report MUST create a support case under the Technical Issue preset with the device, operating system, app version, and report timestamp attached (shown read-only on Screen 3), and problem report submissions MUST be throttled to 10 new cases per hour per patient (REQ-035-063)
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary; restated in Business Rule 18. FR-035 and FR-001 point to it.

nodes.title: Automatic reopen recorded by System with reason User replied

attrs.statement: System MUST record an automatic reopen (a patient or provider reply to a Resolved case) as a Reopening record reopened by System with the reason "User replied"
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary; Screen 4 business rules and Entity 7.

nodes.title: Link a support case to a provider-caused cancellation (no automatic ticket)

attrs.statement: System MUST allow an admin to link a support case to a provider-caused cancellation (FR-015 A5 impact shown in FR-016 Provider-Caused Impacts); the system MUST NOT create a support case automatically when a provider-caused cancellation happens
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements Summary; restated in General Module Rules, Rule 19. FR-016 points to it.

nodes.title: Booking cancellation or change case carries a request type

attrs.statement: A support case raised for a booking cancellation or booking change MUST carry a request type: booking cancellation or booking change (shown in FR-016 as Cancellation or Appointment Change)
attrs.rationale: Data Requirements; General Module Rules, Rule 20.

nodes.title: Request status is kept beside case status

attrs.statement: Such a case MUST carry a request status of Open, Resolved, or Declined. The request status describes what happened to the patient's request; the case status (Open, In Progress, Resolved, Closed) describes the support work on the case. Both are kept and shown, and neither replaces the other
attrs.rationale: Data Requirements; General Module Rules, Rule 20.

nodes.title: Declined request requires a decline reason of at least 20 characters

attrs.statement: When an admin declines a request, the system MUST require a decline reason of at least 20 characters
attrs.rationale: Data Requirements; General Module Rules, Rule 20.

nodes.title: Resolved or declined request records the outcome

attrs.statement: For a Resolved or Declined request, the system MUST record the outcome: the action taken, the admin who took it, the time, and a link to the audit entry
attrs.rationale: Data Requirements; General Module Rules, Rule 20.

nodes.title: Built-in case categories are fixed (label and display order editable)

attrs.statement: The ten built-in case categories (Technical Issue, Account Access, Payment Question, Booking Issue, General Inquiry, Provider Support, Patient Support, Feature Request, Bug Report, Feedback) are fixed: Super Admin cannot add, delete or switch off a category, and only the category label and display order can be edited
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 680 to 684, 727 (Screen 7 Case Categories section and business rules).

nodes.title: Built-in priorities are locked; added priorities carry no rule

attrs.statement: The four built-in priorities (Low, Medium, High, Urgent) cannot be renamed, switched off or deleted; Super Admin may add other priorities, which carry no escalation or resolution-time rule unless one is defined
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 686 to 688, 726 (Screen 7 Case Priorities section and business rules).

nodes.title: An overdue Urgent or High case is escalated by the system to all Super Admins

attrs.statement: When the Urgent Case Unassigned Threshold or the High Priority Case Threshold runs out, the system marks the case as escalated in its timeline and sends the escalation notice to all Super Admins; it does not reassign the case or change its priority. Both clocks are stall alarms that run only while the case is Open or In Progress. The Urgent clock starts when a case is Urgent and unassigned (at creation, or when it becomes Urgent later) and stops when the case is assigned; the High clock starts when a case is High and restarts on any status change. Each clock escalates once per start, with no repeat. The FR-030 notice `support.urgent_case_unassigned` (REQ-030-258) for an unassigned Urgent case goes to the Support Staff pool after a fixed 1 hour, counted from the same start of the Urgent clock
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow A7 and Screen 7, Section 6. It is the same Support Case Escalated event as a manual escalation (REQ-034-103), raised by a clock instead of an admin.

nodes.title: A case with an Open booking request cannot be Resolved until the request is completed or declined

attrs.statement: A case whose request status is Open cannot be set to Resolved until the request is completed or declined; declining and recording the outcome stay in FR-016 (Screen 9, REQ-016-196, REQ-016-197)
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 business rules and Business Rule 20. The request status and the case status are separate (REQ-034-168); this rule keeps them from contradicting each other.

nodes.title: First response target: 24 hours on business days

attrs.statement: First-response target: 24 hours on business days (Monday to Friday, UTC, matching the support staff hours); it is a target only and the system takes no action when it passes
attrs.rationale: Business Rule 21. The submission confirmations (REQ-034-098) and FR-035 REQ-035-054 quote the same 24 hours on business days.

nodes.title: Provider case submission limit

attrs.statement: Provider submissions are limited to 10 new cases per hour per provider user, the same figure as the patient limit (REQ-035-063)
attrs.rationale: Data and Privacy Rules, Threat mitigation. Owner ruling: the provider figure follows the patient figure.

nodes.title: No email route to reopen when the support email setting is empty

attrs.statement: When the support email setting is empty there is no email route for asking to reopen a Closed case, and the patient creates a new ticket instead
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow B3. FR-035 shows the Email support link in the Closed Case Banner only when the setting has a value.

nodes.title: A provider can only ask for a Closed case to be reopened

attrs.statement: A provider cannot reopen a Closed case; the request is added to the case thread as a flagged message, the case stays Closed, the assigned admin (or the Support Staff pool if unassigned) is told through the user-reply notice, and an admin decides with Reopen Case (Screen 6), as for a patient
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow B3a. Owner ruling: the admin decides, as for patients (REQ-034-017). No new notification event is needed.

nodes.title: A case without a patient link carries a contact email

attrs.statement: When No Patient Link is ticked on Screen 2, a contact email is required and a contact name is optional; both are stored on the case, and every notice that would go to the patient goes to that address
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 and Alternative Flow B1. Owner ruling: a case without a patient link still gets its emails.

nodes.title: Account intervention from a case needs the account permission

attrs.statement: An account intervention started from a case needs the FR-031 permission that FR-016 requires for that action (Edit Patients for patient accounts, REQ-016-070 and REQ-016-220; Edit Providers for provider accounts); an admin without it escalates the case to a Super Admin (REQ-034-103)
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flows A2 and A6. The permission is settled by FR-016 and FR-031; FR-034 only states that the case route needs it.

nodes.title: An admin can reopen a Resolved case

attrs.statement: An admin can use Reopen Case on a Resolved case as well as on a Closed one: the reopening reason is required, the auto-close timer is cancelled, the case returns to Open, and no reopening request is involved; the reopened notice of REQ-034-146 applies as for a Closed case
attrs.rationale: Screens 1, 3 and 6; Alternative Flow B3. A mistaken Resolve is undone without Close then Reopen, which would write a Closed event for a case that was never closed. A patient or provider reply on a Resolved case still reopens it automatically (REQ-034-139).

nodes.title: Contact Support on a blocked booking screen creates a plain case with the booking reference

attrs.statement: Contact Support on the Payment Window Expired and Cancelled booking screens (FR-006) creates a plain support case that carries the booking reference and has no request type; only booking cancellation and booking change requests carry a request type (REQ-034-167)
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow A8. A restore or refund question is not a booking request: FR-016 has no action to complete one, so it would add a request status nobody can finish.

nodes.title: Patient Help Center content shown read-only

attrs.statement: System MUST display patient-specific Help Center content (FAQs, Articles, Resources, Videos) managed by admins in FR-033 as read-only resources (FR-033 REQ-033-003, REQ-033-008)
attrs.rationale: Restated by General Module Rule 1 (line 453), Screen 1 rules (246: content is managed exclusively by admins via FR-033 and scoped to the patient audience) and Screen 2 rules (336: patients have no ability to create, edit or delete content). The four content types are fixed (see REQ-035-042).

nodes.title: Patients see only patient-audience content

attrs.statement: System MUST enforce content isolation — patients see only patient-audience content, never provider content (FR-033 REQ-033-021)
attrs.rationale: Restated by General Module Rule 2 (line 454), Screen 2 rules (337) and the Executive Summary objective (21).

nodes.title: FAQs in collapsible topic sections

attrs.statement: System MUST display FAQ content in collapsible accordion sections organized by admin-defined topics (FR-033 REQ-033-006); each topic header shows the topic name and item count and expands or collapses on tap; an FAQ answer expands inline or opens an FAQ detail view, and supports formatted text and inline images
attrs.rationale: Restated by Screen 2 rules (341: not a flat list). Each topic header shows the topic name and item count and expands or collapses on tap (277); an answer expands inline or navigates to FAQ detail (278); answers support formatted text and inline images (280).

nodes.title: Articles filtered by subtype

attrs.statement: System MUST display article content with subtype filtering (Tutorial Guides, Troubleshooting Tips); the filter chips are All (the default), Tutorial Guides and Troubleshooting Tips
attrs.rationale: Article Subtype Filter chips All (default), Tutorial Guides, Troubleshooting Tips narrow the Articles list; subtypes are secondary filters inside the Articles list view (265, 287).

nodes.title: In-app video playback with controls

attrs.statement: System MUST support in-app video playback for video tutorials with play/pause, seek, and fullscreen controls; the transcript link, when present, opens the transcript in a scrollable text view
attrs.rationale: Video Detail has an embedded player with play/pause, seek and fullscreen that streams the video, a title, a rich-text description and an optional transcript link that opens a scrollable text view (321-324). The video list shows thumbnail, title and duration (316-320). Technology assumption: the app supports in-app video playback (592).

nodes.title: In-app resource preview and download

attrs.statement: System MUST support in-app file preview and download for resource documents; the preview shows at least the first page, and Download shows a progress indicator and saves the file to the device downloads folder
attrs.rationale: Resource Detail previews at least the first page in-app; the Download button shows a progress indicator and saves the file to the device downloads folder (308-309). The resource list shows title, file type icon and size (302-306). Technology assumption: the app supports in-app PDF and document preview (593).

nodes.title: Was this helpful? binary feedback, aggregated anonymously

attrs.statement: System MUST provide "Was this helpful?" binary feedback on all content types, with feedback aggregated anonymously at the content level (FR-033 Privacy Rule 2); tapping Yes or No shows the confirmation "Thank you for your feedback"; each tap is one vote written to the item's helpfulness count through the FR-033 content interface, so a repeat tap adds another vote (FR-033 REQ-033-096)
attrs.rationale: Restated by Privacy Rule 1 (line 461), Screen 2 rules (339) and Main Flow steps 9-10 (122). Tapping Yes or No shows the confirmation Thank you for your feedback (294); admin dashboards show total Yes and No counts per content item; FAQ, resource and video feedback behave the same (281, 310, 325). Near-duplicate of REQ-035-027, kept as both are PRD lines.

nodes.title: Related content suggestions across content types

attrs.statement: System MUST display up to 4 related content suggestions when FR-033 configures them (no minimum; none when none are configured); suggestions may cross content types
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 Article Detail: 2-4 related items suggested by the system, admin-configured via FR-033, tappable (296); relationship may cross content types, for example an article linking to a video tutorial (342).

nodes.title: Contact Support form fields and limits

attrs.statement: System MUST allow patients to submit support requests via Contact Support form with title (10-200 chars, entered by the patient and never auto-generated), category, description (20-5000 chars), priority, and optional file attachments (FR-034 REQ-034-020, REQ-034-030, REQ-034-031, REQ-034-035)
attrs.rationale: Screen 5 fields (430-434): title has no auto-generation; priority and category are pickers; attachments are optional. Form validation limits are fixed in the codebase (483). Creating a ticket follows FR-034 Workflow A5 (249, 372).

nodes.title: Cases auto-created with Patient App source and Patient submitter

attrs.statement: System MUST automatically create support cases in FR-034 with Ticket Source = "Patient App" and Submitter Type = "Patient" on form submission (FR-034 REQ-034-021, REQ-034-024)
attrs.rationale: Restated by General Module Rule 3 (line 455), Screen 1 rules (249), Screen 3 rules (372), A3 step 5 (161) and the Submit Button (435).

nodes.title: Cases linked to the patient by session

attrs.statement: System MUST link patient-submitted cases to patient records using logged-in patient session (FR-034 REQ-034-024)
attrs.rationale: A3 step 6 (162) and the Submit Button (435: links to the patient record via session). Patient session provides the patient ID (Dependencies FR-001, 543-545).

nodes.title: Eight patient-visible support categories

attrs.statement: System MUST display 8 patient-visible categories under their current labels: Technical Issue, Account Access, Payment Question, Booking Issue, General Inquiry, Feature Request, Bug Report, Feedback (FR-034 REQ-034-030; labels edited in FR-034 REQ-034-087; "Provider Support" and "Patient Support" excluded as admin-internal whatever their label)
attrs.rationale: Provider Support and Patient Support are admin-internal categories and are not shown to patients (372, 431). Business assumption: eight categories are sufficient for launch (600). Category visibility and fixed-list wording are in dispute, see REQ-035-076.

nodes.title: Attachment size, count and formats

attrs.statement: System MUST support file attachments up to 10 MB per file, maximum 5 files per message (the initial request and each reply may each carry up to 5 files), formats: JPG, PNG, PDF, DOC, DOCX (FR-034 REQ-034-036/037)
attrs.rationale: Fixed in the codebase (482). Screen 5 Attachments (434: thumbnail preview with remove option) and Screen 4 Attachment Button (403) carry the same limits. The limit counts per message, replies included.

nodes.title: Patient uploads virus-scanned before acceptance

attrs.statement: System MUST virus-scan all patient-uploaded files before acceptance; when the scanner is unavailable the file is refused with a "try again later" message and the case or reply can be sent without it; a file attached to a reply follows the same scan rules as a file attached to a new case
attrs.rationale: Restated by Privacy Rule 4 (line 464), Screen 5 Attachments (434) and the Virus Scanning dependency (558-561). Mechanics: REQ-035-058 to REQ-035-060.

nodes.title: My Support Tickets list content

attrs.statement: System MUST display patient's submitted support tickets with case ID, title, status (Open/In Progress/Resolved/Closed), priority, submitted date, and last updated timestamp
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 Ticket Card (359-365): case ID in subdued style, bold title truncated to 1-2 lines, colour-coded status badge (Open blue, In Progress amber, Resolved green, Closed grey), colour-coded priority badge (Low grey, Medium blue, High orange, Urgent red), short submitted date, relative last-updated time. Main A4 step 2 (175).

nodes.title: Original request and full communication thread with sender labels

attrs.statement: System MUST display the patient's original request (description and initial attachments) and the full communication thread for each ticket showing all messages from patient and admin with sender labels and timestamps
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 Communication Thread (397-400): chronological, scrollable, newest message at the bottom, sender label You for patient messages and Support Team for admin replies, plain-text body, relative or absolute timestamp; attachments are viewable full-size or downloadable (401). Empty thread shows Your case has been submitted. Our team will respond within 24 hours. (406).

nodes.title: Reply allowed unless the case is Closed

attrs.statement: System MUST allow patients to reply to admin messages when case is Open, In Progress, or Resolved (FR-034 REQ-034-026); reply input hidden only for Closed cases
attrs.rationale: Restated by Screen 4 Reply Input Field (402), Screen 4 rules (410) and Send Reply Button (404: hidden for Closed cases). Critical for healthcare: patients must be able to report that a resolved issue has recurred (410).

nodes.title: Reply to a Resolved case reopens it

attrs.statement: System MUST automatically reopen Resolved cases to Open status when patient sends a reply, and send the admin a support.case_reopened notice (FR-034 REQ-034-092)
attrs.rationale: Restated by Screen 4 Reply Input Field (402), rules (411) and A5 steps 4-6 (192-194): the patient sees the status badge update immediately and the admin receives support.case_user_reply.

nodes.title: Auto-closure countdown on Resolved tickets

attrs.statement: System MUST display auto-closure countdown on Resolved tickets showing remaining days before automatic closure (FR-034 REQ-034-061); "closes today" on the last day; none when the closure period is Immediately
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 Auto-Closure Countdown (394): text This case will close in X days if no further reply, shown only when status is Resolved, hidden for Open, In Progress and Closed; period is configurable 3, 7 or 14 days, default 7 (FR-034 REQ-034-061). A5 step 2 (190). Governed by SET-support-case-auto-closure-period.

nodes.title: Resolution summary shown

attrs.statement: System MUST display resolution summary when the case is Resolved or Closed and admin has provided one (FR-034 REQ-034-059, REQ-034-060)
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 Resolution Summary (395): read-only, shown only when status is Resolved or Closed and the admin entered a summary, displayed prominently above the thread under a Resolution header; also emailed on the change to Resolved (see REQ-035-070).

nodes.title: Feedback Resolution shown for feedback cases

attrs.statement: System MUST display Feedback Resolution status (Implemented, Planned, Declined, Under Review) for feedback/feature request/bug report cases when set by admin (FR-034 REQ-034-006)
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 Feedback Resolution (396) and rules (415): shown only for feedback, feature request or bug report categories and only when the admin has set a value; values Implemented, Planned, Declined, Under Review.

nodes.title: Internal admin notes hidden from patients

attrs.statement: System MUST hide internal admin notes from patient view — only messages explicitly sent to the patient are visible (FR-034 REQ-034-013, REQ-034-046)
attrs.rationale: Restated by Privacy Rule 2 (line 462) and Screen 4 rules (414).

nodes.title: Patient authentication required; not-logged-in view shows only support contact details

attrs.statement: System MUST require patient authentication to access Help Center content, submit support requests, and view tickets; a person who is not logged in sees only the support contact details (phone and email), with no case and no help content
attrs.rationale: Security Considerations Authentication (639) and Dependencies FR-001 (544).

nodes.title: Patients see only their own cases

attrs.statement: System MUST ensure patients can only view their own support cases — no access to other patients' cases
attrs.rationale: Security Considerations Authorization (640). See also REQ-035-072 for the wider access statement (Privacy Rule 3, 463).

nodes.title: Helpfulness feedback stores no patient identity

attrs.statement: System MUST aggregate "Was this helpful?" feedback without storing individual patient identity (FR-033 Privacy Rule 2)
attrs.rationale: Privacy Rule 1 (line 461) and Screen 2 rules (339: feedback responses do not store individual patient identity). Near-duplicate of REQ-035-007, kept as both are PRD lines.

nodes.title: Content from FR-033 API within 1 minute

attrs.statement: System MUST consume patient-specific Help Center content from FR-033 REST API; an admin publishing, editing, reordering, unpublishing or deleting content reaches the patient view within 1 minute (FR-033 REQ-033-034)
attrs.rationale: Restated by General Module Rule 4, Screen 2 rules, Dependencies FR-033 and Implementation Notes caching (cache invalidation respects the 1-minute propagation SLA).

nodes.title: Cases created through the FR-034 API

attrs.statement: System MUST create support cases via FR-034 Ticketing API on patient form submission
attrs.rationale: Dependencies FR-034 (536-537) and A3 step 5 (161).

nodes.title: Status updates, replies and resolutions received from FR-034

attrs.statement: System MUST receive and display case status updates, admin replies, and resolution summaries from FR-034
attrs.rationale: Communication Structure (79) and Dependencies FR-034 (537): the patient views case status, thread and replies within FR-035 screens; all case management stays in FR-034.

nodes.title: Patient notifications through FR-020

attrs.statement: System MUST trigger patient notifications via FR-020/S-03 for case status changes, admin replies (support.case_admin_reply), and case closure
attrs.rationale: Shared Services (66-70): email on status changes Open to In Progress, In Progress to Resolved and Resolved to Closed, on admin replies and on closure when the auto-closure period expires; push and email per Screen 4 rules (416); events support.case_status_changed, support.case_resolved, support.case_closed and support.case_user_reply routed through FR-020/S-03 (541). Patient reply notifies the admin (REQ-035-065).

nodes.title: Entry points to the patient Help Center

attrs.statement: Patient navigates to "Help & Support" from the Settings Main screen (FR-001 Screen 15, REQ-001-185); in-app deep link from other screens (e.g., contextual help links from booking, payment, or aftercare screens); push notification tap (e.g., tapping a case status change notification navigates to Ticket Detail); the Report a Problem row on the Hub opens Contact Support with the category preset to Technical Issue and the device, operating system, app version, and report time attached per FR-034 REQ-034-164; a person who is not logged in reaches only the support contact details (REQ-035-024).
attrs.rationale: Entry Points (lines 96-98). Also Multi-Tenant Breakdown (48) and Dependencies FR-001 (the Settings Main screen has a Help & Support row linking to Screen 1).

nodes.title: Provider and admin platforms have no patient Help Center screens

attrs.statement: Provider Platform: not applicable (providers access help via FR-032). Admin Platform: not applicable (admins manage content via FR-033, manage tickets via FR-034).
attrs.rationale: Multi-Tenant Architecture (40-41) and Multi-Tenant Breakdown (59, 63). Admin actions that reach the patient: publishing or unpublishing content (FR-033), responding to cases and updating status (FR-034) (64). Ownership boundary recorded as stated.

nodes.title: Timestamps in the user's local timezone

attrs.statement: All timestamps displayed in user's local timezone
attrs.rationale: General Module Rule 5 (line 457).

nodes.title: Help search covers published patient-audience content, ranked by relevance

attrs.statement: Search covers all published patient-audience Help Center content (FAQs, Articles, Resources, Videos); results are ranked by relevance and appear on the Help Center Browser (Screen 2), whichever search bar the patient types in; if no results match, show a "Contact Support" prompt. Full-text search is required for P1 and must not be downgraded to browse-only behavior.
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 rules (247), Screen 1 Search Bar (236), Screen 2 rules (338), Alternative Flow A1 (134-136). Search covers all four patient content types on Screen 1 and Screen 2.

nodes.title: Help search suggests results while typing

attrs.statement: Full-text search, relevance ordering, and inline suggestions are required for the patient Help Center MVP scope.
attrs.rationale: Implementation Notes Search (611), promoted. Screen 2 Search Bar (264): auto-suggests results while typing, scoped to the patient audience, required for P1. Results appear inline or on a separate results screen (236).

nodes.title: Contact Support offered when help does not answer

attrs.statement: Patient taps No on Was this helpful? (on any content type: FAQ, article, resource, or video) or sees no search results; System displays Still need help? Contact Support CTA, and the no-results message "No results for '[query]'. Try different keywords or Contact Support."; Patient taps Contact Support; System displays Contact Support form (Screen 5).
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow A2 (141-148), Screen 2 Article Detail Contact Support CTA (295: conditional on tapping No), General Content List No Results State (331: No results for '[query]'. Try different keywords or Contact Support.) and Screen 2 rules (338: empty search results must always surface a Contact Support path).

nodes.title: Emergency Contact Section always rendered on the Hub, each row when it has a value

attrs.statement: Emergency contact section is a healthcare UX best practice for post-procedure patient safety; the section is always rendered while at least one value is set - it cannot be hidden or require scrolling past it. The section must remain visible regardless of scroll position (sticky or always rendered); emergency phone is read-only with tap-to-call on mobile and emergency email is read-only with tap-to-compose on mobile. Each row is shown only when its App Setting has a value: a row with no value is left out, and the Contact Support row stays.
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 rules (248, marked [Design Addition: not in FR-033/FR-034]) and Screen 1 fields Emergency Contact Section, Emergency Phone, Emergency Email (240-242). Main Flow step 2 (114) lists the section on the Hub.

nodes.title: Emergency phone and email are two App Settings owned by FR-026

attrs.statement: Emergency phone and email values are two App Settings owned by FR-026 (support emergency contact phone and email); this screen displays them. FR-026 refuses a save that changes the phone or the email and leaves both blank, but both values are blank at launch until an admin sets one; while both are blank the whole section is hidden and the other Hub rows stay (REQ-026-143).
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 rules, Admin Editability and Business Process Assumption 3; FR-026 REQ-026-143 lets other Screen 8 rows save while both values are blank, as at launch.

nodes.title: My Support Tickets badge counts open and in-progress tickets

attrs.statement: "My Support Tickets" badge count reflects open + in-progress tickets only; hidden when count is 0
attrs.rationale: Screen 1 rules (250) and My Support Tickets row (239: badge shows count of open and in-progress tickets).

nodes.title: Four fixed content types, always shown; no Service Status for patients

attrs.statement: 4 content types for patient platform: FAQs, Articles, Resources, Videos (FR-033 REQ-033-003), all four cards always shown; admin cannot add new content types for patients; no Service Status for patients.
attrs.rationale: Fixed in Codebase (479), Configurable with Restrictions (488), Screen 2 Content Type Cards (265) and Out of Scope (88: Service Status page is a provider-only feature per FR-033).

nodes.title: Empty content type shown greyed out with an empty-state message

attrs.statement: Content type card is shown greyed out but still tappable, with label "No content available yet"; tapping shows empty state message "No [content type] available yet. Check back later or Contact Support." Item count badge is hidden if count is 0.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 Empty Content Type State and Item Count Badge (268-269), General Content List Empty Content State (332) and Edge Cases (736: first launch before admin populates content).

nodes.title: Featured / Popular Articles: five most viewed patient articles in the past 30 days

attrs.statement: Featured / Popular Articles [Design Addition]: automatic shortlist of the five patient articles with the most views in the past 30 days, up to 5 items; not defined in FR-033; generated automatically from view analytics (FR-033 REQ-033-018), not curated by admins.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 field Featured / Popular Articles (270), optional (Required: No). Generated from view analytics, not admin-curated.

nodes.title: Help Center unavailable: cached content or retry message

attrs.statement: When Help Center content is unavailable (API down), display cached content if available or show "Help Center temporarily unavailable" with a retry option
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 rules (343), Content Unavailable State (271: Help Center temporarily unavailable. Please try again later., retry button) and Alternative Flow B2 (212-219: patient may navigate to Contact Support as fallback). Implementation Notes Caching (609) and Integration 1 error handling (618); Technology Assumption 2 (591: cached content available offline where feasible); Media Storage failure handling (556).

nodes.title: Tickets ordered by latest activity

attrs.statement: Tickets are ordered by most recently updated (newest activity at top) within each filter tab
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 rules (370). Last Updated uses relative format such as 2h ago or Yesterday (365).

nodes.title: Ticket cards always open the full thread

attrs.statement: Ticket cards are always tappable regardless of status — patients can view the full thread even for Closed cases
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 rules (374) and Ticket Card (359).

nodes.title: Resolved ticket cards show an auto-closes indicator

attrs.statement: Resolved cases display a subtle "Auto-closes in X days" indicator to set expectations about the closure window (FR-034 REQ-034-061); on the last day it reads "Auto-closes today", and it is not shown when the closure period is Immediately because there is no Resolved window
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 rules (375).

nodes.title: Submit stays disabled until required fields are valid

attrs.statement: All fields except Attachments are mandatory; the Submit button remains disabled until Title (>= 10 chars), Category, Description (>= 20 chars), and Priority are all valid
attrs.rationale: Screen 5 rules (440) and Submit Button (435: disabled until all required fields pass validation). Conflicts with Alternative Flow B1 (REQ-035-050): see product owner decision list.

nodes.title: Server-found problems highlighted inline after Submit

attrs.statement: Patient taps Submit with every field valid; System checks the submission on the server and finds a failure; System highlights the affected fields with inline error messages; Patient corrects the reported errors and resubmits.
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow B1 (198-208). Submit is enabled only when every field is valid (REQ-035-049), so this flow covers a failure found by the server after submitting.

nodes.title: Priority picker default Medium with self-triage descriptions

attrs.statement: Priority Picker options: Low, Medium, High, Urgent; default: Medium. Brief inline descriptions help patients self-triage: Low = "General question", Medium = "Something isn't working right", High = "Blocking my care or booking", Urgent = "Critical issue needing immediate attention".
attrs.rationale: Screen 5 Priority Picker (433) and rules (444: patients in distress tend to over-select Urgent without guidance, which degrades response quality for truly urgent cases).

nodes.title: Category inline descriptions (design addition)

attrs.statement: Brief inline description per category to help patients select correctly: Feature Request = "Suggest a new feature or improvement", Bug Report = "Report something that is broken or not working as expected", Feedback = "Share general feedback about your experience".
attrs.rationale: Screen 5 Category Picker (431) and rules (445, marked [Design Addition]: all three appear in FR-034 REQ-034-030 without patient-facing guidance).

nodes.title: Category selection drives admin routing

attrs.statement: Category selection drives downstream admin routing — this is transparent to the patient but important for response time
attrs.rationale: Screen 5 rules (443).

nodes.title: Submission confirmation shows the case ID and the 24-hours-on-business-days message

attrs.statement: Upon successful submission, the system displays a confirmation screen showing the assigned Case ID (CASE-YYYY-#####) and the message "We will respond within 24 hours on business days" (REQ-034-175), then navigates to My Support Tickets (Screen 3); the confirmation always shows in the app, whether or not the confirmation email is sent
attrs.rationale: Screen 5 rules (441), Alternative Flow A3 steps 8-9 (164-165) and Screen 3 Create New Ticket Button (357: confirmation then return to the ticket list).

nodes.title: Confirmation email with the case reference number

attrs.statement: Patient receives a confirmation email with the case reference number upon submission unless an admin has switched the notice off in the Admin notification settings (FR-030, FR-034 REQ-034-090); the in-app confirmation always shows (FR-020, FR-034 A5 step 11)
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 rules (373), Alternative Flow A3 step 7 (163) and Screen 5 Submit Button (435). The PRD names no event for this email.

nodes.title: Case ID format CASE-YYYY-#####

attrs.statement: Case ID format: CASE-YYYY-##### (fixed in the codebase, not editable by admin)
attrs.rationale: Fixed in Codebase (481), Screen 3 Case ID (360), Screen 4 Case ID (389) and A3 step 5 (161).

nodes.title: Discard confirmation on leaving the form

attrs.statement: Back Navigation prompts "Discard draft?" confirmation if the form has unsaved input; Cancel / Discard prompts "Discard this request?" if any field has input; no data saved on cancel.
attrs.rationale: Screen 5 Back Navigation (429) and Cancel / Discard (436).

nodes.title: Attachments validated on the device and on the server

attrs.statement: File uploads are validated client-side (format + size) before upload and server-side (virus scan + format whitelist) before acceptance (FR-034 REQ-034-036/037)
attrs.rationale: Screen 5 rules (442).

nodes.title: Failed virus scan refuses the file with the FR-034 message

attrs.statement: A file that fails virus scanning is refused with the FR-034 message (REQ-034-106), and the patient can send the case or reply without it.
attrs.rationale: Edge Cases (735).

nodes.title: Media storage failure: uploads queued and patient told of delay

attrs.statement: Media Storage Service failure handling: for file uploads, the case is created without the files, the files are queued for retry, and the patient is told of the delay.
attrs.rationale: External Dependencies (553-556).

nodes.title: Support request submitted offline is queued

attrs.statement: A support request submitted while offline, or one that fails with a server error (5xx), is queued on the device and shows "queued, will be sent when online"; it is sent when connectivity returns or retried with exponential backoff, and the patient gets the Case ID after it is sent. Only one request waits in the queue at a time (a second submit is refused with a message to wait until the first is sent); one not sent within 24 hours is reported to the patient as not sent, and the typed text is kept so it can be sent again.
attrs.rationale: Edge Cases (734) and Integration 2 error handling (623: queue submission locally if offline; retry with exponential backoff on 5xx errors).

nodes.title: Rate limit on new ticket submissions

attrs.statement: Rate limiting on new ticket submissions (max 10 new tickets per hour per patient); the patient sees a message to wait before trying again; replies are not counted by this limit.
attrs.rationale: Security Considerations Threat mitigation (643), promoted.

nodes.title: Notification failures never block case operations

attrs.statement: Notification delivery failures do not block case operations; retry asynchronously.
attrs.rationale: Integration 3 error handling (628), promoted.

nodes.title: Patient reply joins the thread and notifies the assigned admin

attrs.statement: Patient replies are added to the shared communication thread; the assigned admin notification for each reply (recipients, content, and whether it can be switched off) is defined in FR-020 REQ-020-111 (support.case_user_reply event)
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 rules (413), A4 steps 6-7 (179-181) and Send Reply Button (404). The notification itself is owned by FR-020 REQ-020-111.

nodes.title: Send Reply enabled only with text; a reply that cannot be sent keeps the text

attrs.statement: Send Reply Button is enabled when reply input is non-empty; hidden for Closed cases. A reply that cannot be sent right now (device offline, server error, or media storage unavailable) is refused with a retry message and the typed text is kept.
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 Send Reply Button (404).

nodes.title: Resolved cases auto-close after the closure period

attrs.statement: Cases auto-close after 7 days in Resolved status if no patient reply (configurable: Immediately, 3, 7, or 14 days per FR-034 REQ-034-061/062); the patient receives a support.case_closed notification. With Immediately there is no Resolved window: the case goes straight to Closed, no countdown or Auto-closes indicator is shown, and the patient uses the Closed Case Banner (reopen request or new ticket).
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 rules (412), Admin Editability (473: configured via FR-034), User Story 4 scenario 2 (711) and Shared Services (70). The countdown is visible in Ticket Detail to set expectations. Governed by SET-support-case-auto-closure-period.

nodes.title: Closure while the patient is viewing: a late reply is refused and the text is kept

attrs.statement: The screen learns that a case closed on its next refresh or when the patient sends a reply. A reply sent after closure is refused with a message, the typed text stays visible for copying, and the Closed Case Banner replaces the reply input.
attrs.rationale: Edge Cases (738).

nodes.title: Closed Case Banner offers new ticket or reopen request

attrs.statement: Closed Case Banner: "This case is closed. If you still need help, you can create a new ticket or contact support to request this case be reopened." with "Create New Ticket" link to Screen 5 and "Email support" link that opens an email to the support address (the emergency email App Setting) with the case ID in the subject; the clause "or contact support to request this case be reopened" and the Email support link are shown only when that setting has a value (the sentence then ends after "create a new ticket"). Both paths: new ticket creation (in-app) and case reopening via admin (FR-034 Workflow B3, REQ-034-017).
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 Closed Case Banner (405) and User Story 4 scenario 3 (712). The reply input is hidden for Closed cases (REQ-035-018).

nodes.title: Resolution summary emailed when the case becomes Resolved

attrs.statement: The resolution summary is also emailed to the patient when the case becomes Resolved, if the admin left Send Resolution Email checked on the case (FR-034 REQ-034-060, REQ-034-161) and the notification settings allow it (FR-030); the summary always shows on Ticket Detail.
attrs.rationale: Screen 4 Resolution Summary (395).

nodes.title: Support case lifecycle is fixed

attrs.statement: Support case lifecycle workflow: Open -> In Progress -> Resolved -> Closed (fixed in the codebase, not editable by admin); it moves forward only, except that a patient reply reopens a Resolved case (REQ-035-019) and an Admin can reopen a Closed case (FR-034 REQ-034-017), after which the patient sees the case as Open with the reply box again and receives the FR-034 reopen notice (REQ-034-163).
attrs.rationale: Fixed in Codebase (480) and Screen 3 filter chips (358).

nodes.title: Support case data visible only to the patient and authorized admin staff

attrs.statement: Patient support case data is accessible only to the submitting patient and authorized admin staff
attrs.rationale: Data & Privacy Privacy Rule 3 (463). Complements REQ-035-025.

nodes.title: Support case lifecycle events audited in FR-034

attrs.statement: All support case lifecycle events (creation, status changes, messages, attachments) are logged with timestamp and user ID in FR-034 case timeline
attrs.rationale: Audit Rule (465) and Security Considerations Audit trail (642: timestamp, patient ID and action type, managed by FR-034).

nodes.title: Patient support data follows HIPAA and GDPR requirements

attrs.statement: Patient support data handling follows the same HIPAA/GDPR compliance requirements as all patient data in the platform
attrs.rationale: Security Considerations Compliance (644), promoted.

nodes.title: Account deletion with support cases: cases stay with the Admin and notices stop

attrs.statement: Open, In Progress, and Resolved cases of a deleted patient stay with the Admin, marked "Patient Account Deleted" (FR-034 REQ-034-109), and notices to the deleted patient stop; patient identity is anonymized per data retention policy (FR-023).
attrs.rationale: Edge Cases (737): a patient deleting their account while support cases are active. Applies at the patient Deleted stage.

nodes.title: Patient-visible support categories are a fixed list

attrs.statement: Patient-visible support categories (admin cannot add or remove categories from the fixed list; the labels are editable in FR-034 REQ-034-087, the picker shows the current label, and the two internal categories stay hidden whatever their label)
attrs.rationale: Configurable with Restrictions (487). Editable by Admin (475) says patient-facing category descriptions and category visibility are managed via FR-033, which sits uneasily with a fixed list and with FR-033 being the help content module: see product owner decision list. Business assumption 4 (600).

nodes.title: My Support Tickets empty state

attrs.statement: Empty State shown when the patient has no tickets (or none match the filter): "No support tickets yet. Need help? Tap 'Create New Ticket'."
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 Empty State field (PRD line 366).

nodes.title: Out of scope: Help Center content creation, editing, publishing

attrs.statement: Out of scope: Help Center content creation, editing, publishing (handled by FR-033: Help Centre Content Management)
attrs.rationale: Module Scope, Out of Scope list (85).

nodes.title: Out of scope: Support case management, assignment, escalation, resolution

attrs.statement: Out of scope: Support case management, assignment, escalation, resolution (handled by FR-034: Support Center & Ticketing)
attrs.rationale: Module Scope, Out of Scope list (86).

nodes.title: Out of scope: Real-time in-app chat between patient and admin

attrs.statement: Out of scope: Real-time in-app chat between patient and admin (future enhancement)
attrs.rationale: Module Scope, Out of Scope list (87).

nodes.title: Out of scope: Service Status page

attrs.statement: Out of scope: Service Status page (provider-only feature per FR-033)
attrs.rationale: Module Scope, Out of Scope list (88).

nodes.title: Out of scope: Aftercare-specific communications

attrs.statement: Out of scope: Aftercare-specific communications (handled by FR-011: Aftercare & Recovery Management)
attrs.rationale: Module Scope, Out of Scope list (89).

nodes.title: Out of scope: Provider-to-patient secure messaging

attrs.statement: Out of scope: Provider-to-patient secure messaging (handled by FR-012: Secure Messaging)
attrs.rationale: Module Scope, Out of Scope list (90).

nodes.title: Out of scope: Automated chatbot responses

attrs.statement: Out of scope: Automated chatbot responses (future enhancement)
attrs.rationale: Module Scope, Out of Scope list (91).

nodes.title: Out of scope: Community forum

attrs.statement: Out of scope: Community forum (future enhancement)
attrs.rationale: Module Scope, Out of Scope list (92).

nodes.title: Create New Ticket button always visible and returns to the list

attrs.statement: The Create New Ticket button on My Support Tickets is always visible and opens the Contact Support form (Screen 5); on successful submission the patient sees the confirmation and then returns to the ticket list (Screen 3).
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 357 (Screen 3 Create New Ticket Button: opens Contact Support Form, confirmation then returns to the ticket list, always visible).

nodes.title: Empty thread message on a new case

attrs.statement: When no messages exist yet on a case (the case was just created), Ticket Detail shows "Your case has been submitted. Our team will respond within 24 hours on business days."
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 406 (Screen 4 Empty Thread State).

nodes.title: Attached files show a thumbnail and can be removed

attrs.statement: On the Contact Support form, each attached file shows a thumbnail preview with a remove option, so the patient can take it off before submitting.
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 434 (Screen 5 Attachments: tap to add; shows thumbnail preview with remove option).

nodes.title: Text entered by the patient is sanitised

attrs.statement: Input sanitization applies to all text fields the patient fills in (search, support request title and description, ticket replies).
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 642 (Security Considerations, Threat mitigation: input sanitization for all text fields).

nodes.title: Contact Support form carries the booking reference from a blocked booking screen

attrs.statement: When Contact Support is opened from the Payment Window Expired or Cancelled booking screen (FR-006), the booking reference is passed to the form and saved with the case, which is a plain case with no request type (REQ-034-182); the patient does not type or edit it.
attrs.rationale: Screen 5 field Booking Reference. FR-034 REQ-034-182 owns the case side.

nodes.title: Article list excerpt and video description sources

attrs.statement: The article list excerpt is a 1-2 line preview taken from the first words of the article body, because FR-033 holds no separate excerpt for articles; the Video Detail description is the FR-033 Video Description (up to 500 characters, optional) and is left out when the video has none.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 fields Item Excerpt and Video Detail Description.

nodes.title: Content views recorded through the content interface

attrs.statement: Opening an FAQ answer, an article, a resource detail or a video is recorded as a view through the FR-033 content interface and counted each time it is opened; a resource download is counted too, and a video view follows the 30-second rule (FR-033 REQ-033-097, REQ-033-079).
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 business rules. FR-033 REQ-033-097 owns the counting rule.

nodes.title: One active hair-loss monitoring case per patient

attrs.statement: System MUST enforce one active hair-loss monitoring case per patient.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Business Rule 1 (one active case per monitoring type; the FR-038 non-blocking half is REQ-037-032), Screen 1 business rules (only one active case; a self-monitoring patient must complete the case before starting an advice-mode case) and the Business Workflows duplicate-creation gate. Also fixed in code per Admin Editability.

nodes.title: Mode chosen at activation and fixed for the case

attrs.statement: Patient MUST select self-monitoring or provider-advice mode before activation, and the mode MUST remain fixed for that case.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Business Rule 2, Screen 1 (Monitoring Mode immutable after activation; mode cannot change after activation), Communication Structure out of scope (no switching from self-monitoring to advice mode) and Admin Editability fixed in code.

nodes.title: Optional dated logs with severity, notes, photos and head scan

attrs.statement: System MUST provide optional dated logs with severity 1 to 10, notes, photos, and V1 head scan photo sets.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Screen 3 and the Executive Summary. Assumption: severity 1 means least severe and 10 most severe. The patient records optional entries on any date.

nodes.title: Logging allowed during pending assignment and reassignment

attrs.statement: System MUST allow logging during pending provider assignment and pending reassignment.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Business Rule 4, Screen 2 business rules, the Patient Platform scope and the Business Workflows (logging stays available in every assignment state).

nodes.title: Advice mode requires the active Inquiry medical questionnaire

attrs.statement: Advice mode MUST require the active FR-025 Inquiry medical questionnaire before provider access. It MUST reuse the same Admin-designated active Inquiry-context set, with no separate questionnaire context type and no separate Admin toggle for monitoring advice.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Screen 1 (Medical Questionnaire conditional, required for provider advice mode), the Patient Platform scope and the Business Workflows medical gate (missing or invalid answers shown; patient completes before activation).

nodes.title: Admin assigns advice providers; reassignment distinguished

attrs.statement: Admin MUST assign advice providers and clearly distinguish reassignment after withdrawal.
attrs.rationale: Restated by the Admin Platform scope (assigns an eligible provider, reassigns withdrawn cases, distinguishes first assignment from reassignment in queues and case history), Screens 8 and 12 (Assignment Type badge) and the assumption that Admin selects providers manually.

nodes.title: Provider withdrawal with reason ends access and returns case to Admin

attrs.statement: Provider MUST be able to withdraw with a reason, ending access and returning the case to Admin.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Screen 11 (mandatory reason 1 to 1000 characters, confirmation of immediate loss of access; withdrawal does not end the patient's case; case returns to Admin as Pending Reassignment labelled as a reassignment), Screen 8 (case leaves the queue immediately after confirmation) and the Business Workflows (Admin and patient notified).

nodes.title: Global advice cadence weekly or bi-weekly, captured per case at creation

attrs.statement: System MUST enforce a single global Admin-configurable weekly or bi-weekly advice cadence. Each case MUST capture the active cadence at creation and keep it for the case lifetime; a cadence change MUST apply only to cases created after the change. The default cadence MUST be weekly (7 days).
attrs.rationale: Restated by Business Rules 5 and 5a (minimum intervals of 7 or 14 days; one global value with no per-case, per-provider or per-patient override; the case keeps its creation-time cadence through reassignment; a patient with an active case gets the new cadence on the next case), Screen 13 Advice Cadence, Admin Editability (approved weekly and bi-weekly values only) and the Edge Cases (cadence change while a window is partly elapsed).

nodes.title: Complete case and export a date-to-date PDF summary

attrs.statement: Patient MUST be able to complete the case and export a date-to-date PDF summary, which for advice-mode cases MUST include the provider advice. Provider advice appears in the completion PDF only.
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 183, 332 (the workflow and the Screen 6 business rule both state that the completion PDF includes the provider advice for advice-mode cases, and that provider advice appears in the completion PDF only), Screens 5 and 6.

nodes.title: Convert an active case into a distinct FR-003 inquiry

attrs.statement: Patient MUST be able to convert an active case into a distinct FR-003 inquiry.
attrs.rationale: Restated by the Executive Summary, Business Rule 6 (a converted monitoring case remains distinct from the inquiry), Screen 5 and Screen 7.

nodes.title: Conversion starts with a read-only summary step

attrs.statement: Conversion MUST present a read-only summary step showing the monitoring recap, all carried-over data, the summary PDF, and remaining inquiry-only items before any editable inquiry form is opened, and leaving that step MUST NOT alter the monitoring case.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Screen 7 Step A business rules (Step A is read-only; no inquiry record exists yet; leaving Step A never completes, converts or alters the monitoring case).

nodes.title: No reminders, cadence, milestones or overdue state

attrs.statement: For hair-loss cases, System MUST NOT provide patient logging or scan reminders, cadence, milestones, or overdue/compliance state; reminders belong to transplant-progress cases only (FR-038, REQ-038-031), and the other mechanics belong to the aftercare package.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Business Rule 8, the Service Boundary table (cadence, scan reminders, overdue and compliance state, milestone entities are aftercare mechanics), the Communication Structure out of scope list (nudges, streaks, adherence notifications), Screen 2 (no daily frequency; missing dates neutral, never overdue) and the assumption that patients may log irregularly without penalty.

nodes.title: Advice window opens on start date, open until submitted or superseded

attrs.statement: Each advice window MUST open on its calculated start date and remain actionable without an ordinary deadline until its single advice is submitted or a successor window opens; a successor MUST expire only the older unsubmitted window and become the sole actionable window. The cadence is the spacing between window openings. The first window MUST open one cadence period (7 or 14 days) after the provider is first assigned; an open, unanswered window MUST expire when the assignment ends, for any cause; windows MUST then pause while the case has no assigned provider, and the first window for a replacement provider MUST open one cadence period after the new assignment. Window dates MUST be UTC dates. A future window is derived from its start date, so the stored window state has three values (available, submitted, expired).
attrs.rationale: Restated by Business Rule 5b, Screen 10B (each window opens on its calculated start date; both windows stay visible with distinct states), Screen 9 Advice Window Summary, the Provider Platform scope and the Edge Cases (unsubmitted window expires when the next opens).

nodes.title: Advice is a separate provider-authored calendar record

attrs.statement: Submitted provider advice MUST create a separate provider-authored case-calendar record and MUST NOT attach to or modify any patient log record.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Business Rule 5c, Screens 2, 10A, 10B, 13, 14A and 14B business rules and the Edge Cases (same-date log and advice show as two authored records). Admin sees both as separate record types.

nodes.title: Submitted advice editable with immutable versions and edited cue

attrs.statement: Provider MUST be able to edit submitted advice while the system preserves immutable versions and displays an edited cue plus latest-edit timestamp to patient, provider, and Admin users.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Business Rule 5c, Screen 10B (edit saves a new version; patient, Provider and Admin views show edited cue and latest-edit time), Screen 2 and the Business Workflows edit-advice step.

nodes.title: Provider and Admin lists: search, filters, sorting, pagination, Admin mode tabs

attrs.statement: Provider and Admin listing screens MUST support scoped search, filters, sorting, and pagination; the Admin list MUST cover hair-loss cases only and provide separate All Cases, Self-Monitoring, and Provider Intervention tabs with operational case, activity, and assignment summaries.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Screen 8 (search by anonymized patient ID or case ID; search, filters, sorting and pagination compose without exposing cases assigned to another provider) and Screen 12 (mode tabs; counts and selected tab stay synchronized with filters; status, provider, advice-state and date filters).

nodes.title: Case overviews with full dashboard and calendar; dedicated detail screens

attrs.statement: Provider and Admin case overviews MUST include the full patient-visible monitoring dashboard and calendar, while each patient daily log and provider-advice record MUST open in its dedicated role-specific detail screen with the authorized fields and actions defined in Screens 10A, 10B, 14A, and 14B.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Screens 9 and 13 (overview only; no inline expansion of a daily log or inline advice editing), Screens 10A, 10B, 14A and 14B, and Screen 13 (Admin sees every field and dated record in the patient view plus assignment, advice-window, audit, preview, export and conversion controls).

nodes.title: Admin read-only pre-assignment preview link, revocable, expiry chosen at share time up to 14 days

attrs.statement: Admin MUST be able to generate and revoke a read-only pre-assignment case-preview link for a candidate provider, MUST select its expiry at share time (any time from 1 to 14 days), and preview access MUST NOT create an assignment or ongoing case access. Open previews MUST be revoked on assignment, completion, and conversion.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Business Rule 5d, Screen 12 (expiry chosen each time Share is used; read-only; scoped to the minimum information for an acceptance decision; audited; revocable; does not grant assignment access), the Business Workflows and the Edge Cases (preview revoked or expired without assignment; candidate opens a valid preview but is never assigned).

nodes.title: No embedded chat for pre-assignment communication

attrs.statement: FR-037 MUST NOT add an embedded chat screen for pre-assignment communication; the preview link is shared through an existing external communication channel.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Business Rule 5d, the Communication Structure (in scope: link shared through an existing external channel; out of scope: FR-037 chat screen) and Screen 12 (Admin shares the link through an existing channel and records the eventual assignment decision on the screen).

nodes.title: Submission timestamp stored; latest entry on a date sets that date's severity

attrs.statement: Every entry MUST store a submission timestamp, and derived severity for a date MUST use the latest-timestamped entry on that date.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Business Rule 9 and Screen 3 (earlier entries stay visible and auditable; latest timestamp supplies the date's severity for the trend, latest-severity and summary calculations).

nodes.title: Conversion pre-fills compatible information; all copied fields editable

attrs.statement: Conversion MUST pre-fill compatible information and allow the patient to edit all copied fields; a Duration whose stored option is no longer active MUST be chosen again.
attrs.rationale: Restated by the Executive Summary (the patient must not repeat information already supplied merely because they are changing services) and Screen 7 Step B (every copied field remains editable before submission).

nodes.title: Conversion selects the latest valid scan by default

attrs.statement: Conversion MUST select the latest valid scan by default and allow another scan or retake. Photo items MUST be sent as `{ scanRef, photoIndex }` references, the stored scan MUST be copied and never moved or replaced, and a retake in Step B MUST belong to the inquiry only.
attrs.rationale: Restated by the Business Workflows scan-choice step, Screen 7 Step B (Selected Head Scan) and the Edge Cases (latest scan fails quality validation; patient selects an earlier valid scan).

nodes.title: Conversion attaches a generated summary PDF

attrs.statement: Conversion MUST attach a PDF containing logs, scan photos, logged-day count, and severity summary; if generation fails three times, conversion proceeds without it and the PDF MUST be attached once a retry succeeds (REQ-037-059).
attrs.rationale: Restated by the Business Workflows (monitoring-summary PDF generated, then pre-fill), Screen 7 Steps A and B and the Integration Points note.

nodes.title: Previous monitoring history links to its destination only through conversion

attrs.statement: Previous monitoring history MUST NOT be attached to a newly created monitoring case, for hair-loss monitoring (FR-037) or transplant-progress monitoring (FR-038). History MUST link to its destination only through conversion: the FR-003 inquiry for hair-loss monitoring and the FR-011 standalone aftercare request for transplant-progress monitoring.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Business Rule 3 and Screen 1 business rules (a new monitoring case starts with its own intake; previous monitoring-case history is not attached to it). Covers FR-037 and FR-038.

nodes.title: Patient, assigned provider and authorized Admin access only

attrs.statement: System MUST enforce patient, current assigned provider, and authorized Admin access boundaries.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Data and Privacy Rules (access limited to the patient, authorized Admin users and the currently assigned provider for advice-mode cases), the Provider Platform scope and Screen 4 (providers view scans only while assigned).

nodes.title: Medical-data access, advice, preview, export, assignment, withdrawal and conversion audited

attrs.statement: System MUST audit all medical-data access, advice submissions and edits, preview-link creation/access/expiry/revocation, exports, assignments, withdrawals, conversions, and advice-cadence changes.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Data and Privacy Rules (every view, export, edit, assignment, withdrawal and conversion of medical data is audited) and Screen 13 Audit History.

nodes.title: Admin edits keep version history and need a reason

attrs.statement: Admin edits MUST preserve version history and require a reason.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Admin Editability (edits require permission, a reason and version history; edits cannot delete audit evidence) and Screens 13, 14A and 14B (Edit Reason required before save; before and after values, actor, reason, time).

nodes.title: Providers see only an anonymized patient identifier for the whole case

attrs.statement: Provider-facing FR-037 screens MUST show an anonymized patient identifier for the entire case lifetime and MUST NOT expose patient full name or contact details.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Data and Privacy Rules, Screen 9 (FR-037 advice involves no payment, so no de-anonymization trigger exists here; any later de-anonymization happens only in the FR-003/FR-004 flow created by conversion; Admin retains full identity visibility) and the Implementation Notes.

nodes.title: Exclusive routing to the assigned provider; decline falls back to normal distribution

attrs.statement: If an assigned advice provider exists when the FR-003 inquiry submission succeeds, only that provider MUST initially be selected to quote. Exclusive routing ends only when that provider explicitly declines before quote creation (FR-003 MUST audit the reason) or when redistribution follows the provider's suspension or deactivation (REQ-003-072); either way FR-003 MUST remove exclusive routing and execute normal distribution exactly once. If no provider is assigned at that moment, or the assigned provider has withdrawn or is not eligible at that moment, conversion MUST continue and FR-003 normal distribution MUST apply immediately. Exclusive routing MUST bypass only FR-003 country and provider-selection matching and the 10-provider cap; anonymization, notification timing, and provider dashboard behavior MUST remain unchanged. Expiry MUST remain governed by FR-003/FR-004 rather than this decline fallback.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Business Rule 7 (decline fallback needs no patient release action; expiry stays governed by FR-003/FR-004), Screen 7 Step B (exclusive provider is the only initial quote recipient; transition occurs on the resulting inquiry), Screen 7 Step A routing notice, the Business Workflows provider-route gate and the Edge Cases. Overlaps FR-003 and FR-004 rules (see the report).

nodes.title: Monitoring stays active if submission fails; ends only on commit or completion

attrs.statement: The monitoring case MUST stay untouched until the FR-003 inquiry submission succeeds (Step B ends in a hand-off into the FR-003 screens and submits nothing), MUST remain active if that submission fails, and MUST terminate only after successful conversion commit or explicit completion.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Business Rule 6 (completion and conversion are terminal outcomes), Screen 5 (conversion not committed until the FR-003 inquiry is submitted), Screen 7 Step A (leaving never alters the case) and the Edge Cases (exit before submission leaves monitoring active).

nodes.title: Conversion is idempotent; no duplicate inquiries

attrs.statement: Conversion MUST be idempotent and MUST NOT create duplicate inquiries. One idempotency key MUST be created per case at the first Request Treatment and kept when the conversion draft is cleared; completion MUST discard any open conversion draft, and a conversion request that arrives after completion MUST be refused.
attrs.rationale: Restated by the Shared Services scope (idempotent transfer of compatible fields and attachments), Admin Editability (conversion identity and idempotency fixed in code), the Technology Assumptions (idempotency key) and the Edge Cases (retry after a network timeout).

nodes.title: Active hair-loss case does not block an active FR-038 case

attrs.statement: A patient may have one active case per monitoring type; an active FR-037 case does not block an active FR-038 case.
attrs.rationale: Business Rule 1 (prd.md line 589); Internal Dependencies FR-038 (both reuse shared monitoring entities discriminated by case type).

nodes.title: Starting monitoring with an active case opens it

attrs.statement: System blocks duplicate creation and opens the existing active case.
attrs.rationale: Business Workflows main flow, active-case gate (Duplicate step).

nodes.title: Entry points to Monitor Your Hair Loss

attrs.statement: Patient selects Monitor Your Hair Loss from FR-003 Screen 1: Service Selection, opens the active case from the patient home/dashboard monitoring card, or opens conversion from the active case actions or from the completion flow. Provider opens Hair Loss Monitoring Advice from the provider dashboard. Admin opens Monitoring Cases or the pending assignment/reassignment queue.
attrs.rationale: Entry Points (five bullets, joined). Screen names are as written in the PRD.

nodes.title: Intake captures reusable concern information

attrs.statement: Hair-loss monitoring intake captures Nature of Concern (required, 1 to 2000 characters), Duration (required; only active options of the FR-026-managed problem-duration list are offered, and the case stores the option reference and its label at capture), Previous Treatments or "None" (required, maximum 2000 characters), Initial Severity (required, integer 1 to 10), Lifestyle Factors and Additional Notes (optional, maximum 2000 characters each), Initial Photos (optional, FR-003 image limits) and an Initial Head Scan (optional, FR-002 quality contract).
attrs.rationale: Assembled from the Screen 1 field table (prd.md lines 220-229); the PRD has no prose statement.

nodes.title: Advice-mode case activates as Pending Assignment and Admin is notified

attrs.statement: System activates the case as Pending Assignment and notifies Admin once the required medical answers are complete and valid.
attrs.rationale: Business Workflows medical gate and ActivateAdvice step; Executive Summary (advice-mode cases wait for Admin assignment while the patient continues logging).

nodes.title: Self-monitoring case has no provider workflow

attrs.statement: No provider workflow is available for a self-monitoring case. Admin supports self-monitoring cases without adding a provider.
attrs.rationale: Business Workflows NoProvider step; Admin Platform scope; Provider Platform scope (does not manage self-monitoring cases); Communication Structure out of scope (provider advice for self-monitoring cases).

nodes.title: Providers see only their assigned advice-mode cases

attrs.statement: Provider sees only advice-mode cases currently assigned to the provider. Self-monitoring and unassigned cases never appear in the provider queue.
attrs.rationale: Provider Platform scope; Screen 8 business rules.

nodes.title: Entry validation

attrs.statement: Log Date must not be in the future; Severity is an integer 1 to 10; Notes are at most 3000 characters; Photos follow the secure image limits; a Head Scan must meet the FR-002 quality contract.
