attrs.rationale: Assembled from the Screen 3 field table (Validation Rules column); Admin Screen 14A repeats the 1 to 10 and 3000-character limits.

nodes.title: Patient edits and deletes own entries while active; all versions auditable

attrs.statement: The patient may create, edit, or delete their own entries while the case is active; all versions remain auditable. Deleted and superseded entries are excluded from every count and from the severity trend, and First recorded severity is recalculated from the remaining entries (the first remaining trend point, which can be the intake rating).
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 business rules.

nodes.title: Multiple entries per date; logged days count a date once

attrs.statement: Multiple entries on one date are allowed, but Logged Days counts the date once.
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 business rules; Screen 2 Logged Days (unique dates with at least one entry).

nodes.title: Calendar in patient-local time; authors and types distinguishable

attrs.statement: The monitoring calendar uses the patient-local timezone and shows patient logs, scans, and separate provider-advice entries so that the event author and type are distinguishable.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 Calendar field; Screens 9 and 13 (provider and Admin calendars show the same dated events).

nodes.title: Patient sees advice as its own entry; no reply; edited cue without prior versions

attrs.statement: Advice is shown chronologically as its own provider-authored calendar entry, never inside a patient log, and cannot be replied to as a chat thread. Edited advice shows a clear edited cue and latest-edit timestamp without exposing prior versions to the patient.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 business rules; Provider Advice Detail is read-only to the patient.

nodes.title: Scan capture links to the log date; guidance, validation and retake

attrs.statement: Scan capture opens the head scan capture screen and links the resulting scan to the log date. The capture shows front, top, left, right, and back guidance, offers five views with at least one view required and no single view mandatory, and validates quality. A scan set that fails the quality check cannot be saved; it must be retaken to be saved, so every saved scan is valid. The scan is optional on a case or a log, but a saved scan set needs at least one photo; saving makes one FR-002 media-only call with the scan id as the idempotency key and up to five photos, and staged photos that are never saved are removed 7 days after staging (REQ-002-047, REQ-002-051).
attrs.rationale: Screen 3 business rules; Screen 4 (Capture Guidance, Photo Set validation, retake rule).

nodes.title: V1 head scan is a standardized multi-view photo set

attrs.statement: In V1, all references to a "3D head scan" mean the standardized multi-view head scan photo set defined by FR-002. True 3D reconstruction is not required in V1; true 3D capture and viewing remain V2 scope.
attrs.rationale: Executive Summary V1 scan terminology; Screen 4 business rules; Technology Assumptions.

nodes.title: Provider access ends immediately; scans visible only while assigned

attrs.statement: Provider access ends immediately on withdrawal, Admin ending the assignment, provider suspension or deactivation, reassignment away, case completion, or conversion. Providers can view scans and media only while assigned to the advice case.
attrs.rationale: Data and Privacy Rules; Screen 4 business rules; Security Considerations (revoke provider media access when assignment ends).

nodes.title: Preview link token, expiry, revocation, approved dataset, event record

attrs.statement: Pre-assignment preview links must use an unguessable token, expire at the Admin-selected time, support revocation (including automatic revocation on assignment, completion, and conversion), expose only the approved preview dataset, and record creation, access, expiry, and revocation events.
attrs.rationale: Data and Privacy Rules.

nodes.title: End Monitoring previews the case and needs a confirmed choice

attrs.statement: End Monitoring shows the patient a preview of date range, logged-day count, scan count, and severity trend. The patient makes a single completion choice (complete and export, or Request Treatment). Complete and export requires a confirmation that acknowledges monitoring will end; Request Treatment shows no confirmation and does not end monitoring until the FR-003 inquiry is successfully submitted (Step A states that monitoring ends when the inquiry is submitted); declining returns to the active case.
attrs.rationale: Business Workflows completion preview and gate; Screen 5 field table (Completion Choice single selection; Confirmation must be selected).

nodes.title: Completion or successful conversion ends the case and any advice assignment

attrs.statement: Completing or successfully converting ends the active case and any advice assignment, sets the advice state to ended, revokes open case previews, and removes the case from the Admin queue.
attrs.rationale: Screen 5 business rules; Business Workflows Complete step.

nodes.title: Completed or converted case is read-only except Admin audited correction

attrs.statement: A completed or converted case is read-only except for Admin audited correction of its content; its status stays final and Admin cannot edit it. A converted case's summary PDF can be viewed on the summary screen like a completed case's, and Retry PDF stays available there while the PDF has failed.
attrs.rationale: Screen 5 business rules.

nodes.title: PDF generated asynchronously, retained, retryable

attrs.statement: Summary PDFs are generated asynchronously and the generated artifact is retained; the patient is notified when the PDF is ready. A failed generation is retryable on a completed or converted case without altering it. The PDF is regenerated when logs or the selected scan change after it was made.
attrs.rationale: Shared Services scope (asynchronous generation, retained artifact); Screen 6 business rules; Technology Assumptions (notify when ready); Edge Cases (generation fails after completion and succeeds on retry).

nodes.title: PDF versioned and regenerated after Admin correction

attrs.statement: When Admin corrects a value after PDF generation, for example a severity value, the PDF is versioned and regenerated.
attrs.rationale: Edge Cases (last bullet); Key Entities MonitoringExport (report version).

nodes.title: Monitoring summary values derived from valid entries

attrs.statement: Monitoring summary values are derived from valid entries: deleted and superseded entries are excluded from every count and from the severity trend. The monitoring period is the date range from the earlier of the case creation date and the earliest log date through the final case date. The severity trend is in date order; the Initial Severity given at intake is a trend point dated on the case creation date that follows the same-date rule (the latest-timestamped entry on a date wins), and the summary's First recorded severity is the first (earliest-dated) remaining trend point, which can be the intake rating, recalculated when entries are deleted or superseded. Logged-day count, scan count, advice count when applicable, and severity latest, minimum, maximum, average, and trend are derived from the same valid entries. A case with zero logs starts its period on the case creation date, shows the Initial Severity as a one-point trend (first, latest, minimum, maximum and average all equal it), and shows no log entries.
attrs.rationale: Assembled from Screens 2, 5, 6 and 7 Step A (Derived columns); per-date severity follows REQ-037-020.

nodes.title: Conversion blocked while an FR-003 inquiry is active

attrs.statement: System blocks conversion when the patient already has an active FR-003 inquiry, explains the conflict, and preserves the active monitoring case.
attrs.rationale: Business Workflows inquiry gate.

nodes.title: Conversion summary shows PDF status; continue when ready or retry

attrs.statement: If PDF generation has not finished, the conversion summary step shows generation status and allows the patient to continue once it is ready or retry on failure. After three failed tries the PDF is marked failed and the patient can continue without it: the conversion proceeds, the inquiry shows "summary pending", and Admin sees the failure on the case overview. Retry PDF works on the converted case, and a successful retry attaches the PDF to the inquiry.
attrs.rationale: Screen 7 Step A business rules.

nodes.title: Conversion summary states the provider routing

attrs.statement: The conversion summary step states, when an advice provider has an active assignment, that the assigned advice provider will be the only initial quote recipient if still assigned when the patient submits the inquiry.
attrs.rationale: Screen 7 Step A Provider Routing Notice field.

nodes.title: Patient answers only missing information and reconfirms medical answers

attrs.statement: The patient answers only missing or newly required information and reconfirms existing medical answers during conversion review.
attrs.rationale: Screen 7 Step B business rules and Medical Answers field.

nodes.title: Monitoring case and inquiry linked by immutable conversion provenance

attrs.statement: The monitoring case and the inquiry remain distinct records linked by immutable conversion provenance.
attrs.rationale: Screen 7 Step B business rules; Business Workflows CommitConversion step.

nodes.title: Conversion hands off to FR-003 screens for inquiry-only information

attrs.statement: Completing conversion review hands the patient into the standard FR-003 inquiry screens for the inquiry-only information (destinations, dates, provider selection rules, terms). FR-037 does not duplicate those screens; it supplies pre-filled values and the summary PDF to them.
attrs.rationale: Screen 7 Step B business rules and Inquiry-Only Handoff Target field.

nodes.title: Failed conversion preserves the case and the draft

attrs.statement: When FR-003 data is invalid or submission fails, System preserves the monitoring case and the conversion draft and shows corrections or a retry option. The conversion draft is held by the patient's app and is not stored on the case; when a kept draft is resumed, the PDF and carried-over values are rebuilt from the current case.
attrs.rationale: Business Workflows PreserveDraft step.

nodes.title: FR-003 accepts the generated PDF as an additional document

attrs.statement: FR-003 must accept the system-generated monitoring-summary PDF as an additional document even if its ordinary patient upload UI remains image/video-only.
attrs.rationale: Integration Points (promoted from the technical section; the behaviour is FR-003's, stated here by the PRD).

nodes.title: Withdrawal reasons hidden from other providers

attrs.statement: Withdrawal reasons are never exposed to another provider unless Admin includes an appropriate operational note.
attrs.rationale: Security Considerations (promoted from the technical section); Screen 11 (reason visible to Admin).

nodes.title: Reassignment shows history to Admin and replacement provider

attrs.statement: Reassignment cases display the withdrawal reason and prior assignment history to Admin; the replacement provider receives the case history and the date of the first window after reassignment.
attrs.rationale: Screen 12 business rules; Business Workflows Reassign and Replacement steps.

nodes.title: Assignment eligibility and Admin permissions validated before save

attrs.statement: Assignment eligibility and Admin permissions are validated before an assignment is saved. An eligible provider is one that is Active under FR-015 with setup complete; providers do not opt in separately to advice cases.
attrs.rationale: Screen 12 business rules; Marking Unclear Requirements (eligible provider means FR-015 Active with setup complete).

nodes.title: Provider assigned at conversion eligible; otherwise normal distribution

attrs.statement: The provider assigned when the inquiry submission succeeds is eligible to receive the inquiry; if that provider has withdrawn or is not eligible at that moment, conversion continues and the case follows the no-assigned-provider path.
attrs.rationale: Business Process Assumptions, promoted because it states a business path; Marking Unclear Requirements (eligible provider means FR-015 Active with setup complete).

nodes.title: Admin mode tabs partition provider controls from self-monitoring rows

attrs.statement: The Admin mode tabs are a primary partition: provider-intervention controls and advice fields do not appear as applicable on self-monitoring rows, and tab counts stay synchronized with the filters.
attrs.rationale: Screen 12 business rules and Mode Tabs field.

nodes.title: Preview contents reviewed before sharing; contact and audit data excluded

attrs.statement: Admin must review the exact read-only case overview and clinical summary that a candidate provider will receive before sharing a preview; the preview excludes patient direct-contact details and Admin-only audit and assignment data.
attrs.rationale: Screen 12 Preview Contents field.

nodes.title: Admin may edit any case information; no edit erases history

attrs.statement: Admin may edit all patient-supplied monitoring information, logs, severity ratings, scan metadata, and advice records where operational correction is required, each with a reason, but never the case status (completed and converted are final); assignment changes happen only through the assignment controls, conversion provenance is fixed, and no edit may erase historical values or provenance.
attrs.rationale: Admin Editability (Editable by Admin); Screen 13 business rules.

nodes.title: Admin advice edits keep the provider as author and every prior version

attrs.statement: Admin edits to advice preserve the provider as original author, retain every prior version, and surface the edited cue and latest-edit timestamp. An Admin change to the advice text sends the patient the same advice notification marked "updated"; other corrections send no notification.
attrs.rationale: Screen 14B business rules.

nodes.title: Advice is informational, one concise paragraph, no chat or consultation

attrs.statement: Advice is informational and must not be represented as diagnosis or prescription. It is one concise paragraph (maximum 1500 characters); FR-037 has no embedded chat, calls, diagnosis, prescriptions, or full medical consultation.
attrs.rationale: Screen 10B business rules and Advice Paragraph field; Communication Structure out of scope.

nodes.title: Provider cannot edit patient-authored data

attrs.statement: The provider cannot edit patient-authored monitoring data.
attrs.rationale: Screen 10A business rules.

nodes.title: Advice submit and edit need an active assignment

attrs.statement: Advice submit and edit actions require an active assignment, and only the author of an advice record may edit it; a replacement provider can read earlier advice but cannot edit it.
attrs.rationale: Screen 10B (Advice Paragraph, Submit Advice and Edit Advice validation rules).

nodes.title: Who is notified on assignment, withdrawal, replacement and advice

attrs.statement: The patient is notified when a provider is assigned, withdraws, is replaced, or posts advice; editing posted advice, or an Admin change to its text, sends the same advice notification marked "updated". When an assignment ends other than by the provider's withdrawal, the patient and Admin are notified; the provider is also notified, in neutral wording that does not show the reason, when Admin ends the assignment, and receives no notice on completion or conversion. Provider and Admin are notified of assignment and reassignment actions.
attrs.rationale: Communication Structure in scope; Shared Services scope; Business Workflows.

nodes.title: FR-037 notification events; no logging or scan reminder

attrs.statement: FR-037 notifications are limited to assignment, reassignment, assignment-ended, advice, withdrawal, completion, export-ready, and conversion events. FR-037 defines no patient-configurable logging or scan reminder for hair-loss cases; reminders belong to transplant-progress cases only (FR-038, REQ-038-031).
attrs.rationale: Service Boundary closing paragraph; Integration Points (FR-020 event candidates).

nodes.title: Add Log, Request Treatment and End Monitoring on active cases only

attrs.statement: Add Log, Request Treatment, and End Monitoring are available on active cases only.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 field table (Validation Rules column).

nodes.title: Advice availability states

attrs.statement: Advice availability is derived and shown as a future start date, available since date, submitted, or expired-unsubmitted; the stored window state has three values (available, submitted, expired).
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 Advice Availability field; Screen 8 and Screen 12 advice filters.

nodes.title: List screens show derived activity values

attrs.statement: Provider and Admin lists show derived activity values: last patient log, logged-day count, latest severity, scan count, last advice, and next or current advice state.
attrs.rationale: Screen 8 (Last Patient Log, Advice Availability) and Screen 12 (Activity Summary).

nodes.title: Provider advice is a limited free service

attrs.statement: Provider advice is a limited free service, not a full consultation; FR-037 advice involves no payment and has no payment event.
attrs.rationale: Business Process Assumptions; Screen 9 business rules; Data and Privacy Rules.

nodes.title: Self-service boundary: aftercare mechanics are not inherited

attrs.statement: FR-037 is a standalone, patient-driven self-service utility; it is not an aftercare package and must never inherit aftercare mechanics. An aftercare capability absent here is correct scope, not a defect.
attrs.rationale: Module Scope, Service Boundary (NON-NEGOTIABLE), including the care-team and milestone-entity rows.

nodes.title: Provider assignment lifecycle events are immutable

attrs.statement: Provider assignment lifecycle events are immutable.
attrs.rationale: Screen 13 Assignment History field (Validation Rules: Immutable events).

nodes.title: Advice mode cannot be chosen while no Inquiry questionnaire set is active

attrs.statement: System MUST NOT allow provider-advice mode to be chosen while no Inquiry-context questionnaire set is active, MUST show Admin the same system-level warning FR-025 defines for a missing active Inquiry set, and MUST keep self-monitoring available.
attrs.rationale: Business Rule 10 and the Admin Platform scope; reuses the FR-025 warning for a missing active Inquiry set.

nodes.title: Provider queue search, filters and sort

attrs.statement: The provider can search by anonymized patient ID or case ID; filter by status, advice availability, and assignment type; and sort by last patient log, advice availability, assignment date, or anonymized patient ID.
attrs.rationale: Screen 8 (Provider Monitoring Advice Queue) Business Rules.

nodes.title: Admin case list search, filters and sort

attrs.statement: Admin can search by patient name, patient ID, case ID, assigned provider, or candidate provider; filter by case status, advice state, advice window, provider, and date; and sort by updated date, start date, last patient log, advice availability, patient, or provider. The list covers case type hair_loss only; FR-038 lists its own cases on its own screen.
attrs.rationale: Screen 12 (Admin Monitoring Cases and Assignment Queue) Business Rules.

nodes.title: Withdrawal reason is 1 to 1000 characters

attrs.statement: The provider must enter a withdrawal reason of 1 to 1000 characters before the withdrawal is saved.
attrs.rationale: Screen 11 (Provider Withdrawal Confirmation) Business Rules.

nodes.title: Withdrawal confirmation must be ticked

attrs.statement: The provider must tick the confirmation that access ends immediately before the withdrawal is saved.
attrs.rationale: Screen 11 (Provider Withdrawal Confirmation) Business Rules.

nodes.title: Provider can move between the patient daily logs of an assigned case

attrs.statement: On Provider Daily Log Detail, the provider can move between the patient-authored daily logs of the case, for an assigned case only.
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 440 (Screen 10A, Previous / Next Log: moves between patient-authored daily logs in the case; assigned case only)

nodes.title: Summary PDF download only when ready, through a signed access link

attrs.statement: The patient can download the summary PDF only once it is ready, through a signed access link.
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 329 (Screen 6, Download PDF: downloads the ready report; signed access link)

nodes.title: Withdrawn case leaves the provider queue at once

attrs.statement: A withdrawn case leaves the provider's queue immediately after the withdrawal is confirmed.
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 406 (Screen 8 business rules: withdrawing removes the case from this queue immediately after confirmation)

nodes.title: Assign Provider and Share Case Preview only in pending states

attrs.statement: Admin can assign a provider and share a case preview with a candidate provider only while the case is active and in Pending Assignment or Pending Reassignment. Admin can end an assignment with a reason, and it ends automatically when the provider is suspended or deactivated (FR-015); the case then returns to Pending Reassignment and the provider's access ends. The assignment record keeps the end cause and, for an Admin end, the reason; the reason is not shown to the provider.
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 503-504 (Screen 12, Assign Provider: pending states only; Share Case Preview: pending assignment or reassignment only)

nodes.title: One active monitoring case per patient

attrs.statement: System MUST enforce one active transplant-progress monitoring case per patient.
attrs.rationale: Restated by General Rule 1 (one active case per monitoring type), Screen 1 (a patient may have only one active transplant-progress case), Main Flow step 1 (the patient selects Monitor Transplant Progress; the system checks that no active case exists, otherwise flow B1), Alternative Flow B1 and Admin Editability (one-active-case-per-type enforcement is fixed in codebase).

nodes.title: Self-service only: no provider advice, assignment, queue or data access

attrs.statement: FR-038 MUST remain self-service only with no provider advice, assignment, queue, or data access.
attrs.rationale: Restated by General Rule 2, Module Scope (Provider Platform not applicable: no operational surface, no provider assigned, no provider dashboard, advice, chat, review queue or patient-data access), Screen 2 (no provider identity or advice controls appear), Provider Platform Screens (no list, detail, advice, assignment or media-access surface) and Admin Editability (self-service-only restriction and provider-access prohibition are fixed in codebase). Executive Summary and Business Process Assumptions give the reason: avoiding clinic conflicts of interest and preventing a free self-tracking tool from being represented as managed aftercare. Communication Structure puts provider advice, assignment, chat, clinic review, diagnosis and prescriptions out of scope.

nodes.title: No required cadence, milestones, overdue status or compliance

attrs.statement: System MUST NOT impose required cadence, milestones, overdue status, or compliance obligations.
attrs.rationale: Restated by General Rule 3 (logging frequency is entirely optional; no overdue, missed-task, compliance or milestone state), Screen 2 (the system must not display overdue, missed milestone, compliance or required-frequency states), Executive Summary and Main Flow step 7 (timeline, scan history and severity trend update without overdue states).

nodes.title: Convert an active case into a distinct FR-011 standalone request

attrs.statement: Patient MUST be able to convert an active case into a distinct FR-011 standalone-aftercare request.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Alternative Flow A2 and Screens 5 and 6.

nodes.title: Intake captures FR-011-compatible external treatment details

attrs.statement: Initial intake MUST capture FR-011-compatible external treatment details.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Main Flow step 2, Module Scope and Screen 1 purpose (information compatible with FR-011 standalone aftercare).

nodes.title: Conversion attaches a summary PDF

attrs.statement: Conversion MUST attach a PDF containing treatment summary, logs, scan photos, logged-day count, and severity summary.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Executive Summary (carries the monitoring-summary PDF into the aftercare request) and Integration Points (FR-011 receives the generated PDF and must accept it as treatment documentation or additional case context).

nodes.title: Data restricted to the patient and authorized Admin users

attrs.statement: System MUST restrict FR-038 data to the patient and authorized Admin users.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Data & Privacy Rules (access is restricted to the patient and authorized Admin users while data belongs to FR-038), Screen 7 (Head Scan Photos: authorized access only) and Screen 9 (Conversion Link: authorized access only).

nodes.title: All medical-data access, edits, exports and conversions audited

attrs.statement: System MUST audit all medical-data access, edits, exports, and conversions.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Data & Privacy Rules (every view, edit, export and conversion is audited), Module Scope (Admin edits with audit history) and Communication Structure (Admin support actions visible in audit history where appropriate).

nodes.title: Case stays active unless conversion commits or the patient completes

attrs.statement: Monitoring MUST remain active if FR-011 request creation fails and MUST terminate only after successful conversion commit or explicit completion.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Alternative Flow A2 step 7 and B2 (no partial conversion is committed), Screen 5 (conversion ends the case only when the FR-011 standalone request is successfully created), Executive Summary and User Story 3 scenario 4.

nodes.title: Conversion is idempotent; no duplicate standalone requests

attrs.statement: Conversion MUST be idempotent and MUST NOT create duplicate standalone-aftercare requests. A standalone request may be created from an FR-038 conversion with pre-filled fields, the attached monitoring PDF, an optional selected scan, and an idempotency key; a repeated key returns the existing request. The idempotency key is created once per case at the first Switch to Aftercare Package and is kept when the draft is cleared.
attrs.rationale: Restated by Module Scope (idempotent transfer), Admin Editability (conversion idempotency is fixed in codebase), Edge Cases (conversion retried after network timeout) and Implementation Notes (idempotency key on the conversion record).

nodes.title: FR-011 owns everything after a successful handoff

attrs.statement: After successful handoff, FR-011 MUST exclusively own package selection, payment, assignment, activation, milestones, and provider-managed aftercare.
attrs.rationale: Restated by General Rule 6, Alternative Flow A2 step 8, Admin Editability (FR-011 ownership after successful handoff is fixed in codebase) and Executive Summary.

nodes.title: An active FR-038 case does not block an active FR-037 case

attrs.statement: An active FR-038 case does not block an active FR-037 case.
attrs.rationale: Second clause of General Rule 1; the first clause (one active case per monitoring type) is REQ-038-001.

nodes.title: Duplicate creation blocked; Resume Monitoring or End Existing Case offered

attrs.statement: When an active transplant-progress case already exists, System blocks duplicate creation and the patient can Resume Monitoring or End Existing Case.
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 153.

nodes.title: Intake required and optional fields with validation

attrs.statement: Intake requires treatment date (not in the future), treatment type (an active treatment-type value), treating clinic (1 to 200 characters), initial severity (integer 1 to 10) and the self-service acknowledgment. Treating country (an active FR-028 country), treatment documentation (PDF, JPG or PNG, maximum 10MB each), current concerns (maximum 2000 characters), initial photos (maximum 5, secure image limits) and an initial head scan (FR-002 quality contract) are optional.
attrs.rationale: Digest of the Required and Validation Rules columns of the Screen 1 field table.

nodes.title: Consent review and self-tracking confirmation

attrs.statement: Patient reviews consent and confirms this is self-tracking, not managed aftercare.
attrs.rationale: Main Flow step 3. Screen 1 Self-Service Acknowledgment (confirms no provider monitoring or required cadence) is required and must be selected before the case is created. Patient profile and consent state are listed under Data Dependencies.

nodes.title: Self-tracking is not medical advice or provider-monitored aftercare

attrs.statement: The system must clearly state that self-tracking is not medical advice or provider-monitored aftercare.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 369 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Intake does not purchase aftercare or create an FR-011 request

attrs.statement: This intake does not purchase aftercare and does not create an FR-011 request.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 200 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Valid intake creates an active self-service case

attrs.statement: System creates active self-service case.
attrs.rationale: Main Flow step 4. User Story 1 scenario 1 adds that the case opens without provider assignment.

nodes.title: Severity 1 is least severe, 10 is most severe

attrs.statement: Severity 1 means least severe and 10 means most severe.
attrs.rationale: Promoted from User Behavior Assumptions because it defines the meaning of every severity value stored.

nodes.title: Log required and optional fields with validation

attrs.statement: A log requires a log date (not in the future and not before the treatment date) and a severity (integer 1 to 10). Notes (maximum 3000 characters), photos (secure image limits) and a head scan (V1 photo set, FR-002 quality contract) are optional.
attrs.rationale: Digest of the Required and Validation Rules columns of the Screen 3 field table.

nodes.title: No automated clinical advice from a score or image

attrs.statement: No automated clinical advice is generated from a score or image.
attrs.rationale: Communication Structure puts automated clinical interpretation of severity or scan changes, diagnosis and prescriptions out of scope.

nodes.title: Only Admin corrects the treatment date; earlier-dated logs are fixed in the same edit

attrs.statement: Only the Admin can correct the treatment date after the case exists. When the new date leaves logs dated before it, the Admin must correct or remove those logs in the same edit, otherwise the save is refused.
attrs.rationale: Screen 9 (Admin is the only route to correct the treatment date) and Edge Cases.

nodes.title: Reminders are on by default, patient-changeable, and stop at completion or conversion

attrs.statement: Reminders are on by default with the Admin schedule (once a month for 12 months from the case creation date); the patient can change the schedule or switch them off with Reminder Preference on Screen 2, without affecting case status. Reminders are sent through a progress-reminder event of the FR-030 catalogue, stop when the case is completed or converted, and cannot become mandatory milestones or compliance checks.
attrs.rationale: Communication Structure, Screen 2 (Reminder Preference) and Admin Editability (patient reminder defaults).

nodes.title: Calendar uses the patient-local timezone

attrs.statement: The calendar shows dates with logs and scans in the patient-local timezone.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 211 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Add Log, Switch to Aftercare Package and End Monitoring need an active case

attrs.statement: Add Log, Switch to Aftercare Package, and End Monitoring are available on an active case only.
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 214.

nodes.title: Severity summary derived from the severity ratings, starting at the Initial Severity

attrs.statement: Severity Summary shows first, latest, minimum, maximum, average, and trend of the severity ratings; the Initial Severity given at intake is a data point of the trend plotted on the case creation date, the trend is in date order with the logs, and first means the earliest-dated point. A case with no log shows the Initial Severity as first, latest, minimum, maximum, and average, with a one-point trend, and completion and conversion stay allowed.
attrs.rationale: Screen 2 Severity Trend is the rating over time (derived); Main Flow step 7 updates the severity trend as entries change; Scalability says trend summaries may be cached while source entries stay authoritative.

nodes.title: Monitoring Period runs from the earlier of the case creation date and the earliest log date to the completion or conversion date

attrs.statement: Monitoring Period is the date range from the earlier of the case creation date and the earliest log date to the date the case was completed or converted (to today for an active case preview).
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 301 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Last Log Date is the most recent patient entry

attrs.statement: Last Log Date is the most recent patient entry.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 332 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Conversion State is None, draft or converted; the draft is set at Switch and cleared at commit, return or completion

attrs.statement: Conversion State is None, draft, or converted to FR-011. The conversion draft is set when the patient selects Switch to Aftercare Package and cleared when the conversion is committed, the patient returns to monitoring, or the patient completes the case; the idempotency key is kept when the draft is cleared (REQ-038-016).
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 333 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Completion previews date range, logged days, scan count and severity trend

attrs.statement: Before completion, System previews the monitoring date range, logged-day count, scan count, and severity trend.
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow A1 step 2 and the Screen 5 Case Summary (derived).

nodes.title: Explicit completion ends the case immediately after confirmation

attrs.statement: Explicit completion ends the case immediately after confirmation.
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow A1 steps 3 and 4. Screen 5 requires the patient to select the Confirmation checkbox (acknowledges the current monitoring case will end) and a single Completion Choice.

nodes.title: Completion PDF content

attrs.statement: PDF includes treatment summary, complete date-to-date log, scan photos, logged-day count, and severity summary.
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow A1 step 5 and User Story 2 scenario 2. REQ-038-010 states the same content for the PDF attached at conversion.

nodes.title: Failed PDF generation can be retried without reopening the case

attrs.statement: Failed generation can be retried without reopening the case: the patient sees the failed status on Screen 7, or on Screen 6 during conversion, and selects Retry PDF.
attrs.rationale: User Story 2 scenario 3 adds that the retry does not duplicate the case.

nodes.title: Export-ready, completion and conversion notifications to the patient

attrs.statement: System sends export-ready, completion, and conversion notifications to the patient.
attrs.rationale: Shared Services (S-03) and Communication Structure (system confirmations, export-ready notifications and conversion status notifications are in scope). Integration Points list the candidate event names; notification copy is left to technical design.

nodes.title: Completion and conversion are terminal; source and destination stay distinct

attrs.statement: Completion and successful conversion are terminal outcomes, and source/destination cases remain distinct. The patient may end monitoring while a conversion draft is open; completion discards the draft, and a request creation arriving after completion is refused.
attrs.rationale: Screen 6 (the monitoring record and the FR-011 request remain distinct records linked by conversion provenance), Executive Summary and User Story 3 scenario 3.

nodes.title: Admin correction after PDF generation regenerates the PDF as a new report version

attrs.statement: When Admin corrects data after PDF generation, the system regenerates the PDF as the next report version; the patient sees the latest version on Screen 7 and gets the export-ready notice, and a copy already attached to an FR-011 request is not replaced.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 561 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Capture guidance and quality and completeness checks

attrs.statement: Scan capture shows front, top, left, and right guidance, and the standardized multi-view photo set must pass quality and completeness checks under the FR-002 V1 contract.
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 249.

nodes.title: A scan that fails the quality check cannot be saved

attrs.statement: A scan set that fails the quality check cannot be saved; it must be retaken to be saved, so every saved scan is valid.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 256 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Scan history grouped by date, current case only

attrs.statement: Scan history lists prior scans grouped by date, for the current case only. Screen 4 opens from Scan History on Screen 2, from the head-scan capture on Screens 1 and 3, and from the retake on Screen 6. A scan captured from Screen 1 is held with the intake draft and saved when the case is created.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 251 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Provider access to copied data begins at FR-011 assignment

attrs.statement: Provider access to information copied from FR-038 begins when the Admin assigns the provider to the FR-011 request, under FR-011 rules and before payment.
attrs.rationale: Module Scope, Screen 4 and Data & Privacy Rules; the assigned provider reviews the copied intake, PDF and scan to set up the plan, and the patient has already reviewed what is sent (REQ-038-067).

nodes.title: Admin may edit all case information for operational correction

attrs.statement: Admin may edit all monitoring intake information, entries, severity ratings, scan metadata, report regeneration, and conversion metadata when operational correction is required. Case status is not editable: completed and converted are final. No edit may erase historical values or provenance.
attrs.rationale: Module Scope (Admin Platform: full case visibility and audited editing) and Screen 9 Case Data (permission controlled).

nodes.title: Admin edits may not erase historical values or provenance

attrs.statement: Admin may edit any information for operational correction, but no edit may erase historical values or provenance: version history, exports, and conversion provenance remain.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 354 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Admin edit validated for permission and value, then saved as a new version

attrs.statement: System validates permission and value before saving a new version of an edited monitoring case.
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow A3 steps 3 and 4.

nodes.title: Audit history is immutable and records actor, reason, time, before and after

attrs.statement: Audit history is immutable and records actor, reason, time, and before and after values; a saved Admin edit creates an immutable before-and-after audit event.
attrs.rationale: Alternative Flow A3 step 4, Screen 9 Audit History, Admin Editability (audit immutability fixed in codebase).

nodes.title: Admin cannot assign a provider; conversion to FR-011 is the only route

attrs.statement: Admin cannot assign a provider to FR-038; the patient must convert to FR-011 for managed aftercare.
attrs.rationale: Module Scope (Admin cannot turn an FR-038 case into provider-managed monitoring), Screen 8 (no assignment queue or provider field) and Business Process Assumptions (FR-011 standalone aftercare remains the only route from self-tracking to provider-managed aftercare).

nodes.title: Admin visibility implies no clinical monitoring or advice responsibility

attrs.statement: Admin visibility does not imply clinical monitoring or advice responsibility.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 338 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Admin case list: all cases, paginated, status filter, permission-scoped search

attrs.statement: Admin Transplant-Progress Cases (Screen 8) lists all transplant-progress monitoring cases, paginated, with a status filter (Active, Completed, Converted to aftercare), no Type filter, and search by patient or case identifier within the Admin's permission scope.
attrs.rationale: Module Scope (Admin views all self-service cases and supports the patient when needed) and Entry Points (Admin opens Transplant-Progress Cases). Digest of the Screen 8 field table.

nodes.title: Entry points to transplant-progress monitoring

attrs.statement: Patient selects Aftercare: Monitor Transplant Progress from FR-003 Screen 1: Service Selection. Patient opens the active case from the patient home/dashboard monitoring card. Patient opens a completed or converted case from the same card, which also lists previous completed and converted cases, each opening its Screen 7 read-only. Admin opens Transplant-Progress Cases (Screen 8). Patient selects Switch to Aftercare Package from active-case actions or Screen 5.

nodes.title: No FR-012 messaging; no FR-011 milestone communications before activation

attrs.statement: FR-038 includes no FR-012 secure messaging, and FR-011 milestone/task communications do not begin before standalone aftercare is purchased, assigned, and activated.
attrs.rationale: prd.md lines 71.

nodes.title: Current summary PDF generated at Switch, with status, retry, regeneration and repeat rules

attrs.statement: System generates the current monitoring-summary PDF when the patient selects Switch to Aftercare Package. Screen 6 shows the PDF status; on failed the patient can retry; the PDF is regenerated when logs or the selected scan change after it was made; a repeated Switch reuses the existing draft PDF unless data changed; the export-ready notice for the conversion PDF opens Screen 6 only while the conversion draft is open, otherwise Screen 7.
attrs.rationale: Screen 6 Monitoring Summary PDF (current date-to-date report, system-generated).

nodes.title: Fields valid and PDF ready before the aftercare request

attrs.statement: Patient continues to FR-011 to submit the standalone aftercare request only when the fields are valid and the monitoring PDF status is ready.
attrs.rationale: Screen 6 Continue to Aftercare Request. The patient picks the package and pricing option on FR-011 Screen 6 (REQ-038-017).

nodes.title: Only reviewed data is transferred to FR-011

attrs.statement: Only data explicitly reviewed in the conversion draft is transferred to FR-011.
attrs.rationale: Promoted from Security Considerations; Assumptions say patients review copied external-treatment information before conversion.

nodes.title: Failed or abandoned conversion preserves the case and the conversion draft

attrs.statement: When FR-011 request validation or creation does not complete, or the patient abandons it, System preserves the active monitoring case and the conversion draft; the patient returns to FR-038 Screen 6 with the draft intact, corrects copied fields there, and retries or returns to monitoring.
attrs.rationale: REQ-038-015 states the active-case half of this rule.

nodes.title: FR-011 owns payment failure after the request exists

attrs.statement: When FR-011 payment fails after a standalone request is created, FR-011 owns the pending or failed payment state while the FR-038 conversion link remains intact.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 559 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: FR-011 and FR-007 own pricing, checkout, payment, invoice, subscription, refund

attrs.statement: If the patient converts, FR-011 and FR-007 exclusively own package pricing, checkout, payment status, invoice, subscription, and refund behavior.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 399 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: FR-038 is free and creates no invoice, charge, subscription or refund

attrs.statement: FR-038 is free and creates no invoice, charge, subscription, or refund.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 398 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: FR-038 does not price, take payment, assign a provider or activate aftercare

attrs.statement: FR-038 does not calculate price, take payment, assign a provider, or activate aftercare.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 291 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Incomplete or failed checkout creates no FR-038 payment record

attrs.statement: An incomplete or failed checkout must not create an FR-038 payment record.
attrs.rationale: prd.md line 400 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Log Timeline in chronological order

attrs.statement: The Log Timeline MUST list entries in chronological order.
attrs.rationale: Screen 7 Business Rules.

nodes.title: Download PDF only when the report is ready, through a signed access link

attrs.statement: Download PDF MUST be available only when the report is ready, through a signed access link; each Download issues a new signed link.
attrs.rationale: Screen 7 Business Rules.

nodes.title: Malware scan of uploaded documentation and generated PDFs

attrs.statement: System MUST scan uploaded treatment documentation and generated PDFs for malware; an uploaded file that fails the scan is rejected with an error and not stored, and a generated PDF that fails ends with generation status failed.
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements, Display and Processing Requirements.

nodes.title: Out-of-scope statements: no advice, assignment, chat, review, diagnosis or prescriptions

attrs.statement: System MUST NOT provide provider advice, provider assignment, provider chat, clinic review, diagnosis, prescriptions, FR-012 secure messaging, FR-011 milestone communications before standalone aftercare is purchased, assigned, and activated, or automated clinical interpretation of severity or scan changes.
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements, Display and Processing Requirements.

nodes.title: Asynchronous PDF generation with patient notification when ready

attrs.statement: System MUST generate PDF summaries asynchronously and notify the patient when the PDF is ready.
attrs.rationale: Functional Requirements, Display and Processing Requirements; Integration Points and Technology Assumptions (applies to the completion PDF and the conversion PDF).

nodes.title: Completion choice required, single selection

attrs.statement: Completion Choice (Screen 5) is required and allows a single selection: Complete and export, or Switch to Aftercare Package.
attrs.rationale: Screen 5 field table (Completion Choice: required, single selection).

nodes.title: Confirmation checkbox required

attrs.statement: Confirmation (Screen 5) is required and MUST be selected: for Complete and export it acknowledges that this case will end, and for Switch to Aftercare Package it acknowledges that the case stays active until the aftercare request is created.
attrs.rationale: Screen 5 field table (Confirmation: required, must be selected).

nodes.title: Rejected or expired converted request leaves the monitoring case final

attrs.statement: When FR-011 ends a converted request as Rejected or Expired, the monitoring case stays converted and read-only; the patient may start a new standalone request from the same source data in FR-011, which uses a new idempotency key (FR-011 REQ-011-093, REQ-011-094).
attrs.rationale: Screen 7 business rules. FR-011 owns the receiving side and the new request.

nodes.title: Patient identity hidden until booking confirmation

attrs.statement: Providers MUST see only the anonymized patient ID, shown in the display form "Mark P." followed by the ID, until booking confirmation (the first successful payment). At booking confirmation the patient's name and contact details (phone number and email address) unlock for the provider. The rule does not apply to admins, who see the full patient identity for compliance and support.
attrs.rationale: system-prd.md lines 1928.

nodes.title: One 10-year retention period

attrs.statement: System MUST keep every record for 10 years: audit logs, financial transaction and payment records, booking records, discount records, medical records, inquiry data, and head and monitoring scan media; no record type has a shorter period. A patient deletion request does not shorten the period: the patient's personal data stays archived and anonymised (no hard deletion). Backup copies follow the separate backup retention in NFR-004.
attrs.rationale: system-prd.md lines 1934.

nodes.title: Soft deletes only

attrs.statement: Every delete MUST be a soft delete (the record is archived); hard deletion is prohibited.
attrs.rationale: system-prd.md line 1940 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Encryption in transit and at rest

attrs.statement: All data in transit MUST be encrypted using TLS 1.3. All sensitive data at rest MUST be encrypted using AES-256, including personal and medical data, payment-related personal data, messages, and media.
attrs.rationale: system-prd.md line 1945 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: No card numbers stored

attrs.statement: System MUST NOT store card numbers; only the payment processor handles them. System MUST be PCI DSS compliant through the payment processor. System MUST verify the signature of every payment webhook before acting on it.
attrs.rationale: system-prd.md lines 1949.

nodes.title: Core security controls fixed in code

attrs.statement: Core security controls, encryption standards, the audit scope for financial events, and duplicate-charge protections are fixed in the product and MUST NOT be editable in the Admin Platform.
attrs.rationale: system-prd.md line 1955 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Password and one-time-code policy

attrs.statement: Passwords MUST have at least 12 characters, including at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, one digit, and one special character; the policy is fixed and not editable in the Admin Platform. One-time codes (email verification and password reset) MUST have 6 digits (fixed); their expiry time and resend limits MUST be configurable in FR-026.
attrs.rationale: system-prd.md lines 1959.

nodes.title: Admin API rate limit

attrs.statement: System MUST rate-limit the admin configuration and settings APIs, including the payment configuration API, to 100 requests per minute per admin to prevent abuse.
attrs.rationale: system-prd.md line 1964 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Role-based, audited access

attrs.statement: Access to platform data MUST be granted by role (patient, provider, admin, and the permissions inside each). Every access to personal, medical, financial, and conversation data MUST be audited with who accessed it and when; a feature adds the reason where one is required. Audit log entries MUST be immutable: read-only, with no editing or deletion.
attrs.rationale: system-prd.md lines 1969.

nodes.title: Times shown in the user's local time zone

attrs.statement: System MUST display every date and time on every screen in the user's local time zone; admin views MAY switch to UTC for audits.
attrs.rationale: system-prd.md line 1974 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: GDPR and HIPAA-equivalent compliance

attrs.statement: System MUST follow GDPR and HIPAA-equivalent practices for personal and medical data. Patient consent MUST be respected for any data sharing, and data residency MUST be honored. Tenants MUST NOT share a database directly with each other.
attrs.rationale: system-prd.md lines 1978.

nodes.title: Concurrent admin edits: warn, then last save wins

attrs.statement: When two admins edit the same item at the same time on an admin screen, the second admin MUST be warned that the item was changed since they opened it, with who changed it and when, and MAY continue; the last save wins and overwrites the earlier change.
attrs.rationale: system-prd.md line 1984 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Setting and policy changes apply to new cases only

attrs.statement: A change to any setting, configuration, or policy MUST NOT affect a case that is already ongoing; it affects only a new case from the point the new setting or policy goes into effect.
attrs.rationale: system-prd.md line 1988 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Download links expire and check permission

attrs.statement: Links to downloadable files (PDF reports and media) MUST expire and MUST check the requester's permission every time they are opened.
attrs.rationale: system-prd.md line 1992 (found by matching the rule statement to the PRD text).

nodes.title: Inquiry Summary and Submission (Screen 7)

nodes.title: Provider Selection (Screen 7a)

nodes.title: Inquiry Dashboard, Post-Submission (Screen 8)

attrs.description: Patient sees stage, timeline, responses, summary, deadlines and stage-dependent actions (cancel or contact support).

nodes.title: Cancel Inquiry Confirmation Modal (Screen 8a)

attrs.description: Patient confirms irreversible cancellation, with impact summary and a required reason.

nodes.title: Cancellation Success Confirmation (Screen 8b)

nodes.title: Inquiry List Dashboard (Screen 9)

attrs.description: Provider list of distributed inquiries with masked patient names, alerts, date ranges and filters.

nodes.title: Inquiry Detailed View (Screen 10)

attrs.description: Provider detail of one inquiry, read-only before a quote, with media, head scan, questionnaire and the exclusive-inquiry decline action.

nodes.title: Hairline Overview Dashboard (Screen 11)

attrs.description: Admin list of all inquiries in every stage with unmasked identity, status, counts and advanced filters.

nodes.title: Inquiry Detailed Management (Screen 12)

attrs.description: Admin edit, reassign, override, soft delete and audit trail for one inquiry.

nodes.title: Quote Creation/Edit

attrs.description: Provider creates or edits one parent quote and its package options with full inquiry context, through seven ordered tabs (Treatment Service; Package Options with Sub-screen 2A Inline Package Editor; Grafts & Visual Plan; Dates & Pricing; Option Treatment Plans; Clinical Details & Notes; Review & Submit). Each tab has a completion gate; Review & Submit links each issue back to its owning tab and submits parent and options as one transaction.

nodes.title: Quote List

attrs.description: Provider views all quotes in a single unified list with no tabs, reflecting global case statuses; actions (Edit, Soft Delete for drafts only, View Details) are state-aware; cancelled quotes are greyed out with a badge and all actions disabled; the admin-authored replacement quote is not listed.

nodes.title: Quote Details

attrs.description: Provider inspects full quote details, patient-first as a continuation of the inquiry (Patient, Inquiry, Quote, Audit); Edit and Soft Delete (drafts only) when eligible, and Withdraw for a sent quote before acceptance or for an accepted quote only while the booking is Accepted or Confirmed, before check-in, with no provider-fault marker; withdrawing an accepted quote opens a confirmation that names the consequence (the booking goes to the admin for a transfer or refund), and an ineligible accepted quote shows no Withdraw and a short note; an Inquiry Cancelled banner and read-only state for cancelled quotes, with neutral wording when an admin closed or cancelled the inquiry.

nodes.title: Quote Review

attrs.description: Patient reviews parent quotes and their subquotes, read-only in FR-004; acceptance of exactly one subquote, edge cases and booking handoff are governed by FR-005, which may extend the actions while preserving FR-004 privacy and data structure.

nodes.title: Quote List (Admin)

attrs.description: Admin lists and filters all quotes across providers, grouped by inquiry by default, with a multi-quote cue, per-quote audit trail and version history; Restore and Archive are hidden for accepted quotes; Restore is offered only for an expired quote or a quote archived from draft or sent, other archived quotes show no Restore, and a restore is blocked with a message that names the failed guard (inquiry not open, provider not Active, active acceptance, provider-fault marker).

nodes.title: Quote Detail (Admin)

attrs.description: Admin views the complete quote with inquiry continuation and can switch between quotes of the same inquiry.

nodes.title: Admin Inline Quote Edit

attrs.description: Admin performs inline edits with audit on draft, sent, and accepted quotes, with a mandatory reason; price, currency, and promotion stay read-only once accepted, an edit after acceptance is stored as a new version beside the unchanged acceptance snapshot, and edits of the accepted quote are blocked while the booking carries a provider-fault marker, except admin notes; the replacement quote is not offered, because Screen 8 is its only edit surface.

nodes.title: Admin Replacement Quote Authoring

attrs.description: Admin authors a quote for the replacement provider during an FR-006 provider-fault transfer, pending or closed, opened only from the transfer and blocked with a message that names the failed check; the quote is a draft with no expiry until Save and Continue sends it and starts the normal quote expiry, hidden from the provider and the patient throughout, with its currency captured at the first save and fixed after, and Screen 8 is its only edit surface; Save and Continue confirms the summary, sends the quote and returns to FR-006 to record the acceptance before it expires.

nodes.title: Inquiry Dashboard with Quote Comparison

attrs.description: Extends FR-003 Screen 8. Patient views submitted inquiry status (stage, timeline, summary, medical alerts, deadlines, next actions), browses parent quotes grouped under providers, compares complete subquotes side by side, and accepts one subquote. Parent quote groups show provider, reference, shared clinical information, reviews, credentials, the expiry timer and a Message Provider button that opens the FR-012 conversation. Each subquote card offers View Details and Accept. Sort and filter controls and Compare checkboxes (at most three) sit above the list; the comparison panel renders only when at least two subquotes are selected.

nodes.title: Subquote Detail with Accept Action

attrs.description: Extends FR-004 Screen 4 (Quote Review). Patient views one complete subquote with inherited parent context read-only, may enter a promotion code for this subquote, acknowledges the terms, and taps Accept, which opens the confirmation modal.

nodes.title: Acceptance Confirmation Modal

attrs.description: Confirms acceptance and shows next steps (Booking & Payment handoff information) before finalizing. Confirm finalizes when eligible; Cancel returns to the subquote detail. Shows the slot-taken error state when the slot is taken first.

nodes.title: Quote Outcome Notification

attrs.description: Read-only. Informs the provider of the acceptance outcome for each parent quote and its subquotes; only the selected provider sees the accepted selection; a non-selected reason never identifies another provider or the accepted price; links to version/audit history.

nodes.title: Acceptance Oversight Dashboard

attrs.description: Admin monitors all subquote acceptance events with status filters (active, booking cancelled, superseded), views the immutable accepted selection, supersession or booking-cancelled indicator, flagged conflicts, and annotations, and adds audited notes or corrections with a reason. No delete or restore action exists.

nodes.title: Payment & Booking Confirmation

attrs.description: Review the accepted subquote and inherited parent context, view its pre-scheduled appointment slot, and proceed to payment without reselection. Accessed from FR-005's Accepted Subquote detail view; shows a read-only blocked state when the booking can no longer be paid.

nodes.title: Booking Confirmation & Itinerary

attrs.description: Confirmed booking, reference number, next steps and basic itinerary; appears immediately after successful payment.

nodes.title: Bookings Dashboard (Provider)

attrs.description: Accepted and confirmed bookings in table list format (no calendar view); monitor booking status and payment state.

nodes.title: Booking Detail View (Provider)

attrs.description: Complete booking details with context from inquiry, parent quote, accepted subquote, acceptance and booking stages; read-only.

nodes.title: Bookings Management Dashboard (Admin)

attrs.description: Monitor all bookings across the platform; entry to the governed interventions.

nodes.title: Booking Detail & Intervention (Admin)

attrs.description: Complete booking details from all stages, with the governed intervention actions: revive, change appointment, cancel, provider-fault transfer, resolve in-progress provider fault, close an in-progress case early with no fault, reassign aftercare, refund, internal note.

nodes.title: Revive Booking (Admin Modal)

attrs.description: Revive a Payment Window Expired booking to Accepted with a new slot hold, opened from Screen 6.

nodes.title: Change Appointment (Admin Modal)

attrs.description: Change the appointment date/time of an Accepted or Confirmed booking, opened from Screen 6.

nodes.title: Cancel Booking (Admin Modal)

attrs.description: Cancel a booking on an admin decision or a patient request received through support, opened from Screen 6.

nodes.title: Provider-Fault Transfer and Replacement Quote (Admin)

attrs.description: Move a patient to a replacement provider in the same inquiry through an admin-authored replacement quote and a new admin-authored acceptance, opened from Screen 6.

nodes.title: Resolve In-Progress Case (Admin Modal)

attrs.description: Record the admin's decision for a booking that is In Progress, opened from Screen 6: the case-by-case decision for a provider fault, or the early close with no fault.

nodes.title: Patient Checkout (Deposit)

attrs.description: Screen 1. Allow patient to pay deposit to confirm booking.

nodes.title: Patient Final Payment

attrs.description: Screen 2. Allow patient to complete final payment before or on procedure date.

nodes.title: Booking Payment Status and Progress (Provider)

attrs.description: Screen 3. View complete payment information with full context from inquiry, quote, booking, and payment stages.

nodes.title: Provider Payout Overview (Provider)

attrs.description: Screen 4. View payout status and details for completed treatments with full context from booking and payment stages.

nodes.title: Patient Payment Progress Dashboard (Admin)

attrs.description: Screen 5. Allow admin to monitor patient payment progress across all bookings (list/dashboard view).

nodes.title: Payment Detail View (Admin)

attrs.description: Screen 5B. View complete payment information with full context from all stages for a specific booking.

nodes.title: Refund Processing (Admin)

attrs.description: Screen 6. Process refunds per cancellation policy with full context from booking and payment stages.

nodes.title: Patient Checkout - Installment Plan Selection

attrs.description: Allow the patient to select an installment plan at booking checkout. Reached from the Payment Options step (FR-006/FR-007) after the patient selects Pay in Installments; shows the full schedule, the late fee, grace period and cancellation point, an interest-free highlight, a Pay in Full alternative, a plan versus full payment comparison and a calculator. UI controls: installment selector, calculator, Pay in Full option, confirm.

nodes.title: Patient Booking Details - Installment Schedule View

attrs.description: Allow the patient to view the installment payment schedule and history from the booking details screen. UI controls: progress bar, countdown, Update Payment Method button (opens payment method management from the FR-001 menu, REQ-001-151), Pay now button on a Failed or Overdue installment or, on an Active plan, on the next scheduled installment, receipt download.

nodes.title: Provider Installment Plans Overview

attrs.description: Let the provider see all their bookings that use installment plans, with high-level status and risk indicators; read-only. UI controls: Booking ID link to the shared detail screen, plan status and date range filters, sort.

nodes.title: Provider Booking Installment Plan Detail

attrs.description: Read-only view of one booking's installment plan, schedule and payment history. The Installment Schedule table has one row per installment; the overdue or defaulted support banner is described by a Rule.

nodes.title: Admin Installment Plan Management Dashboard

attrs.description: Monitor and manage all installment plans across the platform: metric widgets, a filterable and sortable plan list, aging report, revenue forecast, export and drill-down. UI controls: widgets, filters, export, contact patient, retry, cancel booking actions.

nodes.title: Admin Booking Installment Plan Detail

attrs.description: Actionable view of one booking's installment plan with the Admin Action Panel (Retry Charge, Mark as Resolved), each with a justification of at least 20 characters. Mark as Resolved is only for a recorded bank transfer (amount, date, receiving account, reference) that a second admin who holds the Resolve Installments permission approves. The panel is a UI control group; its justification is written to the audit log (S-06), not to a graph entity. Cancelling a booking is not a plan action: it uses the FR-006 Cancel Booking action.

nodes.title: Passport Submission

attrs.description: Patient submits the passport photo and form after the booking is Confirmed, only for Path A, so the provider can complete included bookings. Passes the on-device photo quality gate first. After submission the screen becomes a read-only confirmation of the form fields with a masked passport number and no photo. On an earlier or carried-over passport the patient sees Use these details and Enter new details.

nodes.title: Travel Requirement Check

attrs.description: Path B only. Full-screen prompt with the confirmed booking reference and appointment context and a single question: does the patient need to arrange travel. Yes continues to flight then hotel submission; No sets no_travel_required and goes to the itinerary showing No travel required. Buttons: Yes and No.

nodes.title: Flight Information Patient Submission

attrs.description: Path B only. Patient submits confirmed flight details for one leg; used twice for a round trip. The form header shows Outbound Flight or Return Flight. Locked on submission. Early-departure warning applies to the return leg.

nodes.title: Hotel Information Patient Submission

attrs.description: Path B only. Patient submits confirmed hotel details so the provider can coordinate. Locked on submission. Early-departure warning applies to the check-out date.

nodes.title: Travel Itinerary View Patient

attrs.description: Unified read-only view assembled each time it opens from the booking, TravelContext and current records: booking and accepted choice, package travel items, passport (Path A only), outbound and return flight, hotel. Shows Awaiting submission, Travel dates under admin review, and No travel required states; read-only when the TravelContext is closed. In Path B the outbound flight, return flight and hotel rows are always shown, as the record, Awaiting or Not needed.

nodes.title: Travel Section Provider Confirmed Booking Detail

attrs.description: Collapsible Travel section at the bottom of the provider's confirmed booking detail screen (FR-006 Screen 4), visible once Confirmed. Shows accepted choice summary, travel path, status badges and path-dependent actions: View Passport, Enter Flight, Enter Hotel (Path A) or View Travel Details (Path B). Shows early-departure flag, Travel dates under admin review and Travel-date review required labels.

nodes.title: Passport View Provider

attrs.description: Path A. Read-only view of the patient's passport details, with the passport number in full and the photo viewable but not downloadable. Access is logged.

nodes.title: Flight Information Provider Entry

attrs.description: Path A, only for flights included in the accepted option. Same form as the patient flight screen; the submitter is recorded as the provider. Locked on submission.

nodes.title: Hotel Information Provider Entry

attrs.description: Path A, only when a hotel is included in the accepted option and none has been submitted yet. Same form as the patient hotel screen. Locked on submission.

nodes.title: Travel Details Provider Path B

attrs.description: Patient-submitted flight and hotel details shown inline as collapsible sub-sections of the Travel section for Path B bookings. Entirely read-only; no passport sub-section. Each item shows Submitted, Awaiting or Not needed, and Patient declared no travel needed is shown when the patient has declared it.

nodes.title: Travel Section Admin Confirmed Booking Detail

attrs.description: Travel section of the admin's confirmed booking detail screen, shown for every confirmed booking. Shows accepted choice, travel path, statuses and TravelContext status with the review baseline. Actions: Re-notify patient, Apply Correction (to Screen 12) and Confirm Travel Dates (review only). Unavailable actions when the TravelContext is closed.

nodes.title: Travel Record Detail and Admin Correction

attrs.description: Full travel record view and correction screen reached from Apply Correction: a header plus tabs for Passport (Path A only), Flight Details and Hotel Details. Each correction needs a mandatory reason note; admin can replace the passport photo, edit fields and soft-delete a record; corrections notify the patient and provider.

nodes.title: Team Management Dashboard

attrs.description: Central view of team members, roles, status, seat usage and available actions (PRD Screen 1).

nodes.title: Invite Team Member Form

attrs.description: Collects the details needed to invite a new team member (PRD Screen 2).

nodes.title: Role and Permission Management Dialog

attrs.description: Modifies a non-Owner member's role and shows the permission difference (PRD Screen 3).

nodes.title: Remove or Suspend Team Member Modal

attrs.description: Guided reassignment and access revocation (PRD Screen 4).

nodes.title: Task Transfer Wizard

attrs.description: High-volume reassignment before removal (PRD Screen 5).

nodes.title: Team Member Detail Page (Provider)

attrs.description: Profile, workload, permissions and activity of one member for Owners and Admins (PRD Screen 6).

nodes.title: Invitation Landing

attrs.description: Validates the invitation token and orients the new member (PRD Screen 7).

nodes.title: Account Setup

attrs.description: Collects core account details and password before access is granted (PRD Screen 8).

nodes.title: First-Login Permission Tour

attrs.description: Educates a new member on allowed actions and pending tasks (PRD Screen 9).

nodes.title: Provider Team Directory

attrs.description: Cross-provider view of team members for support and compliance (PRD Screen 10).

nodes.title: Team Member Detail Page (Admin)

attrs.description: Admin oversight of one member: profile, audit log, assigned work, deferred security and relationship tabs (PRD Screen 11).

nodes.title: Provider Team (Admin, Single Provider)

attrs.description: One provider's team with an Invite Staff Member action, embedded in FR-015 Screen 3 Tab 3 (PRD Screen 12).

nodes.title: Invite Staff Member Form (Admin)

attrs.description: Admin invite form inside PRD Screen 12: email address and non-Owner role.

nodes.title: In Progress Case View

attrs.description: Show the patient a read-only view of their active treatment case, including the provider's beginning-of-treatment note, day-by-day treatment status, and an estimated graft count reference.

nodes.title: Day Details Popup

attrs.description: Show the patient a focused view of a single treatment day's description and current status when they tap a day row in Screen 1.

nodes.title: In Progress Listing

attrs.description: Display all cases currently in the "In Progress" stage for the provider's clinic, with search and filter capabilities.

nodes.title: In Progress Case Detail

attrs.description: The primary treatment execution workspace, displayed as a tabbed case detail page with tabs: Treatment Plan | Note | Book hotel & Book flight | In Progress (active tab during treatment). The In Progress tab is organised into three stages: Before Procedure, During Procedure, and End of Procedure.

nodes.title: Day Edit Modal

attrs.description: Allow the provider to update the status of a specific treatment day and add or edit a clinical note.

nodes.title: End of Treatment Modal

attrs.description: Capture final treatment documentation — conclusion, prescription, advice, medications, actual graft count, final head scan photo set *(V1; true 3D scan in V2)*, and treatment photos — and signal treatment completion to FR-011.

nodes.title: In Progress Listing (Admin)

attrs.description: Display cases across all providers and clinics platform-wide, In Progress cases by default and any other case status through the status filter, with search, filters, the admin flags, and direct access to open any case.

nodes.title: In Progress Case Detail (Admin)

attrs.description: Allow admin to view and edit all aspects of a case, opened from the admin listing in any status (Confirmed, In Progress, Aftercare, Completed, or Cancelled) — including treatment day statuses, provider notes, case actions, and the retry of a failed completion signal. The case status is never set by hand. All fields are editable by admin unless system-locked for audit integrity.

nodes.title: Change Treatment Details (Admin)

attrs.description: Let an admin change a case's current treatment plan days, assigned clinician set, and estimated graft count from `Confirmed` until the treatment ends (Alternative Flow A2). The clinic uses the same form from Screen 4, but only from `Confirmed` until Check In.

nodes.title: Aftercare Dashboard

attrs.description: Patient aftercare home: overall progress, current milestone, days remaining, next and upcoming tasks, last scan and questionnaire, medication adherence, with quick actions to upload a scan, complete a questionnaire, view instructions and contact support.

nodes.title: Scan Upload (V1 Photo Set)

attrs.description: Guided capture and upload of the head scan photo set for a due scan, with real-time quality feedback, retake, upload progress and access to previous scans. True 3D scanning is V2.

nodes.title: Questionnaire Completion

attrs.description: Completion of the milestone questionnaire rendered from the assigned FR-025 Questionnaire Set, with draft save, submit and a warning when responses raise the urgent flag.

nodes.title: Medication Schedule

attrs.description: Today's doses and the provider-prescribed medications with a mark-as-taken action, missed-dose indicator, weekly adherence, missed count and adherence history.

nodes.title: Educational Resources

attrs.description: Milestone educational resources by category (videos, guides, FAQs, help) with view or download, viewed tracking and completion percentage.

nodes.title: Aftercare Service Purchase

attrs.description: Patient picks post-treatment add-on or standalone service, enters external treatment details where needed, browses purchasable templates with pricing in local currency, picks fixed or subscription and proceeds to payment.

nodes.title: Aftercare Payment & Checkout

attrs.description: Order summary with subtotal, platform fee, tax and total (and monthly breakdown for subscriptions), payment method choice, billing address and terms acceptance; payment is processed by FR-007.

nodes.title: Aftercare Cases List

attrs.description: Provider list of assigned aftercare cases with patient, treatment, current milestone, progress, medication alerts and last activity, with search and filters.

nodes.title: Patient Aftercare Details

attrs.description: Provider view of one case with plan, progress, scan history, questionnaire responses, medication adherence history and communication log, plus actions to adjust the plan, request a scan, contact the team and escalate.

nodes.title: Aftercare Setup (Multi-Step)

attrs.description: Five-step provider wizard: select a template, customize milestones, set up medications, add custom instructions, review and confirm before activation.

nodes.title: Aftercare Plan Edit

attrs.description: Provider (and admin) edit of an active plan: template, milestones, medications and instructions, with a mandatory change reason, approval status for major changes and change history.

nodes.title: Aftercare Progress Tracking (Provider)

attrs.description: Provider progress view of an assigned patient: timeline, overdue tasks, scan and questionnaire status, adherence, compliance and a recent activity feed.

nodes.title: Aftercare Cases List (Admin)

attrs.description: Admin list of every aftercare case across providers with provider, type, milestone, progress, medication alerts and status, with search, filters and actions.

nodes.title: Aftercare Case Details (Admin)

nodes.title: Provider - Review Detail and Response

nodes.title: Admin - Reviews Management List

nodes.title: Admin - Review Detail, Insert and Edit

nodes.title: Admin - Takedown Requests Queue

nodes.title: Admin - Review Settings and Export
