attrs.description: Admin manages the global list of questionnaire set categories: add, edit, deactivate and delete (delete blocked while sets are assigned).

nodes.title: Context Type Reference

attrs.description: Read-only reference of the system-defined context types, their sets, active-set counts and consuming modules, in fixed order Inquiry, Aftercare, Multi-Context.

nodes.title: Questionnaire Preview

attrs.description: Admin previews one set as the patient app (mobile) and as the provider summary, reflecting the current Draft; Test Mode fills sample responses that are discarded on exit; Print Preview generates a printable version.

nodes.title: Version History and Audit Trail

attrs.description: Admin views one set's published versions (with View Snapshot and Restore as New Draft) and its audit trail of every admin action.

nodes.title: Settings Management Dashboard (Screen 1)

attrs.description: Lists every setting group in four sections (Authentication & Security, App Data, Notifications, Analytics) with name, current version and last modified; Edit opens the group editor (disabled for groups fixed in codebase) and View History is always available.

nodes.title: Authentication Throttling (Screen 2)

attrs.description: Admin edits max login attempts and lockout duration, then supplies a change reason. Changes apply within 60 seconds of saving (propagation); existing lockouts are untouched. The fixed FR-031 admin endpoint throttle applies in addition to the shared lockout.

nodes.title: OTP Configuration (Screen 3)

attrs.description: Admin edits OTP expiry, resend cooldown and hourly resend limit; the code length is shown read-only (fixed at 6). Includes the interaction logic note for cooldown and hourly limit.

nodes.title: Countries and Calling Codes (Screen 4)

attrs.description: Admin adds, edits, reorders, activates and deactivates countries (name, ISO code, calling code, flag, display order); a usage count of users per country is shown with a warning before deactivating, which also lists the FR-028 groupings and fallback price rows that use it; the final active country cannot be deactivated; a CSV import saves countries Inactive with a flag missing state.

nodes.title: Discovery Question Options (Screen 5)

attrs.description: Shows the fixed question text and lets admin add, edit, reorder, activate and deactivate answer options, with a usage count per option.

nodes.title: Inquiry Cancellation Reasons (Screen 5a)

attrs.description: Admin manages cancellation reasons (label, requires explanation, order, active) with a usage count and date range filter; the "Other" reason is fixed.

nodes.title: Account Deletion Reasons (Screen 5b)

attrs.description: Admin manages account deletion reasons (label, requires explanation, order, active) with a usage count and date range filter; the "Others" reason is fixed.

nodes.title: Inquiry Configuration (Screen 5c)

attrs.description: Admin manages treatment-area options (label, image or icon, order, active) and the minimum inquiry lead time in days (0 through 730).

nodes.title: Quote Configuration (Screen 5d)

attrs.description: Admin edits quote expiry window, quote-expiring-soon lead time, slot-hold duration and hold-expiring-soon lead time; the currency is shown read-only from the FR-029 Default Currency.

nodes.title: Analytics Configuration (Screen 5e)

attrs.description: Admin edits the TTFQ SLA target, At Risk and Dormant thresholds, price outlier threshold, benchmark refresh frequency and optional target monthly commission consumed by FR-014.

nodes.title: Provider Specialties (Screen 5f)

attrs.description: Admin adds, renames, reorders, activates and deactivates provider specialties, with a count of providers holding each; at least one value must stay active and values are never hard-deleted.

nodes.title: OTP Email Templates (Screen 6)

attrs.description: Admin edits the subject, HTML body and plain text body of the Verification and Password Reset templates, sees the available variables and previews the email with sample data; template names are fixed.

nodes.title: Version History (Screen 7)

attrs.description: Read-only list of versions of a setting group, newest first, with diff highlighting of old and new values, change reason and admin; sensitive values are masked. A Quote Configuration version created by an FR-029 Default Currency change shows Change Type System.

nodes.title: Platform Settings Editor (Screen 8)

attrs.description: Admin views and changes the platform Settings that other modules read and that Screens 2 to 7 do not edit: re-verification threshold, admin session policy, landing background images, profile photo limits, head scan quality minimums, acceptance terms text, timezone options, provider notification types, the support emergency contact and the limits owned by other features (creation rate limits, admin invitation token expiry, admin repeated denial threshold). Each Setting sits in one of the Screen 1 setting groups.
attrs.display_only_reason: Platform Settings Editor (PRD Screen 8) lists and edits platform Settings, not data Fields, and the schema forbids a Screen to Setting edge; each Setting is linked through the Rules that apply to this Screen (REQ-026-112 to 121) and govern the Setting.

nodes.title: Admin: Legal Documents List

attrs.description: PRD Screen 1. Lists all legal document types and versions with entry points to draft, edit, preview and publish. UI controls, not fields: Actions buttons (Draft new version, Edit draft, Create draft from this version on Current and Archived rows, View history that filters the list to the document type, Preview, Publish, Withdraw on a Scheduled row), filters by Document Type, Status and Locale (criteria owned by FR-022, REQ-022-110), the Legal settings panel (REQ-027-059), the read-only Audit trail list filtered to one document (REQ-027-013) and the Locale gap badge on a version row (REQ-027-037). Behaviour in REQ-027-049, REQ-027-050 and REQ-027-060. Shows the warning banner (REQ-027-024).

nodes.title: Admin: Draft/Edit Legal Document

attrs.description: PRD Screen 2 (prd.md line 158). Author or edit content of one legal document version before publication. Side-by-side preview while editing; shows a prior version summary for context; rich text editor with Markdown toggle (editor limits in REQ-027-051).

nodes.title: Admin: Preview and Publish

attrs.description: PRD Screen 3 (prd.md line 188). Review draft content, confirm details and publish globally. UI controls, not fields: Publish button (enabled per REQ-027-050) and the link back to edit the draft. Shows the acceptance impact summary.

nodes.title: Admin: Acceptance Coverage Dashboard

attrs.description: PRD Screen 4 (prd.md line 216). Monitor acceptance for current and recent versions. Filters by document type and version; date range for trend; CSV export of pending users; audit link for the publication event. Pending Users list supports pagination and export.

nodes.title: Admin: Acceptance Detail List (Drilldown)

attrs.description: PRD Screen 4A (prd.md line 244). Paginated list of users per version, accepted versus pending, with filters and export; sortable by acceptance timestamp and user ID. UI controls, not fields: User Filter, Status Filter (Accepted or Pending, default Pending) and Export button; criteria owned by FR-022 (REQ-022-111).

nodes.title: Patient and provider: Acceptance prompt

attrs.description: Shared by the patient app and the provider portal (REQ-027-058). Lists each document that needs acceptance with version and effective date; Accept per document is enabled after the full text is opened; shows the fallback-language notice (REQ-027-036) and the blocked and accepted states. UI controls, not fields: the Accept buttons.

nodes.title: Regional Grouping Management (Screen 1)

attrs.description: Admin creates, edits, archives and orders regional groupings that control the location presentation order for patients from different regions.

nodes.title: Location Pricing Configuration (Screen 2)

attrs.description: Admin configures starting price estimates per destination and currency, with fallback prices, effective and expiry dates, and bulk update.

nodes.title: Location Display Preview (Screen 3)

attrs.description: Admin previews how location recommendations and starting prices appear to patients from different regions.

nodes.title: Stripe Accounts Management

attrs.description: Admin Platform. Add, edit and manage multiple Stripe accounts and assign them to countries or regional groupings (PRD Screen 1). UI controls, not fields: Test Connection button and its modal (shows account name, mode and endpoint, calls Stripe with the keys and webhook secret, shows success or failure with error details, logs the attempt and updates Last Tested), Show toggle on the secret fields, Retry Connection, Save & Activate. Also shown: inline help on Test versus Live Mode, a warning icon when the account was not tested for over 30 days, and transaction count and total volume per account for the last 30 days (reference only; read from payment transactions owned by FR-007). Account Status is Active, Inactive or Archived: an account an open booking or active installment plan still uses cannot be deleted, only archived. The countries of an Inactive or Archived account are treated as unassigned for routing, and such an account may hold no countries. On a production deployment only Live accounts are routed and elsewhere only Test accounts, and the Global Fallback account must be Active and in the mode of the deployment. Payment methods are checked against the charge currency.

nodes.title: Currency Conversion: Pair List and Global Settings

attrs.description: Admin Platform. Screen 2A: Section 1 Global Settings, Section 2 Rate Sources (Add, Edit, Delete, Test Connection), Section 3 Currency Pair List (PRD Screen 2A). The pair list supports sorting and filtering by pair name, mode, status and last updated, shows total pair count and counts by mode, an alert badge count in the header when any pair is yellow or red, a banner that currencies not configured default to USD, and actions Add Pair, Edit Pair, Delete Pair and Sync Now per auto-fetch pair. Source Status and Last Tested are display-only. A yellow rate-protection badge compares the pair with its rate 24 hours earlier and stays until an admin acknowledges it on Screen 2B; a later normal sync does not clear it. After the acknowledgement the pair is compared with the rate at that moment, and no comparison runs for 24 hours after a pair is created or switched between modes.

nodes.title: Add / Edit Currency Pair

attrs.description: Admin Platform. Screen 2B: form to create or edit a pair (PRD Screen 2B). UI controls, not fields: Test Connection & Fetch Rate (mandatory before saving a new auto-fetch pair), Save, Cancel, the Rate History link (chart and table of rate changes over the last 30 days when editing), inline help text on Base Rate, the source status indicator beside the Source dropdown, the estimated conversion impact example, and last and next sync timestamps below the form. The Acknowledge button clears a pair's rate-protection warning and logs the acknowledgement with admin and time; afterwards the pair is compared with the rate at that moment until the 24-hour change is again within the threshold.

nodes.title: Deposit Rate Configuration

attrs.description: Admin Platform. Configure the deposit percentage globally or per provider (PRD Screen 3). UI controls, not fields: Provider Search by name or ID, bulk edit of several providers, Apply Deposit Rate. Also shown: a preview calculation, a sortable list of providers with custom rates, a badge next to providers with custom rates on provider list screens, and the historical deposit rate changes from the audit log. A provider-specific rate is removed with the Reset to global default action (confirmation and audit entry), never deleted.

nodes.title: Split Payment (Installment) Configuration

attrs.description: Admin Platform. Configure available installment options and cutoff rules (PRD Screen 4). UI controls, not fields: Preview Installment Schedule button, Save Split Payment Configuration. Also shown: a preview calculator and example scenarios, a warning when cutoff days are very aggressive (over 60), and installment usage statistics for the last 30 days (reference only). The minimum lead time (cutoff + 30 days) and the minimum for each enabled installment count are always shown; the warning appears when the cutoff is above 60 days. A second warning, which does not block the save, appears when a set cancellation point falls before the day the late payment fee would be charged.

nodes.title: Commission Rate Configuration

attrs.description: Admin Platform. Global Default section and Provider Specific section (PRD Screen 5). A provider-scope modal collects Selected Providers, Commission Model, Provider Commission Value, Flat Rate Currency, Effective Date and a preview calculation per model. UI controls, not fields: Save Setting, Add new provider scope, Edit, Archive (the Actions menu). FR-015 Tab 7 is the synchronized single-provider edit surface for the same data.

nodes.title: Currency Management

attrs.description: Admin Platform. Manage the enabled subset of the master currency catalog and the system default currency (PRD Screen 6). UI controls, not fields: Search filter by code or name, Enable common set (e.g., USD/EUR/GBP) and Set Default quick actions. It is the source of truth for currency dropdowns across Admin, Provider and Patient experiences. A currency that is the Default Currency of an active Stripe account, or the Fee Currency of stored fixed fee amounts, cannot be disabled; after the default currency changes a banner on Screen 7 asks the admin to re-enter the fixed fee amounts, and Screen 7 cannot be saved until they are.

nodes.title: Refund, Fees and Settlement Settings

attrs.description: Admin Platform. One global record of the refund ladder, the late payment fee, the rescheduling fee, the balance due days, the unpaid balance cancellation point, Hairline's share of a patient cancellation fee, the patient confirmation window and the settlement period, cutoff day and payout day for manually paid clinics (PRD Screen 7). Not set per provider, region or currency. Also the clinic cancellation deduction and the read-only Fee Currency. The late payment fee, the rescheduling fee, the cancellation point, Hairline's share and the deduction show Not set until an admin sets them. A fixed amount must be above 0 and, after a Default Currency change, re-entered in the new currency before a save is accepted. A warning, not a refusal, shows when the cancellation point falls before the day the late payment fee would be charged. A save that breaks a range or ordering check is refused with the failing field named.

nodes.title: Alerts and Notifications: Rules Dashboard

attrs.description: Admin Platform (A-09), Settings, Alerts & Notifications. Overview of every catalog event and its rules, grouped by category, with quick access to Configure, Test and Pause/Activate (PRD Screen 1). UI controls, not fields: Search Rules box, the Rules List table, the Rule Row Actions button group (Configure, Test, Pause/Activate; there is no Delete action), the Add Rule button, CSV export, pagination, back link.

nodes.title: Alerts and Notifications: Rule Editor

attrs.description: Admin Platform (A-09). Create or edit a rule for a catalog event (an event can have several rules): recipients, channels, templates, timing, retry, escalation, status (PRD Screen 2). UI controls, not fields: preview pane, Test Rule, Save Draft, Save & Activate, change log panel, breadcrumb and Back to list.

nodes.title: Alerts and Notifications: Template Editor

attrs.description: Admin Platform (A-09). Create and edit notification templates per event, channel and language with variables, live preview and version history (PRD Screen 3). UI controls, not fields: Variable Preview Values (transient JSON input used only for preview, not stored), Insert Variable dropdown, Send Test, split-screen preview, Revert by Creating New Version.

nodes.title: User Roles & Permissions

attrs.description: Admin Platform, Settings > User Roles & Permissions, three tabs: Admin Roles, Admin Users, Provider Roles (PRD Screen 1). UI controls, not fields: tab switcher, role list action buttons (Edit Permissions, View Users, Clone Role, and Delete on custom roles; Edit Permissions and Clone Role are disabled for Super Admin), Create Custom Role, Invite Team Member, user action menu (Change Role, Suspend or Reactivate, Delete on a suspended account, View Audit; a Super Admin row shows View Audit only), search bar and filters (Tab 2 specified in FR-022 REQ-022-115, Tab 1 in REQ-022-116), Pending Invitations sub-tab (Resend, Cancel) and notification dot, sync status indicator, warning banner when only one Super Admin exists. Tab 3 View Users links to FR-015. Tab 2 rows also show whether the user has acknowledged the latest role change (Acknowledged, Awaiting acknowledgement or Overdue) and any pending role change with its Effective From.

nodes.title: Invite Team Member

attrs.description: Admin Platform form where a Super Admin invites an admin team member (PRD Screen 2). UI controls: role permission summary, Preview Email, Send Invitation, Cancel.

nodes.title: Admin Account Setup

attrs.description: Admin Platform page the invitee opens from the invitation link to create their account (PRD Screen 3). UI controls: Confirm Password (validation only, nothing stored), MFA enrollment section marked Coming Soon, expiry countdown, Create Account and Cancel buttons.

nodes.title: Permission Matrix Modal

attrs.description: Admin Platform modal to edit one role's permissions (Single Role mode) or compare and edit several roles at once (Matrix mode) (PRD Screen 4). UI controls: Select All and category bulk actions, mode switch, Save Changes, Cancel, Reset to Default, Preview Impact, Export Matrix, matrix filters and search, unsaved-changes dialog, sensitive-permission warning modal.

nodes.title: User Detail & Audit Trail

attrs.description: Admin Platform page with an admin user's profile and audit trail (PRD Screen 5). UI controls: Send Password Reset, Load More, Export audit trail to CSV, security alerts, audit filters (specified in FR-022 REQ-022-117). The audit trail shows access-control events only (REQ-031-132); actions on patient accounts stay in the FR-016 patient action log, and patient accounts and admin accounts remain separate records. Shows the Role Change Acknowledged status (Acknowledged, Awaiting acknowledgement or Overdue).

nodes.title: Provider Profile: Basic Information

attrs.description: Provider Platform, Settings > Profile, Tab 1 (PRD Screen 1). Inline edit per field; Edit Profile button opens bulk edit mode for all fields with Save All / Cancel All. UI controls, not fields: Edit Profile button, crop/resize tool, save/cancel buttons. Rules: REQ-032-001, REQ-032-004, REQ-032-014 and the profile field rules.

nodes.title: Provider Profile: Languages

attrs.description: Provider Platform, Settings > Profile, Tab 2 (PRD Screen 1). Chip list with "+ Add Language" searchable dropdown, x to remove (confirmation on the last chip), drag-and-drop reordering. UI controls, not fields: add-language dropdown, chip remove button. The list offers Active and Preparation locales and keeps a saved entry when its locale becomes Inactive (REQ-032-147).

nodes.title: Provider Profile: Awards

attrs.description: Provider Platform, Settings > Profile, Tab 4 (PRD Screen 1). Award cards with Add / Edit / Delete and drag-and-drop reordering. Tab 3 (Staff List) is not a screen of this FR: it displays FR-009 Screen 1. UI controls, not fields: Add Award button, Edit and Delete actions, delete confirmation dialog.

nodes.title: Provider Profile: Reviews

attrs.description: Provider Platform, Settings > Profile, Tab 5 (PRD Screen 1). Read-only reviews from the Reviews module with rating summary, distribution, filters, sort and pagination (10/20/50 per page); responses through the FR-013 Screen 6 composer. Empty state: "No reviews yet". UI controls, not fields: Rating Filters, Sort Dropdown, Pagination Controls, "Read more" link. Filter, sort and paging run on the server; reviews carry an Edited marker and link to the FR-013 review screens (REQ-032-148).

nodes.title: Provider Profile: Documents

attrs.description: Provider Platform, Settings > Profile, Tab 6 (PRD Screen 1). Upload, view/download, replace and delete credential documents; Admin badge and "View Only" for admin uploads. Empty state invites the first upload. UI controls, not fields: Upload Document, View/Download, Replace and Delete buttons, Document List container, delete confirmation dialog.

nodes.title: Account Information

attrs.description: Provider Platform, Settings > Account Settings (PRD Screen 2), including the password change section and the Account Closure card with its warning dialog. UI controls, not fields: Current Password and Confirm New Password inputs (verification only, not stored), Save button, "Request Account Closure" button, acknowledgement checkbox, Submit / Cancel in the closure dialog. Personal settings belong to the signed-in person and are saved on the team member record. Account Name is read-only for the Owner role and editable for staff roles. Account Email is read-only for every role (REQ-032-144). The Account Closure card is shown to the Owner only (REQ-032-141).

nodes.title: Notification Preferences

attrs.description: Provider Platform, Settings > Notifications (PRD Screen 3). Six notification-type toggles and two channel toggles, organization-wide. No toggle for mandatory notices (REQ-032-031). UI controls, not fields: Save button, Disable-all confirmation dialog. Only the Owner and a Manager can change them; other roles see them read-only (REQ-032-142).

nodes.title: Billing Settings (Owner edits, Billing Staff views)

attrs.description: Provider Platform, Settings > Billing, visible to the holders of the View Billing Settings permission (grantable; Owner and Billing Staff by default) and editable only by the Owner, the only holder of Edit Billing Settings (not grantable); a View-only user sees it read-only with no edit, save or cancel controls and no Complete Stripe sign-up link (PRD Screen 4): bank account details for payouts (form only when the payout method is Manual bank transfer; a Stripe Connect status panel with a Complete Stripe sign-up link otherwise) and the read-only Commission & Payout panel. UI controls, not fields: Edit / Save / Cancel buttons.

nodes.title: Help Centre

attrs.description: Provider Platform, Settings & Support > Help Centre landing page (PRD Screen 5) with global search, category navigation, Most Popular Articles and Recently Updated. Category navigation also links to Contact Support, Feedback & Suggestions, My Support Cases and Service Status. UI controls, not fields: Search Bar.

nodes.title: FAQs

attrs.description: Help Centre FAQs (PRD Screen 5.1): topic filter and accordion list of questions with expandable answers. Empty state when no FAQs match. UI controls, not fields: "Was this helpful?" Yes/No buttons, accordion expand.

nodes.title: Articles (Tutorial Guides, Troubleshooting Tips, Policy Information)

attrs.description: Help Centre article view (PRD Screen 5.2). UI controls, not fields: auto-generated Table of Contents, "Was this helpful?" Yes/No buttons.

nodes.title: Resource Library

attrs.description: Help Centre downloadable resources (PRD Screen 5.3). UI controls, not fields: Preview button (PDF and images), Download button, filters. The category filter maps to the resource category.

nodes.title: Video Tutorials

attrs.description: Help Centre video tutorials (PRD Screen 5.4). UI controls, not fields: player controls, "Was this helpful?" Yes/No buttons.

nodes.title: Contact Support

attrs.description: Help Centre support request form and submission tracking (PRD Screen 5.5). Submissions create FR-034 cases. UI controls, not fields: Submit button.

nodes.title: Feedback & Suggestions

attrs.description: Help Centre feedback form and submission tracking (PRD Screen 5.6). Submissions create FR-034 feedback cases. UI controls, not fields: Submit button.

nodes.title: My Support Cases

attrs.description: Provider list of support and feedback cases (PRD Screen 5.7). Empty state when no cases match. UI controls, not fields: Filter Bar (status, type, date range), Search Bar, Quick Stats Bar (counts per status and unread over all of the clinic's cases, independent of the list filters), Pagination Controls.

nodes.title: Case Detail

attrs.description: Provider view of one support case (PRD Screen 5.8) with thread (oldest first) and timeline (newest first). UI controls, not fields: Send Reply, Request Reopen and Back to List buttons. The reply box is enabled for Open, In Progress and Resolved cases; a reply to a Resolved case reopens it.

nodes.title: Reopen Case Request

attrs.description: Modal opened from Case Detail for Closed cases only (PRD Screen 5.9). The reason and the optional requested priority go to FR-034 as a flagged reopen-request message; the case stays Closed until the admin decides. UI controls, not fields: Priority selector, Submit Reopen Request and Cancel buttons.

nodes.title: Service Status

attrs.description: Platform status page (PRD Screen 5.10). Shows Status not available when no status can be read; status update notifications are a future enhancement.

nodes.title: Provider Help Centre Management Dashboard

attrs.description: Admin Platform dashboard for provider Help Centre content: category navigation over the 10 provider categories, quick stats and recent activity (PRD Screen 1). UI controls, not fields: category navigation links.

nodes.title: Provider Help Centre Category Configuration

attrs.description: Admin configures the 10 provider categories: order, visibility, label, description, routing type, external URL and intro copy (PRD Screen 1.1). UI controls, not fields: none.

nodes.title: Provider FAQ Management

attrs.description: List of provider FAQs organised by topic with edit, delete, preview and manage-topics actions (PRD Screen 2). UI controls, not fields: Add New FAQ, Edit, Delete, Preview, Manage Topics buttons.

nodes.title: Provider FAQ Add/Edit Form

attrs.description: Create or edit a provider FAQ (PRD Screen 2.1). UI controls, not fields: Preview, Save and Cancel buttons.

nodes.title: FAQ Topic Management

attrs.description: Create, edit, reorder and delete FAQ topics for the selected audience, Provider or Patient, chosen with the Audience Switch (PRD Screen 2.2). Opened from the provider FAQ Management screen or the patient FAQ Management screen through Manage Topics. UI controls, not fields: Add New Topic, Edit, Delete, Save Order, Cancel buttons.

nodes.title: Provider Article Management

attrs.description: List of provider articles organised by type (PRD Screen 3). UI controls, not fields: Add New Article, Edit, Delete, Preview buttons.

nodes.title: Provider Article Add/Edit Form

attrs.description: Create or edit a provider article (PRD Screen 3.1). UI controls, not fields: Preview, Save and Cancel buttons.

nodes.title: Provider Resource Library Management

attrs.description: List of provider resources organised by category (PRD Screen 4). UI controls, not fields: Add New Resource, Edit, Delete, Preview, Download buttons.

nodes.title: Provider Resource Add/Edit Form

attrs.description: Create or edit a provider resource (PRD Screen 4.1). UI controls, not fields: Preview, Save and Cancel buttons.

nodes.title: Provider Video Tutorial Management

attrs.description: List of provider video tutorials organised by category (PRD Screen 5). UI controls, not fields: Add New Video, Edit, Delete, Preview buttons.

nodes.title: Provider Video Add/Edit Form

attrs.description: Create or edit a provider video from an uploaded file or a third-party embed (PRD Screen 5.1). UI controls, not fields: Preview, Save and Cancel buttons.

nodes.title: Provider Service Status Management

attrs.description: Overview of overall status, service components, incident history and maintenance schedule (PRD Screen 6). Provider-only. UI controls, not fields: add, edit, delete actions on components, incidents and maintenance.

nodes.title: Provider Service Component Add/Edit Form

attrs.description: Create or edit a service component (PRD Screen 6.1). UI controls, not fields: Save and Cancel buttons.

nodes.title: Provider Incident Add/Edit Form

attrs.description: Create or edit an incident (PRD Screen 6.2). UI controls, not fields: Save and Cancel buttons.

nodes.title: Provider Maintenance Add/Edit Form

attrs.description: Schedule or edit a maintenance window (PRD Screen 6.3). UI controls, not fields: Save and Cancel buttons.

nodes.title: Provider Content Preview

attrs.description: Renders FAQs, articles, resources, videos or service status as providers see them (PRD Screen 7). Shows the content being previewed, read-only. UI controls, not fields: Preview Mode dropdown.

nodes.title: Patient Help Centre Management Dashboard

attrs.description: Admin Platform dashboard for patient Help Centre content; mirrors Screen 1 (PRD Screen 8). Admin-only screen. UI controls, not fields: category navigation links.

nodes.title: Patient FAQ Management

attrs.description: Admin list of patient FAQs; mirrors Screen 2 (PRD Screen 9). Admin-only screen. UI controls, not fields: Add New FAQ, Edit, Delete, Preview buttons.

nodes.title: Patient FAQ Add/Edit Form

attrs.description: Create or edit a patient FAQ; mirrors Screen 2.1 (PRD Screen 9.1). Admin-only screen. UI controls, not fields: Preview, Save and Cancel buttons.

nodes.title: Patient Article Management

attrs.description: Admin list of patient articles; mirrors Screen 3 (PRD Screen 10). Admin-only screen. UI controls, not fields: Add New Article, Edit, Delete, Preview buttons.

nodes.title: Patient Article Add/Edit Form

attrs.description: Create or edit a patient article; mirrors Screen 3.1 (PRD Screen 10.1). Admin-only screen. UI controls, not fields: Preview, Save and Cancel buttons.

nodes.title: Patient Resource Library Management

attrs.description: Admin list of patient resources; mirrors Screen 4 (PRD Screen 11). Admin-only screen. UI controls, not fields: Add New Resource, Edit, Delete, Preview, Download buttons.

nodes.title: Patient Resource Add/Edit Form

attrs.description: Create or edit a patient resource; mirrors Screen 4.1 (PRD Screen 11.1). Admin-only screen. UI controls, not fields: Preview, Save and Cancel buttons.

nodes.title: Patient Video Tutorial Management

attrs.description: Admin list of patient video tutorials; mirrors Screen 5 (PRD Screen 12). Admin-only screen. UI controls, not fields: Add New Video, Edit, Delete, Preview buttons.

nodes.title: Patient Video Add/Edit Form

attrs.description: Create or edit a patient video; mirrors Screen 5.1 (PRD Screen 12.1). Admin-only screen. UI controls, not fields: Preview, Save and Cancel buttons.

nodes.title: Patient Content Preview

attrs.description: Renders patient FAQs, articles, resources or videos as patients see them; mirrors Screen 7 (PRD Screen 13). Admin-only screen. UI controls, not fields: Preview Mode dropdown.

nodes.title: Support Case Listing

attrs.description: Primary admin interface for browsing, searching, filtering, and managing all support cases with quick actions. Controls with no field of their own: Create New Case button, quick stats bar (counts of open, in progress, urgent and unassigned cases), row selection checkboxes, row action buttons, bulk assign and bulk close buttons, pagination.

nodes.title: Create/Edit Support Case Form

attrs.description: Allows admin staff to create new support cases or edit existing case details. Controls with no field of their own: Link to Patient Record and Link to Provider Record buttons, character counters, Save as Draft. Opens from the listing (Create New Case) and from the detail view (Edit Case).

nodes.title: Support Case Detail View

attrs.description: Displays complete case information, two-way communication thread, comprehensive timeline with full context, and all case management actions. Controls with no field of their own: Add Internal Note, Reply to Patient/Provider, Update Status, Resolve Case, Reassign Case, Reopen Case, Close Case and Edit Case buttons; deep links to patient and provider records.

nodes.title: Case Resolution Modal

attrs.description: Allows admin to document case resolution and close case with resolution summary. Modal opened from the detail view or the listing. Controls with no field of their own: Send Resolution Email checkbox, Mark as Resolved and Cancel buttons.

nodes.title: Reassign Case Modal

attrs.description: Allows admin to reassign case to another admin team member with reason tracking for informational purposes. Modal opened from the detail view or the listing. Controls with no field of their own: Notify New Assignee checkbox, Reassign Case and Cancel buttons.

nodes.title: Reopen Case Modal

attrs.description: Allows admin to reopen a Closed or Resolved case when patient/provider indicates issue not fully resolved. Modal opened from the detail view or the listing. Controls with no field of their own: Notify Patient/Provider checkbox, Reopen Case and Cancel buttons.

nodes.title: Support Center Configuration

attrs.description: Allows Super Admin and authorized admin staff to manage centralized lists and configuration options for Support Center module (accessed via Settings > Support Center). Settings path Settings > Support Center. Controls with no field of their own: add buttons and modals per list, list tables, Save Configuration and Cancel buttons.

nodes.title: Help & Support Hub

attrs.description: Central entry point for help and support (PRD Screen 1). UI controls, not fields: Screen Title, Back Navigation, Search Bar, Browse Help Center link, Contact Support link, My Support Tickets link, Emergency Contact Section container.

nodes.title: Help Center Browser

attrs.description: Browse patient help content by type, search, and view FAQ, article, resource and video detail (PRD Screen 2). UI controls and states, not fields: Screen Title, Back Navigation, Search Bar, Content Type Cards group and icons, Article Subtype Filter chips, Article List, Resource List, Video List, Download Button, Contact Support CTA, Content Unavailable State, No Results State, Empty Content State, Empty Content Type State.

nodes.title: My Support Tickets

attrs.description: List of the patient support cases with filter chips (PRD Screen 3). UI controls and states, not fields: Screen Title, Back Navigation, Create New Ticket Button, Filter Chips, Ticket Card container, Empty State (No support tickets yet. Need help? Tap Create New Ticket.).

nodes.title: Ticket Detail

attrs.description: Support case detail, thread and patient reply (PRD Screen 4). UI controls and states, not fields: Back Navigation, Communication Thread container, Reply Input Field, Attachment Button, Send Reply Button, Closed Case Banner, Empty Thread State.

nodes.title: Contact Support Form

attrs.description: Form to submit a support request or feedback; creates an FR-034 case (PRD Screen 5). UI controls, not fields: Screen Title, Back Navigation, Submit Button, Cancel / Discard. The confirmation screen after submission is part of this screen (PRD line 441).

nodes.title: Hair-Loss Monitoring Intake and Mode Selection

attrs.description: Screen 1 (Patient Platform). Creates a monitoring case and captures reusable concern information.

nodes.title: Monitoring Dashboard and Calendar

attrs.description: Screen 2 (Patient Platform). Provides the active case timeline, progress summary and actions.

nodes.title: Daily Monitoring Log

attrs.description: Screen 3 (Patient Platform). Records a dated observation using the same structure on every date.

nodes.title: Head Scan Capture and History

attrs.description: Screen 4 (Patient Platform). Captures or reviews standardized scan photo sets across the case.

nodes.title: Complete or Convert Monitoring Case

attrs.description: Screen 5 (Patient Platform). Lets the patient deliberately end the active case.

nodes.title: Monitoring Summary and PDF Export

attrs.description: Screen 6 (Patient Platform). Displays the completed case and its downloadable report.

nodes.title: Convert to Treatment Inquiry: Conversion Summary (Step A)

attrs.description: Screen 7 Step A (Patient Platform). Read-only consolidated preview of the monitoring record and the data that will populate the inquiry; nothing is edited and no inquiry exists yet.

nodes.title: Convert to Treatment Inquiry: Review and Edit Carried-Over Data (Step B)

attrs.description: Screen 7 Step B (Patient Platform). Reviews and edits pre-filled FR-003 data before entering the remaining FR-003 inquiry screens.

nodes.title: Provider Monitoring Advice Queue

attrs.description: Screen 8 (Provider Platform). Shows and helps the provider find cases currently assigned to them.

nodes.title: Provider Monitoring Case Overview

attrs.description: Screen 9 (Provider Platform). Overall view of one monitoring case for the assigned provider; routes each calendar record into its dedicated detail screen.

nodes.title: Provider Daily Log Detail

attrs.description: Screen 10A (Provider Platform). Shows the complete patient-authored record for one selected calendar day without mixing provider advice into it.

nodes.title: Provider Advice Detail

attrs.description: Screen 10B (Provider Platform). Dedicated surface for viewing, submitting or editing one provider-advice record or the current available advice window.

nodes.title: Provider Withdrawal Confirmation

attrs.description: Screen 11 (Provider Platform). Ends a provider assignment safely.

nodes.title: Admin Monitoring Cases and Assignment Queue

attrs.description: Screen 12 (Admin Platform). System-wide operational picture of monitoring cases; oversight, pre-assignment sharing, first assignment and reassignment.

nodes.title: Admin Monitoring Case Overview and Configuration

attrs.description: Screen 13 (Admin Platform). Overall view and operational controls for one case; routes individual patient logs and provider advice into dedicated detail screens.

nodes.title: Admin Daily Log Detail

attrs.description: Screen 14A (Admin Platform). Complete patient-authored record for one selected calendar day and the audited correction controls for that record.

nodes.title: Admin Provider Advice Detail

attrs.description: Screen 14B (Admin Platform). Complete provider-advice record, its advice-window context and audited correction history, without attaching it to a patient log.

nodes.title: Transplant-Progress Monitoring Intake (Screen 1)

attrs.description: Creates a self-service case using information compatible with FR-011 standalone aftercare.

nodes.title: Transplant-Progress Dashboard and Calendar (Screen 2)

attrs.description: Shows the self-paced longitudinal record and case actions.

nodes.title: Daily Transplant-Progress Log (Screen 3)

attrs.description: Records a dated recovery observation with a consistent structure.

nodes.title: Head Scan Capture and History (Screen 4)

attrs.description: Captures and compares standardized scan photo sets within the self-service case.

nodes.title: Complete or Convert Monitoring Case (Screen 5)

attrs.description: Lets the patient end self-tracking or begin standalone-aftercare conversion.

nodes.title: Convert to Standalone Aftercare (Screen 6)

attrs.description: Reviews the pre-filled information and the monitoring PDF before continuing into FR-011 Screen 6, where the patient picks the package and pricing option.

nodes.title: Monitoring Summary and PDF Export (Screen 7)

attrs.description: Displays the completed or converted case and the downloadable report, read-only.

nodes.title: Admin Monitoring Case List (Screen 8)

attrs.description: Gives Admin support and oversight visibility.

nodes.title: Admin Monitoring Case Detail and Audit (Screen 9)

attrs.description: Supports audited correction and conversion support.

nodes.title: Acceptance legal copy and terms acknowledgment text

attrs.description: Legal copy and terms acknowledgment text shown at quote acceptance (consumer: FR-005). Versioned and edited on FR-026 Screen 8; Terms and Conditions, Privacy Policy and consent forms stay in FR-027. No seeded text: until the admin sets it, the quote acceptance action that needs the acknowledgment checkbox is blocked with a message.

nodes.title: Account deletion reason options

attrs.description: Ordered list of reasons offered when a patient requests account deletion; each has a requires-explanation flag and an active flag.

nodes.title: Activation link expiry

attrs.description: How long the one-time password setup link in the provider activation email stays valid (REQ-015-006, REQ-015-011).

nodes.title: Activation email resend limit

attrs.description: Maximum activation email resend requests per email address per hour (REQ-015-006, REQ-015-016).

nodes.title: Admin change reason length

attrs.description: Allowed length of the Reason for change an admin gives when saving provider data (REQ-015-025).

nodes.title: Admin concurrent sessions per user

attrs.description: Number of concurrent sessions allowed for one admin user (consumer: FR-031). Whole number from 1 to 5. Edited on FR-026 Screen 8.

nodes.title: Admin inactivity timeout

attrs.description: The standard admin inactivity timeout (consumer: FR-031). Whole minutes from 5 to 240. A Login as Provider session ends after its own fixed 30 minutes of inactivity (REQ-015-026) or when the admin's own session ends under this timeout, whichever comes first. Edited on FR-026 Screen 8.

nodes.title: Admin invitation token expiry

attrs.description: Lifetime of an admin team invitation token, configurable by Super Admin in A-09 settings; range 1-30 days, 7 days at launch. It applies to admin team invitations only.

nodes.title: Repeated access denial alert threshold

attrs.description: Refusals of one admin that trigger the Super Admin alert: 5 refusals at launch; an admin setting in A-09 (FR-031 Alternative Flow B5, Admin Editability). The time window is SET-admin-repeated-denial-window.

nodes.title: Repeated access denial time window

attrs.description: Time window in which the refusals of one admin are counted for the Super Admin alert: 10 minutes at launch; admin setting in A-09 (FR-031 Alternative Flow B5, Admin Editability).

nodes.title: Advice cadence

attrs.description: Single global advice cadence selected by Admin on Screen 13: weekly (7 days, the default) or bi-weekly (14 days). Applies to cases created after a change; each case keeps the cadence captured at creation. Placed under FR-037 because the PRD defines the control on its own Screen 13.

nodes.title: Affiliate payout day of month

attrs.description: Day of the month on which monthly affiliate payouts are processed. Admin-editable platform setting owned by FR-018 (PRD General Module Rules, Rule 5), edited on the Screen 1 Affiliate Program Settings panel (SCR-018-01); a whole number 1 to 28, applied from the next run; each save writes an audit entry. The payout stays monthly.

nodes.title: Affiliate performance tier bands

attrs.description: Revenue bands (trailing 12 months, USD) that set an affiliate's performance tier; an admin-editable platform setting edited on the Screen 1 Affiliate Program Settings panel (SCR-018-01); a change applies from the next monthly tier calculation and each save writes an audit entry.

nodes.title: Fixed fee paid to a provider who hands aftercare to the Hairline team

attrs.description: Fixed amount paid to the provider when the provider hands the aftercare to the Hairline aftercare team. In the treatment-linked flow there is no separate aftercare price, so Hairline pays it from its own revenue; in the add-on and standalone flows Hairline keeps the rest of the price. Admin-editable; a default of 0 means nothing is paid until the admin sets an amount.

nodes.title: Days before an unconfirmed plan escalates to the admin

attrs.description: Number of days before an unfinished aftercare plan is escalated to the admin, counted from the same starting points as the reminder. Admin-editable.

nodes.title: Days before the provider is reminded that no plan is confirmed

attrs.description: Number of days before the assignee gets a reminder that the aftercare plan is not finished. Counted from the FR-010 completion signal (treatment-linked), from payment (paid add-on) or from assignment (standalone); it restarts at a handover or an admin assignment. Admin-editable.

nodes.title: Default patient progress reminder

attrs.description: Default progress reminder sent to each patient once a month for 12 months after treatment. The patient may change the reminder or switch it off; the default is admin-editable (Communication Rule 4).
attrs.default: Once a month for 12 months after treatment

nodes.title: At Risk threshold

attrs.description: Whole days of provider inactivity after which a provider is At Risk.

nodes.title: Benchmark refresh frequency

attrs.description: How often benchmarks are refreshed: Daily, Weekly or Monthly.

nodes.title: Booking notification templates

attrs.description: Notification templates for booking events (booking.scheduled, booking.confirmed, booking.appointment_reminder), edited per event, channel and language in the FR-030 Template Editor (Screen 3). Booking confirmation and reminder content is configured here, not in FR-006.

nodes.title: Provider status cascade completion target

attrs.description: Target time for the idempotent background job of the A5 cancellation cascade, counted from the effective time.

nodes.title: Fixed amount deducted when a clinic cancels

attrs.description: Fixed amount deducted from the clinic's next payout when the clinic cancels (FR-017 Release Rule 7). Set by admins on Screen 7 (FR-029) as a fixed amount above 0, stated in the Fee Currency and stored together with its currency code, with no starting value; while it is not set no deduction is made. After a Default Currency change it is re-entered in the new currency before Screen 7 can be saved. FR-017 reads it. Applies on the day of the cancellation.

nodes.title: Commission rate

attrs.description: Platform global default commission percentage (allowed range 15-25%, precision 0.1%, the global model is always Percentage) plus provider-specific commission scopes (Percentage 0-100% or Flat Rate, Screen 5). The PRD names no default for the global value. The global rate also sets the commission on an aftercare payment when a provider delivers, as a percentage of the aftercare price (REQ-011-040).
attrs.unit: percent of booking total or, for an aftercare payment delivered by a provider, of the aftercare price (or fixed amount per completed procedure for Flat Rate)

nodes.title: Future phase: Conversation export controls

attrs.description: Future phase: which admin roles may export conversations, configurable only within restrictions; admin conversation export is deferred (Admin Editability, Configurable with Restrictions).

nodes.title: Country calling codes

attrs.description: Calling code per country in the format +[1-4 digits]; codes may be shared by several countries.

nodes.title: Country list

attrs.description: Centrally managed list of countries (name, ISO code, flag asset URL, display order, active flag) used by patient and provider forms.

nodes.title: Default channel policies

attrs.description: Stub created during FR-020 migration; detail arrives when FR-030 migrates. Default per-event channel routing (email, push, SMS) applied when a notification is dispatched. Editable by Admin (PRD Admin Editability).

nodes.title: System default currency

attrs.description: The enabled currency that is the system default (Screen 6). The MVP seed value is USD. FR-017 Screen 1 initializes its reporting currency from it, and a change creates a new FR-026 Quote Configuration version.

nodes.title: Default seat limit

attrs.description: Maximum team size per provider organization, configured by admins in FR-015; adjustable 1-500. Stub created during FR-009 migration.

nodes.title: Deposit percentage

attrs.description: Deposit percentage of the booking total, configured globally or per provider (Screen 3); a provider-specific rate is reset to the global default, never deleted. Allowed range 20-30%, precision 0.1%, fixed in code. The PRD names no default (25% appears only as an example). New bookings only: existing bookings keep their rate.

nodes.title: Balance due days

attrs.description: How many days before the procedure date the balance of the deposit-now, balance-later option is due; whole number of days from 1 to 30, admin-editable on Screen 7 (PRD Screen 7, Balance Due Days). A booking confirmed with this many days left, or fewer, gets full payment only. Locked at booking confirmation: FR-007 stores the balance due date on the booking then, so a later change never moves it. Read by FR-006 and FR-007.

nodes.title: Discovery question answer options

attrs.description: Ordered list of answer options for the "How did you find out about us?" question, each active or inactive.

nodes.title: Documentation completion deadline

attrs.description: Treatment documentation completion deadline, counted from the moment the End Treatment gate is first met; admin can adjust within 12 to 48 hours. Owner is FR-010 because only the FR-010 PRD states it (ownership question for FR-026).

nodes.title: Documentation reminder timing

attrs.description: Timing of the first reminder when documentation is not completed, counted from the moment the End Treatment gate is first met; range 1 hour up to the deadline minus 1 hour, so it is always earlier than the deadline; admin configurable. Owner is FR-010 because only the FR-010 PRD states it.

nodes.title: Dormant threshold

attrs.description: Whole days of inactivity after which a provider is Dormant; must be greater than the At Risk threshold.

nodes.title: Emergency intervention permissions

attrs.description: Which admin roles hold emergency intervention permission; restricted to authorized admin roles only (Admin Editability, Configurable with Restrictions).

nodes.title: Escalation routing rules

attrs.description: Escalation routing rules, configurable only within allowed destinations and roles (Admin Editability, Configurable with Restrictions).

nodes.title: Featured provider cap

attrs.description: Maximum number of Active providers that may be featured at once (General Module Rule 8).

nodes.title: Free-text translation switch

attrs.description: One platform-wide switch, controlled by the Super Admin only, that turns machine translation of free text between users on or off for the reader (PRD General Module Rule 15, REQ-021-119). It uses the provider the Super Admin chooses for free text, or the single Connected provider; with no Connected provider, free text is shown untranslated.

nodes.title: Free-text translation monthly budget

attrs.description: Monthly budget the Super Admin configures for free-text translation, in the platform currency and counted per calendar month in UTC; the PRD gives no default figure. A blank budget means free text is shown untranslated and zero stops translation. At the limit the Super Admin is notified once and free text is shown untranslated until the next month (PRD General Module Rule 16, REQ-021-120).

nodes.title: Global default markup percentage

attrs.description: Default markup on currency conversion for pairs without a per-pair override. Range 0-20%, precision 0.01%. The PRD names no default (5% appears only as an example).

nodes.title: Global default sync frequency

attrs.description: Default sync interval for auto-fetch pairs: 1h, 3h, 6h, 12h or 24h. The PRD names no default (6h appears only as an example).

nodes.title: Head scan minimum blur score

attrs.description: Lowest blur score (0 to 100) a head scan photo may have and still pass the basic quality check (consumer: FR-002 REQ-002-034, REQ-002-050). Whole number; a photo passes when both its brightness and its blur score reach their minimum. Edited on FR-026 Screen 8.

nodes.title: Head scan minimum brightness score

attrs.description: Lowest brightness score (0 to 100) a head scan photo may have and still pass the basic quality check (consumer: FR-002 REQ-002-034, REQ-002-050). Whole number; a photo passes when both its brightness and its blur score reach their minimum. Edited on FR-026 Screen 8.

nodes.title: Head video duration limits

attrs.description: Minimum and maximum duration of a head video; not used until head video ships (consumer: FR-002 REQ-002-035). Edited on FR-026 Screen 8; the PRD fixes no value.

nodes.title: Hold-expiring-soon reminder lead time

attrs.description: Hours before a slot hold ends at which the hold-expiring-soon reminder is sent. Whole hours from 1 up to half of the slot-hold duration.

nodes.title: Inquiry cancellation reason options

attrs.description: Ordered list of reasons offered when a patient cancels an inquiry; each has a requires-explanation flag and an active flag. Consumer FR-003 Screen 8a.

nodes.title: Minimum inquiry lead time

attrs.description: Versioned minimum inquiry lead time: whole days from 0 through 730, applied to the calendar and to submission validation. Consumer FR-003 Screen 5.

nodes.title: Installment late payment grace period

attrs.description: Late payment grace period (0-14 days, starting at 0, FR-029 Screen 4), counted from the installment due date: reminders and automatic retries run during it, and the late payment fee is charged once after it has passed and the retries have ended. A missed installment is cancelled only by the unpaid balance cancellation point, never by this setting. Locked at booking confirmation.

nodes.title: Landing background images

attrs.description: Background images that rotate behind the patient landing screen (FR-001). Image assets only; rotation follows the admin configuration. With none set, no background images are shown. Edited on FR-026 Screen 8.

nodes.title: Language/locale catalog

attrs.description: Supported locale catalog: drives language selectors, import and export targets, fallback order and coverage reports (PRD Data Dependencies). FR-021 owns the catalog semantics; FR-026 may surface it through the App Settings shell but is not the source of truth; FR-032 consumes it for provider spoken-language choices. Stub created during FR-032 migration; detail added by FR-021 migration.

nodes.title: Late payment fee

attrs.description: Fee charged once when the grace period (counted from the due date) has passed with the installment unpaid and the automatic retries have ended; collected with the next successful charge and kept outside the clinic share and the refund base. A type (fixed amount above 0 in the Fee Currency, converted via USD with the rate set locked at quote acceptance, or a percentage above 0 and up to 100 of the late installment) plus a value, admin-editable on Screen 7. It starts as Not set and no fee is charged while it is not set. Locked at booking confirmation, a fixed amount together with its currency code; a booking confirmed while it is not set keeps no late fee. Hairline keeps it; it changes no provider payout.

nodes.title: Legal acceptance rules: who must accept and when enforcement applies

attrs.description: Admin-configurable acceptance rules. The audience of each document type is fixed (REQ-027-021); the setting can only switch the acceptance requirement of a type off for an audience, and cannot widen the audience or change the gated actions. Edited in the Legal settings panel on Screen 1 (REQ-027-059). Unset: the fixed audience applies. FR-027 owns this setting (CL-5).

nodes.title: Acceptance coverage threshold

attrs.description: Acceptance Rate of the Current version below which the Admin is notified and the document list shows a warning banner. Edited in the Legal settings panel on Screen 1 (REQ-027-059). Unset: no banner and no alert. FR-027 owns this setting (CL-5).
attrs.default: Unset means no banner and no alert

nodes.title: Acceptance export limit

attrs.description: Maximum CSV exports per Admin per day from the acceptance dashboard and detail list. Edited in the Legal settings panel on Screen 1 (REQ-027-059). Unset: CSV export is blocked (CL-5).

nodes.title: Reminder limit for pending acceptance

attrs.description: Maximum reminders per user per version. Edited in the Legal settings panel on Screen 1 (REQ-027-059). Unset: no reminders are sent (CL-5).

nodes.title: Account lockout duration

attrs.description: Minutes an account stays locked after exceeding the allowed failed attempts. Permitted 5 through 60.

nodes.title: Max login attempts before lockout

attrs.description: Failed login attempts allowed before the account is locked. Permitted 1 through 10. One shared Setting for patients, providers and admins. One failed-attempt counter per account is shared by sign-in and verification-code entry; it resets after a successful sign-in or code entry and when a lockout ends, and a lowered limit applies from the next failed attempt (REQ-026-145).

nodes.title: Messaging notification preferences and quiet hours

attrs.description: Admin-editable notification preferences and quiet-hours policy for messaging alerts (Admin Editability).

nodes.title: Moderation keyword and phrase flags

attrs.description: Admin-editable list of keywords and phrases that trigger automatic keyword flags and moderation or escalation cues in conversations, edited in the Moderation settings group on Screen 5 (REQ-012-105). The list starts empty and the admin team fills it before go-live. Provisional owner FR-012; the PRD does not name another owner.

nodes.title: General notification templates

attrs.description: Stub created during FR-020 migration; detail arrives when FR-030 migrates. Titles, messages and templates for email, push and SMS, edited in the FR-030 Notification Template Editor with dynamic variables, multi-language content, rich text (email) and preview. OTP email templates are managed in FR-026.

nodes.title: Notification throttling thresholds

attrs.description: Maximum number of notifications one recipient receives per hour (REQ-030-017): notices over the limit are held and sent in order in the next hour, and locked critical notices are never held. Also holds the thresholds that decide when excessive events in a short window are coalesced, deferred or suppressed (FR-020 REQ-020-006, Alternative Flow B1). Editable by Admin.

nodes.title: OTP code length

attrs.description: Number of digits in an OTP code. Fixed in codebase, not admin-editable.

nodes.title: OTP email templates

attrs.description: Verification Email and Password Reset Email templates: subject line, HTML body, plain text body, required variables.

nodes.title: OTP expiry time

attrs.description: Minutes an OTP stays valid; one value for email verification and password reset. Permitted 5 through 30.

nodes.title: OTP maximum resend attempts

attrs.description: Maximum OTP resend requests per rolling 60 minutes. Permitted 3 through 10.

nodes.title: OTP resend cooldown

attrs.description: Seconds a user must wait between OTP resend requests. Permitted 30 through 300.

nodes.title: Outstanding invoice alert threshold

attrs.description: Number of days overdue after which an outstanding patient invoice raises an alert (FR-017 Admin Editability). Defaults to 7 days.

nodes.title: Package creation rate limit

attrs.description: Maximum new packages per provider per hour; a whole number of 1 or more. A new record counts once, when it is first saved as Active or Inactive, and a clone counts; saving as a draft does not count. There is no total limit on how many packages a provider can create (Admin Editability Rules, Provider Editability Rules).

nodes.title: Password policy

attrs.description: Defined by REQ-SYS-007. FR-026 holds this Setting only as the stored value other FRs read; it is not editable on FR-026 screens. Minimum 12 characters with at least one uppercase, lowercase, digit and special character.

nodes.title: Patient cancellation fee split percentage

attrs.description: Percentage 0-100 of a patient cancellation fee kept by Hairline; the rest goes to the clinic (FR-017 Release Rule 7, FR-007 REQ-007-092). Set on Screen 7 with no starting value; it may be Not set, and while it is not set Hairline keeps the whole fee and holders of the Screen 7 permission see a banner on the admin dashboard asking them to set it, which clears when the share is saved. Applies on the day of the cancellation.

nodes.title: Patient confirmation window after procedure completion

attrs.description: Time the patient has to confirm or dispute a procedure the clinic marked complete; no answer means automatic release (FR-017 Release Rule 1). Editable admin setting on Screen 7, whole number of days from 1 to 30; applies on the day of the event.

nodes.title: Payment reminder timing

attrs.description: When the final payment reminders go out: whole days from 0 to 14 before the due date, up to 3 reminders. Owned by FR-007 and read by FR-030 and FR-017.
attrs.default: 3 days before the due date and on the due date

nodes.title: Payout cutoff day

attrs.description: Day of the week on which the settlement statement is generated for manual-rail clinics; one platform-wide value (FR-017 Fund Release and Payout Rules, Release Rule 3). Admin-editable; must differ from the payout day, and Screen 7 refuses a save that sets both to the same day.

nodes.title: Payout day

attrs.description: Day of the week on which approved settlement statements are paid for manual-rail clinics; one platform-wide value (FR-017 Fund Release and Payout Rules, Release Rule 3). Admin-editable; must differ from the cutoff day, and Screen 7 refuses a save that sets both to the same day.

nodes.title: Payout execution timing window

attrs.description: "Payout execution timing windows (e.g., business days)": configurable with restrictions. Owner FR-017 is provisional; the PRD does not name an owner.

nodes.title: Photo maximum count per case

attrs.description: Per-case limit on uploaded photos and head scan photo sets; admin configurable. The PRD gives no default value.

nodes.title: Photo maximum file size

attrs.description: Maximum size per uploaded treatment photo; part of the admin-editable photo upload limits.

nodes.title: Post-intervention auto-flag for follow-up

attrs.description: Whether the system raises a system flag with category Follow-Up Needed after an emergency intervention; default on, edited in the Moderation settings group on Screen 5 (REQ-012-089, REQ-012-105).

nodes.title: Price outlier threshold

attrs.description: Whole percent difference from the benchmark that marks a price as an outlier. Permitted 1 through 100.

nodes.title: Inquiry problem-duration options

attrs.description: Ordered list of problem-duration options (label, display order, active flag) offered in the inquiry's detailed information step. Starting values, editable by Admin: Less than 6 months; 6 to 12 months; 1 to 2 years; 2 to 5 years; More than 5 years. Edited on FR-026 Screen 5c; consumer FR-003 Screen 3.

nodes.title: Profile photo accepted formats

attrs.description: File formats a patient may upload as a profile photo (read by FR-001 REQ-001-082). Edited on FR-026 Screen 8.

nodes.title: Profile photo maximum size

attrs.description: Largest profile photo a patient may upload (read by FR-001 REQ-001-082). Edited on FR-026 Screen 8.

nodes.title: Promotion approval auto-decline window

attrs.description: Business days before an unanswered provider approval auto-declines; the default of 3 business days is shown on the program form.

nodes.title: Promotion code format policy

attrs.description: Format rules for promotion codes. Admin Editability Rules, PRD line 745.

nodes.title: Conversion Lift minimum quotes per side

attrs.description: Minimum number of quotes on each side (with and without the promotion) before Conversion Lift is shown; below it the lift is not shown. Admin Editability Rules and Screen 6 Analytics Definitions.

nodes.title: Promotion discount categories

attrs.description: Discount categories an admin may use for programs. Admin Editability Rules, PRD line 745.

nodes.title: Promotion maximum discount value

attrs.description: One maximum-discount-value Setting; it also carries the per policy and region limit. Applies to percentage discounts only; fixed-amount discounts have no cap. Admin Editability Rules.

nodes.title: Promotion notification templates

attrs.description: Notification templates for approvals and status, managed in FR-030 (promotion notification templates).

nodes.title: Provider creation rate limit

attrs.description: Maximum provider creations per admin per hour (Implementation Notes, Security Considerations). A fixed platform setting: not editable in the admin console and not listed on FR-026 Screen 8.

nodes.title: Provider notification types

attrs.description: Notification types offered in provider notification preferences (consumers: FR-032, FR-020). Core types quote, schedule, treatment, aftercare and review cannot be removed. Seeded with the five core types. Edited on FR-026 Screen 8.

nodes.title: Provider response window

attrs.description: Time providers have to respond to a distributed inquiry (configurable).

nodes.title: Default sort order for provider search

attrs.description: Admin-editable default sort order for patient provider search; options Recommended, Rating, Price, Experience; it is the default of the Sort By control on FR-003 Screen 7a, and Recommended applies until an admin changes it. Edited on the FR-026 app settings screens. [P2 - Post-MVP]

nodes.title: Provider specialties

attrs.description: Ordered list of specialty values providers can hold; seeded with Hair Transplant Surgeon, Dermatologist, Trichologist, Plastic Surgeon, Other.

nodes.title: Quote expiring-soon lead time

attrs.description: Hours before a quote expires at which the quote-expiring-soon reminder is sent. Whole hours from 1 up to half of the quote expiry window.

nodes.title: Quote expiry window

attrs.description: Hours a sent quote stays valid. Whole hours from 24 to 336.

nodes.title: Rate protection threshold

attrs.description: Percentage by which an auto-fetch pair's rate may differ from its rate 24 hours earlier before the pair is flagged yellow and admins are alerted; the flag clears only when an admin acknowledges it, after which the pair is compared with the rate at the acknowledgement until the 24-hour change is again within the threshold. No comparison runs for 24 hours after a pair is created or switched between modes. Range 1-50%, precision 0.1%. The PRD names no default (3% appears only as an example).

nodes.title: Refund ladder

attrs.description: Refund percentage by how many days before the procedure date the booking is cancelled; one global band table, percentage 0-100 per band, admin-editable on Screen 7 and locked at booking confirmation. Read by FR-006, FR-007, FR-007B and FR-017. The base amount the percentage applies to is not defined in the PRD.
attrs.default: More than 30 days 90 percent; 15 to 30 days 50 percent; under 15 days 0 percent

nodes.title: Rescheduling fee

attrs.description: Fee for rescheduling a booking: a type (fixed amount above 0 in the Fee Currency, converted via USD with the rate set locked at quote acceptance, or a percentage above 0 and up to 100) plus a value, admin-editable on Screen 7. It starts as Not set and no fee is charged while it is not set. Locked at booking confirmation, a fixed amount together with its currency code; a booking confirmed while it is not set keeps no rescheduling fee. Hairline keeps it; it changes no provider payout. It never applies to a change an admin makes in V1; what a percentage is taken of is decided together with patient-side rescheduling.

nodes.title: Retention period by data category

attrs.description: Retention policy per data category (Medical Records, Financial Records, Communications, Media, Account Profile, Analytics) with legal basis and per-jurisdiction overrides, configured by Admin. Every category defaults to the one 10-year period of the system PRD (REQ-SYS-002) and cannot be set below it; a jurisdiction override may only extend the period (REQ-023-045). The PRD names module A-09 for the configuration and no FR-026 setting; FR-023 owns the policy itself.

nodes.title: Re-verification threshold

attrs.description: How long after a patient's last successful sign-in the patient must confirm identity again before a sensitive action (FR-001 Screens 14, 16 and 18). Whole minutes from 1 to 60. Edited on FR-026 Screen 8.

nodes.title: Review category labels

attrs.description: Admin-editable labels for the category ratings (facility, staff, results, value) used by review forms and displays; the canonical keys stay fixed.

nodes.title: Review flagging thresholds

attrs.description: Duplicate, spam and keyword flag settings, within restricted safe ranges approved by policy.

nodes.title: Review photo guidelines text

attrs.description: Patient-facing photo upload guidance shown on the review form; required; edits are audit-logged.

nodes.title: Review removal reason catalog

attrs.description: Standard reasons for admin removals and redactions; at least one active reason.

nodes.title: Takedown request SLA settings

attrs.description: Queue priority and SLA target for takedown decisions, plus the takedown decision deadline, from 12 hours to 7 days. The deadline defaults to 48 hours; a breach shows Overdue and notifies admins.

nodes.title: Maximum search results per page (admin and provider lists)

attrs.description: Admin-editable default page size for admin and provider lists; default 25, range 10-100. A screen whose owning FR states its own page size or selector keeps it (FR-015 Screen 1 at 50, FR-016 selectable 25, 50 or 100, FR-024 at 20). The patient app is fixed at 10 results per page and is not governed by this setting. Edited on the FR-026 app settings screens.

nodes.title: Settlement period

attrs.description: The one settlement period that applies to all manually paid clinics (manual bank transfer rail); there is no per-clinic value and it does not apply on the Stripe Connect rail (PRD Screen 7, Settlement Period). Weekly only in V1, because FR-017 runs a weekly cycle; admins edit only the cutoff day and the payout day, which are SET-payout-cutoff-day and SET-payout-day.

nodes.title: Slot-hold duration

attrs.description: Hours a slot hold lasts once placed. Whole hours from 24 to 168.

nodes.title: SMS enablement

attrs.description: Stub created during FR-020 migration; detail arrives when FR-030 migrates. Admin switch that enables the SMS channel for urgent events. The PRD says SMS is not available in MVP and is enabled by a later phase (see the open question on REQ-020-003).

nodes.title: High-priority categories allowed for SMS

attrs.description: Stub created during FR-020 migration; detail arrives when FR-030 migrates. Which urgent categories may use SMS. Configurable with restrictions (PRD Admin Editability); the restrictions are not stated in the PRD.

nodes.title: Maximum SMS volume

attrs.description: Stub created during FR-020 migration; detail arrives when FR-030 migrates. Cap on SMS sent, so SMS cost stays controlled. Configurable with restrictions (PRD Admin Editability); the restrictions are not stated in the PRD.

nodes.title: Split payment configuration

attrs.description: Split payment (installment) configuration of Screen 4: feature enabled switch, offered installment counts (2 to 9), cutoff days (30-90, default 30), minimum booking amount ($100-$10,000, stated in USD) and late payment grace period (0-14 days, starting at 0 = none, counted from the due date). Installment frequency is fixed at monthly (30-day intervals): the first installment is due on the booking day and the next ones every 30 days, so the minimum lead time for installments is cutoff + 30 days. The PRD names no defaults other than 30 cutoff days.

nodes.title: Status change reason length

attrs.description: Allowed length of the reason for suspension, deactivation, reactivation and cancelling a scheduled change (Screens 4 and 5).

nodes.title: Support case auto-closure period

attrs.description: Days a Resolved support case waits for a patient reply before it closes automatically. Options Immediately, 3, 7 or 14 days (FR-034 REQ-034-061/062; FR-035 lines 394, 412, 473). The admin picks it per case in the Auto-Close After field of Screen 4 (REQ-034-140), default 7; Super Admin does not set it on Screen 7 (REQ-034-087).

nodes.title: Case inactivity threshold

attrs.description: Days with no activity before a case is flagged for admin review and potential closure. Editable by Super Admin on Screen 7 within 7 to 90 days.

nodes.title: Support emergency contact email address

attrs.description: Emergency email address shown read-only with tap-to-compose on the patient Help & Support Hub (FR-035 Screen 1). No default; at least one of phone and email must be set (REQ-026-143); FR-035 assumes the admin sets it before go-live. Edited on FR-026 Screen 8.

nodes.title: Support emergency contact phone number

attrs.description: Emergency phone number shown read-only with tap-to-call on the patient Help & Support Hub (FR-035 Screen 1). No default; at least one of phone and email must be set (REQ-026-143); FR-035 assumes the admin sets it before go-live. Edited on FR-026 Screen 8.

nodes.title: High priority escalation threshold

attrs.description: Hours before an Open or In Progress high priority case with no status change auto-escalates once to all Super Admins; the clock starts when the case is High and restarts on any status change; a stall alarm, separate from the resolution targets. Editable by Super Admin on Screen 7 within 12 to 72 hours.

nodes.title: Urgent unassigned escalation threshold

attrs.description: Hours before an Open or In Progress urgent case that is still unassigned auto-escalates once to all Super Admins; the clock starts when the case is Urgent and unassigned and stops on assignment (the FR-030 notice `support.urgent_case_unassigned` goes to the Support Staff pool first, after a fixed 1 hour). Editable by Super Admin on Screen 7 within 1 to 48 hours.

nodes.title: Supported payment methods and currencies

attrs.description: Payment methods enabled or disabled by admin per region and currency (FR-029 Screen 1, Enabled Payment Methods). A method is offered only in a currency the account supports, checked against the charge currency (USD when the USD fallback applies). FR-007 reads it; FR-007B owns the payment-method records.

nodes.title: System-wide default starting price

attrs.description: One default starting price (one amount and its currency), set by admins on the pricing screen (Screen 2) and stored as the system-wide record of ENT-pricing-default; empty until an admin sets it. Shown when no specific or fallback price applies, before any converted price is used.

nodes.title: Target monthly commission

attrs.description: Optional platform target for monthly commission shown as a reference line in FR-014; blank hides the line.

nodes.title: Timezone options

attrs.description: Timezone choices: every whole-hour offset from GMT-12 to GMT+14, each with its offset and a city example such as "(GMT+3) Istanbul" (consumers: FR-032, FR-021). Edited on FR-026 Screen 8. Offered to patients and providers only; admin screens use the admin's browser timezone (REQ-026-050).

nodes.title: Translation bundle stale window

attrs.description: Maximum acceptable time clients may serve an outdated translation bundle after a publish or rollback; platform-configurable (PRD Business Rules, Rule 13).
attrs.default: 5 (PRD recommends 5 minutes or less; not a fixed default)

nodes.title: Translation import file size limit

attrs.description: Maximum size of a JSON translation file accepted by import; configured by the platform (PRD Screen 8, File row). The PRD gives no value.

nodes.title: Transplant-progress reminder defaults

attrs.description: Patient reminder defaults for transplant-progress monitoring. Reminders are on by default with this schedule and cannot become mandatory milestones or compliance checks. The default schedule is set by admins in the FR-030 notification settings (REQ-030-225); FR-038 only refers to it. The patient may change or switch off their own reminders, and reminders stop when the case is completed or converted.
attrs.default: once a month for 12 months from the case creation date

nodes.title: Inquiry treatment-area options

attrs.description: Ordered list of treatment-area options (label, image or icon asset, active flag) offered on inquiry creation. Seeded with Hair, Beard and Both (REQ-003-120).

nodes.title: Treatment creation rate limit

attrs.description: Maximum new treatments per admin per hour; a whole number of 1 or more. A new record counts once, when it is first saved as Active or Inactive; saving as a draft does not count (Admin Editability Rules, Security Considerations).

nodes.title: Treatment type options

attrs.description: Managed list of treatment types maintained by admins on Screen 6; the Treatment Type field on Screens 1 and 2 chooses from exactly this list. Initial values: FUE, FUT, DHI, Sapphire FUE, Robotic, Other.

nodes.title: Time-to-first-quote SLA target

attrs.description: Platform-wide target for time to first quote, in positive whole minutes.

nodes.title: Unpaid balance cancellation point

attrs.description: The number of days after the oldest unpaid due date (the due date of the oldest installment or balance that is unpaid right now; paying it late restarts the count from the next unpaid one) at which a booking that still has any unpaid balance (the deposit and balance option, or installments) is cancelled (FR-006 Alternative Flow B8). Whole number from 1 to 30, smaller than both the balance due days and the installment cutoff; Screen 7 refuses a save that breaks this and warns, without refusing, when the point falls before the day the late payment fee would be charged. It has no starting value and may be Not set; while it is not set nothing is cancelled for non-payment. It applies only to bookings confirmed after it is set and is locked at booking confirmation.

attrs.summary: FR-003 change request recording automatic redistribution before acceptance, its patient confirmation step and the redistribution state fields. Linked to REQ-003-021 as a documented exception to the rule that decided-by Sources are meeting and decision items.

nodes.title: Operations

nodes.title: Pending

attrs.description: Affiliate partner account exists and is waiting to be activated.

nodes.title: Active

attrs.description: Affiliate partner is active and can use the portal, codes and payouts.

nodes.title: Suspended

attrs.description: Affiliate partner access is paused.

nodes.title: Inactive

attrs.description: Affiliate partner has left the program and the account is closed.

nodes.title: Recovery plan

attrs.description: An aftercare plan starts, either after Hairline treatment or as a standalone aftercare service.

nodes.title: Follow-up

attrs.description: Patient's recovery is followed against the aftercare plan.

nodes.title: Discharge

attrs.description: Aftercare ends and the patient leaves the plan.

nodes.title: Inquiry

attrs.description: Patient submits a treatment inquiry and it is distributed to providers.

nodes.title: Quote

attrs.description: Providers prepare and send quotes in response to an inquiry.

nodes.title: Acceptance

attrs.description: Patient compares the quotes received and accepts one.

nodes.title: Confirmed

attrs.description: The accepted quote becomes a confirmed procedure booking.

nodes.title: Payment

attrs.description: Patient pays for the booked procedure.

nodes.title: In progress

attrs.description: Provider performs and documents the procedure.

nodes.title: Aftercare

attrs.description: Treated patient receives post-procedure recovery support.

nodes.title: Monitoring

attrs.description: Patient's progress is tracked after treatment.

nodes.title: Review and close

attrs.description: Patient reviews the provider and the treatment case is closed.

nodes.title: Baseline

attrs.description: Patient starts a self-service monitoring case and records a starting point.

nodes.title: Tracking

attrs.description: Patient records monitoring entries over time.

nodes.title: Conversion

attrs.description: Patient moves from monitoring into a treatment inquiry or into a standalone aftercare request.

nodes.title: Registered

attrs.description: Patient has created an account.

nodes.title: Profile complete

attrs.description: Patient has completed the profile needed to use the platform.

nodes.title: Active

attrs.description: Patient is using the platform.

nodes.title: Dormant

attrs.description: Patient account has had no activity for a period.

nodes.title: Deleted

attrs.description: Patient account has been deleted.

nodes.title: Deletion requested

attrs.description: Patient has asked to delete the account and the request is pending.

nodes.title: Statement

attrs.description: A settlement statement is prepared for the provider's released bookings.

nodes.title: Approval

attrs.description: Admin reviews and approves the settlement statement.

nodes.title: Transfer

attrs.description: The approved amount is transferred to the provider.

nodes.title: All stages

attrs.description: Platform-wide behaviour that is not tied to one point of any journey.

nodes.title: Invited

nodes.title: Onboarding

attrs.description: Provider completes setup before going live.

nodes.title: Active

nodes.title: Offboarded

Backlog points settled for FR-032: flow label uniqueness, audit steps in the phone-only and timezone-only flows, password change date writer, vestigial account settings entity retired, distinct step title.

Backlog points settled for FR-033: queue-and-sync failure rule added; virus-scan branch made the only path after each upload (attachments and thumbnails included); soft-delete, content-kind change and restore steps tied to their rules; patient video source choice reaches the upload step.
